zh: 专为大力神 II GLV 服务塔设计的双子座飞船专用脐带缆。安装在大力神 II 塔架脐带缆的大折角摆臂款式顶部。脐带管长度可通过展开限制滑块进行调节。

s: A custom umbilical for the Titan II GLV Service Tower, with three switchable arm styles. For reference, from the top down, there were two large angled arms, then two large straight arms, then a small beam arm, then at the bottom another large straight arm. The separate Gemini Spacecraft umbilical attaches to the top of the large angled arm style. Umbilical pipe is adjustable in length using the deploy limit slider.
zh: 大力神 II GLV 服务塔的定制脐带缆，具有三种可切换的摆臂样式。作为参考，从上到下依次为：两个大折角摆臂、两个大直臂、一个小横梁臂，最底部则是另一个大直臂。独立的双子座飞船脐带缆安装在大折角摆臂样式的顶部。脐带管长度可通过展开限制滑块进行调节。

s: A special droop-style Gemini Spacecraft umbilical for the Titan II GLV Service Tower. It attaches to the top of the large angled arm style of the Titan II Tower Umbilical. Umbilical has an extension tube that is adjustable in length using the deploy limit slider.
zh: 专为大力神 II GLV 服务塔设计的垂坠式双子座飞船专用脐带缆。安装在大力神 II 塔架脐带缆的大折角摆臂款式顶部。脐带缆配有延长管，可通过展开限制滑块调节长度。

s: A custom droop-style umbilical for the Titan II GLV Service Tower, with three switchable arm styles. For reference, from the top down, there were two large angled arms, then two large straight arms, then a small beam arm, then at the bottom another large straight arm. The separate Gemini Spacecraft umbilical attaches to the top of the large angled arm style. Umbilical has an extension tube that is adjustable in length using the deploy limit slider.
zh: 大力神 II GLV 服务塔的定制垂坠式脐带缆，具有三种可切换的摆臂样式。作为参考，从上到下依次为：两个大折角摆臂、两个大直臂、一个小横梁臂，最底部则是另一个大直臂。独立的双子座飞船脐带缆安装在大折角摆臂样式的顶部。脐带缆配有延长管，可通过展开限制滑块调节长度。

s: The auxiliary structure used for the Titan II and IV, mounted on the mobile launch platform and positioned to be directly in front of the main fixed tower. The mast has multiple height variants and 8 color options. The top portion can be swutched between the older solid structure type, the later open-truss type, and the open-truss with a small plate on the front. The center trusses have attach nodes for attaching umbilicals and swing arms if desired.
zh: 用于大力神 II 和 IV 的辅助结构，安装在移动发射平台上，位置正对主固定塔架前方。桅杆具有多种高度变体和 8 种颜色选项。顶部结构可在早期实体结构型、后期开放桁架型以及带正面小板的开放桁架型之间切换。中心桁架配有连接节点，可根据需要安装脐带缆和摆臂。

s: The companion service tower for the Vanguard Launch Stand, attaching to one of the outer nodes. The tower is sized for the BDB Vanguard rocket with the stand placed at ground level, with half-height (9m) and full-height (18m) variants. The base frame and top beam can be toggled off to allow stacking of multiple tower sections. The front detail structure can also be turned off. 9 color options are also available. Uses separate umbilicals which are node-attached.
zh: 先锋号发射台的配套服务塔，安装在外部节点之一。塔架尺寸适配放置在地面高度发射台上的 BDB 先锋号火箭，提供半高（9m）和全高（18m）变体。底座框架和顶部横梁均可关闭，以便堆叠多个塔段。正面细节结构亦可关闭。还提供 9 种颜色选项。使用独立的节点连接式脐带缆。

s: Saturn V animated retracting hold-down arm. Four were used on the Saturn Launcher Base, placed in between the F-1 engine fairings. Retraction can be done manually or by staging with Animated Decouplers.
zh: 土星 5 号带动画收回的固定臂。土星发射台上共使用四组，布置在 <<M0>> 发动机整流罩之间。可通过手动或配合 Animated Decouplers 模组编入分级来触发收回。

s: A distinctive feature of the Saturn tower was this hammerhead crane that sat on the very top. This crane has no hoist capability, but it can be rotated up to 180 degrees via an animation; set the rotation limit to 50 to rotate only 90 degrees to the launch position. For launches, the crane was rotated 90 degree in the clockwise direction. A gray variant is also available. The lightning mast on top can be switched between the original Saturn tower mast or the new Shuttle mast, which was first used for the ASTP Saturn IB launch, or can be turned off.
zh: 土星塔架最顶端的锤头起重机是其标志性特征。该起重机没有吊装功能，但可通过动画旋转最多 180 度；将旋转限制设为 50 即可恰好旋转 90 度至发射位置。发射时，起重机会顺时针旋转 90 度。还提供灰色变体。顶部的避雷桅杆可在原始土星塔架桅杆与首次用于 ASTP 土星 1B 发射的新型航天飞机桅杆之间切换，亦可将其关闭。

s: The "Milkstool", as it was nicknamed, was a stand created to allow the Saturn IB-Apollo to use the Saturn V's Launch Umbilical Tower on LC 39. The three Skylab crews and the Apollo CSM for the Apollo-Soyuz Test Project were launched from LC 39 with the milkstool. In reality it was a gray color, but a red variant is also available as an alternative. Attach the milkstool to a bottom center node of a rocket, then attach the launcher base to the bottom node of the milkstool. The center ring at top has switchable hold-down arm support and node arrangements. There is a built-in decoupler for separating the milkstool from a rocket for liftoff.
zh: 这台被戏称为“挤奶凳”的发射架，旨在让土星 1B-阿波罗能够在 39 号发射工位上使用土星 5 号的发射脐带塔。三次天空实验室乘组任务和阿波罗-联盟测试计划中的阿波罗 CSM 均是通过“挤奶凳”从 39 号工位发射升空。现实中它呈灰色，但也提供红色变体可选。将挤奶凳安装到火箭的底部中心节点，然后将发射底座安装到挤奶凳的底部节点。顶部的中心环具有可切换的固定臂支撑及节点布局。内置分离器，用于在起飞时将挤奶凳与火箭分离。

s: Three of these tail service masts were located on the launcher base, connected to the lower part of the S-IC stage of the Saturn V, and were retracted at liftoff. These have to be placed separately, and attach to nodes right outside the flame hole, two on one side, and one on the other side. Rotate them 5 degrees to have them properly aligned with the S-IC.
zh: 发射台基座上布置有三座此类尾部勤务桅杆，连接至土星5号的S-IC级下部，并在起飞时缩回。它们需要单独放置，并安装在排焰口外侧的节点上（一侧两个，另一侧一个）。将其旋转5度以与S-IC对齐。

s: A separate version of the original Saturn tower lightning mast that was mounted on the hammerhead crane, for use with other towers. Red and gray versions can be selected, and the mounting plate can be turned off.
zh: 原版土星发射塔避雷针的独立版本，原本安装在锤头起重机上，现可用于其他发射塔。可选择红色和灰色版本，安装底板也可关闭。

s: A standalone launch clamp version of the Saturn "Milkstool", with two height variants: the regular tall version and an alternate short one, both with two color options. The center ring at top has switchable hold-down arm support pads, which can be adjusted horizontally with the deploy limit slider. The railings on the ring can also be turned off.
zh: 土星“挤奶凳”的独立发射架版本，有两种高度变体：常规高版与备选矮版，均提供两种配色方案。顶部中心环具有可切换的压紧臂支承垫，可通过开启限制滑块进行水平调节。环上的栏杆也可以关闭。

s: Angled base section of the modular Saturn launch tower, with two color options: classic red and new gray. The base has two independent crew elevators, each with four switchable maximum height options; elevators can also be turned off. Adjust the deploy limit of the elevators to make them stop at a lower height than the maximum. Elevators start at the highest point and have to be brought down first. Hatches on the elevator cars allow an alternate method of travel.
zh: 模块化土星发射塔的斜角基座段，提供两种颜色选项：经典红与新版灰。基座拥有两部独立的乘员电梯，每部电梯均有四个可切换的最大高度选项；电梯亦可关闭。调节电梯的开启限制滑块可使其停在低于最大高度的位置。电梯初始处于最高点，必须先降下。电梯轿厢上的舱门提供了另一种移动方式。

s: Square base section of the modular Saturn launch tower, with two color options: classic red and new gray. The base has two independent crew elevators, each with four switchable maximum height options; elevators can also be turned off. Adjust the deploy limit of the elevators to make them stop at a lower height than the maximum. Elevators start at the highest point and have to be brought down first. Hatches on the elevator cars allow an alternate method of travel.
zh: 模块化土星发射塔的方形基座段，提供两种颜色选项：经典红与新版灰。基座拥有两部独立的乘员电梯，每部电梯均有四个可切换的最大高度选项；电梯亦可关闭。调节电梯的开启限制滑块可使其停在低于最大高度的位置。电梯初始处于最高点，必须先降下。电梯轿厢上的舱门提供了另一种移动方式。

s: Modular multi-height core section of the Saturn launch tower. Seven heights of the section are available, each with two color options: default Saturn red and alternate new gray. Nodes for attaching the swing arms are located on the mount rail on the front side of the sections.
zh: 土星发射塔的模块化多高度核心段。该段提供七种高度，每种高度均有两种颜色选项：默认土星红与备选新版灰。用于连接摆臂的节点位于各段正面的安装轨上。

s: A separate crew access floor for the crew access tower section of the Saturn tower, used to provide access from the tower elevator to the crew access arm when a command pod's hatch does not align with the bottom of the crew access section. Attach the floor to the node in the elevator shaft of the crew access section, and adjust its height with the offset gizmo. The floor has two configurations: Saturn Crew Arm access from the back with the walkway or Milkstool access from the front. The floor also has two color options, default red and alternate gray.
zh: 土星发射塔乘员通道塔段的独立乘员登机楼层，当指令舱舱门与乘员通道段底部未对齐时，用于提供从发射塔电梯到乘员通道臂的通路。将楼层安装到乘员通道段电梯井内的节点上，并使用偏移工具微调其高度。该楼层有两种配置：从后方经走道进入的土星乘员臂通道，或从前方进入的挤奶凳通道。该楼层还提供两种颜色选项：默认红与备选灰。

s: Modular crew access section of the Shuttle Launcher's FSS tower, used to allow boarding of spacecraft via a crew access arm and the separate crew access floor. Section has two height options for greater room to align the arm and floor, and two color otions: default gray and alternate black and white. A separate crew access floor is attached to the node inside the section, which then can be moved up and down to align the floor with the elevator exit and the crew arm. There are also optional side panels, with each side separately toggleable.
zh: 航天飞机发射台FSS塔架的模块化乘员通道段，用于通过乘员通道臂和独立的乘员登机楼层登入航天器。该段提供两种高度选项以便更好地对齐通道臂与楼层，并拥有两种颜色选项：默认灰与备选黑白。独立的乘员登机楼层安装在塔段内部的节点上，可上下移动以使楼层与电梯出口及乘员臂对齐。还配备了可选侧板，各侧可单独切换。

s: Saturn V tower damper arm. This V-shaped arm connected to the Apollo LES tower, and was used to stabilize the Saturn V during rollout and times of high winds. Two color options are available from the right-click menu. Arm was retracted before launch. ** Disable staging if retracting manually **
zh: 土星5号发射塔减震臂。该V形臂连接至阿波罗LES逃逸塔，用于在转运和强风期间稳定土星5号。可通过右键菜单选择两种颜色。该臂在发射前缩回。** 如果手动缩回，请禁用分级 **

s: Saturn Tower general swing arm for use with non-Saturn rockets. The arm's length can be adjusted with the deploy limit slider. 7 different umbilical connector types, 15 pipe styles and 2 color options are available from the right-click menu.
zh: 用于非土星火箭的土星发射塔通用摆臂。臂长可通过开启限制滑块进行调节。右键菜单中提供7种不同的脐带接口类型、15种管道样式以及2种颜色选项。

s: Saturn Tower swing arm #7 for the Saturn V. This is the S-IVB Forward arm, which includes the LM umbilical. Two sizes for 3.75m and 4.25m tanks, and two color options are available from the right-click menu.
zh: 土星5号的土星发射塔7号摆臂。这是S-IVB前进段摆臂，包含LM登月舱脐带接口。右键菜单中提供适用于3.75m和4.25m储箱的两种尺寸，以及两种颜色选项。

s: The base section for the Shuttle Launcher's Fixed Service Structure (FSS) tower. It ataches to a large node off to the side of the shuttle launcher base. Two different height variants allow it to be used with the stock Tier 2 launch pad or the LC-39 pad from KSC Extended. Base has two independent elevators with multiple height options; each elevator can alos be turned off. Elevators have to be brought down first, then can be raised. Adjust the maximum stopping height with the deploy limit slider. There are also optional side panels, with each side separately toggleable. Hatches on the elevator cars allow an alternate method of travel.
zh: 航天飞机发射台固定勤务结构（FSS）发射塔的基座段。它连接到航天飞机发射台基座侧面的大节点上。两种不同的高度变体使其能够兼容原版2级发射台或来自KSC Extended的<<M0>>发射台。基座配有两部具有多种高度选项的独立电梯；每部电梯均可关闭。电梯必须先降下，然后才能升起。使用开启限制滑块调节最高停止高度。还包含可选侧板，各侧可单独切换。电梯轿厢上的舱门提供了另一种移动方式。

s: Modular multi-height core section of the Shuttle Launcher's FSS tower. Six heights of the section are available, each with two color options: default gray and alternate black and white. Nodes for attaching the Intertank Access Structure (only one is needed) are located on the right side of the tower core. There are also optional side panels, with each side separately toggleable.
zh: 航天飞机发射台FSS塔架的模块化多高度核心段。该段提供六种高度，每种高度均有两种颜色选项：默认灰与备选黑白。用于安装储箱间通道结构（仅需一个）的节点位于塔架核心的右侧。还包含可选侧板，各侧可单独切换。

s: A separate crew access floor for the crew access tower section of the Shuttle Launcher's FSS tower, used to provide access from the tower elevator to the crew access arm when a command pod's hatch does not align with the bottom of the crew access section. Attach the floor to the node in the elevator shaft of the crew access section, and adjust its height with the offset gizmo. The floor has three configurations: Shuttle Arm access, Rodan Arm access and Launch Platform access. The floor also has two color options, default gray and alternate black&white.
zh: 航天飞机发射台FSS塔乘员通道段的独立通道平台，用于在指令舱舱门与乘员通道段底部未对齐时，提供从塔架电梯通往乘员通道臂的路径。将该平台安装到乘员通道段电梯井内的节点上，并使用平移小工具调整高度。平台具有三种配置：航天飞机通道臂、Rodan通道臂与发射平台通道。平台还提供两种配色选项：默认灰色和备用黑白。

s: The top section of the Shuttle Launcher's FSS tower, with two color options: default gray and alternate black and white. A node for attaching the LOX Vent Arm (beanie cap) is located on mount rail on the front; the rail can also be turned off. There are also optional side panels, with each side separately toggleable.
zh: 航天飞机发射台FSS塔的顶段，提供两种配色选项：默认灰色和备用黑白。前部安装导轨上设有一个用于安装液氧排气臂（便帽罩）的节点；该导轨也可以关闭。还配备可选的侧板，每侧均可单独切换开启或关闭。

s: The Hinge for the Shuttle Launcher Rotating Service Structure (RSS). The hinge attaches to a large node located on the FSS Tower's base section. The RSS itself is then attached to the hinge. The hinge has two color options, default gray and alternate black&white. The hinge details (the platforms and discs) can also be turned off.
zh: 航天飞机发射台旋转服务台（RSS）的铰链。铰链安装在FSS塔基段的大型节点上，RSS本身随后安装在铰链上。铰链提供两种配色选项：默认灰色和备用黑白。铰链细节部件（平台和圆盘）也可以关闭显示。

s: The Rotating Service Structure (RSS) for the Shuttle Launcher Base, used to access and change out the orbiter's payload bay IRL; this version can not be used for that. It attaches to a large node located on the top of the RSS Hinge's central pole. The RSS support legs can be switched between the default height for the stock tier 3 pad and a shorter height for the larger LC-39 pad in Tundra's Space Center/KSC Extended. The RSS can be closed and rolled out via an animation...a slow animation, as this thing is huge after all!
zh: 航天飞机发射台底座的旋转服务台（RSS），在现实中用于接近和更换轨道器的有效载荷舱；但该版本无法实现此功能。它安装在RSS铰链中心立柱顶部的大型节点上。RSS支撑腿可在原版3级发射台的默认高度与Tundra's Space Center/KSC Extended中更大型<<M0>>发射台的较矮高度之间切换。RSS可通过动画关闭和展开……不过动画很慢，毕竟这东西实在太巨大了！

s: Cosmetic hold-down assembly for the space shuttle's SRBs. These attach to the nodes in the launcher base's two SRB exhaust holes. Use mirror symmetry when attaching them to the nodes. They have animated retracting bolts.
zh: 航天飞机固体助推器（SRB）的装饰性压紧组件。安装在发射台底座两个SRB排气孔内的节点上。安装到节点时请使用镜像对称。带有螺栓回缩的动作动画。

s: Two of these tail service masts are mounted on the Shuttle Launcher Base, one on each side of the orbiter's engine section. Use mirror symmetry to orient them properly so the umbilicals face towards the shuttle. The umbilicals have an animated retraction. The sparkers have to be started manually with an action group.
zh: 两个尾部服务桅杆安装在航天飞机发射台底座上，位于轨道器发动机段两侧各一个。请使用镜像对称正确放置，使脐带管朝向航天飞机。脐带管具有回缩动画。火花点火器必须通过动作组手动启动。

s: This is the Shuttle FSS tower lightning mast that was first used for the AS-210 Saturn IB launch (ASTP Apollo), mounted on the hammerhead crane. The crane with the mast was also used for a time with the Space Shuttle's FSS tower, then the crane was removed and the mast mounted directly on the top of the tower. This mast has switchable mount styles: FSS Tower, Hammerhead Crane and a General Tower mount. It attaches to the top node on a tower top section or on the top of the Hammerhead Crane.
zh: 这是航天飞机FSS塔架避雷桅杆，最初安装在锤头起重机上用于<<M0>>土星1B发射任务（阿波罗-联盟测试计划）。带有该桅杆的起重机也曾用于航天飞机的FSS塔架一段时间，后来起重机被拆除，桅杆直接安装在塔架顶部。该桅杆具有可切换的安装样式：FSS塔架、锤头起重机和通用塔架安装底座。它可安装在塔架顶段的顶部节点或锤头起重机的顶部。

s: Gaseous Hydrogen Vent Arm for the Shuttle Launcher's FSS Tower. This arm was used to vent hydrogen gas boiling up into the intertank area, and was dropped at liftoff. The arm attaches to the intertank access structure, on the node at the top, with the umbilical touching the External Tank's intertank at about the middle.
zh: 航天飞机发射台FSS塔的气态氢排气臂。该臂用于排出蒸发进入箱间段区域的氢气，并在起飞时脱落。该臂安装在箱间段通道结构的顶部节点上，其脐带接口大致接触外储箱箱间段的中部。

s: The intertank access arm for the Shuttle Launcher's FSS Tower. It was used to allow pad technicians access to the External Tank's intertank and to attach the hydrogen vent arm. The arm attaches to the intertank access structure, on the node at the front and to the side, pointing towards the external tank.
zh: 航天飞机发射台FSS塔的箱间段通道臂。用于让发射台技术人员进入外储箱箱间段并连接氢排气臂。该臂安装在箱间段通道结构前方偏向一侧的节点上，指向外储箱。

s: The "beanie cap" Liquid Oxygen Vent Arm for the shuttle launcher's FSS tower. The arm is attached to a side node on the FSS top section, with the cap centered over the top of the shuttle's External Tank and almost touching the tank. The arm was retracted at around the T-2 minute point in the countdown
zh: 航天飞机发射台FSS塔的“便帽罩”液氧排气臂。该臂安装在FSS顶段的侧面节点上，罩体居中对准航天飞机外储箱顶部并几乎贴合储箱。该臂在倒计时约<<M0>>分钟时缩回。

s: Crew access arm for the shuttle FSS tower, allowing for crew boarding of the orbiter. It is attached to the crew access section type of the FSS tower, with the walkway lining up with the railing opening in the crew section floor's orbiter variant.
zh: 航天飞机FSS塔的乘员通道臂，供乘员登入轨道器。它安装在FSS塔的乘员通道段类型上，其走道与乘员段地板轨道器构型的栏杆开口对齐。

s: The Intertank Access Structure for the Shuttle Launcher FSS tower. This attaches to a side node on the FSS tower, and was used to access the External Tank's intertank. The intertank access arm is attached to the front node off to the sie, and the hydrogen vent arm are attached to to the top node on the walkway.
zh: 航天飞机发射台FSS塔的箱间段通道结构。它安装在FSS塔的侧面节点上，用于接近外储箱箱间段。箱间段通道臂安装在偏向一侧的前方节点上，氢排气臂安装在走道顶部的节点上。

s: The "beanie cap" Liquid Oxygen Vent Arm for the SLC-6 shuttle tower. Has 3 color variants; the IRL arm was still mostly gray with some red beams at the rear. The arm is attached to a node on the front of top section, not on the square-sided mast base, with the cap centered over the top of the shuttle's External Tank and almost touching the tank. The arm was retracted at around the T-2 minute point in the countdown.
zh: 用于<<M0>>航天飞机塔架的“便帽罩”液氧排气臂。拥有3种颜色变体；现实中的臂体主体仍为灰色，后部带有一些红色梁柱。该臂安装在顶段前部的节点上，而非方形截面的桅杆基座上，罩体居中对准航天飞机外储箱顶部并几乎贴合储箱。该臂在倒计时约<<M1>>分钟时缩回。

s: Crew access arm for the SLC-6 Shuttle tower, allowing for crew boarding of the orbiter. It is attached to a node on the front of SLC-6 tower crew section, with the walkway lining up with the orbiter's hatch. The arm retracts backwards into the tower, it does not swing.
zh: 用于<<M0>>航天飞机塔架的乘员通道臂，供乘员登入轨道器。它安装在<<M0>>塔架乘员段前部的节点上，走道与轨道器的舱门对齐。该臂向后缩回塔内，不会进行水平旋转摆动。

s: Small size launch base for the Space Shuttle, made for smaller flat launch pads, and inspired by the launch mount for the shuttle at Vandenberg's SLC-6 pad. The base attaches to the shuttle's External Tank via the large node in the center, and requires a free attach node below the center of the shuttle's External Tank in order to be attached. Service towers are attached to the nodes around the outside of the mount. SRB hold-downs are integrated into the base and are adjusted with the deploy limit sliders. The shuttle tail service masts attach on the sides of the square main engine exhaust hole, either with the two nodes or by surface attach. The whole base can be rotated via the switcher to keep the support legs in the right place.
zh: 航天飞机小型发射底座，专为较小的平坦发射台设计，灵感源自范登堡 <<M0>> 工位的航天飞机发射支架。该底座通过中心的大节点连接到航天飞机的外储箱，需要外储箱底部中心有一个闲置的连接节点才能安装。勤务塔连接在支架外围的节点上。SRB 压紧装置已集成到基座中，可通过开启限制滑块进行调节。航天飞机机尾勤务桅杆安装在方形主发动机排气孔的两侧，可通过两个节点连接或表面贴装。整个底座可通过切换器旋转，以确保支撑腿处于正确位置。

s: The core (lower) section for the SLC6 Shuttle tower. It ataches to a large node off to the side of the SLC6 Shuttle Launch Mount. Has multiple height variants, and two color options. A node on the side is for attaching the SLC-6 Shuttle Intertank Structure. Has one crew elevator, which has to be brought down first, then can be raised. Adjust the maximum stopping height with the deploy limit slider. A hatch on the elevator car allows an alternate method of travel.
zh: <<M0>> 航天飞机发射塔的核心（下部）段。它连接到 <<M0>> 航天飞机发射支架侧面的大节点上。拥有多种高度变体和两种颜色选项。侧面节点用于连接 <<M1>> 航天飞机级间段结构。配有一部乘员电梯，必须先降下然后才能上升。使用开启限制滑块调节最高停止高度。电梯轿厢上的舱门提供了另一种通行方式。

s: The crew (middle) section for the SLC6 Shuttle tower. It ataches to the top of the core section. Has two crew access height variants plus optional extra core levels on top. Includes an adjustable integrated floor to align with the SLC6 crew arm and the orbiter. The crew arm attaces to the node on the front. A node on the side is for attaching the SLC-6 Shuttle Intertank Structure.
zh: <<M0>> 航天飞机发射塔的乘员（中部）段。连接在核心段顶部。拥有两种乘员登机高度变体，顶部还可选装额外的核心层。包含一个可调节的一体式地板，以便与 <<M0>> 乘员登机臂及轨道器对齐。乘员登机臂连接在正面节点上。侧面的节点用于连接 <<M1>> 航天飞机级间段结构。

s: The Intertank Structure for the SLC-6 shuttle tower. It attaches to one of the nodes on the side of the tower opposite the crew arm. The main structure can be adjusted sideways with the deploy limit slider. The one thing that was mounted on this structure was the Hydrogen Vent Arm, which attaches to the node at the end of the main structure.
zh: 用于 <<M0>> 航天飞机发射塔的级间段结构。它连接到塔架侧面（乘员臂对面）的其中一个节点上。主体结构可通过开启限制滑块横向调节。该结构上安装的部件为液氢排气臂，连接在主体结构末端的节点上。

s: The top (upper) section for the SLC6 Shuttle tower. It attaches to the top of the crew section. Has 3 height variants, though the default height matches the IRL tower. The mast base has 6 height variants, with 4x matching the IRL one. The LOX Vent Arm attaches to the node in the top front, while the mast attaches to the node on top of the square-sided mast base.
zh: <<M0>> 航天飞机发射塔的顶部（上部）段。连接在乘员段顶部。拥有 3 种高度变体，其中默认高度与现实中的塔架一致。桅杆底座拥有 6 种高度变体，其中 4x 与现实一致。液氧排气臂连接在顶部正面的节点上，而桅杆则连接在四方桅杆底座顶部的节点上。

s: The Large Fuel Arm for the Soyuz Launch Base and other bases, styled after the actual Soyuz arm which serviced the third stage and spacecraft. Three color options are available. It attaches to one of the auxiliary nodes on the Soyuz base or a tower node on other bases. Six height options are available, and the umbilical can be adjusted horizontally and vertically with the deploy limit sliders. Arm retraction can be either done manually or by staging.
zh: 用于联盟号发射底座及其他底座的大型燃料臂，仿照现实中为联盟号三级和飞船提供勤务的加注臂设计。提供三种颜色选项。它可连接至联盟号底座上的辅助节点之一，或其它底座上的塔架节点。提供六种高度选项，脐带管可通过开启限制滑块进行水平和垂直调节。支臂回缩可通过手动或分级进行。

s: Small Fuel Arm for the Soyuz Launch Base and other bases, styled after the actual Soyuz arm which serviced the core stage. Three color options are available. It attaches to one of the auxiliary nodes on the Soyuz base ring or a tower node on other bases. Six height options are available, and the umbilical can be adjusted horizontally with the deploy limit slider. Arm retraction can be either done manually or by staging.
zh: 用于联盟号发射底座及其他底座的小型燃料臂，仿照现实中为联盟号芯级提供勤务的加注臂设计。提供三种颜色选项。它可连接至联盟号底座环上的辅助节点之一，或其它底座上的塔架节点。提供六种高度选项，脐带管可通过开启限制滑块进行水平调节。支臂回缩可通过手动或分级进行。

s: Animated retracting clamp arm for the Soyuz Launch Base or other launch base/plate, styled after the actual Soyuz support arms . It surface attaches to the clamp arm pads or the deck of the base, not the auxiliary nodes. There are three color options available. The arm end pad can be adjusted in size with the deploy limit slider. Retraction of the arm can be done manually or by staging.
zh: 用于联盟号发射底座或其他发射底座/平台的带动画回缩托臂，仿照现实中的联盟号支撑臂设计。它表面贴装在托臂垫或底座甲板上，而不是辅助节点。提供三种颜色选项。支臂末端承托垫的大小可通过开启限制滑块调节。支臂的回缩可通过手动或分级进行。

s: A separate version of the Soyuz Gantry crew elevator only. Elevator tower has 7 height options and two color options. The crew elevator pad's height, the walkway platform's height and platform extension's length can be adjusted with the deploy limit sliders. Optional transfer airlock can be turned on to allow crew boarding of a spacecraft inside a fairing via the crew transfer function. Hatches on the elevator car and at the bottom of the tower allow an alternate method of travel.
zh: 联盟号发射塔乘员电梯的独立版本。电梯塔拥有 7 种高度选项和两种颜色选项。乘员电梯垫的高度、走道平台的高度以及平台延伸长度均可通过开启限制滑块进行调节。可启用可选的转移气闸，通过乘员转移功能让乘员进入整流罩内的航天器。电梯轿厢和塔架底部的舱门提供了另一种通行方式。

s: Gantry arm assembly for the Soyuz Launch Base. Three color options are available. It attaches to the auxiliary node in the center of the Soyuz base. There are multiple height options for the arms, and the full arms can be turned off so only the crew elevator is visible. The gantry platform stack has three height variants, and the whole stack can be moved down up to 2.4m with the deploy limit slider. The crew elevator pad's height, the walkway platform's height and platform extension's length can be adjusted with the deploy limit sliders. Optional transfer airlocks can be turned on to allow crew boarding of a spacecraft inside a fairing via the crew transfer function. Hatches on the elevator car and at the bottom of the tower allow an alternate method of travel.
zh: 用于联盟号发射底座的勤务塔架组件。提供三种颜色选项。它连接至联盟号底座中心的辅助节点。双臂拥有多种高度选项，并且可以完全关闭双臂，使其仅显示乘员电梯。塔架平台堆叠有三种高度变体，整个组件可通过开启限制滑块向下移动最多 2.4 米。乘员电梯垫的高度、走道平台的高度以及平台延伸长度均可通过开启限制滑块进行调节。可开启可选的转移气闸，通过乘员转移功能让乘员进入整流罩内的航天器。电梯轿厢和塔架底部的舱门提供了另一种通行方式。
水星-宇宙神乘员升降梯脐带塔
水星-宇宙神乘员升降梯（带舱门）
双子座乘员升降梯（带舱门）
水星-宇宙神乘员升降梯廊桥

s: A short flip-up crew access walkway for the Mini General Crew Elevator. It attaches to one of the large center nodes on the elevator tower. Has 8 color options.
zh: 用于小型通用乘员升降梯的简短上翻式登船廊桥。安装在升降梯塔架的大型中心节点之一上。具有8种颜色可选。

s: Delta IV Modular Service Tower Core
zh: 德尔塔IV模块化勤务塔核心段

s: Delta IV Modular Service Tower Top
zh: 德尔塔IV模块化勤务塔顶段

s: Delta IV Service Tower - Single Piece
zh: 德尔塔IV勤务塔 - 整体式
迷你挤奶凳分离器 1型短款

s: A stand-alone mini milkstool part for use with launch plates and launch bases, to raise a rocket up off the deck of the base or plate. Has 8 color options. Use with the separate hold-downs.
zh: 一个独立的迷你挤奶凳部件，与发射板和发射基座配合使用，将火箭从基座或平板甲板上抬高。具有8种颜色可选。请配合单独的压紧装置使用。
迷你挤奶凳分离器 1型高款
迷你挤奶凳分离器 2型短款
迷你挤奶凳分离器 2型高款
迷你挤奶凳分离器 3型中款
迷你挤奶凳分离器 3型短款
迷你挤奶凳分离器 3型高款

s: Saturn IB Launch Stand Tower Pedestal

zh: 由粘弹性纳米聚合物（偶然在办公室小冰箱深处发现其生长出来的产物）制成，这种烧蚀防热盾可以拉伸至各种尺寸。发射前会硬化为刚性耐热结构！

s: Made from viscoelastic nanopolymers (which were discovered by accident... growing in the back of the office mini-fridge) this fuel tank can be stretched to accommodate fuel loads of a range of sizes and shapes. Hardens to a rigid structure before launch!
zh: 由粘弹性纳米聚合物（偶然在办公室小冰箱深处发现其生长出来的产物）制成，这种储罐可以拉伸以容纳不同尺寸与形状的推进剂负载。发射前会硬化为刚性结构！

s: Made from viscoelastic nanopolymers (which were discovered by accident... growing in the back of the office mini-fridge) this solid rocket can be stretched to accommodate fuel loads of a range of sizes and shapes. Hardens to a rigid structure before launch!

s: The Vostok SA Descent Module was the first spacecraft to carry humans into space when Yuri Gagarin flew on April 12, 1961. The SA stands for Spuskaemiy Apparat (Descent System) and was designed as a ballistic reentry capsule. [Diameter 2.3 m]
zh: 1961年4月12日尤里·加加林进入太空时，东方号 SA 返回舱成为了首个搭载人类进入太空的航天器。SA 代表 Spuskaemiy Apparat（下降系统），设计为弹道式再入返回舱。[直径 2.3 m]

s: When Yuri Gagarin returned to Earth after the first maiden spaceflight, he ejected from the capsule and parachuted to the ground. It was not until later versions of the capsule was the Parachute added. Connect this to the open part of the capsule
zh: 尤里·加加林在完成人类首次载人航天飞行返回地球时，弹射出了返回舱并跳伞着陆。直到后续版本的返回舱才加入了自带降落伞。将此部件连接到返回舱的开放接口处。

s: A service module with batteries a simple engine AK20/Tonka250 engine that has only 1 ignition. This is the same service module that you use for Vostok and Voskhod. Attach the Decoupler to the Descent Module first and attach this to the bottom of the Descent Module.
zh: 配有电池和服务发动机的服务舱，配备一台仅能点火 1 次的简单 AK20/Tonka250 发动机。东方号与上升号均使用此款服务舱。先将分离器安装到返回舱上，再将本舱段安装到返回舱底部。

s: The Zenit Descent Module was developed in parallel with the Vostok Descent Module, for photoreconnaissance use. Placing the camera equipment in a pressurized capsule made development much easier, and the cameras and film could be recovered together, reducing cost. Historically used as a spy satellite, but for our peaceful RP-1 purposes, these represent the earliest weather satellite photos.
zh: 天顶号返回舱与东方号返回舱同步研发，专用于照相侦察任务。将相机设备置于加压舱内极大地简化了研发工作，并且相机与胶卷可以一并回收，从而降低了成本。历史上虽被用作间谍卫星，但出于我们和平的<<M0>>目的，它代表了最早的气象卫星照片。

s: A large 2.5m+ service module for the 1969 Big Gemini concept. Includes a large pressurized volume in the aft for cargo and crew space. This Service Module is also compatible with Apollo (although it will need a custom adapter, and the internal compartment will be inaccessable since Apollo doesn't have a hatch in it's heat shield), and the Apollo Service Module is also compatible with Big Gemini (Adapter not included). NOTE: This contains no propulsion, add RCS thrusters.
zh: 专为1969年大双子座构想设计的2.5m+大型服务舱。尾部包含用于货物和乘员的大型加压舱容积。该服务舱也可兼容阿波罗（不过需要自制转接器，且由于阿波罗防热盾没有舱口，内部舱段将无法进入），阿波罗服务舱同样兼容大双子座（不包含转接器）。注意：该部件不含推进系统，需自行添加RCS推力器。

s: 1961 proposed design for a manned spacecraft to take humans to the moon, but passed over in favour of the familiar Apollo CSM. Remarkably similar to the later Soyuz in design, the D-2 consists of a propulsion module, descent capsule, and a detachable mission module, providing efficient use of space and capability for a wide range of missions, including circumlunar flights.
zh: 1961年提出的一项载人登月航天器设计方案，但最终被熟悉的阿波罗CSM取代。其构型与后来的联盟号惊人相似，<<M0>>由推进舱、返回舱和可分离的任务舱组成，空间利用率高，可胜任包括绕月飞行在内的多种任务。

s: Attach these under each wing. Don’t forget to add them to the GEAR Action group so you can toggle them with the G key. Fiddle with the skid controls at your own risk since they function correctly as is.
zh: 将这些部件安装在各机翼下方。别忘了将它们添加到起落架（GEAR）动作组，以便使用G键进行开关。自行调节滑橇控制参数需自担风险，它们在默认设置下已能正常工作。

s: The aft bay and adapter for Dynasoar, containing liquid hydrogen and liquid oxygen for the fuel cells, space for extra supplies and equipment, and a crew tube. Rated for high altitude hypersonic flight, but decouple before reentry.
zh: 恐龙（Dynasoar）航天飞机的尾舱与转接段，内置供燃料电池使用的液氢与液氧，留有额外补给和设备空间，并包含一条乘员通道。支持高空超音速飞行，但必须在再入前分离。

s: Dynasoar cockpit. Dynasoar (short for "Dynamic Soarer") was an early USAF spaceplane, intended to function as a station tender, reconnaissance craft, and nuclear bomber. Designed for "Dynamic Soaring", dipping deep into the atmosphere and using aerodynamic manuevers to skip back out, or change it's orbit. This would have allowed it to make passes as low as 50 km for precision reconnaissance or bombing before returning to orbit. For reentry, a slightly negative perigee is recommended.
zh: 恐龙（Dynasoar）驾驶舱。“Dynasoar”（即“动态滑翔者”）是美国空军早期的航天飞机计划，旨在用作空间站摆渡船、侦察机以及核轰炸机。专为“动态滑翔”设计，可深入切入大气层并利用气动操纵跳跃脱离，或改变其轨道。这使其能够在返回轨道前突入至最低50 km高度进行精确侦察或轰炸。再入时建议采用略微为负的近地点。

s: The Winged Gemini experiment was designed so that Gemini could land on a runway. It would have greatly reduced the cost of recovery, but it was so unstable and hard to control in tests that it was abandoned. See if you can do better! Keep the AoA high during reentry, and then drop the nose to keep your speed up. Atmosphereic Autopilot or other fly-by-wire mods strongly recommended.
zh: 滑翔翼双子座实验旨在让双子座飞船能够在跑道上着陆。这本可大幅降低回收成本，但由于在测试中极其不稳定且难以操控而被迫放弃。来看看你能否表现得更好！再入期间保持大迎角，随后压低机头以维持速度。强烈建议配合使用Atmospheric Autopilot或其他电传操纵mod。

s: This special docking port is designed to capture the Gemini nose cone's docking mechanism. The simple mechanical connection won't allow you to transfer crew, but it will securely attach two vessels together, for berthing or travel. Electrical connections and a gauge cluster mounted just above the docking port allow the crew to control the vehicle they are docked too.
zh: 此特殊对接口用于捕获双子座机头锥头的对接机构。虽然简单的机械连接无法转移乘员，但可将两艘载具牢固连接在一起，用于停泊或航行。对接口上方的电气连接和仪表盘可让乘员控制所对接的载具。

s: The lower half of the Gemini-B adapter, with batteries and separation motors. Decoupler detaches the bottom node. Designed for the MOL program, it was tested uncrewed, but the program was cancelled before any manned launches.
zh: 双子座-B转接器的下半部分，装有电池和分离火箭。分离器可分离底部节点。专为MOL计划设计，曾进行过无人测试，但在进行任何载人发射前该计划即被取消。

s: A hollow structural adapter with mounting points for 4 retrorockets, and a passage for crew. Hold ALT to make attaching the retrorockets easier. Decoupler detaches the bottom node (adapter module). Designed for the MOL program, it was tested uncrewed, but the program was cancelled before any manned launches.
zh: 中空的结构转接段，带有4枚反推火箭的安装点和一条乘员通道。按住ALT键可更轻松地安装反推火箭。分离器可分离底部节点（转接模块）。专为MOL计划设计，曾进行过无人测试，但在进行任何载人发射前该计划即被取消。

s: Deeply throttleable pressure-fed vacuum engine used for the descent module of the Apollo lunar lander. Uses storable propellants which are not subject to boiloff, but are far less efficient than hydrolox or even kerolox. The version used on J-class missions had slightly higher specific impulse (this, along with other changes, gave enough payload capacity for the rover, for example). A later variant (TR-201) was used on Delta as an upper stage engine (on Delta P series); this was a low-cost model with more restarts (4 instead of 2) and slightly higher thrust but lower efficiency and no throttling capability.
zh: 阿波罗登月舱下降级使用的高深度节流挤压式真空发动机。使用不会发生蒸发损耗的可贮存推进剂，但效率远低于液氢液氧甚至液氧煤油。J级任务使用的版本具有略高的比冲（除其他改动外，这也为月球车等设备提供了足够的有效载荷能力）。后期的衍生型号（<<M0>>）曾用作德尔塔火箭的上面级发动机（德尔塔P系列）；那是一款低成本型号，具有更多重启次数（4次而非2次）和略高的推力，但效率较低且无法节流。

s: This small airbrake prevents the Mercury from stabilizing in a "nose-first" orientation during reentry. Attach to the offset node on the Mercury Antenna/Drogue Chute unit. Once in orbit, click the brakes action group to extend it for the rest of the mission.
zh: 该小型减速板可防止水手号飞船在再入过程中稳定在“机头朝前”的姿态。安装至水手号天线/引导伞单元的偏置节点上。进入轨道后，点击刹车动作组将其展开，并在任务余下时间内保持展开状态。

s: This nose cap for the Mercury capsule includes the drogue chute and the main antenna. It has an attach node for a destabilizing flap. The latter might not accomplish much but its theorized to help self orient a reentering craft and its nice to have.
zh: 水手号乘员舱的鼻锥罩，内含引导伞和主天线。带有一个用于安装防稳定扰流片的安装节点。扰流片的作用或许有限，但理论上有助于再入航天器自我定向，备上一个总无坏处。

s: This metal tub attaches to the bottom of the Mercury heatshield, allowing retro solids to be mounted. Decoupling will release the straps to separate from the capsule for reentry. Note that this is purely a structural unit - no propulsion is included.
zh: 安装在水手号防热盾底部的金属托架，用于安装固体反推火箭。分离时会解开固定带以便在再入前与乘员舱脱离。注意，这纯粹是一个结构单元——不包含推进系统。

s: The main crew compartment for the Orion spacecraft. Secondary life support, reentry systems and personal cargo spaces are located there. The capsule houses four astronauts and can be used multiple times. This variant uses a silver coating for thermal protection.
zh: 猎户座航天器的主乘员舱。副生命保障系统、再入系统和个人货物空间均设于此处。乘员舱可容纳四名宇航员，并可多次重复使用。该型号采用银色隔热涂层。

s: The service module of the Orion spacecraft contains fuel and oxidizer for the main propulsion system, life support, electrical batteries and everything else needed for extended orbital operations. The AJ10-190 should be attached to the node inside the ESM, hold ALT to make attaching easier.
zh: 猎户座航天器的服务舱，装有主推进系统的燃料和氧化剂、生命保障系统、蓄电池以及长时间轨道运营所需的一切。<<M0>>-190应安装在ESM内部的节点上，按住ALT键可更轻松地进行安装。

s: Orion main docking port, drogue parachute and main parachute shield. This one is equipped with a silver coating for thermal protection. Note: The docking petals do not have colliders, so this port should be able to dock with the stock NASA Docking System
zh: 猎户座主对接口、引导伞与主伞防护罩。该部件配有银色隔热涂层。注意：对接花瓣没有碰撞体，因此该对接口应能与原版NASA对接系统对接。

s: The Voskhod Airlock will allow for your crew to perform an EVA from the Voskhod airlock. Attach this to the node on the side of the Voskhod capsule. Transfer your crew memeber inside and perform your EVA. Be sure to decouple this before re-entry.
zh: 上升号气闸舱，可供乘员从上升号气闸进行EVA。将其安装在上升号乘员舱侧面的节点上。将乘员转移至内部即可执行EVA。务必在再入前将其分离。

s: The Voskhod SA Descent Module was a re-purposed version of the Vostok SA. It was retrofitted to allow for an Airlock attachment for EVA and even to fit 3 cosmonauts. However, with 3 cosmonauts, there was not enough room to wear pressure suits. The SA stands for Spuskaemiy Apparat (Descent System) and was designed as a ballistic reentry capsule. [Diameter 2.3 m]
zh: 上升号SA返回舱是东方号SA的改型。它经过改装以支持加装用于EVA的气闸舱，甚至可容纳3名航天员。然而，载员3人时内部空间狭小，无法穿戴增压宇航服。SA代表Spuskaemiy Apparat（下降系统），设计为弹道式再入返回舱。[直径2.3 m]

s: Androgynous Peripheral Attach System developed for the Shuttle-Mir program and ISS. This is the passive variant, useful for permanent fixtures that won't have to form the active docking partner, such as berthing ports on station modules.
zh: 为航天飞机-和平号计划及国际空间站开发的异体同构周边对接系统（APAS）。这是被动型号，适用于无需主动对接的永久性设施，例如空间站舱段上的停靠接口。

s: The drogue parachute pack is meant to slow down the Apollo spacecraft at a high altitude in preparation for the deployment of the main parachute pack. Attach this to the front node before placing the Forward Heat Shield.
zh: 减速伞包用于在阿波罗飞船高空阶段减速，为主降落伞包的展开做准备。在安装前部防热盾之前，请将其安装在前端节点上。

s: The abort motor of the LES is a powerful solid rocket motor, designed specifically to carry away the Apollo Command Module in the case of a pad or a low altitude flight abort. The pitch motor of the LES imparts a small attitude change to the Apollo Command Module during an abort. This ensures that the CM will have sufficient clearance from the launch vehicle after the LES abort motor burns out. The first engine module is the Escape Motor, the second module is the Jettison Motor, and the third is the pitch motor. Fire the escape and pitch motors to abort, then activate the jettision motor to pull the tower clear of the CM.
zh: 逃逸系统（LES）的逃逸发动机是一台大推力固体火箭发动机，专门用于在发射台或低空飞行中止时带离阿波罗指令舱。LES的俯仰发动机在中止期间为阿波罗指令舱提供微小的姿态偏转，确保在LES逃逸发动机燃尽后，指令舱与运载火箭之间有足够的安全间隙。第一发动机模块是逃逸发动机，第二模块是抛离发动机，第三模块是俯仰发动机。点火逃逸和俯仰发动机进行中止，随后启动抛离发动机将逃逸塔从指令舱上拉离。

s: A folding Yagi antenna designed to enhance gathering of VHF radar sounding data. Can be used as a communications antenna in a pinch. Attach to the node on the Apollo engine mount just under the science bay.
zh: 一种折叠八木天线，旨在增强VHF雷达探测数据的采集。紧急情况下也可用作通信天线。安装在阿波罗发动机安装座下方紧邻科学舱的节点上。

s: Common Androgynous Docking Port. Developed to eliminate the limitations of the gendered Apollo docking system, as well as provide a larger passageway for delivering cargo. Equipped with a deployable capture ring to dampen impact. Permanent station ports can use the passive version, which is simpler and lighter.
zh: 通用异体同构对接舱口。旨在消除阿波罗有性别对接系统的局限性，并为运送货物提供更大的通道。配有可展开的捕获环以缓冲撞击。永久性空间站接口可使用更简单、更轻便的被动版本。

s: Significant changes were made to better adapt Apollo to its new role as a crew shuttle for LEO, and the internal volume was modified to fit 5 crew for reentry. Be sure to bring extra living space by attaching the Mission Module to dock with after orbiting. By only using the Command Module, you will have resources for 5 crew for 72 hours. FICTIONAL (Eyes Turned Skyward)
zh: 为了更好地使阿波罗适应低地球轨道乘员摆渡飞船的新角色，对其进行了重大改进，内部容积经改装可容纳5名乘员进行再入。入轨后请务必对接任务舱以获得额外的活动空间。仅使用指令舱时，所携带的资源仅够5名乘员维持72小时。虚构（《仰望苍穹》设定）

s: A collapsible relay antenna consisting of a high gain dish, for transmitting the many exciting things you've discovered. Intended to be placed on the mounting bracket of the Apollo Service Engine Block V. FICTIONAL (Eyes Turned Skyward)
zh: 由高增益蝶形天线组成的可折叠中继天线，用于传回你所发现的诸多振奋人心的成果。设计安装在阿波罗Block V服务舱发动机的安装支架上。虚构（《仰望苍穹》设定）

s: In order to increase the living space and mission duration of the Apollo Block III CSM. This mission module is essentially several more cubic meters of living space for the crew. Place it upside down in place of the lunar module, with docking ports on each end. Extract with the CSM after circularization. FICTIONAL (Eyes Turned Skyward)
zh: 为了增加阿波罗Block III CSM的居住空间和任务时长，该任务舱实质上为乘员额外提供了数立方米的生活空间。将其倒置安装在登月舱原位置，两端均配有对接舱口。入轨圆轨道化后使用CSM将其抽出。虚构（《仰望苍穹》设定）

s: Following the introduction of more capable lifters for crewed LEO missions, the venerable Apollo Block III+ mission module was replaced with a larger can. Includes a larger attachment node on top for using larger androgynous docking ports. Place it upside down in place of the lunar module, with docking ports on each end. Extract with the CSM after circularization.
zh: 随着用于载人近地轨道任务的高运载能力火箭的引入，老旧的阿波罗Block III+任务舱被更大的舱体取代。顶部包含一个更大的连接节点，可使用更大的异体同构对接舱口。将其倒置安装在登月舱原位置，两端均配有对接舱口。入轨圆轨道化后使用CSM将其抽出。

s: The LM Taxi Ascent Stage Cockpit provides accommodations for up to three crew to ride to the Moon's surface atop the LM Decent Stage, perform an extended surface stay, then return to orbit. During surface operations, the Taxi is shut down and put in a dormant state to save resources, while the crew operates out of a separately landed shelter. Includes radiators and deployable insulation for the dormancy period. Remember to have all crew members on board before launching. Due to low performance with 3 crewmembers, it is recommended to leave behind all equipment before launching.
zh: 登月出租车（LM Taxi）上升级座舱可容纳多达三名乘员，乘坐安装在LM下降级顶部的座舱前往月球表面，执行长时间表面驻留，随后返回轨道。在地面运营期间，出租车将关闭并进入休眠状态以节约资源，乘员则在单独着陆的庇护舱中开展工作。配有用于休眠期的散热器和可展开隔热层。发射前请务必确认所有乘员均已登机。由于搭载3名乘员时性能余量较低，建议在发射前将所有外部设备留在月表。

s: Longer surface stays require facilities and consumables beyond what can be carried in a single LM lander. This is a dedicated shelter module. Includes fuel cells, deployable insulation, and an expandable airlock - make sure your front leg does not have the "porch". Requires additional oxygen tanks to be added to the descent module to supply the crew and fuel cells.
zh: 更长时间的月面停留所需的设施和消耗品超出了单艘LM着陆器的承载能力。这是一个专用的庇护舱。配备燃料电池、可展开隔热层以及可充气气闸——请确保你的前起落架没有安装“门廊”。需要在下降级上额外添加氧气罐，以供乘员使用及燃料电池消耗。

s: Modified version of the standard CSM and LM RCS cluster, designed to be mounted on the LM-Truck to provide independent attitude control for autonomous landing.// ============================================================================

A specialized module designed to allow the docking of two separate spacecraft to either end of this module. In addition to mating spacecraft, it provides additional living/working space, as well as a platform for experiments.
zh: 一种专用舱段，旨在允许两艘独立的航天器分别对接在该舱段的两端。除了连接航天器外，它还提供了额外的生活/工作空间以及实验平台。

s: This experiment is a modified and slightly enhanced version of the Far Ultraviolet Spectrometer. This experiment can be used to study measure emissions from celestial bodies, zodiacal light, solar atmosphere emissions, stellar emissions, and galactic emissions.
zh: 该实验是远紫外光谱仪的改进增强版本。该实验可用于研究测量天体辐射、黄道光、太阳大气辐射、恒星辐射和星系辐射。

s: The Gemini Adapter Equipment Section. It contains O2 and H2 for fuel cell consumption and life support. It also contains fuel for manoeuvring and attitude control thrusters. This is the configuration as found on Gemini 10+. RCS O/F Ratio 1.223:1.
zh: 双子座适配器设备段。内含用于燃料电池消耗和生命支持的O2与H2。还装有供机动和姿态控制推进器使用的推进剂。此为双子座10号及后续任务的配置。RCS氧化剂/燃烧剂比为1.223:1。

s: One of the most crucial skills that the Gemini program is meant to develop is the ability to rendezvous and dock in space. This simple docking mechanism doesn't have the ability to transfer crew or resources, but it will allow you to connect two vessels in flight. This male active docking mechanism corresponds to the female Agena Docking Adapter. It include an indexing key, that slides into the V shape on the Agena Docking Adapter, to help line the two craft up properly.
zh: 双子座计划旨在掌握的最关键技能之一就是在太空进行交会与对接。这个简易对接机构无法传输乘员或资源，但它允许你在飞行中连接两个航天器。这种凸式主动对接机构与凹式阿金纳对接适配器相匹配。它包含一个定位销，可滑入阿金纳对接适配器上的V形槽内，以帮助两艘航天器精准对齐。

s: As operations in space become more complex, more crew members are needed. This expanded crew module replaces the standard Gemini service module, allowing seven additional crew members to ride to space. To be used with either a modified Apollo Service Module for deep space operations, or the Big Gemini Service Module for LEO operations.
zh: 随着空间运营变得越来越复杂，需要更多的乘员。这个扩容乘员舱取代了标准双子座服务舱，允许额外运送七名乘员进入太空。可与用于深空运营的改进型阿波罗服务舱配合使用，或与用于近地轨道运营的大双子座（Big Gemini）服务舱配合使用。

s: This solid rocket tower is designed to wrench the command pod up and away from a malfunctioning rocket. Use only in case of emergency. WARNING: Staging the LES will also decouple it from the bottom node, in order to dispose of it after launch. Map the engine to the ABORT action group for emergency use.
zh: 该固体火箭逃逸塔旨在发生故障时将指令舱从火箭上迅速向上拉离。仅在紧急情况下使用。警告：通过分级启动LES时，同时也会将其从底部节点分离，以便在正常发射后抛弃。若用于应急，请将发动机映射至中止（ABORT）动作组。

s: Lunar heatshield for the Big Gemini capsule. Gemini lacks the radiative heat protection of more advanced capsules. Extremely gentle Lunar reentries only.
zh: 用于大双子座指令舱的月球热防护罩。双子座缺少更先进指令舱所具备的辐射热防护能力。仅适用于极其平缓的月球再入轨道。

s: This 4-wheeled buggy can be attached to the side of the Apollo LM descent stage, allowing extended exploration on the surface of the Moon. <#ef7b06> AUTHOR'S NOTE: Due to its unstable nature, you should always quicksave and quickload before attempting to board the LRV.</color>
zh: 这款四轮漫游车可挂载于阿波罗登月舱下降级侧面，用于拓展月表探测范围。<#ef7b06> 作者注：由于其物理特性不稳定，尝试登上月球车（LRV）前请务必先快速保存并快速读档。</color>

s: The Lunar Flying Vehicle was designed to greatly extend the range from the LEM that can be explored. <#ef7b06> AUTHOR'S NOTE: Store inside the LM Descent Stage Assembly's inventory (requires manually placing in a slot), and deploy by placing on the surface with an engineer. After boarding, select "Control From Here" in the PAW to align forward vector with the engines.</color>
zh: 月球飞行载具（LFV）旨在大幅拓展自登月舱出发的探测范围。<#ef7b06> 作者注：存放在登月舱下降级组件的物品栏中（需手动放入格子），并由工程师放置在月表开启使用。登机后，在 PAW 中选择“从此点控制”以将前进矢量与发动机对齐。</color>

s: It's not really a control surface, its more of a metal slat that deflects some of the air that goes by. Goes on the Gemini Flight Pack over the holes.
zh: 严格来说它并不是操纵面，更像是一块用于导流流经空气的金属板条。安装在双子座飞行背包的开口上方。

s: Put two of these stubby little control surfaces on the bottom of the Gemini wing.
zh: 将两个这种短小的操纵面安装在双子座机翼底部。

s: Nose cone halves for the Agena Docking Target fairing.
zh: 用于阿金纳目标飞行器整流罩的鼻部半锥头。

s: Gemini Agena Target Vehicle Docking Port
zh: 双子座阿金纳目标飞行器对接端口
水星 M-ASF 扰流翼片

s: The first American spacecraft. Carrying a single astronaut, it can be launched suborbital on a Redstone or into orbit on Atlas LV3B.
zh: 美国的第一艘载人航天器。可搭载一名宇航员，既可用红石火箭发射进行亚轨道飞行，也可用宇宙神<<M0>>送入轨道。

s: Decoupler for separating the Mercury capsule from a Redstone rocket.
zh: 用于将水星号乘员舱与红石火箭分离的分离器。

s: Interstage for separating the Mercury capsule from an Atlas rocket.
zh: 用于将水星号乘员舱与宇宙神火箭分离的级间段。

s: Main parachute for the Mercury capsule. Attach to the node in the recovery section.
zh: 水星号乘员舱的主降落伞。安装在回收舱段的节点上。

s: This tiny solid rocket motor was originally used to push a Mercury away from its Atlas booster. We're sure you'll think of even more uses for it.
zh: 这款微型固体火箭发动机最初用于将水星号推离其宇宙神助推器。相信你能为它发掘出更多用途。

s: This part contains four way RCS thrusters to help orient the Mercury capsule and the main parachute.
zh: 该部件包含用于调整水星号乘员舱姿态的四向 RCS 推进器以及主降落伞。

s: Cluster of 8 R-4D-11s, used as backup propulsion for the ESM
zh: 8台<<M0>>组合构型，用作 ESM 的备用推进系统

s: This shroud protects the fragile exterior of the SM from the high speed airflow around the rocket during launch.
zh: 该保护罩用于在发射期间保护服务舱脆弱的外部免受高速气流的影响。

s: Decoupler for separating Orion from the SLS.
zh: 用于将猎户座与 SLS 分离的分离器。

s: Orion Forward Heat Shield and Docking Port
zh: 猎户座前进热防护罩与对接端口

s: An ablative heat shield that goes on the bottom of the Orion pod.
zh: 安装在猎户座乘员舱底部的烧蚀热防护罩。

s: Launch Escape System and Boost Protective Cover for the Orion spacecraft. Jettison by decoupling, use by assigning the escape motor and the decoupler on service module to the "abort" action group.
zh: 用于猎户座航天器的发射逃离系统与助推保护罩。通过分离抛弃，使用时请将逃逸发动机和服务舱分离器分配至“中止”动作组。

s: The primary parachute for the Orion spacecraft.
zh: 猎户座航天器的主降落伞。

s: RCS thruster blocks for the Orion Service Module. 4 of them are placed on the service module, 45 degrees off the spacecraft's principal axes.
zh: 用于猎户座服务舱的 RCS 推进器模块。在服务舱上布置4组，与航天器主轴呈45度角夹角安装。

s: Voskhod backup retro unit. Attach above the Voskhod Capsule on top of the Voskhod Retro Decoupler.
zh: 上升号备用反推装置。安装在上升号乘员舱上方、上升号反推分离器的顶端。

s: Place this between the Descent Module and the Service Module to decouple the Capsule for reentry.
zh: 安装在返回舱与服务舱之间，以便分离乘员舱进行再入。
天顶号返回舱（改进型胶卷相机）

s: Androgynous Peripheral Attach System developed for the Shuttle-Mir program and ISS. This is the active variant, with a deployable capture ring to align the ports and dampen the impact.
zh: 为航天飞机-和平号计划及 ISS 异体同构周边对接系统。此为主动型号，配有可展开的捕获环以对准对接机构并缓冲冲击。
阿波罗服务舱 RCS 模块

s: The attitude control thruster blocks of the Apollo Service Module (SM). Four of these allow full three-axis attitude control and translation of the Apollo CSM.
zh: 阿波罗服务舱（SM）的姿态控制推力器组。四组推力器可为阿波罗 CSM 提供完整的三轴姿态控制与平移能力。

s: The Command Module of the Apollo spacecraft. Apollo was the spacecraft that transported humans to the Moon in the 1960's and 1970's. It has room for three crew.
zh: 阿波罗飞船的指令舱。阿波罗是 20 世纪 60 和 70 年代将人类送往月球的航天器。可容纳三名乘员。
阿波罗指令舱/服务舱分离器

s: This is used to decouple the Command Module from the Service Module prior to reentry.
zh: 用于在再入前将指令舱与服务舱分离。

s: Docking spotlight to provide illumination for docking/berthing operations. Attach to the Apollo Service Module decoupler.
zh: 对接探照灯，为对接/靠泊运营提供照明。安装在阿波罗服务舱分离器上。

s: This is the drogue (accepting) part of the Apollo Docking System. It will only work with the Apollo Command Module Probe.
zh: 这是阿波罗对接系统的锥孔（接收）端。仅能与阿波罗指令舱对接探头配合使用。

s: Apollo Command Module Drogue Parachute Pack
zh: 阿波罗指令舱减速伞包
阿波罗服务舱发动机支架

s: The engine mount for the Apollo SM contains mounting points for the Apollo SPS, HGA, and other accessories.
zh: 阿波罗 SM 的发动机支架，包含阿波罗 SPS、高增益天线（HGA）及其他附件的安装挂点。

s: EVA spotlight to provide illumination for EVA operations. Attach to the Apollo Service Module decoupler.
zh: EVA 探照灯，为 EVA 运营提供照明。安装在阿波罗服务舱分离器上。

s: Apollo Command Module Forward Heat Shield
zh: 阿波罗指令舱前隔热罩

s: The forward heat shield for the Apollo Command Module. Attach this to the top of the CM after placing the Drogue and Main Parachutes.
zh: 阿波罗指令舱的前部隔热罩。在安装好减速伞和主伞后将其安装到 CM 顶部。

s: The primary High Gain Antenna of the Apollo Spacecraft. Attach to the node on the Service Module Engine Mount.
zh: 阿波罗飞船的主高增益天线。安装在服务舱发动机支架的节点上。

s: Lunar-rated heatshield for the Apollo Capsule.
zh: 适用于阿波罗太空舱的月球级防热罩。

s: Aerodynamic nosecone used on Apollo Block I, since docking missions weren't planned until Block II.
zh: 用于阿波罗 Block I 的气动整流锥，因为对接任务直到 Block II 才被列入规划。

s: Apollo Command Module Main Parachute Pack
The main parachute pack of the Apollo Command Module. Attach this to the front node before placing the Forward Heat Shield.
zh: 阿波罗指令舱的主伞包。在安装前隔热罩之前，将其安装到前节点上。

s: This is the probe part of the Apollo Docking System. It will only work with the Apollo Docking Mechanism Drogue.
zh: 这是阿波罗对接系统的探头端。仅能与阿波罗对接机构锥孔配合使用。

s: VHF scimitar antenna to provide ship-to-ship comms and act as a backup for the main high-gain antenna. Place two on opposite sides of the SM and LM.
zh: 甚高频（VHF）弯刀天线，提供船间通信并作为主高增益天线的备份。成对对称安装在 SM 和 LM 的两侧。

s: The Apollo Service Module contains the main propellant tanks, the fuel cells, life support and everything else that it is needed for a flight to the Moon.
zh: 阿波罗服务舱容纳了主推进剂储罐、燃料电池、生命支持系统以及登月飞行所需的一切设备。
阿波罗 17 号高频偶极雷达天线

s: An extending dipole antenna used to gather high frequency radar sounding data. Can be used as a communications antenna in a pinch. Attach in a pair to the nodes on the Apollo engine plate.
zh: 一种可展开的双极天线，用于收集高频雷达测深数据。紧急情况下可用作通信天线。成对安装在阿波罗发动机挂盘的节点上。

s: Apollo Block IV CADS Active Docking Port
zh: 阿波罗 Block IV CADS 主动对接端口

s: Apollo Block IV CADS Passive Docking Port
zh: 阿波罗 Block IV CADS 被动对接端口
阿波罗 Block III+ 指令舱 (CM)

s: Apollo Block III High Gain Antenna
zh: 阿波罗 Block III 高增益天线

s: A collapsable relay antenna. Intended to be placed on the mounting bracket of the Apollo Service Engine Block III. FICTIONAL (Eyes Turned Skyward)
zh: 可折叠中继天线。设计安装在阿波罗 Block III 服务推进发动机的安装支架上。虚构部件（Eyes Turned Skyward）

s: Apollo Block V High Gain Antenna
zh: 阿波罗 Block V 高增益天线

s: LEO Heatshield for the Apollo Block III+ Capsule. A lighter heat shield for use with LEO operations.
zh: 适用于阿波罗 Block III+ 太空舱的 LEO 隔热罩。用于 LEO 运营的较轻型隔热罩。
阿波罗 Block III+ 任务舱
阿波罗 Block III+ 服务舱

s: Significant changes were made to better adapt Apollo to its new role as a crew shuttle for LEO and the Service Module was decreased in size and weight. FICTIONAL (Eyes Turned Skyward)
zh: 进行了重大改进以更好地适应其作为 LEO 载人航天飞机的新定位，服务舱的尺寸和重量均有所缩减。虚构部件（Eyes Turned Skyward）

s: Enlarged service module to increase cargo capacity of Apollo Block 4. FICTIONAL (Eyes Turned Skyward)
zh: 扩大的服务舱，用于增加阿波罗 Block 4 的载货能力。虚构部件（Eyes Turned Skyward）

s: Extendable sun-tracking Level 3 solar panel used for the Block V Apollo CSM. 8.05m^2. FICTIONAL (Eyes Turned Skyward)
zh: 用于 Block V 阿波罗 CSM 的可伸展对日定向 3 级太阳能电池板。8.05m^2。虚构部件（Eyes Turned Skyward）

s: The ascent stage and crew compartment of the Apollo Lunar Module.
zh: 阿波罗登月舱的上升级和乘员舱。

s: The explosive bolt interstage connector placed between the ascent and the descent modules of the Apollo Lunar Module.
zh: 放置在阿波罗登月舱上升级和下降级之间的爆炸螺栓级间连接器。

s: The Apollo Lunar Module descent stage. Equipped with storage boxes for storing equipment.
zh: 阿波罗登月舱下降级。配有用于存放设备的储物箱。

s: A sturdy retracting landing leg, perfect for landing on other bodies. This part has multiple options to choose the design of the legs.
zh: 坚固的可收放着陆支架，非常适合在其他天体上着陆。该部件有多种选项可自定义支架设计。

s: Apollo LM Material Experiment Stowage Assembly
zh: 阿波罗 LM 材料实验储存组件 (MESA)

s: Storage bay, containing astronaut EVA equipment, and cameras to record the first steps onto the moon. Place to the left of the LM ladder.
zh: 设备舱，包含宇航员 EVA 设备以及记录人类在月球迈出第一步的摄像机。安装在 LM 梯子的左侧。

s: Folding SNAP-27 mount. Used for upgraded lunar missions that need to have keep-alive power and heat during the dormancy period of a long sortie.
zh: 折叠式 <<M0>> 支架。用于升级版的探月任务，需在长时间出击任务的休眠期内提供维持生存的电力和热量。

s: Radial quad-mount version of the SNAP-9 RTG. Used for upgraded lunar missions that need to have keep-alive power and heat during the dormancy period of a long sortie.
zh: 径向四联装版本的 <<M0>> RTG。用于升级版的探月任务，需在长时间出击任务的休眠期内提供维持生存的电力和热量。

s: This platform is intended to be mounted on top of a LM Descent Stage. Includes extending ramps for deploying a rover to the lunar surface. Rover design or parts not included.
zh: 该平台旨在安装在 LM 下降级顶部。包含用于将巡视器部署到月球表面的展开式坡道。不包含巡视器设计或零件。

s: Modified version of the standard CSM and LM RCS cluster, designed to be mounted on the LM-Truck to provide independent attitude control for autonomous landing.
zh: 标准 CSM 和 LM RCS 模块的改进版本，专为安装在 LM 货运卡车上而设计，为自主着陆提供独立的姿态控制。

s: Androgynous Peripheral Attachment System 75. First fully androgynous docking port, designed for the Apollo Soyuz Test Project.
zh: APAS-75 异体同构周边对接系统。首个完全异体同构的对接端口，专为阿波罗-联盟测试计划设计。
阿波罗-联盟测试计划对接舱

s: Apollo-Soyuz Test Project UV Absorbtion Experiment
zh: 阿波罗-联盟测试计划紫外吸收实验设备
阿波罗-联盟测试计划甚高频调频（VHF-FM）天线

s: A small, fixed VHF-FM whip antenna for the Apollo-Soyuz Test Project Docking Module.
zh: 用于阿波罗-联盟测试计划对接舱的小型固定式甚高频调频（VHF-FM）鞭状天线。

s: A small extending antenna used for maintaining communications between the Gemini spacecraft and the ground. Attaches to the equipment section
zh: 一种小型伸缩天线，用于保持双子座飞船与地面之间的通信。安装在仪器舱段上。

s: The Gemini cabin. Contains two astronauts. When equipped with fuel cells and combined with its service module, it is capable of complex, long duration space missions.
zh: 双子座乘员舱。容纳两名宇航员。当配备燃料电池并与服务舱结合使用时，它能够执行复杂的长时间太空任务。

s: Heatshield for the Gemini Capsule, capable of lifting LEO reentry. Can be switched to the Gemini B configuration with a hatch.
zh: 双子座太空舱隔热罩，可承受升力式 LEO 再入。可切换至带舱门的双子座 B 构型。

s: Gemini L was one proposal for an advanced Gemini pod capable of reentry from translunar trajectory. This would have included development of an improved TPS similar to the system used on Apollo.
zh: 双子座 L 是一种先进双子座乘员舱方案，能够承受地月转移轨道的直接再入。该方案原计划采用类似于阿波罗系统的改进型热防护系统（TPS）。

s: Covers up the nose of the Gemini Docking Mechanism to protect it during ascent. Jettison once out of the atmosphere.
zh: 覆盖双子座对接机构前端，在上升段提供气动保护。脱离大气层后即可抛弃。

s: A lighter nosecone for Gemini without the docking port.
zh: 用于双子座飞船的轻型整流锥，不带对接端口。

s: Gemini Orbit Attitude and Maneuvering System (SE-7-100) (RCS)
zh: 双子座轨道姿态与机动系统（<<M0>>）（RCS）

s: This tiny thruster is nevertheless more than sufficient to manuever the Gemini capsule around in low orbit. This part is configured as RCS.
zh: 这款微型推力器足以为双子座飞船在近地轨道提供机动能力。该部件配置为RCS。

s: Gemini Orbit Attitude and Maneuvering System (SE-7-100)
zh: 双子座轨道姿态与机动系统（<<M0>>）

s: This tiny thruster is nevertheless more than sufficient to manuever the Gemini capsule around in low orbit. This part is configured as an engine.
zh: 这款微型推力器足以为双子座飞船在近地轨道提供机动能力。该部件配置为发动机。
双子座着陆降落伞系统

s: Main parachute for Gemini. Attaches on top of the Gemini Re-entry Control System.
zh: 双子座的主降落伞。安装在双子座再入控制系统顶部。

s: Drogue parachute for the Gemini capsule. Attach to the node in the nose section.
zh: 双子座飞船的减速伞。安装在头部节点的连接点上。

s: This section contains fuel and thrusters to provide Gemini 3 axis attitude control after detaching the adapter section. RCS O/F Ratio 1.25:1.
zh: 该舱段包含推进剂和推力器，在分离适配舱段后为双子座提供三轴姿态控制。RCS氧燃比为1.25:1。

s: Gemini retro solid derived from the Star 13 orbit insertion motor. Place in 4x symmetry in the gaps of the retro module cruciform.
zh: 衍生自Star 13入轨电机的双子座固体反推火箭。以4对称方式安装在反推模块的十字间隙中。
双子座逆行舱段分离器

s: Low profile decoupler for separating the Gemini capsule from the Adapter Retrograde Section.
zh: 用于将双子座返回舱与适配舱段逆行部分分离的低轮廓分离器。

s: This hollow structural adapter is designed to sit on top of the Gemini equipment section and house a quad of retro motors for reentry. Houses six translational control thrusters.
zh: 此中空结构适配器设计用于安装在双子座仪器舱段顶部，容纳四台用于再入的反推火箭。内置六个平移控制推力器。

s: This decoupler is designed to sit between a capsule's heatshield, and the service module. It includes an umbilical to connect the capsule to the service module's systems.
zh: 此分离器设计安装在乘员舱防热盾与服务舱之间。包含一条将乘员舱与服务舱系统相连的脐带缆。

s: Structural docking adapter for Big Gemini. Ideally sized for the Apollo active docking port.
zh: 大双子座的结构对接适配器。尺寸与阿波罗主动对接舱口完美契合。

s: Heatshield for the Big Gemini capsule
zh: 大双子座乘员舱的防热盾

s: This large docking module is used to connect MOL segments to each other. It is capable of soft docking to line up the segments, before retracting and solidifying the connection.
zh: 此大型对接模块用于连接MOL舱段。可在缩回并锁紧连接前进行软对接以对齐舱段。

s: This is an enlarged Gemini nose fairing to allow the installation of larger parachutes for Big Gemini. All rendezvous and docking equipment has been removed to save weight.
zh: 这是加大的双子座头部整流罩，以便为大双子座安装更大的降落伞。已移除所有交会对接设备以减轻重量。

s: Enlarged main parachute for Big Gemini. Attaches on top of the Gemini Re-entry Control System.
zh: 大双子座的加大主降落伞。安装在双子座再入控制系统顶部。

s: Enlarged drogue parachute for the Big Gemini. Attach to the node in the nose section.
zh: 大双子座的加大减速伞。安装在头部节点的连接点上。

s: This intermediate-sized docking mechanism is great for bringing people together.
zh: 这种中等尺寸的对接机构非常适合连接航天器。
APAS 89/95 主动对接舱口（已弃用）

s: Please do not use this part, it will be removed in the future.
zh: 请勿使用此部件，后续版本中将被移除。
APAS 89/95 被动对接舱口（已弃用）

s: AJ10 variant burning liquid hydrogen and oxygen, proposed for use on the GE D-2 vehicle. (HINT: hold ALT while placing engines to disable surface attach.)
zh: 使用液氢液氧的 <<M0>> 改型，曾提议用于GE <<M1>> 飞船。（提示：放置发动机时按住 ALT 可禁用表面吸附。）

s: Deployable dish antenna inside aerodynamic fairing.
zh: 位于空气动力整流罩内的可展开抛物面天线。

s: Abort motor for block I D-2 configuration. Attach to the decoupler in 4x symmetry around base of vehicle.
zh: Block I <<M0>> 构型的逃逸火箭。以4对称方式安装在飞船底部的分离器上。

s: D-2 Block I Abort Motor Decoupler
zh: <<M0>> Block I 逃逸火箭分离器

s: Decoupler for D-2 block I abort motors.
zh: <<M0>> Block I 逃逸火箭的分离器。

s: D-2 Block II Launch Escape System
zh: <<M0>> Block II 发射逃离系统

s: Nose-mounted Launch Escape System for Block II D-2 vehicle. Place on top of attached docking port.
zh: 用于 Block II <<M0>> 飞船的头部发射逃离系统。安装在已附着的对接舱口上方。

s: A simple nose cone for unmanned launches.
zh: 用于无人发射的简易锥头。

s: A small probe and drogue docking system capable of crew transfer, useful for basic space stations.
zh: 可进行乘员转移的小型杆-锥对接系统，适用于基础空间站。

s: 4m to 4m Decoupler which connects the D-2 spacecraft to the launch vehicle.
zh: 用于将 <<M0>> 航天器连接到运载火箭的4米转4米分离器。

s: 3m to 3m decoupler which connects the Block II D-2 spacecraft to the launch vehicle.
zh: 用于将 Block II <<M0>> 航天器连接到运载火箭的3米转3米分离器。

s: 3m to 4m decoupler which connects the Block II D-2 spacecraft to the launch vehicle.
zh: 用于将 Block II <<M0>> 航天器连接到运载火箭的3米转4米分离器。

s: The basic D-2 mission module, containing an airlock, life support supplies, and extended battery power, but no docking capability.
zh: 基础型 <<M0>> 任务舱，包含气闸舱、生命维持补给和扩展电池容量，但不具备对接功能。

s: Upgraded D-2 mission module with docking port attachment.
zh: 带有对接舱口挂载点的升级型 <<M0>> 任务舱。

s: Landing parachute system for the D-2 descent capsule.
zh: 用于 <<M0>> 返回舱的着陆降落伞系统。

s: 3-thruster RCS block for roll control and translation, placed in 4 way symmetry around vessel center of mass.
zh: 用于滚转和平移控制的三喷口 RCS 块，以4对称方式布置在飞行器质心周围。

s: Service Module for D-2 vehicle, carries fuel and other vital systems.
zh: <<M0>> 飞船的服务舱，携带推进剂和其他关键系统。

s: Skirt section for the attachment of 4 engines, for missions requiring high levels of thrust. Originally this was proposed for redundancy and so quick aborts could be performed on circumlunar flights.
zh: 用于安装4台发动机的裙段，适用于需要大推力的任务。最初提议用于提供冗余，以便在绕月飞行任务中快速中止任务。

s: Propulsion/Service Module Skirt for Block II vehicle, with reduced mass and mounting for single engine, suitable for LEO operations.
zh: 用于 Block II 飞船的推进/服务舱裙段，质量更轻并可安装单台发动机，适合近地轨道运营。

s: Deployable solar arrays for extended orbital missions.
zh: 用于长时间轨道任务的可展开太阳能电池阵。

s: The command module of the CST-100 "Starliner" Commercial Crew Transportation System (COTS). Designed to be reusable for up to 10 times.
zh: <<M0>>“星际客机”商业乘员运输系统（COTS）的指令舱。设计最多可重复使用10次。

s: The heat shield for CST-100 "Starliner" command module.
The NASA Docking System (NDS) is a spacecraft docking and berthing mechanism for US human spaceflight vehicles, such as the Orion Multi-Purpose Crew Vehicle and the Commercial Crew vehicles.
zh: NASA 对接系统（NDS）是用于美国载人航天器的航天器对接与停泊机构，例如猎户座多功能载人飞船和商业载人航天器。

s: A protective nose cone for the NASA Docking System of the CST-100 Starliner.
zh: 用于 <<M0>> 星际客机 NASA 对接系统的保护性锥头。

s: The parachute pack for the CST-100 "Starliner" command module.
zh: <<M0>>“星际客机”指令舱的降落伞包。

s: The service module for the CST-100 "Starliner" spacecraft.
DynaSoar Docking arms. Attach them on the front left node of the DynaSoar body. Don’t forget to jettison them before reentry.
zh: <<M0>> 对接臂。安装在 <<M0>> 机身的左前节点上。再入前切勿忘记将其抛弃。

s: Docking rod for the DynaSoar. This is where the docking arms attach.
zh: <<M0>> 的对接杆。用于连接对接臂。

s: Attach this under the nose. Don’t forget to add this to the GEAR Action group so you can toggle it with the G key. Fiddle with the skid controls at your own risk since they function correctly as is.
zh: 安装在机头下方。请务必将其加入起落架动作组，以便使用 G 键开关。滑橇控制已按预期调校，改动风险自负。

s: Cargo bay for Dynasoar, to carry extra equipment, a payload, or bring something back...
zh: 恐龙滑翔机的货舱，用于携带额外设备、载荷或将物体带回地面……

s: The rear compartment of the Dynasoar glider, containing the fuel cells, batteries, avionics, and a very cramped crew passthrough.
zh: 恐龙滑翔机的后部舱段，包含燃料电池、蓄电池、航电设备以及一条极为狭窄的乘员通道。

s: Crew cabin for Dynasoar. Holds 2 passengers, and some extra life support equipment and supplies
zh: 恐龙滑翔机的乘员舱。可容纳2名乘员，以及一些额外的生命维持设备和补给。

s: Crew tube to allow for installation of a docking port in the dynasoar cargo bay
zh: 用于在恐龙滑翔机货舱内安装对接舱口的乘员通道管。

s: Vertical stabilizers for Dynasoar. Place with a slight inward angle for better stability
zh: 恐龙滑翔机的垂直安定面。略微向内倾斜安装以获得更好的稳定性。

s: A large aerodynamic Heatshield to protect your cockpit. Decouple before landing.
zh: 用于保护驾驶舱的大型气动防热盾。着陆前分离。

s: Wings for Dynasoar spaceplane. Place flush with the bottom of the fuselage. Contains RCS ports for roll control.
zh: 恐龙航天飞机的机翼。平齐安装在机身底部。内置用于滚转控制的 RCS 喷口。

s: This is a proposed high gain antenna for Gemini upgrades. It is meant to be mounted on the Gemini rendezvous and recovery section.
zh: 提议用于双子座升级型的高增益天线。设计安装在双子座交会与回收舱段上。

s: Decoupler, and flight pack for Winged Gemini. This pack has a decoupler on the bottom to jettison spent fuel tanks or engines.
zh: 翼状双子座的分离器兼飞行包。此背包底部带有一个分离器，用于抛弃耗尽的推进剂储罐或发动机。

s: Thiel Lox/Alcohol rocket engine. Used on V-2 missile. Work began June 1936. Interim design, but went into production. Used 18 x 1.5 tonne thrust chambers, feeding common mixing chamber. Tested from 1939, mass production 1943-1945. Diameter: [0.76 m].
zh: 蒂尔（Thiel）液氧/酒精火箭发动机。用于<<M0>>导弹。1936年6月开始研制。虽为过渡设计，但最终投入量产。采用18个1.5吨推力室向总混合室供料。1939年开始测试，1943至1945年间大规模生产。直径：[0.76 m]。

s: The power plant of the PGM-11 Redstone Short Range Ballistic Missile (SRBM). Originally designed for Ethanol/LOX (A-6) it was later adapted to use Hydyne/LOx (A-7) with approximately 6% higher performance (yet more toxic) for use in Jupiter-C / Juno I. When the Redstone was adapted from Jupiter-C for manned use under the Project Mercury (Mercury-Redstone Launch Vehicle - MRLV), the A-7 was switched back to Ethalox, accepting a slightly lower performance for the lack of toxicity. Thrust Vector Control (TVC) was provided by carbon thrust vanes and additional attitude control was provided by actuating fins placed in the guidance section. Diameter: 1.77 m.
zh: <<M0>>红石短程弹道导弹（SRBM）的动力装置。最初设计使用乙醇/液氧（<<M1>>），后经改进使用海丁/液氧（<<M2>>），性能提升约6%（但毒性更高），用于朱庇特-C/朱诺一号。当红石从朱庇特-C改进用于水星计划载人任务（水星-红石运载火箭 - MRLV）时，<<M2>>重新换回乙醇/液氧，以牺牲少量性能换取无毒性。推力矢量控制（TVC）由碳素燃气舵提供，制导段的可动翼面提供额外的姿态控制。直径：1.77 m。

s: This little solid motor is designed to be attached to the bottom of the Agena equipment rack to provide ullage thrust. Attach one pair 180 degrees apart for each burn that is necessary for the flight profile
zh: 这种小型固体发动机设计安装在阿吉娜（Agena）设备架底部，用于提供沉底推力。根据飞行剖面的点火需求，每需要一次点火就以180度间隔对称安装一对。

s: Secondary liquid engines for the Agena upper stage system. Attach to the gap in the truss on the Agena-D for intended use. Unintended use is not covered under warranty, but is encouraged. Includes a supply of fuel.
zh: 用于阿吉娜上面级系统的辅助液体发动机。按设计用途安装在阿吉娜-D桁架的空隙处。超出设计用途的使用不在保修范围内，但值得一试。自带推进剂补给。

s: Small pressure-fed hypergolic upper stage engine. Derivative of the first US liquid rocket engine, the AJ10 series is perhaps the longest-lived of any engine series, a part of the US's first satellite launch vehicle, Vanguard, the Apollo CSM, and even one projected Orion service module. This represents advanced era AJ10s with a nozzle extension and restart capability. Used on Transtage as AJ10-138; similar models but back with the -118 designation were used on the Delta F and Delta K upper stages.
zh: 小型挤压循环自燃推进剂上面级发动机。作为美国第一款液体火箭发动机的衍生型号，<<M0>>系列可能是寿命最长的发动机系列之一，曾用于美国首枚卫星运载火箭先锋号、阿波罗指令与服务舱，甚至曾计划用于猎户座服务舱。该型号代表带有延伸喷管和多次点火能力的后期改良型<<M1>>。在过渡级（Transtage）上编号为<<M0>>-138；其类似型号后重新使用-118编号，用于德尔塔F和德尔塔K上面级。

s: Small pressure-fed hypergolic upper stage engine. Derivative of the first US liquid rocket engine, the AJ10 series is perhaps the longest-lived of any engine series, a part of the US's first satellite launch vehicle, Vanguard, the Apollo CSM, and even one projected Orion service module. This is the original Vanguard second stage / Able / Delta configuration, without restart capability.
zh: 小型挤压循环自燃推进剂上面级发动机。作为美国第一款液体火箭发动机的衍生型号，<<M0>>系列可能是寿命最长的发动机系列之一，曾用于美国首枚卫星运载火箭先锋号、阿波罗指令与服务舱，甚至曾计划用于猎户座服务舱。这是最初用于先锋号第二级 / Able / 德尔塔构型，不具备多次点火能力。

s: Small pressure-fed hypergolic upper stage engine. Derivative of the first US liquid rocket engine, the AJ10 series is perhaps the longest-lived of any engine series, a part of the US's first satellite launch vehicle, Vanguard, the Apollo CSM, and even one projected Orion service module. This represents mid-period AJ10s with a nozzle extension and restart capability. Used on Thor-Ablestar and Delta E through Delta N.
zh: 小型挤压循环自燃推进剂上面级发动机。作为美国第一款液体火箭发动机的衍生型号，<<M0>>系列可能是寿命最长的发动机系列之一，曾用于美国首枚卫星运载火箭先锋号、阿波罗指令与服务舱，甚至曾计划用于猎户座服务舱。该型号代表带有延伸喷管和多次点火能力的中期型<<M1>>。用于雷神-Ablestar以及德尔塔E至德尔塔N运载火箭。

s: Proposed pump-fed upgrade for the AJ10. Developed in the 1980s as a high performance upper stage and tug. Based heavily on shuttle OMS, using the same nozzle and combustion chamber, with turbomachinery installed in place of pressure-fed system. Tested, but never flew, as program was cancelled following the Challenger disaster. Diameter: [1.17 m].
zh: <<M0>>的泵压输送改进方案。于20世纪80年代作为高性能上面级和轨道拖船动力研制。深度基于航天飞机OMS，使用相同的喷管与推力室，但将挤压输送系统替换为涡轮泵。虽然经过测试，但因挑战者号失事导致项目取消而未曾实际飞行。直径：[1.17 m]。

s: The AJ-260 was the largest rocket motor to ever be tested. This is the Short Length version that was a 21.6 x 6.6 meter behemoth that, when fully loaded, weighed more than 842 tons. It was capable of providing over 15,000 kN of thrust for 120 seconds. Ultimately the program was cancelled but not before three test firings where the engines performed exactly to specifications. This is the radially attached version to be used as a Solid Rocket Booster. [Diameter: 6.6 m]
zh: <<M0>>是有史以来测试过的最大火箭发动机。此版本为短构型，尺寸达到21.6 x 6.6米的庞然大物，满载时重达842吨以上。能够在120秒内提供超过15,000 kN的推力。该项目最终被取消，但在三次试车中发动机均完全达到了指标要求。此为径向安装版本，用作固体火箭助推器。[直径：6.6 m]

s: The AJ-260 was the largest rocket motor to ever be tested. This is the Short Length version that was a 21.6 x 6.6 meter behemoth that, when fully loaded, weighed more than 842 tons. It was capable of providing over 15,000 kN of thrust for 120 seconds. Ultimately the program was cancelled but not before three test firings where the engines performed exactly to specifications. [Diameter: 6.6 m]
zh: <<M0>>是有史以来测试过的最大火箭发动机。此版本为短构型，尺寸达到21.6 x 6.6米的庞然大物，满载时重达842吨以上。能够在120秒内提供超过15,000 kN的推力。该项目最终被取消，但在三次试车中发动机均完全达到了指标要求。[直径：6.6 m]

s: The AJ-260 was the largest rocket motor to ever be tested. This is the Full Length version of the engine that has a gross mass of more than 1600 tons and provides a thrust of 35,391 kN for more than 2 minutes. This version was te be used as an alternative to the Saturn IB and as booster motors for Apollo Applications launch vehicles. This is the radially attached version to be used as a Solid Rocket Booster. [Diameter: 6.6 m]
zh: <<M0>>是有史以来测试过的最大火箭发动机。此版本为全长全尺寸构型，总质量超过1600吨，可在2分多钟内提供35,391 kN的推力。该版本曾计划作为土星IB的替代方案以及阿波罗应用计划运载火箭的助推器。此为径向安装版本，用作固体火箭助推器。[直径：6.6 m]

s: The AJ-260 was the largest rocket motor to ever be tested. This is the Full Length version of the engine that has a gross mass of more than 1600 tons and provides a thrust of 35,391 kN for more than 2 minutes. This version was te be used as an alternative to the Saturn IB and as booster motors for Apollo Applications launch vehicles. [Diameter: 6.6 m]
zh: <<M0>>是有史以来测试过的最大火箭发动机。此版本为全长全尺寸构型，总质量超过1600吨，可在2分多钟内提供35,391 kN的推力。该版本曾计划作为土星IB的替代方案以及阿波罗应用计划运载火箭的助推器。[直径：6.6 m]

s: A small solid kick motor. Developed from the Altair, this final version was used on later Scout B launch vehicles. Used to circularize at apogee or perform final payload kick. Maximum thrust 25.6kN, burn time 31 seconds. Diameter: [0.50 m].
zh: 小型固体末级发动机。由牛郎星（Altair）发展而来，该最终版本曾用于后期的侦察兵B（Scout B）运载火箭。用于在远地点圆化轨道或完成载荷的最终冲程推进。最大推力25.6 kN，工作时间31秒。直径：[0.50 m]。

s: A small solid kick motor. Developed as alternative Vanguard third stage, reused on many later LVs with Able/Delta upper stage (or simply "Thor Burner") to circularize at apogee or perform final payload kick. Burn time 38 seconds. Diameter: [0.45 m].
zh: 小型固体末级发动机。最初作为先锋号第三级的备选方案开发，后在许多使用Able/德尔塔上面级的运载火箭（或简称为“雷神-Burner”）上广泛重复使用，用于远地点圆化轨道或完成载荷的最终冲程推进。工作时间38秒。直径：[0.45 m]。

s: A small solid kick motor used on the Jupiter-C sounding rocket (and later the Juno I and II launch vehicles) as upper stages in clusters of 11, 3 and, finally, one attached to the payload. The standard version uses the T17-E2 grain mixture while the higher performance one uses the JPL-532A. Very low overall performance and reliability.
zh: 用于朱庇特-C探空火箭（以及后来的朱诺一号和二号运载火箭）上面级的小型固体末级发动机，分别以11联装、3联装及最终单发连接载荷的方式集群使用。标准版本使用T17-E2装药配方，高性能版本则使用<<M0>>。整体性能和可靠性极低。

s: The BE-3 (Blue Engine 3) is a LH2/LOX rocket engine developed by Blue Origin. The BE-3 uses a combustion tap-off cycle engine design which takes a small amount of combustion gases from the main combustion chamber in order to power the engine turbopumps.
zh: <<M0>>（蓝色发动机3号 / Blue Engine 3）是由蓝色起源（Blue Origin）研发的液氢/液氧火箭发动机。<<M0>>采用燃烧室抽气循环设计，从主燃烧室分流少量燃气来驱动发动机涡轮泵。

s: Launch tower for the Saturn V.
zh: 用于土星 5 号的发射塔架。
恐龙滑翔机前起落滑橇
恐龙滑翔机后起落滑橇
