猎户座 LAS 及 BPC 保护罩
猎户座 RCS 姿控喷管
用于猎户座飞船的太阳能电池板。

s: The BE-4 is an oxidizer-rich staged combustion Methalox engine. Though initially developed for use on a Blue Origin launch vehicle, in 2014 United Launch Alliance announced that their new Vulcan launch vehicle, the successor to both the Atlas V and Delta IV launch vehicles, will be powered by a pair of BE-4 engines.
zh: <<M0>> 是一台富氧分级燃烧甲烷液氧发动机。尽管最初是为蓝色起源的运载火箭研发，但在2014年，联合发射联盟（ULA）宣布他们的新型火神运载火箭（宇宙神5型与德尔塔4型运载火箭的共同继承者）将由一对 <<M0>> 发动机提供动力。

s: The Castor 1 was first used for a successful suborbital launch of a Scout X-1 rocket on September 2, 1960. Castor 1 stages were also used as strap-on boosters for launch vehicles using Thor first stages, including the Delta-D. Diameter: [0.79 m].
zh: 卡斯托尔 1（Castor 1）于1960年9月2日首次用于侦察兵 <<M0>> 火箭的成功亚轨道发射。卡斯托尔 1 级也曾作为捆绑助推器，用于使用雷神第一级的运载火箭，包括德尔塔-D。直径：[0.79 m]。

s: A derivative of the Castor 1 motor, the Castor 2 featured higher specific impulse and propellant load and lower dry mass fraction as well as a longer burn time. It was used as strap-on booster starting with Delta E and was also used in all but the early Scouts. Burn time 39s. Diameter: [0.79 m].
zh: 作为卡斯托尔 1 发动机的衍生型，卡斯托尔 2 具有更高的比冲和推进剂加注量、更低的干重比以及更长的燃烧时间。它从德尔塔 E 开始用作捆绑助推器，并在除早期型号外的所有侦察兵火箭中得到应用。燃烧时间 39 秒。直径：[0.79 m]。

s: Pump-fed kerolox open cycle (gas generator) booster engine developed from LR79/89. Backup proposal for the first stage engine on the Titan 1 ICBM, and proposed first stage engine on the Saturn 1 but ultimately never flown (4 E-1s replaced with 8 H-1s). Diameter: [2.14 m].
zh: 基于 LR79/89 研发的泵压式开式循环（燃气发生器）煤油液氧助推器发动机。曾作为大力神 1 洲际弹道导弹第一级发动机的备选方案，并曾被提议用作土星 1 号的第一级发动机，但最终从未飞行（4 台 <<M0>> 被 8 台 <<M1>> 取代）。直径：[2.14 m]。

s: In 2015, ULA announced that Orbital ATK had been contracted to develop the GEM 63 as a drop-in replacement for the AJ-60A, and would replace Aerojet Rocketdyne as their Atlas V SRM supplier by the end of 2018. The GEM 63 will be larger than the GEM 60 SRMs used on the Delta IV and will not be equipped with thrust vectoring. As with the AJ-60A, launches using the four-meter fairing will be able to be equipped with up to three boosters while up to five boosters can be used with the five-meter fairing.
zh: 2015年，ULA 宣布已与轨道 ATK 签约研发 GEM 63，作为 <<M0>> 的直接替代品，并将在2018年底前取代航空喷气洛克达因成为其宇宙神5型的 SRM 供应商。GEM 63 的尺寸将大于德尔塔4型上使用的 GEM 60 SRM，且不配备推力矢量控制。与 <<M0>> 类似，使用4米整流罩的发射最多可配备3枚助推器，而使用5米整流罩时最多可使用5枚助推器。

s: The H-1 is an upgrade to the original LR79 engine that propelled the Saturn-I and IB vehicles, as well as late-model Delta rockets (as the RS-27). The H-1/RS-27 are optimized for the first-stage main engine role. The RS-27A has a higher expansion ratio for increased performance at altitude since liftoff thrust on the Delta II is augmented by solid boosters and the core burns rather longer. Diameter: [1.0 m].
zh: <<M0>> 是最初推动土星-I 和 IB 火箭以及后期德尔塔火箭（代号 <<M2>>）的 <<M1>> 发动机的升级型号。<<M0>>/<<M2>> 专为第一级主发动机的角色进行了优化。<<M3>> 拥有更高的膨胀比，以提高高空性能，因为德尔塔 II 的起飞推力由固体助推器增强，且芯级燃烧时间相当长。直径：[1.0 m]。

s: The R-4D HiPAT or High Performance Liquid Apogee Thruster performs orbit-raising manoeuvres for many of the world's communication satellite platforms, including the Astrium Eurostar 3000, Boeing Space Systems 702HP, MELCO DS-2000 & the Loral LS-1300. The R-4D has also played a critical role in NASA missions such as Cassini's orbit insertion of Saturn.
zh: <<M0>> <<M1>> 即高性能液体远地点推进器，为世界上许多通信卫星平台执行轨道提升机动，包括阿斯特里姆 Eurostar 3000、波音空间系统 702HP、三菱电机 <<M2>> 以及劳拉 <<M3>>。<<M0>> 还在 NASA 任务中发挥了关键作用，例如卡西尼号对土星的轨道捕获。

s: 2000s medium TWR, vacuum engine. The J-2X was intended to be used on the upper stages of Ares I and Ares V. Development continued after the cancellation of Ares, and early designs of SLS incorporated the engine, but selection of the RL10-powered Exploration Upper Stage resulted in the project being mothballed. Diameter: [3.0 m]
zh: 2000年代中 TWR 真空发动机。<<M0>> 原计划用于战神一号和战神五号的上面级。在战神计划取消后该发动机继续研发，SLS 的早期设计也采用了该发动机，但最终选用了 <<M1>> 动力的探索上面级，导致该项目被搁置封存。直径：[3.0 m]

s: A powerful hypergolic upper stage engine. Developed as the second stage of Juno IVB, it was the most powerful upper stage engine of its time. It was cancelled with the rest of the Juno program in favor of Atlas and Thor based LVs. Tested, but never flew.
zh: 一台强力的自燃上面级发动机。作为朱诺 IVB 的第二级研发，它是当时推力最大的上面级发动机。后来随着朱诺计划的其余部分一同被取消，取而代之的是基于宇宙神和雷神的运载火箭。经过测试，但从未飞行。

s: A small early hypergolic upper stage engine. Developed as the third stage of the Juno IVB, and later as the third stage of Atlas-Vega. It was tested extensively, but cancelled when NASA learned of the Air Force's Agena.
zh: 一台早期的小型自燃上面级发动机。最初作为朱诺 IVB 的第三级研发，后来作为宇宙神-织女星的第三级。它经过了广泛测试，但在 NASA 得知空军的阿金纳火箭后被取消。

s: World's first closed-cycle kerolox vacuum engine. The S1.5400 served as an R-7 upper stage and the RD-58 (an upgrade) as upper stage / OMS for many Soviet and Russian launchers and spacecraft (Proton, N1, Zenit, Buran...). The S1.5400 was designed for the Blok L stage which was the final stage for the Molniya configuration of the R-7, used to launch communication satellites and interplanetary probes. Unlike prior upper stages, it was restartable (this was needed to perform apogee kick to place Molniya satellites in their final orbits). It was given the industry designation 11D33. An upgraded version, termed 11D33M, had slightly improved performance. The RD-58 is a derivative of the 11D33M engine with higher performance (industry designation 11D58); it has been used on many Russian launchers and is still in use today on Proton and Zenit. In comparison to hydrolox upper stages, kerolox ones do not suffer boiloff as badly and need far less volume (kerosene being far denser than liquid hydrogen), but have much lower specific impulse. Diameter: [2.0 m].
zh: 世界上第一台闭式循环煤油液氧真空发动机。S1.5400 曾用作 <<M0>> 上面级，而 <<M1>>（升级型）则作为许多苏联和俄罗斯运载火箭及航天器（质子号、N1、天顶号、暴风雪号……）的上面级/OMS。S1.5400 专为 Blok L 级设计，该级是 <<M0>> 闪电构型的末级，用于发射通信卫星和行星际探测器。与以往的上面级不同，它具备多次启动能力（这是将闪电卫星送入最终轨道执行远地点变轨所必需的）。其工业代号为 11D33。被称为 11<<M2>> 的升级版本性能略有提高。<<M1>> 是 11<<M2>> 发动机的高性能衍生型（工业代号 11D58）；它已广泛应用于许多俄罗斯运载火箭上，并且至今仍在质子号和天顶号上服役。与氢氧上面级相比，煤油液氧上面级蒸发损耗不严重，所需容积也小得多（煤油密度远高于液氢），但比冲要低得多。直径：[2.0 m]。

s: The Umbilical Tower functions as both a launch clamp and a fuel pump. This will keep your fuel filled up while waiting on the launch pad for your launch window. To start the fuel flow, right click on the tower.
zh: 脐带塔兼具发射架和燃油泵的功能。这可以在发射台上等待发射窗口时保持燃料充满。要启动燃料加注，请右键点击该塔。

s: The LEROS 4 High Thrust Apogee Engine is a ESA funded 1100 N spacecraft main engine undergoing development by Moog. The engine will uniquely support the agencies future interplanetary exploration missions by reducing the mass of spacecraft propellant required for orbit insertion manoeuvres and so allow increased scientific payload to be accommodated on these missions.
zh: LEROS 4 高推力远地点发动机是由 ESA 资助、穆格公司正在研发的 1100 N 航天器主发动机。该发动机将通过减少航天器轨道捕获机动所需的推进剂质量，独特地支持该机构未来的行星际探测任务，从而使这些任务能够搭载更多的热心科研有效载荷。

s: Pump or pressure-fed kerolox vernier engine. Used for attitude control and final velocity adjustment in the MA-x system (2x LR89 + LR105 + 2x LR101) on Atlas, and MB-x system (LR79 or RS-27 + 2xLR101) on Thor-Able / Thor-Agena / Thor-Delta / Delta.
zh: 泵压或挤压式煤油液氧游控发动机。用于宇宙神 MA-x 系统（2x <<M0>> + <<M1>> + 2x <<M2>>）以及雷神-阿布尔/雷神-阿金纳/雷神-德尔塔/德尔塔的 MB-x 系统（<<M3>> 或 <<M4>> + 2<<M5>>）中的姿态控制和最终速度调整。

s: Kerolox gas-generator sustainer engine used in the Atlas launch vehicle. It, like the Atlas's booster engines (LR89s) are lit on the ground, but after a bit over 2 minutes' flight the boosters are dropped and the Atlas core continues to orbit under the power of the sustainer engine (and the verniers for roll control and final adjustment). The final configuration of the LR105 (like the LR89) uses RS-27 components for increased performance. As a sustainer engine, the LR105 has relatively poor sea level specific impulse compared to most boosters, but somewhat better vacuum specific impulse--though the difference in both is nowhere near as pronounced as when comparing a booster to an upper stage engine. Diameter: [1.5 m].
zh: 用于宇宙神运载火箭的煤油液氧燃气发生器巡航发动机。它与宇宙神的助推器发动机（<<M0>>）一样在地面点火，但在飞行两分多钟后助推器被抛弃，宇宙神芯级依靠巡航发动机的动力（以及用于滚转控制和最终调整的游标）继续飞向轨道。<<M1>> 的最终构型（如 <<M2>>）采用了 <<M3>> 部件以提升性能。作为巡航发动机，与大多数助推器相比，<<M1>> 的海平面比冲相对较差，但真空比冲略好——不过这两者的差距远没有助推器与上面级发动机相比时那么明显。直径：[1.5 m]。

s: Long-lasting US Kerolox gas-generator booster engine. The same components and broadly the same performance as the LR89, the LR79 (also known as S-3D in Jupiter / Juno II) powered Jupiter, Thor, and Thor-Delta (Delta) rockets. Diameter: [1.53 m].
zh: 服役时间极长的美国煤油/液氧燃气发生器助推器发动机。具有与<<M0>>相同的组件和大致相同的性能，<<M1>>（在朱庇特/朱诺二号中也称为<<M2>>）为朱庇特、雷神和雷神-德尔塔（德尔塔）火箭提供动力。直径：[1.53 m]。

s: Used in the first stage of the Titan rocket family, the LR87 is composed of two engines with separate turbomachinery integrated into one unit. The version used on Titan I burned kerosene and liquid oxygen, while Titan II through Titan IV burned storable propellants. A modified version burning liquid hydrogen was developed for the upper stages of Saturn V and Saturn IB, but the J-2 was selected instead. Diameter: [3.0 m].
zh: 用于大力神系列火箭的第一级，<<M0>>由两台集成为一体并带有独立涡轮机械的发动机组成。大力神I型上使用的版本燃烧煤油和液氧，而大力神II型至IV型则燃烧可贮存推进剂。曾为土星五号和土星IB的上级研制过一种燃烧液氢的改进版本，但最终选择了<<M1>>。直径：[3.0 m]。

s: Kerolox gas-generator engine that served as booster for Atlas (as -89, MA-x sysem) and main engine for Thor/Thor-Delta/Delta and Jupiter/Juno II rockets (as -79, MB-x system). Late model LR89s were upgraded with RS-27 components for higher efficiency, whereas the RS-27 itself was used on Delta by that point. LR89 configs are comparable to similar-era -79 configs, since they were the same engine underneath.
zh: 煤油/液氧燃气发生器发动机，曾用作宇宙神助推器（编号-89，MA-x系统）以及雷神/雷神-德尔塔/德尔塔和朱庇特/朱诺二号火箭的主发动机（编号-79，MB-x系统）。后期的<<M0>>升级了<<M1>>组件以提高效率，彼时<<M1>>本身已用于德尔塔火箭。<<M2>>配置与同期的-79配置相当，因为它们本质上是同一款发动机。

s: The Mars Landing Engine (MLE) is a derivative of the highly successful MR-80 engine used for the two Viking missions to Mars in 1976. Eight of these engines where used on the sky-crane which landed the Curiosity Rover on the martian surface.
zh: 火星着陆发动机（MLE）是高度成功的<<M0>>发动机的衍生型号，后者曾用于1976年的两次海盗号火星任务。好奇号火星车降落火星表面所用的空中起重机安装了八台此类发动机。

s: The Viking lander Terminal Descent Engine (TDE). The lander had three such engines, which were used during the final 45 seconds or so of the descent to the surface of Mars. Multiple small exhaust nozzles are used to diffuse the exhaust plume and eliminate a recirculation zone that could contaminate spacecraft instrumentation and avoid potential extensive erosion of the landing site.
zh: 海盗号着陆器终端下降发动机（TDE）。着陆器装有三台此类发动机，用于降落火星表面最后45秒左右的减速阶段。采用多个小型排气喷嘴以分散尾流羽流，消除可能污染航天器仪器的再循环区，并避免着陆点发生严重的土壤冲刷。

s: The NK-15 and NK-33 were originally built in the 1960s/early 1970s for the Soviet N1 and then N1F rocket, respectively. Though the N1F was scrapped, the engines survived. Aerojet acquired several NK-33 engines in the 1990s and refurbished them as AJ26-62 engines for Orbital Science's Antares launch vehicle. Modifications made by Aerojet included increasing rated thrust and equipping the engines to support gimballing. Diameter: [1.83 m].
zh: <<M0>>和<<M1>>最初分别于1960年代和1970年代初为苏联N1以及随后的N1F火箭制造。尽管N1F被取消，但发动机保留了下来。航天飞机发动机公司（Aerojet）在1990年代购得数台<<M1>>发动机，并将其翻新为用于轨道科学公司安塔瑞斯运载火箭的<<M2>>-62发动机。Aerojet的改进包括提高额定推力以及加装万向节摆动支架。直径：[1.83 m]。

s: This model is based on the Phoenix Mars Lander. Featuring a pair of MR-107 Monopropellant Engines, six of these pairs were used as retro-propulsion for the final decent phase of the Phoenix Mars Lander. [Uses RCS Configuration]
zh: 该模型基于凤凰号火星着陆器。配备一对<<M0>>单组元推进剂发动机，凤凰号火星着陆器在最终下降阶段共使用了六对该发动机进行反推减速。[使用 RCS 配置]

s: The R-42 Engine is designed for apogee orbit injection of geostationary satellites and for trajectory and planetary orbit manoeuvres of deep space probes. The engine is an evolution of the R-4D series of engines used on the highly successful HTV vehicle and the legendary Cassini probe.
zh: <<M0>>发动机专为地球同步卫星的远地点变轨以及深空探测器的轨道和行星环绕机动而设计。该发动机由高可靠性的<<M1>>系列发动机演变而来，后者曾用于大获成功的HTV货运飞船和传奇的卡西尼号探测器。

s: Kerolox gas generator vacuum engine which served in R-7 upper stages (Luna, Vostok). The RD-0105 was designed for Luna launches; it was the first upper stage for the R-7 series and was reused for uncrewed Vostok tests. An enhanced version, the RD-0109, was used for crewed Vostok launches. Diameter: [1.30 m].
zh: 用于<<M0>>上级（月球号、东方号）的煤油/液氧燃气发生器真空发动机。<<M1>>专为月球号发射设计；它是<<M0>>系列的第一款上级发动机，并在东方号无人测试中重复使用。其改进型号<<M2>>则用于东方号载人发射。直径：[1.30 m]。

s: Booster engine for the R-7 Semyorka and its derivatives, including the Sputnik, Luna, Voskhod, Vostok, Soyuz, and Molniya launch vehicles. Differs from the core engine series (RD-108) with a higher chamber pressure, thrust, and smaller vernier layout. The R-7 family core was supplemented for (roughly) two minutes by four strap-on boosters powered by these engines. Diameter: [1.85 m].
zh: 用于<<M0>>“老七”及其衍生型号的助推器发动机，衍生型号包括斯普特尼克、月球号、上升号、东方号、联盟号和闪电号运载火箭。与芯级发动机系列（<<M1>>）相比，它的室压更高、推力更大，游机布局更紧凑。由这型发动机提供动力的四枚捆绑式助推器，为<<M0>>家族芯级提供了约两分钟的额外推力。直径：[1.85 m]。

s: Core engine for the R-7 Semyorka and its derivatives, including the Sputnik, Luna, Voskhod, Vostok, Soyuz, and Molniya launch vehicles. Differs from the booster engine series (RD-107) with a lower chamber pressure, thrust, and a wider vernier layout. Powers the R-7 family core through a very long (roughly) five minute burn that starts on the pad alongside the boosters. Diameter: [1.85 m].
zh: 用于<<M0>>“老七”及其衍生型号的芯级发动机，衍生型号包括斯普特尼克、月球号、上升号、东方号、联盟号和闪电号运载火箭。与助推器发动机系列（<<M1>>）相比，它的室压和推力更低，游机布局更展开。在发射台上与助推器同时点火，并在极长（约5分钟）的燃烧时间内持续为<<M0>>家族芯级提供动力。直径：[1.85 m]。

s: A Soviet high performance semi-cryogenic upper stage engine. Originally developed as an upper stage for the R-7, it was later adapted to to Kosmos-2 Launch Vehicle, which needed a high performance upper stage due to the low performance of its R-12 first stage.
zh: 苏联高性能半低温上级发动机。最初作为<<M0>>的上级发动机研发，后来适配于宇宙-2运载火箭，由于该火箭的<<M1>>第一级性能较低，因此需要一款高性能上级。

s: 1980s to present, High TWR, atmospheric booster engine. The RD-170 is the most powerful liquid rocket engine ever flown. Originally developed for the Energia launcher's boosters, the engine consists of four combustion chambers fed by a single turbopump. A modified version, the RD-171, is used on the first stage of the Zenit launch vehicle. Diameter: [3.8 m].
zh: 1980年代至今服役的高TWR大气助推器发动机。<<M0>>是有史以来实际飞行过推力最强的液体火箭发动机。最初为能源号运载火箭的助推器开发，发动机由单台涡轮泵供给四个燃烧室。其改进版本<<M1>>用于天顶号运载火箭的第一级。直径：[3.8 m]。

s: A further continuation of the RD-170/171 series, featuring a single combustion chamber and nozzle. The RD-191 powers the Angara family of launchers, while the RD-151 was used on the Naro-1 launch vehicle and the RD-181 will be used on the Antares 200-series. Diameter: [1.7 m].
zh: <<M0>>/171系列的进一步发展型号，采用单燃烧室和单喷管。<<M1>>为安加拉系列运载火箭提供动力，<<M2>>曾用于<<M3>>运载火箭，而<<M4>>将用于安塔瑞斯200系列。直径：[1.7 m]。

s: An early Soviet four chamber rocket. Developed from the RD-100 for the R-12 IRBM in the mid 1950s, it provided a significant increase in power over earlier Soviet engines. It was later used for the Kosmos-2 launch vehicle.
zh: 早期苏联四室火箭发动机。于1950年代中期在<<M0>>的基础上为<<M1>>中程弹道导弹研制，相比早期苏联发动机推力显著提升。后来用于宇宙-2运载火箭。

s: Soviet dual chamber gas generator engine. Designed in the late 1950s to use storable propellants for ICBMs, since the current R-7 required cryogenic propellants that could not be stored for long periods, requiring lengthy fuelling before launch. It was used in clusters of up to three in many Soviet ICBMs, and later in the Kosmos and Tsiklon launch vehicles.
zh: 苏联双燃烧室燃气发生器发动机。设计于1950年代后期，为洲际弹道导弹使用可贮存推进剂而研制，因为当时服役的<<M0>>需要低温推进剂且无法长期贮存，发射前需要冗长的加注过程。它在许多苏联洲际弹道导弹中以最多三台并联的机组使用，后来用于宇宙号和旋风号运载火箭。

s: 1970s Full Flow Staged Combustion N2O4/UDMH Rocket Engine. Designed for the UR-700 Super Heavy Lift Launch Vehicle. More than 40 hot fire tests were done before the cancelation of all UR series rockets except the Proton. Diameter: [3.30m]
zh: 1970年代的全流量分级燃烧N2O4/UDMH火箭发动机。专为<<M0>>超重型运载火箭设计。在除质子号以外的所有UR系列火箭被取消之前，该发动机已完成40余次热试车。直径：[3.30m]

s: Engine for proposed Vega stage for NASA Atlas-Vega LV. Superceded by Atlas-Agena once NASA became aware of the USAF's Agena stage.
zh: 为 NASA 阿特拉斯-织女星运载火箭织女星级提议的发动机。在 NASA 获知美国空军的阿金纳级后，该方案被阿特拉斯-阿金纳取代。

s: A very early kerolox gas generator booster engine used on the Vanguard launch vehicle. Diameter: 1.0 m.
zh: 先锋号运载火箭上使用的极早期液氧煤油气动发生器循环助推器发动机。直径：1.0 m。

s: Pressure-fed throttleable (by selecting number of chambers active) ethanol/LOX engine designed for the X-1 and used on numerous early US X-planes. Supports up to 4 ignitions.
zh: 挤压循环可节流（通过选择启用的燃烧室数量）乙醇/液氧发动机，专为 <<M0>> 设计并用于多款早期美国 X 系列验证机。支持最多 4 次点火。

s: Americanized version of the V-2 Model 39 (A-4). It was very similar to its predecessor, but was built using American SAE components rather than Metric components, and featured several minor upgrades.
zh: <<M0>> 39 型（<<M1>>）的美国化版本。与前型非常相似，但使用美制 SAE 零部件而非公制零部件制造，并进行了若干细微升级。

s: The Rutherford Engine is the worlds first electric turbo-pumped LOX/RP-1 engine. Rutherford adopts an entirely new propulsion cycle, making use of brushless DC motors and high performance Lithium Polymer batteries to drive its turbo-pumps. The engine is named after the famous physicist Ernest Rutherford.
zh: 卢瑟福（Rutherford）发动机是世界上首款采用电动涡轮泵的液氧/<<M0>>发动机。卢瑟福采用了全新的推进循环，利用无刷直流电机和高性能锂聚合物电池来驱动其涡轮泵。该发动机以著名物理学家欧内斯特·卢瑟福的名字命名。

s: The Rutherford Engine is the worlds first electric turbo-pumped LOX/RP-1 engine. Rutherford adopts an entirely new propulsion cycle, making use of brushless DC motors and high performance Lithium Polymer batteries to drive its turbo-pumps. The engine is named after the famous New Zealand born physicist Ernest Rutherford.
zh: 卢瑟福（Rutherford）发动机是世界上首款采用电动涡轮泵的液氧/<<M0>>发动机。卢瑟福采用了全新的推进循环，利用无刷直流电机和高性能锂聚合物电池来驱动其涡轮泵。该发动机以著名新西兰裔物理学家欧内斯特·卢瑟福的名字命名。

s: The S400 400N bipropellant Engine is designed for apogee orbit injection of geostationary satellites and for trajectory and planetary orbit maneuvers of deep space probes. Notable missions include Galileo, Mars Express, Venus Express & the ExoMars Trace Gas Orbiter. [Uses RCS Configuration]
zh: <<M0>> 400N双组元发动机设计用于地球同步卫星的远地点轨道注入，以及深空探测器的弹道与行星轨道机动。知名任务包括伽利略号、火星快车号、金星快车号以及<<M1>>微量气体轨道飞行器。[使用RCS配置]

s: The S5.92 is a Russian rocket engine currently powering the Fregat upper stage. The S5.92 engine was developed for use on the Phobos missions, then later adapted for use on the Fregat space tug which currently serves as the orbital stage for the Soyuz and Zenit launch vehicles.
zh: S5.92是一款俄罗斯火箭发动机，目前为“巡航（Fregat）”上面级提供动力。S5.92发动机最初为火卫一任务研发，随后被改进用于Fregat轨道拖船，后者目前作为联盟号和天顶号运载火箭的轨道级使用。

s: The S5.98M also known as the 14D30 is a Russian rocket engine, currently powering the Briz upper stages. The engines design was based on the S5.92 engine, but differs slightly in mass, performance and physical layout.
zh: S5.98M也被称为14D30，是一款俄罗斯火箭发动机，目前为“微风（Briz）”上面级提供动力。该发动机的设计基于S5.92发动机，但在质量、性能和物理布局上略有不同。

s: The "SNTP-PFE" series is a 1000MW reactor. The reactor is a particle bed using metallic carbide coated uranium granules embedded in a graphite rod that hydrogen is passed through. This allows for power densities of up to 40MW/liter. Its core is capable of starting up five times. An integral Tungsten Boron Lithium Hydride composite shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shut down gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted three to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be ten to fifteen meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. This rocket has impressive stats for its size (Nozzle Ae=100 Chamber Temp=2720 Ideal ISP=991 Reactor Power=1054MW(th) TWR=13.94 Chamber Pressure=6800kPa Ignitions =5 Tonnage including integral shadow shield:1.504tons ) The nozzle is a fixed ablatively cooled filament wound carbon-carbon design.
zh: "SNTP-PFE"系列是一款1000MW反应堆。该反应堆为颗粒床设计，采用嵌入在氢气流经的石墨棒中的碳化金属涂层铀颗粒。这使得功率密度可高达40MW/升。其堆芯能够启动五次。包含一套整体式钨-硼-氢化锂复合屏蔽罩，整个组件采用再生冷却。次级回路将关机吹扫气体通入小型热机，以最大限度减少燃料损失并提供基本发电机电力。该发动机应安装在距离最近燃料箱三至六米处。燃料应作为乘员屏蔽体，运转时乘员位置应距离发动机十至十五米。额外的屏蔽（如水箱或高密度燃料）可在一定程度上减少该距离。这台火箭在同尺寸下拥有惊人的参数（喷管 Ae=100，燃烧室温度=2720，理想比冲=991，反应堆热功率=1054MW(th)，TWR=13.94，燃烧室压力=6800kPa，点火次数=5，含整体阴影屏蔽总重：1.504吨）。喷管为固定式烧蚀冷却缠绕碳-碳复合材料设计。

s: The STAR 5D rocket motor was designed and qualified to serve as the rocket-assisted deceleration (RAD) motor on the Mars Pathfinder mission. Three of these motors were fired to slow the Pathfinder spacecraft to near-zero velocity before bouncing on the surface of Mars.
zh: STAR 5D火箭发动机经过设计和验证，用作火星探路者号任务中的火箭辅助减速（RAD）发动机。其中三台发动机点火，将探路者号航天器减速至接近零速度，随后在火星表面弹跳着陆。

s: The STAR 8 was developed and qualified as the rocket assisted deceleration (RAD) motor for the Mars Exploration Rover (MER) program. The motor is based on the STAR 5D motor technology developed for JPL’s Mars Pathfinder program. The STAR 8 first flew in January 2004 when three motors were used to decelerate each of the Spirit and Opportunity rovers for landing at Gusev Crater and Meridiani Planum on Mars.
zh: STAR 8作为火星探测漫游者（MER）计划的火箭辅助减速（RAD）发动机研发并经过验证。该发动机基于为JPL火星探路者计划开发的STAR 5D发动机技术打造。STAR 8于2004年1月首次飞行，当时三台发动机分别用于为勇气号和机遇号火星车减速，以在火星古谢夫撞击坑和子午线高原着陆。

s: SuperDraco is a hypergolic propellant liquid rocket engine designed and built by SpaceX. It is part of SpaceX's Draco family of rocket engines. A redundant array of eight SuperDraco engines provides fault-tolerant propulsion for use as a launch escape system and propulsive-landing thrust for the Dragon V2 passenger-carrying space capsule.
zh: <<M0>>是由<<M1>>设计并制造的自燃推进剂液体火箭发动机。它是<<M1>>天龙座（Draco）系列火箭发动机的一部分。由八台<<M0>>发动机组成的冗余阵列提供了容错推进动力，用作载人龙飞船V2的发射逃离系统以及推进着陆推力。

s: The Vernier System as used on the Surveyor Probes. Uses storable hypergolic propellants, has infinite restarts and is not subject to ullage. Throttleable down to 30%. Historically 3 of them were used on the Surveyor probes which landed on the Moon. Diameter: [0.13 m].
zh: 勘测者号探测器上使用的游标系统。使用可贮存自燃推进剂，具备无限次重启能力且不受沉底限制。节流阀可下调至30%。历史上曾有3台安装在勘测者号探测器上用于月球着陆。直径：[0.13 m]。

s: 3m 5-segment strap-on solid rocket booster for Titan rockets. Traditionally, these are fired on the launchpad, and the main stack's liquid first stage is fired 10 seconds before SRB burnout. Used on the Titan III-C, III-D, 23C and III-E.
zh: 用于大力神火箭的3米5段式捆绑固体火箭助推器。传统上，它们在发射台上点火，主芯级的液体第一级在SRB燃尽前10秒点火。曾用于大力神 III-C、III-D、23C 和 III-E。

s: The UA1207 was used on the Titan IVA, which was developed to launch payloads that had been designed to fly on the Shuttle from Vandenberg. It was a 7-segment modification of the 5-segment UA1205 used on the Titan 3. Burn time 130 seconds. Diameter: [3.05 m].
zh: <<M0>>用于大力神 IVA，该火箭开发用于从范登堡发射原本设计由航天飞机搭载的载荷。它是大力神 3所使用的5段式<<M1>>的7段改进型。燃烧时间130秒。直径：[3.05 m]。

s: Large radial decoupler for separating Titan solid rocket boosters from the core stack. Use the attach node to attach the booster at the right height consistently. Has mesh options for each height of UA120 solid rocket.
zh: 用于将大力神固体火箭助推器与芯级分离的大型径向分离器。使用附着节点可确保每次都在正确高度安装助推器。为各种高度的<<M0>>固体火箭提供了模型外观选项。

s: Rated for LEO reentries with a deeply negative perigee.
zh: 额定适用于深负近地点LEO再入。
额定适用于无升力LEO再入。
额定适用于升力式LEO再入。
额定适用于行星际再入。

s: Rated for Mars or very gentle Earth reentries.
zh: 额定适用于火星再入或极平缓的地球再入。

s: This hypersonic inflatable aerodynamic decelerator can have its diameter and configuration changed to fit many different craft sizes and reentry profiles.
zh: 这种高超音速充气式气动减速器可调整直径与构型，以适配多种航天器尺寸及再入剖面。

s: This heatshield can have its diameter and configuration changed to fit many different craft sizes and reentry profiles.
zh: 该防热盾可调整直径与构型，以适配多种航天器尺寸及再入剖面。

s: Unlocks beryllium heat sink technology designed for ballistic reentry
zh: 解锁专为弹道式再入设计的铍吸热型防热技术

s: Unlocks ablative heatshield technology designed for ballistic reentry
zh: 解锁专为弹道式再入设计的烧蚀防热盾技术

s: Unlocks ablative heatshield technology designed for lifting reentry
zh: 解锁专为升力式再入设计的烧蚀防热盾技术

s: Unlocks early lunar capable heatshield technology
zh: 解锁早期具备登月级能力的防热盾技术
高超音速充气式气动减速器

s: Unlocks hypersonic inflatable aerodynamic decelerator technology
zh: 解锁高超音速充气式气动减速器技术

s: An early solid kick motor. It was used as the third stage on the Aerobee 300 and Aerobee 300A sounding rockets.
zh: 早期固体推冲发动机。曾用作“气蜂”300和“气蜂”300A探空火箭的第三级。

s: Small, but powerful solid fueled booster used as the first stage for the Aerobee line of Sounding Rockets.
zh: 小巧而强劲的固体燃料助推器，用作“气蜂”系列探空火箭的第一级。

s: Small sustainer for WAC Corporal and Aerobee sounding rockets. Pressure-fed. Used after a small solid booster. Diameter: [0.3 m].
zh: 用于“下士WAC”和“气蜂”探空火箭的小型主发动机。挤压循环。在小型固体助推器分离后使用。直径：[0.3 m]。

s: Equipment rack for Agena. It contains RCS, fuel tanks, batteries, and can be used to mount auxillary thrusters and solar panels to turn Agena into a self-sustaining satellite bus.
zh: “阿金纳”设备舱段。内含RCS、燃料箱、电池，可用于安装辅助推进器和太阳能电池翼，将“阿金纳”改造成自持式卫星平台。

s: A small solid rocket motor to provide thrust for Agena spin-up. We're sure you can find other uses for it too.
zh: 用于为“阿金纳”提供起旋推力的小型固体火箭发动机。我们相信你也能找到它的其他用途。

s: The Aerojet AJ10-137 was used as the Service Propulsion System (SPS) on the Apollo Service Module. It was designed to operate for up to 750 seconds and could restart 50 times.
zh: Aerojet <<M0>>-137曾用作“阿波罗”服务舱的服务推进系统（SPS）。设计工作时间长达750秒，可重复启动50次。

s: AJ10_190 OMS engine for Space shuttle and Orion spacecraft.
zh: 用于航天飞机和“猎户座”飞船的<<M0>> OMS发动机。

s: AJ-60A is a solid rocket booster produced by Aerojet Rocketdyne. They are currently used as strap-on boosters on United Launch Alliance's Atlas V rocket.
zh: <<M0>>是由Aerojet Rocketdyne生产的固体火箭助推器。目前作为捆绑式助推器用于联合发射联盟（ULA）的“宇宙神V”火箭。

s: Middle cluster in Sergeant Cluster used on Juno I and II launch vehicles and on the Jupiter-C test rocket.
zh: “木星-C”试验火箭以及“朱诺I”和“朱诺II”运载火箭上“军士”集束级的中层构型。

s: First stage in the Sergeant Cluster used on Juno I and II launch vehicles and on the Jupiter-C test rocket.
zh: “木星-C”试验火箭以及“朱诺I”和“朱诺II”运载火箭上“军士”集束级的第一级构型。

s: A small decoupler for your 3x Baby Sargeant engine cluster.
zh: 用于3台“幼军士”集束发动机的小型分离器。

s: A small decoupler for your 11x Baby Sargeant engine cluster. Place this on the node on top of the 3x Cluster (after placing the 3x Cluster) and attach your 11x Cluster to this.

zh: 这种模块化发动机安装架支持多种自定义设置。你可以更换模型，也可以更改直径与长度。

s: The Decoupler allows you to change the Diameter of the part to fit many different configurations for your craft. It allows for customization of Decoupling just the bottom node as normal, or both nodes like a separator.
zh: 该分离器允许修改部件直径，以适配航天器的各种不同构型。它支持自定义分离方式，既可像普通分离器一样仅分离底部节点，也能像双向分离器一样同时分离上下两个节点。

s: The Ring Decoupler allows you to change the Diameter of the part to fit many different configurations for your craft. It allows for customization of Decoupling just the bottom node as normal, or both nodes like a separator.
zh: 该环形分离器允许修改部件直径，以适配航天器的各种不同构型。它支持自定义分离方式，既可像普通分离器一样仅分离底部节点，也能像双向分离器一样同时分离上下两个节点。

s: This modular tank allows for many customizations. You can integrate top and bottom adapters, adjust the length and the diameter as well. It is comprised of many different tank types. You can choose the tank type below. Each tank type has a different base mass, different cost, and different amounts of utilization it can have. The HP versions of the tanks are Highly Pressurized and are used for engines that require it.
zh: 该模块化贮箱支持多种自定义设置。你可以集成顶部和底部适配器，并调整其长度与直径。它包含多种不同的贮箱类型，可在下方选择。每种贮箱类型具有不同的基础质量、成本以及可用容积率。标记为 HP 的高压版本适用于需要增压输送的发动机。

s: This modular tank is based on the Atlas launch vehicle that was used by the United States in the 1950's and 1960's. You can integrate top and bottom adapters, adjust the length and the diameter as well.
zh: 该模块化贮箱基于美国在 20 世纪 50 至 60 年代使用的宇宙神（Atlas）运载火箭设计。你可以集成顶部和底部适配器，并调整其长度与直径。

s: This modular booster tank allows for many adjustments and simulates the types of tanks used on the R-7 family of Soviet rockets. It is comprised of many different tank types. You can choose the tank type below. Each tank type has a different base mass, different cost, and different amounts of utilization it can have. The HP versions of the tanks are Highly Pressurized and are used for engines that require it.
zh: 该模块化助推器贮箱支持多种调整，用于模拟苏联<<M0>>系列火箭所使用的贮箱类型。它包含多种不同的贮箱类型，可在下方选择。每种贮箱类型具有不同的基础质量、成本以及可用容积率。标记为 HP 的高压版本适用于需要增压输送的发动机。

s: This modular tank allows for many customizations. You can swap out models as well as change the diameter and length. It is comprised of many different tank types. You can choose the tank type below. Each tank type has a different base mass, different cost, and different amounts of utilization it can have. zh: 该模块化贮箱支持多种自定义设置。你可以更换外观模型，并调整其直径与长度。它包含多种不同的贮箱类型，可在下方选择。每种贮箱类型具有不同的基础质量、成本以及可用容积率。标记为 HP 的高压版本适用于需要增压输送的发动机。

s: This radial tank allows for many customizations. By adjusting the dimensions, the entire tank will adjust as well. It is comprised of many different tank types. You can choose the tank type below. Each tank type has a different base mass, different cost, and different amounts of utilization it can have. The HP versions of the tanks are Highly Pressurized and are used for engines that require it.
zh: 该径向贮箱支持多种自定义设置。调整尺寸时，整个贮箱会成比例缩放。它包含多种不同的贮箱类型，可在下方选择。每种贮箱类型具有不同的基础质量、成本以及可用容积率。标记为 HP 的高压版本适用于需要增压输送的发动机。

s: This spherical tank allows for many customizations. You can adjust the dimensions and the part will scale. It is comprised of many different tank types. You can choose the tank type below. Each tank type has a different base mass, different cost, and different amounts of utilization it can have. The HP versions of the tanks are Highly Pressurized and are used for engines that require it.
zh: 该球形贮箱支持多种自定义设置。调整尺寸即可缩放该部件。它包含多种不同的贮箱类型，可在下方选择。每种贮箱类型具有不同的基础质量、成本以及可用容积率。标记为 HP 的高压版本适用于需要增压输送的发动机。

s: This toroidal tank allows for many customizations with a hollow collision box. By adjusting the dimensions, the entire tank will adjust as well. It is comprised of many different tank types. You can choose the tank type below. Each tank type has a different base mass, different cost, and different amounts of utilization it can have. The HP versions of the tanks are Highly Pressurized and are used for engines that require it.
zh: 该环形贮箱具有中空的碰撞箱并支持多种自定义设置。调整尺寸时，整个贮箱会成比例缩放。它包含多种不同的贮箱类型，可在下方选择。每种贮箱类型具有不同的基础质量、成本以及可用容积率。标记为 HP 的高压版本适用于需要增压输送的发动机。

s: The magnetometer instruments are used to determine the magnitude and direction of planetary magnetic fields. The long boom separates these instruments from any interference caused by magnetic elements on the craft. Experiments like these can study the Sun's magnetic field and how it interacts with planets, and, if a spacecraft is headed into interstellar space, can help determine the size of the heliosphere and the behavior of the interstellar medium. Historically, this experiment is based on the instruments that flew on Voyager 1/2 and Galileo.
zh: 磁力计用于测定行星磁场的大小和方向。长伸杆可将这些仪器与航天器上磁性部件引起的任何干扰隔离开来。此类实验可以研究太阳磁场及其与行星的相互作用；如果航天器飞向星际空间，还可以帮助确定日球层的大小以及星际介质的特性。历史上，该实验基于旅行者1号/2号和伽利略号上搭载的仪器。

s: This device contains three plates for measuring the impacts of 'micrometeorites', the little pieces of debris and particles that travel through open vacuum at thousands of meters per second. Measuring the number of impacts gives us an idea of how dangerous an area of space may be for our ships.
zh: 该设备包含三块测量板，用于测量“微流星体”的撞击。微流星体是以每秒数千米的速度在开阔真空中穿行的小碎片和颗粒。测量撞击次数有助于我们了解某个太空区域对飞船的危险程度。

s: Commonly called Bennett radio frequency mass spectrometers, they are only sensitive to charged atoms and molecules since they do not incorporate an ion source. Mass spectrometry is an analytical technique that ionizes chemical species and sorts the ions based on their mass-to-charge ratio. This can be used to study the ionosphere and determine what trace gasses exist in space. Historically, these simple experiments were flown on many Aerobee sounding rockets and returned to Earth for study.
zh: 通常称为本内特射频质谱仪，由于不包含离子源，它们仅对带电原子和分子敏感。质谱分析是一种将化学物质电离并根据其质荷比对离子进行分类的分析技术。这可用于研究电离层并确定太空中存在的微量气体。历史上，这些简单的实验曾搭载在许多“云雀”（Aerobee）探空火箭上发射，并带回地球进行研究。

s: The MIMS was an improvement on the Bennett radio version. These had miniaturized magnetic sector field instruments and the mass resolution was much higher than the Bennett RF spectrometer. Mass spectrometry is an analytical technique that ionizes chemical species and sorts the ions based on their mass-to-charge ratio. This data can show not just the composition of the ionosphere, but also how the solar wind affects it, and can detect the interchange between layers of the atmosphere. Historically, these experiments were flown on Explorer 31, AE-C, and other Earth Satellites.
zh: 微型离子质谱仪（MIMS）是对本内特射频版本的改进。它们配备了微型磁扇区分析仪器，质量分辨率远高于本内特射频质谱仪。质谱分析是一种将化学物质电离并根据其质荷比对离子进行分类的分析技术。这些数据不仅可以显示电离层的成分，还可以显示太阳风对它的影响，并能探测大气层之间的物质交换。历史上，这些实验曾搭载在探索者31号、AE-C和其他地球卫星上飞行。

s: The quadropole mass spectrometer is designed to collect data to determine the composition and structure of positive ions and neutral particles in the upper atmosphere of planets and moons as well as the magnetosphere of planets. Mass spectrometry is an analytical technique that ionizes chemical species and sorts the ions based on their mass-to-charge ratio. Historically, these simple experiments were flown on Earth satellites and interplanetary crafts including the Mars Viking Lander and Cassini.
zh: 四极杆质谱仪旨在收集数据以测定行星和卫星高层大气以及行星磁层中正离子和中性粒子的组成与结构。质谱分析是一种将化学物质电离并根据其质荷比对离子进行分类的分析技术。历史上，这些简单的实验曾搭载在地球卫星以及包括火星海盗号着陆器和卡西尼号在内的行星际航天器上飞行。

s: The Basic Film Camera is used to take photographs of Earth from space. This is a vast improvement over the very basic Early Film Camera. Historically, these were flown as KH-1 Spy Satellites under the Corona/Discoverer program.
zh: 基础胶卷相机用于从太空拍摄地球照片。相比非常简陋的早期胶卷相机，这是一项巨大的改进。历史上，这些相机曾在“日冕/发现者”计划中作为<<M0>>间谍卫星升空。

s: The Improved Film Camera is used to take photographs of Earth from space. Historically, these were flown as Spy Satellites under the CORONA/Keyhole name, but for our peaceful RP-1 purposes, these represent the earliest weather satellite photos.
zh: 改进型胶卷相机用于从太空拍摄地球照片。历史上，这些相机曾以“日冕/锁眼”的名义作为间谍卫星飞行，但出于我们和平的<<M0>>目的，它们代表了最早的气象卫星照片。

s: The High Resolution Film Camera is used to take photographs of planets from space. This camera provides very high resolution photographs that need to be recovered back to Earth. Historically, these were flown as Spy Satellites under the KH-9 Hexagon name, but for RP-1, these represent the first high resolution satellite cameras from commercial companies.
zh: 高分辨率胶卷相机用于从太空拍摄行星照片。这台相机提供极高分辨率的照片，且底片需要回收至地球。历史上，这些相机曾以<<M0>>“六边形”的名义作为间谍卫星飞行，但对于<<M1>>而言，它们代表了商业公司的第一批高分辨率卫星相机。

s: The Ultra Resolution Digital Imaging Camera is used to take planetary photographs from space. This camera stores all of the imaging data digitally and these images can be transmitted fully back to Earth. Historically, these were flown as Spy Satellites under the KH-11 Kennen name, and also used in a similar fashion by the Hubble Space Telescope.
zh: 超高分辨率数字成像相机用于从太空拍摄行星照片。该相机以数字方式存储所有成像数据，这些图像可以完整传回地球。历史上，这些相机曾以<<M0>>“坚言”的名义作为间谍卫星飞行，哈勃空间望远镜也采用了类似的成像方式。

s: The plasma wave detector measures the electrostatic and electromagnetic plasma waves from the solar wind. Historically, this experiment is based on the one flown on Pioneer 5,6,7,8 that studied the interplanetary space between Earth and Venus.
zh: 等离子体波探测器用于测量来自太阳风的静电和电磁等离子体波。历史上，该实验基于先驱精神5号、6号、7号和8号上搭载的实验设备，用于研究地球与金星之间的行星际空间。

s: The radio and plasma wave science instrument measures electrostatic and electromagnetic fields generated by the interaction of planetary magnetospheres and the interplanetary plasma medium. Historically, this experiment is based on the one flown on Cassini.
zh: 无线电与等离子体波科学仪器用于测量行星磁层与行星际等离子体介质相互作用所产生的静电场和电磁场。历史上，该实验基于卡西尼号上搭载的仪器。

s: The soil mechanics surface sampler is an instrument designed to test the physical properties of the topsoil (density, porosity, resistivity) and to expose subsoil material for photography. Historically, this experiment is based on the one flown on the Surveyor missions.
zh: 土壤力学表面取样器是一种旨在测试表层土壤物理特性（密度、孔隙度、电阻率）并暴露下层土壤物质以供拍摄的仪器。历史上，该实验基于勘测者号任务中搭载的仪器。

s: The Early Television Camera is used to take images in the visibile wavelength of planetary bodies from space. This is a very early camera and lacks resolution in the images. It is monochromatic, and only capable of distinguishing large features from orbit. Historically, these were flown on Explorer 6, which was the first craft to send images of Earth from orbit, and Luna 3 which was the first craft to return images from the far side of the Moon.
zh: 早期电视摄像机用于在可见光波段从太空拍摄行星天体的图像。这是一台非常早期的摄像机，图像分辨率较低。它是单色的，只能在轨道上分辨大型地表特征。历史上，这些设备曾搭载在探索者6号（首个从轨道发送地球图像的航天器）和月球3号（首个传回月球背面图像的航天器）上飞行。

s: The Basic TV Camera is used to take images in the visibile wavelength of planetary bodies from space. Greatly improved over the early TV camera, it is capable of constructing a color image using combinations of monochromatic filters, and has the resolution to distinguish kilometer-scale surface features. Historically, this type of camera was flown on Mariner 4 and took the first images of another planet.
zh: 基础电视摄像机用于在可见光波段从太空拍摄行星天体的图像。相比早期电视摄像机有了很大改进，它能够利用单色滤光片组合合成彩色图像，其分辨率足以分辨千米级的地表特征。历史上，此类摄像机曾搭载在水手4号上，并拍摄了另一颗行星的首批图像。

s: The Improved TV Camera is used to take images in the visibile wavelength of planetary bodies from space. This camera is much higher resolution, and is capable of rapidly taking pictures, allowing it to quickly capture the entire surface of a planet at 100 meter-scale resolutions. Historically, this type of camera was flown on Mariner 10 and took the first images of Mercury.
zh: 改进型电视摄像机用于在可见光波段从太空拍摄行星天体的图像。该相机的分辨率要高得多，并且能够快速拍摄照片，使其能够以百米级分辨率快速捕获整个行星的表面。历史上，此类摄像机曾搭载在水手10号上，并拍摄了水星的首批图像。

s: Founded in 1905, the FAI is the governing body for air sports and for aeronautics and astronautics world records. If you're setting a milestone, odds are the FAI is the group certifying it. Funding, however, will come from your government--the FAI doesn't offer prizes, just record records.
zh: 国际航空联合会（FAI）成立于1905年，是航空运动以及航空航天世界纪录的管理机构。如果你达成了一项里程碑，很大概率是由FAI负责认证。然而，资金只能来自你的政府——FAI不提供奖金，只记录记录。

s: The Global Positioning System (GPS), originally Navstar GPS, is a space-based radionavigation system owned by the United States government and operated by the United States Air Force. It is a global navigation satellite system that provides geolocation and time information to a GPS receiver anywhere on or near the Earth where there is an unobstructed line of sight to four or more GPS satellites.
zh: 全球定位系统（GPS），最初称为Navstar GPS，是由美国政府拥有并由美国空军运营的天基无线电导航系统。它是一个全球导航卫星系统，只要在地球上或地球附近的任何位置与四颗或更多GPS卫星保持无遮挡视线，便能向GPS接收机提供地理位置和时间信息。

s: GLONASS, or "Global Navigation Satellite System", is a space-based satellite navigation system operating in the radionavigation-satellite service. It provides an alternative to GPS and is the second navigational system in operation with global coverage and of comparable precision.
zh: 格洛纳斯（GLONASS），即“全球导航卫星系统”，是在无线电导航卫星业务下运行的天基卫星导航系统。它提供了GPS之外的另一种选择，是第二个投入运行、具备全球覆盖能力且精度相当的导航系统。

s: Reach the correct orbit within the parameters. Note: The argument of periapsis values mean that the apogee needs to be high in the northern latitudes. This is like a Molniya orbit, but with an orbital period the same as an Earth sidereal day.
zh: 在参数范围内进入目标轨道。注意：近地点幅角的值意味着远地点需要位于高北纬地区。这类似于闪电轨道，但轨道周期与一个地球恒星日相同。

s: The Cherenkov detector is another type of high energy particle detector, using a Cherenkov detector in combination with a scintillation detector to further observe and characterize high-energy gamma rays. It measures the arrival directions and energies of gamma rays and highly-energetic charged particles from cosmic radiation. This detailed measurement can allow for more detailed analysis of the radiation environments in interplanetary space.
zh: 切伦科夫探测器是另一种高能粒子探测器，结合使用切伦科夫探测器与闪烁探测器来进一步观测并表征高能伽马射线。它可以测量来自宇宙辐射的伽马射线和高能带电粒子的入射方向与能量。这种细致的测量有助于更深入地分析行星际空间的辐射环境。

s: The geiger counter measures ionizing radiation such as alpha particles, beta particles, and gamma rays using the ionization effect created inside the tube. By measuring radiation as a spacecraft orbits, it's possible to detect things like Van Allen belts, and an instrument like this is what first discovered Earth's Van Allen belts.
zh: 盖革计数器利用管内产生的电离效应来测量阿尔法粒子、贝塔粒子和伽马射线等电离辐射。通过在航天器绕轨飞行时测量辐射，可以探测到范艾伦带等结构，这类仪器最初就曾用于发现地球的范艾伦辐射带。

s: The scintillation counter cosmic ray telescope is a combination of three scintillators giving both the energy of a charged particle and its rate of energy loss in the scintillators. It is measuring the mass and energy spectra of primary and solar cosmic rays and electrons. This detailed measurement of charged particles can allow for more detailed analysis of the radiation environments in interplanetary space.
zh: 闪烁计数器宇宙线望远镜由三个闪烁体组合而成，可同时测量带电粒子的能量及其在闪烁体中的能量损失率。它用于测量初级与太阳宇宙线以及电子的质量和能谱。对带电粒子的这种细致测量有助于更深入地分析行星际空间的辐射环境。

s: The high-resolution infrared radiometer is improved equipment that measures the thermal emissions and temperatures of the cloud tops as well as the surface features. This can be useful for weather forecasting. Historically, this experiment is based on the ones flown on the NIMBUS satellites.
zh: 高分辨率红外辐射计是一种改进型设备，用于测量云顶及地表特征的热辐射与温度。这可用于天气预报。在历史上，该实验基于“雨云”（NIMBUS）系列卫星上搭载的设备。

s: The two-channel infrared radiometer observes and records the thermal emissions from planetary bodies in two broad spectral bands. If correlated with pictures and other instruments, this could help detect surface features like mountains, valleys, and volcanoes. Historically, this experiment is based on the one flown on Mariner 10.
zh: 双通道红外辐射计可在两个宽光谱波段观测并记录行星天体的热辐射。若与图像及其他仪器数据相结合，可有助于探测山脉、峡谷和火山等地表特征。在历史上，该实验基于“水手10号”（Mariner 10）上搭载的设备。

s: The PMIRR used narrow-band radiometric channels and two pressure modulation cells to measure atmospheric and surface emission in the thermal infrared and a visible channel. This could determine solar radiation reflected from the atmosphere and surface. These measurements can determine what seasons are like on other planets and determine how the contents of an atmosphere vary across altitudes and across locations. Historically, this experiment is based on the instrument that flew on Mars Observer.
zh: 压力调制红外辐射计（PMIRR）使用窄带辐射测量通道和两个压力调制池，在热红外和可见光通道测量大气与表面辐射。这可以确定大气和表面反射的太阳辐射。这些测量值可以确定其他行星的季节特征，并查明大气成分随高度和位置的变化情况。在历史上，该实验基于“火星观察者号”（Mars Observer）上搭载的仪器。

s: The IRIS experiment is used to provide information on the vertical structure, composition, and dynamics of the atmosphere and on the emmissive properties from the surface and atmospheres of planetary bodies in the infrared wavelengths. Historically, these experiments were flown on many craft including NIMBUS 3/4, Mariner 9 and Voyager 1/2 as well as other Earth Satellites.
zh: 红外干涉光谱仪（IRIS）实验用于在红外波段提供有关大气垂直结构、成分和动力学，以及行星天体表面与大气发射特性的信息。在历史上，这些实验曾在包括“雨云3/4号”、“水手9号”、“旅行者1/2号”以及其他地球卫星等多种航天器上运行。

s: The UV spectrometer experiment is used to provide information on the vertical structure, composition, and dynamics of the atmosphere and on the emmissive properties from the surface and atmospheres of planetary bodies in the ultraviolet wavelengths. Historically, these experiments were flown on many craft including Mariner 10.
zh: 紫外光谱仪实验用于在紫外波段提供有关大气垂直结构、成分和动力学，以及行星天体表面与大气发射特性的信息。在历史上，这些实验曾在包括“水手10号”在内的多种航天器上运行。

s: The NIMS and UVS experiments are used to provide information on the vertical structure, composition, and dynamics of the atmosphere and on the emmissive properties from the surface and atmospheres of planetary bodies in the infrared wavelengths. Historically, these experiments were flown on many craft including Galileo.
zh: 近红外绘图光谱仪（NIMS）和紫外光谱仪（UVS）实验用于在红外波段提供有关大气垂直结构、成分和动力学，以及行星天体表面与大气发射特性的信息。在历史上，这些实验曾在包括“伽利略号”在内的多种航天器上运行。

s: The AIMS experiment is used to provide information on the vertical structure, composition, and dynamics of the atmosphere and on the emmissive properties from the surface and atmospheres of planetary bodies in the infrared wavelengths. Historically, this experiment is based on the instrument that flew on Cassini.
zh: 空气辉光红外光谱仪（AIMS）实验用于在红外波段提供有关大气垂直结构、成分和动力学，以及行星天体表面与大气发射特性的信息。在历史上，该实验基于“卡西尼号”上搭载的仪器。

s: The early magnetometer, used to measure magnetic fields. Though these fields stretch out into space, their study can hint at a planet's core. Experiments like these are also used to study the Sun's magnetic field and how it interacts with planets. Historically, this experiment is based on the ones flown on many early satellite and probe missions.
zh: 早期磁力计，用于测量磁场。尽管这些磁场延伸到太空中，但对其研究可以揭示行星核心的信息。此类实验还用于研究太阳磁场及其与行星的相互作用。在历史上，该实验基于许多早期卫星和探测器任务上搭载的设备。

s: Mounted at the end of this folding boom is the main part of a Helium Vector Magnetometer, used to measure magnetic fields. Though these fields stretch out into space, their study can hint at a planet's core. Experiments like these are also used to study the Sun's magnetic field and how it interacts with planets. Historically, this experiment is based on the ones flown on many missions, including Mariner 4.
zh: 安装在该折叠臂末端的是氦矢量磁力计的主体部件，用于测量磁场。尽管这些磁场延伸到太空中，但对其研究可以揭示行星核心的信息。此类实验还用于研究太阳磁场及其与行星的相互作用。在历史上，该实验基于包括“水手4号”在内的许多任务中搭载的设备。

s: The High Resolution Imaging Device is used to take images in the visible wavelength of planetary bodies from space. This imager takes very high resolution images and can show details previously undiscovered on other planetary bodies. Historically, this type of camera was flown on the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter.
zh: 高分辨率成像仪用于从太空获取行星体在可见光波段的图像。该成像设备能够拍摄极高分辨率的照片，展现其他行星体上此前未被发现的细节。在历史上，火星勘测轨道飞行器（MRO）曾搭载此类型相机。

s: The goal of peaceful space exploration starts here, with rocketry missions that perform key experiments, such as taking high altitude photos and testing how biological creatures handle brief exposures to space and the rigors of rocket travel. You'll need to research the Early Science node to complete this program.
zh: 和平太空探索的目标始于此地——通过火箭任务执行关键实验，例如拍摄高空照片，以及测试生物在短暂暴露于太空和严苛火箭飞行环境下的反应。你需要研究“早期科学”科技节点以完成该计划。

s: The adage "What goes up must come down" is no longer the same truism in the age of satellites. Your space agency is tasked to put the first satellites in various orbits around the Earth, breaking the grip of terrestrial gravity. Completing this program will require Satellite Era Science and an orbit-capable launch vehicle.
zh: 在卫星时代，“有升必有降”这句老话已不再是真理。你的航天机构受命将首批卫星送入环绕地球的各类轨道，挣脱地表引力的束缚。完成该计划需要“卫星时代科学”科技以及具备入轨能力的运载火箭。

s: The adage "What goes up must come down" is no longer the same truism in the age of satellites. Your space agency is tasked to put the first satellites in various orbits around the Earth, breaking the grip of terrestrial gravity. These contracts require larger payloads, but will ultimately be more lucrative. Completing this program will require Satellite Era Science and an orbit-capable launch vehicle that can lift 1 ton.
zh: 在卫星时代，“有升必有降”这句老话已不再是真理。你的航天机构受命将首批卫星送入环绕地球的各类轨道，挣脱地表引力的束缚。这些合同需要更大的有效载荷，但最终收益也更为丰厚。完成该计划需要“卫星时代科学”科技以及能将1吨载荷送入轨道的运载火箭。

s: Now that you have proven the ability to send satellites into orbit, the next step is to send them into more useful orbits with more beneficial payloads. This program will focus on satellites for observing the Earth and the space environment around it. This will advance scientific knowledge of not just physical processes within our atmosphere, but also those in space, all of which influence our lives here on Earth.
zh: 既然你已经证明了将卫星送入轨道的能力，下一步就是将它们送入更具实用价值的轨道，搭载更有益的载荷。该计划将侧重于用于观测地球及其周围太空环境的卫星。这不仅将推进有关大气层内物理过程的科学知识，还将深化对太空环境的认知，而所有这些都在影响着我们在地球上的生活。

s: The Moon is the first stepping stone to exploring the solar system. More than a light-second away, operating a probe at that distance is a worthy first step. This program requires new technology and heavier launch vehicles to take your space program's first steps toward studying the Moon up close. Complete it by putting a probe into orbit around the Moon. This program will require Lunar Range Communications at a minimum, and will generally require upgrading Mission Control and the Tracking Station in order to plan your journey. Basic Avionics and Probes unlocks deep-space avionics, which will be essential if you need guided avionics at the Moon.
zh: 月球是探索太阳系的第一块垫脚石。月球距离我们超过一光秒，在此距离操作探测器是迈出的坚实第一步。该计划需要新技术和更重型的运载火箭，以迈出近距离研究月球的第一步。将其送入环月轨道即可完成计划。该计划至少需要“月球测控通信”，通常还需要升级任务控制中心和追踪站以规划航线。“基础航电与探测器”可解锁深空航电，若在月球需要制导控制航电，它将必不可少。

s: Landing uncrewed probes on the Moon is the next step in exploring the Solar System. Successfully landing on the Moon is a difficult problem to solve. You will need to develop even more capable launch vehicles to be able to launch a large enough payload. These uncrewed landings will give you the data you need to plan for your crewed landings to follow. You will need to research deeply-throttleable engines from the Early Landing node (recommended) or figure out how to perform a landing with RCS.
zh: 将无人探测器送上月球着陆是探索太阳系的下一步。在月球成功着陆是一项艰巨的挑战。你需要研制运力更强的运载火箭以发射足够重的有效载荷。这些无人着陆任务将为你提供后续载人着陆所需的关键数据。你需要从“早期着陆”节点研究深节流发动机（推荐），或者掌握利用RCS进行着陆的方法。

s: Sending machines to space as a proxy for human beings was never the final goal. This program requires you to safely put astronauts into orbit and return them to the Earth, proving that humanity can survive in the most hostile environment nature has given us the opportunity to explore. You will need to upgrade your Astronaut Complex to level three so you can train your astronauts for the rigors of spaceflight. Make sure you start to train your crew about a year before you launch.
zh: 派遣机器代替人类进入太空从来不是终极目标。该计划要求你安全地将航天员送入轨道并返回地球，证明人类能够在自然赋予我们探索的最恶劣环境中生存。你需要将航天员复合体升级至3级，以便训练航天员应对严苛的太空飞行。请确保在发射前大约一年就开始训练乘员。

s: Human spaceflight should involve more than mere spam in a can. Both the hardware and skills required for maneuvering, EVA, rendezvous, and docking must be tested if humans are to do more than exist in space as passengers. You will need to research Early Docking Procedures and Second Generation Capsules to complete this program.
zh: 载人航天不应只是把人装在铁罐头里发射出去。如果要让人类在太空中不仅仅是作为被动乘客存在，就必须对轨道机动、EVA、交会与对接所需的硬件和技能进行全面检验。你需要研究“早期对接程序”和“第二代乘员舱”以完成该计划。

s: This program tasks you with exploring Venus and Mars. Though these may be Earth's closest neighbors, the distance between us and them still averages in the hundreds of millions of kilometers. Staying in contact with these probes will require advances in communication technology. Maintaining functionality and power over such great distances and long times will present new challenges in spacecraft design.
zh: 该计划要求你探索金星与火星。虽然它们是地球最近的邻居，但它们与我们的平均距离仍在数亿公里级别。与这些探测器保持通信需要通信技术的飞跃。在如此遥远的距离和漫长的时间跨度内维持设备功能与电力供应，将对航天器设计提出全新的挑战。

s: You are tasked with sending to the Moon, 240,000 miles away from the control station in Houston, a giant rocket more than 300 feet tall, made of new metal alloys, some of which have not yet been invented, capable of standing heat and stresses several times more than have ever been experienced, fitted together with a precision better than the finest watch, carrying all the equipment needed for propulsion, guidance, control, communications, food, and survival, on an untried mission, to an unknown celestial body, and then return it safely to earth, reentering the atmosphere at speeds of over 25,000 miles per hour, causing heat about half that of the temperature of the sun. Alternatively, this could be an opportunity for some command chair antics. But a proper rocket is probably your best bet. You will need to upgrade your astronaut complex to level five to plant a flag on the Moon and complete the first crewed landing contract.
zh: 你的任务是将一枚高达300多英尺的巨型火箭送往距离休斯敦控制站24万英里外的月球。它由新型金属合金制成（其中一些甚至尚未被发明），能够承受数倍于以往经历的热量与应力，装配精度胜过最精密的钟表，搭载推进、制导、控制、通信、食品与生存所需的全部设备，执行一项前往未知天体的前所未有的任务，随后以超过每小时25000英里的速度再入大气层并安全返回地球，承受约相当于太阳表面温度一半的灼热。当然，你也可以尝试用乘员指挥椅搞点花活。但一枚正规的火箭才是你最稳妥的选择。你需要将航天员复合体升级至5级以在月球插旗并完成首次载人着陆合同。

s: An Earth space station will enable long-term human exploration of space and provide benefits to people of Earth. This Program tasks you with the exploration of prototypal and later, more mature solutions for low earth orbit long term space habitat. You will have to complete long term experiments, recrew and refill your station(s) or send new ones when needed.
zh: 一座近地空间站将使人类能够开展长期太空探索，并为地球人类造福。该计划要求你探索近地轨道长期太空栖息设施的原型及后续更成熟的解决方案。你必须完成长期实验，并在需要时轮换乘员、补给空间站或发射新的空间站。

s: Send probes to Mars to survey its atmosphere, land on the surface, and even drive around with a rover. The thin atmosphere of Mars is enough to produce quite a bit of reentry heating, but it's not thick enough to safely land with only parachutes.
zh: 向火星发射探测器以勘测其大气层、在表面着陆，甚至驾驶漫游车巡视。火星稀薄的大气足以产生相当大的再入加热，但又不足以单凭降落伞安全着陆。

s: Send probes to Venus to see what the surface and atmosphere are really like. The dense clouds hide the surface from view, while the corrosive atmosphere and high heat present challenges for anything trying to descend to the surface. Keeping a probe operational for any length of time presents significant challenges. Even with heat-resistant materials, nothing seems able to survive for more than a few hours.
zh: 向金星发射探测器，探寻其地表与大气的真实面貌。浓厚的云层遮蔽了地表视线，而高腐蚀性大气与极端高温则给所有试图降落至地表的设备带来了严峻挑战。让探测器长时间保持运行极为困难，即便使用耐热材料，也几乎没有任何设备能存活超过数小时。

s: Visit some of the smaller bodies in the Solar System. No probe has yet seen the surface of these bodies up close. Mars and Venus both have atmospheres and are far larger than these bodies. What does a small, rocky planet (or dwarf planet) with no atmosphere look like up close? Can we figure out how they formed? Do they have magnetic fields? Send probes to find out.
zh: 造访太阳系中的一些较小天体。此前尚未有探测器近距离观测过这些天体的地表。火星和金星都拥有大气层，且体量远大于这些小天体。一颗没有大气的岩质微型行星（或矮行星）近距离看起来是什么样？我们能否揭开它们的形成之谜？它们是否有磁场？发射探测器去一探究竟吧。

s: Mercury is the least explored of the inner planets, due to the difficulty of orbiting it. Send some probes there to find out more about it. Current data suggests that Mercury is tidally locked with the Sun. How will this affect its surface? Or did we just flyby it at remarkably synchronized times? Either way, sending probes to orbit and land on Mercury will provide fascinating data on the closest planet to the Sun.
zh: 由于入轨难度极高，水星是类地行星中受探索最少的一颗。向那里发射探测器以了解更多信息。现有数据表明水星可能已被太阳潮汐锁定。这会对它的表面产生何种影响？抑或只是我们恰好在极为巧合的周期进行了飞掠？无论如何，发射探测器环绕并着陆水星，都将为这颗距离太阳最近的行星带来极具价值的数据。

s: Orbit Ceres and Vesta to study them. These dwarf planets were discovered in the first decade of the 19th century and named after a goddess of agriculture and a goddess of the hearth respectively. Their study can provide hints at a less mythical creation as well. As the Sun's accretion disk settled, the planets were formed, and so were Ceres and Vesta. These protoplanets are the largest bodies in the asteroid belt, and figuring out how they were formed will provide insight into the early Solar System. NOTE: Has some contracts, but they are unpolished.
zh: 环绕谷神星与灶神星进行研究。这两颗矮行星发现于19世纪初，分别以农业女神和灶神命名。对它们的研究有助于揭示一个褪去神话色彩的天体起源：随着太阳吸积盘逐渐沉降，各大行星孕育而生，谷神星与灶神星也同样如此。这些原行星是小行星带中最大的天体，搞清它们的形成过程将为揭示太阳系早期历史提供全新视角。注意：包含部分合同，但尚未完全打磨。

s: What lies beyond Mars? These distant giants orbit far from the Sun. While Jupiter and Saturn can be seen with a hobbyist telescope, they cannot be closely studied from Earth. The immense mass of the gas giants means that, while they might not receive much sunlight, tidal forces can keep their many moons warm. There may even be liquid water somewhere out there. Send probes to survey these distant bodies. Gravity assists are highly recommended.
zh: 火星之外隐藏着什么？这些遥远的巨行星在远离太阳的轨道上运行。虽然业余望远镜就能观测到木星和土星，但无法从地球进行深入研究。气态巨行星的巨大质量意味着，尽管它们接收到的阳光微乎其微，潮汐力仍能让其众多卫星保持温暖，甚至可能在某处存在液态水。发射探测器去勘察这些遥远的天体吧。强烈建议利用引力助推。

s: The only known double planetary system in the Solar System, Pluto and Charon have been tidally locked in orbit of each other in the darkest, coldest reaches of our system for eons. It is now time for you to land on them, quite possibly within a century of their discovery. Very little is known about these distant, icy worlds. Historically, even our most advanced probes have returned relatively little data compared to what we know about our closer neighbors. Explore the furthest reaches of the Solar System and land on this intriguing pair of dwarf planets.
zh: 作为太阳系中唯一已知的双行星系统，冥王星与卡戎在太阳系最深邃、寒冷的边缘彼此潮汐锁定运转了无数个纪元。现在是时候去着陆它们了，此时距它们被发现可能还不足一个世纪。我们对这些遥远的冰冻世界知之甚少。从历史上看，与较近的邻居相比，即使是我们最先进的探测器带回的数据也相对匮乏。探索太阳系最遥远的边疆，着陆这一对引人入胜的矮行星吧。

s: We have landed men on the Moon, now we must prove that we can live and work on the lunar surface for extended periods of time. This research will be imperative to future long-term space habitation, including if we are ever to send men to Mars.
zh: 我们已经成功将人类送上月球，现在必须证明我们能够在月球表面长时间生活和工作。这项研究对于未来长期的太空定居至关重要，也是我们有朝一日将人类送上火星的前提。

s: Spaceplanes potentially offer considerable advantages over capsules as a way to send people to orbit; in particular the controlled reentry and runway landing makes recovery much simpler and cheaper. Proponents also cite the possibility of using aerodynamic lift to perform plane changes with less propellant. NOTE: This has contracts, but they have not been tested or balanced.
zh: 作为将人员送入轨道的方式，航天飞机相比返回舱具有显著的潜在优势；受控再入和跑道着陆让回收更加简便且低成本。支持者还指出，利用空气动力升力能够以更少的推进剂完成轨道倾角改变。注意：包含相关合同，但尚未经过测试或平衡。

s: After long-term testing of the mental and physiological impact of micro-gravity on the human body in low earth orbit, we can pursue the challenge of exploring our neighboring planet: Mars. This program will task you with the challenge of sending the first humans on Mars. The program allows for the choice to either land crew for a Martian surface stay, or to send a crewed expedition to Phobos and obtain a Mars surface sample via a robotic survey.
zh: 在近地轨道对微重力对人体心理与生理的影响进行了长期测试之后，我们可以向探索邻近行星——火星发起挑战。该项目将要求你完成首次载人火星任务。你可以选择让乘员着陆火星表面驻留，或是派遣载人考察队前往火卫一，并通过无人探测器采集火星地表样本。

s: Once you have proven that you can send satellites into orbit, the next step is to send them into more useful orbits. The goal of this program is to put satellites with different payload requirements into specific and more challenging orbits. A geostationary orbit will require approximately 13,650 m/s of delta-v if launching from Cape Canaveral.
zh: 一旦证明了具备将卫星送入轨道的能力，下一步就是将它们送入更具实用价值的轨道。该项目的目标是将不同有效载荷需求的卫星送入特定且更具挑战性的轨道。如果从卡纳维拉尔角发射，进入地球静止轨道大约需要 13,650 m/s 的Δv。

s: Although the earliest satellites were launched through government programs, commercial uses had been envisioned for a long time. Through this program, you will launch the earliest iterations of commercial-use satellites. With wildly varying needs, each satellite is dedicated to a specific requirement, typically with far more focused requirements than the earlier, broader scientific satellites.
zh: 尽管最早的卫星是通过政府项目发射的，但商业用途的构想早已存在。通过该项目，你将发射最早一批商业用途卫星。面对各色各样的需求，每颗卫星都专用于特定任务，其需求通常远比早期广泛的热心科研卫星更为专一。

s: Communicating with our satellites, and eventually our crewed craft, can be difficult at times. Unless we have line of sight to a tracking station, communication isn't possible. This program tasks you with creating a communications network of 3 or 4 satellites that will provide much better communications coverage. Each satellite will require 125 units of ComSatPayload, and the orbits are fairly high.
zh: 与卫星以及未来的载人飞船保持通信有时会很困难。除非视线内有追踪站，否则无法建立通信。该项目要求你建立一个由 3 到 4 颗卫星组成的通信网络，以提供更优质的通信覆盖。每颗卫星都需要 125 个单位的 <<M0>>，且轨道相对较高。

s: With geostationary orbits, satellites can be placed at specific spots over the equator where they will stay. This allows communications satellites to be put exactly where they will have the greatest benefit. This program tasks you with creating a 4-satellite Geostationary Network for communication. Each satellite will require 315 units of ComSatPayload.
zh: 借助地球静止轨道，卫星可以定点在赤道上方的特定位置。这使得通信卫星能够部署在最具效益的精确位置。该项目要求你建立一个由 4 颗卫星组成的静止轨道通信网络。每颗卫星都需要 315 个单位的 <<M0>>。

s: Geosynchronous, Geostationary, Molniya, and Tundra orbits have the potential to improve satellite coverage and simplify ground antenna tracking. This program tasks you with testing these orbits, launching satellites into them for commercial customers, and creating a 3 or 4 satellite Geostationary or Molniya Network for communication.
zh: 地球同步轨道、地球静止轨道、闪电轨道和冻原轨道具有改善卫星覆盖范围并简化地面天线跟踪的潜力。该项目要求你测试这些轨道，为专注效益客户将卫星送入预定轨道，并建立包含3至4颗卫星的地球静止或闪电轨道通信网络。

s: Sending machines to space as a proxy for human beings was never the final goal. This program requires you to safely put astronauts into orbit and return them, test a variety of crewed maneuvers, and prove that humanity can survive in the most hostile environment nature has given us the opportunity of exploring. You will need to research Early Docking Procedures and Second Generation Capsules to complete this program.
zh: 发射机器代替人类探索太空从来都不是终极目标。该项目要求你安全地将宇航员送入轨道并返回，测试各种载人机动，并证明人类有能力在自然界赋予我们探索的最恶劣环境中生存。你需要研究早期对接程序和第二代载人舱才能完成该项目。

s: Start the space race in 1957 with a generic setup. You will have all techs unlocked to this time period and will have some starting experience with some engines. The Early Satellites program has already been accepted for you, so you have a limited time to complete it.
zh: 以通用配置在1957年开启太空竞赛。你将解锁截至该时期的所有科技，并在部分发动机上获得一定的初始经验。早期卫星项目已被自动接受，因此你完成该项目的时间有限。

s: Start the space race in 1957 with a Soviet-biased setup. This means you will have a huge LC but no solids tech and a handicap in avionics. The Early Satellites (Heavy) program has already been accepted for you, so you have a limited time to complete it.
zh: 以偏向苏联的配置在1957年开启太空竞赛。这意味着你将拥有一个巨大发射工位（LC），但没有固体火箭科技，且在航空电子设备上存在劣势。早期卫星（重型）项目已被自动接受，因此你完成该项目的时间有限。

s: A start tailored for United States at the dawn of 1978. Two decades since the start of the Space Race have seen great leaps in astronautical technology and the 1980s are shaping up to be a decade of grand space stations & spaceplanes!
zh: 专为美国在1978年伊始量身定制的起点。太空竞赛开始以来的二十年见证了航天技术的巨大飞跃，1980年代正成为宏大空间站与航天飞机的黄金十年！

s: A start tailored for Soviet Union at the dawn of 1978. Two decades since the start of the Space Race have seen great leaps in astronautical technology and the 1980s are shaping up to be a decade of grand space stations & spaceplanes!
zh: 专为苏联在1978年伊始量身定制的起点。太空竞赛开始以来的二十年见证了航天技术的巨大飞跃，1980年代正成为宏大空间站与航天飞机的黄金十年！

s: Start at the dawn of 2000. The Cold War is in the past and the Space Race has concluded. With great advances in spaceflight technologies, it is time to turn our attention beyond the aims of the Space Race. Sending humans to Mars and more advanced probes to the outer planets is well within our reach now!
zh: 在2000年伊始启程。冷战已成过去，太空竞赛落下帷幕。随着航天技术的巨大进步，是时候将目光投向超越太空竞赛目标的新天地了。将人类送往火星、向外层行星发射更先进的探测器，如今已触手可及！

s: By sending a continuous, unmodulated radio signal at the lunar surface, our communications network on Earth will catch some of the scattered reflections, which will allow scientists to determine electrical properties and surface roughness of the Lunar surface.
zh: 通过向月表发射连续未调制的无线电信号，我们在地球上的通信网络将接收到部分散射反射波，从而使科学家能够测定月球表面的电学特性和表面粗糙度。

s: You will now be able to airlaunch vessels up to 7.5 t in mass and with dimensions within 12 x 6 x 13 m (width x height x length). Altitude is limited to 7600 m and speed to 150 m/s. NOTE: This is not a part you can use, it just symbolizes the new capabilities you can unlock.
zh: 你现在可以空中投放质量不超过7.5 t、尺寸在12 x 6 x 13 m（宽 x 高 x 长）以内的载具。投放高度限制为7600 m，速度限制为150 m/s。注意：这不是一个可用部件，仅代表你可解锁的新能力。

s: Airlaunch limits are extended to allow vessels up to 11.3 t in mass and with dimensions within 13 x 7 x 17 m (width x height x length). Altitude is limited to 9100 m and speed to 175 m/s. NOTE: This is not a part you can use, it just symbolizes the new capabilities you can unlock.
zh: 空中投放限制已放宽，允许载具质量提升至11.3 t，尺寸在13 x 7 x 17 m（宽 x 高 x 长）以内。投放高度限制为9100 m，速度限制为175 m/s。注意：这不是一个可用部件，仅代表你可解锁的新能力。

s: Airlaunch limits are extended to allow vessels up to 15 t in mass and with dimensions within 15 x 8 x 21 m (width x height x length). Altitude is limited to 13,750 m and speed to 272 m/s. NOTE: This is not a part you can use, it just symbolizes the new capabilities you can unlock.
zh: 空中投放限制已放宽，允许载具质量提升至15 t，尺寸在15 x 8 x 21 m（宽 x 高 x 长）以内。投放高度限制为13,750 m，速度限制为272 m/s。注意：这不是一个可用部件，仅代表你可解锁的新能力。

s: Airlaunch limits are extended to allow vessels up to 25 t in mass while other limits stay at 15 x 8 x 21 m (width x height x length). Altitude is still limited to 13,750 m and speed to 272 m/s. NOTE: This is not a part you can use, it just symbolizes the new capabilities you can unlock.
zh: 空中投放限制已放宽，允许载具质量提升至25 t，其他限制保持在15 x 8 x 21 m（宽 x 高 x 长）。投放高度仍限制为13,750 m，速度限制为272 m/s。注意：这不是一个可用部件，仅代表你可解锁的新能力。

s: This is the most advanced (and thus expensive) procedural avionics. Compared to to Near-Earth avionics, this works and offers control at any distance from Earth due to added complexity (Thermal/Radiation Shielding, Star Trackers, etc.), and can be put on hibernation mode to save power. Uses: lunar and interplanetary probes, satellite buses when hibernation is desired.
zh: 这是最先进（也是最昂贵）的程序化航电。相较于近地航电，由于增加了热防护/防辐射屏蔽、星敏感器等复杂结构，它可以在距地球任意距离正常工作并提供控制，且支持休眠模式以节省电力。用途：月球与行星际探测器，以及需要休眠的卫星平台。

s: Upgrades the X-1 cockpit to X-2 specification. Service ceiling is increased to 75km.\nAfter paying the entry cost of this upgrade, all freshly built and KCT-edited vessels will acquire it automatically.
zh: 将<<M0>>座舱升级至<<M1>>规格。实用升限提高至75km。<<M2>>支付此升级的进入成本后，所有新建及经KCT编辑的载具都将自动获取该升级。

s: This type provides no avionics control, so it is only useful for unguided rockets/stages/probes. Much lighter and lower power than an avionics-capable part of the same tech level. Fixed mass, cost and power consumption for each tech level. Uses: Unguided sounding rockets, Spin-stabilized kick stages, and Unguided probes
zh: 该型号不提供航电控制，因此仅适用于非制导火箭/级/探测器。比同科技等级具备航电能力的部件更轻、功耗更低。各科技等级的质量、成本和功耗均固定。用途：非制导探空火箭、自旋稳定推冲级和非制导探测器。

s: You can now use 1950s Aluminum stringer-stiffened fairings and stringers. The new minimum density is 0.135, compared with 0.180 for fairings and 0.300 for procedural structures at the previous tech level. NOTE: This is not a part you can use, it just symbolizes the new capabilities you can unlock.
zh: 你现在可以使用1950年代的铝制桁条加筋整流罩和桁条。新的最小密度为0.135，而上一科技等级的整流罩为0.180，程序化结构为0.300。注意：这不是一个可用部件，仅代表你可解锁的新能力。

s: New precision welding techniques and composite materials allow for MLI blankets to be safely added to Balloon tanks. NOTE: This is not a part you can use, it just symbolizes the new capabilities you can unlock. You will need to purchase it here before you can take advantage of the improvements it offers.
zh: 全新的精密焊接技术与复合材料允许将多层隔热（MLI）毛毯安全加装至气球储罐上。注意：这不是可直接使用的部件，仅代表可解锁的新技术。在此购买后方可享受其带来的性能提升。

s: You can now use 1960s Magnesium stringer-stiffened fairings and stringers. The new minimum density is 0.124, compared with 0.135 at the previous tech level. NOTE: This is not a part you can use, it just symbolizes the new capabilities you can unlock.
zh: 你现在可以使用1960年代的镁制桁条加筋整流罩和桁条。新的最小密度为0.124，上一科技等级为0.135。注意：这不是一个可用部件，仅代表你可解锁的新能力。

s: The Supersonic Inflatable Aerodynamic Decelerator (SIAD) is a new idea for landing payloads on planetary bodies with an atmosphere. The donut shaped balloon creates atmospheric drag that slows the craft down while protecting it from heating at supersonic speeds. (2019-2028)
zh: 超音速充气式气动减速器（SIAD）是一种用于在具大气天体上着陆有效载荷的新构想。甜甜圈形的充气囊可产生大气阻力，在降低航天器速度的同时，为其在超音速下抵御气动加热。（2019-2028）

s: You can now use late 1960s Fiberglass stringer-stiffened fairings and stringers. The new minimum density is 0.074, compared with 0.124 at the previous tech level. NOTE: This is not a part you can use, it just symbolizes the new capabilities you can unlock.
zh: 你现在可以使用1960年代晚期的玻璃纤维桁条加筋整流罩和桁条。新的最小密度为0.074，上一科技等级为0.124。注意：这不是一个可用部件，仅代表你可解锁的新能力。

s: The Hypersonic Inflatable Aerodynamic Decelerator (HIAD) is the next evolution in development from the SIAD. Capable of surviving reentry at Hypersonic speeds, the HIAD provides new options for payload delivery.
zh: 高超音速充气式气动减速器（HIAD）是 SIAD 的进一步发展型。HIAD 能够承受高超音速下的再入，为有效载荷运送提供了全新的选择。

s: You can now use 1980s Aluminum isogrid fairings and stringers. The new minimum density is 0.068, compared with 0.074 at the previous tech level. NOTE: This is not a part you can use, it just symbolizes the new capabilities you can unlock.
zh: 你现在可以使用1980年代的铝制等网格加筋整流罩和桁条。新的最小密度为0.068，上一科技等级为0.074。注意：这不是一个可用部件，仅代表你可解锁的新能力。

s: DSN Tech Level 10. No significant improvements on the DSN side, but improvements to the Ka-band feeds reduces antenna noise, and construction of additional 34-meter BWG antennas means 2 34-meter antennas are available at all times for arrayed operations, improving the effective gain in the Ka-band.
zh: DSN 科技等级 10。DSN 站点本身无显著改进，但 Ka 波段馈源的改进降低了天线噪声；此外增建了 34 米波导（BWG）天线，意味着可随时动用 2 台 34 米天线进行阵列化运营，从而提高了 Ka 波段的有效增益。

s: You can now use 1990s composite monocoque fairings and stringers. The new minimum density is 0.042, compared with 0.068 at the previous tech level. NOTE: This is not a part you can use, it just symbolizes the new capabilities you can unlock.
zh: 你现在可以使用1990年代的复合材料单体壳整流罩和桁条。新的最小密度为0.042，上一科技等级为0.068。注意：这不是一个可用部件，仅代表你可解锁的新能力。

s: The RD58 Engine now supports the 11D33 configuration for increased performance. Unlock it in the VAB/SPH through the engine configs interface.\n\nDeveloped version of S1.5400 engine for Block L stage of Molniya launch vehicle. Slightly better performance.
zh: <<M0>> 发动机现已支持 11D33 构型以提高性能。可在 VAB/SPH 中通过发动机配置界面解锁。<<M1>> 为闪电号运载火箭 L 级研制的 S1.5400 发动机改进型，性能略有提升。

s: You can now use 2010s advanced composite monocoque fairings and stringers. The new minimum density is 0.040, compared with 0.042 at the previous tech level. NOTE: This is not a part you can use, it just symbolizes the new capabilities you can unlock.
zh: 你现在可以使用2010年代的先进复合材料单体壳整流罩和桁条。新的最小密度为0.040，上一科技等级为0.042。注意：这不是一个可用部件，仅代表你可解锁的新能力。

s: The RD58 Engine now supports the 11D33M configuration for increased performance. Unlock it in the VAB/SPH through the engine configs interface.\n\nThe S1.5400A engine, as used on Block ML on the Molniya M launch vehicle. Further performance improvements to the basic S1.5400/11D33 engine.
zh: <<M0>> 发动机现已支持 11<<M1>> 构型以提高性能。可在 VAB/SPH 中通过发动机配置界面解锁。<<M2>> S1.5400A 发动机，用于闪电 M 运载火箭的 ML 级。在基础型 S1.5400/11D33 发动机的基础上进一步提升了性能。

s: This part provides full control of the craft, instead of the limited control from Science core. The mass and volume of avionics necessary depend on tech level and the mass of the whole craft. It is functional only when close to Earth (up to 2x GEO distance). Uses: LV ascent guidance and upper stages that operate around the Earth.
zh: 该部件提供载具的完全控制权，而非科学核心的受限控制。所需的航空电子设备质量和体积取决于科技等级以及整个载具的质量。仅在靠近地球时（最远2倍GEO距离）有效。用途：运载火箭上升段制导，以及在近地轨道运行的上面级。

s: The NAA75_110 Engine now supports the A-6 configuration for increased performance. Unlock it in the VAB/SPH through the engine configs interface.\n\nMain production variant for Redstone missile, very similar to USAF XLR43-NA-1 / NAA75-65, except with longer burn time.
zh: <<M0>> 发动机现已支持 <<M1>> 构型以提高性能。可在 VAB/SPH 中通过发动机配置界面解锁。<<M2>> 红石导弹的主要量产改型，与美国空军的 <<M3>>-<<M4>> / <<M5>>-65 非常相似，但工作时间更长。

s: The NAA75_110 Engine now supports the A-6H configuration for increased performance. Unlock it in the VAB/SPH through the engine configs interface.\n\nA-6 engine converted to run Hydyne as fuel, used on Jupiter-C sounding rocket and Juno I launch vehicle.
zh: <<M0>> 发动机现已支持 <<M1>> 构型以提高性能。可在 VAB/SPH 中通过发动机配置界面解锁。<<M2>> 改用海丁（Hydyne）作为燃料的 A-6 发动机，用于朱庇特-C 探空火箭和朱诺 1 号运载火箭。

s: The NAA75_110 Engine now supports the A-7 configuration for increased performance. Unlock it in the VAB/SPH through the engine configs interface.\n\nLater production variant for Redstone missile featuring slightly higher performance, also used on Mercury-Redstone with stretched propellant tanks and extra HTP.
zh: <<M0>> 发动机现已支持 <<M1>> 构型以提高性能。可在 VAB/SPH 中通过发动机配置界面解锁。<<M2>> 红石导弹的后期量产改型，性能略有提高；亦用于水星-红石火箭，配备加长推进剂储罐并增加了高浓度过氧化氢（HTP）。

s: The A-4 Engine now supports the A-9 configuration for increased performance. Unlock it in the VAB/SPH through the engine configs interface.\n\nDerivate of the A-4/V-2 engine for use with the A-9 upper stage / spaceplane. Fuel mixture is speculative.
zh: <<M0>> 发动机现已支持 <<M1>> 构型以提高性能。可在 VAB/SPH 中通过发动机配置界面解锁。<<M2>> <<M0>>/<<M3>> 发动机的衍生型号，用于 <<M1>> 上面级/空天飞机。燃料混合比为推测值。

s: The Castor-1-SL Engine now supports the Castor-1-SL configuration for increased performance. Unlock it in the VAB/SPH through the engine configs interface.\n\nSea level optimized variant of the Castor 1 SRM.
zh: Castor-1-SL 发动机现已支持 Castor-1-SL 构型以提高性能。可在 VAB/SPH 中通过发动机配置界面解锁。<<M0>> 卡斯托 1 号固体火箭发动机的海平面优化改型。

s: The Castor-1-Vac Engine now supports the Castor-1-Vac configuration for increased performance. Unlock it in the VAB/SPH through the engine configs interface.\n\nVacuum optimized variant of the Castor 1 SRM.
zh: Castor-1-Vac 发动机现已支持 Castor-1-Vac 构型以提高性能。可在 VAB/SPH 中通过发动机配置界面解锁。<<M0>> 卡斯托 1 号固体火箭发动机的真空优化改型。

s: The RD107-117 Engine now supports the RD-107-11D512 configuration for increased performance. Unlock it in the VAB/SPH through the engine configs interface.\n\nUsed on Soyuz-U 11A511U (also known as RD-117)
zh: <<M0>>-117 发动机现已支持 <<M1>> 构型以提高性能。可在 VAB/SPH 中通过发动机配置界面解锁。<<M2>> 用于联盟-U 11<<M3>>（亦称 <<M4>>）

s: The RD107-117 Engine now supports the RD-107-11D512P configuration for increased performance. Unlock it in the VAB/SPH through the engine configs interface.\n\nUsed on Soyuz-U2 11A511U2 (also known as RD-117)
zh: <<M0>>-117 发动机现已支持 <<M1>> 构型以提高性能。可在 VAB/SPH 中通过发动机配置界面解锁。<<M2>> 用于联盟-U2 11<<M3>>（亦称 <<M4>>）

s: The RD108-118 Engine now supports the RD-108-11D511 configuration for increased performance. Unlock it in the VAB/SPH through the engine configs interface.\n\nUsed on Soyuz-U 11A511U (also known as RD-118)
zh: <<M0>>-118 发动机现已支持 <<M1>> 构型以提高性能。可在 VAB/SPH 中通过发动机配置界面解锁。<<M2>> 用于联盟-U 11<<M3>>（亦称 <<M4>>）

s: The RD108-118 Engine now supports the RD-108-11D511P configuration for increased performance. Unlock it in the VAB/SPH through the engine configs interface.\n\nUsed on Soyuz-U2 11A511U2 (also known as RD-118)
zh: <<M0>>-118 发动机现已支持 <<M1>> 构型以提高性能。可在 VAB/SPH 中通过发动机配置界面解锁。<<M2>> 用于联盟-U2 11<<M3>>（亦称 <<M4>>）

s: The ORM65 Engine now supports the RDA-1-150 configuration for increased performance. Unlock it in the VAB/SPH through the engine configs interface.\n\nUpgraded for use in RP-318 rocket powered aircraft
zh: <<M0>> 发动机现已支持 <<M1>> 构型以提高性能。可在 VAB/SPH 中通过发动机配置界面解锁。<<M2>> 升级型号，用于 <<M3>> 火箭动力飞机

s: The ORM65 Engine now supports the RDA-1-300 configuration for increased performance. Unlock it in the VAB/SPH through the engine configs interface.\n\nUprated RDA-1-150, to allow the RP-318 to take off under its own power.
zh: <<M0>> 发动机现已支持 <<M1>> 构型以提高性能。可在 VAB/SPH 中通过发动机配置界面解锁。<<M2>> 增推版 <<M3>>，使 <<M4>> 能够依靠自身动力起飞。

s: The LR79 Engine now supports the S-3D configuration for increased performance. Unlock it in the VAB/SPH through the engine configs interface.\n\nProduction version of the LR79 engine, used on Thor and Jupiter.
zh: <<M0>> 发动机现已支持 <<M1>> 构型以获得更高性能。可在 VAB/SPH 中通过发动机构型界面解锁。<<M2>><<M0>> 发动机的量产版本，用于雷神与丘比特运载火箭。

s: The X405 Engine now supports the X-405H configuration for increased performance. Unlock it in the VAB/SPH through the engine configs interface.\n\nEngine for proposed Vega stage for NASA Atlas-Vega LV. Superceded by Atlas-Agena once NASA became aware of the USAF's Agena stage.
zh: <<M0>> 发动机现已支持 <<M1>> 构型以获得更高性能。可在 VAB/SPH 中通过发动机构型界面解锁。<<M2>>为 NASA 宇宙神-织女星运载火箭拟议织女星级设计的发动机。在 NASA 获悉美国空军的阿金纳级后，该方案被宇宙神-阿金纳取代。

s: The XLR11 Engine now supports the XLR11-RM-13-8K configuration for increased performance. Unlock it in the VAB/SPH through the engine configs interface.\n\nUprated XLR11 used in pairs on early X-15 flights before the XLR99 was ready.

s: A start tailored for United States at the dawn of 1964. Crewed Orbit has been demonstrated, now the question of orbital rendezvous and docking is at the forefront of the Space Race.

s: This experiment is a small proof of concept for extracting oxygen from the Lunar Regolith. If this were to be viable and scaleable, it would reduce the dependence of future bases on oxygen shipments.
zh: 本实验是从月壤中提取氧气的小型概念验证。如果切实可行并具备可扩展性，将减少未来基地对补给氧气的依赖。

s: Demonstrating the viability of closed-loop agriculture on the Lunar surface would pave the way for future bases to produce their own food in-situ.
zh: 验证月表闭合回路农业的可行性，将为未来基地实现原位生产食物铺平道路。

s: DSN Tech Level 5. This tracking station upgrade installs new digital encoding and noise reduction equipment, increasing your DSN gain by about 3 dB.

s: DSN Tech Level 6. This tracking station upgrade installs new digital encoding equipment and improves antenna efficiency, increasing your DSN gain by about 3 dB.
zh: DSN科技等级6。此跟踪站升级将安装新型数字编码设备并提高天线效率，使DSN增益提升约3 dB。

s: DSN Tech Level 7. This tracking station upgrade installs X-band ground equipment and noise reduction technologies, increasing your DSN gain by about 3 dB.
zh: DSN科技等级7。此跟踪站升级将安装X波段地面设备和降噪技术，使DSN增益提升约3 dB。

s: DSN Tech Level 8. This tracking station upgrade installs the 70m dish, increasing your DSN gain by about 1 dB.
zh: DSN科技等级8。此跟踪站升级将安装70米天线，使DSN增益提升约1 dB。

s: DSN Tech Level 9. This tracking station upgrade installs a super-cooled receiver and Ka-band equipment, increasing your DSN gain by about 4.5 dB.
zh: DSN科技等级9。此跟踪站升级将安装超低温冷却接收机和Ka波段设备，使DSN增益提升约4.5 dB。

The previous launch of the first navigation satellite proved the theories that Doppler shift timing can be used to precisely locate a point or location on the surface of the Earth using satellites. Put that concept into operational use with the first rudimentary satellite navigation network.&br;&br;Build a navigation network with three NavSats that provide more frequent revisit rates than the single previous satellite. Make sure the satellites are spread around the Earth to provide reasonable coverage.&br;&br;NOTE: You may choose only the 3-satellite or 4-satellite contract.

NOTE: The satellites will be destroyed upon completion of the contract. This simulates transfer of the payload back to the customer.

Program: Advanced Commercial Applications
Type: Required

Having a communication satellite that remains stationary relative to a ground station means that the antenna wouldn't need to track movements to stay connected. This would greatly simplify communication relay and mass transmission systems.
Historical example: Syncom 3 (39 kg, Thor-Delta) launched in August of 1964.
zh: 项目：先进专注效益应用 <> 类型：必需 <> <> 让通信卫星相对于地面站保持静止，意味着天线无需跟踪其移动即可保持连接。这将极大简化通信中继和大容量传输系统。 <> 历史参考：Syncom 3（39 kg，雷神-德尔塔），于1964年8月发射。

Historical example: Syncom 2 (39kg, Thor-Delta) launched in July of 1963.
zh: 项目：先进专注效益应用 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 当轨道周期为一个地球日时，卫星将保持在恒定经度上空，在一天中呈现南北漂移的轨迹。这可以实现与地面站的持续连接。 <> 历史参考：Syncom 2（39 kg，雷神-德尔塔），于1963年7月发射。
