s:
Program: Advanced Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

A Molniya orbit is a type of highly elliptical orbit with an inclination of 63.4 degrees, an argument of perigee in the very high or low latitudes, and an orbital period of one half of a sidereal day. This causes it to spend most of its time over two areas on the ground at opposing longitudes. Place a commercial satellite into a Molniya orbit so that it loiters over the specified ground location for at least 6 consecutive hours.

Historical example: Molniya 1-1 (1,600kg, Molniya)

NOTE: The satellite will be destroyed upon completion of the contract. This simulates transfer of the payload back to the customer.
zh: 项目：高级专注效益应用<> 类型：可选 <> <> 闪电轨道是一种大椭圆轨道，倾角为 63.4 度，近地点幅角位于极高或极低纬度，轨道周期为半个恒星日。这使其大部分时间都停留在地面上经度相对的两个区域上方。将一颗专注效益卫星送入闪电轨道，使其在指定的地面位置上方停留至少连续 6 小时。<> <> 历史参考：闪电 1-1（1,600 kg，闪电号）<> <> 注意：合同完成后卫星将被销毁。这是为了模拟将有效载荷移交给客户。

s:
Program: Advanced Commercial Applications
Type: Required

A Tundra orbit is a highly elliptical geosynchronous orbit (note: not geostationary orbit) with a high inclination (usually near 63.4) and an orbital period of one sidereal day. A satellite placed in this orbit spends most of its time over a chosen area of the Earth, a phenomenon known as apogee dwell. Place the customer's satellite in a tundra orbit over the desired area.

NOTE: The satellite will be destroyed upon completion of the contract. This simulates transfer of the payload back to the customer.
zh: 项目：高级专注效益应用<> 类型：必选 <> <> 苔原轨道是一种大椭圆地球同步轨道（注意：非地球静止轨道），具有高倾角（通常接近 63.4 度），轨道周期为一个恒星日。置于该轨道的卫星大部分时间会停留在地球的选定区域上空，这种现象被称为远地点停留。将客户的卫星送入目标区域上空的苔原轨道。<> <> 注意：合同完成后卫星将被销毁。这是为了模拟将有效载荷移交给客户。

s:
Program: Advanced Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

A Tundra orbit is a highly elliptical geosynchronous orbit (note: not geostationary orbit) with a high inclination (usually near 63.4) and an orbital period of one sidereal day. A satellite placed in this orbit spends most of its time over a chosen area of the Earth, a phenomenon known as apogee dwell. The ground track of a satellite in a tundra orbit is a closed figure eight. The orbit in this contract is actually using data from the Sirius satellites, the only known satellites using a Tundra orbit.
zh: 项目：高级专注效益应用<> 类型：可选 <> <> 苔原轨道是一种大椭圆地球同步轨道（注意：非地球静止轨道），具有高倾角（通常接近 63.4 度），轨道周期为一个恒星日。置于该轨道的卫星大部分时间会停留在地球的选定区域上空，这种现象被称为远地点停留。苔原轨道卫星的星下点轨迹呈闭合的“8”字形。本合同中的轨道实际上使用的是天狼星卫星的数据，这是已知唯一使用苔原轨道的卫星。

s:
Program: Advanced Commercial Applications
Type: Required

Geostationary satellites do not provide good coverage in the higher latitudes. Molniya orbits loiter over those latitudes for longer periods, to provide constant coverage with fewer satellites.
Historical example: Molniya 1-1 (1.6t, Molniya 8K78) launched starting in April of 1965.

NOTE: The satellite will be destroyed upon completion of the contract. This simulates transfer of the payload back to the customer.

NOTE: Your orbit should have high eccentricity, an inclination of around 63 degrees, with your periapsis on the same or opposite longitude as the target (@/targetLon) in the opposite North/South hemisphere.

NOTE: If you are completing this with a single launch, you must separate the 3 vessels while in an orbit with a period of less than 6 hours or the payload requirement will not complete. This is to ensure spacing of the network.
zh: 项目：高级专注效益应用<> 类型：必选 <> <> 地球静止卫星对高纬度地区的覆盖效果不佳。闪电轨道可以在这些纬度上空停留更长时间，从而以更少的卫星提供持续覆盖。<> 历史参考：闪电 1-1（1.6 t，闪电号 8K78），自 1965 年 4 月起陆续发射。<> <> 注意：合同完成后卫星将被销毁。这是为了模拟将有效载荷移交给客户。 <> <> 注意：轨道应具有大偏心率，倾角约为 63 度，近地点与目标经度 (@/targetLon) 处于相同或相反的经度上，且位于相对的南北半球。 <> <> 注意：如果通过单次发射完成本任务，必须在轨道周期小于 6 小时的轨道上分离这 3 艘载具，否则将无法完成有效载荷要求。这是为了确保组网卫星的轨道间隔。

s:
Program: Early Lunar Habitation
Type: Required

With a 14-day crewed Lunar mission now complete, it is time to increase the duration spent on the moon. Send at least 3 crew to the Moon for 30 days, complete science and exploration, and return home safely.

Previously landed infrastructure can be used, and a resupply mission can be sent if your mission profile requires it.
zh: 方案：早期月球驻留 <> 类型：必需 <> <> 14天的载人登月中继任务现已完成，是时候延长在月球上的停留时间了。派遣至少3名机组成员前往月球驻留30天，完成科学与探测任务，并安全返回地球。 <> <> 可以利用先前降落的地面基础设施；如果任务剖面需要，也可以发射补给任务。

s:
Program: Early Lunar Habitation
Type: Optional

The time has come to prove the capabilities of our lunar infrastructure. Land three crew on the surface for twelve months, and bring them back home safely.

Previously landed infrastructure can be used, and a resupply mission can be sent if your mission profile requires it. This contract does not require a new set of crew to complete.
zh: 方案：早期月球驻留 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 验证我们月球基础设施能力的时候到了。让三名机组成员在月表着陆驻留12个月，并确保他们安全返回地球。 <> <> 可以利用先前降落的地面基础设施；如果任务剖面需要，也可以发射补给任务。本合同无需派遣全新的一批机组成员即可完成。

s:
Program: Early Lunar Habitation
Type: Required

Previous crewed lunar mission requirements were short in duration, spanning no more than a few days. Much longer stays will be required in order to one day place a permanent installation on the Moon. This mission will conduct the first long-duration planetary habitat experiment to validate the technology for future crewed lunar exploration efforts.

This mission can be completed in numerous ways. Whether Apollo-style with a Lunar Orbit Rendezvous, as a Lunar Direct mission with no orbiter, or by sending a separate presupply mission ahead of your crew, the choice is yours. However, follow-on missions will require longer stays and larger crews, so plan accordingly. A separate pre-supply mission is available should you choose to use that mission profile.
zh: 方案：早期月球驻留 <> 类型：必需 <> <> 以往的载人登月任务要求停留时间较短，不超过数天。为了有朝一日在月球上建立永久设施，需要进行更长时间的停留。本次任务将进行首次长期行星基地居住实验，以验证未来载人登月探测任务的技术。 <> <> 本任务可通过多种方式完成。无论是采用月球轨道交会（LOR）的阿波罗模式、不带轨道器的月球直接登月模式，还是在机组出发前先行发射独立的补给任务，均由你决定。然而，后续任务将需要更长的停留时间和更多的人员编制，请据此进行规划。如果你选择该任务剖面，可以使用独立的预先补给任务。

s:
Program: Early Lunar Habitation

Previously landed infrastructure can be used, and a resupply mission can be sent if your mission profile requires it. This contract does not require a new set of crew to complete.

s:

Previously landed infrastructure can be used, and a resupply mission can be sent if your mission profile requires it, but take note of new Research Payload requirements. This contract does not require a new set of crew to complete.

After this contract has been completed, the 'Lunar Impactor (Uncrewed)' contract will become available.

s:
Program: Early Satellites (Heavy)
Type: Required

Just putting an object in orbit is a stunt. Getting valuable scientific data from it is far more impressive.&br;&br;With the data returned from our sounding rockets, interesting radiation has been observed. We need you to send a scientific satellite into an eccentric orbit in order to study this data with more accuracy. Based on the best guesses of our scientists, having an apoapsis over 1500 km with a low periapsis will help us to learn more about the radiation surrounding Earth.&br;&br;Make sure your craft contains an Advanced Biological Capsule Part and has a mass of at least 400 kg.&br;&br;Real life examples: PS-2 (Sputnik 2)
zh: 方案：早期卫星（重型）<> 类型：必选 <> <>仅仅将物体送入轨道不过是作秀，从中获取有价值的科学数据才更具意义。&br;&br;通过探空火箭传回的数据，我们观测到了引人注目的辐射现象。我们需要你将一颗热心科研卫星送入大椭圆轨道，以便更精确地研究这些数据。根据科学家的大胆推测，将远地点设定在 1500 km 以上并保持较低的近地点，有助于我们进一步了解环绕地球的辐射。&br;&br;请确保你的飞行器包含高级生物舱部件，且质量至少为 400 kg。&br;&br;现实参考原型：<>（伴侣 2 号）

s:

s:

If you have already completed the temperature and pressure scan, click info -> forced run in order to complete this contract. &br;&br;This could be considered the first "Weather Satellite" and will open up new weather satellite opportunities.

zh: 项目：早期卫星（轻型） <> 类型：可选 <> <> 设计、制造并试射一枚火箭，搭载 @/missionPayload.Print() 个单位的探空有效载荷，并在地面上空飞行 6000 km 或更远。这项挑战需要的 Δv 明显多于 5000 km 的尝试。你的火箭必须处于亚轨道飞行状态（高于 140 km）才能完成合同。@RP0:avionics50sAdvice 完善此项技术是运载火箭研发的一部分，有助于调整上升剖面并开发高空分级方案。当前火箭飞行的距离可在本合同的合同应用界面参数中查看，该数据将实时更新。&br;&br;@RP0:f3BadAdvice

s:
Program: Early Satellites (Light)
Type: Optional

Design, build, and launch a rocket that will travel 7500 km or more over ground while carrying @/missionPayload.Print() units of Sounding Payload. This challenge will require rather more delta-v than the 6000 km attempt and will get you very close to an orbital capable rocket. Your rocket must be suborbital (over 140 km) for the contract to be completed. @RP0:avionics50sAdvice Perfecting this is part of launch vehicle development to tune your ascent profile and develop high-altitude staging methods. The current distance that your rocket has traveled can be seen in the contract parameters in the Contracts App display for this contract. It will update in real time. &br;&br;@RP0:f3BadAdvice
zh: 项目：早期卫星（轻型） <> 类型：可选 <> <> 设计、制造并试射一枚火箭，搭载 @/missionPayload.Print() 个单位的探空有效载荷，并在地面上空飞行 7500 km 或更远。这项挑战需要的 Δv 明显多于 6000 km 的尝试，并将使你极为接近入轨级火箭的水平。你的火箭必须处于亚轨道飞行状态（高于 140 km）才能完成合同。@RP0:avionics50sAdvice 完善此项技术是运载火箭研发的一部分，有助于调整上升剖面并开发高空分级方案。当前火箭飞行的距离可在本合同的合同应用界面参数中查看，该数据将实时更新。&br;&br;@RP0:f3BadAdvice

s:
Program: Early Satellites (Light)
Type: Required

A polar orbit is one in which a satellite passes above or nearly above both poles of the body being orbited on each revolution. It therefore has an inclination of (or very close to) 90 degrees to the equator. A satellite in a polar orbit will pass over the equator at a different longitude on each of its orbits. Place a satellite into a polar orbit so we can study the advantages in greater detail.
zh: 项目：早期卫星（轻型） <> 类型：必选 <> <> 极地轨道是指卫星每圈绕行都会经过或接近所绕天体两极上空的轨道。因此其对赤道的倾角为（或非常接近）90度。极轨卫星在每次绕行时都会在不同的经度穿过赤道。将一颗卫星送入极地轨道，以便我们更详细地研究其优势。

s:
Program: Early Satellites (Light)
Type: Required

We need you to give Earth its first artificial satellite! Design, build, and launch a craft that will successfully place an object in orbit with a perigee of at least 150 km.&br;&br;You can accept other orbit contracts at the same time as this if want to do multiple things on your first orbital launch (for example, you could combine all four starting orbit contracts and launch a solar-powered polar science satellite).
zh: 项目：早期卫星（轻型） <> 类型：必选 <> <> 我们需要你为地球送上第一颗人造卫星！设计、制造并试射一艘飞行器，成功将一个物体送入近地点至少 150 km 的轨道。&br;&br;如果你想在首次入轨发射中同时完成多项任务，可以同时接取其他轨道合同（例如，你可以结合全部四个初始轨道合同，发射一颗由太阳能供电的极轨科学卫星）。

s:
Program: Early Satellites (Light)
Type: Required

Just putting an object in orbit is a stunt. Getting valuable scientific data from it is far more impressive.&br;&br;With the data returned from our sounding rockets, interesting radiation has been observed. We need you to send a scientific satellite into an eccentric orbit in order to study this data with more accuracy. Based on the best guesses of our scientists, having an apoapsis over 1500 km with a low periapsis will help us to learn more about the radiation surrounding Earth.&br;&br;Make sure your craft contains a Cosmic Ray Science experiment (Geiger-Muller Counter or Scintillation Counter) as we will need at least one day's worth of science returned from it.&br;&br;Real life examples: Object D (Sputnik 3), Explorer 1.&br;&br;Accepting this contract will automatically accept the First Artificial Satellite contract as well.
zh: 项目：早期卫星（轻型） <> 类型：必选 <> <> 仅仅把物体送入轨道只是一种噱头，从中获取有价值的科学数据才更具意义。&br;&br;探空火箭传回的数据显示存在值得关注的辐射现象。我们需要你将一颗热心科研卫星送入偏心轨道，以便更精确地研究这些数据。根据科学家的推测，远地点高于 1500 km 且近地点较低的轨道有助于我们进一步了解地球周围的辐射。&br;&br;请确保你的飞行器搭载了宇宙射线科学实验设备（盖革-米勒计数器或闪烁计数器），我们需要从中获取至少一天的科学数据回报。&br;&br;现实参考原型：Object D（伴侣号 3 号）、探险者 1 号。&br;&br;接取此合同将自动一并接取“第一颗人造卫星”合同。

s:
Program: Early Satellites (Light)
Type: Required

While batteries alone are good enough for simple satellites, they are insufficient for the greater energy demands of more complex systems. The first step towards that is to generate power to augment the supplied batteries. Launch a satellite into the specified orbit and demonstrate that it can generate more solar power than it consumes after a 2-week period in orbit.
zh: 项目：早期卫星（轻型） <> 类型：必选 <> <> 虽然仅靠电池足以支持简易卫星，但对于能耗更高的复杂系统而言则远远不够。迈向这一目标的第一步是发电以补充自带电池。发射一颗卫星进入指定轨道，并证明其在轨运行两周后，产生的太阳能电力大于其消耗的电力。

s:
Program: Early Satellites (Light)
Type: Optional

A sun-synchronous orbit is a geocentric orbit that combines altitude and inclination in such a way that the satellite passes over any given point of the planet's surface at the same local solar time. Such an orbit can place a satellite in constant sunlight and is useful for imaging, spy, and weather satellites.&br;&br;Place a satellite into a sun-synchronous orbit. Note that sun-synchronous orbits are often slightly retrograde, as is this orbit. You'll need to fly northwest from the launch pad and it will take more delta-v than a normal polar orbit.&br;&br;You can use an online orbit calculator to determine what kind of orbit will meet the eccentricity requirement, such as the one available from https://orbital-math.com/.
zh: 项目：早期卫星（轻型）<>类型：可选<> <>太阳同步轨道是一种将高度与倾角巧妙结合的地心轨道，使卫星能在相同的平太阳时飞越地表任意给定点。这种轨道可让卫星持续处于日照中，非常适合成像、侦察和气象卫星。&br;&br;将一颗卫星送入太阳同步轨道。请注意，太阳同步轨道通常略微逆行，本次轨道亦是如此。你需要从发射场向西北方向飞行，且消耗的Δv会比常规极轨道更多。&br;&br;你可以使用在线轨道计算器来确定何种轨道能满足偏心率要求，例如<>提供的计算工具。

s:
Program: Crewed Orbit
Type: CAPSTONE

Humans staying in space for longer durations allows for different types of experiments from what we can do with unmanned probes. Utilize your stations to complete these experiments. NOTE: You may have already collected some or all of this science. If you have, you won't need to collect it again.
zh: 项目：载人入轨<>类型：收官<> <>人类在太空驻留更长时间，能开展不同于无人探测器的多种实验。利用你的空间站完成这些实验。注意：你可能已经收集了部分或全部此项科学。若已收集，则无需重复进行。

s:
Program: Earth Space Station
Type: Optional

Studying even longer durations of human spaceflight will necessitate rotating in fresh crew and replenishing supplies. Control a second generation space station, then send any needed crew and supplies so that it can continue its mission&br;&br;Number of Phases Completed: @/index / @/maxCompletions
zh: 项目：地球空间站<>类型：可选<> <>研究更长周期的人类航天需要轮换新乘组并补充补给。控制一座第二代空间站，然后运送所需的乘员和补给以继续其任务&br;&br;已完成阶段数：@/index / @/maxCompletions

s:
Program: Earth Space Station
Type: Required

Design, build, and launch a space station into Earth orbit, then crew it for two weeks with at least two crew.
zh: 项目：地球空间站<>类型：必需<> <>设计、建造并将一座空间站发射至地球轨道，然后由至少两名乘员在站内驻留两周。

s:
Program: Crewed Orbit
Type: Required

Humans staying in space for longer durations allows for different types of experiments from what we can do with unmanned probes. Utilize your stations to complete these experiments. NOTE: You may have already collected some or all of this science. If you have, you won't need to collect it again.
zh: 项目：载人入轨<>类型：必需<> <>人类在太空驻留更长时间，能开展不同于无人探测器的多种实验。利用你的空间站完成这些实验。注意：你可能已经收集了部分或全部此项科学。若已收集，则无需重复进行。

s:
Program: Earth Space Station
Type: Optional

After successfully launching your first Space Station, it is now time to keep it working. Control a Space Station, then send any needed crew, life support, and research supplies to accumulate the next month worth of Long Term Habitation experimentation.&br;&br;Number of Phases Completed: @/index / @/maxCompletions
zh: 项目：地球空间站<>类型：可选<> <>成功发射首座空间站后，现在该维持其正常运转了。控制一座空间站，然后运送所需的乘员、生命支持与研究补给，以积累接下来一个月的长期驻留实验进度。&br;&br;已完成阶段数：@/index / @/maxCompletions

s:
Program: Earth Space Station
Type: Optional

After successfully launching your first Space Station, it is now time to launch another. Launch a Space Station with @/crewRequired crew, and have them stay on board to accumulate the next month worth of Long Term Habitation experimentation.&br;&br;Number of Phases Completed: @/index / @/maxCompletions
zh: 项目：地球空间站<>类型：可选<> <>成功发射首座空间站后，现在该发射下一座了。发射一座载有 @/crewRequired 名乘员的空间站，并让他们留驻在轨，以积累接下来一个月的长期驻留实验进度。&br;&br;已完成阶段数：@/index / @/maxCompletions

s:
Program: Earth Space Station
Type: CAPSTONE

Design, build, and launch a second generation space station into Earth orbit to research the effects of long duration space habitation over 2 years. This contract is based off of the Skylab and Second Generation Salyut space stations.
zh: 项目：地球空间站<>类型：收官<> <>设计、建造并将一座第二代空间站发射至地球轨道，以研究历时2年以上的长期太空驻留效应。本合同基于天空实验室和第二代礼炮系列空间站设计。

s:
Program: Crewed Orbit
Type: CAPSTONE

Human beings are capable of conducting a unique class of science experiments, one robotic spacecraft simply can't match. We'd like you to fly orbital missions in order to learn about human beings in space, what they can do, and how they perceive things around them. All these experiments were conducted historically during the Mercury and Vostok programs. As part of this science campaign, we also need you to fly at least one flight that lasts a day or more in orbit. NOTE: You may have already collected some or all of this science. If you have, you won't need to collect it again, but you do need to fly at least one whole-day (or more) duration crewed flight.

Note: Astronauts must be trained before launch. There are two types of training, Proficiency Training and Mission Training. Astronauts need Proficiency Training for each crewed part on the vehicle they launch on and for each part that they will enter during their mission. Proficiency Training has to be done only ONCE and lasts FOREVER. Next is Mission Training for the part you intend to launch them in. Mission training must be performed before EVERY flight and will EXPIRE on use or if it goes unused too long. To begin training your astronauts, go to Training tab in the RP-1 window, accessible via the RP-1 icon in the toolbar.
zh: 项目：载人入轨<>类型：收官<> <>人类有能力开展一类无人航天器无法比拟的独特科学实验。我们希望你执行轨道任务，以了解太空中的人类状况、行为能力以及对周围环境的感知。在历史上，所有这些实验均在水星计划和东方计划期间完成。作为该科学计划的一部分，你还需要执行至少一次在轨驻留一天或更长时间的飞行。注意：你可能已经收集了部分或全部此项科学。若已收集，无需重复进行，但你仍必须完成至少一次全天（或更长）的载人飞行。<> <>注意：航天员在发射前必须接受训练。训练分为两种：熟练度训练和任务训练。航天员对其发射所乘载具上的每个载人部件，以及任务期间将进入的每个部件，都需要进行熟练度训练。熟练度训练只需进行一次且永久有效。接下来是针对预定发射部件的任务训练。每次飞行前都必须进行任务训练，且该训练在执行任务后或长期未使用时会过期失效。若要开始训练航天员，请通过工具栏中的 <> 图标打开 <> 窗口，并前往“训练”标签页。

s:
Program: Crewed Orbit
Type: Required

Arguably one of the most important milestones a space program can achieve is putting a human into orbit around the Earth. The task requires a reliable launch system and many hours of research and engineering to pull off. Before committing to the goal, ensure you have the time to research, design, and build a craft capable of putting a human into a 150 km orbit for at least one full orbit. Single-person orbital spacecraft are fairly rare in history but serve an important role in proving future technologies and sending crew to space before rivals, with Mercury (1962, Atlas LV-3B) and Vostok (1961, Vostok-K) being the only examples.&br;&br;NOTE: Completing this contract will cause the 'Suborbital Flight (Crewed)' contracts to become unavailable. If it is accepted then it will automatically fail.

Note: Astronauts must be trained before launch. There are two types of training, Proficiency Training and Mission Training. Astronauts need Proficiency Training for each crewed part on the vehicle they launch on and for each part that they will enter during their mission. Proficiency Training has to be done only ONCE and lasts FOREVER. Next is Mission Training for the part you intend to launch them in. Mission training must be performed before EVERY flight and will EXPIRE on use or if it goes unused too long. To begin training your astronauts, go to Training tab in the RP-1 window, accessible via the RP-1 icon in the toolbar.
zh: 计划：载人入轨 <> 类型：必要 <> <> 可以说，航天计划所能达成的最重要里程碑之一就是将人类送入环绕地球的轨道。这项任务需要可靠的发射系统，以及数以千计小时的研发与工程攻关才能实现。在承诺此目标前，请确保有足够时间来研发、设计并建造一艘能够将航天员送入 150 km 轨道并完成至少一整圈飞行的航天器。单人轨道航天器在历史上相当罕见，但在验证未来技术以及抢在对手之前将乘员送入太空方面发挥了重要作用，水星号（1962年，宇宙神 <>）和东方号（1961年，东方号-K）是仅有的范例。&br;&br;注意：完成此合同将导致“亚轨道飞行（载人）”合同不再可用。如果已接受该合同，则会自动失败。 <> <> 注意：航天员在发射前必须接受训练。训练分为两种：熟练度训练和任务训练。航天员发射时所乘坐载具上的每个载人部件，以及任务期间将进入的每个部件，都需要完成熟练度训练。熟练度训练只需进行一次且永久有效。接下来是针对预定发射部件的任务训练。任务训练必须在每次飞行前进行，使用后或闲置时间过长均会失效。要开始训练航天员，请前往工具栏中通过 <> 图标打开的 <> 窗口中的“训练”标签页。

s:
Program: Crewed Orbit or Early Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Required

Reentry is brutally hot and dangerous, but it can be survivable with the right technology and equipment. We want you to design, build, and launch a craft that can survive a reentry and make a soft landing or splashdown on Earth. Note that orbital-speed suborbital flights are acceptable as well. Historically this research started with weapon reentry vehicles for the newly developing ICBM forces but the research, and rockets, were quite applicable elsewhere; reconnaissance satellite recovery vessels, crewed capsules, and interplanetary landers have also withstood this crucible.
zh: 计划：载人入轨或早期地球观测卫星 <> 类型：必要 <> <> 再入过程酷热且极度危险，但借助合适的技术与设备完全可以幸存。我们需要你设计、建造并发射一艘能够经受再入考验并在地球上软着陆或溅落的航天器。请注意，达到轨道速度的亚轨道飞行同样有效。历史上这项研究始于新兴洲际弹道导弹部队的武器再入载具，但相关研究与火箭也广泛适用于其他领域；侦察卫星回收舱、载人飞船以及行星际着陆器都曾经历过这种严苛考验。

s:
Program: Crewed Orbit
Type: Optional

Single-person orbital spacecraft are fairly rare in history but serve an important role in proving future technologies, with Mercury (1962, 1.4 tons, Atlas LV-3B) and Vostok (1961, 4.7 tons, Vostok-K) being the only examples. Design, build, and launch one that remains for @/NoOfOrbits orbits and return the crew safely back to Earth.

NOTE: You can not complete this contract and the Orbital Flight with Maneuvers and 2+ Crew contract at the same time. Attempting to complete both in same flight will automatically fail this one.&br;&br;Number of Contracts Completed: @index / unlimited

Note: Astronauts must be trained before launch. There are two types of training, Proficiency Training and Mission Training. Astronauts need Proficiency Training for each crewed part on the vehicle they launch on and for each part that they will enter during their mission. Proficiency Training has to be done only ONCE and lasts FOREVER. Next is Mission Training for the part you intend to launch them in. Mission training must be performed before EVERY flight and will EXPIRE on use or if it goes unused too long. To begin training your astronauts, go to Training tab in the RP-1 window, accessible via the RP-1 icon in the toolbar.
zh: 计划：载人入轨 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 单人轨道航天器在历史上相当罕见，但在验证未来技术方面发挥了重要作用，水星号（1962年，1.4吨，宇宙神 <>）和东方号（1961年，4.7吨，东方号-K）是仅有的范例。设计、建造并发射一艘航天器，在轨停留 @/NoOfOrbits 圈，并将乘员安全送回地球。 <> <> 注意：你不能同时完成此合同与“2人以上机动轨道飞行”合同。若尝试在同一次飞行中同时完成两项，将导致本合同自动失败。&br;&br;已完成合同数量：@index / 无限制 <> <> 注意：航天员在发射前必须接受训练。训练分为两种：熟练度训练和任务训练。航天员发射时所乘坐载具上的每个载人部件，以及任务期间将进入的每个部件，都需要完成熟练度训练。熟练度训练只需进行一次且永久有效。接下来是针对预定发射部件的任务训练。任务训练必须在每次飞行前进行，使用后或闲置时间过长均会失效。要开始训练航天员，请前往工具栏中通过 <> 图标打开的 <> 窗口中的“训练”标签页。

s:
Program: Crewed Orbit
Type: Required

Before putting a crew in a capsule to send into space, it is a good idea to test the capsule on an uncrewed flight. Send a Crew Capsule, WITH NO CREW IN IT, into orbit and return safely to Earth.
zh: 计划：载人入轨 <> 类型：必要 <> <> 在将乘员送入太空舱之前，先通过无人飞行测试该返回舱是一个明智的做法。发射一个载人返回舱（舱内不载人）进入轨道，并安全返回地球。

s:
Program: Crewed Orbit
Type: Optional

Before putting a crew in a capsule to send into space, it is a good idea to test the capsule with an advanced biological creature in it. Send a Crew Capsule WITH AN ANIMAL (one of the generated tourists) into orbit and return safely home. These animals are represented by tourists.

Can be completed @maxCompletions times.
zh: 计划：载人入轨 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 在将乘员送入太空舱之前，先搭载高等生物测试该返回舱是一个明智的做法。发射一个载有动物（由生成的游客代表）的载人返回舱进入轨道，并安全返回家园。这些动物由游客代替。 <> <> 可完成 @<> 次。

s:
Program: Crewed Orbit
Type: Optional

Reentry is brutally hot and dangerous but it can be survivable with the right technology and equipment. We want you to design, build, and launch a craft that can survive a reentry and make a soft landing or splashdown on Earth after achieving a typical orbit (roughly 200 km). This is a step up in the testing to ensure that our equipment works under expected orbital mission parameters. Note that this contract will be unavailable after completing the first crewed orbit.
zh: 计划：载人入轨 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 再入过程酷热且极度危险，但借助合适的技术与设备完全可以幸存。我们需要你设计、建造并发射一艘航天器，在达到典型轨道（约 200 km）后能够经受再入考验并在地球上软着陆或溅落。这是测试的进一步深入，以确保我们的设备在预期的轨道任务参数下正常工作。注意，在完成首次载人入轨后，此合同将不再可用。

s:
Program: Crewed Orbit
Type: Optional

Crewed suborbital flights are used as a safer prelude to an orbital mission, for research, or to set non-orbital altitude records. Send any number of crew above @VesselGroup/ReachAlt/minAltitude meters to satisfy the requirements of this mission. Historical missions used the Mercury capsule (1961, Mercury-Redstone), the X-15 (1963, B-52), and SpaceShipOne (2004, White Knight).NOTE: You can not select this contract and 'First Orbital Flight (Crewed') or 'X-Planes High' at the same time. If you select the other contract while this is active, this will automatically fail.&br;&br;Number of Contracts Completed: @index / @maxCompletions

Note: Astronauts must be trained before launch. There are two types of training, Proficiency Training and Mission Training. Astronauts need Proficiency Training for each crewed part on the vehicle they launch on and for each part that they will enter during their mission. Proficiency Training has to be done only ONCE and lasts FOREVER. Next is Mission Training for the part you intend to launch them in. Mission training must be performed before EVERY flight and will EXPIRE on use or if it goes unused too long. To begin training your astronauts, go to Training tab in the RP-1 window, accessible via the RP-1 icon in the toolbar.
zh: 项目：载人轨道 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 载人亚轨道飞行可用作轨道任务前更安全的前奏、用于研究，或用于创造非轨道高度纪录。将任意数量的乘员送至 @VesselGroup/ReachAlt/minAltitude 米以上以满足该任务的要求。历史上执行此类任务的有水星号乘员舱（1961年，水星-红石）、<>（1963年，<>）以及 <>（2004年，白色骑士）。注意：你不能同时接受此合同与“首次轨道飞行（载人）”或“高空 X 飞机”。如果在激活此合同时接受了另一个合同，此合同将自动失败。&br;&br;已完成合同数量：@index / @<> <> <> 注意：宇航员在发射前必须接受训练。训练分为两类：熟练度训练和任务训练。宇航员在发射载具上的每个载人部件，以及任务期间将进入的每个部件，都需要接受熟练度训练。熟练度训练只需进行一次且永久有效。接下来是针对你计划发射他们所用部件的任务训练。任务训练必须在每次飞行前进行，使用后或闲置过久都会过期。要开始训练宇航员，请转到工具栏中 <> 图标打开的 <> 窗口下的“训练”标签页。

s:
Program: Crewed Orbit
Type: Optional

Before putting a crew in a capsule to send into space, it is a good idea to test the capsule on an uncrewed flight. Send a Crew Capsule, WITH NO CREW IN IT, above @VesselGroup/ReachAlt/minAltitude meters to satisfy the requirements of this mission. &br;&br;Number of Contracts Completed: @index / @maxCompletions
zh: 项目：载人轨道 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 在将乘员送入乘员舱发射升空之前，最好先进行一次无人飞行测试。发射一个不载有任何乘员的载人乘员舱至 @VesselGroup/ReachAlt/minAltitude 米以上以满足该任务的要求。&br;&br;已完成合同数量：@index / @<>

s:
Program: Advanced Crewed Orbit
Type: CAPSTONE

Perform the first docking between two spacecraft. Historically, this was first done on March 16, 1966 with Gemini 8. Neil Armstrong and David Scott docked to an Agena target vehicle, before a stuck thruster on the Gemini spacecraft caused a near-disaster and the mission was aborted.
zh: 项目：高级载人轨道 <> 类型：里程碑 <> <> 完成两艘航天器之间的首次交会对接。历史上，该任务于1966年3月16日由双子座8号首次完成。尼尔·阿姆斯特朗与大卫·斯科特成功与阿金纳目标飞行器对接，随后双子座航天器上卡死的一台姿控推力器险些酿成灾难，任务被迫中止。

s:
Program: Advanced Crewed Orbit
Type: Required

Performing the first EVA provides valuable insight into future spacesuit, rather than flight suit, design. It also highlights future technologies that need development for EVA. Launch a spacecraft into orbit with least one crewmember aboard, perform a spacewalk while recording observations, and immediately transmit them home. Then, return the crew to Earth after at least one full orbit with a perigee above 150 km. Historically, the first spacewalk was performed from a Soviet Voskhod 2 (1965, 5.7 tons, modified Molniya) followed a few months later by a spacewalk from a U.S. Gemini capsule (1965, 3.8 tons, Gemini Titan II).
zh: 项目：高级载人轨道 <> 类型：必需 <> <> 进行首次 EVA 可为未来航天服（而非飞行服）的设计提供宝贵经验，并明确未来 EVA 所需研发的关键技术。发射一艘搭载至少一名乘员的航天器进入轨道，在进行太空行走的同时记录观测数据并立即传回地面。随后，在近地点高于 150 km 的轨道上运行至少一整圈后将乘员安全带回地球。历史上，首次太空行走由苏联上升2号（1965年，5.7吨，改装型闪电号运载火箭）完成，数月后美国双子座乘员舱（1965年，3.8吨，双子座-大力神II）也实现了这一壮举。

s:
Program: Advanced Crewed Orbit
Type: Optional

Putting two people into space in the same capsule opens the door to a range of new activities and opportunities. Such a spacecraft must remain in orbit with its crew @/DurationText days and return them safely to Earth. Only two spacecraft were ever specifically created for this task, the Soviet Voskhod 2, a refit of the 3-seat Voskhod 1 (1965, 5.7 tons, modified Molniya) and the U.S. Gemini (1965, 3.2 - 3.8 tons, Gemini-Titan II).

NOTE: Once you've completed this contract, Orbital Flight (One Crew) contracts will become unavailable. If you have both this and the Orbital Flight (One Crew) contract accepted, completing this will cause that contract to fail.&br;&br;Number of Contracts Completed: @index / unlimited
zh: 项目：高级载人轨道 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 将两人同时送入同一乘员舱进入太空，开启了一系列全新的任务与机遇。此类航天器必须搭载乘员在轨驻留 @/DurationText 天并将他们安全带回地球。历史上仅有两型航天器专门为此任务研制：苏联上升2号（由3座上升1号改装，1965年，5.7吨，改装型闪电号运载火箭）与美国双子座（1965年，3.2 - 3.8吨，双子座-大力神II）。<> <> 注意：完成此合同后，“轨道飞行（单人）”合同将不再可用。如果你同时接受了此合同与“轨道飞行（单人）”合同，完成此合同将导致该合同失败。&br;&br;已完成合同数量：@index / 无限制

s:
Program: Advanced Crewed Orbit
Type: Optional

The goal and realization of putting three (or more) crew on orbit at the same time begins the era of the space taxi and ready access to LEO. Depending on the politics and economy of the originating nation, these craft will either be noted predecessors to later craft or become so ubiquitous and reliable in the role that they are still flying 50 years after their first. These craft should be able to support at least three crew and prove that they can stay in orbit for @/DurationText days. The Soviet Voskhod 1 (1964, 5.3 tons, modified Molniya) and Soyuz (1967, 6.5 tons, Soyuz), and the U.S. Apollo CSM (1968, 14.7 - 21 tons for LEO, Saturn 1B) are examples of these craft.&br;&br;Number of Contracts Completed: @index / unlimited
zh: 项目：高级载人轨道 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 同时将三名（或更多）乘员送入轨道的设想与实现，标志着“太空班车”以及便捷进出近地轨道时代的到来。取决于发起国的政治与经济环境，这些航天器要么成为后续型号的著名先驱，要么在其岗位上高度普及并极其可靠，甚至在首飞50年后仍在使用。此类航天器应能支持至少三名乘员，并证明其能在轨驻留 @/DurationText 天。苏联上升1号（1964年，5.3吨，改装型闪电号运载火箭）、联盟号（1967年，6.5吨，联盟号运载火箭）以及美国阿波罗服务舱/指令舱（1968年，近地轨道构型14.7 - 21吨，土星1B）均为此类航天器的典范。&br;&br;已完成合同数量：@index / 无限制

s:
Program: Advanced Crewed Orbit
Type: Required

The first successful rendezvous between two spacecraft was when Gemini 6 and 7 met in 1965. Wally Schirra maneuvered Gemini 6 to within 30 cm of Gemini 7, close enough and precise enough to prove that docking two craft together in space was possible. Using your own knowledge of orbital mechanics, bring two craft to within 100 meters of each other while in orbit around Earth. At least one of the spacecraft must be a new launch.
zh: 项目：高级载人轨道 <> 类型：必需 <> <> 航天器之间的首次成功交会发生于1965年双子座6号与7号的相会。沃利·希拉操纵双子座6号接近至距离双子座7号仅 30 cm 处，其极高的精度证明了在太空中实现两艘航天器交会对接的可行性。运用你的轨道力学知识，在环绕地球轨道上将两艘航天器相互靠近至 100 米以内。其中至少一艘航天器必须是新发射的。

s:
Program: Early Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Required

Launch a satellite into an elliptical orbit with a new cosmic ray detector called a Cherenkov counter. This device is a different type of cosmic ray detector specifically calibrated for high-energy particles like neutrinos.

Make sure your craft contains a Cherenkov Counter and return 75% of the available science from High Earth Orbit. Science does not have to be collected in only 1 flight.

Historical example: Explorer 11 (37kg, Juno II)
zh: 项目：早期地球观测卫星 <> 类型：必需 <> <> 发射一颗搭载新型宇宙射线探测器（切伦科夫计数器）的卫星进入椭圆轨道。该设备是一种专为中微子等高能粒子校准的特殊宇宙射线探测器。<> <> 确保你的航天器装有切伦科夫计数器，并从高地球轨道传回 75% 的可用科学点数。科学数据无需在单次飞行中全部收集。 <> <> 历史范例：探索者11号（37 kg，朱诺II）

s:
Program: Early Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Required

Taking photographic images from space, with a powerful enough lens, can provide highly detailed information about many things. When used for intelligence purposes, an eye in the sky is an invaluable tool for gathering information about geopolitical rivals. These types of satellites also have numerous peaceful purposes, including crop monitoring, observing deforestation, and providing indicators for areas requiring humanitarian aid. Make sure your craft contains an Basic Film Camera, and a system to return the film for processing. Collection of all available science will require multiple launches due to film storage limitations onboard the vehicle.

Real life examples: Discoverer/Keyhole-1 (780kg, Thor-Agena)
zh: 计划：早期对地观测卫星 <> 类型：必选 <> <> 从太空进行摄影，配合足够强大的镜头，可以获取海量高细节信息。用于情报目的时，天眼是收集地缘政治对手情报的无价工具。此类卫星还具备广泛的和平用途，包括作物监测、森林砍伐观测，以及为需要人道主义援助的地区提供预警指示。确保你的航天器携带基础胶卷相机，以及用于回收胶卷进行冲洗的系统。由于飞行器自带的胶卷存储容量限制，收集所有可用科学数据需要多次发射。 <> <> 现实案例：探索者/锁眼-1（780kg，雷神-阿金纳）

s:
Program: Early Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Optional

With orbital imagery now a proven capability, send up a follow-on early-generation imagery satellite for a longer duration in orbit. This will allow the collection of far more data with repeat passes over the same points on the surface. Make sure your craft contains an Improved Film Camera, and a system to return the film canister for processing. Collection of all available science will require multiple launches due to film storage limitations onboard the vehicle.

Number of Contracts Completed: @index / @maxCompletions

Historical example: CORONA/Keyhole-4 (1,500kg, Thor-Agena)
zh: 计划：早期对地观测卫星 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 随着轨道成像技术得到验证，发射一颗后续的早期成像卫星以延长在轨时间。这将允许通过对地表同一点的多次重访收集更多数据。确保你的航天器携带改进型胶卷相机，以及用于回收胶卷舱进行冲洗的系统。由于飞行器自带的胶卷存储容量限制，收集所有可用科学数据需要多次发射。 <> <> 已完成合同数量：@index / @<> <> <> 历史案例：日冕/锁眼-4（1,500kg，雷神-阿金纳）

s:
Program: Early Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Required

The satellite launched in the Early Satellites program returned valuable data about the space near Earth. Send a satellite to High Earth Orbit to detect cosmic rays so that we may better ascertain the shape and strength of the cosmic ray environment around Earth. Early scientific satellites also contained still-frame and video cameras to take photos of Earth from entirely new perspectives.&br;&br;Make sure your craft contains a Cosmic Ray Science experiment (Geiger-Muller Counter or Scintillation Counter) and an Early TV camera. Between this and any other launches you must transmit 75% of Cosmic Ray Science and 75% of Visual Imaging from High Earth Orbit. Science does not have to be collected in only 1 flight.&br;&br;Historical example: Explorer 6 (64kg, Thor-Able)
zh: 计划：早期对地观测卫星 <> 类型：必选 <> <> 早期卫星计划中发射的卫星传回了关于近地空间的宝贵数据。向地球高轨发射一颗卫星以探测宇宙射线，从而更好地查明地球周围宇宙射线环境的形态与强度。早期科学卫星还搭载了静止图像和视频摄像机，从全新的视角拍摄地球。&br;&br;确保你的航天器携带宇宙射线科学实验（盖革-米勒计数器或闪烁计数器）以及早期电视摄像机。在本次发射及其他发射中，你必须传回地球高轨75%的宇宙射线科学数据与75%的可见光成像数据。科学数据不必在单次飞行中全部收集。&br;&br;历史案例：探险者6号（64kg，雷神-埃布尔）

s:
Program: Early Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Optional

Launch a new satellite to measure the gravimetric field of earth and its effect on orbiting satellites.

Make sure your craft contains an Orbital Perturbation experiment. Launch it into an inclined orbit and return 2 months worth of science.

Historical example: ANNA 1B (161kg, Thor-Ablestar)
zh: 计划：早期对地观测卫星 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 发射一颗新卫星以测量地球的重力场及其对轨道卫星的影响。<> <> 确保你的航天器携带轨道摄动实验设备。将其发射至倾斜轨道并传回相当于2个月的科学数据。 <> <> 历史案例：ANNA 1B（161kg，雷神-埃布尔之星）

s:
Program: Early Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Required

Weather forecasting today would be impossible without the numerous weather satellites constantly observing our atmosphere from orbit. Launch the very first dedicated weather satellite to measure temperatures in the atmosphere and correlate those with real-time video.

Make sure your craft contains an Infrared Radiometer 1 experiment and an Early TV camera.

Historical example: TIROS-1 (120kg, Thor-Able)
zh: 计划：早期对地观测卫星 <> 类型：必选 <> <> 如今的天气预报离不开众多在轨道上持续观测大气的气象卫星。发射首颗专用气象卫星以测量大气温度，并将其与实时视频建立关联。<> <> 确保你的航天器携带红外辐射计1号实验设备和早期电视摄像机。 <> <> 历史案例：泰罗斯1号（120kg，雷神-埃布尔）

s:
Program: Early Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Optional

After the success of your first weather satellite, your government wants additional satellites available for more timely weather observations with better coverage of Earth. Launch an additional weather satellite to fulfill their request.

Make sure your craft contains an Infrared Radiometry 1 experiment and an Early TV camera. Science requirements can be met over multiple launches.

Historical examples: TIROS-2 through TIROS-8.
zh: 计划：早期对地观测卫星 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 在首颗气象卫星成功发射后，政府希望部署更多卫星以获得更及时的气象观测和更好的地球覆盖范围。发射一颗附加气象卫星以满足其需求。<> <> 确保你的航天器携带红外辐射测量1号实验设备和早期电视摄像机。科学需求可通过多次发射达成。 <> <> 历史案例：泰罗斯2号至泰罗斯8号。

s:
Program: Early Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Optional

After the success of your first weather satellite, your government wants additional satellites available for more timely weather observations with better coverage of Earth. Launch an additional weather satellite to fulfill their request.

<Make sure your craft contains an Infrared Radiometry 1 experiment and an Early TV camera. Science requirements can be met over multiple launches.

Historical example: TIROS-9.
zh: 计划：早期对地观测卫星 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 在首颗气象卫星成功发射后，政府希望部署更多卫星以获得更及时的气象观测和更好的地球覆盖范围。发射一颗附加气象卫星以满足其需求。<> <> <确保你的航天器携带红外辐射测量1号实验设备和早期电视摄像机。科学需求可通过多次发射达成。 <> <> 历史案例：泰罗斯9号。

s:
Program: Early Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Required

Anyone that has ever used a compass is familiar with the magnetic fields that encapsulate Earth. Launch a satellite to better charaterize the strength and direction of the magnetic field, and determine how far into space its influence is felt.

Make sure your craft contains a Magnetic Scan experiment. Launch it into an elliptical orbit and return 75% worth of science from both Low and High Earth Orbit.

Historical example: IMP-A (138kg, Thor-Delta)
zh: 计划：早期对地观测卫星 <> 类型：必选 <> <> 任何使用过指南针的人都对包裹地球的磁场并不陌生。发射一颗卫星以更好地表征磁场的强度和方向，并测定其影响能延伸至多远的太空深处。<> <> 确保你的航天器携带磁测扫描实验设备。将其发射至椭圆轨道，并从地球低轨与高轨各传回75%的科学数据。 <> <> 历史案例：IMP-A（138kg，雷神-德尔塔）

s:
Program: Advanced Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Required

Your government wants satellites capable of monitoring the weather in a hempishere. Launch a satellite to fulfill their request.

Make sure your craft contains a Cosmic Ray experiment, a Helium Magnetometer, a Mass Spectrometer and a Basic TV Camera.

Historical example: ATS-1.
zh: 计划：先进对地观测卫星 <> 类型：必选 <> <> 政府需要能够监测半球气象的卫星。发射一颗卫星以满足其需求。<> <> 确保你的航天器携带宇宙射线实验设备、氦磁强计、质谱仪以及基础电视摄像机。 <> <> 历史案例：<>。

s:
Program: Advanced Earth Observation
Type: Required

Your government wants high resolution imagery of Earth.

Launch an analog film camera and retrieve its film.

Make sure your craft contains an High Resolution Film Camera and a system to return the film canister for processing. Collection of all available science will require multiple launches due to film storage limitations onboard the vehicle.

Historical example: KH-9 (Hexagon).
zh: 计划：进阶对地观测 <> 类型：必选 <> <> 你的政府需要地球的高分辨率图像。 <> <> 发射一台模拟胶卷相机并回收其胶卷。 <> <> 请确保你的载具搭载了高分辨率胶卷相机，以及用于带回胶卷舱进行处理的回收系统。受载具胶卷储存限制，收集所有可用科学数据需要多次发射。 <> <> 历史参考：<>（Hexagon）。

With orbital imagery now a proven capability, send up a follow-on early-generation imagery satellite for a longer duration in orbit. This will allow the collection of far more data with repeat passes over the same points on the surface. Make sure your craft contains an High Resolution Film Camera and a system to return the film canister for processing. Collection of all available science will require multiple launches due to film storage limitations onboard the vehicle.

Number of Contracts Completed: @index / @maxCompletions

Historical example: HEXAGON/Keyhole-7
zh: 计划：进阶对地观测 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 轨道成像能力已获验证，现需发射一颗后续的早期成像卫星并在轨运行更长时间。这将通过对地面同一区域的多次重访，收集更多数据。请确保你的载具搭载了高分辨率胶卷相机，以及用于带回胶卷舱进行处理的回收系统。受载具胶卷储存限制，收集所有可用科学数据需要多次发射。 <> <> 已完成合同数量：@index / @<> <> <> 历史参考：HEXAGON/Keyhole-7

s:
Program: Advanced Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Required

Your government wants satellites capable of detecting rocket launches by other nations. Launch a satellite to fulfill their request.

Make sure your craft contains a Cosmic Ray experiment, an Infrared Radiometer and a Micrometeorite Detector.

Historical example: Midas 1.
zh: 计划：进阶对地观测卫星 <> 类型：必选 <> <> 你的政府需要能够探测其他国家火箭发射的卫星。发射一颗卫星以满足他们的需求。 <> <> 请确保你的载具搭载了宇宙射线实验装置、红外辐射计和微流星体探测器。 <> <> 历史参考：Midas 1。

s:
Program: Advanced Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Optional

The initial tests were successful, but a single satellite cannot monitor the entire globe. We need to build a constellation.

Launch another operational rocket launch detection satellite to expand our early warning coverage.

Make sure your craft contains a Cosmic Ray experiment, an Infrared Radiometer and a Micrometeorite Detector. Place it in a polar orbit between 2,500 and 4,000 km.

Number of Contracts Completed: @index / @maxCompletions

Historical example: MIDAS 3-9.
zh: 计划：进阶对地观测卫星 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 早期试验已获成功，但单颗卫星无法监视全球。我们需要构建一个星座。 <> <> 发射另一颗业务化火箭发射探测卫星，以扩大我们的预警覆盖范围。 <> <> 请确保你的载具搭载了宇宙射线实验装置、红外辐射计和微流星体探测器。将其送入 2,500 至 4,000 km 之间的极地轨道。 <> <> 已完成合同数量：@index / @<> <> <> 历史参考：MIDAS 3-9。

s:
Program: Advanced Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Required

Your government wants a satellite capable of more advanced meteorological research. Launch a satellite to fulfill their request.

Make sure your craft contains an Infrared Radiometer and a Basic TV Camera. Science requirements can be met over multiple launches.

Historical example: Nimbus 1.
zh: 计划：进阶对地观测卫星 <> 类型：必选 <> <> 你的政府需要一颗能够开展更先进气象研究的卫星。发射一颗卫星以满足他们的需求。 <> <> 请确保你的载具搭载了红外辐射计和基础电视摄像机。科学需求可通过多次发射累计达成。 <> <> 历史参考：Nimbus 1。

s:
Program: Advanced Earth Observation Satellites
Type: Optional

s:
Program: Operational Earth Observation
Type: Required

To navigate precisely in space and target ICBMs accurately, we need a perfect mathematical model of the Earth's shape and gravity field (the Geoid).

Launch a dedicated geodetic satellite to map gravitational anomalies.

Make sure your craft contains an Orbital Pertubation Experiment and is placed in a high-inclination eccentric orbit.

zh: 项目：业务化对地观测 <> 类型：必选 <> <> 为了在太空中精确定位导航并准确瞄准洲际弹道导弹（ICBM），我们需要一个完美的地球形状和重力场（大地水准面）数学模型。 <> <> 发射一颗专用大地测量卫星来绘制重力异常点图。 <> <> 确保你的航天器配备了轨道摄动实验设备，并进入高倾角大椭圆轨道。 <> <> 历史原型：<> / <>。

s:
Program: Targeted Satellites
Type: Required

A Molniya orbit is a type of highly elliptical orbit with an inclination of 63.4 degrees, an argument of perigee of -90 degrees, and an orbital period of one half of a sidereal day. Place a satellite into a Molniya orbit.&br;&br;There will be an orbit showing in the map view and tracking station. You do not have to place the satellite into this orbit, but it is instead meant to show you where your perigee and apogee should approximately be located, but more importantly, it shows the proper shape of the orbit.
zh: 项目：专用卫星 <> 类型：必要 <> <> 闪电轨道（Molniya orbit）是一种大椭圆轨道，倾角为 63.4 度，近地点幅角为 -90 度，轨道周期为半个恒星日。将一颗卫星送入闪电轨道。&br;&br;地图视图和测控站中会显示一条轨道。你无需完全吻合该轨道，它的作用是向你指示近地点和远地点的大致位置，更重要的是展示轨道的正确形态。

s:
Program: Targeted Satellites
Type: Required

Through measuring the Doppler shift of radio signals transmitted from a satellite in a known orbit, it is possible for a receiver on the ground to establish their location, which would have many applications both civilian and military. To test the principle and develop receiver equipment, it is necessary to have a test navigational satellite in orbit. Be sure to include solar panels to generate power. Historically, the first experiments in satellite navigation were made with Transit 1B (119 kg, Thor-Ablestar).
zh: 项目：专用卫星 <> 类型：必要 <> <> 通过测量已知轨道卫星发射无线电信号的多普勒频移，地面接收机就能够确定自身位置，这在民用和军用领域都有广泛应用。为了测试该原理并研制接收机设备，必须在轨道上拥有一颗导航测试卫星。请务必安装太阳能电池板以发电。历史上，最早的卫星导航实验由子午仪 1B（Transit 1B，119 kg，雷神-爱布尔星运载火箭）完成。

s:
Program: Targeted Satellites
Type: CAPSTONE

A Tundra orbit is a highly elliptical geosynchronous orbit (note: not geostationary orbit) with a high inclination (usually near 63.4) and an orbital period of one sidereal day. A satellite placed in this orbit spends most of its time over a chosen area of the Earth, a phenomenon known as apogee dwell. The ground track of a satellite in a tundra orbit is a closed figure eight. The orbit in this contract is actually using data from the Sirius satellites, the only known satellites using a Tundra orbit.&br;&br;Place a satellite into a Tundra orbit.&br;&br;There will be an orbit showing in the map view and tracking station. You do not have to place the satellite into this orbit, but it is instead meant to show you where your perigee and apogee should approximately be located, but more importantly, it shows the proper shape of the orbit.
zh: 项目：专用卫星 <> 类型：重大里程碑 <> <> 苔原轨道（Tundra orbit）是一种大椭圆地球同步轨道（注意：并非地球静止轨道），具有高倾角（通常接近 63.4 度），轨道周期为一个恒星日。置于该轨道的卫星大部分时间都停留于地球选定区域的上空，这种现象称为远地点驻留。苔原轨道卫星的星下点轨迹呈闭合的“8”字形。此合同中的轨道实际上采用了天狼星（Sirius）卫星的数据，这是已知唯一使用苔原轨道的卫星系统。&br;&br;将一颗卫星送入苔原轨道。&br;&br;地图视图和测控站中会显示一条轨道。你无需完全吻合该轨道，它的作用是向你指示近地点和远地点的大致位置，更重要的是展示轨道的正确形态。

s:

zh: 项目：专用卫星 <> 类型：必要 <> <> 我们发射的大气分析卫星是了解高层大气如何影响天气的重要一步。然而，气象学家希望获取云层图像以更好地评估气象状况。&br;&br;发射我们的第一颗正式气象卫星入轨。

zh: 项目：木星观测 <> 类型：必选 <> <> 建造一颗探测器并使其在 9700 km 内飞掠木卫二。请务必在飞掠期间传回科学数据。

s:
Program: Jupiter Observation
Type: Required

Create a probe and send it to flyby Ganymede within 20,000 km. Make sure to transmit science from the flyby.
zh: 项目：木星观测 <> 类型：必选 <> <> 建造一颗探测器并使其在 20,000 km 内飞掠木卫三。请务必在飞掠期间传回科学数据。

s:

Type: Required

Design and successfully launch an uncrewed probe that will enter into an orbit of Jupiter.
zh: 项目：木星观测 <> 类型：必选 <> <> 设计并成功发射一颗无人探测器，使其进入环绕木星的轨道。

s:
Program: Jupiter Observation
Type: Optional

Design and successfully launch an uncrewed probe that will enter into a scientifically useful orbit of Jupiter.&br;The flexible parameters of this contract allow you to choose either a high inclination orbit for maximum surface coverage, or an orbit coplanar with the moons for repeated flybys.
zh: 项目：木星观测 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 设计并成功发射一颗无人探测器，使其进入具备科研价值的木星轨道。&br;该合同参数灵活，你可以选择高倾角轨道以实现最大地表覆盖，或选择与卫星共面的轨道以便多次飞掠。

s:
Program: Jupiter Observation
Type: Optional

Design and successfully launch an uncrewed probe that will enter into the atmosphere of Jupiter and will return scientific data.
zh: 项目：木星观测 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 设计并成功发射一颗无人探测器，使其进入木星大气层并发回科学数据。

s:
Program: Crewed Lunar Exploration
Type: Required

Design, build, and launch a crewed spacecraft into lunar space (with a periselene under 5000 km) and return safely to Earth.
zh: 项目：载人月球探测 <> 类型：必选 <> <> 设计、建造并成功发射一艘载人飞船进入月球空间（近月点低于 5000 km），随后安全返回地球。

s:
Program: Crewed Lunar Exploration
Type: Optional

Launch a crewed spacecraft into lunar orbit for a routine mission of the specified duration and return safely to Earth.&br;&br;Number of Contracts Completed: @index / 2
zh: 项目：载人月球探测 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 发射一艘载人飞船进入环月轨道执行指定时长的常规任务，随后安全返回地球。&br;&br;已完成合同数：@index / 2

s:
Program: Crewed Lunar Exploration
Type: Optional

Design and launch a spacecraft with at least two crew members with the ability to land one crew member on the Moon. This will be a targeted landing near a randomly generated waypoint. We will also require you to take a crewed rover to explore an additional two waypoints. Once you have explored the waypoints, return safely to Earth.&br;&br;Number of Contracts Completed: @index / @maxCompletions
zh: 项目：载人月球探测 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 设计并发射一艘至少搭载两名乘员的飞船，并具备将一名乘员送上月球着陆的能力。此为定点着陆，降落于随机生成的航路点附近。同时要求携带一辆载人漫游车探索另外两个航路点。探索完毕后，安全返回地球。&br;&br;已完成合同数：@index / @<>

s:
Program: Crewed Lunar Exploration
Type: CAPSTONE

Design and launch a spacecraft with at least two crew members and the capability to land at least one crew member at a specific location on the Moon. Explore the area for at least @/LandDur and then return safely to Earth.&br;&br;Number of Contracts Completed: @index / @maxCompletions
zh: 项目：载人月球探测 <> 类型：里程碑 <> <> 设计并发射一艘至少搭载两名乘员的飞船，并具备将至少一名乘员送至月球指定地点着陆的能力。在目标区域探索至少 @/LandDur，随后安全返回地球。&br;&br;已完成合同数：@index / @<>

s:
Program: Crewed Lunar Exploration
Type: Required

Design and launch a spacecraft with at least two crew members to orbit close to the Moon for at least 20 hours and return safely to Earth. You must also broadcast live TV during the mission, the experiment for which is unlocked in the Improved Communications technology node. Historically, Apollo 8 was the first to do this, flying to the Moon over Christmas, 1968.
zh: 项目：载人月球探测 <> 类型：必选 <> <> 设计并发射一艘至少搭载两名乘员的飞船，在近月轨道运行至少 20 小时并安全返回地球。任务期间还必须进行电视直播，该实验可在“改进型通信”科技节点中解锁。历史上，阿波罗 8 号于 1968 年圣诞节期间飞往月球，率先完成了这一壮举。

s:
Program: Crewed Lunar Exploration
Type: Required

We are ready to finally put Humans on the surface of the Moon! Good luck to you in your design and execution of this complex mission!&br;&br;You must bring two Humans to the Moon and put at least one Human on the Moon and return them safely to the Earth.&br;&br;NOTE: The contract asks you to plant a flag on the Moon. Be sure that you have updated your Astronaut Complex to level five to unlock that ability.
zh: 项目：载人月球探测 <> 类型：必选 <> <> 我们终于准备好将人类送上月球表面了！祝你在设计与执行这项复杂任务时一切顺利！&br;&br;你必须搭载两名乘员前往月球，并让至少一名乘员踏上月球表面，最后将他们安全带回地球。&br;&br;注意：该合同要求在月球表面插旗。请确保航天员中心已升级至 5 级以解锁该能力。

s:
Program: Crewed Lunar Exploration
Type: Required

We are ready to finally put Humans on the surface of the Moon! Good luck to you in your design and execution of this complex mission!&br;&br;You must put at least two Humans on the Moon and return them safely to the Earth. You may not perform any dockings or this contract will fail. &br;&br;NOTE: The contract asks you to plant a flag on the Moon. Be sure that you have updated your Astronaut Complex to level five to unlock that ability.
zh: 项目：载人月球探测 <> 类型：必选 <> <> 我们终于准备好将人类送上月球表面了！祝你在设计与执行这项复杂任务时一切顺利！&br;&br;你必须让至少两名乘员踏上月球表面，并安全返回地球。全程不得执行任何对接操作，否则合同失败。&br;&br;注意：该合同要求在月球表面插旗。请确保航天员中心已升级至 5 级以解锁该能力。

s:
Program: Uncrewed Lunar Surface Exploration
Type: Required

Design and successfully launch a craft that can achieve a soft landing on the Moon and return science data back to Earth.

After this contract has been completed, the 'Lunar Landing (Uncrewed)' contract will become available.
zh: 项目：无人月表探测 <> 类型：必选 <> <> 设计并成功发射一艘航天器，使其在月球软着陆并将科学数据传回地球。 <> <> 完成该合同后，将解锁“月球着陆（无人）”合同。

s:
Program: Uncrewed Lunar Surface Exploration
Type: CAPSTONE

Design and successfully launch a craft that can achieve a soft landing on the far side of the Moon and return science data back to Earth.

Lunar libration already allows us to see 59% of the Moon's surface, so we want you to land within 80° of the far side.

After this contract has been completed, the 'Far Side Lunar Landing (Uncrewed)' contract will become available.
zh: 项目：无人月表探测 <> 类型：里程碑 <> <> 设计并成功发射一艘能够在月球背面实现软着陆、并将科学数据传回地球的航天器。 <> <> 月球天平动已经让我们能观测到 59% 的月球表面，因此我们希望你在月球背面中心区域 80° 范围内着陆。 <> <> 完成此合同后，将解锁“月球背面着陆（无人）”合同。

s:
Program: Uncrewed Lunar Surface Exploration
Type: Optional

Design and successfully launch a craft that can achieve a soft landing on the far side of the Moon and return science data back to Earth.

Lunar libration already allows us to see 59% of the Moon's surface, so we want you to land within 80° of the far side.

This is a series of @maxCompletions contracts, of which @index have been completed.
zh: 项目：无人月表探测 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 设计并成功发射一艘能够在月球背面实现软着陆、并将科学数据传回地球的航天器。 <> <> 月球天平动已经让我们能观测到 59% 的月球表面，因此我们希望你在月球背面中心区域 80° 范围内着陆。 <> <> 这是一个包含 @<> 个合同的系列任务，当前已完成 @index 个。

s:
Program: Uncrewed Lunar Surface Exploration
Type: Optional

You have successfully landed on the Moon, but our scientists need to know more information about the elements that make up the surface. Send a craft to land on the Moon and then return to Earth with scientific data from the Moon's surface.

This is a series of @maxCompletions contracts, of which @index have been completed.
zh: 项目：无人月表探测 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 你已经成功在月球着陆，但我们的科学家需要了解更多有关月表组成成分的信息。发射一艘航天器在月球着陆，并携带月表的科学数据返回地球。 <> <> 这是一个包含 @<> 个合同的系列任务，当前已完成 @index 个。

s: Gather science from the surface of the Moon and Return some of it home, DO NOT ONLY TRANSMIT
zh: 从月球表面收集科学数据并带回部分样本，不要仅进行数据传输

s:
Program: Uncrewed Lunar Surface Exploration
Type: Required

Design and successfully launch a probe into lunar orbit (with a maximum apiselene of @/maxApText.Print() km) and successfully transmit or return Visible Imaging 2 Science.

After this contract has been completed, the 'Lunar Orbiter & Mapper (Uncrewed)' contracts will become available.
zh: 项目：无人月表探测 <> 类型：必需 <> <> 设计并成功发射一颗探测器进入环月轨道（远月点最高不超过 @/maxApText.Print() km），并成功传回或带回可见光成像 2 科学数据。 <> <> 完成此合同后，将解锁“月球轨道器与测绘器（无人）”合同。

s:
Program: Uncrewed Lunar Surface Exploration
Type: Optional

Design and successfully launch a probe into lunar orbit (with a maximum apiselene of @/maxApText.Print() km) and successfully transmit or return Visible Imaging 2 Science.

This is a series of @maxCompletions contracts, of which @index have been completed.
zh: 项目：无人月表探测 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 设计并成功发射一颗探测器进入环月轨道（远月点最高不超过 @/maxApText.Print() km），并成功传回或带回可见光成像 2 科学数据。 <> <> 这是一个包含 @<> 个合同的系列任务，当前已完成 @index 个。

s:
Program: Uncrewed Lunar Surface Exploration
Type: Optional

A good way to explore more of the Moon is to send a rover to visit different places. Our scientists have picked three locations to inspect with a rover.

Design and successfully send a rover to the Moon and visit the marked waypoints.
It is recommended to use the Waypoint Manager mod for better navigation.

This is a series of @maxCompletions contracts, of which @index have been completed.
zh: 项目：无人月表探测 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 深入探索月球的良策是派遣巡视器造访不同地点。我们的科学家已选定三处地点供巡视器考察。 <> <> 设计并成功发射一辆巡视器前往月球，造访标记的导航点。 <> 建议使用 Waypoint Manager 模组以获得更佳的导航体验。 <> <> 这是一个包含 @<> 个合同的系列任务，当前已完成 @index 个。

s:
Program: Mars Surface Exploration
Type: Optional

Create a probe and send it to flyby Deimos within 45 km. Make sure to transmit science from the flyby.
zh: 项目：火星表面探测 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 制造并向火卫二发射一颗探测器，在 45 km 范围内飞掠。务必在飞掠期间传回科学数据。

s:
Program: Mars Surface Exploration
Type: Optional

Design and successfully launch an uncrewed probe that will soft land on Deimos and transmit a science report from the surface. This contract can be completed 2 times.
zh: 项目：火星表面探测 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 设计并成功发射一颗无人探测器，在火卫二软着陆并从表面传回科学报告。此合同可完成 2 次。

s:
Program: Mars Surface Exploration
Type: Required

Design and successfully launch an uncrewed probe that will soft land on Mars and transmit a science report from the surface.
zh: 项目：火星表面探测 <> 类型：必需 <> <> 设计并成功发射一颗无人探测器，在火星软着陆并从表面传回科学报告。

s:
Program: Mars Surface Exploration
Type: Optional

Design and successfully launch an uncrewed probe that will soft land on Mars and transmit a science report from the surface. This contract can be completed as many times as you wish.
zh: 项目：火星表面探测 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 设计并成功发射一颗无人探测器，在火星软着陆并从表面传回科学报告。此合同可按意愿重复完成任意次数。

s:
Program: Mars Surface Exploration
Type: Optional

Design and successfully launch an uncrewed probe that will enter into the atmosphere of Mars and return scientific data.
zh: 项目：火星表面探测 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 设计并成功发射一颗无人探测器，进入火星大气层并带回科学数据。

s:
Program: Mars Surface Exploration
Type: CAPSTONE

Design and send a rover to the surface of Mars and visit the different areas marked by our scientists.&br;&br;We suggest landing your rover as close as possible to the first marker.
zh: 项目：火星表面探测 <> 类型：里程碑 <> <> 设计一辆巡视器并送往火星表面，造访科学家标记的各个区域。&br;&br;建议将巡视器着陆在尽可能靠近第一个标记点的位置。

s:
Program: Mars Surface Exploration
Type: Optional

Design and send a rover to the surface of Mars and visit the different areas marked by our scientists.&br;&br;We suggest landing your rover as close as possible to the first marker.
zh: 项目：火星表面探测 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 设计一辆巡视器并送往火星表面，造访科学家标记的各个区域。&br;&br;建议将巡视器着陆在尽可能靠近第一个标记点的位置。

s:
Program: Early Inner Planet Probes
Type: Required

Create a probe and send it to flyby Mars within 20,000 km. Make sure to transmit science from the flyby.
zh: 项目：早期内行星探测器 <> 类型：必需 <> <> 制造并向火星发射一颗探测器，在 20,000 km 范围内飞掠。务必在飞掠期间传回科学数据。

s:
Program: Early Inner Planet Probes
Type: Required

Design and successfully launch an uncrewed probe that will enter into an orbit of Mars.
zh: 项目：早期内行星探测器 <> 类型：必需 <> <> 设计并成功发射一颗无人探测器进入环火星轨道。

s:
Program: Early Inner Planet Probes or Mars Surface Exploration
Type: Optional

Design and successfully launch an uncrewed probe that will enter into a scientifically useful orbit of Mars.&br;The flexible parameters of this contract allow you to choose either a high inclination orbit for maximum surface coverage, or an orbit coplanar with the moons for repeated flybys.
zh: 项目：早期内行星探测器或火星表面探测 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 设计并成功发射一颗无人探测器，进入具有科学价值的环火星轨道。&br;该合同的弹性参数允许你选择高倾角轨道以实现最大地表覆盖率，或选择与卫星共面的轨道以进行多次飞掠。

s:
Program: Mars Surface Exploration
Type: Optional

Create a probe and send it to flyby Phobos within 45 km. Make sure to transmit science from the flyby.
zh: 项目：火星表面探测 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 制造并向火卫一发射一颗探测器，在 45 km 范围内飞掠。务必在飞掠期间传回科学数据。

s:
Program: Mars Surface Exploration
Type: Optional

Design and successfully launch an uncrewed probe that will soft land on Phobos and transmit a science report from the surface. This contract can be completed 2 times.
zh: 计划：火星表面探测 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 设计并成功发射一艘无人探测器，在火卫一软着陆并从表面传回一份科学报告。该合同可完成 2 次。

s:
Program: Mars Surface Exploration
Type: Optional

Design and successfully launch an uncrewed probe to land on Phobos, gather science, and bring something back to Earth for study. This is a sample return missions so you cannot just transmit the data back, it needs to be physically returned.
zh: 计划：火星表面探测 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 设计并成功发射一艘无人探测器着陆火卫一，收集科学数据，并将样本带回地球进行研究。这是一次样本返回任务，因此不能仅回传数据，必须带回实体样本。

s: Gather science while landed and Return it home, DO NOT TRANSMIT
zh: 在着陆状态下收集科学数据并带回本土，切勿无线电传回

s:
Program: Crewed Mars Exploration
Type: Optional

Design and launch a spacecraft with at least two crew members to land on Mars. Explore the area for at least 30 days and then return safely to Earth.
zh: 计划：载人火星探测 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 设计并发射一艘载有至少两名乘员的航天器着陆火星。在着陆区域探索至少 30 天，然后安全返回地球。

s:
Program: Crewed Mars Exploration
Type: Optional

Some of our scientists and engineers believe that we should land humans on Deimos as part of the mission architecture for Mars.&br;&br;Design a mission that will successfully land at least two humans on Deimos and return safely to Earth.
zh: 计划：载人火星探测 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 我们的一些科学家和工程师认为，作为火星任务构型的一部分，我们应该派人着陆火卫二。&br;&br;设计一项任务，成功将至少两名航天员送上火卫二着陆并安全返回地球。

s:
Program: Crewed Mars Exploration
Type: Required

We want to put "Boots on the Ground" and explore the surface of Mars with humans. This mission will be the most ambitious, complex and expensive mission ever undertaken by our space agency.&br;&br;Design a mission that will successfully land at least two humans on Mars, stay for at least 30 days and return safely to Earth.
zh: 计划：载人火星探测 <> 类型：必需 <> <> 我们希望让人类踏上火星表面展开实地探索。该任务将是我们航天局有史以来最具雄心、最为复杂且耗资最为巨大的任务。&br;&br;设计一项任务，成功将至少两名航天员送上火星着陆，停留至少 30 天并安全返回地球。

s:
Program: Crewed Mars Exploration
Type: Required

Design and successfully launch a craft that can carry at least four crew into orbit around Mars and return them safely to Earth.
zh: 计划：载人火星探测 <> 类型：必需 <> <> 设计并成功发射一艘能够运载至少四名乘员进入环火星轨道并安全返回地球的航天器。

s:
Program: Crewed Mars Exploration
Type: Required

Perform geologic field work while on the martian surface. Obtain surface samples and perform deep core drilling to return to Earth.
zh: 计划：载人火星探测 <> 类型：必需 <> <> 在火星表面进行野外地质考察。采集地表样本并进行深层岩芯钻探，将其带回地球。

s: Gather Mars Surface Samples and Return it home
zh: 收集火星地表样本并带回本土

s: Gather Mars Deep Surface Samples and Return it home
zh: 收集火星深层地表样本并带回本土

s: Gather Robotic Surface Sample while Landed and Return it home
zh: 在着陆状态下收集无人探测地表样本并带回本土

s:
Program: Crewed Mars Exploration
Type: Optional

In preparation of a Mars orbit and a longer mission duration, we want to send a crew on a free-return fly-by of Mars to test components of the orbital mission architecture. Design, build and launch a mission that sends at least two humans on a flyby of Mars and return them home safely to Earth.&br;&br;NOTE: This contract will become unavailable once the Crewed Mars Orbit contract is accepted or completed.
zh: 计划：载人火星探测 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 为了筹备火星环绕以及更长时间的任务，我们希望派乘员进行一次火星自由返回飞越，以测试轨道任务构型的各组件。设计、制造并执行一次任务，运载至少两名航天员飞越火星并安全返回地球。&br;&br;注意：一旦接受或完成载人环火任务合同，此合同将失效。

s:
Program: Crewed Mars Exploration
Type: Optional

To reduce total radiation exposure to Crew, a gravity assist from Venus has been proposed as part of an Opposition-Class missions to the Red Planet. This trajectory also reduces the overall Delta-V requirements neeeded for a faster interplanetary transfer compared to a direct-to-Mars approach.
zh: 计划：载人火星探测 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 为减少乘员承受的总辐射剂量，已提出在前往火星的冲位型任务中利用金星引力助推。与直接奔火方案相比，该轨道还能降低快速行星际转移所需的总Δv。

s:
Program: Crewed Mars Exploration
Type: Required

Send astronauts to Phobos to demonstrate key technologies that will be needed for future crewed Mars Landings. Obtain various surface samples from Phobos and remain for the specified duration.
zh: 计划：载人火星探测 <> 类型：必需 <> <> 派遣航天员前往火卫一，验证未来载人火星着陆所需的关键技术。从火卫一采集多种地表样本，并停留规定时间。

s: Gather Phobos Surface Samples and Return it home
zh: 收集火卫一地表样本并带回本土

s: Gather Phobos Deep Surface Samples and Return it home
zh: 收集火卫一深层地表样本并带回本土

s:
Program: Crewed Mars Exploration
Type: Optional

Some of our scientists and engineers believe that we should land humans on Phobos as part of the mission architecture for Mars. They expect landing on Phobos will be similar to how we landed on our own Moon.&br;&br;Design a mission that will successfully land at least two humans on Phobos and return safely to Earth.
zh: 计划：载人火星探测 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 我们的一些科学家和工程师认为，作为火星任务构型的一部分，我们应该派人着陆火卫一。他们预计着陆火卫一的过程类似于着陆月球。&br;&br;设计一项任务，成功将至少两名航天员送上火卫一着陆并安全返回地球。

s:
Program: Mercury Exploration

s:
Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

Communications around the globe are limited to line of sight because of the curvature of Earth. If we can launch a communications satellite into orbit, we can use it to transmit information to the opposite side of the world. Launching a satellite into an eccentric low earth orbit is a good place to start. It should be relatively easy with existing launch vehicles, and the high apogee will provide good lines of sight for a few minutes every orbit. However, providing global communications coverage with such a low orbit would require very many satellites.

Historical example: Telstar 1 (78kg, Thor-Delta).
zh: 项目：早期商业应用 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 由于地球曲率的影响，全球范围内的通信受限于视距传输。如果能将一颗通信卫星送入轨道，我们就能利用它将信息传送到地球的另一侧。将卫星发射到大椭圆低地球轨道是一个很好的起点。利用现有的运载火箭相对容易实现，而且较高的远地点在每个轨道周期都能提供数分钟良好的视距通信。然而，要用如此低的轨道实现全球通信覆盖，需要非常多的卫星。 <> <> 历史范例：同温层1号（Telstar 1，78 kg，雷神-德尔塔）。

s:
Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

Having a communication satellite that remains stationary relative to a satellite earth station means that the antenna wouldn't need to track movements to stay connected, and a constant line of sight can be maintained 24 hours a day. This would greatly simplify communication relay and mass transmission systems.

See the RP-1 wiki for more information on how to get to a geostationary orbit.
Historical example: Syncom 3 (39 kg, Thor-Delta) launched in August of 1964.
zh: 项目：早期商业应用 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 拥有相对于卫星地球站保持相对静止的通信卫星，意味着地面天线无需追踪移动即可保持连线，且能全天 24 小时保持不间断视距。这将极大地简化通信中继与大规模传输系统。 <> <> 有关如何进入地球静止轨道的更多信息，请参阅 <> wiki。 <> 历史范例：辛康3号（Syncom 3，39 kg，雷神-德尔塔），于 1964 年 8 月发射。

s:
Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

With an orbital period of an earth day, a satellite will remain above a constant longitude, appearing to drift north and south through the day. This orbit will be able to provide a constant line of sight for satellite earth stations at low latitudes, but at high latitudes it may still drift too far north or south to be used for portions of the day. However, forgoing an inclination change burn makes this orbit easier to get to than a proper geostationary orbit.

See the RP-1 wiki for more information on how to get to a geostationary orbit.
Historical example: Syncom 2 (36kg, Thor-Delta).
zh: 项目：早期商业应用 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 若轨道周期为一个地球日，卫星将保持在固定的经度上方，并在一天中呈现南北漂移。该轨道能够为低纬度的卫星地面站提供持续的视距，但在高纬度地区，卫星在一天中的部分时间仍可能漂移过远而无法使用。不过，放弃轨道倾角变轨使得该轨道比真正的地球静止轨道更容易入轨。 <> <> 有关如何进入地球静止轨道的更多信息，请参阅 <> wiki。 <> 历史范例：辛康2号（Syncom 2，36 kg，雷神-德尔塔）。

s:
Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

A Molniya orbit is a type of highly elliptical orbit with an inclination of 63.4 degrees, an argument of perigee of -90 (270) degrees, and an orbital period of one half of a sidereal day. This orbit will cause the satellite to appear to remain nearly stationary in the sky for a short period at apogee. Combined with the high inclination, this orbit will allow a satellite to maintain a line of sight with satellite earth stations at a high latitude for about 6 hours a day.

See the RP-1 wiki for more information on how to get to a Molniya orbit.

Historical example: Molniya 1-1 (1,600kg, Molniya)
zh: 方案：早期专注效益应用 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 闪电轨道是一种大椭圆轨道，倾角为 63.4 度，近地点幅角为 -90（270）度，轨道周期为半个恒星日。处于此轨道的卫星在远地点附近的一段短周期内，在天空中看起来几乎处于静止状态。结合高倾角特性，该轨道能让卫星每天维持与高纬度地面站视线连通约 6 小时。 <> <> 有关如何进入闪电轨道的详细信息，请参阅 <> wiki。 <> <> 历史参考：闪电 1-1（1,600kg，闪电号）。

s:
Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

A Tundra orbit is a highly elliptical geosynchronous orbit (note: not geostationary orbit) similar to a Molniya orbit, with a high inclination (usually near 63.4) and an orbital period of one sidereal day. A satellite placed in this orbit spends most of its time over a chosen area of the Earth, a phenomenon known as apogee dwell, allowing it to maintain a line of sight with satellite earth stations at a high latitude for about 8 hours a day. The ground track of a satellite in a tundra orbit is a closed figure eight.

See the RP-1 wiki for more information on how to get to a Tundra orbit.

Historical example: Sirius FM-1 (3,800kg, Proton-K)
zh: 方案：早期专注效益应用 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 苔原轨道是一种类似于闪电轨道的大椭圆地球同步轨道（注意：非地球静止轨道），具有高倾角（通常在 63.4 度左右）和 1 个恒星日的轨道周期。置于该轨道的卫星大部分时间停留在地球的指定区域上空（称为远地点驻留现象），使其每天能维持与高纬度地面站视线连通约 8 小时。处于苔原轨道的卫星地面星下点轨迹呈闭合的“8”字形。 <> <> 有关如何进入苔原轨道的详细信息，请参阅 <> wiki。 <> <> 历史参考：天狼星 <>（3,800kg，质子-K）。

s:
Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Required

As part of a Franco-Soviet agreement on colour television, we are considering using the space segement of the Soviet television network to relay television between Paris and Moscow.

Historical example: Molniya 1+ series satellites (1,600kg, Molniya).
zh: 方案：早期专注效益应用 <> 类型：必选 <> <> 作为法苏彩色电视协议的一部分，我们正在考虑利用苏联电视网络空间段在巴黎和莫斯科之间中继电视信号。 <> <> 历史参考：闪电 1+ 系列卫星（1,600kg，闪电号）。

s:
Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Required

For the Soviet Union, which occupies about one-sixth of the earth’s surface, an efficient system of space communications is a vital necessity. The country covers nearly 11,000 km from east to west and over 7,200 km from north to south, and is crossed by 11 time zones; in addition, there are tremendously varied climatic conditions and vast areas of rugged terrain.

Historical example: Molniya 1-1 (1,600kg, Molniya).
zh: 方案：早期专注效益应用 <> 类型：必选 <> <> 对占据地球陆地面积约六分之一的苏联来说，建立高效的空间通信系统是至关重要的刚需。苏联东西横跨近 11,000 km，南北纵贯超过 7,200 km，跨越 11 个时区；此外，各地气候条件差异极大，且分布着广袤崎岖的地形。 <> <> 历史参考：闪电 1-1（1,600kg，闪电号）。

s:
Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Required

The development of artificial satellites opens the possibility of applying microwave radio relay technology to transoceanic links, using a “microwave repeater in the sky”. The objective for this experiment is to answer the critical questions, leaving until a later round of design the optimization of trade-offs and the development and construction of a commercial operating system.

Historical example: Telstar 1 (78kg, Thor-Delta).
zh: 方案：早期专注效益应用 <> 类型：必选 <> <> 人造卫星的发展使利用“空中微波转发器”将微波无线电中继技术应用于跨洋通信链路成为可能。本试验的目标是验证关键技术问题，系统的权衡优化以及商业运营系统的研制与建设则留待后续阶段进行。 <> <> 历史参考：电星 1 号（78kg，雷神-德尔塔）。

s:
Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

Satellite communications offers the ability to communicate with nearly any point on Earth, including the oceans. A ship equipped with a satellite terminal could be provided a reliable radio link to shore in nearly any condition, bypassing many of the difficulties involved in communicating with a vessel at sea. However, this will require a satellite terminal small enough to fit on a ship.
Historical example: Syncom 2 (39kg, Thor-Delta).
zh: 方案：早期专注效益应用 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 卫星通信具备与地球上几乎任何地点（包括大洋）进行通信的能力。配备卫星终端的船只几乎可以在任何条件下与陆地保持可靠的无线电连接，避开海上船舶通信面临的诸多困难。然而，这需要研制出小到足以安装在船上的卫星终端。 <> 历史参考：辛康 2 号（39kg，雷神-德尔塔）。

s:
Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

For a transatlantic satellite telecom system to be viable, it must provide a sustained link, not just a few minutes until the satellite passes below the horizon. Provide a transatlantic connection that supports a few voice channels for at least 12 hours a day. The lower required data rate should allow a very small satellite to be used, opening up the possibility for higher orbits.
Historical example: Syncom 2 (39kg, Thor-Delta).
zh: 方案：早期专注效益应用 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 跨大西洋卫星电信系统要具备实用性，就必须提供持久的链路，而不能仅在卫星降至地平线以下的几分钟内有效。请建立一条每天至少支持 12 小时数路话音信道的跨大西洋连接。较低的数据速率需求可以使用极小型的卫星，从而为进入更高轨道创造条件。 <> 历史参考：辛康 2 号（39kg，雷神-德尔塔）。

s:
Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

For a Transpacific satellite telecom system to be viable, it must provide a sustained link, not just a few minutes until the satellite passes below the horizon. Provide a Transpacific connection that supports a few voice channels for at least 12 hours a day. The lower required data rate should allow a very small satellite to be used, opening up the possibility for higher orbits.
Historical example: Syncom 3 (34kg, Thor-Delta)
zh: 方案：早期专注效益应用 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 跨太平洋卫星电信系统要具备实用性，就必须提供持久的链路，而不能仅在卫星降至地平线以下的几分钟内有效。请建立一条每天至少支持 12 小时数路话音信道的跨太平洋连接。较低的数据速率需求可以使用极小型的卫星，从而为进入更高轨道创造条件。 <> 历史参考：辛康 3 号（34kg，雷神-德尔塔）。

s:
Program: First Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

Cuba is a close ally to the Soviet Union, but it's position in the Caribbean leaves it surrounded by unfriendly forces. Satellite communications offers a way to safely link Cuba to the Soviet Union.

Historical example: Molniya 1+ series satellites (1,600kg, Molniya).
zh: 方案：第一代专注效益应用 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 古巴是苏联的亲密盟友，但其地处加勒比海的地理位置使其处于敌对势力的包围之中。卫星通信提供了一种将古巴与苏联安全连接的方式。 <> <> 历史参考：闪电 1+ 系列卫星（1,600kg，闪电号）。

s:
Program: First Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

Australia is one of the furthest-flung members of the British Commonwealth, positioned in the southern hemisphere, nearly at the antipode of the British Isles. Even in the jet age, it takes a Boeing 707 a grueling 34 hours to make the trip from London to Sydney. We would like to end the isolation of "the land down under", and broadcast live television between Britain and Australia.

Historical example: Intelsat II series satellites (86kg, Delta-E1).
zh: 项目：第一代专注效益应用 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 澳大利亚是英联邦中最遥远的成员国之一，位于南半球，几乎处于不列颠群岛的对跖点上。即使在喷气机时代，波音 707 从伦敦飞往悉尼也需要耗费漫长而疲惫的 34 小时。我们希望结束这片“南方大陆”的隔绝状态，在英国和澳大利亚之间进行电视直播。 <> <> 历史参考：国际通信卫星 II 系列卫星（86kg，Delta-E1）。

s:
Program: First Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Required

The ability to relay television, voice and facsimile transmissions across the Atlantic ocean has proven useful. However, we would like to be able to maintain continuous communications, instead of being constrained by the timing of satellite passes.

Historical example: Intelsat II series satellites (86kg, Delta-E1).
zh: 项目：第一代专注效益应用 <> 类型：必需 <> <> 事实证明，跨越大西洋中继电视、语音和传真传输的能力十分实用。然而，我们希望能维持持续不间断的通信，而不再受限于卫星过境的时间窗口。 <> <> 历史参考：国际通信卫星 II 系列卫星（86kg，Delta-E1）。

s:
Program: First Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Required

The ability to relay television, voice and facsimile transmissions across the Pacific ocean has proven useful. However, we would like to be able to maintain continuous communications, instead of being constrained by the timing of satellite passes.

Historical example: Intelsat II series satellites (86kg, Delta-E1).
zh: 项目：第一代专注效益应用 <> 类型：必需 <> <> 跨越太平洋中继电视、语音和传真传输的能力已被证明极具价值。然而，我们希望能维持不间断的通信，不再受限于卫星过境的时间窗口。 <> <> 历史参考：国际通信卫星 II 系列卫星（86kg，Delta-E1）。

s:
Program: First Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Required

The success of the link between Moscow and Vladivostok has shown the viability of a system of space communications. We must now turn this experiment into an operational network for the entire Union.

Historical example: Molniya 1+ series satellites (1,600kg, Molniya).
zh: 项目：第一代专注效益应用 <> 类型：必需 <> <> 莫斯科与符拉迪沃斯托克之间链路的成功，证明了天基通信系统的可行性。我们现在必须将这项试验转化为覆盖全联盟的实用业务网络。 <> <> 历史参考：闪电 1+ 系列卫星（1,600kg，Molniya）。

s:
Program: First Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

Satellite communications offers the ability to communicate with nearly any point on Earth, including the oceans. A ship equipped with a satellite terminal could be provided a reliable radio link to shore in nearly any condition, bypassing many of the difficulties involved in communicating with a vessel at sea. However, this will require a satellite terminal small enough to fit on a ship.

Historical example: Molniya 1+ series satellites (1,600kg, Molniya).
zh: 项目：第一代专注效益应用 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 卫星通信使我们能够与地球上的几乎任何地点进行联络，包括广袤的大洋。配备卫星终端的船只几乎可以在任何海况下与陆地建立可靠的无线电链路，绕过海上船只通信所面临的诸多难题。然而，这需要体积足够小、能够安装在船只上的卫星终端。 <> <> 历史参考：闪电 1+ 系列卫星（1,600kg，Molniya）。

s:
Program: First Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

Mongolia is a close ally to the Soviet Union, but much like the eastern territories of the Soviet Union, it is sparsely populated and dominated by rugged terrain. Satellite telecommunication offers a way to easily provide TV to these remote areas.

Historical example: Molniya 1+ series satellites (1,600kg, Molniya).
zh: 项目：第一代专注效益应用 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 蒙古是苏联的亲密盟友，但与苏联东部领土类似，其地广人稀且以崎岖地形为主。卫星电信为向这些偏远地区普及电视转播提供了一条便捷之路。 <> <> 历史参考：闪电 1+ 系列卫星（1,600kg，Molniya）。

s:
Program: First Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

We would like to create "Ground stations at sea", ships equipped with unified S-band antennas to relay data from manned and unmanned scientific spacecraft. However, a ship at sea cannot have a landline connection to mission control, and existing HF radio systems are unreliable and low quality. Instead, these ships have had a satellite communications terminal installed, allowing them to relay data back to mission control via communications satellites.

Historical example: Intelsat II series satellites (86kg, Delta-E1).
zh: 项目：第一代专注效益应用 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 我们希望建立“海上地面站”，即配备统一 S 波段天线的船只，以中继载人和无人热心科研航天器的数据。然而，海上的船只无法通过陆线连接至任务控制中心，而现有的高频无线电系统可靠性差且质量低下。因此，这些船只安装了卫星通信终端，使其能够通过通信卫星将数据回传给任务控制中心。 <> <> 历史参考：国际通信卫星 II 系列卫星（86kg，Delta-E1）。

s:
Program: First Generation Commercial Applications
Type: CAPSTONE

Your satellite communications network has allowed the world to be connected like never before, routing live TV broadcasts across continents and over oceans. To celebrate this achievement we would like to make a special TV broadcast involving live footage from dozens of countries across the world. You will need to provide a connection for about 3 months for shakedown testing before the broadcast.
Author's note: Our World was televised June 1967, although the Soviet Union pulled out 4 days before the broadcast in protest of the Six-Day War.

Historical example: Intelsat I (39kg, Delta-D), Intelsat IIF-2 and F-3 (86kg, Delta-E1), and ATS-1 (352 kg, Atlas-Agena D).
zh: 项目：第一代专注效益应用 <> 类型：收官任务 <> <> 你的卫星通信网络使整个世界前所未有地紧密相连，将电视直播信号送过大洲与重洋。为了庆祝这一成就，我们计划举办一场包含全球数十个国家现场画面的特别电视直播。在正式播出前，你需要提供约 3 个月的稳定连接以进行试运转测试。 <> 作者注：《我们的世界》于 1967 年 6 月播出，尽管苏联为了抗议六日战争在播出的 4 天前退出了该项目。 <> <> 历史参考：国际通信卫星 I（39kg，Delta-D）、国际通信卫星 <> 和 <>（86kg，Delta-E1）以及 <>（352 kg，Atlas-Agena D）。

s:
Program: Second Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Required

The first generation telecommunications satellite network has proven successful. However, demand is growing for satellite communication, and more countries want dedicated satellite links. Provide simultaneous links between North America, South America, and Europe.

Historical example: Intelsat III series satellites (151kg, Delta-M).
zh: 项目：第二代专注效益应用 <> 类型：必需 <> <> 第一代电信卫星网络已大获成功。然而，对卫星通信的需求正在日益增长，更多国家希望获得专用的卫星链路。请建立同时覆盖北美洲、南美洲与欧洲的通信链路。 <> <> 历史参考：国际通信卫星 III 系列卫星（151kg，Delta-M）。

s:
Program: Second Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Required

The first generation telecommunications satellite network has proven successful. However, demand is growing for satellite communication, and more countries want dedicated satellite links. Provide simultaneous links between Europe, Pakistan, Africa, Thailand and Australia.

Historical example: Intelsat III series satellites (151kg, Delta-M).
zh: 方案：第二代专注效益应用 <> 类型：必选 <> <> 第一代通信卫星网络已取得成功。然而，卫星通信需求持续增长，更多国家需要专用卫星链路。在欧洲、巴基斯坦、非洲、泰国与澳大利亚之间建立同步链路。 <> <> 历史参考：通信卫星三号（Intelsat III）系列卫星（151kg，Delta-M）。

s:
Program: Second Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Required

We have successfully deployed satellite communications across the Soviet Union. However, we would also like the ability to directly broadcast to other Soviet-aligned states. The Intersputnik International Organization of Space Communications has been formed to bring satellite communications technology to Soviet allies in Europe.

Historical example: Molniya 3 series satellites (1,740kg, Molniya-M).
zh: 方案：第二代专注效益应用 <> 类型：必选 <> <> 我们已成功在苏联境内完成卫星通信部署。然而，我们还希望能够直接向其他苏联阵营国家进行广播。国际宇宙通信组织（Intersputnik）已成立，旨在将卫星通信技术推广至欧洲的苏联盟友。 <> <> 历史参考：闪电3型（Molniya 3）系列卫星（1,740kg，Molniya-M）。

s:
Program: Second Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

Fast and reliable communication between the United States and the Soviet Union is critical to prevent diplomatic incidents and misunderstandings. We would like to use satellite communications to ensure a fast and uninterruptible teletype link between Moscow and Washington D.C.

Historical example: Molniya 2 series satellites (1,700kg, Molniya-M).
zh: 方案：第二代专注效益应用 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 美苏之间快速可靠的通信对于防止外交事件和误解至关重要。我们希望利用卫星通信确保莫斯科与华盛顿特区之间快速且不间断的电传通信链路。 <> <> 历史参考：闪电2型（Molniya 2）系列卫星（1,700kg，Molniya-M）。

s:
Program: Second Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Required

The first generation telecommunications satellite network has proven successful. However, we would like to improve bandwidth to utilize color television and improve quality. Further, we want be able to use satellite communications to relay information back to Moscow. Select stations across the Union have had transmission equipment installed. Improve the existing TV network while adding two-way voice capabilities.

Historical example: Molniya 2 series satellites (1,700kg, Molniya-M).
zh: 方案：第二代专注效益应用 <> 类型：必选 <> <> 第一代通信卫星网络已取得成功。然而，我们希望提高带宽以支持彩色电视并改善质量。此外，我们希望利用卫星通信将信息传回莫斯科。苏联各地的指定地面站已安装发射设备。改善现有电视网络并增加双向语音功能。 <> <> 历史参考：闪电2型（Molniya 2）系列卫星（1,700kg，Molniya-M）。

s:
Program: Second Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Required

The first generation telecommunications satellite network has proven successful. However, demand is growing for satellite communication, and more countries want dedicated satellite links. Provide simultaneous links between North America, Japan, the Republic of China, Hong Kong and Australia.

Historical example: Intelsat III series satellites (151kg, Delta-M).
zh: 方案：第二代专注效益应用 <> 类型：必选 <> <> 第一代通信卫星网络已取得成功。然而，卫星通信需求持续增长，更多国家需要专用卫星链路。在北美、日本、中华民国、香港与澳大利亚之间建立同步链路。 <> <> 历史参考：通信卫星三号（Intelsat III）系列卫星（151kg，Delta-M）。

s:
Program: Second Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional
