Historical example: Molniya 2 series satellites (1,700kg, Molniya-M).
zh: 方案：第二代专注效益应用 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 作为法苏彩色电视协议的一部分，我们正在考虑使用苏联电视网络的空间段在中继巴黎与莫斯科之间的电视信号。 <> <> 历史参考：闪电2型（Molniya 2）系列卫星（1,700kg，Molniya-M）。

s:
Program: Second Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

We would like to create "Ground stations at sea", ships equipped with high-gain antennas to relay data from manned and unmanned scientific spacecraft. However, a ship at sea cannot have a landline connection to mission control, and existing HF radio systems are unreliable and low quality. Instead, these ships have had a satellite communications terminal installed, allowing them to relay data back to mission control via communications satellites.

Historical example: Molniya 2 series satellites (1,700kg, Molniya-M).
zh: 方案：第二代专注效益应用 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 我们希望建立“海上地面站”，即装备高增益天线的船只，用于中继载人和无人热心科研航天器的数据。然而，海上的船只无法通过陆地线路连接任务控制中心，且现有的高频无线电系统可靠性低、质量差。为此，这些船只已安装卫星通信终端，使其能够通过通信卫星将数据传回任务控制中心。 <> <> 历史参考：闪电2型（Molniya 2）系列卫星（1,700kg，Molniya-M）。

s:
Program: Second Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

We would like to be able to relay live TV footage from manned spacecraft to mission control via tracking ships. Provide improved connections to our tracking ships.
zh: 方案：第二代专注效益应用 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 我们希望能够通过测量船将载人航天器的实时电视画面中继至任务控制中心。改善与我们测量船的通信连接。

s:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Required

The second generation telecommunications satellite network has proven successful. However, demand is growing for satellite communication, and more countries want dedicated satellite links. Provide simultaneous links between North America, South America, and Europe.

Historical example: Intelsat IV series satellites (730kg, Atlas-Centaur D).
zh: 方案：第三代专注效益应用 <> 类型：必选 <> <> 第二代通信卫星网络已取得成功。然而，卫星通信需求持续增长，更多国家需要专用卫星链路。在北美、南美与欧洲之间建立同步链路。 <> <> 历史参考：通信卫星四号（Intelsat IV）系列卫星（730kg，Atlas-Centaur D）。

s:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

The Canadian government has called for the establishment of a commercial, domestic satellite system to provide telecommunications services throughout the nearly 10 million square kilometers (4 million square miles) of Canada extending across six time zones. As the first stage of this system, satellite links should be established across the populated areas in the southern portion of Canada. This nearly 5,000 kilometer (3,000 mile) strip of land along the US-Canada border contains the majority of the Canadian population, and a satellite telecommunications should allow TV and voice circuits to be quickly routed from one side of the country to the other.

Historical example: Anik A series satellites (544kg, Delta 1914).
zh: 方案：第三代专注效益应用 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 加拿大政府呼吁建立一个专注效益的国内卫星系统，为横跨六个时区、近1000万平方公里（400万平方英里）的加拿大全境提供电信服务。作为该系统的第一阶段，应在加拿大南部人口稠密地区建立卫星链路。沿美加边界近5,000公里（3,000英里）的狭长地带聚集了加拿大的大部分人口，卫星电信应能够让电视与语音线路在全国东西两端之间快速接通。 <> <> 历史参考：加拿大阿尼克A（Anik A）系列卫星（544kg，Delta 1914）。

s:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

The Canadian government has called for the establishment of a commercial, domestic satellite system to provide telecommunications services throughout the nearly 10 million square kilometers (4 million square miles) of Canada extending across six time zones. Hundreds of small towns, hamlets and clusters of isolated communities in northern areas have very limited communications. Satellite service offers a way for TV and radio programs to be distrubuted to remote communities in the Canadian north.

Historical example: Anik A series satellites (544kg, Delta 1914).
zh: 方案：第三代专注效益应用 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 加拿大政府呼吁建立一个专注效益的国内卫星系统，为横跨六个时区、近1000万平方公里（400万平方英里）的加拿大全境提供电信服务。北部数百个小镇、村落和孤立的定居点通信手段极其有限。卫星服务为向加拿大北部的偏远社区分发电视和广播节目提供了途径。 <> <> 历史参考：加拿大阿尼克A（Anik A）系列卫星（544kg，Delta 1914）。

s:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

Several corporations have expressed interest in establishing a domestic satellite communications network for voice, fax and data transmissions. A series of satellite earth stations distributed across the country will allow for fast and secure transmission of data.

Historical example: Western Union Westar series satellites (574kg, Delta 2914), RCA Satcom series satellites (868kg, Delta 3914), AT&T Comstar series satellites (1,516 kg, Atlas-Centaur D).
zh: 项目：第三代专注效益应用 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 数家企业表示有兴趣建立国内卫星通信网络，用于语音、传真和数据传输。分布在全国各地的一系列卫星地面站将实现快速安全的数据传输。 <> <> 历史参考：西联通信 Westar 系列卫星（574kg，Delta 2914）、RCA Satcom 系列卫星（868kg，Delta 3914）、AT&T Comstar 系列卫星（1,516kg，Atlas-Centaur D）。

s:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

Although satellite communications have brought state TV to millions across the vast territories of the Soviet Union, large swathes of territory remain without coverage. Even with recent advances in telecommunications technology, the satellite earth stations required to track, recieve and demodulate signals from out existing satellite network are too expensive and complex to install in every village, hamlet and logging camp across the vast territories of Siberia. Instead, we would like to transmit TV signals directly from orbit, where they can be recieved with standard TV and radio equipment, bringing accessible television to the entire Union.

Historical example: Ekran series satellites (1,970kg, Proton-K Blok-DM).
zh: 项目：第三代专注效益应用 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 尽管卫星通信已将国家电视信号带给全苏联广袤土地上的千百万人，但仍有大片区域未被覆盖。即使近年来电信技术有所突破，要在西伯利亚辽阔疆域上的每个村庄、聚落和伐木营地都安装用于跟踪、接收和解调现有卫星网络信号的卫星地面站，成本过高且过于复杂。因此，我们希望直接从轨道广播电视信号，只需标准的电视和无线电设备即可接收，让电视信号覆盖整个苏联。 <> <> 历史参考：Ekran（荧屏）系列卫星（1,970kg，Proton-K Blok-DM）。

s:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

Many TV studios have expressed interest in using leased domestic satellite communications to distribute TV programs. This will allow TV programs to be produced at a single central studio and be instantly transmitted to dozens of local studios across the country. In order to reduce costs, however, local TV studios will be equipped with very basic 4.5-meter satellite earth stations.

Historical example: Western Union Westar series satellites (574kg, Delta 2914), RCA Satcom series satellites (868kg, Delta 3914), AT&T Comstar series satellites (1,516 kg, Atlas-Centaur D).
zh: 项目：第三代专注效益应用 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 许多电视台表示有兴趣租赁国内卫星通信信道来分发电视节目。这将允许电视节目在中央演播室制作完成后，即时分发至全国各地的数十家地方演播室。然而，为了降低成本，地方演播室将仅配备基础的 4.5 米卫星地面站。 <> <> 历史参考：西联通信 Westar 系列卫星（574kg，Delta 2914）、RCA Satcom 系列卫星（868kg，Delta 3914）、AT&T Comstar 系列卫星（1,516kg，Atlas-Centaur D）。

s:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

The C-band frequencies are heavily utilized for both satellite and terrestrial communications. There are growing concerns that there will not be enough bandwidth to accommodate future growth in telecommunications demand. Additionally, C-band satellite earth stations require large and expensive antennas to recieve signals from satellites in orbit. However, recent advances in technology have allowed for the creation of lightweight and efficient millimeter-wave transcievers, operating in what is now known as Ku-band.
Ku-band offers much wider frequency allocations than C-band, and allows for the use of much smaller antennas. This has allowed for the creation of a portable satellite earth station that is able to fit on a single truck. We would like to test the capabilities of this portable station to recieve and transmit TV from remote communities in the Canada.

Historical example: CTS "Hermes" (680kg, Delta 2914).
zh: 项目：第三代专注效益应用 <> 类型：可选 <> <> C 频段频率已被卫星和地面通信大量占用。人们日益担忧现有带宽无法满足未来的电信增长需求。此外，C 频段卫星地面站需要庞大且昂贵的天线来接收轨卫星信号。不过，最新技术进展已实现了轻型高效毫米波收发机，运行在如今被称为 Ku 频段的频域。 <> Ku 频段相比 C 频段拥有更宽阔的可用频带，并允许使用尺寸小得多的天线。这使得单辆卡车即可容纳的便携式卫星地面站成为可能。我们希望测试这种便携式站点在加拿大偏远社区收发电视信号的能力。 <> <> 历史参考：CTS "Hermes"（680kg，Delta 2914）。

s:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Required

The second generation telecommunications satellite network has proven successful. However, demand is growing for satellite communication, and more countries want dedicated satellite links. Provide simultaneous links between Europe, Pakistan, Africa, Thailand and Australia.

Historical example: Intelsat IV series satellites (730kg, Atlas-Centaur D).
zh: 项目：第三代专注效益应用 <> 类型：必需 <> <> 第二代电信卫星网络已取得成功。然而，卫星通信需求正在激增，更多国家希望获得专属卫星链路。请在欧洲、巴基斯坦、非洲、泰国和澳大利亚之间建立同步通信链路。 <> <> 历史参考：Intelsat IV 系列卫星（730kg，Atlas-Centaur D）。

s:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Required

We have successfully deployed satellite communications across the Union. However, we would also like the ability to directly broadcast to other Soviet-aligned states. The Intersputnik International Organization of Space Communications would like to bring satellite communications technology to Soviet allies in Central and Southeast Asia.

Historical example: Raduga/Gran series satellites (2,000kg, Proton-K Blok-DM).
zh: 项目：第三代专注效益应用 <> 类型：必需 <> <> 我们已成功在全苏联部署卫星通信。然而，我们还希望能够直接向其他亲苏阵营国家广播。国际卫星通信组织（Intersputnik）希望将卫星通信技术拓展至中亚和东南亚的苏联盟友。 <> <> 历史参考：Raduga/Gran（彩虹/格兰）系列卫星（2,000kg，Proton-K Blok-DM）。

s:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Required

Satellites have proven to be a reliable way to communicate with our comrades in the Western Hemisphere. We would like to increase the capacity of the link between Moscow and Cuba. Additionally, Nicuragua has joined the Intersputnik International Organization of Space Communications and needs satellite service as well.

Historical example: Molniya 3 series satellites (1,740kg, Molniya-M).
zh: 项目：第三代专注效益应用 <> 类型：必需 <> <> 事实证明，卫星是与我们在西半球的同志通信的可靠方式。我们希望扩大莫斯科与古巴之间通信链路的容量。此外，尼加拉瓜已加入国际卫星通信组织，同样需要卫星通信服务。 <> <> 历史参考：Molniya 3 系列卫星（1,740kg，Molniya-M）。

s:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

Maritime mobile communications on the high seas in the HF radio band suffer from the inherent limitations of signal propagation. Continuous, real-time, highly reliable communication to ships on the high seas is not available today, with an average message taking 12 hours to reach a ship at sea. With the power of satellite communications, we would like to provide reliable telephone and teletype service to the high seas.

Historical example: Marisat series satellites (362kg, Delta 2914).
zh: 项目：第三代专注效益应用 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 远海上的高频（HF）无线电移动通信受制于信号传播特性的固有缺陷。目前仍无法为远海船舶提供持续、实时、高可靠性的通信，一封电报平均需要 12 小时才能送达海上船只。借助卫星通信的力量，我们希望能为远海区域提供可靠的电话和电传打字机服务。 <> <> 历史参考：Marisat 系列卫星（362kg，Delta 2914）。

s:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Required

The second generation telecommunications satellite network has proven successful. However, with just a single central television feed, it is difficult to provide timely TV programming across 11 time zones. Further, our existing satellite earth stations are expensive to construct and maintain, and in order to continue spreading TV coverage to remote communities we would like to reduce costs. Provide five dedicated regional connections, and support connections to smaller satellite earth stations.

Historical example: Gorizont series satellites (2,300kg, Proton-K Blok-DM).
zh: 计划：第三代专注效益应用 <> 类型：必选 <> <> 第二代通信卫星网络已证明非常成功。然而，仅靠单一的中央电视信号源，很难跨越11个时区及时提供电视节目。此外，我们现有的卫星地面站建造成本与维护费用高昂，为了继续将电视信号覆盖扩大到偏远社区，我们需要降低成本。请提供5个专用区域连接，并支持连接到较小的卫星地面站。 <> <> 历史参考：地平线（Gorizont）系列卫星（2,300 kg，质子-K/D组级）。

s:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Required

The second generation telecommunications satellite network has proven successful. However, demand is growing for satellite communication, and more countries want dedicated satellite links. Provide simultaneous links between North America, Taiwan, Japan, Taiwan, and Australia.

Historical example: Intelsat IV series satellites (730kg, Atlas-Centaur D).
zh: 计划：第三代专注效益应用 <> 类型：必选 <> <> 第二代通信卫星网络已证明非常成功。然而，对卫星通信的需求正在增长，更多国家希望获得专用卫星链路。请建立北美、台湾、日本与澳大利亚之间的同步链路。 <> <> 历史参考：国际通信卫星IV系列（Intelsat IV）（730 kg，宇宙神-半人马座D）。

s:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

As part of a Franco-Soviet agreement on colour television, we are considering using the space segement of the Soviet television network to relay television between Paris and Moscow.

Historical example: Molniya 2 series satellites (1,700kg, Molniya-M).
zh: 计划：第三代专注效益应用 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 作为法苏彩色电视协议的一部分，我们正在考虑利用苏联电视网络空间段在巴黎和莫斯科之间转播电视节目。 <> <> 历史参考：闪电2型（Molniya 2）系列卫星（1,700 kg，闪电-M）。

s:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

We would like to create "Ground stations at sea", ships equipped with high-gain antennas to relay data from manned and unmanned scientific spacecraft. However, a ship at sea cannot have a landline connection to mission control, and existing HF radio systems are unreliable and low quality. Instead, these ships have had a satellite communications terminal installed, allowing them to relay data back to mission control via communications satellites.

Historical example: Raduga/Gran series satellites (2,000kg, Proton-K Blok-DM).
zh: 计划：第三代专注效益应用 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 我们希望建立“海上地面站”，即配备高增益天线的测控船，用于中继载人和无人科学航天器的数据。然而，海上的船只无法通过陆线与任务控制中心连接，而现有的高频无线电系统可靠性差且质量低下。因此，这些船只安装了卫星通信终端，使其能够通过通信卫星将数据回传给任务控制中心。 <> <> 历史参考：虹（Raduga）/面（Gran）系列卫星（2,000 kg，质子-K/D组级）。

s:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

Hawaii, Alaska and Puerto Rico are isolated from the continental United States by hundreds of miles of ocean or rugged terrain, rendering communications between them and the continental United States expensive and difficult using terrestrial methods. Several corporations have expressed interest in using the domestic US satellite network to establish reliable, high data-rate communications with their remote offices located in these areas. However, some modifications may be required to ensure a stable connection can be established with ground stations far from the continental US.

Historical example: Western Union Westar series satellites (574kg, Delta 2914), RCA Satcom series satellites (868kg, Delta 3914), AT&T Comstar series satellites (1,516 kg, Atlas-Centaur D).
zh: 计划：第三代专注效益应用 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 夏威夷、阿拉斯加和波多黎各与美国本土相隔数百英里的海洋或崎岖地形，利用地面手段在它们与本土之间建立通信既昂贵又困难。几家公司表示有兴趣利用美国国内卫星网络与位于这些地区的偏远办事处建立可靠的高速率数据通信。不过，可能需要进行一些改造，以确保能与远离美国本土的地面站建立稳定连接。 <> <> 历史参考：西联西星（Westar）系列卫星（574 kg，德尔塔2914）、RCA Satcom系列卫星（868 kg，德尔塔3914）、AT&T Comstar系列卫星（1,516 kg，宇宙神-半人马座D）。

s:
Program: Third Generation Commercial Applications
Type: Optional

Soviet vessels at on the high seas currently must undergo long periods of isolation from communications with fleet headquarters. Shore-based HF band is limited and unreliable, and in many areas Soviet shipping must rely on international communication networks, which the Soviet government considers an unacceptable security risk. With the power of satellite communications, we would like to provide reliable telephone and teletype service to the high seas.

Historical example: Gorizont series satellites (2,300kg, Proton-K Blok-DM).
zh: 计划：第三代专注效益应用 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 目前公海上的苏联船只往往与舰队司令部长期处于通信失联状态。岸基高频频段通信受限且不可靠，在许多区域，苏联船运不得不依赖国际通信网络，苏联政府认为这是不可接受的安全隐患。借助卫星通信的力量，我们希望为公海提供可靠的电话和电传服务。 <> <> 历史参考：地平线（Gorizont）系列卫星（2,300 kg，质子-K/D组级）。

s:
Program: Small Bodies Flyby
Type: Required

Create a probe and send it to flyby Ceres within 20,000 km. Make sure to transmit science from the flyby.
zh: 计划：小天体飞掠 <> 类型：必选 <> <> 建造一颗探测器并将其送往谷神星，在20,000 km以内完成飞掠。务必在飞掠期间传回科学数据。

s:
Program: Small Bodies Flyby
Type: Required

Create a probe and send it to flyby Mercury within 20,000 km. Make sure to transmit science from the flyby.
zh: 计划：小天体飞掠 <> 类型：必选 <> <> 建造一颗探测器并将其送往水星，在20,000 km以内完成飞掠。务必在飞掠期间传回科学数据。

s:
Program: Small Bodies Flyby
Type: Required

Create a probe and send it to flyby Vesta within 20,000 km. Make sure to transmit science from the flyby.
zh: 计划：小天体飞掠 <> 类型：必选 <> <> 建造一颗探测器并将其送往灶神星，在20,000 km以内完成飞掠。务必在飞掠期间传回科学数据。

s:
Program: Early Rocket Development
Type: Optional

Design, build, and launch a rocket with @/missionPayload.Print() units of Sounding Rocket Payload to a downrange distance of @/missionDistance.Print() km. @RP0:soundingTankAdvice Your rocket must be suborbital (over 140 km) for the contract to be completed. @RP0:avionics50sAdvice Perfecting this is part of Launch Vehicle development to utilize a gravity turn and tune your ascent profile and angle of attack. The current distance that your rocket has traveled can be seen in the contract parameters screen. It will update in real time. A better option is to use the MechJeb information called Downrange Distance. It can be added to any window using the Custom Window Editor and is found in the Flight Recorder section.

@RP0:f3BadAdvice

Once more than half of the expected days have been elapsed, the reward of this contract will slowly increase over time, but will be reset to 0 after each completion.&br;Current reward is at @rewardFactorPercent % of its nominal value. Elapsed/Expected Days: @elapsedDays / @RP0:expectedDays_DistanceSounding
zh: 计划：早期火箭研发 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 设计、建造并发射一枚携带 @/missionPayload.Print() 单位探空火箭有效载荷的火箭，射程达到 @/missionDistance.Print() km。@RP0:soundingTankAdvice 火箭必须处于亚轨道（高度超过 140 km）方可完成合同。@RP0:avionics50sAdvice 熟练掌握这一点是运载火箭研发的一部分，有助于运用重力转向并微调上升剖面和迎角。火箭当前飞过的距离可以在合同参数界面中查看，该数值将实时更新。更好的选择是使用 <> 中名为“Downrange Distance”（射程）的信息项。可以通过自定义窗口编辑器将其添加到任何窗口中，该项位于飞行记录器（Flight Recorder）部分。 <> <> @RP0:f3BadAdvice <> <> 超过预期天数的一半后，此合同的奖励会随时间缓慢增加，但每次完成后都将重置为0。&br;当前奖励为标称值的 @<> %。已用/预期天数：@<> / @RP0:expectedDays_DistanceSounding

s:
Program: Early Rocket Development
Type: CAPSTONE

Design, build, and launch a rocket that will travel 5000 km or more over ground while carrying @/missionPayload.Print() units of Sounding Payload. This challenge will require rather more delta-v than the 3000 km attempt. Your rocket must be suborbital (over 140 km) for the contract to be completed. @RP0:avionics50sAdvice Perfecting this is part of launch vehicle development to tune your ascent profile and develop high-altitude staging methods. The current distance that your rocket has traveled can be seen in the contract parameters in the Contracts App display for this contract. It will update in real time. &br;&br;@RP0:f3BadAdvice
zh: 计划：早期火箭开发 <> 类型：核心里程碑 <> <> 设计、建造并发射一枚火箭，搭载 @/missionPayload.Print() 单位的探测载荷，并在地面上飞行 5000 km 或更远。这项挑战所需要的 Δv 远多于 3000 km 的尝试。火箭必须处于亚轨道（高度超过 140 km）方可完成合同。@RP0:avionics50sAdvice完善该过程是运载火箭开发的一部分，有助于优化你的上升轨迹并开发高空分级技术。当前火箭已飞行的距离可在合同应用程序界面中的该合同参数内查看。它将实时更新。&br;&br;@RP0:f3BadAdvice

s:
Program: Early Rocket Development
Type: Required

The challenge of orbit is not merely to go high, which has been shown by breaching the Karman line, but to achieve great horizontal speed. Design, build, and launch a rocket that will travel 3000 km or more over ground. Such a rocket is typically two stages (guided lower stage coupled with an unguided upper stage), has 6 km/s or more of delta-v, and is using upgraded engines, tanks, and/or avionics. Do this, and you will be halfway to orbit! Your rocket must be suborbital (over 140 km) for the contract to be completed. @RP0:avionics50sAdvice Perfecting this is part of launch vehicle development to tune your ascent profile and develop high-altitude staging methods. The current distance that your rocket has traveled can be seen in the contract parameters in the Contracts App display for this contract. It will update in real time. &br;&br;@RP0:f3BadAdvice
zh: 计划：早期火箭开发 <> 类型：必需 <> <> 入轨的挑战不仅在于飞得高（冲破卡门线已证明了这一点），更在于获得极高的水平速度。设计、建造并发射一枚火箭，在地面上飞行 3000 km 或更远。此类火箭通常采用两级构型（受控下级配合无控上级），拥有 6 km/s 或更多的 Δv，并采用升级后的发动机、储箱和/或航电系统。完成此目标，你就已经完成入轨的一半了！火箭必须处于亚轨道（高度超过 140 km）方可完成合同。@RP0:avionics50sAdvice完善该过程是运载火箭开发的一部分，有助于优化你的上升轨迹并开发高空分级技术。当前火箭已飞行的距离可在合同应用程序界面中的该合同参数内查看。它将实时更新。&br;&br;@RP0:f3BadAdvice

s:
Program: Any starting program
Type: Optional

Congratulations on starting a new space program! For your first mission, you should launch your first vessel. Just design and build a vessel, roll it out to the pad (or the runway if it's an airplane), throttle up with "Z" and stage to take off! (And note all the records to break in the 'Active Contracts' tab. They update, so keep checking.) If you haven't already, look at the tutorial on the GitHub wiki for advice on this and other missions.
zh: 计划：任意初始计划 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 祝贺你启动了全新的航天计划！作为你的首个任务，你应该发射你的第一艘载具。只需设计并建造一艘载具，将其转运至发射台（如果是飞机则转运至跑道），用“Z”键推满节流阀，然后分级起飞！（请注意“活动合同”标签页中待打破的各项记录。它们会实时更新，记得常去查看。）如果你尚未查阅，可以查看 <> wiki 上的教程，获取有关此任务及其他任务的建议。

s:
Program: Early Rocket Development or Suborbital Research
Type: Required

The Karman line is the line at which the speed necessary to maintain altitude via lift is the same as the speed required for orbit. It's the traditional dividing line between the atmosphere and space (despite there being nonzero pressure well above it; Earth's atmosphere extends quite far indeed). We want you to send something above it!
zh: 计划：早期火箭开发或亚轨道研究 <> 类型：必需 <> <> 卡门线是指依靠空气动力升力维持飞行高度所需的速度与轨道速度相等的边界高度。它历来被视为大气层与太空的分界线（尽管在此高度之上仍存在非零的大气压力；地球大气层确实延伸得很远）。我们希望你将物体发射到该线之上！

s:
Program: Suborbital Research
Type: Optional

Design, build, and launch a sounding rocket with @/totalPayload.Print() units of payload to @/missionAltitude.Print() km. @RP0:soundingTankAdvice

Once more than half of the expected days have been elapsed, the reward of this contract will slowly increase over time, but will be reset to 0 after each completion.&br;Current reward is at @rewardFactorPercent % of its nominal value. Elapsed/Expected Days: @elapsedDays / @RP0:expectedDays_AltitudeSounding
zh: 计划：亚轨道研究 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 设计、建造并发射一枚探空火箭，将 @/totalPayload.Print() 单位的载荷运送至 @/missionAltitude.Print() km。@RP0:soundingTankAdvice <> <> 当超过预期天数的一半后，此合同的奖励将随时间缓慢增加，但在每次完成后将重置为 0。&br;当前奖励为其名义价值的 @<> %。已用/预期天数：@<> / @RP0:expectedDays_AltitudeSounding

s:
Program: Suborbital Research
Type: CAPSTONE

By training and launching a larger mammal in a capsule with recording instruments, we can test how astronauts might perform tasks under similar conditions. For instance, whether they'll be able to focus under the heavy G-loads, vibrations, and noise encountered during the launch into and recovery from orbit.
Carry an advanced biological capsule and @payload units of monitoring instrumentation on a suborbital trajectory, then recover the experiment.

After this contract has been completed, the 'Advanced Biological Suborbital Experiment' contract will become available.
zh: 计划：亚轨道研究 <> 类型：核心里程碑 <> <> 通过训练并使用搭载记录仪器的乘员舱发射大型哺乳动物，我们可以测试宇航员在类似条件下的任务执行能力。例如，测试他们是否能在发射入轨及从轨道再入回收期间承受重过载、剧烈振动和高噪声并保持专注。<> 携带一个高级生物实验舱和 @payload 单位的监测仪器进入亚轨道轨迹，随后回收该实验。<> <> 完成此合同后，将解锁“高级生物亚轨道实验”合同。

Launching small mammals will prepare us for the monumental task of putting an astronaut into space. Carry a small biological capsule and @payload units of monitoring instrumentation above the Karman line, then recover the experiment. @RP0:soundingTankAdvice

After this contract has been completed, the 'Low Space Biological Experimentation' contract will become available.
zh: 计划：亚轨道研究 <> 类型：必需 <> <> 发射小型哺乳动物将为我们把宇航员送入太空这一艰巨任务做好准备。携带一个小型生物实验舱和 @payload 单位的监测仪器飞跃卡门线，随后回收该实验。@RP0:soundingTankAdvice <> <> 完成此合同后，将解锁“低太空生物实验”合同。

s:
Program: Suborbital Research
Type: Required

V-2s launched by the U.S. from the White Sands Proving Grounds returned the first images of Earth from space. We need you to test emerging high-altitude photography technology. Design, build, and launch a rocket with a payload of bulky testing and stabilization equipment that will recover film imagery from just above the edge of space. @RP0:avionics50sAdvice

After this contract has been completed, 'Low Space Film Return' contract will become available.
zh: 项目：亚轨道研究 <> 类型：必要 <> <> 美国从白沙试验场（White Sands Proving Grounds）发射的 <> 传回了人类首批从太空拍摄的地球图像。我们需要你测试新兴的高空摄影技术。设计、建造并发射一枚运载笨重测试与增稳设备载荷的火箭，从太空边缘上方回收胶卷图像。@RP0:avionics50sAdvice <> <> 完成此合同后，将解锁“低轨道胶卷回收”合同。

s:
Program: Early Rocket Development
Type: Required

As early as 1947 the U.S. was launching fruit flies into space on suborbital trajectories and recovering them, but it wasn't until 1951 that a monkey named Yorick and eleven mice were successfully recovered from an Aerobee flight. The Soviets preferred dogs and returned many from suborbital flights, the first two being Dezik and Tsygan in 1951 on top of an R-1. Although it is not a requirement to launch a biological capsule for this mission, it is a perfect opportunity to do so. Send a rocket out of the atmosphere (140 km) and return at least some of the craft back to Earth, intact, for study.
zh: 项目：早期火箭研制 <> 类型：必要 <> <> 早在1947年，美国就已通过亚轨道弹道将果蝇送入太空并成功回收，但直到1951年，名为Yorick的猴子和11只小鼠才在一架Aerobee火箭的飞行中被成功回收。苏联人更倾向于使用犬类，并从亚轨道飞行中多次回收它们，最早的两只是1951年搭乘 <> 的德齐克（Dezik）和吉甘（Tsygan）。虽然本次任务不强制要求发射生物舱，但这无疑是一次绝佳的机会。发射一枚火箭穿出大气层（140 km），并使航天器的至少一部分完好无损地返回地球以供研究。

s:
Program: Crewed Spaceplane Development
Type: Capstone

A use for space shuttles is orbital servicing, docking to an existing satellite and performing repairs, like the Space Shuttle did to fix the Hubble Space Telescope. Docking is also necessary to bring crew to space stations. Perform the first docking between a spaceplane and another spacecraft.&br;&br;NOTE: You can not select this contract and 'First Docking' at the same time. If you select the other contract while this is active, this will automatically fail.&br;&br;NOTE: This contract requires a horizontal landing on the space center runway. If playing from the Cape, the Space Shuttle runway provided by the RSS-CanaveralHD mod is also a valid landing target.
zh: 项目：载人空天飞机研制 <> 类型：顶点 <> <> 航天飞机的一项重要用途是在轨维护——与现有卫星对接并执行维修任务，就像航天飞机维护哈勃空间望远镜那样。对接也是运送乘员前往空间站的必要手段。执行一次空天飞机与另一艘航天器之间的首次对接。&br;&br;注意：你不能同时接取此合同与“首次对接”合同。若在激活此合同时接取另一合同，此合同将自动失败。&br;&br;注意：此合同要求在航天中心跑道上水平着陆。如果在卡纳维拉尔角发射，RSS-<> 模组提供的航天飞机跑道同样为有效着陆目标。

s:
Program: Crewed Spaceplane Development
Type: Required

Putting a human into orbit around the Earth is a major milestone in spaceplane development. Such a spaceplane needs to be capable of both extended operation in space, like traditional spacecraft, but also atmospheric flight at speeds up to 7 km/s. The task requires a reliable launch system and many hours of research and engineering to pull off. Single-person orbital spaceplanes were not historically built, but a number of concepts were studied and X-20 Dyna-Soar (1966 planned, Titan III) even began construction, paving the way for later more capable vehicles.&br;&br;NOTE: Unlike capsule missions, this contract requires a horizontal landing on the space center runway. If playing from the Cape, the Space Shuttle runway provided by the RSS-CanaveralHD mod is also a valid landing target.&br;&br;HINT: Launching slightly northwards (if in the Northern Hemisphere) instead of due East will put the launch site back under your track after a small number of orbits, reducing crossrange requirements.&br;&br;NOTE: Completing this contract will cause the 'Suborbital Spaceplane (Crewed)' contracts to become unavailable. If it is accepted then it will automatically fail.
zh: 项目：载人空天飞机研制 <> 类型：必要 <> <> 将人类送入环绕地球的轨道是空天飞机研制过程中的重大里程碑。此类空天飞机不仅需要像传统航天器一样具备长时间在太空运行的能力，还必须能够在大气层内以高达 7 km/s 的速度飞行。这项任务需要可靠的发射系统，以及数以千计小时的研究与工程设计才能实现。历史上并未建造过单人轨道空天飞机，但曾研究过多种概念设计，<> Dyna-Soar（原计划1966年，大力神III）甚至已动工建造，为后续性能更强大的飞行器奠定了基础。&br;&br;注意：与返回舱任务不同，此合同要求在航天中心跑道上水平着陆。如果在卡纳维拉尔角发射，RSS-<> 模组提供的航天飞机跑道同样为有效着陆目标。&br;&br;提示：向稍偏北方向发射（若位于北半球）而非正东方向，可以使发射场在少数几圈轨道后重新位于你的地面轨迹下方，从而降低横向航程需求。&br;&br;注意：完成此合同将导致“亚轨道空天飞机（载人）”系列合同不可用。若已接取该合同，它将自动失败。

s:
Program: Crewed Spaceplane Development
Type: Optional

Single-person orbital spaceplanes were not historically built, but a number of concepts were studied and X-20 Dyna-Soar (1966 planned, Titan III) even began construction, paving the way for later more capable vehicles. Design, build, and launch a spaceplane that remains for @/NoOfOrbits orbits and return the crew safely back to Earth.&br;&br;NOTE: You can not select this contract and the Orbital Flight (One Crew) or Orbital Spaceplane with Maneuvers and 2+ Crew contract. If you select the other contract while this is active, this will automatically fail.&br;&br;NOTE: This contract requires a horizontal landing on the space center runway. If playing from the Cape, the Space Shuttle runway provided by the RSS-CanaveralHD mod is also a valid landing target. Make sure to plan your orbit to allow reentry in the right place.&br;&br;Number of Contracts Completed: @index / unlimited
zh: 项目：载人空天飞机研制 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 历史上并未建造过单人轨道空天飞机，但曾研究过多种概念设计，<> Dyna-Soar（原计划1966年，大力神III）甚至已动工建造，为后续性能更强大的飞行器奠定了基础。设计、建造并试射一架空天飞机，在轨飞行 @/NoOfOrbits 圈并将乘员安全带回地球。&br;&br;注意：你不能同时接取此合同与“轨道飞行（单人）”或“带机动与2人以上乘员的轨道空天飞机”合同。若在激活此合同时接取另一合同，此合同将自动失败。&br;&br;注意：此合同要求在航天中心跑道上水平着陆。如果在卡纳维拉尔角发射，RSS-<> 模组提供的航天飞机跑道同样为有效着陆目标。务必合理规划轨道以确保在正确地点再入。&br;&br;已完成合同数：@index / 无限制

s:
Program: Crewed Spaceplane Development
Type: Optional

Putting two people into space in the same spaceplane opens the door to a range of new activities and opportunities. Such a spacecraft must remain in orbit with its crew @/DurationText days and return them safely to Earth.&br;&br;NOTE: You can not select this contract and 'Orbital Flight with Maneuvers and 2+ Crew' at the same time. If you select the other contract while this is active, this will automatically fail.&br;&br;NOTE: This contract requires a horizontal landing on the space center runway. If playing from the Cape, the Space Shuttle runway provided by the RSS-CanaveralHD mod is also a valid landing target.&br;&br;Number of Contracts Completed: @index / unlimited
zh: 项目：载人空天飞机研制 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 将两名乘员搭载在同一架空天飞机中送入太空，开启了一系列新任务和机遇的大门。此类航天器必须搭载其乘员在轨驻留 @/DurationText 天并将他们安全带回地球。&br;&br;注意：你不能同时接取此合同与“带机动与2人以上乘员的轨道飞行”合同。若在激活此合同时接取另一合同，此合同将自动失败。&br;&br;注意：此合同要求在航天中心跑道上水平着陆。如果在卡纳维拉尔角发射，RSS-<> 模组提供的航天飞机跑道同样为有效着陆目标。&br;&br;已完成合同数：@index / 无限制

s:
Program: Crewed Spaceplane Development
Type: Optional

The goal and realization of putting three (or more) crew on orbit at the same time begins the era of the space shuttle and ready access to LEO. These craft should be able to support at least three crew and prove that they can stay in orbit for @/DurationText days before returning to a runway landing. The U.S. Space Shuttle (1981, STS) performed this mission, while the Soviet Буран (1988, Energia) was designed to do the same but made only one, unmanned, orbital flight before cancellation.&br;&br;NOTE: You can not select this contract and 'Orbital Flight with at Least Three Crew' at the same time. If you select the other contract while this is active, this will automatically fail.&br;&br;NOTE: This contract requires a horizontal landing on the space center runway. If playing from the Cape, the Space Shuttle runway provided by the RSS-CanaveralHD mod is also a valid landing target.&br;&br;Number of Contracts Completed: @index / unlimited
zh: 方案：载人空天飞机研发 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 同时将三名（或更多）乘员送入轨道的设想与实现，开启了航天飞机以及便捷往返近地轨道（LEO）的时代。航天器应能支持至少三名乘员，并证明其能在轨驻留 @/DurationText 天，然后返回跑道着陆。美国航天飞机（1981年，STS）执行过此类任务，而苏联暴风雪号（Буран，1988年，能源号）虽设计具有同样能力，但在取消前仅执行过一次无人轨道飞行。&br;&br;注意：不可同时接取此合同与“至少三名乘员的轨道飞行”。若在此合同有效时接取另一合同，本合同将自动判定失败。&br;&br;注意：此合同要求在航天中心跑道水平着陆。若在卡纳维拉尔角游玩，RSS-<> 模组提供的航天飞机跑道也是有效着陆目标。&br;&br;已完成合同数：@index / 无限制

s:
Program: Crewed Spaceplane Development
Type: Required

One mission planned for reconnaissance spaceplanes such as Dyna-Soar II was to rendezvous with and investigate satellites on orbit. Using your own knowledge of orbital mechanics, bring two craft to within 100 meters of each other while in orbit around Earth. At least one of the spacecraft must be a newly launched spaceplane which subsequently lands on the runway.&br;&br;NOTE: You can not select this contract and 'First Rendezvous' at the same time. If you select the other contract while this is active, this will automatically fail.&br;&br;NOTE: This contract requires a horizontal landing on the space center runway. If playing from the Cape, the Space Shuttle runway provided by the RSS-CanaveralHD mod is also a valid landing target.
zh: 方案：载人空天飞机研发 <> 类型：必要 <> <> 恐龙 II（Dyna-Soar II）等侦察空天飞机规划的一项任务，是与在轨卫星交会并进行调查。运用你的轨道力学知识，让两个航天器在环绕地球轨道上交会至相距 100 米以内。其中至少一艘航天器必须是新发射的空天飞机，且随后在跑道上着陆。&br;&br;注意：不可同时接取此合同与“首次交会”。若在此合同有效时接取另一合同，本合同将自动判定失败。&br;&br;注意：此合同要求在航天中心跑道水平着陆。若在卡纳维拉尔角游玩，RSS-<> 模组提供的航天飞机跑道也是有效着陆目标。

s:
Program: Crewed Spaceplane Development
Type: Optional

Crewed suborbital flights are used as a safer prelude to an orbital mission, for research, or to set non-orbital altitude records. Send any number of crew above @VesselGroup/ReachAlt/minAltitude meters and land on the runway to satisfy the requirements of this mission. Historical missions used the X-15 (1963, B-52), and SpaceShipOne (2004, White Knight).NOTE: You can not select this contract and 'First Orbital Spaceplane Flight', 'X-Planes (Suborbital)', or 'Suborbital Flight (Crewed)' at the same time. If you select the other contract while this is active, this will automatically fail.&br;&br;NOTE: This contract requires a horizontal landing on the space center runway. If playing from the Cape, the Space Shuttle runway provided by the RSS-CanaveralHD mod is also a valid landing target.&br;&br;Number of Contracts Completed: @index / @maxCompletions
zh: 方案：载人空天飞机研发 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 载人亚轨道飞行可用作轨道任务前更安全的前奏、用于研究，或创下非轨道高度纪录。运送任意数量的乘员达到 @VesselGroup/ReachAlt/minAltitude 米以上高度并降落在跑道上，即可满足本任务要求。历史任务曾使用 <>（1963年，<>）和 <>（2004年，White Knight）。注意：不可同时接取此合同与“首次轨道空天飞机飞行”、“X 系列验证机（亚轨道）”或“亚轨道飞行（载人）”。若在此合同有效时接取其他合同，本合同将自动判定失败。&br;&br;注意：此合同要求在航天中心跑道水平着陆。若在卡纳维拉尔角游玩，RSS-<> 模组提供的航天飞机跑道也是有效着陆目标。&br;&br;已完成合同数：@index / @<>

s:

Design, build, and launch a crewed plane capable of hypersonic atmospheric flight of at least @/minSpeedMPS m/s below 40km and return home safely. s:
Program: X-Plane Research
Type: Required

Design, build, and fly a crewed aircraft or rocket to attain Mach 1 and hold above it for 30 seconds. Vital to the development of new wing shapes and high-speed aerodynamics (the area rule, swept wings, mach tuck, and so on), breaching the sound barrier is a worthy scientific endeavor. Firsts include the U.S. Bell X-1 (1947), the Soviet Lavochkin La-176 (1948), and the British de Havilland DH.108 (1948).

Note: Astronauts must be trained before launch. There are two types of training, Proficiency Training and Mission Training. Astronauts need Proficiency Training for each crewed part on the vehicle they launch on and for each part that they will enter during their mission. Proficiency Training has to be done only ONCE and lasts FOREVER. Next is Mission Training for the part you intend to launch them in. Mission training must be performed before EVERY flight and will EXPIRE on use or if it goes unused too long. To begin training your astronauts, go to Training tab in the RP-1 window, accessible via the RP-1 icon in the toolbar.

zh: 项目：X-Plane 研究 <> 类型：可选 <> <> 设计、制造并发射一枚载人火箭或飞机，将一名人员送入 @/altitudeKm km 以上的高层大气并安全返回。可选目标：着陆返回跑道将奖励额外声望。如果在卡纳维拉尔角进行游戏，RSS-<> 模组提供的航天飞机跑道也是有效的着陆目标。 <> <> 这是一个包含 @<> 个合同的系列，已完成 @index 个。 <> <> 一旦完成“亚轨道飞行（载人）”，将不再提供此合同！ <> <> 注意：宇航员必须在发射前接受训练。训练分为两种：熟练度训练和任务训练。宇航员需要对发射时搭乘的每个载人部件，以及任务期间将要进入的每个部件进行熟练度训练。熟练度训练只需进行一次且永久有效。接下来是针对你计划搭乘发射部件的任务训练。每次飞行前都必须进行任务训练，使用后或长期未使用都会过期。要开始训练宇航员，请转到 <> 窗口中的“训练”标签页，可通过工具栏中的 <> 图标打开。

s:

Type: Required

Optionally, landing back at the runway will award extra reputation. If playing from the Cape, the Space Shuttle runway provided by the RSS-CanaveralHD mod is also a valid landing target.

s: A resizable satellite for communication contract payload. The solar panels in the part texture are sized to power the client's payload, and won't produce any excess power for your rocket or command and control. From RP-1 mod
zh: 一种可调整尺寸的卫星，用于通信合同有效载荷。部件贴图中的太阳能电池板尺寸仅够为客户的有效载荷供电，不会为你的火箭或指令控制提供任何多余电力。来自 <> 模组

s: A resizable satellite for navigation contract payload. The solar panels in the part texture are sized to power the client's payload, and won't produce any excess power for your rocket or command and control. From RP-1 mod
zh: 一种可调整尺寸的卫星，用于导航合同有效载荷。部件贴图中的太阳能电池板尺寸仅够为客户的有效载荷供电，不会为你的火箭或指令控制提供任何多余电力。来自 <> 模组

s: The Science Sample Return Capsule is based on the Corona/Discoverer satellites from the United States in the early 1960's. These capsules were used to send film back to Earth to be processed for analysis. In-game, you can use this to return your valuable samples and science data from low Earth orbit. Note that the heat shield on this part is a <b>heatsink<b>, meaning it can only survive steep re-entries (perigee around -500 km) with high peak heat flux but low total heating. Historically, the Corona return capsules used a Star-12 SRM for deorbiting, which is comparable to a Baby Sergeant. [Diameter 0.6 m]
zh: 科学样本返回舱基于 20 世纪 60 年代初美国的“日冕/发现者”卫星设计。这些返回舱最初用于将胶卷送回地球进行冲洗和分析。在游戏中，你可以用它从近地轨道运回宝贵的样本和科学数据。请注意，该部件的防热盾为<b>吸热式<b>，这意味着它只能在陡峭的再入轨迹（近地点约 -500 km）中幸存——即承受高瞬时热流但总吸热量较低。历史上，“日冕”返回舱使用 <<M0>> 固体火箭发动机进行离轨制动，其性能相当于一枚“幼兵”（Baby Sergeant）。[直径 0.6 m]

s:
The experimental era is over. We have proven that satellites can see the Earth; now we must put them to work. This program shifts from simple prototypes to the establishment of dedicated operational networks. The goal is no longer to just survive in orbit, but to provide a constant stream of actionable data for national security and public safety.
Author's Note: This program requires Surface Science (1969-1971).
zh: 试验时代已经结束。我们已经证明了卫星可以观测地球；现在必须让它们投入实际应用。该计划标志着从单一原型测试转向建立专用业务化卫星网络。目标不再仅仅是在轨道上生存，而是为国家安全与公共安全提供持续、可用的数据流。  <<M0>> <color=red>作者注：该计划需要地表科学（1969-1971）。</color>

s:
We are expanding our vision beyond the visible spectrum and simple photography. The advanced platforms we will launch now require complex orbital insertions and long-duration stability to revolutionise our understanding of the planet's changing environment.
Author's Note: This program requires Deep Space Science (1972-1980).
zh: 我们的视野正在超越可见光与简单的摄影。我们即将发射的先进平台需要复杂的轨道切入和长期的稳定性，以彻底革新我们对地球环境变化的认知。  <<M0>> <color=red>作者注：该计划需要深空科学（1972-1980）。</color>

s:
Although the earliest satellites were launched through government programs, commercial uses had been envisioned for a long time. Through this program, you will launch the earliest iterations of commercial-use satellites. With wildly varying needs, each satellite is dedicated to a specific requirement, typically with far more focused requirements than the earlier, broader scientific satellites.
Author's Note: These contracts will require a satellite relay to be maintained for ONE YEAR.
zh: 尽管最早的卫星是通过政府计划发射的，但商业用途很早就被提上日程。通过该计划，你将发射最早期的商业卫星。由于需求各异，每颗卫星都专门针对特定需求设计，通常比早期用途广泛的科学卫星要求更为专注。  <<M0>> <color=red>作者注：这些合同将要求维持卫星中继运行一年。</color>

s:
Geosynchronous, Geostationary, Molniya, and Tundra orbits have the potential to improve satellite coverage and simplify ground antenna tracking. This program tasks you with testing these orbits, launching satellites into them for commercial customers, and creating a satellite network for communication.
Author's Note: These contracts will require a satellite relay to be maintained FOREVER.
zh: 地球同步轨道、地球静止轨道、闪电轨道和冻结轨道具有改善卫星覆盖范围并简化地面天线跟踪的潜力。该计划要求你测试这些轨道，为商业客户发射卫星进入预定轨道，并建立用于通信的卫星网络。 <<M0>> <color=red>作者注：这些合同将要求永久维持卫星中继运行。</color>

s:
Jupiter presents many opportunities for exploration, but also many challenges: it requires almost the same amount of energy for a spacecraft to reach Jupiter from Earth's orbit as it does to lift it into orbit in the first place. Gravity assists can be used to save delta-v at the cost of flight duration. Once there, a rich and diverse system awaits any explorer. Along with the largest planet in the Solar System, the Jovian system is also home to the largest moon, Ganymede, a planetary-mass moon. This program will send uncrewed scientific probes to Jupiter and its moons.

Historically, Jupiter is the most-visited outer planet, with 9 missions having completed flybys or entered orbits, most notably by the Voyager missions in 1979 on their flybys towards the outer Solar System, and by the Juno orbiter whose mission continues today. Most recently, NASA's Europa Clipper mission departed in 2024 enroute to the Galilean moons.
zh: 木星带来了许多探测机遇，但也伴随着诸多挑战：航天器从地球轨道飞往木星所需的能量，几乎与将其送入轨道的能量相当。可以利用引力助推来节省Δv，代价是增加飞行时间。一旦抵达，一个丰富多样的星系便展现在探索者眼前。除拥有太阳系中最大的行星外，木星系还拥有最大的卫星——行星质量级别的木卫三。该计划将向木星及其卫星派遣无人科学探测器。 <<M0>>  <<M0>> 历史上，木星是访问次数最多的外行星，共有 9 次任务完成了飞掠或入轨，最著名的当属 1979 年旅行者号任务在飞往外太阳系途中的飞掠，以及至今仍在运行的朱诺号轨道器。最近，NASA 的欧罗巴快船任务于 2024 年启程前往伽利略卫星。

s:
Known for its photogenic rings, Saturn has long been a subject of observation and exploration. Visible from Earth with little more than a set of binoculars, Saturn's rings have intrigued observers for centuries. Further, with the highest number of moons in the entire Solar System, and more discovered with each additional mission, the Saturn system is a destination with extensive exploration opportunities. Titan, the largest moon of Saturn, may have an atmosphere conducive to life, while Enceladus is thought to contain liquid water below its icy exterior. Explore the Saturn system with uncrewed probes, analyzing the atmospheres of Saturn and Titan, and take a closer look at the larger moons of the system.

Historical missions to Saturn include flybys from Pioneer 11 and both Voyagers, while the Cassini orbiter mission operated from 2004 to 2017.
zh: 土星以其上镜的环形结构闻名，长期以来一直是观测和探索的对象。只需一副双筒望远镜即可从地球上观测到，几个世纪以来土星的环形系统一直吸引着观测者。此外，土星拥有整个太阳系中最多的卫星，且每次任务都会发现更多，土星系是一个拥有广阔探测前景的目标。土卫六作为土星最大的卫星，可能拥有适宜生命存在的大气层；而土卫二则被认为在其冰层外壳下蕴藏着液态水。利用无人探测器探索土星系，分析土星和土卫六的大气，并近距离观察该系统中的主要大卫星。 <<M0>>  <<M0>> 历史上前往土星的任务包括先驱精神 11 号和两艘旅行者号的飞掠，以及在 2004 至 2017 年间运行的卡西尼号轨道器任务。

s: This experiment is designed to test how well humans can track objects in space. A multicolor, mylar balloon, about the size of a beach ball, will be extended on a tether for the crew member to track.This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: This experiment takes 2 hours.
zh: 该实验旨在测试人类在太空中追踪物体的能力。一个约沙滩球大小的彩色聚酯薄膜气球将通过系绳释放，供乘员进行追踪观测。该实验可完成两次。注意：该实验需要 2 小时。

s: Maneuvering in space will be very important if we want to continue our exploration. We need the crew member to see how the spacecraft reacts and maneuvers with yaw, pitch and roll controls. This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: Experiment takes 1 hour of Crew Observations to complete
zh: 如果我们想要继续探索，在太空中进行机动将至关重要。我们需要乘员观察航天器在偏航、俯仰和滚转控制下的响应与机动表现。该实验可完成两次。注意：实验需要 1 小时的乘员观测才能完成

s: By using a hand-held camera, our crew can take images of locations on Earth that our scientists are intersted in. These images can be of much higher quality than our current satellite technology can accomplish. This experiment can be completed four times. NOTE: Experiment takes 1 hour of Crew Observations to complete
zh: 通过手持相机，我们的乘员可以拍摄科学家感兴趣的地球区域图像。这些图像的清晰度可以远高于我们现有的卫星技术水平。该实验可完成四次。注意：实验需要 1 小时的乘员观测才能完成

s: Broadcast live black & white analog television while landed on the moon. This experiment can be completed once. NOTE: This experiment takes 4 hours and can only be completed landed on the moon.
zh: 在着陆月球期间进行黑白模拟电视实时直播。该实验可完成一次。注意：该实验需要 4 小时，且只能在着陆月球后完成。

s: Broadcast live black & white analog television while en route to the Moon.This experiment can be completed once. NOTE: This experiment takes 4 hours and can only be completed in space high.
zh: 在飞往月球的途中进行黑白模拟电视实时直播。该实验可完成一次。注意：该实验需要 4 小时，且只能在高轨道太空完成。

s: To investigate determination of spacecraft attitude in yaw and pitch from measurement of ion flow variations. The recording of ion sensor outputs during pitch and yaw maneuvers will be compared with data obtained from the inertial guidance system and the horizon scanner. Results of the comparison and the astronaut evaluation will form the basis for further development of simple, lightweight orbital attitude determination systems.This experiment can be completed once. NOTE: This experiment takes 48 hours.
zh: 通过测量离子流变化来研究航天器偏航和俯仰姿态的确定方法。在俯仰和偏航机动期间记录的离子传感器输出将与惯性制导系统和地平线扫描仪获得的数据进行比对。比对结果与宇航员评估将为进一步研发简易、轻型轨道姿态确定系统奠定基础。此实验可完成一次。注意：此实验耗时 48 小时。

s: To test the usefulness and performance of a low-light-level television system as a supplement to unaided vision in observing surface features primarily when such features are in darkness and spacecraft pilots are not dark-adapted.This experiment can be completed once. NOTE: This experiment takes 12 hours.
zh: 测试微光电视系统的可用性和性能，作为肉眼观察的补充手段，主要用于在地面目标处于黑暗中且航天器驾驶员尚未适应暗光环境时观测地面特征。此实验可完成一次。注意：此实验耗时 12 小时。

s: Crew photographs of land and ocean areas for geologic, geographic, and oceanographic study for evaluation of various film typesThis experiment can be completed 3 times. NOTE: This experiment takes 12 hours.
zh: 由乘员拍摄陆地和海洋区域的照片，用于地质学、地理学和海洋学研究，并评估各类胶片的性能。此实验可完成 3 次。注意：此实验耗时 12 小时。

s: Crew photographs of global and local weather systems for use by scientists in improving techniques of interpretation of orbital altitude weather photographs.This experiment can be completed 3 times. NOTE: This experiment takes 12 hours.
zh: 由乘员拍摄全球和局地天气系统照片，供科学家改进轨道高度气象照片的判读技术。此实验可完成 3 次。注意：此实验耗时 12 小时。

s: It will be necessary for our future spacecraft to be able to change their orbits in order to rendezvous and dock. This experiment will test the Orbital Maneuvering system to better understand what is required and possible.This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: This experiment takes 2 hours.
zh: 我们未来的航天器必须能够改变轨道以进行交会对接。本实验将测试轨道机动系统，以更好地了解相关需求与可行性。此实验可完成两次。注意：此实验耗时 2 小时。

s: The visual ability of the astronauts in the detection and recognition of objects on the Earth's or Moon's surface will be tested. This experiment can be completed three times. NOTE: This experiment takes 2 hours.
zh: 测试宇航员在探测和识别地球或月球表面物体方面的视觉能力。此实验可完成三次。注意：此实验耗时 2 小时。

s: To study the feasibility and operational value of star occulting measurements in the development of a simple, accurate, and self-contained navigational capability by measuring the time stars dip behind an established horizon.This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: This experiment takes 24 hours.
zh: 通过测量恒星落入既定地平线以下的时间，研究恒星掩星测量值在开发简易、精确且自主的导航能力方面的可行性与实用价值。此实验可完成两次。注意：此实验耗时 24 小时。

s: To determine man's ability to perform work tasks in pressurized suit under zero gravity.This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: This experiment takes 24 hours.
zh: 测定人在零重力环境下身穿加压宇航服执行工作任务的能力。此实验可完成两次。注意：此实验耗时 24 小时。

s: This experiment is designed to explore the possibility of the existence of a gravitational field effect on cells exposed to microgravity situations. These irregularities would be easier to explore in simple cell systems. This experiment can be completed once. NOTE: This experiment takes 3 hours.
zh: 本实验旨在探索微重力环境下细胞是否存在重力场效应。在简单的细胞系统中更容易探索这些异常现象。此实验可完成一次。注意：此实验耗时 3 小时。

s: The objective is to examine the biological effects of radiation. The experiment will test the possibility that weightlessness interacts with radiation to produce unpredicted effects greater than the sum of their individual effects. This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: This experiment takes 48 hours.
zh: 目标是研究辐射的生物学效应。本实验将测试失重是否会与辐射相互作用，产生超出两者各自单独效应总和的不可预测影响。此实验可完成两次。注意：此实验耗时 48 小时。

s: The objectives of this experiment are to assess the crew's state of alertness, levels of consciousness, and depth of sleep during flight.This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: This experiment takes 72 hours.
zh: 本实验的目标是评估飞行期间乘员的警觉状态、意识水平以及睡眠深度。此实验可完成两次。注意：此实验耗时 72 小时。

s: Our scientists have come up with a fancy way of packaging food for consumption in space. We need the crew to evaluate how the trip to space has affected this packaging and the quality of the food. This experiment can be completed once. NOTE: This experiment takes 1 hour.
zh: 我们的科学家设计了一种精巧的食品包装方式供太空食用。我们需要乘员评估太空飞行对这种包装以及食品质量造成的影响。此实验可完成一次。注意：此实验耗时 1 小时。

s: The astronauts will use a bungee cord to assess their capacity to do physical work under space flight conditions. This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: This experiment takes 1 hour.
zh: 宇航员将使用弹力绳来评估他们在太空飞行条件下进行体力劳动的能力。此实验可完成两次。注意：此实验耗时 1 小时。

s: Study the capability of crew to provide a reliable method of navigation without input from the ground utilizing a space stedimeter and a sextant.This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: This experiment takes 12 hours.
zh: 研究乘员利用太空测距仪和六分仪在没有地面输入的情况下提供可靠导航方法的能力。此实验可完成两次。注意：此实验耗时 12 小时。

s: To obtain photographs of zodiacal light, airglow layer, and other dim light phenomena, including day sky brightness from orbital altitude.This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: This experiment takes 12 hours.
zh: 从轨道高度拍摄黄道光、气辉层及其他微光现象，包括白天天空亮度。此实验可完成两次。注意：此实验耗时 12 小时。

s: To obtain information on communication systems operating through the ionosphere.This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: This experiment takes 12 hours.
zh: 获取穿越电离层运行的通信系统相关信息。此实验可完成两次。注意：此实验耗时 12 小时。

s: To analyze the health of humans in space over a prolonged period of time. NOTE: This experiment takes half a year and consumes 750L of Research Payload every 30 days
zh: 长期分析人体在太空中的健康状况。注意：此实验耗时半年，且每 30 天消耗 750L 研究载荷

s: To track the movement of civilian ships and naval vessels with Visible, Infrared, and Radio light NOTE: This experiment takes 30 Days.
zh: 利用可见光、红外光和无线电波追踪民用船只与海军舰艇的航行动态注意：此实验耗时 30 天。

s: To utilize an orthicon to analyze UV radiation near orbital vessels NOTE: This experiment takes 6 Days.
zh: 利用正视管分析轨道航天器附近的紫外辐射注意：此实验耗时 6 天。

s: To analyze the airglow formed by radiation interacting with the upper atmosphere NOTE: This experiment takes 6 hours.
zh: 分析辐射与高层大气相互作用形成的气辉注意：此实验耗时 6 小时。

s: To test secure communication using a narrow radio beam NOTE: This experiment takes 1 Day.
zh: 测试利用窄束无线电波的保密通信注意：此实验耗时 1 天。

s: To test secure communication using a narrow laser beam NOTE: This experiment takes 1 Day.
zh: 测试利用窄束激光的保密通信注意：此实验耗时 1 天。

s: To test an evaporator for vacuum distillation/vapor filtration water reclamation system for use on manned space flights. NOTE: This experiment takes 7 Days.
zh: 测试用于载人航天飞行的真空蒸馏/蒸汽过滤水回收系统蒸发器。注意：此实验耗时 7 天。

s: To monitor X-ray flux emitted by the Sun NOTE: This experiment takes 30 Days.
zh: 监测太阳发射的X射线通量注意：此实验耗时 30 天。

s: To further analyze the health of humans in space over an extended period of time. NOTE: This experiment takes 2 years and consumes 750L of Research Payload every 30 days.
zh: 进一步长期分析人体在太空中的健康状况。注意：此实验耗时 2 年，且每 30 天消耗 750L 研究载荷。

s: To utilize an emulsion consisting of silver-halide crystals in gelatin to identify atomic nuclei in cosmic rays NOTE: This experiment takes 21 days.
zh: 利用由明胶中卤化银晶体构成的乳胶来识别宇宙射线中的原子核注意：此实验耗时 21 天。

s: To analyze ultraviolet line spectra of stars in the Milky Way and other galaxies NOTE: This experiment takes 30 days.
zh: 分析银河系及其他星系中恒星的紫外线谱线注意：此实验耗时 30 天。

s: To photograph ultraviolet and x-ray line spectra of stars in the Milky Way and other galaxies NOTE: This experiment takes 30 days.
zh: 拍摄银河系及其他星系中恒星的紫外和X射线线状光谱注意：此实验耗时 30 天。

s: To analyze airglow in the upper atmosphere in the UV spectrumNOTE: This experiment takes 30 days.
zh: 分析高层大气在紫外波段的气辉注意：此实验耗时 30 天。

s: To fabricate a lamellar eutetic composite in the absence of thermal convectionNOTE: This experiment takes 6 hours.
zh: 在无热对流环境下制备层状共晶复合材料。注意：该实验耗时 6 小时。

s: To determine the effects of zero-G on the growth of Gallium Arsenide CrystalsNOTE: This experiment takes 115 hours.
zh: 测定零重力对砷化镓晶体生长的影响。注意：该实验耗时 115 小时。

s: To analyze the health of humans in Lunar space over an extended period of time. NOTE: Requires a Scientist. This experiment takes 720 Days and consumes 750L of Research Payload every 30 days.
zh: 长期分析月球空间中人体的健康状况。注意：需要一名科学家。该实验耗时 720 天，且每 30 天消耗 750L 研究载荷。

s: Advanced health monitoring and lab work, activity experimentation and in-situ analysis of working and living on lunar regolith. NOTE: This experiment takes 720 days and consumes 12000L of Research Payload.
zh: 高级健康监测与实验室工作、在月壤上工作与生活的活动实验及原位分析。注意：该实验耗时 720 天，并消耗 12000L 研究载荷。

s: The extreme darkness, lack of atmosphere and stability provided by solid ground is ideal for high precision astronomy. NOTE: This experiment takes 14 days and must run during the lunar night.
zh: 极度黑暗、无大气干扰以及坚固地面带来的稳定性，是进行高精度天文观测的理想条件。注意：该实验耗时 14 天，且必须在月夜期间运行。

s: A basic, heavily miniaturized tape drive, capable of storing a few hours of data from early science experiments. <color=green>Base Capacity: 6.3 kB</color>
zh: 一种基础且高度微型化的磁带机，能够存储早期科学实验数小时的数据。<color=green>基础容量：6.3 kB</color>

s: Although essentially the same as the early tape recorder, increased size allows for more tape to be loaded, improving capacity. <color=green>Base Capacity: 25 kB</color>
zh: 尽管本质上与早期磁带录音机相同，但扩大的尺寸允许装填更多磁带，从而提升了容量。<color=green>基础容量：25 kB</color>

s: A full-size tape drive for more advanced satellites, this is capable of storing much more data, such as slow-scan TV images. <color=green>Base Capacity: 125 kB</color>
zh: 适用于更先进卫星的全尺寸磁带机，能够存储更多数据，例如慢扫描电视图像。<color=green>基础容量：125 kB</color>

s: Transistorized electronics allow for better read/write sensitivity, enabling more data to be stored on the same length of tape. <color=green>Base Capacity: 700 kB</color>
zh: 晶体管化电子设备提供了更高的读写灵敏度，使相同长度的磁带能够存储更多数据。<color=green>基础容量：700 kB</color>

s: Using a digital computer to digitize and compress data increases the effective capacity that can be stored on a data tape by an order of magnitude. <color=green>Base Capacity: 3 MB</color>
zh: 利用数字计算机对数据进行数字化和压缩，使数据磁带的有效存储容量提升了一个数量级。<color=green>基础容量：3 MB</color>

s: Advances in integrated circuits allows better data compression, smaller control electronics, and continued improvements to data density. <color=green>Base Capacity: 60 MB</color>
zh: 集成电路的进步带来了更高的数据压缩率、更小巧的控制电子设备，并持续提升了数据密度。<color=green>基础容量：60 MB</color>

s: Advances in integrated circuits allows better data compression, smaller control electronics, and continued improvements to data density. <color=green>Base Capacity: 150 MB</color>
zh: 集成电路的进步带来了更高的数据压缩率、更小巧的控制电子设备，并持续提升了数据密度。<color=green>基础容量：150 MB</color>

s: Flash Memory, Random Access Memory, and other solid state storage techniques are now advanced enough to offer superior performance to magnetic data tape, although at a high price. <color=green>Base Capacity: 12 GB</color>
zh: 闪存、随机存取存储器和其他固态存储技术现已足够先进，尽管价格昂贵，但性能已优于磁带存储。<color=green>基础容量：12 GB</color>

s: Flash storage continues to improve at an exponential rate, offering low cost bulk data storage. <color=green>Base Capacity: 200 GB</color>
zh: 闪存技术继续以指数级速度发展，提供了低成本的海量数据存储。<color=green>基础容量：200 GB</color>

s: Flash storage continues to improve at an exponential rate, offering low cost bulk data storage. <color=green>Base Capacity: 3 TB</color>
zh: 闪存技术继续以指数级速度发展，提供了低成本的海量数据存储。<color=green>基础容量：3 TB</color>

s: To investigate determination of spacecraft attitude in yaw and pitch from measurement of ion flow variations. The recording of ion sensor outputs during pitch and yaw maneuvers will be compared with data obtained from the inertial guidance system and the horizon scanner. Results of the comparison and the astronaut evaluation will form the basis for further development of simple, lightweight orbital attitude determination systems.This experiment can be completed once. NOTE: This experiment takes 48 hours.
zh: 通过测量离子流变化来研究航天器偏航与俯仰姿态的测定。将俯仰和偏航机动期间离子传感器的输出记录与惯导系统和地平扫描仪获取的数据进行比对。比对结果与宇航员的评估将为进一步开发简易、轻型的轨道姿态测定系统奠定基础。此实验可完成 1 次。注意：此实验耗时 48 小时。

s: To test the usefulness and performance of a low-light-level television system as a supplement to unaided vision in observing surface features primarily when such features are in darkness and spacecraft pilots are not dark-adapted.This experiment can be completed once. NOTE: This experiment takes 12 hours.
zh: 测试微光电视系统的实用性与性能，作为肉眼视力的补充，主要用于在地面目标处于黑暗中且航天器驾驶员尚未适应暗光时观察地表特征。此实验可完成 1 次。注意：此实验耗时 12 小时。

s: Crew photographs of land and ocean areas for geologic, geographic, and oceanographic study for evaluation of various film typesThis experiment can be completed 3 times. NOTE: This experiment takes 12 hours.
zh: 乘员拍摄陆地和海洋区域的照片，用于地质、地理和海洋学研究，并评估各类胶片的性能。此实验可完成 3 次。注意：此实验耗时 12 小时。

s: Crew photographs of global and local weather systems for use by scientists in improving techniques of interpretation of orbital altitude weather photographs.This experiment can be completed 3 times. NOTE: This experiment takes 12 hours.
zh: 乘员拍摄全球和局部天气系统，供科学家改进轨道高度气象照片的判读技术。此实验可完成 3 次。注意：此实验耗时 12 小时。

s: It will be necessary for our future spacecraft to be able to change their orbits in order to rendezvous and dock. This experiment will test the Orbital Maneuvering system to better understand what is required and possible.This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: This experiment takes 2 hours.
zh: 未来的航天器必须能够改变轨道以进行交会对接。本实验将测试轨道机动系统，以更好地了解相关需求和可行性。此实验可完成 2 次。注意：此实验耗时 2 小时。

s: The visual ability of the astronauts in the detection and recognition of objects on the Earth's or Moon's surface will be tested. This experiment can be completed three times. NOTE: This experiment takes 2 hours.
zh: 测试宇航员在探测和识别地球或月球表面目标时的视觉能力。此实验可完成 3 次。注意：此实验耗时 2 小时。

s: To study the feasibility and operational value of star occulting measurements in the development of a simple, accurate, and self-contained navigational capability by measuring the time stars dip behind an established horizon.This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: This experiment takes 24 hours.
zh: 通过测量恒星沉入既定地平线以下的时间，研究恒星掩星测量值在开发简易、精确且自主的导航能力方面的可行性与实用价值。此实验可完成 2 次。注意：此实验耗时 24 小时。

s: To determine man's ability to perform work tasks in pressurized suit under zero gravity.This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: This experiment takes 24 hours.
zh: 测定人在零重力环境下身着增压服执行工作任务的能力。此实验可完成 2 次。注意：此实验耗时 24 小时。

s: This experiment is designed to explore the possibility of the existence of a gravitational field effect on cells exposed to microgravity situations. These irregularities would be easier to explore in simple cell systems. This experiment can be completed once. NOTE: This experiment takes 3 hours.
zh: 本实验旨在探索微重力环境下细胞是否存在重力场效应。这类异常现象在简单的细胞系统中更容易探索。此实验可完成 1 次。注意：此实验耗时 3 小时。

s: The objective is to examine the biological effects of radiation. The experiment will test the possibility that weightlessness interacts with radiation to produce unpredicted effects greater than the sum of their individual effects. This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: This experiment takes 48 hours.
zh: 目的是检查辐射的生物学效应。实验将检验失重与辐射相互作用产生超出各自效应总和的不可预测影响的可能性。此实验可完成 2 次。注意：此实验耗时 48 小时。

s: The objectives of this experiment are to assess the crew's state of alertness, levels of consciousness, and depth of sleep during flight.This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: This experiment takes 72 hours.
zh: 本实验的目的是评估乘员在飞行期间的警觉状态、意识水平和睡眠深度。此实验可完成 2 次。注意：此实验耗时 72 小时。

s: Our scientists have come up with a fancy way of packaging food for consumption in space. We need the crew to evaluate how the trip to space has affected this packaging and the quality of the food. This experiment can be completed once. NOTE: This experiment takes 1 hour.
zh: 我们的科学家研发出了一种用于太空食用的高级食品包装。我们需要乘员评估太空飞行对该包装以及食品质量造成的影响。此实验可完成 1 次。注意：此实验耗时 1 小时。

s: The astronauts will use a bungee cord to assess their capacity to do physical work under space flight conditions. This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: This experiment takes 1 hour.
zh: 宇航员将使用弹力绳评估他们在太空飞行条件下进行体力劳动的能力。此实验可完成 2 次。注意：此实验耗时 1 小时。

s: Study the capability of crew to provide a reliable method of navigation without input from the ground utilizing a space stedimeter and a sextant.This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: This experiment takes 12 hours.
zh: 利用太空视距仪和六分仪，研究乘员在脱离地面支持的情况下提供可靠导航方法的能力。此实验可完成 2 次。注意：此实验耗时 12 小时。

s: To obtain photographs of zodiacal light, airglow layer, and other dim light phenomena, including day sky brightness from orbital altitude.This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: This experiment takes 12 hours.
zh: 从轨道高度拍摄黄道光、气辉层以及包括白昼天空亮度在内的其他微光现象的照片。此实验可完成 2 次。注意：此实验耗时 12 小时。

s: To obtain information on communication systems operating through the ionosphere.This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: This experiment takes 12 hours.
zh: 获取穿越电离层运行的通信系统的相关信息。此实验可完成 2 次。注意：此实验耗时 12 小时。

s: To analyze the health of humans in space over a prolonged period of time. NOTE: This experiment takes half a year and consumes 750L of Research Payload every 30 days
zh: 长期分析人体在太空中的健康状况。注意：此实验耗时半年，且每 30 天消耗 750L 研究载荷

s: To track the movement of civilian ships and naval vessels with Visible, Infrared, and Radio light NOTE: This experiment takes 30 Days.
zh: 利用可见光、红外线和无线电波追踪民用船只和海军舰艇的动向 注意：此实验耗时 30 天。

s: To utilize an orthicon to analyze UV radiation near orbital vessels NOTE: This experiment takes 6 Days.
zh: 利用超正规管分析轨道航天器附近的紫外辐射 注意：此实验耗时 6 天。

s: To analyze the airglow formed by radiation interacting with the upper atmosphere NOTE: This experiment takes 6 hours.
zh: 分析辐射与高层大气相互作用形成的气辉 注意：此实验耗时 6 小时。

s: To test secure communication using a narrow radio beam NOTE: This experiment takes 1 Day.
zh: 测试利用窄波束无线电的安全通信 注意：此实验耗时 1 天。

s: To test secure communication using a narrow laser beam NOTE: This experiment takes 1 Day.
zh: 测试利用窄波束激光的安全通信 注意：此实验耗时 1 天。

s: To test an evaporator for vacuum distillation/vapor filtration water reclamation system for use on manned space flights. NOTE: This experiment takes 7 Days.
zh: 测试载人航天飞行所用的真空蒸馏/蒸汽过滤水回收系统蒸发器。注意：此实验耗时 7 天。

s: To monitor X-ray flux emitted by the Sun NOTE: This experiment takes 30 Days.
zh: 监测太阳发射的 X 射线通量 注意：此实验耗时 30 天。

s: To further analyze the health of humans in space over an extended period of time. NOTE: This experiment takes 2 years and consumes 750L of Research Payload every 30 days.
zh: 在更长的时间内进一步分析人体在太空中的健康状况。注意：此实验耗时 2 年，且每 30 天消耗 750L 研究载荷。

s: To utilize an emulsion consisting of silver-halide crystals in gelatin to identify atomic nuclei in cosmic rays NOTE: This experiment takes 21 days.
zh: 利用明胶中卤化银晶体构成的乳胶来识别宇宙射线中的原子核 注意：此实验耗时 21 天。

s: To analyze ultraviolet line spectra of stars in the Milky Way and other galaxies NOTE: This experiment takes 30 days.
zh: 分析银河系及其他星系中恒星的紫外线谱线 注意：此实验耗时 30 天。

s: To photograph ultraviolet and x-ray line spectra of stars in the Milky Way and other galaxies NOTE: This experiment takes 30 days.
zh: 拍摄银河系及其他星系中恒星的紫外线和 X 射线谱线 注意：此实验耗时 30 天。

s: To analyze airglow in the upper atmosphere in the UV spectrumNOTE: This experiment takes 30 days.
zh: 在紫外光谱中分析高层大气的气辉 注意：此实验耗时 30 天。

zh: 更小型的固体逃逸塔，用来把乘员从必死无疑的险境中猛掷出去。

s: A division of Wenkel Corporation, RealChutes was the result of an Industry-Government-Academia Joint Research project undertaken in conjunction with the Kerbal Space Administration (KSA) and the University of Kerbin to develop improved spacecraft recovery systems.
zh: 作为 Wenkel 公司的分支机构，<<M0>> 是与坎巴拉航天局（KSA）和坎星大学联合开展的“产学研联合研究”项目的成果，旨在开发更先进的航天器回收系统。

s: Originally founded by Wenkel Kerman in KY 450 to commercialize his vapor-compression refrigeration units for domestic use, the company now develops and manufactures air conditioning and thermal control systems for the aerospace industry. More recently, it has entered the spacecraft recovery systems market through innovative new products by its subsidiary, RealChute Aerodynamic Deacceleration Recovery Systems.
zh: 该公司最初由 Wenkel Kerman 于 KY 450 年创立，旨在将家用蒸气压缩制冷装置商业化。如今该公司为航空航天业研发和制造空调与热控系统。近来，它通过其子公司 <<M0>> 气动减速回收系统推出的创新产品进入了航天器回收系统市场。

s: After Bob almost splattered against the walls of a descending capsule whose instantly-deploying, one-size fits all parachute ripped off, he demanded change. KSC ignored his demand, citing cost, until he returned with a BACC, a lighter, and an empty bottle of Scotch. Terrified, KSC engineers invented the Real Chute, which is highly configurable gradually deploys.
zh: 在一次返回中，由于瞬间展开的“均码”降落伞被直接扯碎，Bob 险些在降落舱内撞成肉泥。为此他强烈要求做出改变。KSC 以成本为由无视了他的诉求，直到他带着一台 BACC 助推器、一个打火机和一个空威士忌酒瓶折返。吓坏了的 KSC 工程师们随即发明了 Real Chute——高度可配置且能平缓渐进地展开。

s: After Bill nearly met fiery doom because his Real Chute could not stop his capsule's screaming descent, he demanded change. KSC ignored his demand, citing cost, until he strapped some spare boosters from Jebediah's Junkyard onto his car and flew into the boardroom one afternoon, terrorizing the already traumatized directors with savage screams and his wafer-thin heatshield. KSC engineers hastily added a drogue chute to their otherwise successful Real Chute design.
zh: 在 Bill 的 Real Chute 没能阻止返回舱的狂暴坠落险些让他葬身火海之后，他强烈要求做出改变。KSC 以成本为由无视了他的诉求，直到某个下午，他把一些从 Jebediah's Junkyard 淘来的废弃助推器绑在车上飞进了董事会会议室，用野蛮的尖叫和他那薄如蝉翼的防热盾把本就心有余悸的董事们吓得魂飞魄散。KSC 工程师随后火速为大体上很成功的 Real Chute 设计增加了减速伞。

s: When Vernher designed a parachute that could be placed under things, administrators with brimming eyes called the nursing home. When Verhner spelled "Institutionalize THIS!" with smoking craters on KSC's lawn, they immediately effected his vision.
zh: 当 Wernher 设计出可以安装在其他部件下方的降落伞时，眼含热泪的管理人员们立刻拨打了养老院的电话。而当 Wernher 在 KSC 的草坪上用冒着青烟的撞击坑拼出“把我送进养老院试试看！”时，他们立刻落实了他的构想。

s: The Science Sample Return Capsule is based on the Corona/Discoverer satellites from the United States in the early 1960's. These capsules were used to send film back to Earth to be processed for analysis. In-game, you can use this to return your valuable samples and science data from low Earth orbit. Note that the heat shield on this part is a <b>heatsink<b>, meaning it can only survive steep re-entries (perigee around -500 km) with high peak heat flux but low total heating. Historically, the Corona return capsules used a Star-12 SRM for deorbiting, which is comparable to a Baby Sergeant. [Diameter 0.6 m]
zh: 科学样本返回舱基于 20 世纪 60 年代初美国的“日冕/发现者”卫星设计。这些返回舱曾用于将胶卷送回地球进行冲洗和分析。在游戏中，你可以用它从近地轨道运回宝贵的样本和科学数据。请注意，该部件上的防热盾属于<b>散热阱<b>，这意味着它只能承受峰值热通量高但总受热量低的陡峭再入轨道（近地点约 -500 km）。在历史上，“日冕”返回舱使用 <<M0>> 固体火箭发动机进行离轨制动，其性能相当于“小警官”（Baby Sergeant）。[直径 0.6 m]

s:
The experimental era is over. We have proven that satellites can see the Earth; now we must put them to work. This program shifts from simple prototypes to the establishment of dedicated operational networks. The goal is no longer to just survive in orbit, but to provide a constant stream of actionable data for national security and public safety.
Author's Note: This program requires Surface Science (1969-1971).
zh: 试验时代已经结束。我们已经证明了卫星能够俯瞰地球；现在我们必须让它们发挥实效。该计划从简单的原型研制转向建立专门的业务化网络。目标不再仅仅是在轨生存，而是为国家安全与公共安全提供持续、可用的数据流。  <<M0>> <color=red>作者注：该计划需要“地表科学（1969-1971）”。</color>

s:
We are expanding our vision beyond the visible spectrum and simple photography. The advanced platforms we will launch now require complex orbital insertions and long-duration stability to revolutionise our understanding of the planet's changing environment.
Author's Note: This program requires Deep Space Science (1972-1980).
zh: 我们的视野正拓展至可见光波段和简单摄影之外。我们即将发射的先进平台需要复杂的入轨机动与长期的稳定性，以彻底革新我们对地球环境变化的认识。  <<M0>> <color=red>作者注：该计划需要“深空科学（1972-1980）”。</color>

s:
Although the earliest satellites were launched through government programs, commercial uses had been envisioned for a long time. Through this program, you will launch the earliest iterations of commercial-use satellites. With wildly varying needs, each satellite is dedicated to a specific requirement, typically with far more focused requirements than the earlier, broader scientific satellites.
Author's Note: These contracts will require a satellite relay to be maintained for ONE YEAR.
zh: 尽管最早的卫星是通过政府项目发射的，但人们早就设想过商业用途。通过该计划，你将发射最早一批商业用途卫星。由于需求千差万别，每颗卫星都专门针对特定需求设计，通常比早期用途广泛的科学卫星要求更为明确。  <<M0>> <color=red>作者注：这些合同需要保持卫星中继运行一年。</color>

s:
Geosynchronous, Geostationary, Molniya, and Tundra orbits have the potential to improve satellite coverage and simplify ground antenna tracking. This program tasks you with testing these orbits, launching satellites into them for commercial customers, and creating a satellite network for communication.
Author's Note: These contracts will require a satellite relay to be maintained FOREVER.
zh: 地球同步轨道、地球静止轨道、莫尼亚轨道与金德拉轨道具有改善卫星覆盖范围并简化地面天线跟踪的潜力。该计划要求你测试这些轨道，为专注效益的客户向这些轨道发射卫星，并建立通信卫星网络。 <<M0>> <color=red>作者注：这些合同需要永久保持卫星中继运行。</color>

s:
Jupiter presents many opportunities for exploration, but also many challenges: it requires almost the same amount of energy for a spacecraft to reach Jupiter from Earth's orbit as it does to lift it into orbit in the first place. Gravity assists can be used to save delta-v at the cost of flight duration. Once there, a rich and diverse system awaits any explorer. Along with the largest planet in the Solar System, the Jovian system is also home to the largest moon, Ganymede, a planetary-mass moon. This program will send uncrewed scientific probes to Jupiter and its moons.

Historically, Jupiter is the most-visited outer planet, with 9 missions having completed flybys or entered orbits, most notably by the Voyager missions in 1979 on their flybys towards the outer Solar System, and by the Juno orbiter whose mission continues today. Most recently, NASA's Europa Clipper mission departed in 2024 enroute to the Galilean moons.
zh: 木星带来了许多探测机遇，但也伴随着重重挑战：航天器从地球轨道飞往木星所需的能量，几乎与最初将其送入轨道所需的能量相当。可以利用引力助推来节省Δv，代价是延长飞行时间。一旦抵达，一个丰富多样的系统正等待着探索者。除了太阳系中最大的行星之外，木星系还是太阳系最大卫星——具有行星级质量的木卫三的家园。该计划将向木星及其卫星派遣无人科学探测器。 <<M0>>  <<M0>> 历史上，木星是到访次数最多的外行星，共有 9 次任务完成了飞掠或入轨，其中最著名的是 1979 年旅行者号在飞往外太阳系途中的飞掠，以及至今仍在执行任务的朱诺号轨道器。最近，NASA 的欧罗巴快船任务已于 2024 年启程前往伽利略卫星群。

s:
Known for its photogenic rings, Saturn has long been a subject of observation and exploration. Visible from Earth with little more than a set of binoculars, Saturn's rings have intrigued observers for centuries. Further, with the highest number of moons in the entire Solar System, and more discovered with each additional mission, the Saturn system is a destination with extensive exploration opportunities. Titan, the largest moon of Saturn, may have an atmosphere conducive to life, while Enceladus is thought to contain liquid water below its icy exterior. Explore the Saturn system with uncrewed probes, analyzing the atmospheres of Saturn and Titan, and take a closer look at the larger moons of the system.

Historical missions to Saturn include flybys from Pioneer 11 and both Voyagers, while the Cassini orbiter mission operated from 2004 to 2017.
zh: 土星以其优美上镜的光环而闻名，长期以来一直是观测和探索的对象。只需一副双筒望远镜即可从地球上观测到，土星的环形结构几个世纪以来一直吸引着观测者。此外，土星拥有全太阳系最多的卫星，且每次任务都会发现更多，因此土星系是一个拥有广阔探索机遇的目的地。土卫六是土星最大的卫星，可能拥有孕育生命的大气层，而土卫二被认为在其冰层之下存在液态水。利用无人探测器探索土星系统，分析土星和土卫六的大气，并近距离观察该系统的各大卫星。 <<M0>>  <<M0>> 历史上前往土星的任务包括先驱精神 11 号和两艘旅行者号的飞掠，而卡西尼号轨道器任务则在 2004 年至 2017 年间运行。

s: This experiment is designed to test how well humans can track objects in space. A multicolor, mylar balloon, about the size of a beach ball, will be extended on a tether for the crew member to track.This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: This experiment takes 2 hours.
zh: 该实验旨在测试人类在太空中跟踪目标的能力。一个沙滩球大小的彩色聚酯薄膜气球将通过系绳释放，供乘员进行追踪。该实验可完成两次。注意：该实验需要 2 小时。

s: Maneuvering in space will be very important if we want to continue our exploration. We need the crew member to see how the spacecraft reacts and maneuvers with yaw, pitch and roll controls. This experiment can be completed twice. NOTE: Experiment takes 1 hour of Crew Observations to complete
zh: 如果我们想继续探索，太空机动将至关重要。我们需要乘员观察航天器在偏航、俯仰和滚转控制下的反应与机动表现。该实验可完成两次。注意：实验需要 1 小时的乘员观测方可完成

s: By using a hand-held camera, our crew can take images of locations on Earth that our scientists are intersted in. These images can be of much higher quality than our current satellite technology can accomplish. This experiment can be completed four times. NOTE: Experiment takes 1 hour of Crew Observations to complete
zh: 通过使用手持相机，乘员可以拍摄科学家感兴趣的地球区域图像。这些图像的清晰度可以远高于当前卫星技术所能达到的水平。该实验可完成四次。注意：实验需要 1 小时的乘员观测方可完成

s: To fabricate a lamellar eutetic composite in the absence of thermal convectionNOTE: This experiment takes 6 hours.
zh: 在无热对流环境下制备层状共晶复合材料。注意：该实验耗时 6 小时。

s: To determine the effects of zero-G on the growth of Gallium Arsenide CrystalsNOTE: This experiment takes 115 hours.
zh: 测定零重力对砷化镓晶体生长的影响。注意：该实验耗时 115 小时。

s: To analyze the health of humans in Lunar space over an extended period of time. NOTE: Requires a Scientist. This experiment takes 720 Days and consumes 750L of Research Payload every 30 days.
zh: 长期分析地月空间中人体的健康状况。注意：需要一名科学家。该实验耗时 720 天，每 30 天消耗 750L 研究载荷。

s: The extreme darkness, lack of atmosphere and stability provided by solid ground is ideal for high precision astronomy. NOTE: This experiment takes 14 days and must run during the lunar night.
zh: 极端黑暗、无大气干扰以及坚实地面提供的稳定性是高精度天文学观测的理想条件。注意：该实验耗时 14 天，且必须在月夜期间进行。

s: A basic, heavily miniaturized tape drive, capable of storing a few hours of data from early science experiments. <color=green>Base Capacity: 6.3 kB</color>

s: A full-size tape drive for more advanced satellites, this is capable of storing much more data, such as slow-scan TV images. <color=green>Base Capacity: 125 kB</color>
zh: 适用于更先进卫星的全尺寸磁带机，能够存储更多数据，例如慢扫描电视图像。<color=green>基础容量：125 kB</color>

s: Transistorized electronics allow for better read/write sensitivity, enabling more data to be stored on the same length of tape. <color=green>Base Capacity: 700 kB</color>
zh: 晶体管化电子学带来了更好的读写灵敏度，使同等长度的磁带能够存储更多数据。<color=green>基础容量：700 kB</color>

s: Using a digital computer to digitize and compress data increases the effective capacity that can be stored on a data tape by an order of magnitude. <color=green>Base Capacity: 3 MB</color>

s: Advances in integrated circuits allows better data compression, smaller control electronics, and continued improvements to data density. <color=green>Base Capacity: 60 MB</color>

s: Advances in integrated circuits allows better data compression, smaller control electronics, and continued improvements to data density. <color=green>Base Capacity: 150 MB</color>

s: Flash Memory, Random Access Memory, and other solid state storage techniques are now advanced enough to offer superior performance to magnetic data tape, although at a high price. <color=green>Base Capacity: 12 GB</color>
zh: 闪存、随机存取内存（RAM）及其他固态存储技术现已足够成熟，性能超越了磁带，但价格较为昂贵。<color=green>基础容量：12 GB</color>
