s: An early 1950s turbojet. Derived from the MetroVick F.2, the first axial-flow jet developed in Britain, the Sapphire powered the Hawker Hunter, Handley Page Victor, and Gloster Javelin. This represents a later model, the ASSa.7, which powered the Gloster Javelin FAW Mk.7. Available 1955. Thrust 48.9kN. OPR 7.0, SFC 0.885 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 2.0.
zh: 一款20世纪50年代早期的涡轮喷气发动机。源自英国研制的第一款轴流式喷气发动机<<M0>> F.2，Sapphire曾为霍克“猎手”、汉德利·佩奇“胜利者”和格罗斯特“标枪”提供动力。此型号代表后期的ASSa.7，曾用于格罗斯特“标枪”FAW Mk.7。1955年可用。推力48.9kN。总增压比7.0，地面静态比油耗0.885 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制马赫数2.0。

s: A Soviet hypergolic gas generator upper stage engine. Created for the upper stage of the UR-100, the 15D13 was one of the first rockets ever developed by OKB-117. In order to save time, it's development was combined with the 5D22 upper stage engine for the A-350Zh anti-ballistic missile. It was also proposed as the braking engine for the LK-700S lander as the 11D423.
zh: 一款苏联自燃推进剂气动发生器循环上面级发动机。15D13专为<<M0>>上面级设计，是<<M1>>最早研制的火箭发动机之一。为节省时间，其研制工作与用于<<M2>>反弹道导弹的5D22上面级发动机合并进行。它还曾以11<<M4>>的代号被提议作为<<M3>>着陆器的制动发动机。

s: This is a 50 kW-class thruster. Development started in 2000 to enable space solar power systems and other high power spacecraft. A laboratory model of this high power thruster was fabricated and tested with xenon in 2002 at power levels up to 72 kW with 650V.
zh: 这是一款50 kW级推力器。研制始于2000年，旨在支持空间太阳能系统和其他大功率航天器。2002年制造了该大功率推力器的实验室模型，并在高达72 kW功率和650V电压下进行了氙气测试。

s: A basic pump-fed booster engine developed as an improved version of the Hermes A-1 for the Hermes A-3 ballistic missile. Difficulties with development led the program being split into two parts, with the smaller A-3A testing the engine and guidance systems for the larger A-3B. Although it was evaluated for use by the US Army as the SSM-A-16, it was rejected due to poor performance and reliability.
zh: 一款基础型泵压式助推器发动机，作为Hermes <<M0>>的改进型为Hermes <<M1>>弹道导弹研制。由于研发困难，该项目被拆分为两部分：由较小的<<M2>>测试发动机和制导系统，随后用于较大的<<M3>>。尽管曾作为SSM-<<M4>>接受美国陆军评估，但因性能和可靠性欠佳而被否决。

s: A Thiel alcolox booster engine used on the A-4 Series B/V-2 missile. The Model 39b was an interim design, but went into production. Used 18 x 1.5 tonne thrust chambers that fed a common mixing chamber, as combustion instability issues of a single large injector were unable to be resolved. Work began 1936, testing in 1939, and mass production from 1943-1945.
zh: 一款用于<<M0>>系列B/<<M1>>导弹的蒂尔醇氧助推器发动机。Model 39b虽为过渡设计，但最终投入量产。由于单个大型喷注器的燃烧不稳定性问题无法解决，该发动机采用了18个1.5吨级推力室汇入一个共用混合室的设计。1936年开始研发，1939年进行测试，1943至1945年间大规模生产。

s: A hypergolic upper stage engine. The baseline Aestus engine is pressure fed and is used on the Ariane 5 G, GS and ES series, while the Aestus II (also known as RS-72) variant is pump-fed with better overall performance.
zh: 一款自燃推进剂上面级发动机。基准型Aestus发动机为挤压循环，用于阿丽亚娜5号G、GS和ES系列；而Aestus II（亦称<<M0>>）变型则采用泵压循环，具备更优异的综合性能。

s: Originally developed for a standoff weapon for the B-58 Hustler, the XLR81 is a gas-generator engine with storable propellants. Later space variants improved performance and capability. Engine restart was added on the Agena B's XLR81-BA-7 (Model 8081). The XLR81-BA-11 (Model 8096) used on Agena D used propellant sumps to handle ullage. The XLR81-BA-13 (Model 8247) powered the Gemini Agena Target Vehicle (a modified Agena D) and was rated for up to 14 restarts.
zh: <<M1>>最初是为<<M0>>“盗贼”防区外武器研制的，是一款采用常温贮存推进剂的燃气发生器循环发动机。后期的航天变型提升了性能和任务能力。阿金纳B上的<<M1>>-<<M2>>（Model 8081）增加了发动机空中二次启动能力。用于阿金纳D的<<M1>>-<<M3>>（Model 8096）采用推进剂集液槽来解决沉底问题。用于双子座阿金纳目标飞行器（改装自阿金纳D）的<<M1>>-<<M4>>（Model 8247）额定支持多达14次重启。

s: A secondary propulsion system developed for the Gemini program on the Agena Target Vehicle. It allowed for fine control and orbital maneuvers without igniting the main engine. It was later offered to commercial customers as an upgrade for Agena. The system is a completely contained unit including propellant tanks, one 16-lb thrust chamber, and one 200-lb thrust chamber.
zh: 为双子座计划阿金纳目标飞行器研制的辅助推进系统。无需启动主发动机即可进行微调控制和轨道机动。该系统后来作为阿金纳的升级选件推向专注效益客户。系统为完全独立的单元，包含推进剂贮箱、一个16磅推力室以及一个200磅推力室。

s: A small pressure-fed hypergolic engine. A derivative of the first US liquid engine, the AJ10 is the longest-lived of any engine family, from the US's first satellite launch vehicle, Vanguard, through the Apollo CSM, and even planned for an Orion service module. This represents advanced AJ10s with a nozzle extension and restart capability. Used on Transtage and the Delta F and Delta K upper stages.
zh: 一款小型挤压式自燃推进剂发动机。作为美国第一款液体发动机的衍生型号，<<M0>>是服役寿命最长的发动机家族，从美国首枚卫星运载火箭“先锋号”，到阿波罗CSM，甚至曾计划用于猎户座服务舱。此型号代表先进的<<M1>>，配备喷管延伸段并具备重启能力。曾用于过渡级（Transtage）以及德尔塔F和德尔塔K上面级。

s: A small pressure-fed hypergolic engine. A derivative of the first US liquid engine, the AJ10 is the longest-lived of any engine family, from the US's first satellite launch vehicle, Vanguard, through the Apollo CSM, and even planned for an Orion service module. This is the original Vanguard second stage / Able / Delta configuration, without restart capability.
zh: 一款小型挤压式自燃推进剂发动机。作为美国第一款液体发动机的衍生型号，<<M0>>是服役寿命最长的发动机家族，从美国首枚卫星运载火箭“先锋号”，到阿波罗CSM，甚至曾计划用于猎户座服务舱。这是最初的先锋号第二级/Able/德尔塔构型，不具备重启能力。

s: A small pressure-fed hypergolic engine. A derivative of the first US liquid engine, the AJ10 is the longest-lived of any engine family, from the US's first satellite launch vehicle, Vanguard, through the Apollo CSM, and even planned for an Orion service module. This represents mid-period AJ10s with a nozzle extension and restart capability. Used on Thor-Ablestar and Delta E through Delta N.
zh: 一款小型挤压式自燃推进剂发动机。作为美国第一款液体发动机的衍生型号，<<M0>>是服役寿命最长的发动机家族，从美国首枚卫星运载火箭“先锋号”，到阿波罗CSM，甚至曾计划用于猎户座服务舱。此型号代表中期的<<M1>>，配备喷管延伸段并具备重启能力。曾用于雷神-Ablestar以及德尔塔E至德尔塔N系列。

s: A pump-fed upgrade for the AJ10 developed in the 1980s as a high performance upper stage and tug. It was based heavily on the Shuttle OMS, with the same nozzle and combustion chamber, but had turbomachinery installed in place of a pressure-fed system. The program was cancelled after the Challenger disaster, but Transtar 1 flew as the Titan Launch Dispenser on Titan IV.
zh: 20世纪80年代为<<M0>>研制的泵压式升级型，旨在作为高性能上面级和轨道拖船。该发动机大量借鉴了航天飞机OMS的技术，采用相同的喷管和燃烧室，但用涡轮泵机械替代了挤压供流系统。“挑战者号”失事后该项目被取消，但Transtar 1曾作为大力神发射分配器在大力神IV上飞行。

s: The AJ-260 was the largest rocket motor ever tested. This is the full length version of the engine. With a gross mass of 1,648 tons, it provides a thrust of 35,391 kN for more than 2 minutes. This version was designed as an alternative to the Saturn IB and as a booster for Apollo Applications launch vehicles.
zh: <<M0>>是有史以来测试过的最大火箭发动机。这是该发动机的全长版本。总质量达1648吨，可提供超过35391 kN的推力，工作时间超过2分钟。该版本设计用作土星IB号的替代方案，以及阿波罗应用计划运载火箭的助推器。

s: The AJ-260 was the largest rocket motor ever tested. This is the full length version of the engine. With a gross mass of 1,648 tons, it provides a thrust of 35,391 kN for more than 2 minutes. This version was designed as an alternative to the Saturn IB and as a booster for Apollo Applications launch vehicles. This is the radially attached version to be used as a strap-on booster. [Diameter: 6.6 m]
zh: <<M0>>是有史以来测试过的最大火箭发动机。这是该发动机的全长版本。总质量达1648吨，可提供超过35391 kN的推力，工作时间超过2分钟。该版本设计用作土星IB号的替代方案，以及阿波罗应用计划运载火箭的助推器。此型号为径向安装版本，用作捆绑式助推器。[直径：6.6 m]

s: The AJ-260 was the largest rocket motor ever tested. This is the short length version, a 21.6 x 6.6 meter behemoth that weighed more than 842 tons fully loaded. It was capable of providing over 15 MN of thrust for 120 seconds. The program was ultimately cancelled, but not before three test firings where the engines performed exactly to specifications.
zh: <<M0>>是有史以来测试过的最大火箭发动机。这是短款版本，尺寸为21.6 x 6.6米，满载质量超过842吨。它能够提供超过15 MN的推力，工作时间120秒。该项目最终被取消，但在取消前进行过三次试车，发动机表现完全符合设计指标。

s: The AJ-260 was the largest rocket motor ever tested. This is the short length version, a 21.6 x 6.6 meter behemoth that weighed more than 842 tons fully loaded. It was capable of providing over 15 MN of thrust for 120 seconds. The program was ultimately cancelled, but not before three test firings where the engines performed exactly to specifications. This is the radially attached version to be used as a strap-on booster.
zh: <<M0>>是有史以来测试过的最大火箭发动机。这是其短尺寸版本，一个尺寸达 21.6 x 6.6 米、满载重量超过 842 吨的庞然大物。它能够提供超过 15 MN 的推力，工作时间 120 秒。该项目最终被取消，但取消前进行了三次试车，发动机性能完全符合指标要求。这是径向安装版本，用作捆绑助推器。

s: A small solid kick motor developed for use as the 5th stage on the Scout launch vehicles. It was only ever launched once, on the Scout E-1 used for Explorer 52. Maximum thrust 27.5kN, burn time 9 seconds.
zh: 一款小型固体推进冲量发动机，开发用作侦察兵（Scout）运载火箭的第 5 级。它仅发射过一次，用于发射探索者 52 号的 Scout <<M0>> 火箭上。最大推力 27.5 kN，工作时间 9 秒。

s: A small solid kick motor developed as alternative Vanguard third stage. It was reused on many later LVs with the Able/Delta upper stage (or simply "Thor Burner") to circularize at apogee or perform a final payload kick. Burn time 39 seconds.
zh: 一款小型固体推进冲量发动机，作为先锋号第三级的替代方案研制。后来被多次重复用于配备 Able/Delta 上面级（或简称为“雷神 Burner”）的运载火箭，以在远地点进行圆轨道化或对有效载荷进行最终的推冲。工作时间 39 秒。

s: The Advanced Material Bipropellant Rocket engine is a high performance, higher thrust, radiation cooled, storable bipropellant space engine of the same physical envelope as the High Performance Apogee Thruster.
zh: 先进材料双组元火箭发动机（AMBR）是一款高性能、更高推力、辐射冷却的可贮存双组元航天发动机，外形尺寸与高性能远地点推进器相同。

s: The AR-1 is a 2,200-kilonewton-class kerolox engine using oxidizer-rich staged combustion. Two of those were proposed to replace the Russian made RD-180 on the Atlas V rocket. Development of this engine was halted because Aerojet Rocketdyne was unwilling to pay for its completion.
zh: <<M0>>是一款 2200 千牛级的液氧煤油发动机，采用富氧分级燃烧循环。曾提议使用两台该发动机来替代宇宙神 5 号运载火箭上的俄制<<M1>>。该发动机的研制工作因 Aerojet Rocketdyne 不愿承担后续研发费用而中止。

s: A small liquid fueled booster rocket, intended to increase the performance of the FJ-4/F-86. Tested extensively, but the weight of the system offset any performance gains. Later upgraded to be pump-fed, allowing it to use fuel directly from the fuel tanks of the aircraft, and used to power the NF-104A astronaut training aircraft.
zh: 一款小型液体燃料助推火箭，旨在提升<<M0>>/<<M1>>的性能。经过了大量测试，但系统自重抵消了所有的性能收益。后来升级为泵压供压式，允许直接使用飞机油箱中的燃料，并用于驱动<<M2>>宇航员训练机。

s: A composite solid rocket motor designed as a drop-in replacement for the 5 Segment RSRM used on the Space Launch System (SLS). Its lower inert mass along with the higher surface thrust will enable the SLS to lift more than 130 metric tonnes into low Earth orbit.
zh: 一款复合材料固体火箭发动机，设计用作太空发射系统（SLS）上 5 级分段式 RSRM 的直接替代品。其更低的惰性质量与更高的海平面推力将使 SLS 能够将超过 130 吨的有效载荷送入近地轨道。

s: A small solid kick motor used on the Jupiter-C sounding rocket (and later the Juno I and II launch vehicles) as upper stages in clusters of 11, 3 and, finally, one attached to the payload. The standard version uses the T17-E2 grain mixture while the higher performance one uses the JPL-532A.
zh: 一款小型固体推进冲量发动机，用于木星-C 探空火箭（以及后来的丘诺 1 号和 2 号运载火箭），以 11 台、3 台以及最后单台连接到有效载荷的方式组成上面级机组。标准版使用 T17-E2 推进剂药柱配方，高性能版则使用<<M0>>。

s: The BE-3 (Blue Engine 3) is a hydrolox rocket engine developed by Blue Origin, using a combustion tap-off cycle. The BE-3U is a significantly upgraded BE-3 for vacuum use, with a large nozzle and very high thrust to weight ratio.
zh: <<M0>>（BE-3）是由蓝色起源开发的一款采用燃烧室抽气循环的液氢液氧火箭发动机。<<M1>>是大幅升级后的真空版<<M0>>，配有大喷管且具备极高的推重比。

s: The BE-4 is an oxidizer-rich staged combustion methalox engine. Though initially developed for use on a Blue Origin launch vehicle, United Launch Alliance announced in 2014 that their new Vulcan launch vehicle will be powered by a pair of BE-4 engines.
zh: <<M0>>是一款采用富氧分级燃烧循环的液氧甲烷发动机。尽管最初是为蓝色起源自家的运载火箭研制的，但联合发射联盟（ULA）在 2014 年宣布，其全新的火神运载火箭将采用一对<<M0>>发动机作为动力。

s: Low thrust pump-fed expander nuclear engine. Evolved from the original NERVA design, the Bimodal NTR, instead of wasting precious propellant mass on cooling the engine reactor, uses a Brayton cycle electricity generator unit to convert the waste thermal energy into useful electrical power. It also supports liquid oxygen injection (TRITON - trimodal operation) for increased thrust at the cost of lower overall efficiency.
zh: 低推力泵压膨胀循环核火箭发动机。由原 NERVA 设计演变而来的双模态核热火箭（Bimodal NTR），不再将宝贵的推进剂质量浪费在冷却反应堆上，而是利用布雷顿循环发电机组将废热转化为有用的电能。它还支持液氧喷射注入（TRITON - 三模态运行），以牺牲整体效率为代价换取更高的推力。

s: Moderate thrust pump-fed expander nuclear engine. Evolved from the original NERVA design, the Bimodal NTR, instead of wasting precious propellant mass on cooling the engine reactor, uses a Brayton cycle electricity generator unit to convert the waste thermal energy into useful electrical power. It also supports liquid oxygen injection (TRITON - trimodal operation) for increased thrust at the cost of lower overall efficiency. This is from a later study, and is larger than the original BNTR design. It also uses low-enriched uranium to reduce costs, and a much more powerful Brayton generator to power electrical propulsion systems.
zh: 中等推力泵压膨胀循环核火箭发动机。由原 NERVA 设计演变而来的双模态核热火箭（Bimodal NTR），不再将宝贵的推进剂质量浪费在冷却反应堆上，而是利用布雷顿循环发电机组将废热转化为有用的电能。它还支持液氧喷射注入（TRITON - 三模态运行），以牺牲整体效率为代价换取更高的推力。这来自于后期的研究，尺寸大于最初的 BNTR 设计。它还采用低浓缩铀以降低成本，并配备更强大的布雷顿发电机为电推进系统供电。

s: A derivative of the Castor 1 motor, the Castor 2 featured higher specific impulse and propellant load, a lower dry mass fraction, and a longer burn time. It was used as strap-on booster starting with Delta E and in all but the early Scouts. Burn time 39s.
zh: 卡斯托 1（Castor 1）发动机的衍生型号，卡斯托 2 具备更高的比冲和推进剂装载量、更低的结构质量比以及更长的工作时间。自德尔塔 E 起被用作捆绑助推器，并应用于除早期型号外的所有侦察兵火箭中。工作时间 39 秒。

s: The Castor 4 was developed as the second stage of the Athena H missile and first flew in 1971. It was later adapted to replace Delta's Castor 2 boosters, increasing GTO capacity from 723 kg to nearly 900 kg. The Delta 3000-series launched in 1975 with a staggered booster staging sequence. Previous Deltas burned their motors in a 6-3 sequence and then jettisoned all SRMs at once. The heavier and longer-burning Castor 4 required that the motors be jettisoned as soon as they ran out to reduce dead weight. A less efficient 5-4 sequence was used until Delta was strengthened in the early 80s to handle the acceleration of a 6-3 sequence.
zh: 卡斯托 4 最初作为雅典娜 H 导弹的第二级研制，并于 1971 年首飞。后来经过改装以替代德尔塔上的卡斯托 2 助推器，将 GTO 运载能力从 723 kg 提升至近 900 kg。德尔塔 3000 系列于 1975 年首飞，采用了交错助推器分级点火时序。此前的德尔塔火箭采用 6-3 顺序点火，然后一次性抛弃所有固体火箭发动机。更重且工作时间更长的卡斯托 4 要求发动机燃尽后立即抛弃以减少死重。在 80 年代初德尔塔结构得到强化以承受 6-3 时序的加速度之前，一直采用效率较低的 5-4 时序。

s: The Castor 4A was introduced on the first generation of Delta II launchers, the 6000-series, and offered improved thrust and specific impulse by replacing PBAA with higher energy HTPB. This, combined with a stretched first stage (the Extra-Extended Long Tank Thor), and a return to the more efficient 6-3 SRM ignition sequence, improved Delta's performance by 11% over the 3000-series. The Castor 4A was flown on the Delta II from 1989 until 1993, when it was replaced by the GEM 40. The boosters were also used on the Atlas IIAS from 1993 until 2004. Burn time 53 seconds.
zh: 卡斯托 4A 首次应用于第一代德尔塔 II（6000 系列）火箭，通过用更高能量的 HTPB 替代 PBAA，提高了推力和比冲。结合加长型第一级（超长贮箱雷神）并恢复效率更高的 6-3 固体火箭发动机点火时序，使德尔塔的性能比 3000 系列提升了 11%。卡斯托 4A 于 1989 年至 1993 年在德尔塔 II 上服役，随后被 GEM 40 取代。该助推器还于 1993 年至 2004 年间用于宇宙神 IIAS。工作时间 53 秒。

s: The CASTOR 30 is a low cost, robust, state-of-the-art upper stage motor. This commercially-developed motor is 144 inches long and nominally designed as an upper stage that can function as a second or third stage depending on the vehicle configuration.
zh: CASTOR 30 是一款低成本、高可靠且先进的上面级发动机。这款商业研制的发动机长度为 144 英寸，额定设计为上面级，可根据火箭构型充当第二级或第三级。

s: The J85 was developed as a small, disposable jet engine to power decoys and drones, but was later upgraded for use on manned aircraft. It powered many small aircraft, including the F-5, CF-5, G.91Y, T-2, T-38, and A-37. This is the -4 variant, which powered the T-2C Buckeye. Available 1958. Thrust 13.1 kN. OPR 6.1, SFC 0.980 lb/lbf-hr static.
zh: J85最初作为一款小型一次性喷气发动机研发，用于为诱饵弹和无人机提供动力，但后来升级用于有人驾驶飞机。它为包括<<M0>>、<<M1>>、G.91Y、<<M2>>、<<M3>>和<<M4>>在内的众多小型飞机提供了动力。这是-4型号，用于为<<M5>>“雄鹿”提供动力。1958年可用。推力13.1 kN。总增压比（OPR）6.1，静止耗油率（SFC）0.980 lb/lbf-hr。

s: An early 50s turbojet that was the powerplant for the Su-7, Su-9, Su-11, Tu-128, and Be-10 flying boat. This a early model with afterburner, the -7F, which powered the prototype Su-7. Available 1955. 88.8kN wet, 66.7kN dry. OPR 9.5, SFC 0.97/2.25 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 1.85.
zh: 一款50年代初期的涡轮喷气发动机，曾是<<M0>>、<<M1>>、<<M2>>、<<M3>>以及<<M4>>水上飞机的动力装置。这是一款带有加力燃烧室的早期型号-7F，用于为<<M0>>原型机提供动力。1955年可用。加力推力88.8 kN，无加力推力66.7 kN。总增压比9.5，静止耗油率0.97/2.25 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制马赫数1.85。

s: A late 1950s redesign of the Atar 101 to increase thrust (creating the Atar 08) and add an afterburner (creating the Atar 09). These upgrades powered the next generation of French jet aircraft, including the Etendard IV, Super Etendard, Mirage III/IV, and Mirage F1. The Atar 09B is an early model used in the Mirage IIIA. Available 1959. 58.8kN wet, 40.9kN dry. SFC 1.01/2.03 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 2.0.
zh: 1950年代末对Atar 101进行的重新设计，旨在增加推力（派生出Atar 08）并加装加力燃烧室（派生出Atar 09）。这些升级为法国下一代喷气机提供了动力，包括“超军旗”IV、超军旗、幻影III/IV和幻影F1。Atar 09B是用于幻影IIIA的早期型号。1959年可用。加力推力58.8 kN，无加力推力40.9 kN。静止耗油率1.01/2.03 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制马赫数2.0。

s: The Avon was Rolls-Royce's first axial-flow turbojet, introduced in 1950. It powered most British aircraft of the 1950s and 60s, including the Sea Vixen, Canberra, Lightning, Hunter, Swift and Valiant. The RA.4, an early 1950s model, powered early Hawker Hunters. Available 1951. Thrust 33.4kN. OPR 7.0, SFC 0.883 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 1.5.
zh: Avon是罗尔斯·罗伊斯于1950年推出的第一款轴流式涡轮喷气发动机。它为20世纪50年代和60年代的大多数英国飞机提供了动力，包括“海雌狐”、“堪培拉”、“闪电”、“猎鹰”、“褐雨燕”和“勇士”。RA.4是1950年代初期的型号，曾为早期豪客“猎鹰”提供动力。1951年可用。推力33.4 kN。总增压比7.0，静止耗油率0.883 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制马赫数1.5。

s: The Avon was Rolls-Royce's first axial-flow turbojet, introduced in 1950. It powered most British aircraft of the 1950s and 60s, including the Sea Vixen, Canberra, Lightning, Hunter, Swift and Valiant. The RA.24R, an early 1960s model, powered the English Electric Lightning F.1. Available 1960. 63.9kN wet, 50.0kN dry. OPR 7.8, SFC 0.88/1.9 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 2.5.
zh: Avon是罗尔斯·罗伊斯于1950年推出的第一款轴流式涡轮喷气发动机。它为20世纪50年代和60年代的大多数英国飞机提供了动力，包括“海雌狐”、“堪培拉”、“闪电”、“猎鹰”、“褐雨燕”和“勇士”。RA.24R是1960年代初的型号，曾为英国电气“闪电”F.1提供动力。1960年可用。加力推力63.9 kN，无加力推力50.0 kN。总增压比7.8，静止耗油率0.88/1.9 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制马赫数2.5。

s: The J48 was also known as the Rolls-Royce Tay. Essentially an enlarged Nene, it was abandoned by Rolls-Royce in favor of the Avon. However, Pratt & Whitney was able to acquire the design, and produced it as the J48. It was used in the F9F-5 Panther, F9F-6/8 Cougar, F-94C Starfire, and YF-93. This is the -5, with afterburner, as used in the F-94C. Available 1950. 38.9 kN wet, 28.2 kN dry. 4.4 OPR, SFC 1.16 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 1.
zh: J48也被称为罗尔斯·罗伊斯“泰”（Tay）。它本质上是放大版的“尼恩”（Nene），后来被罗尔斯·罗伊斯放弃，转而研发Avon。然而，普拉特·惠特尼获得了该设计并将其生产为J48。它被用于F9F-5“黑豹”、F9F-6/8“美洲狮”、<<M0>>“星火”和<<M1>>。这是带加力燃烧室的-5型号，用于<<M0>>。1950年可用。加力推力38.9 kN，无加力推力28.2 kN。总增压比4.4，静止耗油率1.16 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制马赫数1。

s: An early 50s turbojet. The J57 was a workhorse, designed in the early 1950s and powering the B-52, most of the Century Series fighters, and even the U-2. This represents an early model, the -8, which powered the F4D Skyray/F5D Skylancer. Available 1951. 64.5kN wet, 45.3kN dry. OPR 11.9, SFC 0.90/2.1 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 1.5.
zh: 一款50年代初期的涡轮喷气发动机。J57是一款功勋主力发动机，于1950年代初设计，曾为<<M0>>、大部分“百系列”战斗机甚至<<M1>>提供动力。这是其早期型号-8，曾为F4D“天光”/F5D“空中柳叶刀”提供动力。1951年可用。加力推力64.5 kN，无加力推力45.3 kN。总增压比11.9，静止耗油率0.90/2.1 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制马赫数1.5。

s: The J85 was developed as a small, disposable jet engine to power decoys and drones, but was later upgraded for use on manned aircraft. It powered many small aircraft, including the F-5, CF-5, G.91Y, T-2, T-38, and A-37. This is the afterburning -5 variant, which powered the F-5A/B Freedom Fighter. Available 1959. Thrust 17.1 kN wet, 11.9 kN dry. OPR 6.5, SFC 1.03/2.2 lb/lbf-hr static.
zh: J85最初作为一款小型一次性喷气发动机研发，用于为诱饵弹和无人机提供动力，但后来升级用于有人驾驶飞机。它为包括<<M0>>、<<M1>>、G.91Y、<<M2>>、<<M3>>和<<M4>>在内的众多小型飞机提供了动力。这是带加力燃烧室的-5型号，用于为<<M5>>/B“自由战士”提供动力。1959年可用。推力加力17.1 kN，无加力11.9 kN。总增压比6.5，静止耗油率1.03/2.2 lb/lbf-hr。

s: A late 50s turbojet. Based on the Pratt & Whitney J57, the Model 304-2 was a liquid-hydrogen fueled turbojet, designed for project SUNTAN, a high performance replacement for the U-2 spyplane. The project required the development of large-scale Liquid Hydrogen production and handling techniques, at the cost of hundreds of millions of dollars, but the results were impressive. Pratt & Whitney were able to convert various jet engines to hydrogen power, where they showed incredible stability and efficiency. This information, along with many of the engineers involved in the project, were later transferred to working on the Pratt & Whitney RL-10, where the information gained proved invaluable. The Model 304 and project SUNTAN, however, were ultimately cancelled, as the conventionally fueled A-12/SR-71 was showing much greater promise. This represents the Model 304-2, the most advanced design developed before the cancellation of the project. Available 1959. 60.1 kN wet, 32.1 kN dry. OPR 5.1, SFC 0.38/0.9 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 3.0.
zh: 一款50年代后期的涡轮喷气发动机。Model 304-2基于普拉特·惠特尼J57研制，是一款液氢燃料涡轮喷气发动机，专为“日晒”（SUNTAN）项目设计，旨在作为<<M0>>侦察机的高性能替代方案。该项目耗资数亿美元，需要开发大规模液氢生产与处理技术，但成果令人印象深刻。普拉特·惠特尼成功将多种喷气发动机改造成氢燃料驱动，展现出令人难以置信的稳定性和效率。这些技术积累以及许多参与该项目的工程师后来转入普拉特·惠特尼<<M1>>的研发工作中，所获得的经验被证明是无价的。然而，由于常规燃料的<<M2>>/<<M3>>展现出更大的潜力，Model 304和SUNTAN项目最终被取消。这代表了项目取消前开发的最先进型号Model 304-2。1959年可用。加力推力60.1 kN，无加力推力32.1 kN。总增压比5.1，静止耗油率0.38/0.9 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制马赫数3.0。

s: A late 1960s turbojet. The ultimate version of the Olympus turbojet, designed for sustained Mach 2 operation to power Concorde. Although thirsty at sea level, when mated to a well-optimized intake this engine can supercruise at Mach 2, achieving relatively good efficiency. This represents the Olympus 593 Mk.610, as used in all production Concordes. Available 1969. 169.2kN wet, 139.4kN dry. OPR 15.5, SFC 0.87/1.39 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 3.0.
zh: 一款1960年代后期的涡轮喷气发动机。“奥林匹斯”（Olympus）涡轮喷气发动机的终极版本，专为协和式客机持续以2马赫巡航而设计。虽然海平面油耗极高，但在搭配高度优化的进气道后，该发动机能以2马赫超音速巡航并保持相对优异的效率。这代表了Olympus 593 Mk.610，用于所有量产型协和客机。1969年可用。加力推力169.2 kN，无加力推力139.4 kN。总增压比15.5，静止耗油率0.87/1.39 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制马赫数3.0。

s: A late 50s turbojet. Developed in parallel with the less sophisticated RD-9, the R-11 became the powerplant for the MiG-21, Yak-28 and Su-15. This an early model, the F2-300, which powered the MiG-21PF. Available 1960. 60.8kN wet, 38.3kN dry. OPR 8.8, SFC 0.95/2.37 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 2.5.
zh: 一款50年代后期的涡轮喷气发动机。与结构较为简单的<<M0>>并行研发，<<M1>>成为了<<M2>>、<<M3>>和<<M4>>的动力装置。这是早期型号F2-300，曾为<<M5>>提供动力。1960年可用。加力推力60.8 kN，无加力推力38.3 kN。总增压比8.8，静止耗油率0.95/2.37 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制马赫数2.5。

s: A late 50s turbojet. Originally developed for the Tu-121 cruise missile, the R-15 was modified instead for use on the MiG-25, which became the fastest serially produced fighter, capable of reaching Mach 3.2, although at the risk of severe engine damage. This is a later model, the BD-300, used on the MiG-25RB. Available 1969. 109.8kN wet, 86.3kN dry. OPR 4.75, SFC 1.25/2.75 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 3.5.
zh: 一款50年代后期的涡轮喷气发动机。<<M1>>最初为<<M0>>巡航导弹研制，后改为用于<<M2>>——这使其成为飞行速度最快的量产战斗机，能够达到3.2马赫（尽管有造成发动机严重损坏的风险）。这是后期的型号<<M3>>，用于<<M4>>。1969年可用。加力推力109.8 kN，无加力推力86.3 kN。总增压比4.75，静止耗油率1.25/2.75 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制马赫数3.5。

s: A late 60s turbojet. Developed to replace the R-11 and R-13, the R-25 added an extremely powerful "extra-power" afterburner, that allowed it to nearly double it's thrust for short periods of time. This is the production model, used on the MiG-21Bis and Su-15Bis. 97.1kN wet, 40.3kN dry. OPR 9.5, SFC 0.96/3.34 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 2.5.
zh: 一款60年代后期的涡轮喷气发动机。<<M2>>旨在替代<<M0>>和<<M1>>，增加了一个极其强劲的“超功率”加力燃烧室，能在短时间内使其推力几乎翻倍。这是量产型号，用于<<M3>>和<<M4>>。加力推力97.1 kN，无加力推力40.3 kN。总增压比9.5，静止耗油率0.96/3.34 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制马赫数2.5。

s: An early 50s turbojet. Developed as a scaled down Mikulin AM-3, the RD-9 was designed for fighter aircraft, and powered the Yak-25, 26, 27, 28, and MiG-19. This represents an early model, the -9B, which powered early MiG-19s. 31.9kN wet, 25.1kN dry. Available 1951. OPR 7.14, SFC 0.96/1.6 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 1.5.
zh: 一款50年代初期的涡轮喷气发动机。<<M1>>作为米库林<<M0>>的缩尺改进型号研发，专为战斗机设计，曾为<<M2>>、26、27、28以及<<M3>>提供动力。这代表了早期型号-9B，曾为早期的<<M4>>提供动力。加力推力31.9 kN，无加力推力25.1 kN。1951年可用。总增压比7.14，静止耗油率0.96/1.6 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制马赫数1.5。

s: The CASTOR 30B is a low cost, robust, state-of-the-art upper stage motor. This production motor incorporates a few modifications from the CASTOR 30, primarily a change in propellant and a longer nozzle. It is 169.9 inches long and nominally designed as an upper stage that can function as a second or third stage depending on the vehicle configuration.
zh: CASTOR 30B 是一款低成本、坚固且先进的上面级发动机。该量产型发动机在 CASTOR 30 的基础上进行了一些改进，主要是更换了推进剂并加长了喷管。其长度为 169.9 英寸，标称设计为上面级，可根据运载火箭的构型作为第二级或第三级使用。

s: The CASTOR 30XL is more than a stretched version of the CASTOR 30. The motor is 235.8 inches long and designed to function as a second or third stage depending on vehicle configuration. The nozzle is 8 feet long and submerged, with a high expansion ratio (55.9:1), a dual density exit cone for high altitude operation, and an electro-mechanical TVA system.
zh: CASTOR 30XL 不仅仅是 CASTOR 30 的加长版本。该发动机长 235.8 英寸，根据火箭构型可用作第二级或第三级。喷管长 8 英尺且为潜入式设计，具有高膨胀比（55.9:1）、适用于高空运作的双密度出口锥头，以及机电式推力矢量控制（TVA）系统。

s: The Castor 120 is a medium solid booster used on the Minotaur and Athena launch vehicles. Its design was based on the TU-903, which serves as the first stage of the Peacekeeper ICBM. The standard thrust curve can be modified to produce a regressive burn that reduces maximum acceleration or a saddle-shaped profile that limits aerodynamic forces. Burn time 79 seconds.
zh: Castor 120 是一款用于米诺陶（Minotaur）和雅典娜（Athena）运载火箭的中型固体助推器。其设计基于和平卫士洲际弹道导弹第一级所采用的 <<M0>>。标准推力曲线可进行修改，以产生降低最大加速度的递减燃烧方案，或限制空气动力载荷的鞍形推力曲线。燃烧时间 79 秒。

s: The Co-Optimized Booster for Reusable Applications was an early 2000s atmospheric staged combustion hydrolox engine. Developed as the main engine for a Space Shuttle replacement through the Space Launch Initiative program. Extremely high performance, but cancelled during prototype phase.
zh: 可重复使用应用协同优化助推器（COBRA）是 2000 年代初研制的大气层分级燃烧循环氢氧发动机。它作为“航天发射倡议”计划中航天飞机替代方案的主发动机而开发。性能极高，但在原型机阶段被取消。

s: The Co-optimized Booster for Reusable Applications was proposed by Pratt & Whitney-Aerojet Propulsion Associates to cover a wide range of thrust. This hydrolox reusable rocket engine was designed in 2003 to produce 4500 kN thrust. Proposed as a long-life, moderate-to high-thrust, reusable booster engine with a safe and low-cost single burner and a fuel-rich staged combustion cycle.
zh: 可重复使用应用协同优化助推器（COBRA）由普惠-喷气飞机构造推进联合公司提出，旨在覆盖广泛的推力范围。这款氢氧可重复使用火箭发动机于 2003 年设计，可产生 4500 kN 推力。其定位为长寿命、中高推力的可重复使用助推级发动机，配备安全低成本的单燃烧室和富燃分级燃烧循环。

s: The Aerojet Dual Fuel Mixed-Mode High Pressure Engine for SSTO Vehicles. It burned RP-1 and LOX in sea level mode, and then at high altitude would deploy a nozzle extension and switch to burning LH2 and LOX for higher performance.
zh: 喷气飞机公司为单级入轨（SSTO）运载器设计的高压双燃料混合模式发动机。它在海平面模式下燃烧 <<M0>> 和液氧，随后在高空开启喷管延伸段并切换为燃烧液氢和液氧以获得更高的性能。

s: The Dual Stage 4 Grid (DS4G) ion thruster was developed primarily by the European Space Agency for a variety of future deep space missions. This version is their most robust design, designed for deep space missions. Requires 50kW of electrical power. NOTE: This engine is based on technical design and test articles.
zh: 双级四栅极（<<M0>>）离子推力器主要由欧洲空间局开发，用于各种未来的深空任务。此版本是他们最为坚固可靠的设计，专为深空任务打造。需要 50 kW 电功率。注意：该发动机基于技术设计方案和测试件制作。

s: An open cycle kerolox booster engine developed from LR79/89. It was a backup proposal for the first stage engine on the Titan 1 ICBM, and proposed first stage engine on the Saturn 1, but ultimately never flown (4 E-1s were replaced by 8 H-1s).
zh: 基于 LR79/89 研制的开式循环煤油/液氧助推器发动机。它曾是大力神 1 号洲际弹道导弹第一级发动机的备选方案，也曾被提议用作土星 1 号的第一级发动机，但最终从未升空飞行（4 台 <<M0>> 被 8 台 <<M1>> 取代）。

s: The EPEX (Electrical Propulsion Experiment) was a pulsed magnetoplasmadynamic thruster, tested on the Japanese Space Flyer Unit satellite in 1995. Although the Soviet Union experimented with MPD thrusters extensively, the Space Flyer Unit was the first spacecraft to use an MPD thruster as its main propulsion system.
zh: EPEX（电推进实验）是一种脉冲磁等离子体动力（MPD）推力器，于 1995 年在日本太空巡航单元（SFU）卫星上进行了测试。尽管苏联曾广泛开展过 MPD 推力器实验，但太空巡航单元是首个将 MPD 推力器作为主推进系统的航天器。

s: The massive Rocketdyne F-1 engine. One of the largest, most powerful rocket engines ever built. Ensure you enable roll capability or disable gimbal as required for your application. Represents the throttlable F-1A engine as found in 'Eyes Turned Skyward'.
zh: 巨大的 Rocketdyne <<M0>> 发动机，是有史以来建造的最大、推力最强的火箭发动机之一。请根据你的任务需求确保开启滚转控制功能或禁用万向节。该型号代表架空历史《仰望苍穹》（Eyes Turned Skyward）中出现的具备节流能力的 <<M1>> 发动机。

s: The pulsed inductive thruster uses a powerful magnetic pulse to ionize and accelerate gas. It can achieve impressive ISPs and be scaled up simply by increasing the pulse rate. However, it consumes a considerable amount of power. FARAD (Faraday Accelerator with Radio-Frequency Assisted Discharge) ionizes gas before it is exposed to the magnetic field, greatly reducing the required pulse energy, allowing for a much smaller thruster.
zh: 脉冲感应推力器利用强磁脉冲使气体电离并加速。它可以实现惊人的比冲，并只需提高脉冲频率就能扩展推力。然而，它的耗电量相当可观。法拉第射频辅助放电加速器（FARAD）在气体接触磁场前将其电离，大幅降低了所需的脉冲能量，从而使得推力器体积得以大幅缩减。

s: The F-1B engine was designed to power the proposed Pyrios advanced boosters for the Space Launch System. A highly modified version of the original F-1, the F-1B uses modern manufacturing techniques including 3-D printing and features a simpler gas generator exhaust arrangement in order to reduce manufacturing costs and increase thrust at a slight cost of efficiency.
zh: <<M0>> 发动机旨在为太空发射系统（SLS）拟议的 Pyrios 先进助推器提供动力。作为原始 <<M1>> 的深度改进版本，<<M0>> 采用了包括 3D 打印在内的现代制造技术，并具有更简单的燃气发生器排气布局，从而在轻微牺牲效率的代价下降低了制造成本并提高了推力。

s: This was developed for the NOMAD high energy upper stage, intended to replace Agena. The hydrazine/fluorine propellant mix showed impressive performance in testing, but concerns over the toxicity of fluorine lead to the project being cancelled after extensive work had already been done.
zh: 该发动机专为 NOMAD 高能上面级研制，旨在取代阿金纳（Agena）。肼/氟推进剂组合在测试中展现出了惊人的性能，但由于对氟毒性的担忧，该项目在进行了大量前期工作后最终被取消。

s: A two chamber version of Gamma, used for the second stage of the Black Arrow satellite launch vehicle. As the only Gamma not required to operate at sea level, the nozzles were extended to allow better expansion.
zh: 伽马（Gamma）发动机的双燃烧室版本，用于黑箭号卫星运载火箭的第二级。作为唯一不需要在海平面运作的伽马型号，其喷管经过延伸以提供更好的膨胀效果。

s: This was an 8 chamber development of Gamma, used for the first stage of the Black Arrow satellite launch vehicle. Gamma thrust chambers were mounted in pairs radially, each pair on a one-axis tangential gimbal. Collective movement gave roll control while differential movement gave pitch control.
zh: 这是伽马（Gamma）发动机的 8 燃烧室衍生型号，用于黑箭号卫星运载火箭的第一级。伽马的推力室沿径向成对安装，每对安装在一个单轴切向万向节上。同向偏转提供滚转控制，差动偏转提供俯仰控制。

s: This was an 4 chamber development of Gamma, used for the first stage of the Black Knight sounding rocket. Gamma thrust chambers were mounted in pairs radially, each pair on a one-axis tangential gimbal. Collective movement gave roll control while differential movement gave pitch control.
zh: 这是伽马（Gamma）发动机的 4 燃烧室衍生型号，用于黑骑士探空火箭的第一级。伽马的推力室沿径向成对安装，每对安装在一个单轴切向万向节上。同向偏转提供滚转控制，差动偏转提供俯仰控制。

s: The Graphite-Epoxy Motor (GEM) replaced the steel case used on earlier Castor-series boosters with a lighter composite case. The 40-inch (1-meter) diameter GEM 40 was used on the Delta II 7000-series in sets of three, four, or nine. When nine boosters were used, six were ignited at liftoff and the remaining three were ignited after burnout and jettison of the first six. Burn time: 58 seconds.
zh: 石墨-环氧树脂发动机（GEM）用更轻的复合材料壳体取代了早期卡斯托尔（Castor）系列助推器使用的钢制壳体。直径 40 英寸（1 米）的 GEM 40 以 3 台、4 台或 9 台一组的形式用于德尔塔 II 7000 系列。当使用 9 台助推器时，6 台在起飞时点火，其余 3 台在首批 6 台燃尽脱离后点火。燃烧时间：58 秒。

s: The 46-inch (1.2-m) diameter GEM 46 was used on the Delta III and Delta II Heavy in sets of nine, with six ignited at liftoff and three ignited after burnout of the first six. On the Delta III, three ground-lit boosters were equipped with TVC while all the remaining boosters used fixed nozzles. The Delta II Heavy used no boosters with TVC. Burn time 75 seconds.
zh: 直径 46 英寸（1.2 米）的 GEM 46 以 9 台一组的形式用于德尔塔 III 和德尔塔 II 重型火箭，其中 6 台在起飞时点火，3 台在前 6 台燃尽后点火。在德尔塔 III 上，3 台地面点火的助推器配备了推力矢量控制（TVC），其余助推器均采用固定喷管。德尔塔 II 重型火箭则完全没有使用配备 TVC 的助推器。燃烧时间 75 秒。

s: The KTDU-35 is a gas generator hypergolic engine capable of multiple ignitions, used on the first generation Soyuz and Progress spacecrafts (the 7K series). It consists of the single nozzle S5.60 main engine and the dual nozzle S5.35 backup engine. If the main engine fails, the backup one will assume its position.
zh: <<M0>> 是一款具备多次点火能力的气体发生器循环自燃推进剂发动机，用于第一代联盟号和进步号航天器（7K系列）。它由单喷管的 S5.60 主发动机和双喷管的 S5.35 备用发动机组成。若主发动机发生故障，备用发动机将接替其工作。

s: The landing engine for Luna 15-24. The main gas generator engine was used for orbital manuevering and descent, and then switched over to a secondary pressure-fed engine for terminal descent. Use an action group to toggle between the main and secondary engines quickly to make landing easier.
zh: 月球 15-24 号的着陆发动机。主发动机采用气体发生器循环，用于轨道机动和动力下降，随后切换至挤压循环的副发动机进行末段下降。使用动作组在主副发动机之间快速开关切换，可以让着陆更加轻松。

s: A staged combustion hydrolox engine intended for the N-1M, considered for Proton and Angara, and eventually licensed to India for its GSLV. Later versions were developed by India for domestic use as the CE-7.5. The main engine bell is fixed in place and two verniers provide combined pitch-yaw-roll control. This engine runs with a somewhat higher than average O/F ratio, resulting in a denser than average hydrolox stage.
zh: 一款专为 <<M0>> 设计的分级燃烧氢氧发动机，曾考虑用于质子号和安加拉号，最终授权给印度用于其 GSLV。印度后来在此基础上自行研发了 <<M1>>.5。该发动机的主喷管固定不偏转，由两个游标喷管提供俯仰、偏航和滚转联合控制。其运行氧燃比较常规发动机略高，使得氢氧级的推进剂密度高于平均水平。

s: The LE-5 is a gas generator hydrolox engine, the first natively-developed Japanese hydrolox engine, designed for use on the second stage of the H-1 launch vehicle. It was then completely redesigned into the world's first expander bleed cycle engine for use on the H-II. It has gone through several evolutions since, being used on the H-IIA, H-IIB, and planned for the H-3.
zh: <<M0>> 是一款气体发生器循环氢氧发动机，也是日本自主研发的首款氢氧发动机，专为 <<M1>> 运载火箭二级设计。随后它被彻底重新设计为世界上第一款开式膨胀循环发动机，用于 H-II 火箭。自那以后它历经数次改进，曾用于 H-IIA、H-IIB，并计划用于 <<M2>>。

s: A fuel-rich staged combustion engine used on the core stage of H-II series launchers. The original LE-7 was replaced by the LE-7A, which sacrificed some performance in favor of reduced cost and better reliability.
zh: 一款富燃分级燃烧发动机，用于 H-II 系列运载火箭的核心级。最初的 <<M0>> 后来被 <<M1>> 取代，后者牺牲了部分性能以换取更低的成本和更高的可靠性。

s: An expander-bleed cycle booster engine, developed for the Japanese H-3 launch vehicle. The use of an expander-bleed cycle makes the engine much cheaper than it's staged combustion predecessor, the LE-7.
zh: 一款为日本 <<M0>> 运载火箭开发的开式膨胀循环助推器发动机。采用开式膨胀循环使其造价比其分级燃烧的前代型号 <<M1>> 便宜得多。

s: LEROS is a family of chemical rocket engines manufactured by Moog-ISP. LEROS engines have been used as primary apogee engines for telecommunications satellites such as the Lockheed Martin A2100 as well as deep space missions such as Juno.
zh: LEROS 是由 Moog-ISP 生产的化学火箭发动机家族。LEROS 发动机曾用作通信卫星（如洛克希德·马丁公司的 <<M0>>）的主远地点发动机，亦用于深空探测任务（如朱诺号）。

s: The LEROS 4 High Thrust Apogee Engine is an ESA-funded 1100 N engine undergoing development by Moog. It will support the agency's future interplanetary missions by reducing the mass of spacecraft propellant required for orbit insertion maneuvers, allowing more scientific payload to be carried.
zh: LEROS 4 高推力远地点发动机是由欧空局出资、Moog 正在研发的一款 1100 N 发动机。它将通过减少航天器进行入轨机动所需的推进剂质量，为欧空局未来的行星际任务提供支持，从而允许携带更多热心科研有效载荷。

s: An American closed cycle gas core nuclear rocket. Fissile material is contained in fused quartz "lightbulbs", cooled by continuously circulating neon. Propellant passed over these "lightbulbs" is heated to incredible temperatures by the intense light and radiation produced by the nuclear reaction. This design prevents any fissile material from escaping the engine, but reduces performance due to heat transfer losses.
zh: 一款美国闭式循环气冷反应堆核火箭。裂变材料装在熔融石英“灯泡”内，由不断循环的氖气进行冷却。流经这些“灯泡”的推进剂被核反应产生的强烈光辐射加热至极高温度。该设计防止了任何裂变材料泄漏出发动机，但由于传热损耗而降低了性能。

s: A deeply-throttleable pressure-fed engine used for the descent module of the Apollo lunar lander. The version on J-class missions had slightly higher isp, which helped give payload capacity for the rover and other equipment. A later variant (TR-201) was used on Delta P series as an upper stage engine; this was a low-cost model with more restarts and slightly higher thrust but with lower efficiency and no throttling.
zh: 一款用于阿波罗登月舱下降级的大范围节流挤压循环发动机。J级任务使用的版本比冲略高，有助于为月球车和其他设备提供有效载荷能力。后期的改型（<<M0>>）用作德尔塔 P 系列的上面级发动机；那是一款低成本型号，具有更多重启次数和略高的推力，但效率较低且无法节流。

s: The low-pressure NTR is a proposal for a higher performance NTR, relying on hydrogen dissociation. By decreasing the chamber pressure of an NTR to near atmospheric pressure, it is possible to trigger dissociation of diatomic hydrogen into monatomic hydrogen, greatly increasing specific impulse. This low pressure also allows for extremely lightweight construction, allowing for an acceptable TWR despite the low mass flow. The LPNTR is also extremely simple, requiring no pumps, and self-regulating using hydrogen as a moderator, although it also lacks a gimbal.
zh: 低压 NTR 是一种基于氢解离原理的高性能核热火箭提案。通过将 NTR 的燃烧室压力降至接近大气压，可以触发双原子氢解离为单原子氢，从而大幅提高比冲。这种低压还允许采用极轻量化的结构，尽管质量流量较低，但仍可实现可观的 TWR。LPNTR 结构也极其简单，不需要泵，并利用氢作为慢化剂实现自调节，不过它也没有万向节。

s: A long-lasting US kerolox gas-generator booster engine. The same components and broadly the same performance as the LR89, the LR79 (also known as S-3D in Jupiter / Juno II) powered the Jupiter, Thor, and Thor-Delta (Delta) rockets.
zh: 一款长寿的美国液氧煤油气体发生器循环助推器发动机。<<M1>>（在朱庇特 / 朱诺二号中亦称 <<M2>>）采用与 <<M0>> 相同的部件，性能也大体相当，曾为朱庇特、雷神和雷神-德尔塔（德尔塔）火箭提供动力。

s: Used in the first stage of the Titan rocket family, the LR87 is composed of two engines with separate turbomachinery integrated into one unit. The version used on Titan I burned kerosene and liquid oxygen, while Titan II through Titan IV burned storable propellants. A modified version burning liquid hydrogen was developed for the upper stages of Saturn V and Saturn IB, but the J-2 was selected instead.
zh: <<M0>> 用于大力神系列火箭的第一级，由两台拥有独立涡轮泵的发动机组合为一个动力单元。用于大力神 I 的版本燃烧煤油和液氧，而大力神 II 到大力神 IV 则改用可贮存推进剂。曾开发过一款燃烧液氢的改进版本用于土星五号和土星 IB 的上面级，但最终入选的是 <<M1>>。

s: Aerojet developed the LR87 engine (used for the Titan series) into a liquid hydrogen/oxygen engine for prospective USAF contracts in the 1958-1960 period, at the same time Aerojet was converting the LR87 to burn Aerozine and NTO. Aerojet also proposed this engine for Saturn upper stage duties, but NASA selected the J-2 over the LR87-LH2 and it was canceled in 1961.
zh: 在 1958-1960 年间，Aerojet 将用于大力神系列的 <<M0>> 发动机改装为液氢/液氧发动机以竞标美国空军合同，与此同时 Aerojet 也在改造 <<M0>> 以燃烧混肼50和四氧化二氮。Aerojet 还提议将该发动机用于土星火箭上面级任务，但 NASA 最终选择了 <<M1>> 而非 <<M0>>-LH2，该项目于 1961 年取消。

s: Beginning its life as the etholox-powered XLR43-NA-3, this was the first US engine to use tubular-wall construction for its combustion chamber. It served as the basis for early orbital US engines, with its lineage stretching to the 21st century. The LR43 was converted to run on kerosene for Atlas and was later renamed LR89, and the LR79 derivative powered Thor. Later LR89s used RS-27 components for higher efficiency, whereas the RS-27 itself was used on Delta by that point. LR89 configs are comparable to similar-era -79 configs, since they were the same engine underneath.
zh: 该系列最初为采用乙醇-液氧推进剂的 <<M0>>-<<M1>>，是美国首款采用管束焊接推力室壁结构的发动机。它构成了美国早期轨道发动机的基础，其血统一直延续到了 21 世纪。<<M2>> 改为使用煤油以适配宇宙神，随后更名为 <<M3>>，其衍生型号 <<M4>> 则为雷神火箭提供动力。后期的 <<M5>> 采用了 <<M6>> 的部件以提高效率，而此时 <<M6>> 本身已被德尔塔火箭采用。<<M3>> 的构型与同时期的 -79 构型相当，因为二者本质上是同一款发动机。

s: A pump or pressure-fed kerolox vernier engine. Used for attitude control and final velocity adjustment in the MA-x system (2x LR89 + LR105 + 2x LR101) on Atlas, and MB-x system (LR79 or RS-27 + 2xLR101) on Thor-Able, Thor-Agena, Thor-Delta, and Delta.
zh: 一款泵压或挤压循环的液氧煤油游标发动机。用于宇宙神火箭的 MA-x 系统（2x <<M0>> + <<M1>> + 2x <<M2>>），以及雷神-埃布尔、雷神-阿金纳、雷神-德尔塔和德尔塔火箭的 MB-x 系统（<<M3>> 或 <<M4>> + 2<<M5>>），负责姿态控制和最终速度修正。

s: A kerolox gas-generator sustainer engine used in the Atlas launch vehicle. It, like the Atlas's booster engines (LR89s), is lit on the ground, but after a bit over 2 minutes the boosters are dropped and Atlas continues to orbit under the power of the LR105 (with the verniers for roll control and final adjustment). The final configuration of the LR105 (like the LR89) uses RS-27 components for better performance. As a sustainer, the LR105 has sea level and vacuum efficiencies somewhere between a booster and an upper stage engine.
zh: 一种用于宇宙神运载火箭的煤油/液氧燃气发生器循环持续机发动机。与宇宙神的助推器发动机（<<M0>>）一样，它在地面点火，但约两分多钟后助推器分离，宇宙神依靠<<M1>>的动力继续飞往轨道（利用游标发动机进行滚转控制与最终调整）。<<M1>>的最终构型（如<<M2>>）使用了<<M3>>组件以获得更优性能。作为持续机，<<M1>>的海平面与真空效率介于助推级和上面级发动机之间。

s: A staged combustion sustainer engine developed for the USAF ISINGLASS spaceplane. After the ISINGLASS project was cancelled, it was adapted by P&W for their SSME proposal. It utilized staged combustion, mixture control, and extendable nozzles to allow for versatility and high performance.
zh: 一种为美国空军 ISINGLASS 空天飞机研制的分级燃烧循环持续机发动机。在 ISINGLASS 项目取消后，普惠公司将其改型用于其 SSME 竞标方案。它采用了分级燃烧循环、混合比控制以及可延伸喷管，具备出色的多任务适应能力与高性能。

s: Developed from the RS-25 SSME, the Liquid Rocket Booster Engine (LRBE) was a design concept for a liquid fueled Space Shuttle booster. Methane was chosen as a fuel, which increased density and thrust while still allowing fuel-rich staged combustion.
zh: 液体火箭助推器发动机（LRBE）基于<<M0>> SSME 研发，是一种用于航天飞机液体燃料助推器的概念设计。它选用甲烷作为燃料，在提高密度和推力的同时，仍保留了富燃分级燃烧循环的能力。

s: A "radiator" liquid core nuclear thermal rocket developed by Lewis Research Center. Rather than bubbling hydrogen through the reactor core, it is used to regeneratively cool the reactor walls, then flow through the middle of the reactor to be heated by radiation. Although this is less efficient than a "bubbler" reactor, the reduced interaction with the reactor core allows for much higher mass flow rates without excessive fuel loss, resulting in a higher TWR. The simpler core design also means it can be reloaded with fuel on-orbit (requires Near Future Electrical).
zh: 由刘易斯研究中心（Lewis Research Center）研制的一种“辐射式”液核热核火箭。它不采用氢气直接在反应堆堆芯中起泡穿流的方案，而是先利用氢气对反应堆壁进行再生冷却，再流经堆芯中央吸收辐射加热。尽管热效率低于“起泡式”反应堆，但由于减少了推进剂与堆芯的直接接触，它能在避免核燃料严重损耗的前提下实现极高的质量流量，从而获得更高的 TWR。堆芯设计相对简单，也意味着它可以在轨道上重新加注核燃料（需要 Near Future Electrical 支持）。

s: The massive M-1 engine was the largest and most powerful hydrolox engine ever designed and individual components have been tested. It was generally designed as an upper stage engine, but first stage designs with expanding nozzles were also worked on.
zh: 巨大的<<M0>>发动机是有史以来设计过的尺寸最大、推力最强的氢氧发动机，部分独立组件曾进行过点火测试。它通常被设计为上面级发动机，但也开展过配备膨胀喷管的一级发动机设计工作。

s: Italian expander cycle methalox upper stage engine. Originally developed as a derivative of the RD-0146 in collaboration with KBKhA, sanctions levied against Russia in 2014 forced Avio to continue the development alone. The engine is intended to be used as the third stage of the new Vega-E launch vehicle, with it's first flight planned for 2026.
zh: 意大利膨胀循环甲烷/液氧上面级发动机。该发动机最初与<<M1>>合作研制，作为<<M0>>的衍生型号。2014 年对俄制裁实施后，Avio 被迫独立继续推进研制。该发动机计划用作新型织女星-E（Vega-E）运载火箭的第三级，首飞定于 2026 年。

s: The Mars Landing Engine (MLE) is a derivative of the highly successful MR-80 engine used for the two Viking missions to Mars in 1976. Eight of these engines were used on the sky-crane which landed the Curiosity Rover on the martian surface.
zh: 火星着陆发动机（MLE）衍生自极其成功的<<M0>>发动机，后者曾在 1976 年的两次海盗号火星任务中使用。在好奇号火星车着陆火星表面的空中起重机上，共安装了八台此类发动机。

s: The "Nerva NRX" series is a 1200MW reactor. A partial flight test prototype originally based on the KIWI B4E replacing the "Hot End Seal" with peripheral systems. Its core is capable of starting up thirty times. An integral Tungsten Boron composite shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shut down gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted three to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be eight to ten meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. This rocket represents the beginnings of a more powerful and capable series of rocket. This version features a fixed regeneratively cooled nozzle with a 50:1 expansion ratio. Nozzle Ae=50 Chamber Temp=2550 Ideal ISP=943 Reactor Power=1197MW(th) TWR=2.19 Chamber Pressure=4151kPa Ignitions =30 Tonnage including integral shadow shield: 11.33tons
zh: “Nerva NRX”系列是一台 1200MW 的反应堆。作为部分飞行测试原型，它最初基于 KIWI B4E 改进，以外围系统取代了“热端密封”。其堆芯具备 30 次启动能力。集成有整体式钨-硼复合屏蔽层，整个组件均采用再生冷却。辅助回路可将关机排放气体导入小型热机，以最大程度减少燃料损失并提供基础交流电源。该发动机安装位置距最近的燃料储罐应保持 3 至 6 米。运行期间燃料可用于为乘员提供辐射屏蔽，乘员舱位距发动机应保持 8 至 10 米。增设水箱或高密度燃料储罐等额外屏蔽可适当缩短此距离。该火箭代表了一系列性能更强劲火箭的开端。该版本配备膨胀比为 50:1 的固定式再生冷却喷管。喷管膨胀比=50 燃烧室温度=2550 理想比冲=943 反应堆热功率=1197MW(th) TWR=2.19 燃烧室压力=4151kPa 点火次数=30 含集成遮蔽屏蔽层总吨位：11.33 吨

s: The "Nerva XE" series is a 1550 MW reactor. A full flight test prototype originally based on the KIWI B4E. Its core is capable of starting up sixty times. An integral Tungsten Boron composite shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shut down gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted three to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be eight to ten meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. This rocket represents the beginnings of a more powerful and capable series of rocket. This version features a fixed regeneratively cooled nozzle with a 100:1 expansion ratio. Nozzle Ae=100 Chamber Temp=2500 Ideal ISP=945 Reactor Power=1163MW(th) TWR=2.34 Chamber Pressure=3806kPa Ignitions =60 Tonnage including integral shadow shield: 10.38tons
zh: “Nerva XE”系列是一台 1550MW 的反应堆。作为完整飞行测试原型，它最初基于 KIWI B4E 研制。其堆芯具备 60 次启动能力。集成有整体式钨-硼复合屏蔽层，整个组件均采用再生冷却。辅助回路可将关机排放气体导入小型热机，以最大程度减少燃料损失并提供基础交流电源。该发动机安装位置距最近的燃料储罐应保持 3 至 6 米。运行期间燃料可用于为乘员提供辐射屏蔽，乘员舱位距发动机应保持 8 至 10 米。增设水箱或高密度燃料储罐等额外屏蔽可适当缩短此距离。该火箭代表了一系列性能更强劲火箭的开端。该版本配备膨胀比为 100:1 的固定式再生冷却喷管。喷管膨胀比=100 燃烧室温度=2500 理想比冲=945 反应堆热功率=1163MW(th) TWR=2.34 燃烧室压力=3806kPa 点火次数=60 含集成遮蔽屏蔽层总吨位：10.38 吨

s: The NASA Evolutionary Xenon Thruster (NEXT) project at NASA GRC produced quite a little marvel. Certified for flight use, and currently planned for several outer-Solar-System missions, the efficiency of the ion thruster greatly increased the payload weight, at the expense of burn time. Uses about 6.9kW of electricity.
zh: NASA 格伦研究中心（GRC）的 NASA 进化型氙推进器（NEXT）项目打造出了一款令人惊叹的工程杰作。它已通过飞行认证，目前已规划用于多个太阳系外围探索任务。离子推进器极高的效率大幅增加了有效载荷质量，代价则是更长的工作时间。耗电量约为 6.9kW。

s: A staged combustion engine developed as part of an initiative to build a 150-ton-thrust booster engine for the N1. The NK-15 powered the N1, and the NK-33 was developed to power the upgraded N1F. Though the N1F was scrapped, the engines survived and were sold to Aerojet in the 1990s. Refurbished as AJ26-62 engines, they powered Antares. Modifications made by Aerojet included increasing thrust and adding gimbals.
zh: 一种分级燃烧循环发动机，最初作为为 N1 火箭研制 150 吨级推力助推器发动机计划的一部分而研发。<<M0>>为 N1 提供动力，而研制<<M1>>则是为了驱动升级版的 N1F。尽管 N1F 项目被废弃，但这批发动机幸存下来并在 20 世纪 90 年代售予喷气飞机公司（Aerojet）。翻新后的型号命名为<<M2>>-62，用于安塔瑞斯运载火箭。Aerojet 进行的改进包括提高推力和加装万向节。

s: The pulsed inductive thruster uses a powerful magnetic pulse to ionize and accelerate gas. It can achieve impressive ISPs, and be scaled up simply by increasing the pulse rate. However, it consumes a considerable amount of power. The NuPIT (Nuclear-Electric Pulsed Inductive Thruster) is based on the PIT Mk VII, redesigned for extremely long life for Ice Giant and even Interstellar missions.
zh: 脉冲感应推进器利用强磁脉冲来电离并加速气体。它可以实现惊人的比冲，并且仅需提高脉冲频率即可放大推力。然而，它的功耗相当巨大。<<M0>>（核电脉冲感应推进器）基于 PIT Mk VII，专为冰巨星甚至星际任务重构了超长使用寿命。

s: An American open cycle gas core nuclear rocket. NYRATH (Nuclear electrodYnamic Retention Advanced THermal) uses electrostatic confinment, instead of magnetic confinment, to contain the gaseous fissile core. By exploiting the difference between the ionization energies of uranium and hydrogen, an electrostatic nozzle can prevent fissile material from passing through while allowing hydrogen to leave unhindered. This allows for complete mixing of fissile material and propellant in the core, enabling extremely high energy transfer, and therefore extremely high performance.
zh: 一款美国开式循环气芯核火箭。NYRATH（核<<M0>>滞留先进热力）采用静电约束而非磁约束来容纳气态易裂变核心。利用铀和氢电离能的差异，静电喷管可以阻止裂变材料穿过，同时允许氢气畅通无阻地排出。这使得裂变材料与推进剂在芯级中完全混合，实现极高的能量传递，从而获得极高的性能。

s: A very early Soviet rocket engine, designed by Glushko in 1936 for use on the KR-212 cruise missile, and modified for the rocket aircraft RP-318. It was the first reliable, regeneratively cooled rocket.
zh: 一款非常早期的苏联火箭发动机，由格卢什科于 1936 年为<<M0>>巡航导弹设计，并为<<M1>>火箭飞机进行了改装。它是第一款可靠的再生冷却火箭。

s: Developed jointly by the AFRL and PEPL, the P5 is a dual-stage Hall thruster. This means it can more effectively lens the charged ions, giving you increased thrust above single-stage operation at the expense of efficiency.
zh: P5 由 AFRL 与 PEPL 联合开发，是一款双级霍尔推进器。这意味着它可以更有效地聚焦带电离子，以牺牲效率为代价换取高于单级工作模式的推力。

s: The "PEWEE" series is a smaller 572MW reactor with the highest power density of all the rover tests. It also recorded the Highest ISP ratings of the test at 901s. Its core is capable of starting up to 12 times. An integral Tungsten Boron Composite shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shutdown gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted three to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be nine to twelve meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. Most modern NASA study reactors such as the BNTR are derived in turn from this test reactor. This version features a fixed regeneratively cooled nozzle. Nozzle Ae=100 Chamber Temp=2750 Ideal ISP=998 Reactor Power=572MW(th) TWR=5.07 Chamber Pressure=4344kPa Ignitions =12 Tonnage including integral shadow shield: 2.23tons
zh: “PEWEE”系列是一款较小的 572MW 反应堆，具有所有 Rover 测试中最高的功率密度。它还在测试中创下了 901s 的最高比冲记录。其核心最多可启动 12 次。包含一体式钨硼复合屏蔽层，整个组件均为再生冷却。副回路将停堆气体通过小型热机导出，以最大程度减少燃料损失并提供基础交流发电。该发动机应安装在距离最近推进剂储罐三到六米处。推进剂应为乘员提供屏蔽，运行时乘员位置距发动机应为九到十二米。额外的屏蔽（如水箱或高密度推进剂）可在一定程度上减少此距离。大多数现代 NASA 研究反应堆（例如 BNTR）均源自此测试反应堆。该版本配有固定式再生冷却喷管。喷管面积比=100 燃烧室温度=2750 理想比冲=998 反应堆功率=572MW(th) TWR=5.07 燃烧室压力=4344kPa 点火次数=12 包含一体式阴影屏蔽层重量：2.23tons

s: The "Phoebus 1" series is a 1500MW reactor. Most tests early resulted in failure from pumping or faulted test equipment however much was learned and the development of advanced coatings chemical vapour deposition and lighter materials. Its core is capable of starting up four times. An integral Tungsten Boron composite shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shut down gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted three to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be eight to twelve meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. This rocket represents the beginnings of a more powerful and capable series of rocket. This version features a fixed regeneratively cooled nozzle with a 50:1 expansion ratio. Nozzle Ae=50 Chamber Temp=2445 Ideal ISP=881 Reactor Power=1500MW(th) TWR=3.33 Chamber Pressure=3772kPa Ignitions =4 Tonnage including integral shadow shield: 9.14tons
zh: “Phoebus 1”系列是一款 1500MW 反应堆。早期的多数测试因泵或测试设备故障而失败，但借此掌握了许多经验，并开发了先进涂层、化学气相沉积和更轻的材料。其核心最多可启动四次。包含一体式钨硼复合屏蔽层，整个组件均为再生冷却。副回路将停堆气体通过小型热机导出，以最大程度减少燃料损失并提供基础交流发电。该发动机应安装在距离最近推进剂储罐三到六米处。推进剂应为乘员提供屏蔽，运行时乘员位置距发动机应为八到十二米。额外的屏蔽（如水箱或高密度推进剂）可在一定程度上减少此距离。这枚火箭代表了一系列推力更大、性能更强火箭的开端。该版本配有膨胀比为 50:1 的固定式再生冷却喷管。喷管面积比=50 燃烧室温度=2445 理想比冲=881 反应堆功率=1500MW(th) TWR=3.33 燃烧室压力=3772kPa 点火次数=4 包含一体式阴影屏蔽层重量：9.14tons

s: The "Phoebus 2" series is a 5000MW reactor. Most tests resulted in success proving new coatings worked well and existing at the time as the most powerful reactor core on the planet. Its core is capable of starting up eight times. An integral Tungsten Boron composite shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shut down gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted three to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be ten to fifteen meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. This rocket represents a more powerful and capable series of rocket with a TWR of nearly 6. This version features a fixed regeneratively cooled nozzle with a 100:1 expansion ratio. Nozzle Ae=100 Chamber Temp=2245 Ideal ISP=889 Reactor Power=4182MW(th) TWR=5.48 Chamber Pressure=3825kPa Ignitions =8 Tonnage including integral shadow shield: 16.97tons
zh: “Phoebus 2”系列是一款 5000MW 反应堆。大多数测试均取得成功，证明了新涂层表现优异，并在当时成为全球功率最大的反应堆堆芯。其核心最多可启动八次。包含一体式钨硼复合屏蔽层，整个组件均为再生冷却。副回路将停堆气体通过小型热机导出，以最大程度减少燃料损失并提供基础交流发电。该发动机应安装在距离最近推进剂储罐三到六米处。推进剂应为乘员提供屏蔽，运行时乘员位置距发动机应为十到十五米。额外的屏蔽（如水箱或高密度推进剂）可在一定程度上减少此距离。这枚火箭代表了一系列推力更大、能力更强的火箭，TWR 接近 6。该版本配有膨胀比为 100:1 的固定式再生冷却喷管。喷管面积比=100 燃烧室温度=2245 理想比冲=889 反应堆功率=4182MW(th) TWR=5.48 燃烧室压力=3825kPa 点火次数=8 包含一体式阴影屏蔽层重量：16.97tons

s: The pulsed inductive thruster uses a powerful magnetic pulse to ionize and accelerate gas. It can achieve impressive ISPs, and be scaled up simply by increasing the pulse rate. However, it consumes a considerable amount of power. The Mk V PIT was tested by TRW in 1993 with a variety of voltages, pulse sizes, and propellants.
zh: 脉冲感应推进器利用强磁脉冲来电离并加速气体。它可以实现惊人的比冲，并且仅需提高脉冲频率即可放大推力。然而，它的功耗相当巨大。TRW 于 1993 年使用各种电压、脉冲大小和推进剂测试了 Mk V PIT。

s: A "Bubbler" liquid core nuclear thermal rocket. Hydrogen gas is bubbled through the liquid core of the reactor, resulting in extremely efficient heat transfer and high performance. Unfortunately, unexpected behavior in the hydrogen gas bubbles resulted in large amounts of fuel being lost from the reactor, and temperature and propellant flow had to be reduced, decreasing performance. A later redesign with a different fuel alloy allowed some performance to be restored.
zh: 一种“鼓泡式”液芯核热火箭。氢气通过反应堆的液态堆芯鼓泡而出，从而获得极高的传热效率与优异性能。不幸的是，氢气气泡中不可预见的行为导致大量燃料从反应堆中流失，不得不降低温度与推进剂流量，从而降低了性能。后来采用不同燃料合金的重新设计恢复了部分性能。

s: A 490 N bipropellant thruster found in the propulsion system of the ESA ATV and the Orion MPCV Service Module. It performs orbit-raising maneuvers for many communication satellite platforms, including the Astrium Eurostar 3000, Boeing Space Systems 702HP, MELCO DS-2000, and the Loral LS-1300. The R-4D has also played a role in NASA missions, such as Cassini's orbital insertion around Saturn.
zh: 一款 490 N 双组元推进剂推进器，用于 ESA ATV 与猎户座 MPCV 服务舱的推进系统。它为众多通信卫星平台执行轨道提升机动，包括 Astrium Eurostar 3000、波音太空系统 702HP、三菱电机<<M0>>以及劳拉<<M1>>。<<M2>>还在 NASA 任务中发挥了作用，例如卡西尼号的环土星轨道捕获。

s: The 60-inch (1.5-meter) diameter GEM 60 is used on the Delta IV in sets of two or four. When two boosters are used, both are equipped with thrust vector control (TVC). When four are used, two boosters use TVC while the other two use fixed nozzles to reduce weight. Burn time 90 seconds.
zh: 直径60英寸（1.5米）的GEM 60在德尔塔IV号上以双联或四联方式使用。使用两枚助推器时，两者均配备推力矢量控制（TVC）。使用四枚时，其中两枚配备TVC，另两枚使用固定喷管以减轻重量。工作时间90秒。

s: In 2015, ULA announced that Orbital ATK would develop the GEM 63 as a drop-in replacement for the AJ-60A, and replace Aerojet-Rocketdyne for Atlas V SRMs. The GEM 63 is larger than the GEM 60 used on the Delta IV and cannot thrust vector. As with the AJ-60A, launches using the 4 m fairing will be able to use up to three boosters while up to five can be used with the 5 m fairing.
zh: 2015年，ULA宣布轨道ATK将研发GEM 63作为<<M0>>的直接替代品，取代喷气推进动力航天公司供应宇宙神V号的固推助推器。GEM 63比德尔塔IV号上使用的GEM 60更大，且无推力矢量能力。与<<M0>>一样，使用4米整流罩的发射配置最多可使用三枚助推器，而5米整流罩最多可使用五枚。

s: In addition to the GEM 63 for Atlas V, Orbital ATK will develop a larger variant, the GEM 63XL, for Vulcan. The boosters will be approximately 1.5 m longer than the GEM 63 and Vulcan will be able to use up to four boosters with a four-meter fairing or six boosters with a five-meter fairing.
zh: 除用于宇宙神V号的GEM 63外，轨道ATK还将为火神火箭研发更大的衍生型号GEM 63XL。该助推器比GEM 63长约1.5米，火神火箭在配4米整流罩时最多可使用四枚助推器，配5米整流罩时最多可使用六枚。

s: The H-1 is an upgrade to the original LR79 engine that propelled the Saturn-I and IB vehicles, as well as late-model Delta rockets (as the RS-27). The RS-27A has a higher expansion ratio optimized for performance at altitude since liftoff thrust on the Delta II is augmented by solid boosters.
zh: <<M0>>是早期<<M1>>发动机的升级型号，后者曾为土星I号和IB运载火箭以及后期的德尔塔火箭（代号<<M2>>）提供动力。<<M3>>拥有更大的膨胀比，专为高空性能优化，因为德尔塔II号在起飞阶段由固体助推器增强推力。

s: The High Power Electric Propulsion (HiPEP) unit was designed and tested at NASA Glenn Research Center and can produce more thrust than its smaller cousin. Requires about 39.3kW of electricity. Mass/power ratio: 3.05 kg/kW.
zh: 大功率电推进（<<M0>>）装置由NASA格伦研究中心设计并测试，能产生比同门小型号更大的推力。需要约39.3 kW电力。质量功率比：3.05 kg/kW。

s: Advanced NTR, based on the SNTP/Timberwind design. Higher temperature alloys and a sintered fuel element allow for extremely-high-temperature operation, with specific impulse exceeding 1000 seconds. The use of low-enriched uranium fuel reduces TWR as compared to Timberwind/SNTP designs, but allows for greatly increased core lifetime.
zh: 基于SNTP/Timberwind设计的高级核热火箭（NTR）。耐高温合金与烧结燃料元件使其能够以极高的温度运行，比冲超过1000秒。使用低浓缩铀燃料虽然相比Timberwind/SNTP设计降低了TWR，但大幅延长了堆芯寿命。

s: A 2000s medium TWR vacuum engine, the J-2X was intended to be used on the upper stages of Ares I and Ares V. Development continued after the cancellation of Ares, and early designs of SLS incorporated the engine, but the project was mothballed after the RL10-powered Exploration Upper Stage was selected.
zh: 一款2000年代的中TWR真空发动机，<<M0>>原计划用于战神I号和战神V号的上面级。战神计划取消后研发工作仍继续进行，SLS的早期设计也曾引入该发动机，但在选用<<M1>>驱动的探索上面级（EUS）后，该项目被搁置。

s: Early exploration into pressure-fed hypergolic upper stage engines. This was designed by JPL to be the third stage on the Juno IV launch vehicle. After cancellation of the Juno IV, it was then selected to power the Vega upper stage for the Atlas-Vega launcher, but the Vega program was canceled in 1959. The "6K" upper stage engine was tested often, but never flew.
zh: 压挤式自燃上面级发动机的早期探索产物。由JPL设计，原定作为朱诺IV号运载火箭的第三级。在朱诺IV号取消后，它被选为宇宙神-织女星运载火箭的织女星上面级动力，但织女星计划于1959年取消。该“6K”上面级发动机进行了多次点火测试，但从未实际飞行。

s: Developed by JPL as a high-performance second stage engine, this was intended for the Juno IV launch vehicle and would provide 45,000 pounds of thrust in vacuum. It was tested, but ultimately decided against in favor of the X-405.
zh: 由JPL研制的高性能二级发动机，原定用于朱诺IV号运载火箭，真空推力可达45000磅。曾接受过地面试车，但最终被弃用，转而选择了<<M0>>。

s: The "KIWI A" series is an older 132MW reactor with the lowest power density of all the rover tests. Most tests resulted in failure with shattered fuel elements or faulted test equipment however much was learned and the development of liquid hydrogen pumping is a major accomplishment. Its core is capable of starting up twice. An integral Tungsten shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shutdown gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted two to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be six to nine meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. All subsequent US nuclear thermal rocket designs build off this concept. This version features a very small fixed regeneratively cooled nozzle with a 24:1 area expansion ratio. Nozzle Ae/A*=24 Chamber Temp=2300 Ideal ISP=874 Reactor Power=132MW(th) TWR=0.24 Chamber Pressure=1415kPa Ignitions =2 Tonnage including integral shadow shield: 12.08tons
zh: “KIWI A”系列是一款老旧的132 MW反应堆，是罗孚计划所有试验堆中功率密度最低的。大多数测试均以燃料元件粉碎或测试设备故障告终，但从中积累了大量经验，液氢泵送技术的突破更是重大成就。堆芯可启动两次。内置一体式钨防护罩，整机采用再生冷却。辅助回路将关机吹除气体导入小型热机，以尽量减少燃料损失并提供基本交流发电。该发动机与最近推进剂贮箱的安装距离应为2至6米。推进剂应能屏蔽所有乘员，运行时乘员位置距发动机应为6至9米。水箱或高密度推进剂等额外屏蔽可适当缩减这一距离。后续所有美国核热火箭设计均基于此概念发展而来。该版本采用极小的固定再生冷却喷管，面积膨胀比为24:1。喷管 Ae/A*=24，燃烧室温度=2300，理想比冲=874，反应堆功率=132 MW(th)，TWR=0.24，燃烧室压力=1415 kPa，点火次数=2，含一体式暗区屏蔽质量：12.08吨。

s: A division of Wenkel Corporation, RealChutes was the result of an Industry-Government-Academia Joint Research project undertaken in conjunction with the Kerbal Space Administration (KSA) and the University of Kerbin to develop improved spacecraft recovery systems.
zh: 作为 Wenkel Corporation 的一个部门，<<M0>> 是与坎巴拉航天局（KSA）和坎原大学联合开展的“产官学联合研究”项目的成果，旨在开发更先进的航天器回收系统。

s: Originally founded by Wenkel Kerman in KY 450 to commercialize his vapor-compression refrigeration units for domestic use, the company now develops and manufactures air conditioning and thermal control systems for the aerospace industry. More recently, it has entered the spacecraft recovery systems market through innovative new products by its subsidiary, RealChute Aerodynamic Deacceleration Recovery Systems.
zh: 该公司最初由 Wenkel Kerman 于 KY 450 年创立，旨在将其民用蒸汽压缩制冷机组商业化，如今致力于为航空航天工业开发和制造空调与热控系统。近来，它通过其子公司 <<M0>> 气动减速回收系统的创新产品进军了航天器回收系统市场。

s: After Bob almost splattered against the walls of a descending capsule whose instantly-deploying, one-size fits all parachute ripped off, he demanded change. KSC ignored his demand, citing cost, until he returned with a BACC, a lighter, and an empty bottle of Scotch. Terrified, KSC engineers invented the Real Chute, which is highly configurable gradually deploys.
zh: 在一次返回中，由于瞬间展开的“均码”降落伞直接扯脱，Bob 险些在指令舱内被压成肉泥，随后他便强烈要求整改。KSC 以成本为由无视了他的诉求，直到他拎着一台 BACC 助推器、一个打火机和一瓶喝光的苏格兰威士忌再次登门。KSC 工程师们被吓破了胆，连夜发明了 Real Chute——高度可配置且支持渐进展开。

s: The "KIWI B" series is an older 1100MW reactor with more than 10 times the power density of the A series. Most tests early resulted in failure with shattered fuel elements or faulted test equipment however much was learned and the development of advanced coatings chemical vapour deposition and heat pipes. The final test B4E ran smoothly and even restarted from a cold condition. The first Kiwi B test was run on gaseous hydrogen since hydrogen pumping and storage was in its infancy. Its core is capable of starting up four times. An integral Tungsten shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shut down gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted three to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be eight to twelve meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. This rocket represents the basic and conservative solid core rocket design. The NERVA designs build off this concept. This version features a fixed regeneratively cooled nozzle with a 66:1 expansion ratio. Nozzle Ae=66 Chamber Temp=2473 Ideal ISP=864 Reactor Power=1166MW(th) TWR=2.04 Chamber Pressure=3606kPa Ignitions =4 Tonnage including integral shadow shield: 14.89tons
zh: “KIWI B”系列是一款老旧的1100 MW反应堆，功率密度是A系列的10倍以上。早期的多数测试均以燃料元件粉碎或测试设备故障告终，但推动了先进涂层、化学气相沉积和热管技术的发展。最终的B4E测试运行平稳，甚至完成了冷态重新启动。由于氢泵送和储存技术当时尚处于起步阶段，Kiwi B的首次测试使用的是气态氢。堆芯可启动四次。内置一体式钨防护罩，整机采用再生冷却。辅助回路将关机吹除气体导入小型热机，以尽量减少燃料损失并提供基本交流发电。该发动机与最近推进剂贮箱的安装距离应为3至6米。推进剂应能屏蔽所有乘员，运行时乘员位置距发动机应为8至12米。水箱或高密度推进剂等额外屏蔽可适当缩减这一距离。该火箭代表了基础而保守的固态堆芯火箭设计，NERVA设计均基于此概念发展而来。该版本配备固定再生冷却喷管，膨胀比为66:1。喷管 Ae=66，燃烧室温度=2473，理想比冲=864，反应堆功率=1166 MW(th)，TWR=2.04，燃烧室压力=3606 kPa，点火次数=4，含一体式暗区屏蔽质量：14.89吨。

s: After Bill nearly met fiery doom because his Real Chute could not stop his capsule's screaming descent, he demanded change. KSC ignored his demand, citing cost, until he strapped some spare boosters from Jebediah's Junkyard onto his car and flew into the boardroom one afternoon, terrorizing the already traumatized directors with savage screams and his wafer-thin heatshield. KSC engineers hastily added a drogue chute to their otherwise successful Real Chute design.
zh: 在经历了一次 Real Chute 无法阻止指令舱呼啸坠落、险些烈火焚身的大难不死后，Bill 强烈要求做出改变。KSC 同样以成本为由置之不理，直到某天下午，他用 Jebediah's Junkyard 淘来的废弃助推器绑在车上直接冲进了董事会，伴随着野兽般的咆哮和薄如蝉翼的隔热罩，吓傻了本就惊魂未定的董事们。KSC 工程师只得在他们原本大获成功的 Real Chute 设计上匆忙加装了减速伞。

s: A Soviet gas generator hypergolic vacuum engine designed for use on the TKS FGB (Functional Cargo Block). Extremely reliable and with restart capability, it has been used on many FGB derivatives, such as later Almaz stations, Skif, Kvant-1 FSM, Kvant-2, Krystal, Spektr, Priroda, Zarya, and Nauka. The pump of the KRD-442 can also be used to internally transfer fuel or refuel from Progress resupply craft.
zh: 苏联燃气发生器循环自燃真空发动机，专为TKS FGB（功能货运舱）设计。具有极高可靠性与多次重启能力，广泛应用于各类FGB衍生型号，例如后期的礼炮号空间站、极地号、量子1号推进舱、量子2号、晶体号、光谱号、自然号、曙光号和科学号。<<M0>>的涡轮泵还可用于舱内推进剂转注或从进步号货运飞船进行燃料补加。

s: When Vernher designed a parachute that could be placed under things, administrators with brimming eyes called the nursing home. When Verhner spelled "Institutionalize THIS!" with smoking craters on KSC's lawn, they immediately effected his vision.
zh: 当 Wernher 设计出一款可以安装在部件下方的降落伞时，眼眶湿润的行政人员差点直接拨通了养老院的电话。而当 Wernher 用冒烟的撞击坑在 KSC 的草坪上拼出“送我住院试试！”时，他们立即贯彻落实了他的构想。

s: A Soviet gas generator hypergolic vacuum engine designed for use in the propulsion systems of the Luna E-6 spacecraft bus. It was used for the first Soviet lunar landers and lunar orbiters. When used on a lunar lander, it was switched to verniers only for terminal descent.
zh: 苏联燃气发生器循环自燃真空发动机，设计用于月球号<<M0>>航天器平台的推进系统。曾用于苏联早期的月球着陆器和月球轨道器。在月球着陆器上使用时，末段下降会切换为仅由游机工作。

s: Improved wrapping techniques allow for an even greater increased layering of multi layer insulation.
zh: 改进的包覆工艺允许铺设更多层的多层绝热材料（MLI）。

s: Lightweight, weak, easily ripped, but cheap. Essential for all your deathtrap concepts.
zh: 轻便、脆弱、易撕裂，但价格低廉。为你所有的自杀式飞行器概念量身打造。

s: More solid than silk, this should land your tin cans in one piece.
zh: 比丝绸更坚固，足以让你的铁皮罐头完好着陆。

s: The heaviest of strongest of all. Comes with a free anchor tatoo.
zh: 所有伞布中最重也是最坚固的。附赠一张免费的铁锚纹身贴纸。

s: After Jebediah rejoiced his new heavy capsule's having only one parachute, KSC engineers foresaw the impending fiasco and immediately invented a radial version of the Real Chute.
zh: 在 Jebediah 为他的新型重型指令舱只有一个降落伞而欢呼之后，KSC 的工程师们预感到了即将到来的惨剧，随即研发出了径向安装版的 Real Chute。

s: Basic RealChute preset for a 1.25m main chute.
Basic RealChute preset for a 1.25m drogue chute.
Basic RealChute preset for a 1.25m drag chute.
Basic RealChute preset for a 0.625m main chute.
Basic RealChute preset for a 0.625m drogue chute.
Basic RealChute preset for a 0.625m drag chute.
Basic RealChute preset for a 2.5m main chute.
Basic RealChute preset for a 2.5m drogue chute.
Basic RealChute preset for a 2.5m drag chute.
Basic RealChute preset for a normal sized main radial. Meant to be used in triple symmetry.
zh: 标准尺寸径向主伞基础<<M0>>预设。专为三向对称设计。

s: Basic RealChute preset for a normal sized drogue radial. Meant to be used in triple symmetry.
zh: 标准尺寸径向减速伞基础<<M0>>预设。专为三向对称设计。

s: Basic RealChute preset for a normal sized drag radial. Meant to be used in triple symmetry.
zh: 标准尺寸径向阻力伞基础<<M0>>预设。专为三向对称设计。

s: Basic RealChute preset for a small sized main radial. Meant to be used in double symmetry.
zh: 小尺寸径向主伞基础<<M0>>预设。专为双向对称设计。

s: Basic RealChute preset for a small sized drogue radial. Meant to be used in double symmetry.
zh: 小尺寸径向减速伞基础<<M0>>预设。专为双向对称设计。

s: Basic RealChute preset for a small sized drag radial. Meant to be used in double symmetry.
zh: 小尺寸径向阻力伞基础<<M0>>预设。专为双向对称设计。

s: Basic RealChute preset for a large sized main radial. Meant to be used in quadruple symmetry.
zh: 大尺寸径向主伞基础<<M0>>预设。专为四向对称设计。

s: Basic RealChute preset for a large sized drogue radial. Meant to be used in quadruple symmetry.
zh: 大尺寸径向减速伞基础<<M0>>预设。专为四向对称设计。

s: Basic RealChute preset for a large sized drag radial. Meant to be used in quadruple symmetry.
zh: 大尺寸径向阻力伞基础<<M0>>预设。专为四向对称设计。

s: Basic RealChute preset for a 1.25m double main chute.
Basic RealChute preset for a 1.25m double drogue chute.
Basic RealChute preset for a 1.25m double drag chute.
Basic RealChute preset for a 0.625m double main chute.
Basic RealChute preset for a 0.625m double drogue chute.
Basic RealChute preset for a 0.625m double drag chute.
Basic RealChute preset for a 2.5m double main chute.
Basic RealChute preset for a 2.5m double drag chute.
Basic RealChute preset for a 1.25m combo chute.
Basic RealChute preset for a 0.625m combo chute.
Basic RealChute preset for a 2.5m combo chute.

A further continuation of the RD-170/171 series, featuring a single combustion chamber and nozzle. The RD-191 powers the Angara family of launchers, while the RD-151 was used on the Naro-1 launch vehicle and the RD-181 will be used on the Antares 200-series.
zh: <<M0>>/171系列的进一步延续型，采用单燃烧室和单喷管构型。<<M1>>为安加拉系列运载火箭提供动力，而<<M2>>曾用于<<M3>>运载火箭，<<M4>>将用于安塔瑞斯200系列。

s: The first multi-chamber engine developed by Glushko. After Glushko's attempts to scale up existing engines for what would become the R-7 resulted in unresolvable combustion instability (RD-105/106), Glushko instead combined multiple chambers of his ED-140 engine into one to increase thrust. The result, the RD-200, proved successful and, although it never flew, its design formed the basis of the RD-107/108 and RD-214.
zh: 格鲁什科开发的第一款多燃烧室发动机。在格鲁什科尝试放大现有发动机以用于后来的<<M0>>时遭遇了无法解决的燃烧不稳定问题（<<M1>>/106）后，他转而将其<<M2>>发动机的多个燃烧室合并为一个以提高推力。其成果<<M3>>被证明是成功的，虽然它从未飞行过，但其设计构成了<<M4>>/108和<<M5>>的基础。

s: A staged combustion hypergolic rocket engine. Used as a power plant on the first stage of the UR-200 rocket, with 3 RD-0203s and 1 RD-0204 forming a RD-0202 engine module. Features a two-axis gimbal mechanism for attitude control.
zh: 一款分级燃烧自燃推进剂火箭发动机。用作<<M0>>火箭第一级的动力装置，由3台<<M1>>和1台<<M2>>组成一个<<M3>>发动机模块。具有双轴万向节机构用于姿态控制。

s: An early Soviet four combustion chamber rocket. Developed from the RD-100 for the R-12 IRBM in the mid 1950s, it provided a significant increase in power over earlier Soviet engines. It was later used for the Kosmos-2 launch vehicle.
zh: 一款早期的苏联四燃烧室火箭。由<<M0>>发展而来，于1950年代中期专为<<M1>>中程弹道导弹研发，相较于早期苏联发动机提供了显著的动力提升。它后来被用于宇宙-2运载火箭。

s: A staged combustion, hypergolic vacuum rocket engine. Used as the power plant on the second stage of the UR-200, and third stage of UR-500/Proton launch vehicle family. Features four integrated vernier engines for three-axis attitude control.
zh: 一款分级燃烧自燃推进剂真空火箭发动机。用作<<M0>>第二级和<<M1>>/质子号系列运载火箭第三级的动力装置。集成了四台游标发动机以实现三轴姿态控制。

s: A staged combustion engine found on the second stage of the UR-200 and third stage of the UR-500/Proton series launcher. It is fixed, and requires its accompanying vernier module for 3-axis control. It uses UDMH & NTO for propellant.
zh: 一款分级燃烧发动机，用于<<M0>>的第二级和<<M1>>/质子号系列运载火箭的第三级。该发动机为固定式，需要配套的游标模块来实现三轴控制。使用偏二甲肼和四氧化二氮作为推进剂。

s: A Soviet dual chamber gas generator engine. It was designed in the late 1950s to use storable propellants for ICBMs because the cryogenic propellants in the current R-7 could not be stored for long periods, requiring lengthy fueling before launch. It was used in clusters of up to three in many Soviet ICBMs, and later in the Kosmos and Tsiklon launch vehicles.
zh: 一款苏联双燃烧室燃气发生器发动机。设计于1950年代末，旨在为洲际弹道导弹使用可贮存推进剂，因为当时<<M0>>中的低温推进剂无法长期贮存，发射前需要漫长的加注过程。它以最多三台并联的形式应用于许多苏联洲际弹道导弹中，后来也用于宇宙号和旋风号运载火箭。

s: A staged combustion hypergolic rocket engine. It was used as a power plant on the first stage of the UR-100 rocket, with 3 RD-0216s and 1 RD-0217 forming a 15D2 engine module. Features a two-axis gimbal mechanism for attitude control. It was later modified into an upper stage engine for the UR-100N, and proposed as an upper stage engine for the UR-700/LK-700 complex.
zh: 一款分级燃烧自燃推进剂火箭发动机。用作<<M0>>火箭第一级的动力装置，由3台<<M1>>和1台<<M2>>组成一个15D2发动机模块。具有双轴万向节机构用于姿态控制。它后来被改装为<<M3>>的上面级发动机，并曾提议作为<<M4>>/<<M5>>复合体的上面级发动机。

s: A Soviet dual chamber gas generator engine. Designed in the late 1950s to use storable propellants for ICBMs because the cryogenic propellants in the current R-7 could not be stored for long periods, requiring lengthy fuelling before launch. It was used on the R-16 and R-36 ICBMs, and Tsiklon-2 and Tsiklon-3 LVs.
zh: 一款苏联双燃烧室燃气发生器发动机。设计于1950年代末，旨在为洲际弹道导弹使用可贮存推进剂，因为当时<<M0>>中的低温推进剂无法长期贮存，发射前需要漫长的加注过程。它曾用于<<M1>>和<<M2>>洲际弹道导弹，以及旋风-2和旋风-3运载火箭。

s: An early Soviet hypergolic staged combustion vacuum engine. Designed for the second stage of the enormous R-20 project, versions were designed using Nitric Acid or Liquid Oxygen as an oxidizer, with UDMH as fuel. Although it was never used, it formed the basis of the much more successful RD-253 used on Proton.
zh: 一款早期的苏联自燃推进剂分级燃烧真空发动机。专为庞大的<<M0>>项目第二级设计，曾设计过以硝酸或液氧为氧化剂、偏二甲肼为燃料的衍生型号。尽管它从未投入使用，但它为后来在质子号上大获成功的<<M1>>奠定了基础。

s: A staged combustion upper stage engine module developed for the R-36M second stage. It consists of an RD-0229 main engine and RD-0230 vernier engine. The R-36M2 used an upgraded version of the engine known as the RD-0255.
zh: 为<<M0>>第二级开发的分级燃烧上面级发动机模块。它由一台<<M1>>主发动机和一台<<M2>>游标发动机组成。<<M3>>使用了该发动机的升级型号，命名为<<M4>>。

s: A staged combustion upper stage engine developed for the R-36M second stage. This engine cannot gimbal, and should be paired with a set of RD-0230 verniers. The R-36M2 used an upgraded version of the engine known as the RD-0256.
zh: 为<<M0>>第二级开发的分级燃烧上面级发动机。该发动机无法使用万向节摆动，需与一组<<M1>>游标配合使用。<<M2>>使用了该发动机的升级型号，命名为<<M3>>。

s: A staged combustion booster engine developed for the UR-100N. The RD-0234 was identical, other than the addition of pressurization equipment. Three RD-0233s and one RD-0234 powered the first stage of the UR-100N, UR-100NU, Strela and Rokot.
zh: 为<<M0>>开发的分级燃烧助推器发动机。<<M1>>除增加了增压设备外，与它完全相同。三台<<M2>>和一台<<M1>>为<<M0>>、<<M3>>、箭号和呼啸号的第一级提供动力。

s: Staged combustion booster engine module. Developed as the first stage engine of the R-29RM Submarine-Launched Ballistic Missile, the RD-0243 consists of an RD-0244 main engine and RD-0245 vernier engine. In order to save space, the engine is submerged within the fuel tank of the R-29RM, with the rear bulkhead of the missile welded to the engine nozzle. Also used on the Shtil' launch vehicle, a unique smallsat launcher capable of being deployed from Delta IV submarines.
zh: 分级燃烧助推器发动机模块。作为<<M0>>潜射弹道导弹的第一级发动机开发，<<M1>>由一台<<M2>>主发动机和一台<<M3>>游标发动机组成。为了节省空间，该发动机浸入在<<M0>>的燃料箱内部，导弹的后箱底直接焊接在发动机喷管上。该发动机还用于平静号运载火箭——一种独特的能够从德尔塔IV型潜艇发射的小型卫星运载火箭。

s: A Soviet hypergolic staged combustion engine. Developed as part of an initiative to build a 150-ton-thrust booster engine for the N1, versions were created burning nitric acid, NTO, or LOX with UDMH. Although the NK-15 was ultimately selected to power the N1, the RD-253, using NTO, was chosen to power the UR-500/Proton, becoming the workhorse of the Soviet space program.
zh: 一款苏联自燃推进剂分级燃烧发动机。作为为N1研发150吨级推力助推器发动机倡议的一部分，曾衍生出燃烧硝酸、四氧化二氮或液氧搭配偏二甲肼的版本。尽管最终选择了<<M0>>为N1提供动力，但使用四氧化二氮的<<M1>>被选为<<M2>>/质子号的动力，成为苏联航天计划的中流砥柱。

s: A Soviet hypergolic staged combustion engine. Developed as part of an initiative to build a 150-ton-thrust vacuum engine for the N1, versions were created burning nitric acid, NTO, or LOX with UDMH. Although the NK-15V was ultimately selected to power the N1, the RD-254, using NTO, was chosen to power the upper stages of the UR-700. The RD-254 was cancelled with the rest of the UR-700 project and never flew.
zh: 一款苏联自燃推进剂分级燃烧发动机。作为为N1研发150吨级推力真空发动机倡议的一部分，曾衍生出燃烧硝酸、四氧化二氮或液氧搭配偏二甲肼的版本。尽管最终选择了<<M0>>为N1提供动力，但使用四氧化二氮的<<M1>>被选中为<<M2>>的上面级提供动力。<<M1>>最终随<<M2>>项目的取消而取消，从未飞行过。

s: The largest single-chamber engine ever built in the USSR, and the first full-flow staged combustion engine, the RD-270 was fueled by NTO and UDMH combined under some of the highest pressures ever encountered in an ignition chamber. Extensively tested to power the first and second stages of the UR-700, it was cancelled with the rest of the UR-700 project and never flew, despite efforts to convert it to kerosene for the N1.
zh: 苏联制造过的最大的单燃烧室发动机，也是第一款全流量分级燃烧发动机，<<M0>>以四氧化二氮和偏二甲肼为推进剂，在极高的燃烧室压力下混合燃烧。该发动机曾进行了广泛的地面测试以用于<<M1>>的第一级和第二级，但尽管曾尝试将其转换为适用于N1的煤油版本，它最终还是随整个<<M1>>项目一同取消，从未飞行过。

s: Modification of the RD-270 to use highly toxic pentaborane as fuel. Although the M variant boasts higher thrust and isp, the fuel mixture is much, much more toxic than even UDMH. Pentaborane has a flash point of 30 degrees Celsius, a tendency to form shock-sensitive explosive compounds, and is classified as "immediately dangerous to life or health" with concentrations at or above one part per million.
zh: <<M0>>使用剧毒戊硼烷作为燃料的改型。虽然M改型拥有更高的推力和比冲，但其燃料混合物的毒性甚至远超偏二甲肼。戊硼烷的闪点仅为30摄氏度，容易形成对冲击敏感的爆炸性化合物，浓度达到或超过百万分之一（1 ppm）即被列为“对生命或健康有直接危险”。

s: A post-war Russian version of the German Taifun anti-aircraft barrage rocket booster. Developed and tested in 1947-1951 but abandoned in favor of the R-110. A cluster of 8 of these rockets formed the first stage of the MR-1 sounding rocket. Length without payload - 1.36 meters.
zh: 战后苏联对德国“台风”防空火箭助推器的仿制版本。于 1947 至 1951 年间研制并测试，但后来被放弃，转而采用 <<M0>>。8 台该型火箭捆绑构成了 <<M1>> 探空火箭的第一级。不含有效载荷的长度为 1.36 米。

s: A 225 N hydrazine thruster, used on all Ranger and early Mariner spacecraft for midcourse corrections. Since reliable hydrazine catalysts had not yet been developed, the engines were only capable of two starts.
zh: 一款 225 N 肼推进器，用于所有“徘徊者”及早期“水手”航天器的中途修正。由于当时尚未研制出可靠的肼催化剂，该发动机仅能点火两次。

s: The Raptor is a methalox full-flow staged combustion engine designed for both Starship & the Super Heavy Launch Vehicle. The Super Heavy first stage uses 33 sea-level optimized engines, and Starship uses 3 sea-level engines and 3 vacuum engines.
zh: 猛禽（Raptor）是一款液氧甲烷全流量分级燃烧发动机，专为星舰（Starship）及超重型运载火箭（Super Heavy）设计。超重型第一级使用 33 台海平面优化版发动机，星舰使用 3 台海平面版和 3 台真空版发动机。

s: A four-chamber nitric acid and kerosene engine developed by Glushko during WW2. It was used in various rocket powered aircraft proposals, and tested extensively in the Pe-2RD, a Pe-2 bomber with an RD-1 installed in the fuselage, but abandoned after WW2, as jet engines proved to be more reliable for high performance aircraft.
zh: 格鲁什科在二战期间研制的四燃烧室硝酸/煤油发动机。它曾用于多种火箭动力飞机的方案，并在 <<M0>>（机身内装有 <<M2>> 的 <<M1>> 轰炸机）上进行了大量测试。二战后被放弃，因为喷气式发动机被证明对高性能飞机而言更为可靠。

s: A 1970s low TWR staged combustion hydrolox upper stage engine intended for use on the N1/N1M. A later version designated RD-57M had an extendable nozzle and was intended for the Vulkan and Energia-M rockets. The engine was marketed by Aerojet in the 1990s under the designation D-57 for use on an SSTO demonstrator.
zh: 一款 20 世纪 70 年代的低 TWR 液氢液氧分级燃烧上面级发动机，原计划用于 N1/N1M。后来的改型编号为 <<M0>>，配有可延伸喷管，计划用于“火神”和“能源-M”火箭。20 世纪 90 年代，该发动机由 Aerojet 公司以编号 <<M1>> 进行推销，用于单级入轨（SSTO）验证机。

s: The world's first closed-cycle engine. The S1.5400 was used as the final stage for the R-7's Molniya configuration to launch communication satellites and interplanetary probes. Unlike prior upper stages, it was restartable (apogee kicks are needed for Molniya orbits). It was given the industry designation 11D33. The 11D33M brought upgrades and was the basis for the RD-58 with higher performance still (designated 11D58). The RD-58 was used on many Russian launchers, including N1 and Buran and is still in use on Proton and Zenit.
zh: 世界上第一款闭式循环发动机。S1.5400 曾作为 <<M0>> 闪电构型的末级，用于发射通信卫星和行星际探测器。与以往的上面级不同，它具备二次启动能力（闪电轨道需要远地点加速）。其工业编号为 11D33。11<<M1>> 进行了升级，并成为性能更高的 <<M2>>（编号 11D58）的基础。<<M2>> 曾用于包括 N1 和“暴风雪”在内的多种苏联运载火箭，至今仍在使用于“质子”和“天顶”号上。

s: RD-100 series engines were the first large scale ethalox Russian engines ever developed and fired.
