The original RD-100 engine was a 1:1 copy of the German Model 39 engine (used on the A-4 ballistic missile), with later variants (RD-101 and RD-103/M) featuring ever increasing performance to satisfy the needs of the larger R-2 and R-5 IRBMs.
zh: <<M0>> 系列发动机是苏联研制并点火的第一批大型乙醇液氧发动机。最初的 <<M0>> 发动机是德国 39 型发动机（用于 <<M1>> 弹道导弹）的 1:1 复制品，后来的改型（<<M2>> 和 <<M3>>/M）性能不断提升，以满足更大的 <<M4>> 和 <<M5>> 中程弹道导弹（IRBM）的需求。

s: A kerolox gas generator vacuum engine which served in R-7 upper stages (Luna, Vostok). The RD-0105 was designed for Luna launches; it was the first upper stage for the R-7 series and was reused for uncrewed Vostok tests. An enhanced version, the RD-0109, was used for crewed Vostok launches.
zh: 一款用于 <<M0>> 上面级（“月球”、“东方”）的煤油液氧燃气发生器循环真空发动机。<<M1>> 专为“月球”发射设计；它是 <<M0>> 系列的第一个上面级，并重新用于“东方”号的无人测试。其改进版本 <<M2>> 则用于载人“东方”号发射。

s: The booster engine for the R-7 Semyorka and its derivatives, including the Sputnik, Luna, Voskhod, Vostok, Soyuz, and Molniya launch vehicles. It differs from the core engine series (RD-108) with a higher chamber pressure, thrust, and smaller vernier layout. The R-7 family core was supplemented for (roughly) two minutes by four strap-on boosters powered by these engines.
zh: 用于 <<M0>>“老七”（Semyorka）及其衍生型号（包括人造卫星号、月球号、上升号、东方号、联盟号和闪电号运载火箭）的助推器发动机。与芯级发动机系列（<<M1>>）相比，它具有更高的室压、推力以及更紧凑的游标布局。<<M0>> 家族的芯级在起飞后由 4 台采用该发动机的捆绑式助推器协同工作约两分钟。

s: The core engine for the R-7 Semyorka and its derivatives, including the Sputnik, Luna, Voskhod, Vostok, Soyuz, and Molniya launch vehicles. It differs from the booster engine series (RD-107) with a lower chamber pressure, thrust, and a wider vernier layout. It powers the R-7 family core through a very long (roughly) five minute burn that starts on the pad alongside the boosters.
zh: 用于 <<M0>>“老七”（Semyorka）及其衍生型号（包括人造卫星号、月球号、上升号、东方号、联盟号和闪电号运载火箭）的芯级发动机。与助推器发动机系列（<<M1>>）相比，它的室压和推力较低，游标布局更宽。它为 <<M0>> 家族芯级提供动力，在发射台上与助推器同时点火，持续工作长达约五分钟。

s: A Soviet high-performance semi-cryogenic upper stage engine. Originally developed as an upper stage for the R-7, it was never used due to Korolev's refusal to use toxic propellants. It was later adapted for the Kosmos-2 Launch Vehicle, which needed a high performance upper stage due to the low performance of its R-12 first stage.
zh: 苏联的高性能半低温上面级发动机。最初作为 <<M0>> 的上面级研制，但因科罗廖夫拒绝使用有毒推进剂而从未被采用。后来它被转用于宇宙-2 号运载火箭，该火箭由于 <<M1>> 第一级性能较低，亟需一款高性能上面级。

s: The first stage engine for the R-9 ICBM. Derived from the RD-107/108 engines of the R-7, the RD-111 was intended to provide a much quicker reaction time than the R-7. Although still using cryogenic liquid oxygen, it could be fuelled and launched in under 20 minutes. This, combined with its high performance, meant it was the last cryogenic ICBM to leave service.
zh: 用于 <<M0>> 洲际弹道导弹的第一级发动机。<<M3>> 衍生自 <<M2>> 的 <<M1>>/108 发动机，旨在提供比 <<M2>> 快得多的反应时间。尽管仍使用低温液氧，但它可以在 20 分钟内完成加注并发射。凭借这一特性及其高性能，它成为了最后退役的低温洲际弹道导弹发动机。

s: A 1990s medium TWR engine for atmospheric and vacuum use. The RD-0120T is a fuel-rich staged combustion tripropellant engine developed from the RD-0120 for use on SSTOs and other high performance vehicles. Tested in collaboration with Aerojet, but never flew.
zh: 一款 20 世纪 90 年代用于大气层和真空的中 TWR 发动机。<<M0>> 是一款富燃分级燃烧三组元推进剂发动机，由 <<M1>> 改进而来，用于 SSTO 和其他高性能运载工具。曾与 Aerojet 合作测试，但从未实际飞行。

s: The first expander cycle engine developed in Russia. It was developed in collaboration with Pratt & Whitney as a high performance upper stage for Proton. It was heavily inspired by the RL10, and some of its design elements were integrated into the RL10.
zh: 俄罗斯研制的第一款膨胀循环发动机。它与普惠公司（Pratt & Whitney）合作研制，作为“质子”号的高性能上面级。它深受 <<M0>> 的启发，其部分设计元素也被融入到了 <<M0>> 中。

s: Between 2002 and 2005, KBKhA teamed up with European industry to develop a reusable staged combustion methane engine with a thrust of 200 tons under the Volga project. In 2006, the company started work on a reusable engine designated RD-0162 for the Russian MRKS-1 reusable space booster.
zh: 在 2002 至 2005 年间，<<M0>> 在“伏尔加”项目下与欧洲工业界合作，研制了一款推力为 200 吨的可重复使用分级燃烧甲烷发动机。2006 年，该公司开始为俄罗斯 <<M2>> 可重复使用航天助推器研制代号为 <<M1>> 的可重复使用发动机。

s: Between 2002 and 2005, KBKhA teamed up with European industry to develop a reusable staged combustion methane engine with a thrust of 200 tons under the Volga project. In 2006, the company started work on a reusable engine designated RD-0162 for the Russian MRKS-1 reusable space booster. RD-0164 is higher thrust variant of that engine.
zh: 在 2002 至 2005 年间，<<M0>> 在“伏尔加”项目下与欧洲工业界合作，研制了一款推力为 200 吨的可重复使用分级燃烧甲烷发动机。2006 年，该公司开始为俄罗斯 <<M2>> 可重复使用航天助推器研制代号为 <<M1>> 的可重复使用发动机。<<M3>> 是该发动机的高推力改型。

s: Between 2002 and 2005, KBKhA teamed up with European industry to develop a reusable staged combustion methane engine with a thrust of 200 tons under the Volga project. In 2006, the company started work on a reusable engine designated RD-0162 for the Russian MRKS-1 reusable space booster. RD-0169 is an upper stage derivative of that engine.
zh: 在 2002 至 2005 年间，<<M0>> 在“伏尔加”项目下与欧洲工业界合作，研制了一款推力为 200 吨的可重复使用分级燃烧甲烷发动机。2006 年，该公司开始为俄罗斯 <<M2>> 可重复使用航天助推器研制代号为 <<M1>> 的可重复使用发动机。<<M3>> 是该发动机的上面级衍生型号。

s: An atmospheric booster engine used from the 1980s to present, the RD-170 is the most powerful liquid rocket engine ever flown. Originally developed for the Energia launcher's boosters, the engine consists of four combustion chambers fed by a single turbopump. A modified version, the RD-171, is used on the first stage of the Zenit launch vehicle.
zh: 一款从 20 世纪 80 年代使用至今的大气助推器发动机，<<M0>> 是有史以来飞行过的推力最大的液体火箭发动机。该发动机最初为“能源”号运载火箭的助推器研制，由单台涡轮泵向四个燃烧室供油。其改进型号 <<M1>> 用于“天顶”号运载火箭的第一级。

s: An exotic fuel-rich staged combustion vacuum engine. Developed as a high-energy upper stage for Proton by Glushko, the RD-301 burned liquid fluorine and ammonia, which gave very high performance and density. It was tested extensively, but never flew due to toxicity concerns.
zh: 一款奇特且罕见的富燃分级燃烧真空发动机。由格卢什科设计局研制，作为“质子号”的高能上面级，<<M0>> 燃烧液氟与液氨，具有极高的性能和密度。该发动机进行了大量地面测试，但由于毒性问题从未实际飞行。

s: RD-0410 was a Soviet nuclear thermal rocket engine developed from 1965 through the 1994 using liquid hydrogen propellant. The engine was ground-tested at the Semipalatinsk Test Site, and its use was incorporated in the Kurchatov Mars 1994 manned mission proposal. Its moderator and fuel are quite different from the US designs and Metal Carbide (MC) versions of the fuel are rumoured to have reach as high as 3500K without melting in the early 1990's. Use of Heptane to reduce hydrogen corrosion of the carbides was critical to function (~1%). First run tests occurred in 1985. Some Russian sources list it as dual mode using not only Hydrogen but also liquid Methane without additives. During the SNTP program the US tried to acquire MC fuels from Russian sources but planned purchases fell through. This engine is very heavily built compared to US designs and incorporates a four lobed spiral fuel rod to eliminate risk of fuel being ejected if the rods shattered. This design uses a short regeneratively cooled nozzle and is intended as an upper stage. Design stats Nozzle Ae=46 Chamber Temp=3000 Ideal ISP=972 Reactor Power=173MW(th) TWR=1.73 Chamber Pressure=4000kPa Ignitions =10 Tonnage including integral shadow shield:2tons. In Methane mode the nozzle is slightly expanded by 12cm length and slightly enlarged. Nozzle Ae=46 Chamber Temp=3000 Ideal ISP=467 Reactor Power=173MW(th) TWR=3.56 Chamber Pressure=4800kPa Ignitions =10 Tonnage including integral shadow shield:2tons
zh: <<M0>> 是苏联在1965至1994年间研制的使用液氢推进剂的核热火箭发动机。该发动机在塞米巴拉金斯克试验场进行了地面点火测试，并曾计划用于库尔恰托夫1994载人火星任务方案。其慢化剂与核燃料与美国设计截然不同，据传其碳化物金属（MC）版本的燃料在1990年代初能承受高达3500K的高温而不融化。使用庚烷（~1%）来减轻氢对碳化物的腐蚀对正常运行至关重要。首次试车于1985年进行。部分俄罗斯资料显示它具有双模能力，除氢外还可在不添加添加剂的情况下直接使用液态甲烷。在SNTP计划期间，美国曾试图从俄罗斯购买MC燃料，但采购计划流产。与美国设计相比，该发动机结构非常厚重坚固，并采用四叶螺旋燃料棒，以消除燃料棒破碎时核燃料被喷射抛出的风险。该设计采用较短的再生冷却喷管，定位于上面级使用。设计参数：喷管面积比=46，燃烧室温度=3000，理想比冲=972，反应堆功率=173MW(th)，TWR=1.73，燃烧室压力=4000kPa，点火次数=10，包含整体阴影屏蔽层的总重：2吨。在甲烷模式下，喷管长度微扩12cm且喉径略有增大。喷管面积比=46，燃烧室温度=3000，理想比冲=467，反应堆功率=173MW(th)，TWR=3.56，燃烧室压力=4800kPa，点火次数=10，包含整体阴影屏蔽层的总重：2吨。

s: A Soviet nuclear thermal rocket engine. Developed in parallel with the RD-0410, the RD-0411 was a much larger engine, intended for upper stage use on the UR-700 or N-I. Using the same advanced Metal Carbide (MC) fuels and spiral fuel rods as the RD-0410, it achieves good performance for it's size. Unlike the RD-0410, no test articles were ever built, as the failure of the N1 and cancellation of the UR-700 meant there would be no launch vehicle large enough to use it. It never progressed past the study stage, and much of it's performance is speculative.
zh: 一款苏联核热火箭发动机。与 <<M0>> 平行开发，<<M1>> 尺寸要大得多，原定用于 <<M2>> 或 N-1 的上面级。它采用了与 <<M0>> 相同的先进碳化物金属（MC）燃料和螺旋燃料棒，在此尺寸下实现了优异的性能。与 <<M0>> 不同，由于 N-1 的失败以及 <<M2>> 的取消意味着再无足够庞大的运载火箭来搭载它，该发动机从未制造过测试样机。它从未走出论证阶段，其大部分性能数据均为推测。

s: A staged combustion kerosene and peroxide lander engine, developed for Soviet heavy manned moon landers. Derived from the earlier RD-502 project, the use of hydrogen peroxide with kerosene allowed for a very dense, storable, and non-toxic stage. Although tested extensively, and proposed for various lunar lander designs including the LK-700, it never flew.
zh: 一款分级燃烧煤油-过氧化氢着陆器发动机，专为苏联重型载人登月着陆器研制。衍生自早期的 <<M0>> 项目，使用过氧化氢搭配煤油可实现极高密度、可贮存且无毒的推进剂组合。尽管进行了大量测试，并被提议用于包括 <<M1>> 在内的多种登月舱设计，但从未实际飞行。

s: A Soviet magnetic confinment open cycle gas core nuclear rocket. After a few experiments with solid-core nuclear thermal rockets, Glushko ordered development transferred to other design bureaus due to low performance, and instead focused on gas core nuclear rockets. The RD-600 was a very complex design, containing a conventional solid core reactor for power generation and startup, and powerful electromagnets to contain the gaseous fissile material in the core powered by a 2 MW magnetoplasmadynamic generator on the nozzle. Designed for manned Mars missions, outer planet probes, and worryingly the sustainer stage of superheavy launch vehicles, development was ultimately abandoned due to high costs, difficulty achieving stable containment of a gaseous core, and the lack of launch vehicles of the required scale for such a large engine.
zh: 一款苏联磁约束开式循环气芯核火箭发动机。在对固芯核热火箭进行少量实验后，格卢什科因其性能有限而下令将其研发移交给其他设计局，转而专注于气芯核火箭。<<M0>> 是一项极为复杂的设计，包含一个用于发电和启动的常规固芯反应堆，并通过安装在喷管上的2 MW磁流体发电机供电，驱动强力电磁铁将气态裂变物质约束在堆芯内。该发动机专为载人火星任务、外行星探测器以及（令人不安的）超重型运载火箭的芯级而设计，但最终由于高昂成本、极难实现气芯的稳定约束，以及缺乏能容纳如此庞大发动机的运载火箭而中止研发。

s: A staged combustion tripropellant liquid fuel engine using kerosene, liquid hydrogen, and liquid oxygen. Originally developed for the MAKS space plane. In the booster phase of the ascent it uses a mixture of kerosene with liquid hydrogen and it switches to pure hydrogen for the sustainer phase.
zh: 一款采用煤油、液氢和液氧的三组元分级燃烧液体燃料发动机。最初为“MAKS”空天飞机研制。在上升的助推阶段，它使用煤油与液氢的混合燃料；进入巡航/持续推力阶段后，则切换为纯液氢。

s: A staged combustion tripropellant liquid fuel engine using kerosene, liquid hydrogen, and liquid oxygen. This is the single chamber version of the RD-701, originally developed for the MAKS space plane. In the booster phase of the ascent it uses a mixture of kerosene with liquid hydrogen and it switches to pure hydrogen for the sustainer phase.
zh: 一款采用煤油、液氢和液氧的三组元分级燃烧液体燃料发动机。这是 <<M0>> 的单燃烧室版本，最初为“MAKS”空天飞机研制。在上升的助推阶段，它使用煤油与液氢的混合燃料；进入巡航/持续推力阶段后，则切换为纯液氢。

s: A single-chamber derivative of the RD-8 engine used on the Zenit second stage. A Yuzhnoye Design Office concept, featuring dual-axis gimbal control and restart capability for use as a standalone upper stage engine.
zh: 天顶号第二级所用 <<M0>> 发动机的单燃烧室衍生型。这是南方设计局的一个概念构型，具备双轴万向节控制与多次重启能力，可用作独立的上面级发动机。

s: A pressure-fed upper stage engine developed for the third stage of R-36MUTTKh. This represents 1/4th of an RD-864. The RD-864 was able to restart many times and had extremely high gimbal authority and limited throttle, to allow it to dodge American missile defenses while deploying multiple warheads. The R-36M2 used an upgraded version of the engine known as the RD-869.
zh: 一款为 <<M0>> 第三级研制的挤压循环上面级发动机。此部件相当于 <<M1>> 的四分之一。<<M1>> 具备多次重启能力、极大的万向节偏转角度以及有限的节流阀调节范围，使其在释放多枚弹头时能够规避美国的导弹防御系统。<<M2>> 使用了该发动机的升级型号 <<M3>>。

s: A restartable expander-cycle hydrolox engine used in multiple upper stages, including Centaur, the Saturn I S-IV, and the Delta Cryogenic Second Stage. It has low thrust, but very high ISP and low mass.
zh: 一款可多次启动的膨胀循环氢氧发动机，曾用于包括半人马座、土星一号 S-IV 级和德尔塔低温第二级在内的多个上面级。其推力较小，但比冲极高且质量很轻。

s: A next generation cryogenic upper stage engine designed to replace the RL10, providing higher performance while maintaining the same installation envelope. Also available in a lower 180kN thrust Vinci-180 model.
zh: 下一代低温上面级发动机，旨在取代 <<M0>>，在保持相同安装包络的同时提供更高性能。另有推力较低（180kN）的 Vinci-180 型号可选。

s: A reusable expander-cycle vacuum engine. Also known as the Advanced Expander Cycle engine, it was developed as an engine for a high-performance Space Shuttle upper stage. Although the engine was tested, it was canceled after the Challenger disaster.
zh: 一款可重复使用的膨胀循环真空发动机。又称“先进膨胀循环发动机”（AEC），专为航天飞机的高性能上面级而研制。虽然该发动机进行了试验测试，但在“挑战者号”失事后被取消。

s: A 1990s atmospheric engine using technology developed for the Space Shuttle SSME, the RS-68 is a single-use engine. It features a simplified design with fewer parts and an easier construction and uses exhaust from the gas generator for roll control. The RS-68 powers the Delta IV launch vehicle family and is the most powerful LH2/LOX engine ever flown.
zh: 一款诞生于1990年代的大气发动机，采用了为航天飞机主发动机（SSME）开发的技术，<<M0>> 是一款一次性发动机。它采用了部件更少、制造更容易的简化设计，并利用燃气发生器的废气进行滚转控制。<<M0>> 为德尔塔四号运载火箭家族提供动力，是有史以来实际飞行过的推力最大的氢氧（LH2/LOX）发动机。

s: An early 2000s atmospheric staged combustion kerolox engine. Developed as the booster engine for the liquid fly-back booster, a reusable space shuttle booster system. Extremely high performance, cancelled during prototype phase.
zh: 一款2000年代初研制的大气分级燃烧液氧煤油发动机。专为液体飞回式助推器（一种可重复使用的航天飞机助推器系统）开发。性能极高，但在原型阶段被取消。

s: An early 2000s atmospheric staged combustion hydrolox engine. Developed as the main engine for a Space Shuttle replacement as a part of the Space Launch Initiative program. Extremely high performance, cancelled during prototype phase.
zh: 一款2000年代初的大气分级燃烧氢氧发动机。作为太空发射倡议计划的一部分，为替代航天飞机的主发动机而研发。性能极高，但在原型机阶段被取消。

s: An early 2000s atmospheric staged combustion kerolox engine. Developed as the booster engine for a Space Shuttle replacement as a part of the Space Launch Initiative program. Extremely high performance, cancelled during prototype phase.
zh: 一款2000年代初的大气分级燃烧液氧煤油发动机。作为太空发射倡议计划的一部分，为替代航天飞机的助推器发动机而研发。性能极高，但在原型机阶段被取消。

s: A high thrust pressure-fed hypergolic engine. Initially designed and built as a part of the NASA Bantam System Technology program, aiming for a low cost, high power propulsion system, it was later modified by Lockheed Martin for use as a launch abort engine. A derivative of the RS-88 is used by the Boeing CST-100 "Starliner" spacecraft for launch aborts under the name "Launch Abort Engine - LAE".
zh: 一款高推力挤压循环自燃推进剂发动机。最初作为NASA矮脚鸡系统技术计划的一部分设计制造，旨在打造低成本、大功率的推进系统，后被洛克希德·马丁公司改装为发射逃逸发动机。<<M0>>的衍生型号被波音<<M1>>“星际客机”飞船用作发射逃逸发动机，命名为“LAE”。

s: A four segment Reusable Solid Rocket Motor, one of the most powerful rocket motors ever built and flown. Two of them were used by the Space Shuttle for liftoff and the initial part of the flight, providing more than 75% of the overall stack thrust. Manufactured by Thiokol and later by ATK.
zh: 四段式可重复使用固体火箭发动机，是有史以来建造并飞行过的推力最大的火箭发动机之一。航天飞机使用两台该型发动机进行起飞和初段飞行，提供了整个发射组合体超过75%的推力。由赛奥科（Thiokol）制造，后转由ATK生产。

s: The 5-segment Reusable Solid Rocket Motor (RSRMV) was first studied as an upgrade for the Space Shuttle, and entered full-scale development for Ares I. Development continued for SLS after the cancellation of Ares. Nose Cone 6.50662m tall.
zh: 5段式可重复使用固体火箭发动机（RSRMV）最初作为航天飞机的升级方案进行研究，后进入战神一号的全面工程研制阶段。战神火箭取消后，继续为SLS研制。头锥头高6.50662m。

s: The Rutherford engine is the world's first electrically pumped engine. It adopts an entirely new propulsion cycle, making use of brushless DC motors and high performance lithium polymer batteries to drive its pumps. The engine is named after the New Zealand-born physicist Ernest Rutherford.
zh: 卢瑟福发动机是世界上第一款采用电泵驱动的发动机。它采用了全新的推进循环，利用无刷直流电机和高性能锂聚合物电池来驱动涡轮泵。该发动机以新西兰出生的物理学家欧内斯特·卢瑟福的名字命名。

s: A pump-fed gas generator hydrolox engine, developed as an upper stage for the Black Knight and Blue Streak. The use of furnace brazing, rather than hand brazing as used in many earlier designs, significantly reduced manufacturing costs. The design was tested, but cancelled in the late 60s due to funding concerns.
zh: 一款泵压式燃气发生器氢氧发动机，曾作为黑骑士和蓝光火箭的上面级研发。该设计采用炉中钎焊替代了此前许多设计中采用的手工钎焊，显著降低了制造成本。该设计进行了测试，但在60年代末因资金问题被取消。

s: Better known by its western designation, Scud, the S2.253 engine was developed for use in the R-11 Zemlya ballistic missile and sounding rocket. It was originally based on the German Wasserfall engine and later versions were exported extensively to many countries, eventually forming the basis of the Iranian and North Korean space programs.
zh: S2.253发动机在西方以“飞毛腿”代号更为人熟知，是为<<M0>>大地弹道导弹和探空火箭研发的。它最初基于德国瀑布防空火箭的发动机研制，后续型号大量出口到许多国家，最终成为伊朗和朝鲜航天项目的基础。

s: A small gas generator vacuum engine, developed as the de-orbit motor for the Vostok spacecraft. It was very reliable, and was also used on the Voskhod and early Zenit spacecraft, before being replaced by a solid rocket motor.
zh: 一款小型燃气发生器真空发动机，作为东方号飞船的离轨制动发动机研发。其非常可靠，也曾用于上升号和早期天顶号飞船，后被固体火箭发动机取代。

s: A throttleable rocket engine designed to turn the MiG-21 into a super-high-performance rocket interceptor. It proved successful in tests, but the destruction of the only prototype due to an engine explosion and the increasing performance of jet-powered aircraft led to the project being abandoned.
zh: 一款可节流火箭发动机，旨在将<<M0>>改造成超高性能的火箭截击机。测试证明其性能优异，但因发动机爆炸导致唯一一架原型机损毁，加之喷气式飞机的性能不断提升，该项目最终被放弃。

s: The "SNTP-PFE" series is a 1000MW reactor. The reactor is a particle bed using metallic carbide coated uranium granules embedded in a graphite rod that hydrogen is passed through. This allows for power densities of up to 40MW/liter. Its core is capable of starting up five times. An integral Tungsten Boron Lithium Hydride composite shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shut down gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted three to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be ten to fifteen meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. This rocket has impressive stats for its size (Nozzle Ae=100 Chamber Temp=3000 Ideal ISP=991 Reactor Power=1054MW(th) TWR=13.94 Chamber Pressure=6800kPa Ignitions =5 Tonnage including integral shadow shield:1.504tons ) The nozzle is a fixed ablatively cooled filament wound carbon-carbon design.
zh: “SNTP-PFE”系列是一台1000MW反应堆。该反应堆采用颗粒床设计，将涂有金属碳化物的铀颗粒嵌入石墨棒中，氢推进剂从中流过。这使得功率密度高达40MW/升。其堆芯具备5次启动能力。集成了钨-硼-氢化锂复合屏蔽罩，整个组件采用再生冷却。辅助回路将停堆废气引入小型热机，以最大限度减少燃料损耗并提供基础交流电。该发动机安装位置应距离最近的燃料箱3至6米。燃料应为乘员提供屏蔽，运行时乘员位置应距离发动机10至15米。水箱或高密度燃料等附加屏蔽可以适度减小此距离。该火箭在其尺寸下性能令人瞩目（喷管膨胀比Ae=100，燃烧室温度=3000，理想比冲=991，反应堆功率=1054MW(th)，TWR=13.94，燃烧室压力=6800kPa，点火次数=5，含集成阴影屏蔽总重：1.504吨）。喷管为固定式烧蚀冷却纤维缠绕碳-碳复合材料设计。

s: Derived from the Sprite, the Spectre was a rocket motor designed for the SR.53 interceptor, and to replace the Sprite for higher-performance JATO applications. It was tested extensively, both on the SR.53 prototypes and on the Vickers Valiant and Hadley-Page Victor, but improved jet engine performance and cancellation of the SR.53 and the SR.177 follow-on project resulted in the cancellation of the Spectre.
zh: 幽灵（Spectre）火箭发动机衍生自雪精（Sprite），专为SR.53截击机设计，并用于替代雪精以满足更高性能的JATO起飞辅助需求。该发动机在SR.53原型机以及维克斯勇士和汉德利·佩奇胜利者轰炸机上进行了广泛测试，但喷气发动机性能的提升以及SR.53和后续SR.177项目的取消导致幽灵发动机最终下马。

s: A small monopropellant rocket motor, intended for JATO use to improve the takeoff performance of various aircraft. Developed directly from german JATO boosters captured during WW2, the Sprite incorporated improvements such as silver gauze catalyst beds, but was still a low-performance motor. The Super Sprite added a kerosene "afterburner" that injected small amounts of kerosene into the combustion chamber to increase performance.
zh: 一款小型单组元推进剂火箭发动机，设计用作JATO助推器以改善各类飞机的起飞性能。雪精（Sprite）直接根据二战期间缴获的德国JATO助推器研制，引入了银丝网催化剂床等改进设计，但整体性能仍然偏低。超级雪精（Super Sprite）增加了一个煤油“加力燃烧室”，通过将少量煤油喷入燃烧室来提高性能。

s: The Titan IVB Solid Rocket Motor Upgrade (also known as the Upgraded Solid Rocket Motor or USRM), was developed with the goal of 25% more capacity than the Titan IVA with the UA1207 SRM. It achieved this through a more energetic propellant and a 3-segment composite case that carried more fuel and weighed less than the UA1207's 7-segment steel case. Burn time 150 seconds.
zh: 大力神IVB固体火箭发动机升级版（也称改进型固体火箭发动机或USRM），其研制目标是将使用<<M0>> SRM的大力神IVA的运载能力提高25%。它通过能量更高的推进剂以及3段式复合材料壳体实现了这一点，相比<<M0>>的7段式钢制壳体容纳了更多燃料且自重更轻。工作时间150秒。

s: Developed from the RS-25 SSME, the Space Shuttle Booster Engine (SSBE) was a concept for a kerolox fueled Space Shuttle booster. The engine used three fuel-rich preburners, burning a mixture of LH2 and RP-1 to minimize coking. The LH2 was also used to cool the combustion chamber, allowing unmodified SSME components to be used.
zh: 航天飞机助推器发动机（SSBE）衍生自<<M0>> SSME，是一种采用液氧煤油推进剂的航天飞机助推器概念方案。该发动机采用三个富燃预燃室，燃烧液氢和<<M1>>的混合物以最大限度减少结焦。液氢还用于冷却燃烧室，从而可以直接使用未修改的SSME组件。

s: The RS-25, also known as the Space Shuttle Main Engine (SSME), is a LH2/LOX fuel-rich staged combustion engine. Though complex and expensive, these engines provide very high performance and are extremely reliable. Three of these engines powered each Shuttle Orbiter and four power the core stage of the SLS.
zh: <<M0>>，亦称航天飞机主发动机（SSME），是一款液氢/液氧富燃分级燃烧发动机。尽管结构复杂且造价高昂，这些发动机仍具备极高的性能和极佳的可靠性。每架航天飞机轨道器配备三台该型发动机，SLS芯级则配备四台。

s: The CASTOR 30B is a low cost, robust, state-of-the-art upper stage motor. This production motor incorporates a few modifications from the CASTOR 30, primarily a change in propellant and a longer nozzle. It is 169.9 inches long and nominally designed as an upper stage that can function as a second or third stage depending on the vehicle configuration.
zh: CASTOR 30B 是一款低成本、坚固且先进的上面级发动机。此量产型发动机在 CASTOR 30 的基础上进行了一些改进，主要是更换了推进剂并加长了喷管。其长度为 169.9 英寸，标称设计为上面级，可根据运载火箭构型用作二级或三级。

s: The CASTOR 30XL is more than a stretched version of the CASTOR 30. The motor is 235.8 inches long and designed to function as a second or third stage depending on vehicle configuration. The nozzle is 8 feet long and submerged, with a high expansion ratio (55.9:1), a dual density exit cone for high altitude operation, and an electro-mechanical TVA system.
zh: CASTOR 30XL 不仅仅是 CASTOR 30 的加长版本。该发动机长 235.8 英寸，根据运载火箭构型可用作二级或三级。喷管长 8 英尺且为潜入式设计，具有高膨胀比（55.9:1）、用于高空运行的双密度出口锥头以及机电推力矢量控制（TVA）系统。

s: The Castor 120 is a medium solid booster used on the Minotaur and Athena launch vehicles. Its design was based on the TU-903, which serves as the first stage of the Peacekeeper ICBM. The standard thrust curve can be modified to produce a regressive burn that reduces maximum acceleration or a saddle-shaped profile that limits aerodynamic forces. Burn time 79 seconds.
zh: Castor 120 是一款中型固体助推器，用于米诺陶和雅典娜运载火箭。其设计基于 <<M0>>（用作和平卫士洲际弹道导弹的第一级）。标准推力曲线可以修改为递减燃烧以降低最大加速度，或修改为马鞍形剖面以限制气动力。燃烧时间 79 秒。

s: The Co-Optimized Booster for Reusable Applications was an early 2000s atmospheric staged combustion hydrolox engine. Developed as the main engine for a Space Shuttle replacement through the Space Launch Initiative program. Extremely high performance, but cancelled during prototype phase.
zh: COBRA（可重复使用共优化助推器）是 2000 年代初期研制的大气层内分级燃烧循环氢氧发动机。作为“太空运载倡议”（SLI）计划中航天飞机替代方案的主发动机而开发。性能极高，但在原型机阶段被取消。

s: The Co-optimized Booster for Reusable Applications was proposed by Pratt & Whitney-Aerojet Propulsion Associates to cover a wide range of thrust. This hydrolox reusable rocket engine was designed in 2003 to produce 4500 kN thrust. Proposed as a long-life, moderate-to high-thrust, reusable booster engine with a safe and low-cost single burner and a fuel-rich staged combustion cycle.
zh: COBRA（可重复使用共优化助推器）由普惠-喷气飞机构型联合推进系统提出，旨在覆盖广泛的推力范围。这款氢氧可重复使用火箭发动机于 2003 年设计，可产生 4500 kN 推力。其定位为长寿命、中高推力的可重复使用助推器发动机，采用安全且低成本的单燃烧室与富燃分级燃烧循环。

s: The Aerojet Dual Fuel Mixed-Mode High Pressure Engine for SSTO Vehicles. It burned RP-1 and LOX in sea level mode, and then at high altitude would deploy a nozzle extension and switch to burning LH2 and LOX for higher performance.
zh: Aerojet 为单级入轨（SSTO）运载器设计的双燃料混合模态高压发动机。在海平面模式下燃烧 <<M0>> 与液氧（LOX），而在高空则开启喷管延伸段并切换为燃烧液氢（LH2）与液氧以获得更高性能。

s: The Dual Stage 4 Grid (DS4G) ion thruster was developed primarily by the European Space Agency for a variety of future deep space missions. This version is their most robust design, designed for deep space missions. Requires 50kW of electrical power. NOTE: This engine is based on technical design and test articles.
zh: 双级四栅极（<<M0>>）离子推力器主要由欧洲空间局开发，用于各种未来的深空任务。该型号是其设计中最坚固的一款，专为深空任务打造。需要 50kW 的电能。注意：该发动机基于工程设计方案和测试件。

s: An open cycle kerolox booster engine developed from LR79/89. It was a backup proposal for the first stage engine on the Titan 1 ICBM, and proposed first stage engine on the Saturn 1, but ultimately never flown (4 E-1s were replaced by 8 H-1s).
zh: 基于 LR79/89 改进的开式循环液氧煤油助推器发动机。曾作为泰坦 1 洲际弹道导弹一级发动机的备选方案，并提议用作土星 1 的一级发动机，但最终从未飞行（4 台 <<M0>> 被 8 台 <<M1>> 取代）。

s: The EPEX (Electrical Propulsion Experiment) was a pulsed magnetoplasmadynamic thruster, tested on the Japanese Space Flyer Unit satellite in 1995. Although the Soviet Union experimented with MPD thrusters extensively, the Space Flyer Unit was the first spacecraft to use an MPD thruster as its main propulsion system.
zh: EPEX（电推进实验）是一种脉冲磁等离子体动力（MPD）推力器，于 1995 年在日本太空巡游单元（Space Flyer Unit）卫星上进行了测试。尽管苏联对 MPD 推力器进行了广泛试验，但太空巡游单元是第一个使用 MPD 推力器作为主推进系统的航天器。

s: The massive Rocketdyne F-1 engine. One of the largest, most powerful rocket engines ever built. Ensure you enable roll capability or disable gimbal as required for your application. Represents the throttlable F-1A engine as found in 'Eyes Turned Skyward'.
zh: 巨大的 Rocketdyne <<M0>> 发动机。有史以来制造的体型最大、推力最强的火箭发动机之一。请根据应用需求确保开启滚转控制能力或禁用万向节。代表了《目光投向天际》架空历史中的可节流 <<M1>> 发动机。

s: The pulsed inductive thruster uses a powerful magnetic pulse to ionize and accelerate gas. It can achieve impressive ISPs and be scaled up simply by increasing the pulse rate. However, it consumes a considerable amount of power. FARAD (Faraday Accelerator with Radio-Frequency Assisted Discharge) ionizes gas before it is exposed to the magnetic field, greatly reducing the required pulse energy, allowing for a much smaller thruster.
zh: 脉冲感应推力器利用强大的磁脉冲来电离并加速气体。它可以达到令人惊叹的比冲，并且只需提高脉冲频率即可放大推力。然而，它的耗电量十分可观。FARAD（射频辅助放电法拉第加速器）在气体暴露于磁场之前就将其电离，大幅降低了所需的脉冲能量，从而造就了尺寸更小的推力器。

s: The F-1B engine was designed to power the proposed Pyrios advanced boosters for the Space Launch System. A highly modified version of the original F-1, the F-1B uses modern manufacturing techniques including 3-D printing and features a simpler gas generator exhaust arrangement in order to reduce manufacturing costs and increase thrust at a slight cost of efficiency.
zh: <<M0>> 发动机专为太空发射系统（SLS）提议的 Pyrios 先进助推器提供动力。作为原始 <<M1>> 的高度改进型，<<M0>> 采用了包括 3D 打印在内的现代制造工艺，并配备了更简单的燃气发生器排气布局，以降低制造成本并提高推力，仅付出了极小的效率代价。

s: This was developed for the NOMAD high energy upper stage, intended to replace Agena. The hydrazine/fluorine propellant mix showed impressive performance in testing, but concerns over the toxicity of fluorine lead to the project being cancelled after extensive work had already been done.
zh: 专为 NOMAD 高能上面级研发，旨在取代阿金纳（Agena）。肼/氟推进剂组合在测试中展现出了惊人的性能，但由于对氟毒性的担忧，该项目在完成大量工作后仍被取消。

s: A two chamber version of Gamma, used for the second stage of the Black Arrow satellite launch vehicle. As the only Gamma not required to operate at sea level, the nozzles were extended to allow better expansion.
zh: Gamma 的双燃烧室版本，用于黑箭卫星运载火箭的第二级。作为唯一不需要在海平面运行的 Gamma 发动机，其喷管经过加长以获得更好的膨胀效果。

s: This was an 8 chamber development of Gamma, used for the first stage of the Black Arrow satellite launch vehicle. Gamma thrust chambers were mounted in pairs radially, each pair on a one-axis tangential gimbal. Collective movement gave roll control while differential movement gave pitch control.
zh: 这是 Gamma 的 8 燃烧室发展型，用于黑箭卫星运载火箭的第一级。Gamma 的推力室成对径向安装，每对安装在一个单轴切向万向节上。同步偏转提供滚转控制，而差动偏转提供俯仰控制。

s: This was an 4 chamber development of Gamma, used for the first stage of the Black Knight sounding rocket. Gamma thrust chambers were mounted in pairs radially, each pair on a one-axis tangential gimbal. Collective movement gave roll control while differential movement gave pitch control.
zh: 这是 Gamma 的 4 燃烧室发展型，用于黑骑士探空火箭的第一级。Gamma 的推力室成对径向安装，每对安装在一个单轴切向万向节上。同步偏转提供滚转控制，而差动偏转提供俯仰控制。

s: The Graphite-Epoxy Motor (GEM) replaced the steel case used on earlier Castor-series boosters with a lighter composite case. The 40-inch (1-meter) diameter GEM 40 was used on the Delta II 7000-series in sets of three, four, or nine. When nine boosters were used, six were ignited at liftoff and the remaining three were ignited after burnout and jettison of the first six. Burn time: 58 seconds.
zh: 石墨-环氧树脂发动机（GEM）用更轻的复合材料壳体取代了早期卡斯托系列助推器使用的钢制壳体。直径 40 英寸（1 米）的 GEM 40 以 3、4 或 9 台一组的形式用于德尔塔 II 7000 系列。当使用 9 台助推器时，6 台在起飞时点火，其余 3 台在前 6 台燃尽脱落后点火。燃烧时间：58 秒。

s: The 46-inch (1.2-m) diameter GEM 46 was used on the Delta III and Delta II Heavy in sets of nine, with six ignited at liftoff and three ignited after burnout of the first six. On the Delta III, three ground-lit boosters were equipped with TVC while all the remaining boosters used fixed nozzles. The Delta II Heavy used no boosters with TVC. Burn time 75 seconds.
zh: 直径 46 英寸（1.2 米）的 GEM 46 以 9 台一组的形式用于德尔塔 III 和德尔塔 II 重型火箭，其中 6 台在起飞时点火，3 台在前 6 台燃尽后点火。在德尔塔 III 上，3 台地面点火助推器配备了推力矢量控制（TVC），而其余助推器均采用固定喷管。德尔塔 II 重型火箭则未使用配备 TVC 的助推器。燃烧时间 75 秒。

s: The J85 was developed as a small, disposable jet engine to power decoys and drones, but was later upgraded for use on manned aircraft. It powered many small aircraft, including the F-5, CF-5, G.91Y, T-2, T-38, and A-37. This is the -4 variant, which powered the T-2C Buckeye. Available 1958. Thrust 13.1 kN. OPR 6.1, SFC 0.980 lb/lbf-hr static.
zh: J85最初作为一款小型一次性喷气发动机研发，用于为诱饵和无人机提供动力，但后来升级用于有人驾驶飞机。它为许多小型飞机提供了动力，包括<<M0>>、<<M1>>、G.91Y、<<M2>>、<<M3>>以及<<M4>>。这是-4型号，曾为<<M5>>“橡树”提供动力。1958年可用。推力13.1 kN。总增压比6.1，静止比油耗0.980 lb/lbf-hr。

s: An early 50s turbojet that was the powerplant for the Su-7, Su-9, Su-11, Tu-128, and Be-10 flying boat. This a early model with afterburner, the -7F, which powered the prototype Su-7. Available 1955. 88.8kN wet, 66.7kN dry. OPR 9.5, SFC 0.97/2.25 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 1.85.
zh: 一款50年代初期的涡轮喷气发动机，曾是<<M0>>、<<M1>>、<<M2>>、<<M3>>以及<<M4>>水上飞机的动力装置。这是一款带加力燃烧室的早期型号-7F，曾为原型机<<M0>>提供动力。1955年可用。加力88.8kN，无加力66.7kN。总增压比9.5，静止比油耗0.97/2.25 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制1.85马赫。

s: A late 1950s redesign of the Atar 101 to increase thrust (creating the Atar 08) and add an afterburner (creating the Atar 09). These upgrades powered the next generation of French jet aircraft, including the Etendard IV, Super Etendard, Mirage III/IV, and Mirage F1. The Atar 09B is an early model used in the Mirage IIIA. Available 1959. 58.8kN wet, 40.9kN dry. SFC 1.01/2.03 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 2.0.
zh: 于1950年代末期对Atar 101进行的重新设计，旨在提高推力（研制出Atar 08）并增加加力燃烧室（研制出Atar 09）。这些改进型为法国下一代喷气式飞机提供了动力，包括超军旗、军旗IV、幻影III/IV和幻影F1。Atar 09B是用于幻影IIIA的早期型号。1959年可用。加力58.8kN，无加力40.9kN。静止比油耗1.01/2.03 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制2.0马赫。

s: The Avon was Rolls-Royce's first axial-flow turbojet, introduced in 1950. It powered most British aircraft of the 1950s and 60s, including the Sea Vixen, Canberra, Lightning, Hunter, Swift and Valiant. The RA.4, an early 1950s model, powered early Hawker Hunters. Available 1951. Thrust 33.4kN. OPR 7.0, SFC 0.883 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 1.5.
zh: Avon是罗尔斯·罗伊斯于1950年推出的第一款轴流式涡轮喷气发动机。它为20世纪50年代和60年代的大多数英国飞机提供了动力，包括海雌狐、堪培拉、闪电、猎鹰、急流和勇士。RA.4是1950年代初期的型号，曾为早期的小贩猎鹰提供动力。1951年可用。推力33.4kN。总增压比7.0，静止比油耗0.883 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制1.5马赫。

s: The Avon was Rolls-Royce's first axial-flow turbojet, introduced in 1950. It powered most British aircraft of the 1950s and 60s, including the Sea Vixen, Canberra, Lightning, Hunter, Swift and Valiant. The RA.24R, an early 1960s model, powered the English Electric Lightning F.1. Available 1960. 63.9kN wet, 50.0kN dry. OPR 7.8, SFC 0.88/1.9 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 2.5.
zh: Avon是罗尔斯·罗伊斯于1950年推出的第一款轴流式涡轮喷气发动机。它为20世纪50年代和60年代的大多数英国飞机提供了动力，包括海雌狐、堪培拉、闪电、猎鹰、急流和勇士。RA.24R是1960年代初期的型号，曾为英国电气闪电F.1提供动力。1960年可用。加力63.9kN，无加力50.0kN。总增压比7.8，静止比油耗0.88/1.9 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制2.5马赫。

s: The J48 was also known as the Rolls-Royce Tay. Essentially an enlarged Nene, it was abandoned by Rolls-Royce in favor of the Avon. However, Pratt & Whitney was able to acquire the design, and produced it as the J48. It was used in the F9F-5 Panther, F9F-6/8 Cougar, F-94C Starfire, and YF-93. This is the -5, with afterburner, as used in the F-94C. Available 1950. 38.9 kN wet, 28.2 kN dry. 4.4 OPR, SFC 1.16 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 1.
zh: J48也被称为罗尔斯·罗伊斯泰伊。它本质上是放大的尼恩发动机，罗尔斯·罗伊斯后来放弃该项目转而研发Avon。然而，普拉特·惠特尼获得了该设计，并将其作为J48生产。它曾用于F9F-5黑豹、F9F-6/8美洲狮、<<M0>>星火和<<M1>>。这是带加力燃烧室的-5型号，用于<<M0>>。1950年可用。加力38.9 kN，无加力28.2 kN。总增压比4.4，静止比油耗1.16 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制1马赫。

s: An early 50s turbojet. The J57 was a workhorse, designed in the early 1950s and powering the B-52, most of the Century Series fighters, and even the U-2. This represents an early model, the -8, which powered the F4D Skyray/F5D Skylancer. Available 1951. 64.5kN wet, 45.3kN dry. OPR 11.9, SFC 0.90/2.1 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 1.5.
zh: 一款50年代初期的涡轮喷气发动机。J57是一款主力机型，设计于1950年代初，曾为<<M0>>、大多数百系列战斗机甚至<<M1>>提供动力。这代表了其早期型号-8，曾为F4D天光/F5D空中骑兵提供动力。1951年可用。加力64.5kN，无加力45.3kN。总增压比11.9，静止比油耗0.90/2.1 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制1.5马赫。

s: The J85 was developed as a small, disposable jet engine to power decoys and drones, but was later upgraded for use on manned aircraft. It powered many small aircraft, including the F-5, CF-5, G.91Y, T-2, T-38, and A-37. This is the afterburning -5 variant, which powered the F-5A/B Freedom Fighter. Available 1959. Thrust 17.1 kN wet, 11.9 kN dry. OPR 6.5, SFC 1.03/2.2 lb/lbf-hr static.
zh: J85最初作为一款小型一次性喷气发动机研发，用于为诱饵和无人机提供动力，但后来升级用于有人驾驶飞机。它为许多小型飞机提供了动力，包括<<M0>>、<<M1>>、G.91Y、<<M2>>、<<M3>>以及<<M4>>。这是带加力燃烧室的-5型号，曾为<<M5>>/B自由斗士提供动力。1959年可用。推力：加力17.1 kN，无加力11.9 kN。总增压比6.5，静止比油耗1.03/2.2 lb/lbf-hr。

s: A late 50s turbojet. Based on the Pratt & Whitney J57, the Model 304-2 was a liquid-hydrogen fueled turbojet, designed for project SUNTAN, a high performance replacement for the U-2 spyplane. The project required the development of large-scale Liquid Hydrogen production and handling techniques, at the cost of hundreds of millions of dollars, but the results were impressive. Pratt & Whitney were able to convert various jet engines to hydrogen power, where they showed incredible stability and efficiency. This information, along with many of the engineers involved in the project, were later transferred to working on the Pratt & Whitney RL-10, where the information gained proved invaluable. The Model 304 and project SUNTAN, however, were ultimately cancelled, as the conventionally fueled A-12/SR-71 was showing much greater promise. This represents the Model 304-2, the most advanced design developed before the cancellation of the project. Available 1959. 60.1 kN wet, 32.1 kN dry. OPR 5.1, SFC 0.38/0.9 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 3.0.
zh: 一款50年代后期的涡轮喷气发动机。304-2型基于普拉特·惠特尼J57改进，是一款液氢燃料涡轮喷气发动机，专为SUNTAN计划设计，该计划旨在寻找高性能飞机替代<<M0>>侦察机。该项目耗资数亿美元研发了大规模液氢生产和处理技术，成果令人瞩目。普拉特·惠特尼成功将多种喷气发动机改装为氢燃料动力，展现出了极高的稳定性与效率。这些技术资料以及参与该项目的许多工程师随后被转去研发普拉特·惠特尼<<M1>>，所获得的经验被证明极具价值。然而，304型和SUNTAN项目最终被取消，因为使用常规燃料的<<M2>>/<<M3>>展现出了更光明的前景。这代表了该项目取消前研发的最先进设计——304-2型。1959年可用。加力60.1 kN，无加力32.1 kN。总增压比5.1，静止比油耗0.38/0.9 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制3.0马赫。

s: A late 1960s turbojet. The ultimate version of the Olympus turbojet, designed for sustained Mach 2 operation to power Concorde. Although thirsty at sea level, when mated to a well-optimized intake this engine can supercruise at Mach 2, achieving relatively good efficiency. This represents the Olympus 593 Mk.610, as used in all production Concordes. Available 1969. 169.2kN wet, 139.4kN dry. OPR 15.5, SFC 0.87/1.39 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 3.0.
zh: 一款1960年代后期的涡轮喷气发动机。作为奥林匹斯涡轮喷气发动机的终极版本，专为协和飞机以2马赫持续巡航而设计。尽管在海平面油耗极高，但在配合经过良好优化的进气道时，该发动机能够以2马赫超音速巡航并获得相对不错的效率。这代表了用于所有量产型协和飞机的奥林匹斯593 Mk.610。1969年可用。加力169.2kN，无加力139.4kN。总增压比15.5，静止比油耗0.87/1.39 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制3.0马赫。

s: A late 50s turbojet. Developed in parallel with the less sophisticated RD-9, the R-11 became the powerplant for the MiG-21, Yak-28 and Su-15. This an early model, the F2-300, which powered the MiG-21PF. Available 1960. 60.8kN wet, 38.3kN dry. OPR 8.8, SFC 0.95/2.37 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 2.5.
zh: 一款50年代后期的涡轮喷气发动机。与技术较为简单的<<M0>>并行研发，<<M1>>成为了<<M2>>、<<M3>>和<<M4>>的动力装置。这是一款早期型号F2-300，曾为<<M5>>提供动力。1960年可用。加力60.8kN，无加力38.3kN。总增压比8.8，静止比油耗0.95/2.37 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制2.5马赫。

s: A late 50s turbojet. Originally developed for the Tu-121 cruise missile, the R-15 was modified instead for use on the MiG-25, which became the fastest serially produced fighter, capable of reaching Mach 3.2, although at the risk of severe engine damage. This is a later model, the BD-300, used on the MiG-25RB. Available 1969. 109.8kN wet, 86.3kN dry. OPR 4.75, SFC 1.25/2.75 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 3.5.
zh: 一款50年代后期的涡轮喷气发动机。<<M1>>最初为<<M0>>巡航导弹研制，后改装用于<<M2>>，使其成为飞行速度最快的量产战斗机，能够达到3.2马赫（尽管有发动机严重受损的风险）。这是后期的<<M3>>型号，用于<<M4>>。1969年可用。加力109.8kN，无加力86.3kN。总增压比4.75，静止比油耗1.25/2.75 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制3.5马赫。

s: A late 60s turbojet. Developed to replace the R-11 and R-13, the R-25 added an extremely powerful "extra-power" afterburner, that allowed it to nearly double it's thrust for short periods of time. This is the production model, used on the MiG-21Bis and Su-15Bis. 97.1kN wet, 40.3kN dry. OPR 9.5, SFC 0.96/3.34 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 2.5.
zh: 一款60年代后期的涡轮喷气发动机。为了替代<<M0>>和<<M1>>而研制，<<M2>>增加了一个极其强劲的“额外功率”加力燃烧室，使其能够在短时间内将推力提升近一倍。这是量产型号，用于<<M3>>和<<M4>>。加力97.1kN，无加力40.3kN。总增压比9.5，静止比油耗0.96/3.34 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制2.5马赫。

s: An early 50s turbojet. Developed as a scaled down Mikulin AM-3, the RD-9 was designed for fighter aircraft, and powered the Yak-25, 26, 27, 28, and MiG-19. This represents an early model, the -9B, which powered early MiG-19s. 31.9kN wet, 25.1kN dry. Available 1951. OPR 7.14, SFC 0.96/1.6 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 1.5.
zh: 一款50年代初期的涡轮喷气发动机。<<M1>>作为米库林<<M0>>的按比例缩小版本进行研发，专为战斗机设计，曾为<<M2>>、26、27、28以及<<M3>>提供动力。这代表了其早期型号-9B，曾为早期<<M4>>提供动力。加力31.9kN，无加力25.1kN。1951年可用。总增压比7.14，静止比油耗0.96/1.6 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制1.5马赫。

s: An early 1950s turbojet. Derived from the MetroVick F.2, the first axial-flow jet developed in Britain, the Sapphire powered the Hawker Hunter, Handley Page Victor, and Gloster Javelin. This represents a later model, the ASSa.7, which powered the Gloster Javelin FAW Mk.7. Available 1955. Thrust 48.9kN. OPR 7.0, SFC 0.885 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 2.0.
zh: 一款20世纪50年代早期的涡轮喷气发动机。源自英国研制的第一款轴流式喷气发动机<<M0>> F.2，Sapphire曾为霍克“猎鹰”、汉德利·佩奇“胜利者”和格罗斯特“标枪”提供动力。此型号代表后期的ASSa.7，曾用于格罗斯特“标枪”FAW Mk.7。1955年可用。推力48.9 kN。总增压比7.0，地面静止SFC 0.885 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制马赫数2.0。

s: A Soviet hypergolic gas generator upper stage engine. Created for the upper stage of the UR-100, the 15D13 was one of the first rockets ever developed by OKB-117. In order to save time, it's development was combined with the 5D22 upper stage engine for the A-350Zh anti-ballistic missile. It was also proposed as the braking engine for the LK-700S lander as the 11D423.
zh: 一款苏联自燃推进剂气动发生器循环上面级发动机。15D13专为<<M0>>的上面级研制，是<<M1>>最早开发的火箭发动机之一。为了节省时间，其研发与用于<<M2>>反弹道导弹的5D22上面级发动机合并进行。它还曾以11<<M4>>的代号被提议用作<<M3>>着陆器的制动发动机。

s: This is a 50 kW-class thruster. Development started in 2000 to enable space solar power systems and other high power spacecraft. A laboratory model of this high power thruster was fabricated and tested with xenon in 2002 at power levels up to 72 kW with 650V.
zh: 这是一款50 kW级的推进器。研发始于2000年，旨在支持空间太阳能电站系统和其他大功率航天器。2002年制造了该大功率推进器的实验室模型，并在高达72 kW、650V的功率水平下进行了氙气测试。

s: A basic pump-fed booster engine developed as an improved version of the Hermes A-1 for the Hermes A-3 ballistic missile. Difficulties with development led the program being split into two parts, with the smaller A-3A testing the engine and guidance systems for the larger A-3B. Although it was evaluated for use by the US Army as the SSM-A-16, it was rejected due to poor performance and reliability.
zh: 一款基础泵压式助推器发动机，作为Hermes <<M0>>的改进型为Hermes <<M1>>弹道导弹研制。由于研发困难，该项目被拆分为两部分，由较小的<<M2>>为较大的<<M3>>测试发动机和制导系统。尽管曾被美国陆军评估为SSM-<<M4>>使用，但因性能和可靠性较差而被否决。

s: A Thiel alcolox booster engine used on the A-4 Series B/V-2 missile. The Model 39b was an interim design, but went into production. Used 18 x 1.5 tonne thrust chambers that fed a common mixing chamber, as combustion instability issues of a single large injector were unable to be resolved. Work began 1936, testing in 1939, and mass production from 1943-1945.
zh: 一款用于<<M0>>系列B/<<M1>>导弹的Thiel酒精/液氧助推器发动机。Model 39b是一个过渡设计，但最终投入了量产。由于单个大型喷注器的燃烧不稳定性问题无法解决，该发动机采用了18个1.5吨级的推力室共同喷入一个混合室。研发工作始于1936年，1939年进行测试，1943年至1945年间大规模生产。

s: A hypergolic upper stage engine. The baseline Aestus engine is pressure fed and is used on the Ariane 5 G, GS and ES series, while the Aestus II (also known as RS-72) variant is pump-fed with better overall performance.
zh: 一款自燃推进剂上面级发动机。基准型Aestus发动机为挤压循环，用于阿丽亚娜5 G、GS和ES系列；而Aestus II（亦称<<M0>>）变型则采用泵压循环，具备更优越的综合性能。

s: Originally developed for a standoff weapon for the B-58 Hustler, the XLR81 is a gas-generator engine with storable propellants. Later space variants improved performance and capability. Engine restart was added on the Agena B's XLR81-BA-7 (Model 8081). The XLR81-BA-11 (Model 8096) used on Agena D used propellant sumps to handle ullage. The XLR81-BA-13 (Model 8247) powered the Gemini Agena Target Vehicle (a modified Agena D) and was rated for up to 14 restarts.
zh: <<M1>>最初是为<<M0>>“盗贼”防区外武器研制的，是一款采用可贮存推进剂的气动发生器循环发动机。后期的航天型号提升了性能和能力。阿金纳B使用的<<M1>>-<<M2>>（Model 8081）增加了发动机重启功能。阿金纳D使用的<<M1>>-<<M3>>（Model 8096）利用推进剂收集沉淀槽来解决沉底问题。<<M1>>-<<M4>>（Model 8247）为双子座阿金纳目标飞行器（改装版阿金纳D）提供动力，额定重启次数多达14次。

s: A secondary propulsion system developed for the Gemini program on the Agena Target Vehicle. It allowed for fine control and orbital maneuvers without igniting the main engine. It was later offered to commercial customers as an upgrade for Agena. The system is a completely contained unit including propellant tanks, one 16-lb thrust chamber, and one 200-lb thrust chamber.
zh: 为双子座计划中阿金纳目标飞行器研制的二次推进系统。它无需启动主发动机即可进行微调控制和轨道机动。该系统后来作为阿金纳的升级方案向商业客户推销。该系统为一个完全自成一体的单元，包含推进剂贮箱、一个16磅推力室和一个200磅推力室。

s: A small pressure-fed hypergolic engine. A derivative of the first US liquid engine, the AJ10 is the longest-lived of any engine family, from the US's first satellite launch vehicle, Vanguard, through the Apollo CSM, and even planned for an Orion service module. This represents advanced AJ10s with a nozzle extension and restart capability. Used on Transtage and the Delta F and Delta K upper stages.
zh: 一款小型挤压循环自燃推进剂发动机。作为美国第一款液体发动机的衍生型号，<<M0>>是所有发动机家族中寿命最长的一系，从美国首颗卫星运载火箭“先锋号”，到阿波罗CSM，乃至曾计划用于“猎户座”服务舱。此型号代表带有喷管延伸段且具备重启能力的先进型<<M1>>。曾用于Transtage以及德尔塔F和德尔塔K上面级。

s: A small pressure-fed hypergolic engine. A derivative of the first US liquid engine, the AJ10 is the longest-lived of any engine family, from the US's first satellite launch vehicle, Vanguard, through the Apollo CSM, and even planned for an Orion service module. This is the original Vanguard second stage / Able / Delta configuration, without restart capability.
zh: 一款小型挤压循环自燃推进剂发动机。作为美国第一款液体发动机的衍生型号，<<M0>>是所有发动机家族中寿命最长的一系，从美国首颗卫星运载火箭“先锋号”，到阿波罗CSM，乃至曾计划用于“猎户座”服务舱。这是最初的“先锋号”第二级/Able/德尔塔构型，不具备重启能力。

s: A small pressure-fed hypergolic engine. A derivative of the first US liquid engine, the AJ10 is the longest-lived of any engine family, from the US's first satellite launch vehicle, Vanguard, through the Apollo CSM, and even planned for an Orion service module. This represents mid-period AJ10s with a nozzle extension and restart capability. Used on Thor-Ablestar and Delta E through Delta N.
zh: 一款小型挤压循环自燃推进剂发动机。作为美国第一款液体发动机的衍生型号，<<M0>>是所有发动机家族中寿命最长的一系，从美国首颗卫星运载火箭“先锋号”，到阿波罗CSM，乃至曾计划用于“猎户座”服务舱。此型号代表带有喷管延伸段且具备重启能力的中期型<<M1>>。曾用于雷神-Ablestar以及德尔塔E至德尔塔N。

s: A pump-fed upgrade for the AJ10 developed in the 1980s as a high performance upper stage and tug. It was based heavily on the Shuttle OMS, with the same nozzle and combustion chamber, but had turbomachinery installed in place of a pressure-fed system. The program was cancelled after the Challenger disaster, but Transtar 1 flew as the Titan Launch Dispenser on Titan IV.
zh: 于20世纪80年代为<<M0>>研制的泵压式升级型，旨在用作高性能上面级和轨道拖船。它大量借鉴了航天飞机OMS的技术，拥有相同的喷管和燃烧室，但安装了涡轮泵机械以取代挤压循环系统。该计划在挑战者号失事后取消，但Transtar 1曾作为大力神发射分配器在“大力神IV”上飞行。

s: The AJ-260 was the largest rocket motor ever tested. This is the full length version of the engine. With a gross mass of 1,648 tons, it provides a thrust of 35,391 kN for more than 2 minutes. This version was designed as an alternative to the Saturn IB and as a booster for Apollo Applications launch vehicles.
zh: <<M0>>是有史以来测试过的最大火箭发动机。这是该发动机的全长版本。总质量1,648吨，可提供超过2分钟的35,391 kN推力。该版本被设计为土星IB的替代方案，以及阿波罗应用计划运载火箭的助推器。

s: The AJ-260 was the largest rocket motor ever tested. This is the full length version of the engine. With a gross mass of 1,648 tons, it provides a thrust of 35,391 kN for more than 2 minutes. This version was designed as an alternative to the Saturn IB and as a booster for Apollo Applications launch vehicles. This is the radially attached version to be used as a strap-on booster. [Diameter: 6.6 m]
zh: <<M0>>是有史以来测试过的最大火箭发动机。这是该发动机的全长版本。总质量1,648吨，可提供超过2分钟的35,391 kN推力。该版本被设计为土星IB的替代方案，以及阿波罗应用计划运载火箭的助推器。这是用于捆绑式助推器的径向安装版本。[直径：6.6 m]

s: The AJ-260 was the largest rocket motor ever tested. This is the short length version, a 21.6 x 6.6 meter behemoth that weighed more than 842 tons fully loaded. It was capable of providing over 15 MN of thrust for 120 seconds. The program was ultimately cancelled, but not before three test firings where the engines performed exactly to specifications.
zh: <<M0>>是有史以来测试过的最大火箭发动机。这是缩短长度的版本，是一个尺寸达21.6 x 6.6米、满载重量超过842吨的庞然大物。它能够提供超过15 MN的推力并持续120秒。该项目最终被取消，但取消前曾进行过三次试车，发动机的性能完全符合技术规范。

s: The AJ-260 was the largest rocket motor ever tested. This is the short length version, a 21.6 x 6.6 meter behemoth that weighed more than 842 tons fully loaded. It was capable of providing over 15 MN of thrust for 120 seconds. The program was ultimately cancelled, but not before three test firings where the engines performed exactly to specifications. This is the radially attached version to be used as a strap-on booster.
zh: <<M0>>是有史以来测试过的最大火箭发动机。这是短款构型，是一个尺寸达 21.6 x 6.6 米、满载重量超过 842 吨的庞然大物。它能够提供超过 15 MN 的推力，工作时间长达 120 秒。该计划最终被取消，但在三次试车中发动机均完全达到了指标要求。此版本为径向安装型，用作捆绑助推器。

s: A small solid kick motor developed for use as the 5th stage on the Scout launch vehicles. It was only ever launched once, on the Scout E-1 used for Explorer 52. Maximum thrust 27.5kN, burn time 9 seconds.
zh: 一款小型固体冲量发动机，开发用作侦察兵（Scout）运载火箭的第 5 级。它仅发射过一次，搭载于用于探索者 52 号的 Scout <<M0>> 上。最大推力 27.5 kN，工作时间 9 秒。

s: A small solid kick motor developed as alternative Vanguard third stage. It was reused on many later LVs with the Able/Delta upper stage (or simply "Thor Burner") to circularize at apogee or perform a final payload kick. Burn time 39 seconds.
zh: 一款小型固体冲量发动机，作为先锋号第三级的替代方案而开发。它随后被广泛用于搭载 Able/Delta 上级（或简称“雷神-伯纳”）的多种后续运载火箭，用于在远地点进行圆轨道化或对有效载荷进行最终加速。工作时间 39 秒。

s: The Advanced Material Bipropellant Rocket engine is a high performance, higher thrust, radiation cooled, storable bipropellant space engine of the same physical envelope as the High Performance Apogee Thruster.
zh: 先进材料双组元火箭（AMBR）发动机是一款高性能、高推力、辐射冷却的可贮存双组元航天发动机，具有与高性能远地点推进器相同的外部轮廓尺寸。

s: The AR-1 is a 2,200-kilonewton-class kerolox engine using oxidizer-rich staged combustion. Two of those were proposed to replace the Russian made RD-180 on the Atlas V rocket. Development of this engine was halted because Aerojet Rocketdyne was unwilling to pay for its completion.
zh: <<M0>>是一款 2200 kN 级的富氧分级燃烧煤油液氧发动机。曾提议使用两台该型发动机来替代宇宙神 V 型火箭上的俄制<<M1>>。由于 Aerojet Rocketdyne 不愿出资完成研发，该发动机的研制工作最终中止。

s: A small liquid fueled booster rocket, intended to increase the performance of the FJ-4/F-86. Tested extensively, but the weight of the system offset any performance gains. Later upgraded to be pump-fed, allowing it to use fuel directly from the fuel tanks of the aircraft, and used to power the NF-104A astronaut training aircraft.
zh: 一款小型液体燃料助推火箭，旨在提升<<M0>>/<<M1>>的性能。经过了大量测试，但该系统的重量抵消了所有的性能收益。后来升级为泵压式，使其能够直接使用飞机油箱中的燃料，并用于驱动<<M2>>宇航员训练机。

s: A small solid kick motor used on the Jupiter-C sounding rocket (and later the Juno I and II launch vehicles) as upper stages in clusters of 11, 3 and, finally, one attached to the payload. The standard version uses the T17-E2 grain mixture while the higher performance one uses the JPL-532A.
zh: 一款小型固体冲量发动机，用于朱庇特-C 探空火箭（以及后来的朱诺 I 号和 II 号运载火箭），以 11 台、3 台以及最后单台连接至有效载荷的聚束形式作为上面级使用。标准版本使用 T17-E2 推进剂药柱，而高性能版本则使用<<M0>>。

s: The BE-3 (Blue Engine 3) is a hydrolox rocket engine developed by Blue Origin, using a combustion tap-off cycle. The BE-3U is a significantly upgraded BE-3 for vacuum use, with a large nozzle and very high thrust to weight ratio.
zh: <<M0>>（蓝色发动机 3 号）是由蓝色起源（Blue Origin）开发的一款氢氧火箭发动机，采用燃烧室抽气循环。<<M1>>是<<M0>>的大幅真空升级型，拥有大喷管和极高的推重比。

s: The BE-4 is an oxidizer-rich staged combustion methalox engine. Though initially developed for use on a Blue Origin launch vehicle, United Launch Alliance announced in 2014 that their new Vulcan launch vehicle will be powered by a pair of BE-4 engines.
zh: <<M0>>是一款富氧分级燃烧甲烷液氧发动机。虽然最初是为蓝色起源自家的运载火箭开发，但联合发射联盟（ULA）于 2014 年宣布，其全新的火神（Vulcan）运载火箭将由一对<<M0>>发动机提供动力。

s: Low thrust pump-fed expander nuclear engine. Evolved from the original NERVA design, the Bimodal NTR, instead of wasting precious propellant mass on cooling the engine reactor, uses a Brayton cycle electricity generator unit to convert the waste thermal energy into useful electrical power. It also supports liquid oxygen injection (TRITON - trimodal operation) for increased thrust at the cost of lower overall efficiency.
zh: 低推力泵压膨胀循环核火箭发动机。双模态 NTR 从原版 NERVA 设计演变而来，不再将珍贵的推进剂质量浪费在反应堆冷却上，而是使用布雷顿循环发电机组将废热能转化为有用的电能。它还支持液氧喷射（TRITON——三模态运行），以牺牲整体效率为代价换取更大的推力。

s: Moderate thrust pump-fed expander nuclear engine. Evolved from the original NERVA design, the Bimodal NTR, instead of wasting precious propellant mass on cooling the engine reactor, uses a Brayton cycle electricity generator unit to convert the waste thermal energy into useful electrical power. It also supports liquid oxygen injection (TRITON - trimodal operation) for increased thrust at the cost of lower overall efficiency. This is from a later study, and is larger than the original BNTR design. It also uses low-enriched uranium to reduce costs, and a much more powerful Brayton generator to power electrical propulsion systems.
zh: 中推力泵压膨胀循环核火箭发动机。双模态 NTR 从原版 NERVA 设计演变而来，不再将珍贵的推进剂质量浪费在反应堆冷却上，而是使用布雷顿循环发电机组将废热能转化为有用的电能。它还支持液氧喷射（TRITON——三模态运行），以牺牲整体效率为代价换取更大的推力。这来自后期的研究方案，尺寸大于原始的 BNTR 设计。它还使用低浓缩铀以降低成本，并配备更强劲的布雷顿发电机为电力推进系统供电。

s: A derivative of the Castor 1 motor, the Castor 2 featured higher specific impulse and propellant load, a lower dry mass fraction, and a longer burn time. It was used as strap-on booster starting with Delta E and in all but the early Scouts. Burn time 39s.
zh: 作为卡斯托 1（Castor 1）发动机的衍生型号，卡斯托 2 具有更高的比冲和装药量、更低的结构质量比以及更长的工作时间。从德尔塔 E 起，以及除早期型号外的所有侦察兵火箭上，它都被用作捆绑助推器。工作时间 39 秒。

s: The Castor 4 was developed as the second stage of the Athena H missile and first flew in 1971. It was later adapted to replace Delta's Castor 2 boosters, increasing GTO capacity from 723 kg to nearly 900 kg. The Delta 3000-series launched in 1975 with a staggered booster staging sequence. Previous Deltas burned their motors in a 6-3 sequence and then jettisoned all SRMs at once. The heavier and longer-burning Castor 4 required that the motors be jettisoned as soon as they ran out to reduce dead weight. A less efficient 5-4 sequence was used until Delta was strengthened in the early 80s to handle the acceleration of a 6-3 sequence.
zh: 卡斯托 4 最初作为雅典娜 H 导弹的第二级研制，于 1971 年首飞。后来经过改装以替代德尔塔火箭上的卡斯托 2 助推器，将地球同步转移轨道（GTO）运载能力从 723 kg 提高到近 900 kg。德尔塔 3000 系列于 1975 年首飞，采用了交错的助推器分离时序。先前的德尔塔火箭采用 6-3 顺序点火，然后一次性抛弃所有固体火箭助推器。更重且工作时间更长的卡斯托 4 要求助推器燃尽后立即抛弃以减少死重。在 80 年代初德尔塔火箭进行结构加强以承受 6-3 顺序的加速度之前，一直采用效率较低的 5-4 顺序。

s: The Castor 4A was introduced on the first generation of Delta II launchers, the 6000-series, and offered improved thrust and specific impulse by replacing PBAA with higher energy HTPB. This, combined with a stretched first stage (the Extra-Extended Long Tank Thor), and a return to the more efficient 6-3 SRM ignition sequence, improved Delta's performance by 11% over the 3000-series. The Castor 4A was flown on the Delta II from 1989 until 1993, when it was replaced by the GEM 40. The boosters were also used on the Atlas IIAS from 1993 until 2004. Burn time 53 seconds.
zh: 卡斯托 4A 首次应用于第一代德尔塔 II 系列运载火箭（6000 系列），通过使用能量更高的 HTPB 代替 PBAA，提高了推力和比冲。配合加长的第一级（加长型长箱体雷神）以及恢复采用更高效率的 6-3 固体助推器点火时序，使德尔塔的性能比 3000 系列提高了 11%。卡斯托 4A 在德尔塔 II 上服役至 1993 年，随后被 GEM 40 取代。该助推器还于 1993 年至 2004 年间用于宇宙神 IIAS 火箭。工作时间 53 秒。

s: The CASTOR 30 is a low cost, robust, state-of-the-art upper stage motor. This commercially-developed motor is 144 inches long and nominally designed as an upper stage that can function as a second or third stage depending on the vehicle configuration.
zh: CASTOR 30 是一款低成本、高可靠性、先进的上面级发动机。这款商业开发的发动机长 144 英寸，名义上设计为上面级，可根据火箭构型充当第二级或第三级。

s: The RS-25, also known as the Space Shuttle Main Engine (SSME), is a LH2/LOX fuel-rich staged combustion engine. This version uses an extendable nozzle, allowing the SSME to switch from a 50:1 sea level nozzle to a 150:1 vacuum nozzle mid-flight. Intended for SSTO use, where the extending nozzle would allow for the required performance at sea level and vacuum.
zh: <<M0>>也被称为航天飞机主发动机（SSME），是一种液氢/液氧富燃分级燃烧发动机。该型号采用了可伸缩喷管，允许 SSME 在飞行途中从 50:1 的海平面喷管切换为 150:1 的真空喷管。专为单级入轨（SSTO）设计，伸缩喷管可确保其兼顾海平面与真空环境所需的性能。

s: The RS-25, also known as the Space Shuttle Main Engine (SSME), is a LH2/LOX fuel-rich staged combustion engine. This version has an enormous 650:1 vacuum nozzle and has undergone extensive weight-reduction measures for use on a martian space tug.
zh: <<M0>>也被称为航天飞机主发动机（SSME），是一种液氢/液氧富燃分级燃烧发动机。该型号配备了巨大的 650:1 真空喷管，并经过了深度减重改造，用于火星空间拖船。

s: The STAR 3 motor was developed and qualified in 2003 as the Transverse Impulse Rocket System (TIRS) for the Mars Exploration Rover (MER) program for JPL in Pasadena, CA. Three TIRS motors were carried on each of the MER landers. One of the TIRS motors was fired in January 2004 to provide the impulse necessary to reduce lateral velocity of the MER Spirit lander prior to landing on the Martian surface. The motor also has applicability for spin/despin and separation systems.
zh: STAR 3 发动机于 2003 年研制并完成认证，作为加州帕萨迪纳 JPL 火星探测漫游者（MER）项目的横向冲量火箭系统（TIRS）。每个 MER 着陆器上都搭载了三台 TIRS 发动机。2004 年 1 月，其中一台 TIRS 发动机成功点火，提供了必要的冲量，以在 MER“勇气号”着陆器着陆火星表面之前消除横向速度。该发动机还可应用于自旋/减旋以及分离系统。

s: This STAR motor was developed and tested in January 2000 under a NASA Goddard Space Flight Center program for a low-cost, high mass fraction orbit adjust motor for use in deploying constellations of very small satellites (nanosatellites). The first static test of the STAR 4G prototype motor was conducted 8 months after program start. The motor is designed to operate at high chamber pressure and incorporates a noneroding throat insert to maximize specific impulse.
zh: 该 STAR 发动机于 2000 年 1 月根据 NASA 戈达德太空飞行中心的项目研制并测试，旨在作为一种低成本、高质量分数的轨道调整发动机，用于部署超小型卫星（纳米卫星）星座。STAR 4G 原型发动机在项目启动 8 个月后进行了首次静力测试。该发动机设计在较高室压下工作，并集成了耐烧蚀喉衬以最大化比冲。

s: The STAR 5C rocket motor was initially designed and produced (1960-1963) under a contract with Martin Marietta. The STAR 5C is used to separate the second stage from the trans-stage on the Titan II missile and Titan launch vehicle. The current version was qualified for use in 1976, replacing the earlier main propellant grain with TP-H-3062.
zh: STAR 5C 火箭发动机最初是在与马丁·玛丽埃塔公司的合同下设计并生产的（1960-1963年）。STAR 5C 用于在泰坦 II 导弹和泰坦运载火箭上分离二级与过渡级。当前版本于 1976 年通过认证，将早期的主推进剂药柱更换为 TP-<<M0>>。

s: The STAR 5D rocket motor was designed and qualified to serve as the Rocket-Assisted Deceleration (RAD) motor on the Mars Pathfinder mission. Three of these motors were fired to slow the Pathfinder spacecraft to near-zero velocity before bouncing on the surface of Mars.
zh: STAR 5D 火箭发动机经过专门设计和认证，用作火星探路者任务中的火箭辅助减速（RAD）发动机。其中三台发动机点火工作，在探路者探测器接触火星表面弹跳之前将其速度降至接近零。

s: The STAR 6B rocket motor was developed for spin-up and axial propulsion of re-entry vehicles. The design incorporates an aluminum case and a carbon-phenolic nozzle assembly. The STAR 6B was qualified in 1984 and first flew in 1985.
zh: STAR 6B 火箭发动机专为再入飞行器的起旋和轴向推进而研制。其设计采用了铝制壳体和碳-酚醛喷管组件。STAR 6B 于 1984 年通过认证，并于 1985 年首次飞行。

s: The STAR 8 was developed and qualified as the Rocket Assisted Deceleration (RAD) motor for the Mars Exploration Rover (MER) program. The motor is based on the STAR 5D motor technology developed for JPL’s Mars Pathfinder program. The STAR 8 first flew in January 2004 when three motors were used to decelerate each of the Spirit and Opportunity rovers for landing at Gusev Crater and Meridiani Planum on Mars.
zh: STAR 8 作为火星探测漫游者（MER）项目的火箭辅助减速（RAD）发动机研制并完成认证。该发动机基于为 JPL 火星探路者项目开发的 STAR 5D 发动机技术。STAR 8 于 2004 年 1 月首飞，当时三台发动机分别用于为“勇气号”和“机遇号”漫游车减速，以着陆在火星的古谢夫撞击坑和子午线高原。

s: The STAR 9 rocket motor was developed in 1993 on independent research and development funds to demonstrate a number of low-cost motor technologies. These included an integral aft polar boss/exit cone, two-dimensional carbon-carbon throat, and case-on-propellant manufacturing technique.
zh: STAR 9 火箭发动机于 1993 年利用独立研究与开发资金研制，旨在验证多项低成本发动机技术。其中包括一体式后极性接头/扩张锥头、二维碳-碳喉衬以及药柱浇注壳体制造工艺。

s: This orbit insertion motor incorporated the lightweight case developed for the STAR 13 with the propellant and nozzle design of the earlier TE-M-516 apogee motor. The motor case was stretched 2.2 inches to provide for increased propellant loading. This motor was used to adjust the inclination of a satellite from a Delta launch.
zh: 该轨道注入发动机将为 STAR 13 研制的轻质壳体与早期 TE-<<M0>> 远地点发动机的推进剂和喷管设计相结合。发动机壳体延长了 2.2 英寸，以增加推进剂加注量。该发动机曾用于调整德尔塔火箭发射卫星的倾角。

s: Apogee kick motor. Modifications: 175 mm straight section added to the Star 17. The 17A has been used for circularized orbits for the Skynet 1, NATO 1, and IMP-H & J satellites. This motor provides the high case safety factor required for this program. The TE-M-521-7 model used for several Air Force missions provides a typical safety factor with a 1.3 pound weight savings.
zh: 远地点变轨发动机。改进项：在 Star 17 的基础上增加了一段 175 mm 的直筒段。17A 型号曾用于天网 1、北约 1 以及 IMP-H & J 卫星的圆轨道成轨。该发动机提供了该项目所需的高壳体安全系数。用于多次空军任务的 TE-<<M0>> 型号提供了常规安全系数，同时减轻了 1.3 磅的重量。

s: The lightweight external nozzle is a composite of graphite, plastic, and steel. The consumable pyrogen igniter is actuated by two 6-second-delay electrical initiators or two SBASI zero-time-delay initiators.
zh: 轻质外置喷管是由石墨、塑料和钢制成的复合材料结构。消耗型烟火点火具由两个 6 秒延时电引爆器或两个 SBASI 零延时引爆器触发。

s: The STAR 24C is an improved variant of the STAR 24 solid rocket motor, designed for the International Ultraviolet Explorer mission. Features an increased propellant loading and higher chamber pressure compared to the baseline STAR 24 motor.
zh: STAR 24C 是 STAR 24 固体火箭发动机的改进型，专为国际紫外线探测器（IUE）任务设计。与基准 STAR 24 发动机相比，其增加了推进剂加注量并提高了室压。

s: An apogee motor developed for the Canadian Communications Research Centre's Communications Technology Satellite. An offloaded version was qualified and flown successfully. With various propellant loadings and explosive transfer assemblies, it was used for the Broadcast Satellite Experiment, the Geostationary Meteorological Satellite, the Navigation Technology Satellite No. 2, the Global Positioning System Satellites, the P78-1 Satellite, and the Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite.
zh: 为加拿大通信研究中心的通信技术卫星开发的远地点发动机。其降额装药版本通过了认证并成功飞行。通过不同的推进剂装药量和爆炸导爆索组件，它曾用于广播卫星试验、静止气象卫星、导航技术卫星 2 号、全球定位系统卫星、P78-1 卫星和静止环境观测卫星。

s: Antares III is the third-generation third stage for Vought Corporation's Scout launch vehicle. The design incorporates an 89-percent-solids HTPB propellant in a Kevlar filament-wound case insulated with silica-filled EPDM rubber.
zh: 心宿二 III（Antares III）是沃特公司侦察兵（Scout）运载火箭的第三代第三级发动机。该设计采用了含 89% 固体含量的 HTPB 推进剂，置于开夫拉纤维缠绕壳体内，内衬绝热层为掺二氧化硅的三元乙丙橡胶（EPDM）。

s: The STAR 37E is an improved version of the venerable STAR 37 solid rocket motor, featuring increased propellant loading, higher efficiency, and more vacuum thrust. It was first used on the Delta 1000 launch vehicle family as a third stage kick motor.
zh: STAR 37E 是久负盛名的 STAR 37 固体火箭发动机的改进型号，具有更高的推进剂装填量、更高的效率和更大的真空推力。它最初在德尔塔 1000 运载火箭系列中用作第三级变轨发动机。

s: The STAR 37FM is an improved version of the venerable STAR 37 solid rocket motor, featuring increased propellant loading, higher efficiency, and more vacuum thrust. It was first used on the FTLSATCOM satellites as an apogee motor.
zh: STAR 37FM 是久负盛名的 STAR 37 固体火箭发动机的改进型号，具有更高的推进剂装载量、更高的效率和更大的真空推力。它最初在 FLTSATCOM 卫星上用作远地点发动机。

s: Also known as the Payload Assistance Module (PAM) B, this kick motor was used for Delta and STS launches to add extra impulse to the payload. This is the short-nozzle version. Maximum thrust 76.11kN, burn time 85 seconds.
zh: 也被称为有效载荷辅助模块（PAM）B，该变轨发动机用于德尔塔和航天飞机发射任务，为有效载荷提供额外的冲量。此版本为短喷管型号。最大推力 76.11kN，工作时间 85 秒。

s: The STAR 63, as part of the PAM DII upper stage, has been flown from the Space Shuttle. The motor utilizes a head-end web and a carbon-phenolic nozzle. The case material is a Kevlar-epoxy composite, through future motors would be made using a graphite-epoxy composite. Testing of STAR 63 series motors began in 1978 with completion of the PAM DII motor qualification in 1985. The first STAR 63D flight was from the Shuttle in November 1985 to place a defense communication satellite in orbit.
zh: STAR 63曾作为PAM DII上面级的一部分随航天飞机升空。该发动机采用前端星孔药型和碳-酚醛喷管。壳体材料为凯夫拉-环氧树脂复合材料，不过后续型号改为石墨-环氧树脂复合材料。STAR 63系列发动机的测试始于1978年，PAM DII发动机鉴定测试于1985年完成。STAR 63D的首次飞行是在1985年11月由航天飞机发射升空，将一颗国防通信卫星送入轨道。

s: Stentor was developed as a two chamber booster-sustainer for the Blue Steel missile, with one chamber providing boost thrust and another smaller chamber providing sustainer thrust. This part represents the larger booster chamber. The smaller chamber was developed into the Gamma series of rocket engines, while the larger chamber was proposed for several projects, but ultimately never developed further.
zh: Stentor是为“蓝钢”导弹研发的双燃烧室助推器-巡航发动机，其中一个燃烧室提供助推推力，另一个较小的燃烧室提供巡航推力。该部件代表较大的助推燃烧室。较小的燃烧室后来发展为Gamma系列火箭发动机，而较大的燃烧室虽曾被提议用于多个项目，但最终未进一步研发。

s: The Space Transportation Main Engine was a hydrolox engine, ultimately cancelled in 1992. Rocketdyne was teamed with Aerojet and Pratt & Whitney on the STME, which would have powered the next generation of large launch vehicles.
zh: 空间运输主发动机（STME）是一款液氢液氧发动机，最终于1992年取消。Rocketdyne与Aerojet及Pratt & Whitney联手研制STME，本计划用于为下一代大型运载火箭提供动力。

s: The Vernier System as used on the Surveyor Probes. It uses storable hypergolic propellants, has infinite restarts, is not subject to ullage, and is throttleable down to 30%. Historically 3 of them were used on the Surveyor probes which landed on the Moon.
zh: 用于“勘测者”探测器的游标推进系统。使用可贮存自燃推进剂，可无限次重启，不受沉底限制，且节流阀可深节流至30%。历史上曾有3台该发动机用于着陆月球的“勘测者”探测器。

s: The Viking lander Terminal Descent Engine (TDE). The lander had three such engines, which were used during the final 45 seconds or so of the descent to the surface of Mars. Multiple small exhaust nozzles are used to diffuse the exhaust plume to eliminate a recirculation zone that could contaminate spacecraft instrumentation and avoid potential extensive erosion of the landing site.
zh: 海盗号着陆器末端下降发动机（TDE）。着陆器装有三台此类发动机，用于降落至火星表面最后约45秒的过程。采用多个小排气喷管扩散尾流羽流，以消除可能污染航天器仪器的再循环区，并避免有着陆场被严重吹蚀的潜在风险。

s: A small solid fueled booster originally used to power anti-shipping rockets during WW2. It was used as the kick stage on the WAC Corporal, the USA's first sounding rocket, and reused in a modified form for the Aerobee line of sounding rockets.
zh: 一种小型固体燃料助推器，最初在二战期间用于为反舰火箭提供动力。它曾用作美国首枚探空火箭“下士WAC”的起飞助推级，并经改进后复用于Aerobee系列探空火箭。

s: An early 2000s atmospheric staged combustion kerolox engine developed as the booster engine for a Space Shuttle replacement as a part of the Space Launch Initiative program. High performance with reusability and throttling capabilities, but cancelled during prototype phase.
zh: 一种21世纪初的大气分级燃烧煤油液氧发动机，作为航天发射倡议（SLI）计划的一部分，研发用作航天飞机替代方案的助推器发动机。具备高可靠性、可复用与节流阀调节能力，但在原型阶段被取消。

s: The UA1207 was used on the Titan IVA, which was developed to launch payloads that had been designed to fly on the Shuttle from Vandenberg. It was a 7-segment modification of the 5-segment UA1205 used on the Titan 3. Burn time 130 seconds.
zh: <<M0>>曾用于大力神IVA，该型号专为在范登堡发射原本设计由航天飞机搭载的有效载荷而研制。它是大力神3所使用的5段式<<M1>>的7段改进型。燃烧时间130秒。

s: Developed as a "Super-Veronique", the Vexin is a large pressure-fed booster engine used on the Vesta and "Precious Stones" series of sounding rockets, as well as the Diamante and Europe launch vehicles. One of the largest pressure-fed engines ever flown, this engine is simple but low performance.
zh: Vexin作为“超级韦罗妮克”研制，是一种用于“灶神星”和“宝石”系列探空火箭以及钻石号和欧罗巴运载火箭的大型挤压式助推器发动机。作为有史以来升空过的最大挤压式发动机之一，该发动机结构简单但性能较低。

s: Based on the Ad Astra lab test article built to test the configuration to be flown on the ISS, the VASIMR engine is far more powerful than any other ion engine to this point. It will require about 200kW of power.
zh: 基于Ad Astra实验室用于测试拟在ISS上运行配置的试验机研制，VASIMR发动机的威力远超迄今为止的任何其他离子发动机。它需要约200kW的电力。

s: A high thrust hypergolic vacuum engine. Derived from the European Viking engines that were used on the early Ariane launch vehicles for booster or sustainer roles. ISRO adapted them as a vacuum engine for the second stage of the Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle (PSLV) and the Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle (GSLV) families.
zh: 一款大推力自燃真空发动机。衍生自用于早期阿丽亚娜运载火箭作为助推器或巡航级的欧洲维京发动机。ISRO将其改装为真空发动机，用于极轨卫星运载火箭（PSLV）和地球同步卫星运载火箭（GSLV）系列的第二级。

s: A hypergolic booster engine developed for the European Ariane launch vehicle. Used as both a first stage engine and second stage engine when equipped with an extended nozzle. A version was also created for the Ariane 4 strap-on liquid boosters. Unremarkable performance, but good reliability.
zh: 为欧洲阿丽亚娜运载火箭研发的自燃助推器发动机。既可用作第一级发动机，换装延伸喷管后也可用作第二级发动机。还专门为阿丽亚娜4捆绑式液体助推器开发了一个型号。性能平平，但可靠性良好。

s: Operational Viking variants with bell nozzles, used on the first stage of Ariane 1-4, and on the Ariane 4 strap-on liquid boosters. The Viking is a hypergolic booster engine developed for Ariane and used as both a first and second stage engine (when equipped with an extended nozzle). Unremarkable performance, but good reliability.
zh: 带钟形喷管的维京发动机实用型号，用于阿丽亚娜1-4的第一级以及阿丽亚娜4捆绑式液体助推器。维京发动机是为阿丽亚娜研发的自燃助推器发动机，可用作第一级发动机，配装延伸喷管时也可作为第二级发动机。性能平平，但可靠性良好。

s: Developed to power the Wasserfall anti-aircraft missile, the Wasserfall Booster was essentially a 1/4 scale A-4. Designed to be cheap and able to launch on short notice, it used a simple pressure-fed feed system and was powered by explosives-grade nitric acid and liqufied coal. Although the rocket worked well, difficulty in developing a guidance system that could accurately engage aircraft proved impossible with the technology available. Post-war, it was tested by both American and Soviet engineers. Soviet engineers developed improved versions for the R-101, but were also unable to develop a practical guidance system for anti-aircraft use, and instead converted it into a ballistic missile, creating the R-11 (Scud).
zh: 为“瀑布”防空导弹提供动力而研制，瀑布助推器本质上是1/4比例的<<M0>>。其设计目标是成本低廉且能快速待命发射，采用简易的挤压式输送系统，以炸药级硝酸和液化煤作为动力。尽管该火箭运行良好，但以当时的技术无法研制出能精确拦截飞机的制导系统。战后，美苏两国工程师都对其进行了测试。苏联工程师为<<M1>>研发了改进版本，但同样无法研制出用于防空的实用制导系统，转而将其改装为弹道导弹，造就了<<M2>>（飞毛腿）。

s: This 3-channel thruster was designed for operation up to 250 kW of discharge power at specific impulses ranging from 1800–3500 seconds on xenon propellant and up to 5000 seconds on krypton, all with state of the art total efficiencies in excess of 60%.
zh: 该3通道推力器设计放电功率可达250 kW，使用氙推进剂时比冲范围为1800–3500秒，使用氪推进剂时最高可达5000秒，顶尖的总效率超过60%。

s: Xenon Ion Propulsion System, 25 cm. A small gridded ion thruster developed by L-3 technologies to act as a stationkeeping thruster for commercial satellites. Currently used on the Boeing 601 and 702 satellite busses. Mass/power ratio: 3.56 kg/kW.
zh: 氙离子推进系统，25 cm。由<<M0>>科技研制的小型栅极离子推力器，用作专注效益卫星的位置保持推力器。目前用于波音601和702卫星平台。质功比：3.56 kg/kW。

s: The Reaction Motors XLR10 was an early rocket developed to power the Viking sounding rocket. Intended to replace the V-2, the Viking sounding rocket was successful, but ultimately cancelled due to high costs. It was revived to create the first stage of the Vanguard launch vehicle, with the XLR10 modified to create the XLR50 (X-405).
zh: Reaction Motors <<M0>>是为“维京”探空火箭提供动力而研制的早期火箭发动机。维京探空火箭旨在替代<<M1>>，虽然发射成功，但最终因高昂的成本被取消。后来它被重新启用，用于制造“先锋”运载火箭的第一级，并将<<M0>>改进为<<M2>>（<<M3>>）。

s: The Reaction Motors XLR11 (internal designation 6000C-4) was a small rocket motor designed to power experimental high-speed aircraft, including the X-1, early X-15s, X-24B, and D-558-2. Its four combustion chambers were ignited independently, which is represented as the ability to throttle in discrete steps.
zh: Reaction Motors <<M0>>（内部代号6000C-4）是一款小型火箭发动机，旨在为实验性高速飞机提供动力，包括<<M1>>、早期<<M2>>、<<M3>>和<<M4>>。它的四个燃烧室可独立点火，在游戏中表现为离散分档调节节流阀的能力。

s: The XLR25 was designed for the X-2, to test higher speeds and altitudes than the X-1. It was the first continuously throttleable engine designed in the US. Although the engine was successful, the X-2 proved extremely unstable at high speeds and only a few flights were undertaken.
zh: <<M0>> 专为 <<M1>> 设计，用于测试比 <<M2>> 更高的速度与高度。它是美国设计的第一款可连续调节节流阀的发动机。尽管发动机本身很成功，但 <<M1>> 在高速下极不稳定，仅进行了数次飞行。

s: A Chinese hypergolic gas generator booster engine. Derived from the Isayev S2.1100 Burya booster engine, four YF-1 engines form the YF-2 booster used on the first stage of the DF-3, DF-4, and Long March 1 rockets.
zh: 一款中国自研的可贮存推进剂气动燃气发生器助推器发动机。源自伊萨耶夫 S2.1100“风暴”助推器发动机，由四台 <<M0>> 构成用于 <<M2>>、<<M3>> 和长征一号运载火箭第一级的 <<M1>> 助推器动力。

s: A Chinese hypergolic gas generator booster engine. Four YF-20 engines form the YF-21 booster used on the first stage of the DF-5, FB-1, and Long March 2/3/4 rockets, as well as the strap-on boosters for the Long March 2/3.
zh: 一款中国自研的可贮存推进剂气动燃气发生器助推器发动机。四台 <<M0>> 构成 <<M1>> 助推级，用于 <<M2>>、<<M3>> 以及长征二号/三号/四号系列火箭的第一级，并作为长征二号/三号的捆绑助推器。

s: A Chinese hydrolox gas generator vacuum engine, created to replace the YF-73. Used on the third stage of the Long March 3A/B/C. It was converted to expander cycle to create the YF-75D, which is used on the second stage of Long March 5.
zh: 一款中国自研的液氢液氧燃气发生器真空发动机，用于替代 <<M0>>。曾用于长征三号甲/乙/丙的第三级。后改进为膨胀循环演变出 <<M1>>，用于长征五号的第二级。

s: A Chinese kerolox staged combustion booster engine. Based on the RD-120, it is the first staged combustion engine developed in China, and is used on the boosters of the Long March 5, as well as the boosters and first stage of the Long March 6, 7, and 8.
zh: 一款中国自研的液氧煤油分级燃烧助推器发动机。基于 <<M0>> 研制，是中国首款分级燃烧发动机，用于长征五号的助推器，以及长征六号、七号和八号的助推器与第一级。

s: An early 1960s nuclear turbo-ramjet, designed for supersonic bombers. One of the ultimate direct-cycle designs produced by the Aircraft Nuclear Propulsion (ANP) program, the A-136 used a hybrid cycle to improve supersonic performance. By tapping off a small amount of air to cool the turbine, turbine inlet temperatures could be managed, while the remaining air passed straight through the reactor and was heated to full temperature. This gave the engine good performance up to Mach 3. It also included a kerosene burner to improve takeoff thrust.
zh: 一款 1960 年代初期的核动力涡轮冲压发动机，专为超音速轰炸机设计。作为飞机核动力推进（ANP）计划的终极直循环设计之一，<<M0>> 采用混合循环以改善超音速性能。通过分流少量进气冷却涡轮以控制涡轮前温度，其余进气则直接穿过反应堆加热至最高温度。这使发动机在高达 3 马赫时仍具有出色性能。它还包含一个煤油燃烧室以提升起飞推力。

s: The AL-31 is a early 1980s low-bypass turbofan, designed to power the Su-27. Despite difficult development, resulting in early Su-27s being equipped with the AL-21 engine, it ultimately proved successful, powering the Su-27, Su-30, Su-34, Su-35, Su-57, J-10 and J-11. Later models were also equipped with thrust vectoring capability. Modernized AL-31s were designated AL-41F-1, not to be confused with the AL-41, an unrelated design from the late 1980s.
zh: <<M0>> 是 1980 年代初期的一款小涵道比涡扇发动机，设计用于为 <<M1>> 提供动力。尽管研制过程困难重重，导致早期的 <<M2>> 被迫换装 <<M3>> 发动机，但它最终大获成功，为 <<M1>>、<<M4>>、<<M5>>、<<M6>>, <<M7>>、<<M8>> 和 <<M9>> 提供动力。后期型号还配备了推力矢量能力。现代化的 <<M10>> 被命名为 <<M11>>，切勿与 1980 年代末完全无关的 <<M12>> 设计混淆。

s: The Atar 08/09 was a late-1950s redesign of the Atar 101, increasing thrust (creating the Atar 08) and adding an afterburner (creating the Atar 09). The Atar 09 powered the next generation of French jet aircraft, including the Cheetah C/D/E/R, Mirage III/IV, and Mirage F1.
zh: 阿塔（Atar）08/09 是 1950 年代末对阿塔 101 的重新设计型号，增加了推力（演变为阿塔 08）并加装了加力燃烧室（演变为阿塔 09）。阿塔 09 为下一代法国喷气式飞机提供了动力，包括猎豹 C/D/E/R、幻影 III/IV 以及幻影 F1。

s: The Avon was Rolls-Royce's first axial-flow turbojet, introduced in 1950. It powered most British aircraft of the 1950s and 60s, including the Sea Vixen, Canberra, Lightning, Hunter, Swift and Valiant.
zh: 埃文（Avon）是劳斯莱斯于 1950 年推出的第一款轴流式涡轮喷气发动机。它为 1950 至 60 年代的大多数英国飞机提供动力，包括海泼妇、堪培拉、闪电、猎手、雨燕和勇士。

s: The CF6 high-bypass turbofan was developed from the TF39, the first ever production high-bypass turbofan. It powered many large aircraft, including the A300, A310, A330, B747, B767, DC-10, KC-10, MD-11, E-4, C-2, and C-5M.
zh: CF6 大涵道比涡扇发动机由 <<M0>> 发展而来，后者是有史以来第一款量产的大涵道比涡扇发动机。它为许多大型飞机提供了动力，包括 <<M1>>、<<M2>>、<<M3>>、<<M4>>、<<M5>>、<<M6>>、<<M7>>、<<M8>>、<<M9>>、<<M10>> 和 <<M11>>。

s: The TF34 is a 1970s high-bypass turbofan. It powered the S-3, S-72, and A-10, while its civilian derivative, the CF34, powered many large private jets and regional airliners such as the Challenger 600 Series, Challenger 850, CRJ100/200/440/700/900, and the Embraer 170/175/190/195.
zh: <<M0>> 是 1970 年代的一款大涵道比涡扇发动机。它曾为 <<M1>>、<<M2>> 和 <<M3>> 提供动力，而其民用衍生型号 <<M4>> 则为许多大型私人飞机和支线客机提供动力，例如挑战者 600 系列、挑战者 850、CRJ100/200/440/700/900 以及巴西航空工业 170/175/190/195。

s: The CFM56 is a 1970s high-bypass turbofan, developed from the F101. Created in a collaboration between GE and Snecma, the CFM56 is the most successful high-bypass turbofan ever made, with over 30,000 built. It powered the Airbus A320 and A340 series, B737 Classic and Next Gen series, DC-8-70, and was used to re-engine many 707-based aircraft such as the E-3, E-6, and KC/RC-135.
zh: <<M0>> 是 1970 年代的一款大涵道比涡扇发动机，由 <<M1>> 发展而来。由通用电气与斯奈克玛联合研制，<<M0>> 是有史以来最成功的大涵道比涡扇发动机，产量超过 30,000 台。它为空中客车 <<M2>> 和 <<M3>> 系列、<<M4>> 经典型与新一代系列、<<M5>> 提供动力，并用于换装改装许多基于波音 707 的机型，如 <<M6>>、<<M7>> 和 KC/<<M8>>。

s: The D-30 is one of the first turbofan engines developed in the Soviet Union, and the most successful. While originally developed to power the Tu-134 airliner, it found its way into many Soviet aircraft, including the Tu-154, Il-62, Il-76, M-55, and with afterburner, MiG-31 and Su-47.
zh: <<M0>> 是苏联最早研制的涡扇发动机之一，也是最成功的型号。虽然最初是为 <<M1>> 客机研制的，但它随后被广泛应用于许多苏联飞机，包括 <<M2>>、<<M3>>、<<M4>>、<<M5>>，以及带加力燃烧室的 <<M6>> 和 <<M7>>。

s: The Derwent was a development of the W.2 / Welland engine with "straight through flow" rather than "reverse flow," leading to an increase in thrust and efficiency. It was a short-lived line of engines, ending with World War II; indeed, the Derwent V was in fact a scaled-down Nene. Powered the Meteor F.3/F.4/NF.12/NF.14, Nord 1601, Sagittario II, and Yak-23/25/30 and La-15 as the license-built RD-500.
zh: 德温特（Derwent）是 W.2 / 威兰（Welland）发动机的改进型号，采用“直流式”取代了“回流式”燃烧室，显著提高了推力和效率。该发动机系列寿命较短，随着二战结束而终结；事实上德温特 V 实际上是缩小版的尼恩（Nene）。曾为流星 F.3/F.4/NF.12/NF.14、北方 1601、人马座 II，以及作为许可证制造型号 <<M2>> 为 <<M0>>/25/30 和 <<M1>> 提供动力。

s: The F100 is a 1970s low-bypass turbofan designed for the F-15 and F-16. Its advanced design and high power allowed the F-15 and F-16 to achieve a thrust to weight ratio greater than one. It was used in all F-15 and most F-16 variants.
zh: <<M0>> 是 1970 年代为 <<M1>> 和 <<M2>> 设计的小涵道比涡扇发动机。其先进的设计和强劲的动力使 <<M1>> 和 <<M2>> 实现了大于 1 的推重比。它被用于所有 <<M1>> 以及大部分 <<M2>> 的改型。

s: The F119 is a 1990s low-bypass turbofan designed for the Advance Tactical Fighter program. Designed for supercruise capability, it has unusually high dry thrust for its size, and it has a 2D thrust-vectoring nozzle for increased maneuverability. It was used in the F-22, YF-23, X-32 and X-35.
zh: <<M0>> 是 1990 年代为先进战术战斗机（ATF）计划设计的小涵道比涡扇发动机。专为超音速巡航能力设计，其尺寸具有极高的无加力推力，并配备二维推力矢量喷管以提高机动性。曾用于 <<M1>>、<<M2>>、<<M3>> 和 <<M4>>。

s: The F135 is a 2000s low-bypass turbofan designed for the F-35. Two variants exist, with a conventional nozzle for the F-35A/C, and one with a forward PTO shaft and gimbaled nozzle for the VTOL-capable F-35B.
zh: <<M0>> 是 2000 年代为 <<M1>> 设计的小涵道比涡扇发动机。存在两种改型，一种配备适用于 <<M2>>/C 的常规喷管，另一种配备前进动力输出轴和万向喷管，适用于具备垂直起降能力的 <<M3>>。

s: The F404 is a 1970s low-bypass turbofan designed for the F/A-18. It was designed for reliability rather than performance, in order to replace the notoriously unreliable F-4s and F-14s used by the US Navy and Marines at the time. It was used in the F/A-18A/B/C/D, F-20A, F-117A, T-7A, T-50, JAS-39, and Tejas.
zh: <<M0>> 是 1970 年代为 F/<<M1>> 设计的小涵道比涡扇发动机。其设计侧重于可靠性而非极端性能，旨在取代当时美国海军和陆战队使用且臭名昭著极不可靠的 <<M2>> 和 <<M3>>。曾用于 F/<<M4>>/B/C/D、<<M5>>、<<M6>>, <<M7>>、<<M8>>、<<M9>> 以及光辉（Tejas）战机。

s: The GE4 was a 1970s turbojet developed to power the Boeing 2707 supersonic transport at speeds up to Mach 2.7. The most powerful turbojet ever made, the GE4 was tested extensively, but ultimately cancelled with the rest of the 2707 project.
zh: GE4 是 1970 年代研发的涡轮喷气发动机，用于为波音 2707 超音速客机提供动力，速度可达 2.7 马赫。作为有史以来推力最大的涡轮喷气发动机，GE4 进行了大量测试，但最终随着 2707 项目的终止而取消。

s: The pulsed inductive thruster uses a powerful magnetic pulse to ionize and accelerate gas. It can achieve impressive ISPs, and be scaled up simply by increasing the pulse rate. However, it consumes a considerable amount of power. The NuPIT (Nuclear-Electric Pulsed Inductive Thruster) is based on the PIT Mk VII, redesigned for extremely long life for Ice Giant and even Interstellar missions.
zh: 脉冲感应推进器利用强磁脉冲使气体电离并加速。它能实现极具吸引力的比冲，且只需提高脉冲频率即可扩展功率。然而，它的电力消耗相当巨大。<<M0>>（核电脉冲感应推进器）基于 PIT Mk VII 设计，专为冰巨星乃至星际任务进行了极长寿命的重新设计。

s: A very early Soviet rocket engine, designed by Glushko in 1936 for use on the KR-212 cruise missile, and modified for the rocket aircraft RP-318. It was the first reliable, regeneratively cooled rocket.
zh: 一款极早期的苏联火箭发动机，由格卢什科于1936年为<<M0>>巡航导弹设计，后改装用于<<M1>>火箭飞机。它是第一台可靠的再生冷却火箭发动机。

s: Developed jointly by the AFRL and PEPL, the P5 is a dual-stage Hall thruster. This means it can more effectively lens the charged ions, giving you increased thrust above single-stage operation at the expense of efficiency.
zh: 由 AFRL 与 PEPL 联合研制的 P5 是一款双级霍尔推进器。这意味着它能更有效地聚焦带电离子，以牺牲部分效率为代价，提供高于单级运行状态的推力。

s: The "PEWEE" series is a smaller 572MW reactor with the highest power density of all the rover tests. It also recorded the Highest ISP ratings of the test at 901s. Its core is capable of starting up to 12 times. An integral Tungsten Boron Composite shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shutdown gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted three to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be nine to twelve meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. Most modern NASA study reactors such as the BNTR are derived in turn from this test reactor. This version features a fixed regeneratively cooled nozzle. Nozzle Ae=100 Chamber Temp=2750 Ideal ISP=998 Reactor Power=572MW(th) TWR=5.07 Chamber Pressure=4344kPa Ignitions =12 Tonnage including integral shadow shield: 2.23tons
