zh: “PEWEE”系列是一款功率为 572MW 的小型反应堆，在所有 Rover 测试堆中具有最高的功率密度。它还在测试中创下了 901s 的最高比冲记录。其堆芯最多可启动 12 次。包含整体式钨硼复合材料屏蔽层，整个组件采用再生冷却。二级回路通过小型热机导出停堆废气，以最大程度减少燃料损失并提供基础交流发电功率。该发动机距离最近的燃料储罐应保持 3 至 6 米。燃料应为乘员提供屏蔽，运行时乘员位置距离发动机应在 9 至 12 米。额外的屏蔽（如水箱或高密度燃料）可在一定程度上缩短该距离。现代 NASA 研究的多数反应堆（如 BNTR）均源自此测试反应堆。该型号采用固定式再生冷却喷管。喷管面积比=100 燃烧室温度=2750 理想比冲=998 反应堆功率=572MW(th) TWR=5.07 燃烧室压力=4344kPa 点火次数=12 含整体投影屏蔽重量: 2.23吨

s: The "Phoebus 1" series is a 1500MW reactor. Most tests early resulted in failure from pumping or faulted test equipment however much was learned and the development of advanced coatings chemical vapour deposition and lighter materials. Its core is capable of starting up four times. An integral Tungsten Boron composite shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shut down gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted three to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be eight to twelve meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. This rocket represents the beginnings of a more powerful and capable series of rocket. This version features a fixed regeneratively cooled nozzle with a 50:1 expansion ratio. Nozzle Ae=50 Chamber Temp=2445 Ideal ISP=881 Reactor Power=1500MW(th) TWR=3.33 Chamber Pressure=3772kPa Ignitions =4 Tonnage including integral shadow shield: 9.14tons
zh: “Phoebus 1”系列是一款 1500MW 的反应堆。早期的大多数测试都因泵故障或测试设备损坏而失败，但也借此积累了大量经验，并促进了先进涂层、化学气相沉积和更轻材料的发展。其堆芯最多可启动 4 次。包含整体式钨硼复合材料屏蔽层，整个组件采用再生冷却。二级回路通过小型热机导出停堆废气，以最大程度减少燃料损失并提供基础交流发电功率。该发动机距离最近的燃料储罐应保持 3 至 6 米。燃料应为乘员提供屏蔽，运行时乘员位置距离发动机应在 8 至 12 米。额外的屏蔽（如水箱或高密度燃料）可在一定程度上缩短该距离。该火箭代表了更强大、更高效火箭系列的开端。该型号采用膨胀比为 50:1 的固定式再生冷却喷管。喷管面积比=50 燃烧室温度=2445 理想比冲=881 反应堆功率=1500MW(th) TWR=3.33 燃烧室压力=3772kPa 点火次数=4 含整体投影屏蔽重量: 9.14吨

s: The "Phoebus 2" series is a 5000MW reactor. Most tests resulted in success proving new coatings worked well and existing at the time as the most powerful reactor core on the planet. Its core is capable of starting up eight times. An integral Tungsten Boron composite shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shut down gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted three to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be ten to fifteen meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. This rocket represents a more powerful and capable series of rocket with a TWR of nearly 6. This version features a fixed regeneratively cooled nozzle with a 100:1 expansion ratio. Nozzle Ae=100 Chamber Temp=2245 Ideal ISP=889 Reactor Power=4182MW(th) TWR=5.48 Chamber Pressure=3825kPa Ignitions =8 Tonnage including integral shadow shield: 16.97tons
zh: “Phoebus 2”系列是一款 5000MW 的反应堆。大多数测试均取得成功，不仅验证了新涂层性能优良，还成为当时地球上功率最强大的反应堆堆芯。其堆芯最多可启动 8 次。包含整体式钨硼复合材料屏蔽层，整个组件采用再生冷却。二级回路通过小型热机导出停堆废气，以最大程度减少燃料损失并提供基础交流发电功率。该发动机距离最近的燃料储罐应保持 3 至 6 米。燃料应为乘员提供屏蔽，运行时乘员位置距离发动机应在 10 至 15 米。额外的屏蔽（如水箱或高密度燃料）可在一定程度上缩短该距离。该火箭代表了 TWR 接近 6 的更强大、更高效的火箭系列。该型号采用膨胀比为 100:1 的固定式再生冷却喷管。喷管面积比=100 燃烧室温度=2245 理想比冲=889 反应堆功率=4182MW(th) TWR=5.48 燃烧室压力=3825kPa 点火次数=8 含整体投影屏蔽重量: 16.97吨

s: The pulsed inductive thruster uses a powerful magnetic pulse to ionize and accelerate gas. It can achieve impressive ISPs, and be scaled up simply by increasing the pulse rate. However, it consumes a considerable amount of power. The Mk V PIT was tested by TRW in 1993 with a variety of voltages, pulse sizes, and propellants.
zh: 脉冲感应推进器利用强磁脉冲使气体电离并加速。它能实现极具吸引力的比冲，且只需提高脉冲频率即可扩展功率。然而，它的电力消耗相当巨大。TRW 于 1993 年对 Mk V PIT 进行了测试，评估了各种电压、脉冲大小和推进剂。

s: A "Bubbler" liquid core nuclear thermal rocket. Hydrogen gas is bubbled through the liquid core of the reactor, resulting in extremely efficient heat transfer and high performance. Unfortunately, unexpected behavior in the hydrogen gas bubbles resulted in large amounts of fuel being lost from the reactor, and temperature and propellant flow had to be reduced, decreasing performance. A later redesign with a different fuel alloy allowed some performance to be restored.
zh: 一款“鼓泡式”液芯核热火箭。氢气通过气泡形式穿过反应堆的液态堆芯，带来极高的换热效率和出色的性能。不幸的是，氢气泡的异常行为导致反应堆损失了大量燃料，不得不降低温度和推进剂流量，从而降低了性能。后来采用不同燃料合金进行的改型设计挽回了部分性能。

s: A 490 N bipropellant thruster found in the propulsion system of the ESA ATV and the Orion MPCV Service Module. It performs orbit-raising maneuvers for many communication satellite platforms, including the Astrium Eurostar 3000, Boeing Space Systems 702HP, MELCO DS-2000, and the Loral LS-1300. The R-4D has also played a role in NASA missions, such as Cassini's orbital insertion around Saturn.
zh: 一款 490 N 双组元推进剂推进器，用于欧空局 ATV 和猎户座 MPCV 服务舱的推进系统。它负责为多种通信卫星平台执行轨道提升机动，包括 Astrium Eurostar 3000、Boeing Space Systems 702HP、MELCO <<M0>> 以及 Loral <<M1>>。<<M2>> 还在 NASA 任务中发挥了重要作用，例如卡西尼号的土星轨道捕获。

s: The J48 was also known as the Rolls-Royce Tay. Essentially an enlarged Nene, it was abandoned by Rolls-Royce in favor of the Avon. However, Pratt & Whitney was able to acquire the design, and produced it as the J48. It was used in the F9F-5 Panther, F9F-6/8 Cougar, F-94C Starfire, and YF-93.
zh: J48也被称为罗尔斯-罗伊斯泰伊（Tay）。它本质上是尼恩（Nene）的放大版，后来被罗尔斯-罗伊斯放弃，转而开发埃文（Avon）。然而，普惠公司获得了该设计，并将其命名为J48进行生产。它曾用于F9F-5黑豹、F9F-6/8美洲狮、<<M0>>星火以及<<M1>>。

s: The J85 was developed as a small, disposable jet engine to power decoys and drones, but was later upgraded for use on manned aircraft. It powered many small aircraft, including the F-5, CF-5, G.91Y, T-2, T-38, and A-37.
zh: J85最初是作为一种用于驱动诱饵弹和无人机的小型一次性喷气发动机研发的，但后来进行了升级以供有人驾驶飞机使用。它为许多小型飞机提供了动力，包括<<M0>>、<<M1>>、G.91Y、<<M2>>、<<M3>>和<<M4>>。

s: Derived from the J52, the JT8D was an early low-bypass turbofan, used on many second-generation jetliners like the Boeing 727, 737, and DC-9. It received a substantial redesign in the 1970s, creating the JT8D-200 series, which powered the Super 27, MD-80 series, and was used to upgrade many 707-based aircraft like the E-8C.
zh: <<M0>>衍生自J52，是一种早期低涵道比涡扇发动机，用于波音727、737和<<M1>>等许多第二代喷气式客机。它在20世纪70年代进行了重大重新设计，诞生了<<M0>>-200系列，用于驱动Super 27、<<M2>>系列，并用于升级许多基于波音707的飞机，例如<<M3>>。

s: A late 50s turbojet based on the Pratt & Whitney J57, the Model 304-2 was a liquid-hydrogen-fueled turbojet, designed for project SUNTAN, a high-performance replacement for the U-2 spyplane. The project required the development of large-scale liquid hydrogen production and handling techniques, at the cost of hundreds of millions of dollars. Various jet engines were converted to hydrogen power, where they showed incredible stability and efficiency. This information, along with many of the engineers involved, were later transferred to working on the RL-10 where the information gained proved invaluable. The Model 304 and project SUNTAN, however, were ultimately cancelled, as the conventionally-fueled A-12/SR-71 was showing much greater promise.
zh: Model 304-2是一款50年代末期基于普惠J57开发的液氢燃料涡轮喷气发动机，专为SUNTAN计划设计，该计划旨在作为<<M0>>侦察机的高性能替代方案。该项目耗资数亿美元，需要开发大规模液氢生产和处理技术。多种喷气发动机被改装为氢动力，表现出了惊人的稳定性和效率。这些资料以及许多参与的工程师后来被转移到<<M1>>的工作中，事实证明这些获得的资料非常宝贵。然而，Model 304和SUNTAN计划最终被取消，因为常规燃料的<<M2>>/<<M3>>展现出了更大的前景。

s: The NK-8 was a 1960s low-bypass turbofan, created to power the Il-62 and Tu-154. It was later modified for improved performance to power the Il-86, and modified to run on alternate fuels for the Tu-155 project. It powered the A-90, Il-62, Il-62M, Tu-154, Tu-154A/B and Tu-155.
zh: <<M0>>是20世纪60年代的一款低涵道比涡扇发动机，旨在为<<M1>>和<<M2>>提供动力。后来为了提高性能进行了改进以驱动<<M3>>，并针对<<M4>>计划修改为使用替代燃料运行。它曾为<<M5>>、<<M1>>、<<M6>>, <<M2>>、<<M7>>/B和<<M4>>提供动力。

s: The NK-144 was a 1960s low-bypass turbofan developed from the NK-8 to power the Tu-144 supersonic transport. The NK-144 was unable to meet performance requirements and was replaced by the RD-36, but found new life as the NK-22, which powered the Tu-22M0/M1/M2.
zh: <<M0>>是20世纪60年代从<<M1>>发展而来的低涵道比涡扇发动机，用于为<<M2>>超音速客机提供动力。<<M0>>未能满足性能要求并被<<M3>>取代，但作为<<M4>>重获新生，为<<M5>>/M1/M2提供动力。

s: The Nord 1500 ramjet was a combined cycle ramjet, mated to an Atar 101E. Used on the Griffon II experimental aircraft, the Atar 101 would accelerate the aircraft up to the speed of sound, at which point the ramjet could act as a thrust augmentor and accelerate aircraft up to speeds over Mach 2. Although the Griffon II performed well, it was cancelled in favor of more conventional aircraft.
zh: 诺德1500冲压发动机是一种组合循环冲压发动机，与阿塔（Atar）101E配套使用。在短剑II（Griffon II）试验机上，阿塔101先将飞机加速到音速，此时冲压发动机充当推力放大器，将飞机加速到超过2马赫的速度。尽管短剑II性能优异，但最终还是被取消，取而代之的是更传统的飞机。

s: A late 1960s turbojet. The ultimate version of the Olympus turbojet, designed for sustained Mach 2 operation to power Concorde. Although thirsty at sea level, when mated to a well-optimized intake this engine can supercruise at Mach 2, achieving relatively good efficiency.
zh: 一款20世纪60年代后期的涡轮喷气发动机。奥林巴斯（Olympus）涡轮喷气发动机的终极版本，专为协和式飞机在2马赫下持续运行而设计。虽然在海平面非常耗油，但与优化良好的进气道相配合时，该发动机能够以2马赫超音速巡航，并实现相对较好的效率。

s: An early 1960s small turboprop. Developed for midsize general aviation aircraft, the PT6A was first used on the Beechcraft King Air. It's low cost, low weight, and high reliability led to it becoming one of the most popular turboprop engines ever, with over 60,000 built. It is offered in many large general aviation and small commercial aircraft, and is popular as an upgrade to older piston-engined aircraft.
zh: 一款20世纪60年代早期的小型涡轮螺旋桨发动机。<<M0>>专为中型通用航空飞机开发，首次用于比奇空中国王（King Air）。其低成本、轻量化和高可靠性使其成为有史以来最受欢迎的涡桨发动机之一，生产数量超过60,000台。它被广泛应用于大型通用航空和小型商业客机，同时也是老式活塞式发动机飞机的热门升级方案。

s: A late 50s turbojet, the R-11 was developed in parallel with the less sophisticated RD-9. It became the powerplant for the MiG-21, Yak-28 and Su-15. It was reverse-engineered in China and built as the WP-7, where it powered the JJ-7, J/F-7, and J-8.
zh: 作为一款50年代末期的涡轮喷气发动机，<<M0>>与结构更简单的<<M1>>并行研发。它成为了<<M2>>、<<M3>>和<<M4>>的动力装置。它在我国被逆向工程并命名为<<M5>>生产，为<<M6>>、歼-<<M7>>和<<M8>>提供动力。

s: A late 60s turbojet, the R-13 was developed from the earlier R-11 to improve the performance of the MiG-21. It became the powerplant for late model MiG-21s and Su-15s. It was reverse-engineered in China and built as the WP-13, where it powered the J-7III onwards and J-8II.
zh: 作为一款60年代后期的涡轮喷气发动机，<<M0>>是从早期的<<M1>>改进而来的，旨在提高<<M2>>的性能。它成为了后期型号<<M3>>和<<M4>>的动力装置。它在我国被逆向工程并命名为<<M5>>生产，为<<M6>>后续型号及<<M7>>提供动力。

s: A late 50s turbojet originally developed for the Tu-121 cruise missile, the R-15 was modified instead for use on the MiG-25, which became the fastest serially produced fighter, capable of reaching Mach 3.2, although at the risk of severe engine damage.
zh: 一款50年代末期的涡轮喷气发动机，最初为<<M0>>巡航导弹开发，后来经过改装用于<<M1>>，使<<M2>>成为了最快的量产战斗机，能够达到3.2马赫，但有造成发动机严重损坏的风险。

s: A 1980s afterburning turbofan, designed for the Yak-41. It was equipped with an engine gimbal system that allowed the nozzle to rotate 95 degrees, to support vertical flight, and was the first engine of this type equipped with an afterburner, allowing the Yak-41 to achieve supersonic flight. It powered the Yak-141/41, and was proposed to power the Su-47 with the thrust vectoring system removed.
zh: 一款20世纪80年代的带加力燃烧室涡扇发动机，专为<<M0>>设计。它配备了一个万向节系统，喷嘴可旋转95度以支持垂直飞行，并且是第一款配备加力燃烧室的此类发动机，使<<M0>>能够实现超音速飞行。它为<<M1>>/41提供动力，并曾被提议在移除推力矢量系统后为<<M2>>提供动力。

s: The RB.162 was a lightweight turbojet, designed to be used as a liftjet for VTOL aircraft. It utilized fiberglass and plastic extensively in it's construction to reduce weight as much as possible, resulting in a low lifetime but very high thrust-to-weight ratio. It was used as a liftjet on the Do-31, Mirage IIIV, and VAK 191B, and as a booster engine on the Trident 3B to improve takeoff performance.
zh: RB.162是一款轻型涡轮喷气发动机，设计用作VTOL飞机的升力发动机。它在结构中大量使用了玻璃纤维和塑料以尽可能减轻重量，导致寿命较短，但推重比极高。它曾在<<M0>>、幻影IIIV和VAK 191B上用作升力发动机，并在三叉戟3B上作为助推发动机使用以改善起飞性能。

s: An early 50s turbojet. Developed as a scaled down Mikulin AM-3, the RD-9 was designed for fighter aircraft and powered the Yak-25, 26, 27, 28, and MiG-19. It was license-built in China as the WP-6, where it powered the JJ-6, J/F-6, Q/A-5, and J-12.
zh: 一款50年代早期涡轮喷气发动机。作为米库林<<M0>>的按比例缩减版本，<<M1>>专为战斗机设计，为<<M2>>、26、27、28和<<M3>>提供动力。我国按许可证生产将其命名为<<M4>>，为<<M5>>、歼-<<M6>>、强-<<M7>>和<<M8>>提供动力。

s: The RD-36 was a 1970s turbojet, developed to power the Tu-144. The RD-36 replaced the underperforming NK-144 engines, allowing the Tu-144 to achieve its intended range. Ultimately, the Tu-144 was taken out of service shortly after being upgraded due to costs. The RD-36 powered the Tu-144D and M-17.
zh: <<M0>>是一款20世纪70年代的涡轮喷气发动机，专为<<M1>>提供动力而开发。<<M0>>取代了性能欠佳的<<M2>>发动机，使<<M1>>达到了预期的航程。最终，<<M1>>由于成本问题在升级后不久退役。<<M0>>曾为<<M3>>和<<M4>>提供动力。

s: The RD-41 was a lightweight turbojet, designed as an improved version of the RD-36 liftjet for the Yak-141/41M. It was provided with a gimballing engine mount, allowing for 12.5 degrees of deflection to improve stability while hovering. Used as the liftjet on the Yak-141/41M.
zh: <<M0>>是一款轻型涡轮喷气发动机，作为<<M1>>升力发动机的改进版本设计，用于<<M2>>/41M。它配备了可偏转12.5度的万向节发动机架，以提高悬停时的稳定性。曾用作<<M2>>/41M的升力发动机。

s: The RJ43 was a supersonic ramjet, designed to power the CIM-10 Bomarc surface to air missile at speeds up to Mach 3. It was also used on the X-7 and XQ-5/AQM-60 target drone, and was modified to power the D-21 up to speeds over Mach 3.3.
zh: <<M0>>是一款超音速冲压发动机，设计用于驱动<<M1>>波马克地对空导弹以高达3马赫的速度飞行。它还用于<<M2>>和<<M3>>/<<M4>>靶机，并经过改进使<<M5>>的速度达到3.3马赫以上。

s: A kerolox gas-generator sustainer engine used in the Atlas launch vehicle. It, like the Atlas's booster engines (LR89s), is lit on the ground, but after a bit over 2 minutes the boosters are dropped and Atlas continues to orbit under the power of the LR105 (with the verniers for roll control and final adjustment). The final configuration of the LR105 (like the LR89) uses RS-27 components for better performance. As a sustainer, the LR105 has sea level and vacuum efficiencies somewhere between a booster and an upper stage engine.
zh: 用于宇宙神运载火箭的煤油/液氧燃气发生器主级发动机。它与宇宙神的助推器发动机（<<M0>>）一样在地面点火，但在2分多钟后助推器分离，宇宙神在<<M1>>的动力下继续入轨（使用游标发动机进行滚转控制与最终微调）。<<M1>>的最终构型（类似<<M2>>）使用了<<M3>>组件以获得更高性能。作为主级发动机，<<M1>>的海平面与真空效率介于助推器和上面级发动机之间。

s: A staged combustion sustainer engine developed for the USAF ISINGLASS spaceplane. After the ISINGLASS project was cancelled, it was adapted by P&W for their SSME proposal. It utilized staged combustion, mixture control, and extendable nozzles to allow for versatility and high performance.
zh: 为美国空军 ISINGLASS 空天飞机开发的分级燃烧主级发动机。在 ISINGLASS 项目取消后，它被普惠公司改造并用于竞标 SSME 方案。该发动机采用分级燃烧、混合比控制以及可延伸喷管，具备极高的多用途性与高性能。

s: Developed from the RS-25 SSME, the Liquid Rocket Booster Engine (LRBE) was a design concept for a liquid fueled Space Shuttle booster. Methane was chosen as a fuel, which increased density and thrust while still allowing fuel-rich staged combustion.
zh: 液体火箭助推器发动机（LRBE）基于<<M0>> SSME 开发，是液体燃料航天飞机助推器的设计概念。它选用甲烷作为燃料，在提高密度和推力的同时，仍能实现富燃分级燃烧。

s: A "radiator" liquid core nuclear thermal rocket developed by Lewis Research Center. Rather than bubbling hydrogen through the reactor core, it is used to regeneratively cool the reactor walls, then flow through the middle of the reactor to be heated by radiation. Although this is less efficient than a "bubbler" reactor, the reduced interaction with the reactor core allows for much higher mass flow rates without excessive fuel loss, resulting in a higher TWR. The simpler core design also means it can be reloaded with fuel on-orbit (requires Near Future Electrical).
zh: 由刘易斯研究中心（Lewis Research Center）开发的“辐射式”液核核热火箭。该设计不再让氢气以气泡形式穿过反应堆堆芯，而是先用于对反应堆壁面进行再生冷却，随后流经反应堆中心利用热辐射加热。虽然其效率低于“鼓泡式”反应堆，但与反应堆堆芯的相互作用减少，使得在没有过多燃料损失的情况下获得更高的质量流量，从而实现更高的 TWR。更简单的堆芯设计也意味着它可以在轨加注燃料（需要 Near Future Electrical）。

s: The massive M-1 engine was the largest and most powerful hydrolox engine ever designed and individual components have been tested. It was generally designed as an upper stage engine, but first stage designs with expanding nozzles were also worked on.
zh: 巨大的<<M0>>发动机是有史以来设计且经过单独组件测试的尺寸最大、推力最强的氢氧发动机。它通常被设计为上面级发动机，但研究人员也针对带有可膨胀喷管的第一级构型开展过研制。

s: Italian expander cycle methalox upper stage engine. Originally developed as a derivative of the RD-0146 in collaboration with KBKhA, sanctions levied against Russia in 2014 forced Avio to continue the development alone. The engine is intended to be used as the third stage of the new Vega-E launch vehicle, with it's first flight planned for 2026.
zh: 意大利膨胀循环甲烷/液氧上面级发动机。最初作为<<M0>>的衍生型号与<<M1>>合作研发，2014年对俄制裁迫使 Avio 单独继续研制。该发动机计划作为新型织女星-E（Vega-E）运载火箭的第三级使用，首次飞行计划于2026年进行。

s: The Mars Landing Engine (MLE) is a derivative of the highly successful MR-80 engine used for the two Viking missions to Mars in 1976. Eight of these engines were used on the sky-crane which landed the Curiosity Rover on the martian surface.
zh: 火星着陆发动机（MLE）衍生自大获成功的<<M0>>发动机，后者曾用于1976年两次海盗号火星任务。好奇号火星车降落在火星表面时使用的天空起重机就安装了八台此类发动机。

s: The power plant of the Redstone missile. Originally designed for ethanol/LOX it was later adapted to use Hydyne/LOX for 6% more performance in Jupiter-C / Juno I. When adapted for crewed use under Mercury, the A-7 was used with the original ethalox mixture, accepting slightly lower performance for the lack of toxicity. TVC was provided by carbon thrust vanes and additional attitude control was provided by actuating fins in the guidance section.
zh: 红石导弹的动力装置。最初设计使用乙醇/液氧，后来在朱庇特-C / 丘诺一号上改用 Hydyne/液氧，性能提升了6%。当为水星计划进行载人改装时，<<M0>>重新采用了原版乙醇/液氧混合物，为消除毒性而牺牲了少量性能。TVC 由碳质燃气舵提供，制导段上的可动空气舵则提供额外的姿态控制。

s: The "Nerva NRX" series is a 1200MW reactor. A partial flight test prototype originally based on the KIWI B4E replacing the "Hot End Seal" with peripheral systems. Its core is capable of starting up thirty times. An integral Tungsten Boron composite shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shut down gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted three to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be eight to ten meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. This rocket represents the beginnings of a more powerful and capable series of rocket. This version features a fixed regeneratively cooled nozzle with a 50:1 expansion ratio. Nozzle Ae=50 Chamber Temp=2550 Ideal ISP=943 Reactor Power=1197MW(th) TWR=2.19 Chamber Pressure=4151kPa Ignitions =30 Tonnage including integral shadow shield: 11.33tons
zh: “NERVA NRX”系列是一个 1200MW 的反应堆。作为部分飞行试验原型，最初基于 KIWI B4E，并用外围系统取代了“热端密封”。其堆芯可启动三十次。内置钨硼复合屏蔽层，整个组件采用再生冷却。副回路使停机气体流经小型热机，以尽量减少燃料损失并提供基础交流电输出。该发动机应安装在距离最近油箱三至六米处。燃料应对所有乘员进行屏蔽，运行时乘员位置应距发动机八至十米。诸如水箱或高密度燃料等额外屏蔽可适当缩短此距离。该火箭代表了一系列更强力、更先进火箭的开端。该版本配备膨胀比为 50:1 的固定式再生冷却喷管。喷管 Ae=50 燃烧室温度=2550 理想比冲=943 反应堆热功率=1197MW(th) TWR=2.19 燃烧室压力=4151kPa 点火次数=30 包含整体屏蔽层的总重：11.33吨。

s: The "Nerva XE" series is a 1550 MW reactor. A full flight test prototype originally based on the KIWI B4E. Its core is capable of starting up sixty times. An integral Tungsten Boron composite shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shut down gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted three to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be eight to ten meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. This rocket represents the beginnings of a more powerful and capable series of rocket. This version features a fixed regeneratively cooled nozzle with a 100:1 expansion ratio. Nozzle Ae=100 Chamber Temp=2500 Ideal ISP=945 Reactor Power=1163MW(th) TWR=2.34 Chamber Pressure=3806kPa Ignitions =60 Tonnage including integral shadow shield: 10.38tons
zh: “NERVA XE”系列是一个 1550MW 的反应堆。作为完整飞行试验原型，最初基于 KIWI B4E。其堆芯可启动六十次。内置钨硼复合屏蔽层，整个组件采用再生冷却。副回路使停机气体流经小型热机，以尽量减少燃料损失并提供基础交流电输出。该发动机应安装在距离最近油箱三至六米处。燃料应对所有乘员进行屏蔽，运行时乘员位置应距发动机八至十米。诸如水箱或高密度燃料等额外屏蔽可适当缩短此距离。该火箭代表了一系列更强力、更先进火箭的开端。该版本配备膨胀比为 100:1 的固定式再生冷却喷管。喷管 Ae=100 燃烧室温度=2500 理想比冲=945 反应堆热功率=1163MW(th) TWR=2.34 燃烧室压力=3806kPa 点火次数=60 包含整体屏蔽层的总重：10.38吨。

s: The NASA Evolutionary Xenon Thruster (NEXT) project at NASA GRC produced quite a little marvel. Certified for flight use, and currently planned for several outer-Solar-System missions, the efficiency of the ion thruster greatly increased the payload weight, at the expense of burn time. Uses about 6.9kW of electricity.
zh: NASA 格伦研究中心的 NASA 演进型氙推进器（NEXT）项目创造了一项真正的奇迹。它已通过飞行认证，目前计划用于数项外太阳系任务；离子推力器的高效率极大地增加了有效载荷质量，代价是更长的点火时间。功耗约为 6.9kW。

s: A staged combustion engine developed as part of an initiative to build a 150-ton-thrust booster engine for the N1. The NK-15 powered the N1, and the NK-33 was developed to power the upgraded N1F. Though the N1F was scrapped, the engines survived and were sold to Aerojet in the 1990s. Refurbished as AJ26-62 engines, they powered Antares. Modifications made by Aerojet included increasing thrust and adding gimbals.
zh: 作为 N1 运载火箭研制 150 吨级推力助推器发动机计划的一部分而开发的分级燃烧发动机。<<M0>>曾用于为 N1 提供动力，而研制<<M1>>则是为了驱动升级版的 N1F。尽管 N1F 被废弃，但这批发动机幸存了下来，并在 20 世纪 90 年代被出售给 Aerojet。经过翻新后命名为<<M2>>-62发动机，曾为安塔瑞斯火箭提供动力。Aerojet 实施的改进包括提高推力并增加了万向节。

s: The 60-inch (1.5-meter) diameter GEM 60 is used on the Delta IV in sets of two or four. When two boosters are used, both are equipped with thrust vector control (TVC). When four are used, two boosters use TVC while the other two use fixed nozzles to reduce weight. Burn time 90 seconds.
zh: 直径60英寸（1.5米）的GEM 60在德尔塔IV号上以两台或四台为一组使用。当使用两台助推器时，两者均配备推力矢量控制（TVC）。当使用四台时，两台助推器使用TVC，而另外两台采用固定喷管以减轻重量。燃烧时间90秒。

s: In 2015, ULA announced that Orbital ATK would develop the GEM 63 as a drop-in replacement for the AJ-60A, and replace Aerojet-Rocketdyne for Atlas V SRMs. The GEM 63 is larger than the GEM 60 used on the Delta IV and cannot thrust vector. As with the AJ-60A, launches using the 4 m fairing will be able to use up to three boosters while up to five can be used with the 5 m fairing.
zh: 2015年，ULA宣布轨道ATK将开发GEM 63作为<<M0>>的直接替代品，并在宇宙神V号固体火箭助推器上取代喷气发动机-洛克达因公司。GEM 63比德尔塔IV号上使用的GEM 60更大，且无法进行推力矢量控制。与<<M0>>一样，使用4米整流罩的发射最多可使用三台助推器，而使用5米整流罩时最多可使用五台。

s: In addition to the GEM 63 for Atlas V, Orbital ATK will develop a larger variant, the GEM 63XL, for Vulcan. The boosters will be approximately 1.5 m longer than the GEM 63 and Vulcan will be able to use up to four boosters with a four-meter fairing or six boosters with a five-meter fairing.
zh: 除用于宇宙神V号的GEM 63外，轨道ATK还将为火神运载火箭开发更大的衍生型号GEM 63XL。该助推器比GEM 63长约1.5米，火神运载火箭在使用四米整流罩时最多可使用四台助推器，在使用五米整流罩时最多可使用六台助推器。

s: The H-1 is an upgrade to the original LR79 engine that propelled the Saturn-I and IB vehicles, as well as late-model Delta rockets (as the RS-27). The RS-27A has a higher expansion ratio optimized for performance at altitude since liftoff thrust on the Delta II is augmented by solid boosters.
zh: <<M0>>是原始<<M1>>发动机的升级版，曾为土星I号和IB号运载火箭以及后期的德尔塔火箭（作为<<M2>>）提供动力。<<M3>>具有更高的膨胀比，针对高空性能进行了优化，因为德尔塔II号的起飞推力由固体助推器增强。

s: The High Power Electric Propulsion (HiPEP) unit was designed and tested at NASA Glenn Research Center and can produce more thrust than its smaller cousin. Requires about 39.3kW of electricity. Mass/power ratio: 3.05 kg/kW.
zh: 大功率电推进（<<M0>>）装置由NASA格伦研究中心设计并测试，可产生比其同类更小的型号更大的推力。需要约39.3kW的电能。质量/功率比：3.05 kg/kW。

s: Advanced NTR, based on the SNTP/Timberwind design. Higher temperature alloys and a sintered fuel element allow for extremely-high-temperature operation, with specific impulse exceeding 1000 seconds. The use of low-enriched uranium fuel reduces TWR as compared to Timberwind/SNTP designs, but allows for greatly increased core lifetime.
zh: 基于SNTP/Timberwind设计的高级热核火箭（NTR）。耐高温合金和烧结燃料元件使其能够在极高温度下运行，比冲超过1000秒。与Timberwind/SNTP设计相比，使用低浓缩铀燃料降低了TWR，但极大地延长了堆芯寿命。

s: A 2000s medium TWR vacuum engine, the J-2X was intended to be used on the upper stages of Ares I and Ares V. Development continued after the cancellation of Ares, and early designs of SLS incorporated the engine, but the project was mothballed after the RL10-powered Exploration Upper Stage was selected.
zh: 一款2000年代的中TWR真空发动机，<<M0>>原定用于战神I号和战神V号的上面级。战神计划取消后该发动机继续研发，SLS的早期设计也采用了该发动机，但在选用<<M1>>驱动的探索上面级后，该项目被搁置。

s: Early exploration into pressure-fed hypergolic upper stage engines. This was designed by JPL to be the third stage on the Juno IV launch vehicle. After cancellation of the Juno IV, it was then selected to power the Vega upper stage for the Atlas-Vega launcher, but the Vega program was canceled in 1959. The "6K" upper stage engine was tested often, but never flew.
zh: 对挤压循环自燃推进剂上面级发动机的早期探索。由JPL设计，原定作为朱诺IV号运载火箭的第三级。在朱诺IV号取消后，它被选为宇宙神-织女星运载火箭的织女星上面级提供动力，但织女星计划于1959年被取消。“6K”上面级发动机经过多次测试，但从未实际飞行。

s: Developed by JPL as a high-performance second stage engine, this was intended for the Juno IV launch vehicle and would provide 45,000 pounds of thrust in vacuum. It was tested, but ultimately decided against in favor of the X-405.
zh: 由JPL开发的高性能二级发动机，原定用于朱诺IV号运载火箭，可在真空中提供45000磅的推力。经过测试，但最终被否决以支持<<M0>>。

s: The "KIWI A" series is an older 132MW reactor with the lowest power density of all the rover tests. Most tests resulted in failure with shattered fuel elements or faulted test equipment however much was learned and the development of liquid hydrogen pumping is a major accomplishment. Its core is capable of starting up twice. An integral Tungsten shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shutdown gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted two to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be six to nine meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. All subsequent US nuclear thermal rocket designs build off this concept. This version features a very small fixed regeneratively cooled nozzle with a 24:1 area expansion ratio. Nozzle Ae/A*=24 Chamber Temp=2300 Ideal ISP=874 Reactor Power=132MW(th) TWR=0.24 Chamber Pressure=1415kPa Ignitions =2 Tonnage including integral shadow shield: 12.08tons
zh: “KIWI A”系列是一台较早的132MW反应堆，在所有漫游者测试中功率密度最低。大多数测试都以燃料元件破碎或测试设备故障告终，但从中吸取了大量经验，液氢泵送技术的发展也是一项重大成就。其堆芯能够启动两次。包含一体式钨屏蔽层，整体采用再生冷却。辅助回路将停机气体导入小型热机，以尽量减少燃料损失并提供基础交流发电功率。该发动机应安装在距离最近的燃料箱2到6米处。燃料箱应为乘员提供屏蔽，运行时乘员位置应距离发动机6到9米。水箱或高密度燃料等额外屏蔽可适当缩短该距离。后续所有美国热核火箭设计均基于此概念。该版本配备一个极小的固定式再生冷却喷管，面积膨胀比为24:1。喷管 Ae/A*=24 燃烧室温度=2300 理想比冲=874 反应堆功率=132MW(th) TWR=0.24 燃烧室压力=1415kPa 点火次数=2 含一体式阴影屏蔽总重：12.08吨

s: The "KIWI B" series is an older 1100MW reactor with more than 10 times the power density of the A series. Most tests early resulted in failure with shattered fuel elements or faulted test equipment however much was learned and the development of advanced coatings chemical vapour deposition and heat pipes. The final test B4E ran smoothly and even restarted from a cold condition. The first Kiwi B test was run on gaseous hydrogen since hydrogen pumping and storage was in its infancy. Its core is capable of starting up four times. An integral Tungsten shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shut down gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted three to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be eight to twelve meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. This rocket represents the basic and conservative solid core rocket design. The NERVA designs build off this concept. This version features a fixed regeneratively cooled nozzle with a 66:1 expansion ratio. Nozzle Ae=66 Chamber Temp=2473 Ideal ISP=864 Reactor Power=1166MW(th) TWR=2.04 Chamber Pressure=3606kPa Ignitions =4 Tonnage including integral shadow shield: 14.89tons
zh: “KIWI B”系列是一台较早的1100MW反应堆，功率密度是A系列的10倍以上。大多数早期测试都以燃料元件破碎或测试设备故障告终，但从中吸取了大量经验，促进了先进涂层、化学气相沉积和热管技术的发展。最终的B4E测试运行平稳，甚至实现了冷态重启。首次Kiwi B测试使用气态氢进行，因为当时氢泵送和储存技术尚处于起步阶段。其堆芯能够启动四次。包含一体式钨屏蔽层，整体采用再生冷却。辅助回路将停机气体导入小型热机，以尽量减少燃料损失并提供基础交流发电功率。该发动机应安装在距离最近的燃料箱3到6米处。燃料箱应为乘员提供屏蔽，运行时乘员位置应距离发动机8到12米。水箱或高密度燃料等额外屏蔽可适当缩短该距离。这枚火箭代表了基础而保守的固态堆芯火箭设计。NERVA设计即基于此概念。该版本配备一个固定式再生冷却喷管，膨胀比为66:1。喷管 Ae=66 燃烧室温度=2473 理想比冲=864 反应堆功率=1166MW(th) TWR=2.04 燃烧室压力=3606kPa 点火次数=4 含一体式阴影屏蔽总重：14.89吨

s: A Soviet gas generator hypergolic vacuum engine designed for use on the TKS FGB (Functional Cargo Block). Extremely reliable and with restart capability, it has been used on many FGB derivatives, such as later Almaz stations, Skif, Kvant-1 FSM, Kvant-2, Krystal, Spektr, Priroda, Zarya, and Nauka. The pump of the KRD-442 can also be used to internally transfer fuel or refuel from Progress resupply craft.
zh: 苏联燃气发生器循环自燃推进剂真空发动机，设计用于TKS FGB（功能货舱）。极度可靠且具备重启能力，已用于许多FGB衍生型号，例如后期的礼炮号空间站、极地号、量子1号FSM、量子2号、晶体号、光谱号、自然号、曙光号和科学号。<<M0>>的泵还可用于内部燃料输送或从进步号补给船加注推进剂。

s: A Soviet gas generator hypergolic vacuum engine designed for use in the propulsion systems of the Luna E-6 spacecraft bus. It was used for the first Soviet lunar landers and lunar orbiters. When used on a lunar lander, it was switched to verniers only for terminal descent.
zh: 苏联燃气发生器循环自燃推进剂真空发动机，设计用于月球<<M0>>航天器平台的推进系统。用于苏联首批月球着陆器和月球轨道器。在月球着陆器上使用时，在最终下降阶段会切换为仅使用游标发动机。

s: The KTDU-35 is a gas generator hypergolic engine capable of multiple ignitions, used on the first generation Soyuz and Progress spacecrafts (the 7K series). It consists of the single nozzle S5.60 main engine and the dual nozzle S5.35 backup engine. If the main engine fails, the backup one will assume its position.
zh: <<M0>> 是一款具备多次点火能力的气体发生器循环自燃推进剂发动机，用于第一代联盟号和进步号航天器（7K系列）。它由单喷管 S5.60 主发动机和双喷管 S5.35 备用发动机组成。若主发动机发生故障，备用发动机将接替工作。

s: The landing engine for Luna 15-24. The main gas generator engine was used for orbital manuevering and descent, and then switched over to a secondary pressure-fed engine for terminal descent. Use an action group to toggle between the main and secondary engines quickly to make landing easier.
zh: 月球15至24号的着陆发动机。主发生器发动机用于轨道机动和动力下降，随后切换至挤压循环辅助发动机进行末段着陆。使用动作组快速开关切换主发动机与副发动机，可使着陆更为轻松。

s: A staged combustion hydrolox engine intended for the N-1M, considered for Proton and Angara, and eventually licensed to India for its GSLV. Later versions were developed by India for domestic use as the CE-7.5. The main engine bell is fixed in place and two verniers provide combined pitch-yaw-roll control. This engine runs with a somewhat higher than average O/F ratio, resulting in a denser than average hydrolox stage.
zh: 一款专为 <<M0>> 设计的分级燃烧循环氢氧发动机，曾作为质子号和安加拉号的备选，最终授权印度用于其 GSLV 火箭。印度后来将其国产改进型号命名为 <<M1>>.5。主发动机喷管固定，由两个游标发动机提供综合俯仰-偏航-滚转控制。该发动机的氧燃比较常规略高，因此氢氧级推进剂密度更高。

s: The LE-5 is a gas generator hydrolox engine, the first natively-developed Japanese hydrolox engine, designed for use on the second stage of the H-1 launch vehicle. It was then completely redesigned into the world's first expander bleed cycle engine for use on the H-II. It has gone through several evolutions since, being used on the H-IIA, H-IIB, and planned for the H-3.
zh: <<M0>> 是一款气体发生器循环氢氧发动机，也是日本首款自主研发的氢氧发动机，专为 <<M1>> 运载火箭第二级设计。随后它被彻底重新设计为世界上首款开式膨胀循环发动机，用于 H-II 火箭。此后经历多次改进，曾用于 H-IIA、H-IIB，并计划用于 <<M2>>。

s: A fuel-rich staged combustion engine used on the core stage of H-II series launchers. The original LE-7 was replaced by the LE-7A, which sacrificed some performance in favor of reduced cost and better reliability.
zh: 一款富燃分级燃烧循环发动机，用于 H-II 系列运载火箭的芯级。最初的 <<M0>> 被 <<M1>> 取代，后者牺牲了部分性能以换取更低的成本和更高的可靠性。

s: An expander-bleed cycle booster engine, developed for the Japanese H-3 launch vehicle. The use of an expander-bleed cycle makes the engine much cheaper than it's staged combustion predecessor, the LE-7.
zh: 一款为日本 <<M0>> 运载火箭研制的开式膨胀循环助推器发动机。采用开式膨胀循环使其造价比采用分级燃烧循环的前身 <<M1>> 低廉得多。

s: LEROS is a family of chemical rocket engines manufactured by Moog-ISP. LEROS engines have been used as primary apogee engines for telecommunications satellites such as the Lockheed Martin A2100 as well as deep space missions such as Juno.
zh: LEROS 是由 Moog-ISP 生产的化学火箭发动机系列。LEROS 发动机已用作通信卫星（如洛克希德·马丁的 <<M0>>）以及深空探测任务（如朱诺号）的主远地点发动机。

s: The LEROS 4 High Thrust Apogee Engine is an ESA-funded 1100 N engine undergoing development by Moog. It will support the agency's future interplanetary missions by reducing the mass of spacecraft propellant required for orbit insertion maneuvers, allowing more scientific payload to be carried.
zh: LEROS 4 高推力远地点发动机是由欧空局资助、Moog 正在研发的 1100 N 发动机。它将通过减少航天器入轨机动所需的推进剂质量，从而能够携带更多热心科研载荷，为欧空局未来的行星际任务提供支持。

s: An American closed cycle gas core nuclear rocket. Fissile material is contained in fused quartz "lightbulbs", cooled by continuously circulating neon. Propellant passed over these "lightbulbs" is heated to incredible temperatures by the intense light and radiation produced by the nuclear reaction. This design prevents any fissile material from escaping the engine, but reduces performance due to heat transfer losses.
zh: 一款美国闭式气芯核火箭。易裂变材料封装在熔融石英“灯泡”内，由持续循环的氖气冷却。推进剂流经这些“灯泡”时，被核反应产生的强烈光辐射加热至极高温度。该设计防止了任何易裂变材料逸出发动机，但由于传热损失而降低了性能。

s: A deeply-throttleable pressure-fed engine used for the descent module of the Apollo lunar lander. The version on J-class missions had slightly higher isp, which helped give payload capacity for the rover and other equipment. A later variant (TR-201) was used on Delta P series as an upper stage engine; this was a low-cost model with more restarts and slightly higher thrust but with lower efficiency and no throttling.
zh: 一款用于阿波罗登月舱下降级的深度节流挤压循环发动机。J级任务使用的版本比冲略高，有助于为月球车和其他设备提供有效载荷能力。后来的改型（<<M0>>）作为上面级发动机用于德尔塔 P 系列；这是一款低成本型号，具有更多的重启次数和略高的推力，但效率较低且无法节流。

s: The low-pressure NTR is a proposal for a higher performance NTR, relying on hydrogen dissociation. By decreasing the chamber pressure of an NTR to near atmospheric pressure, it is possible to trigger dissociation of diatomic hydrogen into monatomic hydrogen, greatly increasing specific impulse. This low pressure also allows for extremely lightweight construction, allowing for an acceptable TWR despite the low mass flow. The LPNTR is also extremely simple, requiring no pumps, and self-regulating using hydrogen as a moderator, although it also lacks a gimbal.
zh: 低压核热火箭（LPNTR）是一种旨在通过氢解离来提高性能的核热火箭方案。通过将核反应室压力降低至接近大气压，可以触发双原子氢解离为单原子氢，从而大幅提高比冲。这种低压环境还允许采用极轻量化的结构，在较低质量流量的情况下仍可获得尚可的 TWR。LPNTR 还极其简单，无需泵组，且利用氢自身作为慢化剂实现自调节，不过它也缺乏万向节。

s: A long-lasting US kerolox gas-generator booster engine. The same components and broadly the same performance as the LR89, the LR79 (also known as S-3D in Jupiter / Juno II) powered the Jupiter, Thor, and Thor-Delta (Delta) rockets.
zh: 一款服役寿命极长的美国煤油/液氧气体发生器助推器发动机。<<M1>>（在朱庇特/朱诺二号中亦称 <<M2>>）拥有与 <<M0>> 相同的组件和大致相当的性能，曾为朱庇特、雷神及雷神-德尔塔（德尔塔）火箭提供动力。

s: Used in the first stage of the Titan rocket family, the LR87 is composed of two engines with separate turbomachinery integrated into one unit. The version used on Titan I burned kerosene and liquid oxygen, while Titan II through Titan IV burned storable propellants. A modified version burning liquid hydrogen was developed for the upper stages of Saturn V and Saturn IB, but the J-2 was selected instead.
zh: <<M0>> 用于大力神火箭家族的第一级，由两台拥有独立涡轮泵的发动机集成在一个单元内。大力神 I 使用的版本燃烧煤油和液氧，而大力神 II 到大力神 IV 则燃烧可贮存推进剂。曾有一款燃烧液氢的改进版本为土星五号和土星 IB 的上面级研制，但最终入选的是 <<M1>>。

s: Aerojet developed the LR87 engine (used for the Titan series) into a liquid hydrogen/oxygen engine for prospective USAF contracts in the 1958-1960 period, at the same time Aerojet was converting the LR87 to burn Aerozine and NTO. Aerojet also proposed this engine for Saturn upper stage duties, but NASA selected the J-2 over the LR87-LH2 and it was canceled in 1961.
zh: 在 1958-1960 年间，喷气飞机公司（Aerojet）将用于大力神系列的 <<M0>> 发动机改进为液氢/液氧发动机以竞标美国空军合同，与此同时 Aerojet 正在将 <<M0>> 改装为燃烧混胺和四氧化二氮。Aerojet 还提议将此发动机用于土星上面级，但 NASA 最终选择了 <<M1>> 而放弃了 <<M0>>-LH2，该项目遂于 1961 年取消。

s: Beginning its life as the etholox-powered XLR43-NA-3, this was the first US engine to use tubular-wall construction for its combustion chamber. It served as the basis for early orbital US engines, with its lineage stretching to the 21st century. The LR43 was converted to run on kerosene for Atlas and was later renamed LR89, and the LR79 derivative powered Thor. Later LR89s used RS-27 components for higher efficiency, whereas the RS-27 itself was used on Delta by that point. LR89 configs are comparable to similar-era -79 configs, since they were the same engine underneath.
zh: 该系列最初为乙醇/液氧动力的 <<M0>>-<<M1>>，是美国首款采用管状冷却燃烧室壁结构的发动机。它作为美国早期轨道级发动机的基础，其血统一直延续到 21 世纪。<<M2>> 被改装为适用于宇宙神火箭的煤油发动机，后来改名为 <<M3>>，其衍生型号 <<M4>> 则为雷神火箭提供动力。后期的 <<M5>> 采用了 <<M6>> 的部件以提高效率，而此时 <<M6>> 本身已被用于德尔塔火箭。<<M3>> 的构型与同时期的 -79 构型相当，因为两者的本质是同一款发动机。

s: A pump or pressure-fed kerolox vernier engine. Used for attitude control and final velocity adjustment in the MA-x system (2x LR89 + LR105 + 2x LR101) on Atlas, and MB-x system (LR79 or RS-27 + 2xLR101) on Thor-Able, Thor-Agena, Thor-Delta, and Delta.
zh: 一款泵压或挤压循环的煤油/液氧游标发动机。用于宇宙神 MA-x 系统（2x <<M0>> + <<M1>> + 2x <<M2>>）以及雷神-艾布尔、雷神-阿金纳、雷神-德尔塔和德尔塔火箭 MB-x 系统（<<M3>> 或 <<M4>> + 2<<M5>>）的姿态控制和最终速度修正。

s: Upgraded RD-0120 for Vulkan and later Energia versions. Used a nozzle insert to increase sea level performance, which would then be ejected at altitude. Proposed to power Angara after the cancellation of Energia.
zh: 为“火神号”（Vulkan）及后期“能源号”版本升级的<<M0>>。使用喷管嵌件来提高海平面性能，该嵌件随后会在高空抛弃。在“能源号”取消后，曾被提议用于为“安加拉”提供动力。

s: Demonstrator for a throttlable engine, based on the RL10A-3-3. It was intended to be used for the Lunar Applications of a Spent S-IVB Stage (LASS) program to use modified S-IVB stages as heavy lunar landers.
zh: 基于<<M0>>-3-3的可节流发动机验证机。原计划用于“S-IVB废弃级月球应用”（LASS）项目，将改装后的S-IVB级用作重型登月舱。

s: RL10A-3-3A modified to operate with an O/F ratio of 6.0 for Shuttle-Centaur. This reduces performance, but increases the average propellant density, allowing for greater fuel load in the Shuttle cargo bay.
zh: 为“航天飞机-半人马座”改装的<<M0>>-3-3A，氧化剂/燃料比为6.0。这降低了性能，但提高了推进剂平均密度，从而允许在航天飞机货舱内容纳更多的燃料载荷。

s: This config represents the RL-10A-4-1 and RL-10A-4-2 variants. Reworked turbopumps and improved performance for usage in a single & dual engine configuration on Atlas II & Atlas III & single engine configuration on Atlas V.
zh: 此配置代表<<M0>>和<<M1>>改型。重新设计了涡轮泵并提升了性能，用于宇宙神II和宇宙神III的单发及双发配置，以及宇宙神V的单发配置。

s: Upgrade used for the R-17MU, A.K.A Scud-D. It saw very little use in the Soviet Union due to mediocore performance, so the remaining missiles were sold to North Korea, providing the basis for North Korean missile development.
zh: 用于<<M0>>（即飞毛腿-D）的升级版本。由于性能平平，在苏联的使用极少，因此剩余的导弹被出售给朝鲜，为朝鲜的导弹研制奠定了基础。

s: Isayev improved Wasserfall engine used in Soviet R-101B/V/E anti-aircraft missile prototype. Development abandoned in favor of Isayev S09.19A, but was later repurposed for the R-11 (Scud) ballistic missile as the S2.253.
zh: 伊萨耶夫改进型“瀑布”（Wasserfall）发动机，曾用于苏联<<M0>>/V/E防空导弹原型机。该项目因让位于伊萨耶夫S09.19A而被放弃，但随后作为S2.253重新用于<<M1>>（飞毛腿）弹道导弹。

s: A two-person pod. Features an offset Center of Mass to allow lifting reentry and an integrated bi-propellant Attitude Control System (ACS) for controlled reentries. Heat shield rated for LEO reentries.
zh: 双人乘员舱。具有偏置的质心以实现升力再入，并集成有双组元姿态控制系统（ACS）用于受控再入。防热盾额定承受LEO再入。

s: Small solid fueled booster originally used to power anti-shipping missiles during WW2. Used as the kick stage on the WAC Corporal, the USA's first sounding rocket, and reused in modified form for the Aerobee line of sounding rockets.
zh: 小型固体燃料助推器，最初在二战期间用于为反舰导弹提供动力。用作美国第一型探空火箭“女兵准尉”（WAC Corporal）的起旋/助推级，并在修改后重新用于“云雀”（Aerobee）系列探空火箭。

s: Simple steel tank and fuselage designs were used only on very early rockets such as the German V-2 and its American and Soviet clones. Tank and fuselage tankage is no more advanced than that used in the construction of early airplanes.
zh: 简单的钢制贮箱和机身结构仅在极早期的火箭上使用，如德国<<M0>>及其美国和苏联的仿制品。贮箱和机身贮箱结构并不比早期飞机的建造技术先进。

s: Aluminum alloy skin-stringer-frame construction is nothing new to the aerospace industry and is the preferred construction of large aircraft today. Longitudinal stringers are responsible for transferring the aerodynamic loads acting on the skin onto the frame. This method of construction does not have mechanically separate tanks and frame, but the skin of the tank is only responsible for containing the propellant and is not load-bearing. The first rocket of skin-stringer-frame construction was the Soviet R-5 and has remained a staple of Russian design philosophy since, best exemplified in the very successful R-7 family.
zh: 铝合金蒙皮-桁条-框架结构在航空航天工业中并不新鲜，是当今大型飞机的首选结构。纵向桁条负责将作用在蒙皮上的气动载荷传递到框架上。这种构造方法的贮箱和框架在机械上并未分离，但贮箱蒙皮仅负责容纳推进剂，不承受载荷。第一枚采用蒙皮-桁条-框架结构的火箭是苏联的<<M0>>，此后一直成为俄罗斯设计理念的核心支柱，并在极为成功的<<M1>>系列中得到了最好的体现。

s: Improved welding and manufacturing techniques developed in the 1960s allowed the use of more advanced aluminum alloys, containing higher fractions of Magnesium, Manganese, and Copper than their predecessors. The increased alloying makes these alloys slightly difficult to work with, but the increased strength allows for the creation of lighter structures. The most famous use of this construction was in the titanic and powerful S-IC, the first stage of the Saturn V lunar rocket, but it was also used in the early versions of the Shuttle External Tank.
zh: 20世纪60年代开发的改进焊接和制造技术允许使用更先进的铝合金，这些合金比以往的合金含有更高比例的镁、锰和铜。合金含量的增加使得这些合金略微难以加工，但强度的提升使其能够制造更轻的结构。该结构最著名的应用是在土星V号登月火箭庞大而强大的第一级S-IC中，但它也用于早期版本的航天飞机外贮箱。

s: Since lithium is the least dense elemental metal, Al-Li alloys are significantly less dense while being stronger than most other Al alloys. However, they are much more expensive and their metallurgical properties can present great difficulties to work with. Al-Li alloys are commonly used in modern aerospace applications, and all Al-Li skin-stringer construction was used for the final version of the Shuttle External Tank, the Super Lightweight Tank.
zh: 由于锂是密度最低的金属元素，铝锂（Al-Li）合金在比大多数其他铝合金更坚固的同时，密度显著降低。然而，它们造价高昂得多，且其冶金特性可能给加工带来巨大困难。铝锂合金广泛用于现代航空航天领域，全铝锂蒙皮-桁条结构被用于航天飞机外贮箱的最终版本——超轻型贮箱（SLWT）。

s: Improved construction techniques, such as friction stir welding, allow for additional decreases of tank dry mass. Friction stir welding uses heat generated by the friction of rotating tool to soften and mechanically intermixes two pieces of metal. It is used for structures which need very high weld strength, and has broad application in the aerospace industry. Completely stir-welding a semi-stringer-constructed tank was first used by SpaceX on their Falcon 1e and then Falcon 9 series of rockets. This unique construction allows for the use of fewer structural components and lighter welds, resulting in both mass and cost reductions.
zh: 改进的制造技术（如搅拌摩擦焊）使得贮箱干重得以进一步减轻。搅拌摩擦焊利用旋转工具摩擦产生的热量使两块金属软化并在机械上相互混合。它用于需要极高焊接强度的结构，并在航空航天工业中有着广泛的应用。全搅拌摩擦焊接半桁条结构的贮箱最初由<<M0>>在其猎鹰1e以及后来的猎鹰9号系列火箭上采用。这种独特的结构减少了结构组件并减轻了焊缝重量，从而同时降低了质量和成本。

s: Isogrids and orthogrids are advanced hollowed-out structures milled out of a single block of material that have very high rigidity yet exceptional material and mass savings. The delicate & complex lattices on the panel require very high precision machining and thus such a construction is much more expensive to produce than more standard tanks. Nevertheless, gridded tanks have been utilized by nearly every NASA orbital vehicle since the very first to use gridded aluminum construction: Thor/Delta as well as the S-IV and S-IVB upper stage.
zh: 等网格（isogrid）和正交网格（orthogrid）结构是由整块材料铣削加工而成的先进镂空结构，具有极高的刚度，同时显著节省了材料和质量。面板上精密而复杂的晶格需要极高精度的机械加工，因此这种结构的制造成本远高于更标准的贮箱。尽管如此，网格贮箱几乎被NASA的每一个轨道飞行器所采用，最早采用网格铝结构的则是雷神/德尔塔（Thor/Delta）以及S-IV和S-IVB上面级。

s: Improved welding and manufacturing techniques developed in the 1960s allowed the use of more advanced aluminum alloys, containing higher fractions of Magnesium, Manganese, and Copper than their predecessors. The increased alloying makes these alloys slightly difficult to work with, but the increased strength allows for the creation of lighter structures. The S-II stage of the Saturn V used this construction to become the highest performance hydrolox stage of its time.
zh: 20世纪60年代开发的改进焊接和制造技术允许使用更先进的铝合金，这些合金比以往的合金含有更高比例的镁、锰和铜。合金含量的增加使得这些合金略微难以加工，但强度的提升使其能够制造更轻的结构。土星V号的S-II级采用了这种结构，成为当时性能最高的液氢液氧级。

s: Since lithium is the least dense elemental metal, Al-Li alloys are significantly less dense while being stronger than most other Al alloys. However, their tendency to work-harden means that machining such alloys is much more difficult than standard alloys. Nevertheless, lightweight Al-Li gridded tanks have been the foundation of the modern era of orbital American rocketry, used in the Atlas V Common Core Booster, the Delta IV Common Booster Core (and DCSS upper stages), the Space Launch System core stage, and the ULA Vulcan rocket.
zh: 由于锂是密度最低的金属元素，铝锂（Al-Li）合金在比大多数其他铝合金更坚固的同时，密度显著降低。然而，其加工硬化倾向意味着机械加工此类合金比标准合金困难得多。尽管如此，轻质铝锂网格贮箱已成为美国现代轨道火箭时代的基石，用于宇宙神V的公共核心助推器（Common Core Booster）、德尔塔IV的公共助推核心（Common Booster Core，以及DCSS上面级）、太空发射系统（SLS）核心级以及ULA的火神火箭。

s: You can now use Aluminum-Lithium Alloy gridded tanks. Since lithium is the least dense metal, Al-Li alloys are significantly less dense while still being very strong. However, their tendency to work-harden makes them more difficult to machine. These tanks are common in modern American rocketry, used in the Atlas V Common Core Booster, the Delta IV, the SLS core stage, and Vulcan. These are 5% (standard) or 18% (HP) lighter than refined Al gridded tanks while costing 10% more to tool and 15% more once tooled.
zh: 你现在可以使用铝锂合金网格储罐。由于锂是密度最小的金属，铝锂合金在保持高强度的同时显著降低了密度。然而，其加工硬化倾向使得机加工更加困难。此类储罐在现代美国火箭中十分常见，用于宇宙神5号通用核心助推器（CCB）、德尔塔4号、SLS芯级和火神火箭。它们比精炼铝网格储罐轻 5%（标准）或 18%（高压），但开模成本高出 10%，模具制造后的生产成本高出 15%。

s: You can now use Carbon Composite tanks. The low density and high strength of carbon composites have long been the siren call of tank design, ever since the aborted Venture Star program of the 1990s. Costs continue to drop, but the manufacturing process is still very expensive, requiring the wrapping and weaving of hundreds of layers of carbon fiber and baking in massive autoclaves. Currently, the only rocket to use composite tanks is Electron, developed by Rocket Lab. These are 18% lighter than Al-Li gridded tanks while costing 20% more to tool and 17% more once tooled.
zh: 你现在可以使用碳复合材料储罐。自20世纪90年代未果的“冒险之星”计划以来，碳复合材料的低密度与高强度一直是储罐设计领域梦寐以求的目标。虽然成本在持续下降，但其制造工艺仍旧极其昂贵，需要缠绕并编织数百层碳纤维，并在巨型高压釜中固化成型。目前，唯一使用复合材料储罐的火箭是由火箭实验室（Rocket Lab）研发的“电子号”。它们比铝锂合金网格储罐轻 18%，但开模成本高出 20%，模具制造后的生产成本高出 17%。

s: You can now use Advanced Carbon Composite tanks. Ceramic-metal alloys and insulating complex composite structures are still speculative, but if they ever come to fruition, they'd probably be something like this. These are 40% lighter than composite tanks while costing 33% more to tool and 18% more once tooled.
zh: 你现在可以使用先进碳复合材料储罐。金属陶瓷合金与隔热复杂复合材料结构仍处于构想阶段，但若能实现，大体便会是这种形态。它们比复合材料储罐轻 40%，但开模成本高出 33%，模具制造后的生产成本高出 18%。

s: You can now use Steel & Aluminum balloon tanks. Balloon tanks do not have an internal framework, but instead rely on internal pressurization to keep its shape. If the pressurization fails, the balloon tank collapses. They are constructed of very thin sheets of stainless steel and have very good mass fractions, but the logistics involved in maintaining pressurization make them quite expensive. These early balloon tanks were first used by Atlas and the Centaur C upper stage.
zh: 你现在可以使用钢与铝质气囊储罐。气囊储罐没有内部构架，而是依靠内部增压来维持其形状。一旦增压失效，气囊储罐就会发生瘪陷。它们由极薄的不锈钢板制成，拥有极高的质量比，但维持增压所需的后勤保障使其造价相当高昂。这些早期气囊储罐最初应用于宇宙神火箭以及半人马座C上面级。

s: You can now use Steel & Aluminum-Copper Alloy balloon tanks. These advanced balloon tanks were first used by the Centaur G upper stage. These are 25% lighter than basic balloon tanks while costing 20% more to tool and 12% less once tooled.
zh: 你现在可以使用钢与铝铜合金气囊储罐。这些先进气囊储罐最初应用于半人马座G上面级。它们比基础气囊储罐轻 25%，开模成本高出 20%，但模具制造后的生产成本降低 12%。

s: You can now use Steel & Aluminum-Lithium Alloy balloon tanks. These modern balloon tanks were first used by Centaur III. These are 5% lighter than refined balloon tanks while costing 7% more to tool and 25% more once tooled.
zh: 你现在可以使用钢与铝锂合金气囊储罐。这些现代气囊储罐最初应用于半人马座3上面级。它们比精炼气囊储罐轻 5%，开模成本高出 7%，模具制造后的生产成本高出 25%。

s: You can now use composite wet wings. Large-scale use of composite structures was first pioneered in the Boeing 787, 777X, and Airbus A350. These are 35% lighter than wet wing tanks while costing 10% more.
zh: 你现在可以使用复合材料湿式机翼。复合材料结构的大规模应用最早由波音787、777X以及空客<<M0>>开创。它们比湿式机翼储罐轻 35%，但成本高出 10%。

s: The full-sized version of the centrifuge from the Nautilus-X proposal. With a habitable volume close to that of the entire ISS put together, it's large enough to provide comfortable habitation to six astronauts. Although the diameter remains too small to allow for full Earth-like gravity under tolerable rotation rates, Martian gravity levels are easily achievable.
zh: 源自 Nautilus-X 方案的全尺寸离心机。其宜居容积接近整个国际空间站（ISS）的总和，足以容纳六名航天员舒适生活。尽管其直径仍不足以在人体可承受的自转速率下提供完全模拟地球的重力，但达到火星重力水平绰绰有余。

s: The RJ55 was a combined cycle ramjet, mated to a J67. At low speeds, the RJ55 functioned as an afterburner for the J67 turbojet, but at mach 2.24 the turbojet would be shut down and the RJ55 would power the aircraft up to Mach 3. Designed for the XF-103, but difficuties with the J67 turbojet meant the prototype never flew under it's own power.
zh: <<M0>> 是一种组合循环冲压发动机，与 J67 配合使用。在低速下，<<M0>> 充当 J67 涡喷发动机的加力燃烧室；但在达到 2.24 马赫时，涡喷发动机将关闭，由 <<M0>> 驱动飞机加速至 3 马赫。该发动机专为 <<M1>> 设计，但由于 J67 涡喷发动机存在问题，原型机从未依靠自身动力飞行。

s: The RJ59 was a supersonic ramjet, designed to power the Convair Super Hustler. Although the Super Hustler was cancelled, the RJ59 was fitted to the X-7 for testing, where it was able to achieve speeds over Mach 4.
zh: <<M0>> 是一种超音速冲压发动机，设计用于康维尔 Super Hustler。尽管 Super Hustler 项目被取消，但 <<M0>> 被安装在 <<M1>> 上进行测试，并在测试中达到了超过 4 马赫的速度。

s: The Atar 101 was one of the first jet engines developed in France following WW2. It was used in many early French jet aircraft, including the Vautour I/II, Gerfaut I, and Mystère II. This is the 101D, an early model used in the Dassault Mystère IIC. Available 1954. Thrust 29.42kN. OPR 4.5, SFC 1.09 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 1.5.
zh: Atar 101 是二战后法国研制的最早的喷气发动机之一。它曾用于许多早期的法国喷气机，包括秃鹰 I/II、苍鹰 I 和神秘 II。此型号为 101D，是用于达索神秘 IIC 的早期型号。1954 年可用。推力 29.42 kN。总压比 4.5，静态油耗 1.09 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制 1.5 马赫。

s: The Derwent V, rather than being a development of the Derwent line (a straight-through-flow development of the W.2), was instead a scaled-down Nene. It powered the Meteor F.4, and also the La-15, Yak-23 and Yak-25 as the RD-500, a Soviet-built copy. Thrust 15.6kN. Available in mid-late 1945. OPR 4.0, SFC 1.03 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 1.
zh: 德温特 V（Derwent V）并非德温特系列的直接发展型（W.2 的直流道改进型），而是一款缩小版的尼恩（Nene）。它为流星 F.4 以及作为苏联仿制版 <<M3>> 的 <<M0>>、<<M1>> 和 <<M2>> 提供动力。推力 15.6 kN。1945 年中后期可用。总压比 4.0，静态油耗 1.03 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制 1 马赫。

s: The Allison/General Electric J35 is an axial flow turbojet, and one of the first turbojets natively designed in the United States. Although not as well known as it's later derivative, the J47, it still powered many late 40s aircraft such as the FJ-1, F-84, F-89, XP-86, XB-45, XB-47, X-5, and D-558. This is the -11, as used on the Douglas D-558-1. Available 1946. Thrust 16.68kN. 4.0 OPR, SFC of 1.12lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 1.
zh: 艾里逊/通用电气 J35 是一款轴流式涡喷发动机，也是美国本土设计的最早的涡喷发动机之一。尽管不如其后来的衍生型 J47 那样闻名，它仍为 40 年代后期的许多飞机提供了动力，如 <<M0>>、<<M1>>、<<M2>>、<<M3>>、<<M4>>、<<M5>>、<<M6>> 和 <<M7>>。这是 -11 型，用于道格拉斯 <<M8>>。1946 年可用。推力 16.68 kN。总压比 4.0，静态油耗 1.12 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制 1 马赫。

s: The General Electric J47 is an axial flow turbojet, developed from the J35 in parallel with centrifugal flow jets based on British designs. The J47 was very successful, used on many early 50s aircraft, including the F-86, FJ-2, XF-87, XF-91, B-36, B-45, B-47, XB-51, KB-50, KB-97, and even the M-497 jet-powered railcar. This is the -27, a later model used in the F-86F. Available 1952. Thrust 26.47 kN. 5.5 OPR, SFC of 0.902lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 1.
zh: 通用电气 J47 是一款轴流式涡喷发动机，与基于英国设计的离心流喷气发动机并行由 J35 发展而来。J47 非常成功，广泛应用于 50 年代初的许多飞机，包括 <<M0>>、<<M1>>、<<M2>>、<<M3>>、<<M4>>、<<M5>>、<<M6>>、<<M7>>、<<M8>>、<<M9>>，甚至还用于 <<M10>> 喷气动力轨道车。这是 -27 型，是用于 <<M11>> 的后期型号。1952 年可用。推力 26.47 kN。总压比 5.5，静态油耗 0.902 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制 1 马赫。

s: A Soviet-built derivative of the Nene. The British government sold several Nene and Derwent engines to the Soviet Union in 1946, which were then reverse engineered, and used in many early Soviet jet aircraft, including the MiG-15, MiG-17, and Il-28. The VK-1 was an improved version, used in the MiG-15bis. Available 1949. Thrust 26.47 kN. 4.4 OPR, SFC 1.049 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 1.
zh: 苏联生产的尼恩（Nene）衍生型。英国政府于 1946 年向苏联出售了数台尼恩和德温特发动机，苏联对其进行了逆向工程，并用于许多早期苏联喷气式飞机，包括 <<M0>>、<<M1>> 和 <<M2>>。<<M3>> 是其改进版本，用于 <<M4>>。1949 年可用。推力 26.47 kN。总压比 4.4，静态油耗 1.049 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制 1 马赫。

s: Monolithic "mixing-head" injector engine. Improved thrust, decreased weight, and storable fuel mixture consisting of explosives grade acid and coal tar distillate. The combustion instability issues of this design were never resolved, although a subscale version was used as the basis for the "Wasserfall" anti-aircraft missile.
zh: 整体式“混合头”喷注器发动机。提升了推力，减轻了重量，并使用由炸药级硝酸和煤焦油馏分组成的可贮存推进剂混合物。该设计的燃烧不稳定问题从未得到解决，尽管其缩比版本被用作“瀑布”（Wasserfall）防空导弹的动力基础。

s: Proposed engine for X-15 program, with a recirculation valve to allow operation at ~60% throttle. Limited throttle capability and starts, but much lighter, cheaper, and more reliable than other options.
zh: 提议用于 <<M0>> 计划的发动机，带有再循环阀以允许在约 60% 节流阀开度下工作。节流调节能力和启动次数有限，但比其他方案更轻、更便宜且更可靠。

s: Maximum possible thrust for H-1 design, proposed for a post-Apollo uprated Saturn IB. Although engines were tested at increased thrust levels, the end of Apollo and selection of Titan III over Saturn IB meant this was never developed further.
zh: <<M0>> 设计的最大可能推力型号，提议用于后阿波罗时代的土星 IB 改型。尽管发动机在更高推力水平下进行了测试，但阿波罗计划的结束以及泰坦 III 取代土星 IB 的抉择意味着该型号从未进一步发展。

s: Enhanced H-1 design, featuring an enlarged, tap-off cycle turbopump and simplified components to increase thrust and reduce cost. Intended to power the Saturn-II and later versions of the Saturn-I, but development was cancelled due to satisfactory performance of the H-1 at increased thrust levels.
zh: 增强型 <<M0>> 设计，采用扩大的膨胀抽取循环涡轮泵并简化了组件，以提高推力并降低成本。原定用于土星 II 和土星 I 的后期型号，但由于 <<M0>> 在提升推力水平下的性能令人满意，该研发被取消。

s: Further refinement of the HG-3 engine, taking into account developements with the RL-10 and RS-25. Run time and reliability are extended compared to original models, although turbopump throughput is decreased to reduce strain on engine components.
zh: <<M0>> 发动机的进一步改进型，融合了 <<M1>> 和 <<M2>> 的研发成果。与原始型号相比，延长了工作时间和可靠性，但降低了涡轮泵流量以减少对发动机部件的负荷。

s: Sea-level variant of HG-3B upgrade. Increased specific impulse compared to other sea-level variants prior to B version development results in slightly higher thrust for the same level of turbopump throughput as the HG-3B vacuum engine.
zh: <<M0>> 升级型的海平面版本。与 B 型开发前的其他海平面版本相比，提高了比冲，从而在与 <<M0>> 真空发动机相同的涡轮泵流量下获得了略高的推力。

s: Modified version of HG-3B, running the turbopumps harder to generate the same level of mass flow as in previous models. This results in improved thrust compared to the normal B model, at the cost of slightly less reliability in comparison.
zh: <<M0>> 的改进版本，通过加大涡轮泵转速来产生与先前型号相同的质量流量。与普通 B 型相比，这提高了推力，但相应牺牲了少许可靠性。

s: The J-2S (J-2 Simplified) was a improvement on the J-2 Engine. It was completely tested and logged more than 30,000 seconds of static fire before the program was terminated. Five minutes minimum between restarts.
zh: <<M0>>（<<M1>> 简化型）是对 <<M1>> 发动机的改进。在项目终止前，它完成了全面测试，并累计了超过 30,000 秒的静止试车时间。两次重启之间至少需要间隔五分钟。

s: GE4/J6H turbojet, designed after tests revealed the afterburners of the GE4 would make the 2707 too loud to use most airports. The revised engine has slightly superior performance, but is much heavier. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 3.56.
zh: GE4/J6H 涡喷发动机，在测试表明 GE4 的加力燃烧室会使 2707 噪音过大而无法在大多数机场使用后设计。改进后的发动机性能略胜一筹，但重量显著增加。15 km 处的温度马赫数限制：3.56。

s: Simplified design for the H-IIA. Lower cost and better reliability, at the cost of lower performance. Intended to have a nozzle extension, but it had to be removed due to unexpected combustion instability issues.
zh: 为 H-IIA 设计的简化方案。以牺牲部分性能为代价，实现了更低的成本和更高的可靠性。原计划采用喷管延伸段，但由于意外的燃烧不稳定问题而不得不将其移除。

s: AJ23-139, First stage engine for Titan 24B, 34B, IIIBS, IIID, 34D, 34D7 and IIIE. Modified to light in midair, since the UA120x boosters used by Titan III could lift Titan without assistance. Ignited just before booster burnout.
zh: <<M0>>-139，泰坦 24B、34B、IIIBS、IIID、34D、34D7 和 IIIE 的第一级发动机。经改装后可在空中点火，因为泰坦 III 使用的 <<M1>> 助推器可以在没有辅助的情况下托起泰坦。在助推器燃尽前点火。

s: Uprated XLR43 for later Navaho applications. First US engine to use tubular wall, aka spaghetti, thrust chamber which greatly reduced weight. Also first to use a gas generator, removing the need for HTP to power the turbopump.
zh: 用于后期“纳瓦霍”（Navaho）项目的提升推力型 <<M0>>。美国首款采用管状内壁（即意大利面式）推力室的发动机，大幅减轻了重量。也是首款采用燃气发生器的发动机，消除了驱动涡轮泵对过氧化氢（HTP）的需求。

s: The unparalleled low density and high strength of carbon composites have long been the siren call of tank design. Ever since the X-33 and Venture Star program of the 1990s was aborted only a few years years before the leaking problems that had killed Venture Star were solved, space companies have been trying to justify the very high cost of composite materials. Although costs continue to drop, the intensive manufacturing process is still very expensive, requiring the wrapping and weaving of hundreds of layers of carbon fiber with resins that are then baked off in massive autoclaves. Currently, the only rocket to use composite materials is the smallsat Electron orbital launcher developed by Rocket Lab.
zh: 碳复合材料无可比拟的低密度与高强度，长久以来一直是储罐设计的致命诱惑。20世纪90年代的<<M0>>和风险之星（Venture Star）计划因泄漏问题夭折，而就在几年后该问题便得到解决；自此之后，各航天公司一直在努力证明高昂的复合材料成本是物有所值的。尽管成本持续下降，但高强度的制造工艺依然极其昂贵，需要将数百层碳纤维与树脂缠绕编织，然后在巨大的热压罐中固化成型。目前，唯一使用复合材料的火箭是Rocket Lab研发的“电子号”微小卫星轨道运载火箭。

s: Advanced carbon composite tankage, more resistant to cryogenic temperatures, and built using cutting edge construction techniques to maximize strength. Although small technology demonstrators have been made, no launch vehicle has utilized this style of advanced composite tankage.
zh: 先进碳复合材料储罐，更耐深冷低温，采用尖端工艺制造以最大化结构强度。尽管已制造出小型技术验证件，但尚未有运载火箭在实际中使用这种先进复合材料储罐。

s: Balloon tanks do not have an internal framework, but instead rely on internal pressurization to keep its shape. If the pressurization fails, the balloon tank collapses. They are constructed of very thin sheets of stainless steel and have very good mass fractions, but the logistics involved in maintaining pressurization make them quite expensive. These advanced balloon tanks were first used by the Centaur G upper stage.
zh: 气球储罐没有内部框架，而是依靠内部增压来维持形状。如果失去增压，气球储罐便会坍缩。它们由极薄的不锈钢板制成，具有极高的质量比，但维持增压所需的后勤保障使其造价相当昂贵。这种先进气球储罐最早应用于半人马座G上面级。

s: Balloon tanks do not have an internal framework, but instead rely on internal pressurization to keep its shape. If the pressurization fails, the balloon tank collapses. They are constructed of very thin sheets of stainless steel and have very good mass fractions, but the logistics involved in maintaining pressurization make them quite expensive. These modern balloon tanks were first used by Centaur III.
zh: 气球储罐没有内部框架，而是依靠内部增压来维持形状。如果失去增压，气球储罐便会坍缩。它们由极薄的不锈钢板制成，具有极高的质量比，但维持增压所需的后勤保障使其造价相当昂贵。这种现代气球储罐最早应用于半人马座III。

s: You can now use Aluminum Fuselage tanks. Aluminum tank and fuselage construction was first used on the American Viking sounding rocket and then, perplexingly, on the massive Soviet N-1 lunar rocket. These are 40% (standard) or 20% (HP) lighter than steel tanks while costing 5% more to tool and 10% more once tooled.
zh: 你现在可以使用铝制机身储罐。铝制储罐与机身结构最早应用于美国“维京”探空火箭，随后出人意料地应用于巨大的苏联<<M0>>登月火箭。这种储罐比钢制储罐轻40%（标准）或20%（高压），但工装模具成本高出5%，生产单价高出10%。

s: You can now use Aluminum Stringer tanks. Longitudinal stringers transfer the aerodynamic loads from the skin to the frame, similar to aircraft design. This combines tank and frame, but the skin of the tank is only responsible for containing the propellant and is not structural. The first rocket of this type of construction was the R-5 and skin-stringer-frame construction has remained a staple of Russian design philosophy, including the R-7 and Proton families. These are 35% (standard) or 20% (HP) lighter than Al fuselage tanks while costing 25% more to tool and 10% more once tooled.
zh: 你现在可以使用铝制桁条储罐。纵向桁条将气动载荷从蒙皮传递到框架，类似于飞机设计。这种结构将储罐与框架合二为一，但储罐蒙皮仅用于容纳推进剂，不承受结构载荷。采用该结构的首枚火箭是<<M0>>，蒙皮-桁条-框架结构自此成为俄罗斯火箭设计的基石，包括<<M1>>和“质子”系列。这种储罐比铝制机身储罐轻35%（标准）或20%（高压），但工装模具成本高出25%，生产单价高出10%。

s: You can now use Aluminum-Copper Alloy Stringer tanks. Also known as "Duraluminum", this family of alloys is very strong and as workable as regular aluminum. The most famous use of this construction was in the titanic and powerful S-IC, the first stage of the Saturn V lunar rocket, but it was also used in the early versions of the Shuttle External Tank. These are 25% lighter than Al stringer tanks while costing 20% more to tool and 10% more once tooled.
zh: 你现在可以使用铝铜合金桁条储罐。这种合金系列亦称“硬铝”，强度极高且具备与普通铝材相同的可加工性。该结构最著名的应用是土星五号登月火箭极其庞大且强力的S-IC第一级，早期版本的航天飞机外贮箱也采用了此技术。这种储罐比普通铝制桁条储罐轻25%，但工装模具成本高出20%，生产单价高出10%。

s: You can now use Aluminum-Lithium Alloy Stringer tanks. Since lithium is the least dense metal, Al-Li alloys are significantly less dense while still being very strong. However, they are more expensive and can be hard to work with. This technology was used for the final version of the Shuttle External Tank, the Super Lightweight Tank. These are 25% (standard) or 45% (HP) lighter than refined Al stringer tanks while costing 25% more to tool and once tooled.
zh: 你现在可以使用铝锂合金桁条储罐。锂是密度最低的金属，因此铝锂合金在保持极高强度的同时密度显著降低。然而，它们造价更高且难以加工。这项技术曾用于航天飞机外贮箱的最终版本——超轻型外贮箱（SLWT）。这种储罐比精炼铝桁条储罐轻25%（标准）或45%（高压），但工装模具与生产单价均高出25%。

s: You can now use stir-welded Aluminum-Lithium Alloy Stringer tanks. Friction stir welding uses heat from the friction of rotating tool to soften and intermix two pieces of metal for very strong welds. A completely stir-welded tank was first used on the Falcon 1e and then on Falcon 9. This allows for fewer structural components and lighter welds, thus, cheaper and lighter tanks, especially at high pressures. These are 6% (standard) or 15% (HP) lighter than Al-Li stringer tanks while costing 20% less to tool and 15% less once tooled.
zh: 你现在可以使用搅拌摩擦焊铝锂合金桁条储罐。搅拌摩擦焊利用旋转工具的摩擦热软化并混合两块金属，形成极高强度的焊缝。全搅拌摩擦焊储罐最早应用于猎鹰1e，随后应用于猎鹰9号。该技术减少了结构部件并减轻了焊缝重量，从而实现了更便宜、更轻的储罐，在高压下尤为明显。这种储罐比普通铝锂合金桁条储罐轻6%（标准）或15%（高压），同时工装模具成本降低20%，生产单价降低15%。

s: You can now use stir-welded Steel Alloy Stringer tanks. This is the all-new 1950's technology that will be used by SpaceX's Starship vehicle & Superheavy booster. These are 24% (standard) or 70% (HP) heavier than refined Al-Li stringer tanks while costing 20% less to tool and once tooled.
zh: 你现在可以使用搅拌摩擦焊钢合金桁条储罐。这是<<M0>>的“星舰”飞船与“超级重型”助推器所采用的“全新1950年代技术”。这种储罐比精炼铝锂合金桁条储罐重24%（标准）或70%（高压），但工装模具与生产单价均低20%。

s: You can now use Aluminum gridded tanks. Isogrids and orthogrids are advanced hollowed-out structures milled out of a single block of material that have very high rigidity yet exceptional material and mass savings. The delicate & complex lattices on the panel require very high precision machining and thus such a construction is much more expensive to produce than more standard tanks. Nevertheless, gridded tanks have been utilized by nearly every NASA orbital vehicle since the very first to use gridded aluminum construction: the Thor/Delta and Titan rockets as well as the Agena upper stage.
zh: 你现在可以使用铝制网格储罐。等网格和正交网格是从整块材料中铣削出的先进镂空结构，具有极高的刚度，同时极大地节省了材料和质量。面板上精密复杂的晶格需要极高精度的机械加工，因此这种结构的生产成本远高于标准储罐。尽管如此，自最早采用网格式铝结构的雷神/德尔塔与大力神火箭以及阿金纳上面级以来，NASA几乎所有的轨道飞行器都使用了网格储罐。

s: You can now use Aluminum-Copper Alloy gridded tanks. Stronger than unalloyed aluminum and workable to boot, advanced new Al-Cu alloys were used in orthogrid and isogrid tanks for all upper stages of the Saturn program. These are 25% (standard) or 10% (HP) lighter than Al gridded tanks while costing 50% more to tool and 10% more once tooled.
zh: 你现在可以使用铝铜合金网格储罐。先进的新型铝铜合金比纯铝更强，且兼具良好的加工性，被应用于土星计划所有上面级的正交网格和等网格储罐中。这种储罐比铝制网格储罐轻25%（标准）或10%（高压），但工装模具成本高出50%，生产单价高出10%。

s: A post-war Russian version of the German Taifun anti-aircraft barrage rocket booster. Developed and tested in 1947-1951 but abandoned in favor of the R-110. A cluster of 8 of these rockets formed the first stage of the MR-1 sounding rocket. Length without payload - 1.36 meters.
zh: 德国“台风”（Taifun）防空弹幕火箭助推器的战后苏联仿制型号。于1947至1951年间研制并测试，但后来因转投<<M0>>而被放弃。由8枚该型火箭捆绑而成的发动机组构成了<<M1>>探空火箭的第一级。不含有效载荷时的长度为1.36米。

s: A 225 N hydrazine thruster, used on all Ranger and early Mariner spacecraft for midcourse corrections. Since reliable hydrazine catalysts had not yet been developed, the engines were only capable of two starts.
zh: 一款225 N肼推进器，用于所有“徘徊者”以及早期“水手”航天器的中途修正。由于当时尚未开发出可靠的肼催化剂，该发动机仅能点火两次。

s: The Raptor is a methalox full-flow staged combustion engine designed for both Starship & the Super Heavy Launch Vehicle. The Super Heavy first stage uses 33 sea-level optimized engines, and Starship uses 3 sea-level engines and 3 vacuum engines.
zh: 猛禽（Raptor）是一款专为星舰及“超级重型”运载火箭设计的全流量分级燃烧甲烷液氧发动机。“超级重型”第一级使用33台海平面优化发动机，星舰则使用3台海平面发动机和3台真空发动机。

s: A four-chamber nitric acid and kerosene engine developed by Glushko during WW2. It was used in various rocket powered aircraft proposals, and tested extensively in the Pe-2RD, a Pe-2 bomber with an RD-1 installed in the fuselage, but abandoned after WW2, as jet engines proved to be more reliable for high performance aircraft.
zh: 一款由格鲁什科在二战期间研制的四燃烧室硝酸/煤油发动机。它曾用于多种火箭动力飞机的方案设计，并在<<M0>>（一架在机身内安装了<<M1>>的<<M2>>轰炸机）上进行了广泛测试；但由于喷气式发动机在高性能飞机上展现出了更高的可靠性，该方案在二战后被放弃。

s: A 1970s low TWR staged combustion hydrolox upper stage engine intended for use on the N1/N1M. A later version designated RD-57M had an extendable nozzle and was intended for the Vulkan and Energia-M rockets. The engine was marketed by Aerojet in the 1990s under the designation D-57 for use on an SSTO demonstrator.
zh: 一款20世纪70年代研制的低TWR分级燃烧氢氧上面级发动机，原计划用于N1/N1M。后期代号为<<M0>>的改型配备了可伸展喷管，原定用于“火神”（Vulkan）和“能源-M”（Energia-M）火箭。该发动机在20世纪90年代由Aerojet以代号<<M1>>推向市场，拟用于单级入轨（SSTO）验证机。

s: The world's first closed-cycle engine. The S1.5400 was used as the final stage for the R-7's Molniya configuration to launch communication satellites and interplanetary probes. Unlike prior upper stages, it was restartable (apogee kicks are needed for Molniya orbits). It was given the industry designation 11D33. The 11D33M brought upgrades and was the basis for the RD-58 with higher performance still (designated 11D58). The RD-58 was used on many Russian launchers, including N1 and Buran and is still in use on Proton and Zenit.
zh: 世界上第一款闭式循环发动机。S1.5400曾作为<<M0>>“闪电”构型的末级，用于发射通信卫星和行星际探测器。与以往的上面级不同，它具备二次启动能力（闪电轨道需要远地点加速）。其工业代号为11D33。升级版的11<<M1>>成为性能更高的<<M2>>（代号11D58）的基础。<<M2>>曾用于包括N1和暴风雪号在内的众多俄罗斯运载火箭，至今仍在使用于“质子”号和“天顶”号上。

s: RD-100 series engines were the first large scale ethalox Russian engines ever developed and fired. The original RD-100 engine was a 1:1 copy of the German Model 39 engine (used on the A-4 ballistic missile), with later variants (RD-101 and RD-103/M) featuring ever increasing performance to satisfy the needs of the larger R-2 and R-5 IRBMs.
zh: <<M0>>系列发动机是俄罗斯有史以来研发并点火的第一批大型乙醇液氧发动机。最初的<<M0>>发动机是德国39型发动机（用于<<M1>>弹道导弹）的1:1仿制品，后期的衍生型号（<<M2>>与<<M3>>/M）性能不断提升，以满足更大的<<M4>>和<<M5>>中程弹道导弹（IRBM）的需求。

s: A kerolox gas generator vacuum engine which served in R-7 upper stages (Luna, Vostok). The RD-0105 was designed for Luna launches; it was the first upper stage for the R-7 series and was reused for uncrewed Vostok tests. An enhanced version, the RD-0109, was used for crewed Vostok launches.
zh: 一款煤油液氧气动发生器循环真空发动机，曾用于<<M0>>的上面级（“月球”号、“东方”号）。<<M1>>专为“月球”号任务设计，是<<M0>>系列的首个上面级，后又复用于无人“东方”号测试。其性能增强版本<<M2>>则用于载人“东方”号发射。

s: The booster engine for the R-7 Semyorka and its derivatives, including the Sputnik, Luna, Voskhod, Vostok, Soyuz, and Molniya launch vehicles. It differs from the core engine series (RD-108) with a higher chamber pressure, thrust, and smaller vernier layout. The R-7 family core was supplemented for (roughly) two minutes by four strap-on boosters powered by these engines.
zh: 用于<<M0>>“老七”（Semyorka）及其衍生型号（包括“伴侣”号、“月球”号、“上升”号、“东方”号、“联盟”号和“闪电”号运载火箭）的助推器发动机。与芯级发动机系列（<<M1>>）相比，它的室压和推力更高，游标布局更紧凑。由这些发动机提供动力的四个捆绑助推器会为<<M0>>家族芯级提供约两分钟的推力补充。

s: The core engine for the R-7 Semyorka and its derivatives, including the Sputnik, Luna, Voskhod, Vostok, Soyuz, and Molniya launch vehicles. It differs from the booster engine series (RD-107) with a lower chamber pressure, thrust, and a wider vernier layout. It powers the R-7 family core through a very long (roughly) five minute burn that starts on the pad alongside the boosters.
zh: 用于<<M0>>“老七”（Semyorka）及其衍生型号（包括“伴侣”号、“月球”号、“上升”号、“东方”号、“联盟”号和“闪电”号运载火箭）的芯级发动机。与助推器发动机系列（<<M1>>）相比，它的室压和推力更低，游标布局更宽。它为<<M0>>家族芯级提供长达约五分钟的动力推进，并在发射台上与助推器同时点火。

s: A Soviet high-performance semi-cryogenic upper stage engine. Originally developed as an upper stage for the R-7, it was never used due to Korolev's refusal to use toxic propellants. It was later adapted for the Kosmos-2 Launch Vehicle, which needed a high performance upper stage due to the low performance of its R-12 first stage.
zh: 一款苏联研制的高性能半低温上面级发动机。最初作为<<M0>>的上面级研制，但因科罗廖夫拒绝使用剧毒推进剂而未被采用。后来它被适配到“宇宙-2”运载火箭上，以弥补其<<M1>>第一级性能不足的问题。

s: The first stage engine for the R-9 ICBM. Derived from the RD-107/108 engines of the R-7, the RD-111 was intended to provide a much quicker reaction time than the R-7. Although still using cryogenic liquid oxygen, it could be fuelled and launched in under 20 minutes. This, combined with its high performance, meant it was the last cryogenic ICBM to leave service.
zh: 用于<<M0>>洲际弹道导弹的第一级发动机。衍生自<<M2>>的<<M1>>/108发动机，<<M3>>旨在提供比<<M2>>快得多的反应时间。尽管仍使用低温液氧，但它能在20分钟内完成加注并点火发射。这一特点配合其高性能，使其成为服役时间最长的低温洲际弹道导弹。

s: A 1990s medium TWR engine for atmospheric and vacuum use. The RD-0120T is a fuel-rich staged combustion tripropellant engine developed from the RD-0120 for use on SSTOs and other high performance vehicles. Tested in collaboration with Aerojet, but never flew.
zh: 一款20世纪90年代研制的中TWR大气与真空通用发动机。<<M0>>是一款富燃分级燃烧三组元推进剂发动机，由<<M1>>衍生而来，用于SSTO及其他高性能运载工具。曾与Aerojet合作进行过测试，但从未实际飞行。

s: The first expander cycle engine developed in Russia. It was developed in collaboration with Pratt & Whitney as a high performance upper stage for Proton. It was heavily inspired by the RL10, and some of its design elements were integrated into the RL10.
zh: 俄罗斯研制的第一款膨胀循环发动机。它是与普惠公司（Pratt & Whitney）合作开发的，拟作为“质子”号的高性能上面级。其设计深受<<M0>>的启发，部分设计元素后来也被反哺整合到了<<M0>>中。

s: Between 2002 and 2005, KBKhA teamed up with European industry to develop a reusable staged combustion methane engine with a thrust of 200 tons under the Volga project. In 2006, the company started work on a reusable engine designated RD-0162 for the Russian MRKS-1 reusable space booster.
zh: 在2002年至2005年间，<<M0>>在“伏尔加”（Volga）项目下与欧洲工业界联合研制推力达200吨的可重复使用分级燃烧甲烷发动机。2006年，该公司开始为俄罗斯<<M2>>可重复使用航天助推器研制代号为<<M1>>的可重复使用发动机。

s: Between 2002 and 2005, KBKhA teamed up with European industry to develop a reusable staged combustion methane engine with a thrust of 200 tons under the Volga project. In 2006, the company started work on a reusable engine designated RD-0162 for the Russian MRKS-1 reusable space booster. RD-0164 is higher thrust variant of that engine.
zh: 在2002年至2005年间，<<M0>>在“伏尔加”（Volga）项目下与欧洲工业界联合研制推力达200吨的可重复使用分级燃烧甲烷发动机。2006年，该公司开始为俄罗斯<<M2>>可重复使用航天助推器研制代号为<<M1>>的可重复使用发动机。<<M3>>是该发动机的大推力改型。

s: Between 2002 and 2005, KBKhA teamed up with European industry to develop a reusable staged combustion methane engine with a thrust of 200 tons under the Volga project. In 2006, the company started work on a reusable engine designated RD-0162 for the Russian MRKS-1 reusable space booster. RD-0169 is an upper stage derivative of that engine.
zh: 在2002年至2005年间，<<M0>>在“伏尔加”（Volga）项目下与欧洲工业界联合研制推力达200吨的可重复使用分级燃烧甲烷发动机。2006年，该公司开始为俄罗斯<<M2>>可重复使用航天助推器研制代号为<<M1>>的可重复使用发动机。<<M3>>是该发动机的上面级衍生型号。

s: An atmospheric booster engine used from the 1980s to present, the RD-170 is the most powerful liquid rocket engine ever flown. Originally developed for the Energia launcher's boosters, the engine consists of four combustion chambers fed by a single turbopump. A modified version, the RD-171, is used on the first stage of the Zenit launch vehicle.
zh: 一款从20世纪80年代沿用至今的大气助推器发动机，<<M0>>是有史以来实际飞行过的推力最大的液体火箭发动机。该发动机最初为“能源”号运载火箭的助推器研制，由单台涡轮泵向四个燃烧室供油。其改进型号<<M1>>被用于“天顶”号运载火箭的第一级。

s: A further continuation of the RD-170/171 series, featuring a single combustion chamber and nozzle. The RD-191 powers the Angara family of launchers, while the RD-151 was used on the Naro-1 launch vehicle and the RD-181 will be used on the Antares 200-series.
zh: <<M0>>/171系列的进一步延续型号，采用单燃烧室和单喷管设计。<<M1>>为安加拉系列运载火箭提供动力，<<M2>>曾用于<<M3>>运载火箭，而<<M4>>将用于安塔瑞斯200系列。

s: The first multi-chamber engine developed by Glushko. After Glushko's attempts to scale up existing engines for what would become the R-7 resulted in unresolvable combustion instability (RD-105/106), Glushko instead combined multiple chambers of his ED-140 engine into one to increase thrust. The result, the RD-200, proved successful and, although it never flew, its design formed the basis of the RD-107/108 and RD-214.
zh: 格鲁什科开发的第一款多燃烧室发动机。格鲁什科曾尝试放大现有发动机以用于后来的<<M0>>，但导致了无法解决的燃烧不稳定问题（<<M1>>/106），因此他改为将多个<<M2>>发动机燃烧室组合在一起来提升推力。成果即是<<M3>>，该设计被证明是成功的，尽管从未升空飞行，但其设计构成了<<M4>>/108和<<M5>>的基础。

s: A staged combustion hypergolic rocket engine. Used as a power plant on the first stage of the UR-200 rocket, with 3 RD-0203s and 1 RD-0204 forming a RD-0202 engine module. Features a two-axis gimbal mechanism for attitude control.
zh: 一款分级燃烧自燃推进剂火箭发动机。用作<<M0>>火箭第一级的动力装置，由3台<<M1>>和1台<<M2>>组成<<M3>>发动机模块。具备双轴万向节机构以用于姿态控制。

s: An early Soviet four combustion chamber rocket. Developed from the RD-100 for the R-12 IRBM in the mid 1950s, it provided a significant increase in power over earlier Soviet engines. It was later used for the Kosmos-2 launch vehicle.
zh: 苏联早期研发的四燃烧室火箭发动机。由<<M0>>发展而来，于1950年代中期用于<<M1>>中程弹道导弹，相比苏联早期的发动机提供了显著的动力提升。后来用于宇宙-2号运载火箭。

s: A staged combustion, hypergolic vacuum rocket engine. Used as the power plant on the second stage of the UR-200, and third stage of UR-500/Proton launch vehicle family. Features four integrated vernier engines for three-axis attitude control.
zh: 一款分级燃烧自燃推进剂真空火箭发动机。用作<<M0>>第二级以及<<M1>>/质子号运载火箭家族第三级的动力装置。配备四台集成式游标发动机以提供三轴姿态控制。

s: A staged combustion engine found on the second stage of the UR-200 and third stage of the UR-500/Proton series launcher. It is fixed, and requires its accompanying vernier module for 3-axis control. It uses UDMH & NTO for propellant.
zh: 用于<<M0>>第二级和<<M1>>/质子号系列运载火箭第三级的分级燃烧发动机。该发动机为固定安装，需要搭配专用游标模块来实现三轴控制。使用偏二甲肼与四氧化二氮推进剂。

s: A Soviet dual chamber gas generator engine. It was designed in the late 1950s to use storable propellants for ICBMs because the cryogenic propellants in the current R-7 could not be stored for long periods, requiring lengthy fueling before launch. It was used in clusters of up to three in many Soviet ICBMs, and later in the Kosmos and Tsiklon launch vehicles.
zh: 苏联的双燃烧室燃气发生器循环发动机。设计于1950年代后期，旨在为洲际弹道导弹使用可贮存推进剂，因为当时<<M0>>采用的低温推进剂无法长时间贮存，发射前需要耗费漫长时间加注。它以最多三台并联的方式应用于多种苏联洲际弹道导弹，后来又用于宇宙号和旋风号运载火箭。

s: A staged combustion hypergolic rocket engine. It was used as a power plant on the first stage of the UR-100 rocket, with 3 RD-0216s and 1 RD-0217 forming a 15D2 engine module. Features a two-axis gimbal mechanism for attitude control. It was later modified into an upper stage engine for the UR-100N, and proposed as an upper stage engine for the UR-700/LK-700 complex.
zh: 一款分级燃烧自燃推进剂火箭发动机。曾用作<<M0>>火箭第一级的动力装置，由3台<<M1>>和1台<<M2>>组成15D2发动机模块。配备双轴万向节机构用于姿态控制。后来被改装为用于<<M3>>的上面级发动机，并曾提议作为<<M4>>/<<M5>>综合体的上面级发动机。

s: A Soviet dual chamber gas generator engine. Designed in the late 1950s to use storable propellants for ICBMs because the cryogenic propellants in the current R-7 could not be stored for long periods, requiring lengthy fuelling before launch. It was used on the R-16 and R-36 ICBMs, and Tsiklon-2 and Tsiklon-3 LVs.
zh: 苏联的双燃烧室燃气发生器循环发动机。设计于1950年代末，旨在为洲际弹道导弹使用可贮存推进剂，因为当时<<M0>>采用的低温推进剂无法长期贮存，发射前需要冗长的加注过程。曾用于<<M1>>和<<M2>>洲际弹道导弹，以及旋风-2号和旋风-3号运载火箭。

s: An early Soviet hypergolic staged combustion vacuum engine. Designed for the second stage of the enormous R-20 project, versions were designed using Nitric Acid or Liquid Oxygen as an oxidizer, with UDMH as fuel. Although it was never used, it formed the basis of the much more successful RD-253 used on Proton.
zh: 苏联早期的自燃推进剂分级燃烧真空发动机。为庞大的<<M0>>工程第二级而设计，研发了使用硝酸或液氧作为氧化剂、以偏二甲肼为燃料的多个版本。尽管从未实际使用，但它为质子号上极为成功的<<M1>>奠定了基础。

s: A staged combustion upper stage engine module developed for the R-36M second stage. It consists of an RD-0229 main engine and RD-0230 vernier engine. The R-36M2 used an upgraded version of the engine known as the RD-0255.
zh: 为<<M0>>第二级研制的分级燃烧上面级发动机模块。它由一台<<M1>>主发动机和一台<<M2>>游标发动机组成。<<M3>>采用了该发动机的升级型号，即<<M4>>。

s: A staged combustion upper stage engine developed for the R-36M second stage. This engine cannot gimbal, and should be paired with a set of RD-0230 verniers. The R-36M2 used an upgraded version of the engine known as the RD-0256.
zh: 为<<M0>>第二级研制的分级燃烧上面级发动机。该发动机无法使用万向节摆动，需与一组<<M1>>游标发动机搭配使用。<<M2>>采用了该发动机的升级型号，即<<M3>>。

s: A staged combustion booster engine developed for the UR-100N. The RD-0234 was identical, other than the addition of pressurization equipment. Three RD-0233s and one RD-0234 powered the first stage of the UR-100N, UR-100NU, Strela and Rokot.
zh: 为<<M0>>研制的分级燃烧助推器发动机。除增加了增压设备外，<<M1>>与其实际相同。三台<<M2>>和一台<<M1>>共同为<<M0>>、<<M3>>、箭号和呼啸号的第一级提供动力。

s: Staged combustion booster engine module. Developed as the first stage engine of the R-29RM Submarine-Launched Ballistic Missile, the RD-0243 consists of an RD-0244 main engine and RD-0245 vernier engine. In order to save space, the engine is submerged within the fuel tank of the R-29RM, with the rear bulkhead of the missile welded to the engine nozzle. Also used on the Shtil' launch vehicle, a unique smallsat launcher capable of being deployed from Delta IV submarines.
zh: 分级燃烧助推器发动机模块。作为<<M0>>潜射弹道导弹的第一级发动机研制，<<M1>>由一台<<M2>>主发动机和一台<<M3>>游标发动机组成。为节省空间，发动机浸没安装在<<M0>>的燃料贮箱内，导弹尾部舱壁直接与发动机喷管焊接。该发动机还用于静海号运载火箭——一种能够从德尔塔IV级潜艇发射的独特微小型卫星运载器。

s: A Soviet hypergolic staged combustion engine. Developed as part of an initiative to build a 150-ton-thrust booster engine for the N1, versions were created burning nitric acid, NTO, or LOX with UDMH. Although the NK-15 was ultimately selected to power the N1, the RD-253, using NTO, was chosen to power the UR-500/Proton, becoming the workhorse of the Soviet space program.
zh: 苏联自燃推进剂分级燃烧发动机。作为为N1运载火箭建造150吨级推力助推器发动机计划的一部分而研发，制造了分别使用硝酸、四氧化二氮或液氧搭配偏二甲肼燃烧的版本。尽管最终N1选用了<<M0>>作为动力，但采用四氧化二氮的<<M1>>被选为<<M2>>/质子号的动力装置，并成为了苏联航天工程的绝对主力。

s: A Soviet hypergolic staged combustion engine. Developed as part of an initiative to build a 150-ton-thrust vacuum engine for the N1, versions were created burning nitric acid, NTO, or LOX with UDMH. Although the NK-15V was ultimately selected to power the N1, the RD-254, using NTO, was chosen to power the upper stages of the UR-700. The RD-254 was cancelled with the rest of the UR-700 project and never flew.
zh: 苏联自燃推进剂分级燃烧发动机。作为为N1运载火箭建造150吨级推力真空发动机计划的一部分而研发，制造了分别使用硝酸、四氧化二氮或液氧搭配偏二甲肼燃烧的版本。尽管最终N1选用了<<M0>>作为动力，但采用四氧化二氮的<<M1>>被选为<<M2>>的上面级动力装置。<<M1>>随着<<M2>>项目的下马而取消，从未升空飞行。

s: The largest single-chamber engine ever built in the USSR, and the first full-flow staged combustion engine, the RD-270 was fueled by NTO and UDMH combined under some of the highest pressures ever encountered in an ignition chamber. Extensively tested to power the first and second stages of the UR-700, it was cancelled with the rest of the UR-700 project and never flew, despite efforts to convert it to kerosene for the N1.
