Ultimately, the Tu-144 was taken out of service shortly after being upgraded due to costs. The RD-36 powered the Tu-144D and M-17.
zh: <<M0>>是一款20世纪70年代的涡轮喷气发动机，专为<<M1>>提供动力而研制。<<M0>>取代了性能欠佳的<<M2>>发动机，使<<M1>>能够达到预期的航程。最终，出于成本原因，<<M1>>在完成升级后不久便退役。<<M0>>曾用于<<M3>>和<<M4>>。

s: The RD-41 was a lightweight turbojet, designed as an improved version of the RD-36 liftjet for the Yak-141/41M. It was provided with a gimballing engine mount, allowing for 12.5 degrees of deflection to improve stability while hovering. Used as the liftjet on the Yak-141/41M.
zh: <<M0>>是一款轻型涡轮喷气发动机，是为<<M2>>/41M设计的<<M1>>升力发动机的改进版本。它配备了可偏转12.5度的万向节发动机架，以提高悬停时的稳定性。曾用作<<M2>>/41M的升力发动机。

s: The RJ43 was a supersonic ramjet, designed to power the CIM-10 Bomarc surface to air missile at speeds up to Mach 3. It was also used on the X-7 and XQ-5/AQM-60 target drone, and was modified to power the D-21 up to speeds over Mach 3.3.
zh: <<M0>>是一款超音速冲压喷气发动机，设计用于为<<M1>>“波马克”地对空导弹提供动力，最高速度可达3马赫。它还曾用于<<M2>>和<<M3>>/<<M4>>靶机，并经过改装为<<M5>>提供动力，使其速度超过3.3马赫。

s: The unparalleled low density and high strength of carbon composites have long been the siren call of tank design. Ever since the X-33 and Venture Star program of the 1990s was aborted only a few years years before the leaking problems that had killed Venture Star were solved, space companies have been trying to justify the very high cost of composite materials. Although costs continue to drop, the intensive manufacturing process is still very expensive, requiring the wrapping and weaving of hundreds of layers of carbon fiber with resins that are then baked off in massive autoclaves. Currently, the only rocket to use composite materials is the smallsat Electron orbital launcher developed by Rocket Lab.
zh: 碳复合材料无可比拟的低密度与高强度，长期以来一直是储罐设计的诱人目标。自20世纪90年代的<<M0>>与“冒险之星”计划被叫停（而在取消仅数年后，导致其夭折的泄漏难题便被攻克）以来，航天企业一直在设法证明高昂复合材料成本的合理性。尽管成本在持续下降，但其密集制造工艺仍然代价不菲——需要将数百层碳纤维与树脂缠绕编织，随后在巨大的高压釜中固化。目前，唯一使用复合材料的火箭是Rocket Lab研制的小卫星轨道运载火箭“电子号”。

s: Advanced carbon composite tankage, more resistant to cryogenic temperatures, and built using cutting edge construction techniques to maximize strength. Although small technology demonstrators have been made, no launch vehicle has utilized this style of advanced composite tankage.
zh: 先进碳复合材料储罐，具备更优异的耐低温性能，采用尖端制造工艺以实现强度最大化。尽管已有小型技术验证件制成，但尚无运载火箭实际采用此类先进复合材料储罐。

s: Balloon tanks do not have an internal framework, but instead rely on internal pressurization to keep its shape. If the pressurization fails, the balloon tank collapses. They are constructed of very thin sheets of stainless steel and have very good mass fractions, but the logistics involved in maintaining pressurization make them quite expensive. These advanced balloon tanks were first used by the Centaur G upper stage.
zh: 气球储罐没有内部框架，而是依靠内部增压来维持构型。若增压失效，气球储罐就会瘪瘪垮塌。它们由极薄的不锈钢板制成，拥有出色的质量分数，但维持增压所需的后勤保障使其造价高昂。此类先进气球储罐最早应用于半人马座G上面级。

s: Balloon tanks do not have an internal framework, but instead rely on internal pressurization to keep its shape. If the pressurization fails, the balloon tank collapses. They are constructed of very thin sheets of stainless steel and have very good mass fractions, but the logistics involved in maintaining pressurization make them quite expensive. These modern balloon tanks were first used by Centaur III.
zh: 气球储罐没有内部框架，而是依靠内部增压来维持构型。若增压失效，气球储罐就会瘪瘪垮塌。它们由极薄的不锈钢板制成，拥有出色的质量分数，但维持增压所需的后勤保障使其造价高昂。此类现代气球储罐最早应用于半人马座III。

s: You can now use Aluminum Fuselage tanks. Aluminum tank and fuselage construction was first used on the American Viking sounding rocket and then, perplexingly, on the massive Soviet N-1 lunar rocket. These are 40% (standard) or 20% (HP) lighter than steel tanks while costing 5% more to tool and 10% more once tooled.
zh: 您现在可以使用铝制机身储罐。铝制储罐与机身构型最早应用于美国“维京”探空火箭，随后令人费解地用于庞大的苏联<<M0>>登月火箭。这类储罐比钢制储罐轻40%（标准型）或20%（高压型），模具成本高5%，投产后制造成本高10%。

s: You can now use Aluminum Stringer tanks. Longitudinal stringers transfer the aerodynamic loads from the skin to the frame, similar to aircraft design. This combines tank and frame, but the skin of the tank is only responsible for containing the propellant and is not structural. The first rocket of this type of construction was the R-5 and skin-stringer-frame construction has remained a staple of Russian design philosophy, including the R-7 and Proton families. These are 35% (standard) or 20% (HP) lighter than Al fuselage tanks while costing 25% more to tool and 10% more once tooled.
zh: 您现在可以使用铝制桁条储罐。纵向桁条将气动载荷从蒙皮传递至框架，类似于飞机设计。这种结构将储罐与框架融为一体，但储罐蒙皮仅用于容纳推进剂，不承受结构载荷。首枚采用此类结构的火箭是<<M0>>，蒙皮-桁条-框架结构随后一直是俄系设计理念的支柱，包括<<M1>>与“质子”家族。这类储罐比铝制机身储罐轻35%（标准型）或20%（高压型），模具成本高25%，投产后制造成本高10%。

s: You can now use Aluminum-Copper Alloy Stringer tanks. Also known as "Duraluminum", this family of alloys is very strong and as workable as regular aluminum. The most famous use of this construction was in the titanic and powerful S-IC, the first stage of the Saturn V lunar rocket, but it was also used in the early versions of the Shuttle External Tank. These are 25% lighter than Al stringer tanks while costing 20% more to tool and 10% more once tooled.
zh: 您现在可以使用铝铜合金桁条储罐。该合金系列也被称为“硬铝”，强度极高且具备与常规铝相当的可加工性。该结构最著名的应用是土星五号登月火箭体量庞大且推力强劲的S-IC第一级，早期版本的航天飞机外贮箱也有采用。这类储罐比铝制桁条储罐轻25%，模具成本高20%，投产后制造成本高10%。

s: You can now use Aluminum-Lithium Alloy Stringer tanks. Since lithium is the least dense metal, Al-Li alloys are significantly less dense while still being very strong. However, they are more expensive and can be hard to work with. This technology was used for the final version of the Shuttle External Tank, the Super Lightweight Tank. These are 25% (standard) or 45% (HP) lighter than refined Al stringer tanks while costing 25% more to tool and once tooled.
zh: 您现在可以使用铝锂合金桁条储罐。由于锂是密度最低的金属，铝锂合金在保持极高强度的同时密度显著降低。然而，该材料造价更高且加工难度较大。这项技术曾用于航天飞机外贮箱的最终版本——超轻型外贮箱（SLWT）。这类储罐比精炼铝桁条储罐轻25%（标准型）或45%（高压型），模具成本与投产后制造成本均高25%。

s: You can now use stir-welded Aluminum-Lithium Alloy Stringer tanks. Friction stir welding uses heat from the friction of rotating tool to soften and intermix two pieces of metal for very strong welds. A completely stir-welded tank was first used on the Falcon 1e and then on Falcon 9. This allows for fewer structural components and lighter welds, thus, cheaper and lighter tanks, especially at high pressures. These are 6% (standard) or 15% (HP) lighter than Al-Li stringer tanks while costing 20% less to tool and 15% less once tooled.
zh: 您现在可以使用搅拌摩擦焊铝锂合金桁条储罐。搅拌摩擦焊利用旋转工具的摩擦热软化并熔合两块金属，形成极高强度的焊缝。全搅拌摩擦焊储罐最早应用于猎鹰1e，随后用于猎鹰9号。该工艺减少了结构部件并降低了焊缝重量，从而让储罐更便宜、更轻盈（尤其在高压工况下）。这类储罐比铝锂合金桁条储罐轻6%（标准型）或15%（高压型），模具成本低20%，投产后制造成本低15%。

s: You can now use stir-welded Steel Alloy Stringer tanks. This is the all-new 1950's technology that will be used by SpaceX's Starship vehicle & Superheavy booster. These are 24% (standard) or 70% (HP) heavier than refined Al-Li stringer tanks while costing 20% less to tool and once tooled.
zh: 您现在可以使用搅拌摩擦焊合金钢桁条储罐。这项“源自20世纪50年代的全新技术”将被<<M0>>的星舰飞船与超重型助推器所采用。这类储罐比精炼铝锂合金桁条储罐重24%（标准型）或70%（高压型），模具成本与投产后制造成本均低20%。

s: You can now use Aluminum gridded tanks. Isogrids and orthogrids are advanced hollowed-out structures milled out of a single block of material that have very high rigidity yet exceptional material and mass savings. The delicate & complex lattices on the panel require very high precision machining and thus such a construction is much more expensive to produce than more standard tanks. Nevertheless, gridded tanks have been utilized by nearly every NASA orbital vehicle since the very first to use gridded aluminum construction: the Thor/Delta and Titan rockets as well as the Agena upper stage.
zh: 您现在可以使用铝制网格筋储罐。等网格筋与正交网格筋是由整块材料铣削而成的先进镂空结构，在具备极高刚度的同时实现了非凡的材料与质量节省。面板上精细复杂的晶格需要极高精度的机械加工，因此该结构的制造成本远高于常规储罐。尽管如此，自首批采用铝制网格筋结构的雷神/德尔塔、泰坦火箭以及阿金纳上面级以来，NASA几乎所有入轨航天器均采用了网格筋储罐。

s: You can now use Aluminum-Copper Alloy gridded tanks. Stronger than unalloyed aluminum and workable to boot, advanced new Al-Cu alloys were used in orthogrid and isogrid tanks for all upper stages of the Saturn program. These are 25% (standard) or 10% (HP) lighter than Al gridded tanks while costing 50% more to tool and 10% more once tooled.
zh: 您现在可以使用铝铜合金网格筋储罐。先进的新型铝铜合金强度高于纯铝，且易于加工，曾用于土星计划所有上面级的正交网格筋与等网格筋储罐。这类储罐比铝制网格筋储罐轻25%（标准型）或10%（高压型），模具成本高50%，投产后制造成本高10%。

s: Upgraded RD-0120 for Vulkan and later Energia versions. Used a nozzle insert to increase sea level performance, which would then be ejected at altitude. Proposed to power Angara after the cancellation of Energia.
zh: 为“火神”（Vulkan）及后续“能源”（Energia）改型设计的升级版<<M0>>。采用喷管内嵌衬套以提高海平面性能，升空后将其抛弃。在“能源”号取消后曾被提议用于为“安加拉”（Angara）火箭提供动力。

s: Demonstrator for a throttlable engine, based on the RL10A-3-3. It was intended to be used for the Lunar Applications of a Spent S-IVB Stage (LASS) program to use modified S-IVB stages as heavy lunar landers.
zh: 基于<<M0>>-3-3的可节流发动机技术验证机。原计划用于“S-IVB废弃级月球应用”（LASS）项目，将改装后的S-IVB级作为重型月球着陆器使用。

s: RL10A-3-3A modified to operate with an O/F ratio of 6.0 for Shuttle-Centaur. This reduces performance, but increases the average propellant density, allowing for greater fuel load in the Shuttle cargo bay.
zh: 为“航天飞机-半人马座”改型的<<M0>>-3-3A，氧化剂/燃料混合比调整为6.0。这降低了比冲性能，但提高了推进剂平均密度，从而允许在航天飞机有效载荷舱内加注更多燃料。

s: This config represents the RL-10A-4-1 and RL-10A-4-2 variants. Reworked turbopumps and improved performance for usage in a single & dual engine configuration on Atlas II & Atlas III & single engine configuration on Atlas V.
zh: 该构型代表<<M0>>与<<M1>>变体。改进了涡轮泵并提升了性能，适用于“擎天神 II”和“擎天神 III”的单发及双机构型，以及“擎天神 V”的单机构型。

s: Upgrade used for the R-17MU, A.K.A Scud-D. It saw very little use in the Soviet Union due to mediocore performance, so the remaining missiles were sold to North Korea, providing the basis for North Korean missile development.
zh: 用于<<M0>>（即飞毛腿-D）的升级版本。由于性能平平，在苏联几乎没有服役，剩余导弹被出售给朝鲜，为朝鲜的导弹研制奠定了基础。

s: Isayev improved Wasserfall engine used in Soviet R-101B/V/E anti-aircraft missile prototype. Development abandoned in favor of Isayev S09.19A, but was later repurposed for the R-11 (Scud) ballistic missile as the S2.253.
zh: 伊萨耶夫为苏联<<M0>>/V/E防空导弹原型机改进的“瀑布”（Wasserfall）发动机。该项目后来被放弃，转而采用伊萨耶夫S09.19A，但随后作为S2.253重新用于<<M1>>（飞毛腿）弹道导弹。

s: A two-person pod. Features an offset Center of Mass to allow lifting reentry and an integrated bi-propellant Attitude Control System (ACS) for controlled reentries. Heat shield rated for LEO reentries.
zh: 双人乘员舱。具备偏置质心以实现升力式再入，并集成了双组元姿态控制系统（ACS）以实现受控再入。防热盾额定承受LEO再入热流。

s: The final version of the J-2 that flew on the Saturn, the 230k variant flew starting with Apollo 8, SA-208 and all subsequent flights.
zh: 土星运载火箭所用<<M0>>的最终型号，230k构型自阿波罗8号开始使用，涵盖<<M1>>及后续所有飞行任务。

s: J93-GE-3, as used on the XB-70. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 3.35.

Small solid fueled booster originally used to power anti-shipping missiles during WW2. Used as the kick stage on the WAC Corporal, the USA's first sounding rocket, and reused in modified form for the Aerobee line of sounding rockets.
zh: 小型固体燃料助推器，最初在二战期间用于反舰导弹。后作为美国第一型探空火箭“下士WAC”的起飞助推级，并在改进后重新用于“艾比”（Aerobee）系列探空火箭。

s: AL-31F, as used on the Su-27, Su-30M/MKI, and J-11A. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.7.
zh: <<M0>>，用于<<M1>>、<<M2>>/MKI以及<<M3>>。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.7。

s: AL-31FM with thrust vectoring, as used on the Su-27SM, Su-30 and Su-34. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.7.
zh: 带推力矢量的<<M0>>，用于<<M1>>、<<M2>>和<<M3>>。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.7。

s: Simple steel tank and fuselage designs were used only on very early rockets such as the German V-2 and its American and Soviet clones. Tank and fuselage tankage is no more advanced than that used in the construction of early airplanes.
zh: 简易钢制储箱与机身设计仅用于极早期的火箭，例如德国的<<M0>>及其美苏仿制品。这种储箱与机身结构的先进程度不高于早期飞机的制造水平。

s: AL-41F-1S with thrust vectoring, as used in the Su-35 and Su-30SM2. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.67.
zh: 带推力矢量的<<M0>>，用于<<M1>>和<<M2>>。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.67。

s: Early afterburning AL-7, as used on the Su-7. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.48.
zh: 早期加力型<<M0>>，用于<<M1>>。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.48。

s: Afterburning AL-7, as used on Su-7B/BM/BMK and Su-9. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.75.
zh: 加力型<<M0>>，用于<<M1>>/BM/BMK和<<M2>>。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.75。

s: Afterburning AL-7, used on Tu-128 and Su-11. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.74.
zh: 加力型<<M0>>，用于<<M1>>和<<M2>>。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.74。

s: Early Atar 09, as used on the Mirage IIIA. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.62.
zh: 早期阿塔09（Atar 09），用于幻影IIIA。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.62。

s: Ultimate Atar 09, as used on the Mirage 5S, Mirage 50, Mirage IVA/P/R, and Mirage F1C. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.79.
zh: 终极阿塔09（Atar 09），用于幻影5S、幻影50、幻影IVA/P/R和幻影F1C。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.79。

s: Aluminum alloy skin-stringer-frame construction is nothing new to the aerospace industry and is the preferred construction of large aircraft today. Longitudinal stringers are responsible for transferring the aerodynamic loads acting on the skin onto the frame. This method of construction does not have mechanically separate tanks and frame, but the skin of the tank is only responsible for containing the propellant and is not load-bearing. The first rocket of skin-stringer-frame construction was the Soviet R-5 and has remained a staple of Russian design philosophy since, best exemplified in the very successful R-7 family.
zh: 铝合金蒙皮-桁条-隔框结构在航空航天工业中早已屡见不鲜，是当今大型飞机的首选结构。纵向桁条负责将作用在蒙皮上的气动载荷传递到隔框上。这种结构没有机械独立的储箱与框体，但储箱蒙皮仅用于盛装推进剂而不承受载荷。第一型采用蒙皮-桁条-隔框结构的火箭是苏联的<<M0>>，此后一直成为俄罗斯设计理念的核心，最典型的代表就是极为成功的<<M1>>家族。

s: Atar 101, as used on the Vautour IA and early Vautour IIB. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 1.99.
zh: 阿塔101（Atar 101），用于秃鹰IA和早期秃鹰IIB。15 km处温度马赫数极限：1.99。

s: Atar 101, as used on the Vautour IIA/B/N, Etendard IV, and as the turbojet half of the Griffon combined cycle ramjet. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.57.
zh: 阿塔101（Atar 101），用于秃鹰IIA/B/N、超军旗IV，以及狮鹫组合循环冲压发动机的涡喷部分。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.57。

s: Avon RA.4 Mk.107. Early Avon, as used on the Hunter Prototype. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.05.
zh: 埃文（Avon）RA.4 Mk.107。早期埃文发动机，用于猎手原型机。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.05。

s: Avon RA.7R Mk.114R. Early afterburning Avon, as used on the Super Mystère B1 and Hunter Mk.3. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.42.
zh: 埃文（Avon）RA.7R Mk.114R。早期加力型埃文发动机，用于超神秘B1和猎手Mk.3。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.42。

s: Improved welding and manufacturing techniques developed in the 1960s allowed the use of more advanced aluminum alloys, containing higher fractions of Magnesium, Manganese, and Copper than their predecessors. The increased alloying makes these alloys slightly difficult to work with, but the increased strength allows for the creation of lighter structures. The most famous use of this construction was in the titanic and powerful S-IC, the first stage of the Saturn V lunar rocket, but it was also used in the early versions of the Shuttle External Tank.
zh: 20世纪60年代发展的先进焊接与制造技术使得采用更先进的铝合金成为可能，与早期合金相比，这些合金含有更高比例的镁、锰和铜。合金化程度的提高使得这些合金加工难度略有增加，但更高的强度使其能够制造更轻质的结构。这种结构最著名的应用是土星五号登月火箭庞大而强劲的S-IC第一级，同时也用于早期的航天飞机外贮箱。

s: Avon RA.24R Mk.200R. Afterburning Avon, as used on the Lightning F.1. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.6.
zh: 埃文（Avon）RA.24R Mk.200R。加力型埃文发动机，用于闪电F.1。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.6。

s: Avon RB.146 Mk.302. Ultimate afterburning Avon, as used on the Lightning F.6. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.8.
zh: 埃文（Avon）RB.146 Mk.302。终极加力型埃文发动机，用于闪电F.6。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.8。

s: Early TF34, as used on the A-10A.
TF34, as used on the S-3B and S-72.
Early CF34, as used on the Challenger 601.
CF34, as used on the Challenger 604/605.

Since lithium is the least dense elemental metal, Al-Li alloys are significantly less dense while being stronger than most other Al alloys. However, they are much more expensive and their metallurgical properties can present great difficulties to work with. Al-Li alloys are commonly used in modern aerospace applications, and all Al-Li skin-stringer construction was used for the final version of the Shuttle External Tank, the Super Lightweight Tank.
zh: 由于锂是密度最低的金属元素，铝锂合金比大多数其他铝合金密度显著更低，同时强度更高。然而，其成本高得多，冶金特性也会带来极大的加工难度。铝锂合金广泛用于现代航空航天领域，航天飞机外贮箱的最终版本——超轻型贮箱（SLWT），就完全采用了铝锂合金蒙皮-桁条结构。

s: CF6-6, as used on the DC-10-10.
CF6-50A, as used on the DC-10-30.
CF6-80A, as used on the A310 and 767.
Early CFM56, A.K.A. F108-CF-102, as used on the E-3D and E-6B.
CFM56, as used on the A320-111/211.
CFM56, as used on the A321-200.
D-18T, as used on the An-125 and An-225.
Afterburning D-30, as used on MiG-31. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 3.35.
zh: 加力型<<M0>>，用于<<M1>>。15 km处温度马赫数极限：3.35。

s: Derwent V RD.7. Centrifugal Nene derivative, as used on Meteor F.4 and Nord 1601. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 1.83.
zh: 德温特V（Derwent V）RD.7。离心式尼恩（Nene）衍生型号，用于流星F.4和诺德1601。15 km处温度马赫数极限：1.83。

s: Improved construction techniques, such as friction stir welding, allow for additional decreases of tank dry mass. Friction stir welding uses heat generated by the friction of rotating tool to soften and mechanically intermixes two pieces of metal. It is used for structures which need very high weld strength, and has broad application in the aerospace industry. Completely stir-welding a semi-stringer-constructed tank was first used by SpaceX on their Falcon 1e and then Falcon 9 series of rockets. This unique construction allows for the use of fewer structural components and lighter welds, resulting in both mass and cost reductions.
zh: 搅拌摩擦焊等改进的制造技术可进一步降低储箱干重。搅拌摩擦焊利用旋转工具摩擦产生的热量使两块金属软化并在机械力作用下混合。它适用于需要极高焊接强度的结构，并在航天工业中有着广泛应用。<<M0>>首次在“猎鹰1e”及随后的“猎鹰9”系列火箭上对半桁条结构储箱进行了全搅拌摩擦焊接。这种独特的结构减少了结构组件并减轻了焊缝质量，从而同时降低了质量和成本。

s: OKB-300 (Tumansky) license-built copy of the Derwent V, used on the Yak-23/25/30 and La-15. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 1.83.
zh: <<M0>>（图曼斯基）特许生产的德温特V仿制品，用于<<M1>>/25/30和<<M2>>。15 km处温度马赫数极限：1.83。

s: Very powerful electric ducted fan. Optimized for 80 m/s airspeed.
zh: 大功率电动涵道风扇。针对80 m/s空速优化。

s: Very powerful electric ducted fan. Optimized for static thrust
zh: 大功率电动涵道风扇。针对静推力优化。

s: Mk.100, used on the Typhoon Tranche 1. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.81.
zh: Mk.100，用于台风第1批次（Tranche 1）。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.81。

s: Mk.101, mildly improved for the Typhoon Tranche 2. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.99.
zh: Mk.101，为台风第2批次（Tranche 2）进行了小幅改进。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.99。

s: Early F100, as used in the F-15A/B. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.8.
zh: 早期<<M0>>，用于<<M1>>/B。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.8。

s: Isogrids and orthogrids are advanced hollowed-out structures milled out of a single block of material that have very high rigidity yet exceptional material and mass savings. The delicate & complex lattices on the panel require very high precision machining and thus such a construction is much more expensive to produce than more standard tanks. Nevertheless, gridded tanks have been utilized by nearly every NASA orbital vehicle since the very first to use gridded aluminum construction: Thor/Delta as well as the S-IV and S-IVB upper stage.
zh: 等网格和正交网格结构是由整块材料铣削加工而成的先进掏空结构，具有极高的刚度，同时能大幅节省材料并减轻质量。壁板上精致复杂的网格需要极高精度的加工，因此该结构的制造成本远高于标准储箱。尽管如此，自首次采用网格铝结构的雷神/德尔塔以及S-IV和S-IVB上面级以来，NASA几乎所有的轨道飞行器都采用了网格储箱。

s: Upgrade of F100-PW-100, as used in the F-15C/D/E, F-16C/D Block 25, and YA-7F. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.83.
zh: <<M0>>-<<M1>>的升级型，用于<<M2>>/D/E、<<M3>>/D Block 25和<<M4>>。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.83。

s: F100 redesign with larger, more powerful core, as used in the F-15E/I/S, F-16C/D Block 52/52+, F-16I Block 52, and F-16V Block 70. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.99.
zh: <<M0>>改型，采用更大、更强劲的核心机，用于<<M1>>/I/S、<<M2>>/D Block 52/52+、<<M3>> Block 52以及<<M4>> Block 70。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.99。

s: Improved welding and manufacturing techniques developed in the 1960s allowed the use of more advanced aluminum alloys, containing higher fractions of Magnesium, Manganese, and Copper than their predecessors. The increased alloying makes these alloys slightly difficult to work with, but the increased strength allows for the creation of lighter structures. The S-II stage of the Saturn V used this construction to become the highest performance hydrolox stage of its time.
zh: 20世纪60年代发展的先进焊接与制造技术使得采用更先进的铝合金成为可能，与早期合金相比，这些合金含有更高比例的镁、锰和铜。合金化程度的提高使得这些合金加工难度略有增加，但更高的强度使其能够制造更轻质的结构。土星五号的S-II级就采用了这种结构，成为当时性能最高的液氢液氧级。

s: Modified F100 with thrust vectoring Pitch/Yaw Balance Beam Nozzle for the F-15 ACTIVE technology demonstrator. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.99.
zh: 改进型<<M0>>，配备用于<<M1>> ACTIVE技术验证机的俯仰/偏航平衡梁推力矢量喷管。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.99。

s: F100 Engine Enhancement Package, integrating technology from the F119 and F135 programs, as used in the F-16V Block 70. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 3.11.
zh: <<M0>>发动机增强包（EEP），融合了来自<<M1>>和<<M2>>计划的技术，用于<<M3>> Block 70。15 km处温度马赫数极限：3.11。

s: F119, as used on the F-22A. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.89.
zh: <<M0>>，用于<<M1>>。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.89。

s: F135, as used on the F-35A/C. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 3.11.
zh: <<M0>>，用于<<M1>>/C。15 km处温度马赫数极限：3.11。

s: F135 with gimbal, as used on the F-35B. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 3.11.
zh: 带万向节的<<M0>>，用于<<M1>>。15 km处温度马赫数极限：3.11。

s: Early F404, as used in F/A-18A/B. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.79.
zh: 早期<<M0>>，用于F/<<M1>>/B。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.79。

s: Since lithium is the least dense elemental metal, Al-Li alloys are significantly less dense while being stronger than most other Al alloys. However, their tendency to work-harden means that machining such alloys is much more difficult than standard alloys. Nevertheless, lightweight Al-Li gridded tanks have been the foundation of the modern era of orbital American rocketry, used in the Atlas V Common Core Booster, the Delta IV Common Booster Core (and DCSS upper stages), the Space Launch System core stage, and the ULA Vulcan rocket.
zh: 由于锂是密度最低的金属元素，铝锂合金比大多数其他铝合金密度显著更低，同时强度更高。然而，其加工硬化倾向意味着机械加工此类合金比标准合金困难得多。尽管如此，轻质铝锂合金网格储箱仍是现代美国轨道运载火箭的基础，应用于“擎天神 V”的通用核心助推器、“德尔塔 IV”的通用助推核心（及DCSS上面级）、太空发射系统（SLS）的核心级以及ULA的“火神”火箭。

s: F404, as used in F/A-18C/D. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.75.
zh: <<M0>>，用于F/<<M1>>/D。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.75。

s: F404 variant developed by Volvo, as used in the JAS-39 Gripen. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.83.
zh: 沃尔沃研发的<<M0>>衍生型号，用于<<M1>>鹰狮。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.83。

s: GE4/J5P afterburning turbojet, intended to power the B2707. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 3.55.
zh: GE4/J5P加力涡轮喷气发动机，原计划用于<<M0>>。15 km处温度马赫数极限：3.55。

s: GEnx, with a smaller fan to allow it to be installed on the B747-8.
zh: GEnx，配备较小的风扇以适配安装于<<M0>>-8。

s: J35, as used on the B-45A and D558-1. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 1.77.
zh: J35，用于<<M0>>和<<M1>>-1。15 km处温度马赫数极限：1.77。

s: J35, as used on the F-84D, XF4D-1, and X-5. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 1.76.
J47 with water injection, as used on the RB-45C. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 1.68.
zh: 带注水系统的J47，用于<<M0>>。15 km处温度马赫数极限：1.68。

s: J47, as used on the F-86E/F. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 1.62.
zh: J47，用于<<M0>>/F。15 km处温度马赫数极限：1.62。

s: Late J47 with water injection, as used on the B-47E. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 1.84.
zh: 带注水系统的后期J47，用于<<M0>>。15 km处温度马赫数极限：1.84。

s: Early afterburning J48, as used in the F-94C. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 1.81.
zh: 早期加力型J48，用于<<M0>>。15 km处温度马赫数极限：1.81。

s: Afterburning J48, as used in the F9F-6 and most F9F-7s (F-9F and F-9H). Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 1.99.
zh: 加力型J48，用于F9F-6和大多数F9F-7（<<M0>>和<<M1>>）。15 km处温度马赫数极限：1.99。

s: Early J57 with water injection, as used on the XB-52 and XB-60. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.18.
zh: 带注水系统的早期J57，用于<<M0>>和<<M1>>。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.18。

s: Early afterburning J57, as used on the F4D and F5D. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.01.
zh: 早期加力型J57，用于F4D和F5D。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.01。

s: Afterburning J57, as used on the F100C/D/F. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.45.
zh: 加力型J57，用于F100C/D/F。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.45。

s: J57 with high-altitude nozzle, as used on the U-2A. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.44.
zh: 配备高空喷管的J57，用于<<M0>>。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.44。

s: J57 with water injection, as used on the B-52E/F. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.48.
zh: 带注水系统的J57，用于<<M0>>/F。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.48。

s: Civilian J57 with water injection, as used on the B707-120 and DC-8-10. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.48.
zh: 民用注水型J57，用于<<M0>>-120和<<M1>>。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.48。

s: Afterburning J57, as used on the F-8E/J. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.5.
zh: 加力型J57，用于<<M0>>/J。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.5。

s: Ultimate afterburning J57, remanufactured J57-P-20 as used on upgraded F-8H/J. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.58.
zh: 终极加力型J57，由J57-<<M0>>再制造，用于升级后的<<M1>>/J。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.58。

s: JT11D-20, as used on the SR-71A/B and YF-12A. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 3.6.
J58, uprated for NASA to allow for increased payload. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 3.75.
zh: J58，为NASA提升推力以增加有效载荷。15 km处温度马赫数极限：3.75。

s: J75, as used on the F-106A/B. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.65.
zh: J75，用于<<M0>>/B。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.65。

s: J75, as used on the F-105B. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.65.
zh: J75，用于<<M0>>。15 km处温度马赫数极限：2.65。

s: The RJ55 was a combined cycle ramjet, mated to a J67. At low speeds, the RJ55 functioned as an afterburner for the J67 turbojet, but at mach 2.24 the turbojet would be shut down and the RJ55 would power the aircraft up to Mach 3. Designed for the XF-103, but difficuties with the J67 turbojet meant the prototype never flew under it's own power.
zh: <<M0>> 是一种组合循环冲压发动机，与 J67 配合使用。在低速时，<<M0>> 作为 J67 涡喷发动机的加力燃烧室工作；但在 2.24 马赫时涡喷发动机会关闭，由 <<M0>> 驱动飞机加速至 3 马赫。专为 <<M1>> 设计，但 J67 涡喷发动机的技术困难导致原型机从未依靠自身动力飞行过。

s: The RJ59 was a supersonic ramjet, designed to power the Convair Super Hustler. Although the Super Hustler was cancelled, the RJ59 was fitted to the X-7 for testing, where it was able to achieve speeds over Mach 4.
zh: <<M0>> 是一种超音速冲压发动机，设计用于为康维尔“超级骗子”（Super Hustler）提供动力。尽管超级骗子项目被取消，但 <<M0>> 被安装在 <<M1>> 上进行测试，并在测试中达到了超过 4 马赫的速度。

s: The WS-10 is a modern low-bypass afterburning turbofan, and the first successful Chinese turbofan design. Developed from the earlier experimental WS-6 turbofan, the WS-10 was designed to replace the Russian AL-31 engines used in some Chinese aircraft. The WS-10 powers the J-8II, J-10B/C, J-11B, J-15, J-16, and J-20/A.
zh: <<M0>> 是一款现代低涵道比加力涡扇发动机，也是中国首款成功研制的涡扇发动机。由早期的试验性 <<M1>> 涡扇发动机发展而来，<<M0>> 旨在替代部分中国飞机上使用的俄罗斯 <<M2>> 发动机。<<M0>> 为 <<M3>>、<<M4>>/C、<<M5>>, <<M6>>、<<M7>> 和 <<M8>>/A 提供动力。

s: The Atar 101 was one of the first jet engines developed in France following WW2. It was used in many early French jet aircraft, including the Vautour I/II, Gerfaut I, and Mystère II. This is the 101D, an early model used in the Dassault Mystère IIC. Available 1954. Thrust 29.42kN. OPR 4.5, SFC 1.09 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 1.5.
zh: 阿塔（Atar）101 是二战后法国研制的最早的喷气发动机之一。它被用于许多早期的法国喷气式飞机，包括秃鹰 I/II、苍鹰 I 和神秘 II。这是 101D 型，是达索神秘 IIC 上使用的早期型号。1954 年可用。推力 29.42 kN。总压比 4.5，静态比油耗 1.09 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制 1.5 马赫。

s: The Derwent V, rather than being a development of the Derwent line (a straight-through-flow development of the W.2), was instead a scaled-down Nene. It powered the Meteor F.4, and also the La-15, Yak-23 and Yak-25 as the RD-500, a Soviet-built copy. Thrust 15.6kN. Available in mid-late 1945. OPR 4.0, SFC 1.03 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 1.
zh: 德温特 V（Derwent V）并非德温特系列（W.2 的平直通流改型）的衍生产品，而是内恩（Nene）发动机的缩小型。它为流星 F.4 提供动力，其苏联仿制型号 <<M3>> 则为 <<M0>>、<<M1>> 和 <<M2>> 提供动力。推力 15.6 kN。1945 年中后期可用。总压比 4.0，静态比油耗 1.03 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制 1 马赫。

s: The Allison/General Electric J35 is an axial flow turbojet, and one of the first turbojets natively designed in the United States. Although not as well known as it's later derivative, the J47, it still powered many late 40s aircraft such as the FJ-1, F-84, F-89, XP-86, XB-45, XB-47, X-5, and D-558. This is the -11, as used on the Douglas D-558-1. Available 1946. Thrust 16.68kN. 4.0 OPR, SFC of 1.12lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 1.
zh: 艾里逊/通用电气 J35 是一款轴流式涡喷发动机，也是美国本土设计的最早的涡喷发动机之一。尽管不如其后来的衍生型号 J47 知名，但它仍为 40 年代后期的许多飞机提供动力，例如 <<M0>>、<<M1>>、<<M2>>、<<M3>>、<<M4>>、<<M5>>、<<M6>> 和 <<M7>>。这是 -11 型，用于道格拉斯 <<M8>>。1946 年可用。推力 16.68 kN。总压比 4.0，静态比油耗 1.12 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制 1 马赫。

s: The General Electric J47 is an axial flow turbojet, developed from the J35 in parallel with centrifugal flow jets based on British designs. The J47 was very successful, used on many early 50s aircraft, including the F-86, FJ-2, XF-87, XF-91, B-36, B-45, B-47, XB-51, KB-50, KB-97, and even the M-497 jet-powered railcar. This is the -27, a later model used in the F-86F. Available 1952. Thrust 26.47 kN. 5.5 OPR, SFC of 0.902lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 1.
zh: 通用电气 J47 是一款轴流式涡喷发动机，由 J35 改进而来，与基于英国设计的离心式喷气发动机并行发展。J47 非常成功，广泛用于 50 年代初期的许多飞机，包括 <<M0>>、<<M1>>、<<M2>>、<<M3>>、<<M4>>、<<M5>>、<<M6>>、<<M7>>、<<M8>>、<<M9>>，甚至还有 <<M10>> 喷气动力轨道车。这是 -27 型，是用于 <<M11>> 的后期型号。1952 年可用。推力 26.47 kN。总压比 5.5，静态比油耗 0.902 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制 1 马赫。

s: A Soviet-built derivative of the Nene. The British government sold several Nene and Derwent engines to the Soviet Union in 1946, which were then reverse engineered, and used in many early Soviet jet aircraft, including the MiG-15, MiG-17, and Il-28. The VK-1 was an improved version, used in the MiG-15bis. Available 1949. Thrust 26.47 kN. 4.4 OPR, SFC 1.049 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 1.
zh: 内恩（Nene）发动机的苏联仿制衍生型号。英国政府于 1946 年向苏联出售了数台内恩和德温特发动机，随后苏联对其进行逆向工程，并用于许多早期的苏联喷气式飞机，包括 <<M0>>、<<M1>> 和 <<M2>>。<<M3>> 是其改进型号，用于 <<M4>>。1949 年可用。推力 26.47 kN。总压比 4.4，静态比油耗 1.049 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制 1 马赫。

s: Monolithic "mixing-head" injector engine. Improved thrust, decreased weight, and storable fuel mixture consisting of explosives grade acid and coal tar distillate. The combustion instability issues of this design were never resolved, although a subscale version was used as the basis for the "Wasserfall" anti-aircraft missile.
zh: 整体式“混合头”喷注器发动机。提升了推力，减轻了重量，并使用由炸药级硝酸和煤焦油馏分组成的可贮存燃料混合物。该设计的燃烧不稳定问题从未得到解决，但其缩比版本被用作“瀑布”（Wasserfall）防空导弹的动力基础。

s: Proposed engine for X-15 program, with a recirculation valve to allow operation at ~60% throttle. Limited throttle capability and starts, but much lighter, cheaper, and more reliable than other options.
zh: 为 <<M0>> 计划提议的发动机，带有再循环阀，允许在约 60% 节流阀开度下运行。节流阀调节能力和启动次数有限，但比其他方案更轻、更便宜且更可靠。

s: Maximum possible thrust for H-1 design, proposed for a post-Apollo uprated Saturn IB. Although engines were tested at increased thrust levels, the end of Apollo and selection of Titan III over Saturn IB meant this was never developed further.
zh: <<M0>> 设计的最大可能推力型号，提议用于后阿波罗时代的土星 IB 改型。尽管发动机在更高推力水平下进行了测试，但阿波罗计划的结束以及选用大力神 III 而非土星 IB，导致该型号未能进一步开发。

s: Enhanced H-1 design, featuring an enlarged, tap-off cycle turbopump and simplified components to increase thrust and reduce cost. Intended to power the Saturn-II and later versions of the Saturn-I, but development was cancelled due to satisfactory performance of the H-1 at increased thrust levels.
zh: 增强型 <<M0>> 设计，采用扩大的分流循环涡轮泵和简化部件，以增加推力并降低成本。原本打算为土星 II 和土星 I 的后续版本提供动力，但由于 <<M0>> 在更高推力水平下的性能令人满意，该研发被取消。

s: Further refinement of the HG-3 engine, taking into account developements with the RL-10 and RS-25. Run time and reliability are extended compared to original models, although turbopump throughput is decreased to reduce strain on engine components.
zh: <<M0>> 发动机的进一步改进型号，吸收了 <<M1>> 和 <<M2>> 的研制经验。与原始型号相比延长了工作时间和可靠性，但降低了涡轮泵流量以减少发动机部件的应力。

s: Sea-level variant of HG-3B upgrade. Increased specific impulse compared to other sea-level variants prior to B version development results in slightly higher thrust for the same level of turbopump throughput as the HG-3B vacuum engine.
zh: <<M0>> 升级型号的海平面改型。与 B 版本开发前的其他海平面改型相比，提高了比冲，在与 <<M0>> 真空发动机相同的涡轮泵流量下获得了略高的推力。

s: Modified version of HG-3B, running the turbopumps harder to generate the same level of mass flow as in previous models. This results in improved thrust compared to the normal B model, at the cost of slightly less reliability in comparison.
zh: <<M0>> 的改进版本，通过加大涡轮泵转速来产生与早期型号相同的质量流量。与普通 B 型相比提高了推力，但相对代价是可靠性略有下降。

s: The J-2S (J-2 Simplified) was a improvement on the J-2 Engine. It was completely tested and logged more than 30,000 seconds of static fire before the program was terminated. Five minutes minimum between restarts.
zh: <<M0>>（<<M1>> 简化版）是 <<M1>> 发动机的改进型。在项目终止前已完成全部测试，并记录了超过 30,000 秒的静止试车时间。两次重启之间至少需要间隔五分钟。

s: GE4/J6H turbojet, designed after tests revealed the afterburners of the GE4 would make the 2707 too loud to use most airports. The revised engine has slightly superior performance, but is much heavier. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 3.56.
zh: GE4/J6H 涡喷发动机，在测试显示 GE4 的加力燃烧室会使 2707 噪音过大而无法在大多数机场使用后设计。改进后的发动机性能略有提升，但重量大幅增加。15 km 处的温度马赫极限：3.56。

s: Simplified design for the H-IIA. Lower cost and better reliability, at the cost of lower performance. Intended to have a nozzle extension, but it had to be removed due to unexpected combustion instability issues.
zh: 用于 H-IIA 的简化设计。以牺牲部分性能为代价，换取更低的成本和更高的可靠性。原本计划配备喷管延伸段，但由于意料之外的燃烧不稳定问题而不得不将其移除。

s: AJ23-139, First stage engine for Titan 24B, 34B, IIIBS, IIID, 34D, 34D7 and IIIE. Modified to light in midair, since the UA120x boosters used by Titan III could lift Titan without assistance. Ignited just before booster burnout.
zh: <<M0>>-139，大力神 24B、34B、IIIBS、IIID、34D、34D7 和 IIIE 的第一级发动机。经改装可在空中点火，因为大力神 III 使用的 <<M1>> 助推器无需协助即可推起大力神火箭。在助推器燃尽前点火。

s: Uprated XLR43 for later Navaho applications. First US engine to use tubular wall, aka spaghetti, thrust chamber which greatly reduced weight. Also first to use a gas generator, removing the need for HTP to power the turbopump.
zh: 用于后期“纳瓦霍”（Navaho）计划的增推型 <<M0>>。美国第一款采用管状内壁（即意大利面式）推力室的发动机，大幅减轻了重量。也是第一款使用燃气发生器的发动机，消除了对驱动涡轮泵的高浓度过氧化氢（HTP）的需求。

s: You can now use Aluminum-Lithium Alloy gridded tanks. Since lithium is the least dense metal, Al-Li alloys are significantly less dense while still being very strong. However, their tendency to work-harden makes them more difficult to machine. These tanks are common in modern American rocketry, used in the Atlas V Common Core Booster, the Delta IV, the SLS core stage, and Vulcan. These are 5% (standard) or 18% (HP) lighter than refined Al gridded tanks while costing 10% more to tool and 15% more once tooled.
zh: 你现在可以使用铝锂合金网格储罐。由于锂是密度最低的金属，铝锂合金在保持极高强度的同时显著降低了密度。然而，其加工硬化倾向使得机械加工更加困难。这类储罐在现代美国火箭中很常见，应用于擎天神5号公共核心助推器、德尔塔4号、SLS核心级以及火神火箭。它们比精炼铝网格储罐轻 5%（标准）或 18%（高压），但模具成本高出 10%，制造单价高出 15%。

s: You can now use Carbon Composite tanks. The low density and high strength of carbon composites have long been the siren call of tank design, ever since the aborted Venture Star program of the 1990s. Costs continue to drop, but the manufacturing process is still very expensive, requiring the wrapping and weaving of hundreds of layers of carbon fiber and baking in massive autoclaves. Currently, the only rocket to use composite tanks is Electron, developed by Rocket Lab. These are 18% lighter than Al-Li gridded tanks while costing 20% more to tool and 17% more once tooled.
zh: 你现在可以使用碳复合材料储罐。自20世纪90年代中止的冒险之星项目以来，碳复合材料的低密度和高强度一直是储罐设计中极具诱惑的目标。成本虽在持续下降，但制造工艺仍然十分昂贵，需要缠绕编织数百层碳纤维并在巨型高压釜中固化。目前唯一采用复合材料储罐的火箭是火箭实验室研发的电子号。它们比铝锂合金网格储罐轻 18%，但模具成本高出 20%，制造单价高出 17%。

s: You can now use Advanced Carbon Composite tanks. Ceramic-metal alloys and insulating complex composite structures are still speculative, but if they ever come to fruition, they'd probably be something like this. These are 40% lighter than composite tanks while costing 33% more to tool and 18% more once tooled.
zh: 你现在可以使用先进碳复合材料储罐。金属陶瓷合金和隔热复杂复合材料结构仍处于前沿探索阶段，但如果它们最终成真，大概会是这个样子。它们比复合材料储罐轻 40%，但模具成本高出 33%，制造单价高出 18%。

s: You can now use Steel & Aluminum balloon tanks. Balloon tanks do not have an internal framework, but instead rely on internal pressurization to keep its shape. If the pressurization fails, the balloon tank collapses. They are constructed of very thin sheets of stainless steel and have very good mass fractions, but the logistics involved in maintaining pressurization make them quite expensive. These early balloon tanks were first used by Atlas and the Centaur C upper stage.
zh: 你现在可以使用钢铝气囊储罐。气囊储罐没有内部构架，而是依靠内部增压来维持形状。如果失去内部压力，气囊储罐就会瘪塌。它们由极薄的不锈钢板制成，拥有出色的质量比，但维持增压所需的后勤保障使其相当昂贵。这些早期气囊储罐最早应用于擎天神和半人马座C上面级。

s: You can now use Steel & Aluminum-Copper Alloy balloon tanks. These advanced balloon tanks were first used by the Centaur G upper stage. These are 25% lighter than basic balloon tanks while costing 20% more to tool and 12% less once tooled.
zh: 你现在可以使用钢与铝铜合金气囊储罐。这些先进的气囊储罐最早应用于半人马座G上面级。它们比基础气囊储罐轻 25%，模具成本高出 20%，但制造单价低 12%。

s: You can now use Steel & Aluminum-Lithium Alloy balloon tanks. These modern balloon tanks were first used by Centaur III. These are 5% lighter than refined balloon tanks while costing 7% more to tool and 25% more once tooled.
zh: 你现在可以使用钢与铝锂合金气囊储罐。这些现代气囊储罐最早应用于半人马座III。它们比精炼气囊储罐轻 5%，但模具成本高出 7%，制造单价高出 25%。

s: You can now use composite wet wings. Large-scale use of composite structures was first pioneered in the Boeing 787, 777X, and Airbus A350. These are 35% lighter than wet wing tanks while costing 10% more.
zh: 你现在可以使用复合材料机翼油箱。大型复合材料结构的应用最早由波音787、777X和空中客车<<M0>>开创。它们比常规机翼油箱轻 35%，但成本高出 10%。

s: The full-sized version of the centrifuge from the Nautilus-X proposal. With a habitable volume close to that of the entire ISS put together, it's large enough to provide comfortable habitation to six astronauts. Although the diameter remains too small to allow for full Earth-like gravity under tolerable rotation rates, Martian gravity levels are easily achievable.
zh: Nautilus-X 方案中的全尺寸离心机。其居住容积接近整个国际空间站的总和，足够为六名航天员提供舒适的生活空间。尽管其直径仍然较小，在人体可耐受的转速下无法提供完整的类地重力，但达到火星重力水平绰绰有余。
