s: Realism Overhaul completely changes parts, so it itself only supports Sandbox play. RP-1 provides Realism Overhaul with a career mode, please install that if you wish to play career or science mode.
zh: Realism Overhaul 完全重构了部件，因此其本身仅支持沙盒模式。<<M0>> 为 Realism Overhaul 提供了生涯模式，如想游玩生涯或科学模式，请安装该组件。

s: Used on the UR-100 second stage. One 15D13 and one 15D14 make up a DU-419/8D419 propulsion unit.
zh: 用于 <<M0>> 第二级。由一台 15D13 和一台 15D14 组成一台 <<M1>>/8<<M2>> 推进单元。

s: Modified 15D13, intended for use as the ascent/return engine on the LK-700S. More reliable, with restart capability.
zh: 15D13 的改进型，旨在作为 <<M0>> 的上升/返回发动机。可靠性更高，且具备重启能力。

s: Sustainer engine of A-350Zh Anti-Ballistic Missile. Capable of rapid restart under high dynamic pressure for rapid upper atmosphere manuevers.
zh: <<M0>> 反弹道导弹的主发动机。可在高动压下快速重启，以进行快速高层大气机动。

s: Interim mass-production version of the Model 39 for the A-4 Series B/V-2
zh: Model 39 的过渡性量产型号，用于 <<M0>> B 系列/<<M1>>

s: "Interkontinental" version of the Model 39c, for the A-9/A-10 upper stage. Decreased thrust and increased Isp for upper stage use, and special engine modifications to allow air-starting.
zh: Model 39c 的“洲际”版本，用于 <<M0>>/<<M1>> 上面级。降低了推力并提高了比冲以适应上面级工况，并进行了特殊改进以允许空中点火。

s: Prototype engine, used on the Hermes A-3A (RV-A-8) test vehicle.
zh: 原型发动机，用于赫尔墨斯 <<M0>>（RV-<<M1>>）测试载具。

s: Uprated engine for the Hermes A-3B (SSM-A-16) missile.
zh: 用于赫尔墨斯 <<M0>>（SSM-<<M1>>）导弹的增推发动机。

s: A RATO booster modified to be used on the WAC-Corporal for the US Army
zh: 一种火箭辅助起飞（RATO）助推器，经改装用于美国陆军的“女兵下士”（WAC-Corporal）。

s: Developed for the Aerobee X-8, an improved WAC-Corporal for upper atmosphere research to replace the limited stocks of captured V-2s
zh: 专为 Aerobee <<M0>> 研制，作为改进型“女兵下士”，用于高层大气研究以替代缴获数量有限的 <<M1>>

s: Improved XASR-1 with helium pressurization to improve performance.
zh: 改进型 <<M0>>，采用氦气增压以提高性能。

s: Developed as an upgrade to the XASR-1. Continued to be used until the 1980s for meteorlogical studies.
zh: 作为 <<M0>> 的升级型号研制。一直沿用至 20 世纪 80 年代用于气象研究。

s: Developed privately in collaboration with Rocketdyne. Turbopump system from XLR-32 added, allowing much higher performance. A.K.A RS-72
zh: 与洛克达因合作自主研发。增加了源自 <<M0>> 的涡轮泵系统，大幅提升了性能。亦称 <<M1>>

s: Upgrade for the Agena SPS developed by TRW, using an electric pump system to allow it to draw directly from the Agena fuel tanks.
zh: 由 TRW 研发的阿金纳 SPS 升级型号，采用电动泵系统，使其能够直接从阿金纳燃料箱抽取推进剂。

s: Upgrade for the Agena SPS developed by TRW, using an electric pump system to allow it to draw directly from the Agena fuel tanks. HDA version.
zh: 由 TRW 研发的阿金纳 SPS 升级型号，采用电动泵系统直接从阿金纳储箱抽取推进剂。HDA 版本。

s: Derived from the XLR67 used on the RASCAL missile, the Model 117 was intended to power an improved air to surface missile for the B-58 Hustler.
zh: 衍生自 RASCAL 导弹上使用的 <<M0>>，Model 117 旨在为 <<M1>>“盗贼”的改进型空地导弹提供动力。

s: Model 8001, Agena A Prototypes. Effectively a Model 117 with gimbal added, this engine was poorly optimized for upper stage use and only flew twice on the earliest Agena launches.
zh: Model 8001，阿金纳 A 原型。实际上是加装了万向节的 Model 117，对上面级工况的优化较差，仅在最早的阿金纳发射中飞行了两次。

s: Model 8048, Agena A. Switched to higher performance hypergolic fuels and featured an larger nozzle for better vacuum performance. Cavitating venturis improved thrust regulation.
zh: Model 8048，阿金纳 A。改用更高性能的自燃推进剂，并采用更大的喷管以提升真空性能。空化文氏管改善了推力调节。

s: Model 8081, Agena B. Increase burn time and a short nozzle extension increased performance for Agena B. Also featured a restart cartridge to allow restart in space.
zh: Model 8081，阿金纳 B。更长的燃烧时间和短喷管延伸段提高了阿金纳 B 的性能。还配备了重启点火药筒以实现太空二次启动。

s: Model 8096, Agena D. Improved injectors and a larger nozzle extension improved performance for Agena D. This was the most-produced variant of Agena, flying hundreds of times.
zh: Model 8096，阿金纳 D。改进的喷注器和更大的喷管延伸段提高了阿金纳 D 的性能。这是阿金纳产量最高的型号，执行过数百次飞行。

s: A.K.A. XLR81-BA-13, or Model 8247. Add reusable start tanks, developed for GATV, to allow for up to 14 restarts of the XLR81.
zh: 亦称 <<M0>>-<<M1>> 或 Model 8247。增加了为 GATV 研制的可复用启动箱，使 <<M0>> 能够最多重启 14 次。

s: Agena D HDA. Converted to use high density acid oxidizer to increase performance. Cannot restart between 15 minutes and 3 hours after shutdown.
zh: 阿金纳 D HDA。改为使用高密度酸类氧化剂以提高性能。关机后 15 分钟至 3 小时内无法重启。

s: Add reusable start tanks, developed for GATV, to allow for up to 14 restarts of the XLR81.
zh: 增加了为 GATV 研制的可复用启动箱，使 <<M0>> 能够最多重启 14 次。

s: Improved Model 8096 for Titan-Agena, including longer life and higher performance injectors developed for Shuttle-Agena. Cannot restart between 15 minutes and 3 hours after shutdown.
zh: 用于大力神-阿金纳的 Model 8096 改进型，采用了为航天飞机-阿金纳研制的长寿命和高性能喷注器。关机后 15 分钟至 3 小时内无法重启。

s: Add reusable start tanks, developed for GATV, to allow for up to 14 restarts of the XLR81. Cannot restart between 15 minutes and 3 hours after shutdown.
zh: 增加了为 GATV 研制的可复用启动箱，使 <<M0>> 能够最多重启 14 次。关机后 15 分钟至 3 小时内无法重启。

s: Higher expansion ratio nozzle prototype. Cannot restart between 15 minutes and 3 hours after shutdown.
zh: 高膨胀比喷管原型。关机后 15 分钟至 3 小时内无法重启。

s: Reusable Agena for STS, featuring much larger nozzle, a large number of restarts, and higher performance. Cannot restart between 15 minutes and 3 hours after shutdown.
zh: 用于航天飞机（STS）的可复用阿金纳，具有更大的喷管、多次重启能力和更高性能。关机后 15 分钟至 3 小时内无法重启。

s: Improved reusable Agena for STS. Reduced weight, fuel mix modified for better compatibility with shuttle, and turbopump material modified to remove restart limits.
zh: 用于航天飞机（STS）的改进型可复用阿金纳。减轻了重量，调整了燃料配比以更好地适配航天飞机，并更改了涡轮泵材料以消除重启限制。

s: Ultimate reusable Agena for STS. Reduced weight and thrust to increase Isp, nearly unlimited restarts, and extremely long life.
zh: 用于航天飞机（STS）的终极可复用阿金纳。减轻了重量并降低了推力以提高比冲，具有接近无限次的重启能力和极长的使用寿命。

s: Agena upgrade for proposed Atlas V upper stage. Tested, but cancelled when studies showed it would be more economical to use single engine centaur instead.
zh: 拟用于宇宙神 V 上面级的阿金纳升级型号。经过地面测试，但在研究表明使用单台半人马座发动机更经济后被取消。

s: Liquid Fluorine based design, proposed for use on the GE D-2 Apollo vehicle, and later high performance Agena tugs.
zh: 基于液氟的设计，曾提议用于 GE <<M0>> 阿波罗飞船以及后来的高性能阿金纳拖船。

s: Upper Stage engine used on the Titan Transtage
zh: 用于大力神“过渡级”（Transtage）的上面级发动机

s: Improved Transtage Injector Program, upgraded AJ10-138 used for later Transtage launches.
zh: 改进型过渡级喷注器计划（ITIP），用于后期过渡级发射的升级版 <<M0>>-138。

s: Upper stage engine for the Delta-K
zh: 用于德尔塔-K 的上面级发动机

s: AJ10 variant burning liquid hydrogen and oxygen, proposed for use on the Hylas upper stage. Extremely low chamber pressure and autogeneous pressurization system allows conventional tanks to be used.
zh: 以液氢液氧为推进剂的 <<M0>> 改型，曾提议用于海拉斯（Hylas）上面级。极低的燃烧室压力和自生增压系统使其能够使用常规储箱。

s: AJ10 variant burning liquid hydrogen and oxygen, proposed for use on the GE D-2 Apollo vehicle.
zh: 以液氢液氧为推进剂的 <<M0>> 改型，曾提议用于通用电气 <<M1>> 阿波罗载具。

s: Developed for the upper stage of the Vanguard launch vehicle.
zh: 专为先锋号运载火箭的上面级研制。

s: More reliable version of the AJ10-37 used on the Able Upper Stage.
zh: 用于 Able 上级的 <<M0>>-37 的更高可靠性版本。

s: Used on the improved version of the Able upper stage for Thor-Able and Atlas-Able.
zh: 用于雷神-Able 与宇宙神-Able 的改进型 Able 上级。

s: Used as the upper stage engine on the very late Thor-Able and very early Thor-Delta launch vehicles.
zh: 用作极后期雷神-Able 与极早期雷神-德尔塔运载火箭的上级发动机。

s: Second stage engine for the Thor-Delta A.
zh: 雷神-德尔塔 A 的二级发动机。

s: The AJ10-104 was used on the Thor-Able-Star and it was the first upper stage engine with the ability to restart.
zh: <<M0>>-104 用于雷神-Able-Star，是首款具备二次启动能力的上级发动机。

s: Upgrade to the AJ10-118 used on the Delta E-N upper stages.
zh: <<M0>>-118 的升级型，用于德尔塔 E-N 上级。

s: Planned upgrade for space shuttle OMS, cancelled after Challenger disaster
zh: 航天飞机 OMS 的计划升级型号，在挑战者号失事后取消。

s: Engine for Transtar I, a high performance upper stage. Later renamed to Titan Launch Dispenser and used to deploy NRO SIGINT satellites, and may have powered other classified NRO payloads.
zh: 用于高性能上级 Transtar I 的发动机。后更名为大力神发射分配器（TLD），用于开启 NRO 信号情报卫星，并可能曾为其他机密 NRO 载荷提供动力。

s: Hydrolox engine, for high performance reusable space shuttle upper stages
zh: 氢氧发动机，用于高性能可重复使用航天飞机上级。

s: Engine for Transtar III, reusable upgrade of Transtar I
zh: 用于 Transtar III 的发动机，是 Transtar I 的可重复使用升级型号。

s: This was the test version that used the nozzle for the Full Length design.
zh: 这是采用了全长设计喷管的测试版本。

s: AR-1. Experimental pressure-fed super-performance booster for FJ-4F Fury.
zh: <<M0>>。用于 <<M1>> Fury 的实验性挤压循环超高性能助推器。

s: Improved model, with throttle capability. Tested, but never flew.
zh: 改进型号，具备节流阀调节能力。已完成地面测试，但从未飞行。

s: AR2-3. Pump-fed model, able to share fuel tanks with jet engine. Used on the FJ-4F, F-86F(R), and NF-104A for astronaut training.
zh: AR2-3。泵压式型号，可与喷气发动机共用储罐。用于 <<M0>>、<<M1>>(R) 与 <<M2>> 进行宇航员训练。

s: Used on Europa I. Extremely unreliable
zh: 用于欧罗巴 1 号。极不可靠。

s: Upgrade developed for Europa II. Cancelled after first launch following continued failures and lack of funding
zh: 为欧罗巴 2 号开发的升级型号。因持续故障与缺乏资金在首飞后取消。

s: Derived from the Sergeant ballistic missile, for use as an upper stage to the Juno-C to test high velocity re-entry.
zh: 衍生自警长弹道导弹，用作丘比特-C 的上级以测试高速再入。

s: Improved fuel mix created by JPL
zh: 由 JPL 配制的改进型燃料配方。
液氧/RP-1 推进剂挤压循环发动机。

s: LOX/RP1 powered engine using a Gas Generator Cycle.
zh: 采用燃气发生器循环的液氧/RP-1 发动机。

s: LOX/Ethanol powered engine using a Gas Generator Cycle.
zh: 采用燃气发生器循环的液氧/乙醇发动机。

s: LOX/LCH4 powered engine using a Gas Generator Cycle.
zh: 采用燃气发生器循环的液氧/液态甲烷发动机。
挤压循环液氧/RP-1 发动机。

s: Uprated E-1 intended for use with the Dyna Soar project. This version is without boostback hardware.
zh: 拟用于动力滑翔机（Dyna-Soar）项目的增推型 <<M0>>。此版本未配备调头助推硬件。

s: Speculative E-1 upgrade, uprated to target thrust level of original E-1 study.
zh: 推测的 <<M0>> 升级型，增推至原版 <<M0>> 研究的目标推力水平。

s: Speculative E-1 upgrade, uprated to maximum possible thrust.
zh: 推测的 <<M0>> 升级型，增推至最大极限推力。

s: Speculative upgrade configuration for the E-1 intended for use with the Dyna Soar project. This version is without boostback hardware.
zh: 拟用于动力滑翔机（Dyna-Soar）项目的推测升级构型 <<M0>>。此版本未配备调头助推硬件。

s: Speculative upgrade configuration using late 1960s technology.
zh: 采用 1960 年代末技术的推测升级构型。

s: Modified 457M thruster with a krypton propellant, keeping the voltage at 650V. Even higher specific impulse due to lower molecular weight of the gas. Efficiency 58%, 2.19 kg/kW.
zh: 采用氪气推进剂的 457M 改型推力器，保持 650V 电压。由于气体分子量更低，比冲更高。效率 58%，功质比 2.19 kg/kW。

s: The successful test campaign with the laboratory model NASA-457M led to the development of a higher fidelity version of this thruster, labeled the NASA-457M v2. Efficiency 63%, 2.38 kg/kW.
zh: 实验室原型 <<M0>> 的成功测试促成了该推力器高保真度版本的研制，定名为 <<M0>> v2。效率 63%，功质比 2.38 kg/kW。

s: 25 kW, optimized for earth-moon trips. Efficiency 70%, 2.67 kg/kW.
zh: 25 kW，专为地月转移优化。效率 70%，功质比 2.67 kg/kW。

s: 25 kW, optimized for earth-mars trips. Efficiency 72%, 2.67 kg/kW.
zh: 25 kW，专为地火转移优化。效率 72%，功质比 2.67 kg/kW。

s: 25 kW, optimized for gas giant probes. Efficiency 75%, 3.00 kg/kW.
zh: 25 kW，专为气态巨行星探测器优化。效率 75%，功质比 3.00 kg/kW。

s: 50 kW, optimized for earth-mars trips. Efficiency 72%, 2.67 kg/kW.
zh: 50 kW，专为地火转移优化。效率 72%，功质比 2.67 kg/kW。

s: 50 kW, optimized for gas giant probes. Efficiency 75%, 3.00 kg/kW.
zh: 50 kW，专为气态巨行星探测器优化。效率 75%，功质比 3.00 kg/kW。

s: 400 pulses per second, 32.44 kW total. Efficiency 61.6%, 1.58 kg/kW.
zh: 每秒 400 次脉冲，总功率 32.44 kW。效率 61.6%，功质比 1.58 kg/kW。

s: Advanced Electric Propulsion System, propulsion system for Lunar Gateway. Efficiency 61.5%, 1.88 kg/kW.
zh: 先进电力推进系统，月球门户空间站的推进系统。效率 61.5%，功质比 1.88 kg/kW。

s: NEXT-Commercial, scaled down for decreased power consumption. Efficiency 70%, 2.67 kg/kW.
zh: NEXT-专注效益，按比例缩小以降低功耗。效率 70%，功质比 2.67 kg/kW。

s: 50 pulses per second, 205.3 kW total. Efficiency 72%, 2.68 kg/kW.
zh: 每秒 50 次脉冲，总功率 205.3 kW。效率 72%，功质比 2.68 kg/kW。

s: 50 pulses per second, 205.3 kW total. Efficiency 75%, 2.68 kg/kW.
zh: 每秒 50 次脉冲，总功率 205.3 kW。效率 75%，功质比 2.68 kg/kW。

s: 10 pulses per second, 40 kW total. Efficiency 55%, 4.53 kg/kW.
zh: 每秒 10 次脉冲，总功率 40 kW。效率 55%，功质比 4.53 kg/kW。

s: 300 pulses per second, 1200 kW total. Efficiency 55%, 0.24 kg/kW.
zh: 每秒 300 次脉冲，总功率 1200 kW。效率 55%，功质比 0.24 kg/kW。

s: 10 pulses per second, 40 kW total. Efficiency 46%, 4.53 kg/kW.
zh: 每秒 10 次脉冲，总功率 40 kW。效率 46%，功质比 4.53 kg/kW。

s: 300 pulses per second, 1200 kW total. Efficiency 46%, 0.24 kg/kW.
zh: 每秒 300 次脉冲，总功率 1200 kW。效率 46%，功质比 0.24 kg/kW。

s: Lab-tested version of the X3 thruster. Efficiency 63%, 2.30 kg/kW.
zh: X3 推力器的实验室测试版本。效率 63%，功质比 2.30 kg/kW。

s: Uprated X3 thruster operated at 800V and 200kW. Efficiency 63%, 1.25 kg/kW.
zh: 增推型 X3 推力器，工作参数为 800V 及 200kW。效率 63%，功质比 1.25 kg/kW。

s: X3 variant using Krypton for increased Isp, at the expense of thrust. Efficiency 60%, 1.25 kg/kW.
zh: 使用氪气的 X3 改型，牺牲推力换取更高比冲。效率 60%，功质比 1.25 kg/kW。
后期型号，重新设计了喷注器。

s: Uprated and simplified F-1 developed for post-Apollo launch vehicles. Tested extensively, but cancelled following the cancellation of Apollo
zh: 为阿波罗后运载火箭研发的增推简化型 <<M0>>。进行了大量测试，但在阿波罗计划取消后随之终止。

s: Original Gamma-2 used on all Black Arrow launches
zh: 用于所有黑箭运载火箭发射的原型 Gamma-2。

s: Speculative vacuum Larch based on Gamma-2
zh: 基于 Gamma-2 的推测真空版 Larch。

s: Early Gamma used on first 14 Black Knight launches, developed from Walter 109-509
zh: 早期 Gamma，用于前 14 次黑骑士发射，由 Walter 109-509 发展而来。

s: Substantially upgraded Gamma based on Stentor sustainer chamber, used on last 8 Black Knight launches and Black Arrow
zh: 大幅升级的 Gamma，基于 Stentor 持续推力室，用于最后 8 次黑骑士发射及黑箭。

s: Improved engine developed by Bristol Siddeley as a replacement for Gamma
zh: 布里斯托尔·西德利开发的改进型发动机，用以替代 Gamma。

s: Original Gamma-8 used on flown Black Arrows
zh: 用于实际飞行的黑箭的原型 Gamma-8。

s: Improved version of the H-1 Engine for the Saturn I, Block II. It is rated at 188k lbf sea level thrust.
zh: 用于土星 1 号 Block II 的 <<M0>> 改进型发动机。海平面额定推力 188k lbf。

s: H-1 Engine that flew on the first 5 Saturn IB launches. It is rated at 200k lbf sea level thrust.
zh: 在前 5 次土星 1B 发射中飞行的 <<M0>> 发动机。海平面额定推力 200k lbf。

s: Final version of the H-1 Engine for the Saturn IB that flew on the 4 flights of Skylab and ASTP. It is rated at 205k lbf sea level thrust.
zh: 用于土星 1B 的 <<M0>> 最终型号，在天空实验室的 4 次飞行和阿波罗-联盟测试计划中飞行。海平面额定推力 205k lbf。

s: Remanufactured H-1 for use with Delta
zh: 重新制造的 <<M0>>，用于德尔塔火箭。

s: RS-27 with a higher expansion nozzle for Delta II
zh: 采用更高膨胀比喷管的 <<M0>>，用于德尔塔 II。

s: Speculative upgrade, using lessons learned from experience with HG-3 in service and development of RS-25 to improve reliability.
zh: 推测的升级型号，利用 <<M0>> 的服役经验以及 <<M1>> 的研发成果来提升可靠性。

s: Sea-level version of HG-3B-2 upgrade and modification. The improved specific impulse now means that this version produces more vacuum thrust than previous vacuum versions of the engine.
zh: <<M0>> 升级改型的海平面版本。得益于比冲的提升，该版本产生的真空推力超过了之前该发动机的真空版本。

s: Improved version of the HM-7 used for Ariane 3 and 4.
zh: <<M0>> 的改进型，用于阿里安 3 和 4。

s: Upgraded for higher performance on Ariane 4.
zh: 针对阿里安 4 的高性能升级型。

s: Upgraded for higher performance for later Ariane 4s and Ariane 5
zh: 针对后期阿里安 4 和阿里安 5 的高性能升级型。
两次重新启动之间至少间隔五分钟。

s: This was the earliest variant of the J-2 that flew on the first 3 Saturn IB flights AS-201 to AS-203.
zh: 这是 <<M0>> 的最早变体，曾用于土星 1B 的前三次飞行 <<M1>> 至 <<M2>>。

s: Adds CVS propellant management system and O2/H2 burner preheater, to allow for on-orbit engine conditioning and restarts. One hour minimum between restarts.
zh: 增加了 CVS 推进剂管理系统和 O2/H2 预热燃烧器，支持在轨发动机温控调节和重新启动。两次重新启动之间至少间隔一小时。

s: The uprated 225k variant was flown starting with SA-501 Saturn V.
zh: 增推至 225k 的型号，从 <<M0>> 土星 5 号开始投入飞行。

s: The whole family of Merlin 1 rocket engines, made by SpaceX.
zh: Merlin 1全系列火箭发动机，由<<M0>>制造。

s: Aerojet MR-510 series arcjet engines are currently used on Lockheed Martin A2100 satellites using hydrazine as a propellant.
zh: Aerojet <<M0>>系列电弧推力器目前用于使用肼类推进剂的洛克希德·马丁<<M1>>卫星。

s: A 1970s low-TWR vacuum engine, the NERVA (Nuclear Engine for Rocket Vehicle Applications) is designed for orbital tugs and large rocket upper stages.
zh: 一款20世纪70年代的低TWR真空发动机，NERVA（核动力火箭飞行器应用计划）专为轨道拖船和大型火箭上面级设计。

s: A later 1970s atomic engine with relatively low TWR but high ISP and a power generation of 4200 MW. Derived from the Phoebus 2A ground demonstrator, tested in 1968.
zh: 一款20世纪70年代后期的核动力发动机，TWR相对较低但比冲极高，发电功率达4200 MW。衍生自1968年测试的Phoebus 2A地面验证机。

s: A first stage solid rocket motor used on many sounding rockets including Nike-Deacon, Nike-Cajun, Nike-Apache, Nike-Aerobee170, Nike-Aerobee350, and more.
zh: 一种固体火箭第一级发动机，用于包括耐克-执事、耐克-卡津、耐克-阿帕奇、耐克-<<M0>>、耐克-<<M1>>等多种探空火箭。

s: A staged combustion kerolox booster engine designed by Kuznetsov for the Korolev GR-1 project. It was the basis for the NK-15 used on the N1, and the NK-33 used today.
zh: 由库兹涅佐夫为科罗廖夫的<<M0>>项目设计的分级燃烧液氧煤油助推器发动机。它是N1所用<<M1>>以及当今使用的<<M2>>的基础。

s: A staged combustion kerolox upper/vacuum engine designed by Kuznetsov for the Korolev GR-1 project. It was reused (as NK-19) on the N1 and upgraded for the N1F with restart capability as NK-31.
zh: 由库兹涅佐夫为科罗廖夫的<<M0>>项目设计的分级燃烧液氧煤油上面级/真空发动机。该型号在N1上复用（称为<<M1>>），后为N1F升级为具备二次启动能力的<<M2>>。

s: Originally designed and built for the N1F, the NK-43 is a derivative of the NK-33 with a longer bell and restart capability for use on upper stages.
zh: <<M0>>最初为N1F设计并建造，是<<M1>>的衍生型号，具有更长的喷管延伸段并具备重启能力，适用于上面级。

s: The first large gridded ion thruster, the NASA Solar Technology Application Readiness (NSTAR) was used on the Deep Space 1 and Dawn spacecraft to allow for extended operations in the asteroid belt.
zh: 首款大型栅极离子推力器，NASA太阳能技术应用就绪计划（NSTAR）曾用于深空1号和黎明号航天器，以支持在小行星带的长期任务。

s: NYRATH Open Cycle Gas Core Atomic Rocket Motor
zh: NYRATH开式循环气核核动力火箭发动机

s: PIT Mk Va Pulsed Inductive Thruster
zh: PIT Mk Va脉冲感应推力器

s: A Hall-effect ion thruster used on many commercial spacecraft for station keeping.
zh: 一种霍尔效应离子推力器，广泛用于商业航天器的轨道位置保持。

s: A pressure-fed vacuum hypergolic engine used for attitude control on the Space Shuttle.
zh: 一种挤压循环真空自燃推进剂发动机，用于航天飞机的姿态控制。

s: A pressure-fed hypergolic rocket engine, burning either MMH and NTO (R-42) or hydrazine and NTO (R-42DM). Used as an apogee kick motor for geostationary satellites.
zh: 一种挤压循环自燃推进剂火箭发动机，燃烧MMH/NTO（<<M0>>）或肼/NTO（<<M1>>）。用作地球同步卫星的远地点变轨发动机。

s: The RD-8 is a four-chamber, staged combustion, vacuum kerolox vernier engine. It is used on the second stage of the Zenit launch vehicle family for two-axis attitude control.
zh: <<M0>>是一款四推力室、分级燃烧的真空液氧煤油游控发动机。用于天顶号系列运载火箭第二级进行双轴姿态控制。

s: An upper stage kerolox engine designed for the R-9 ICBM and later used on the Molniya, Voskhod. and Soyuz launchers.
zh: 一款专为<<M0>>洲际弹道导弹设计的上面级液氧煤油发动机，后用于闪电号、上升号和联盟号运载火箭。

s: The RD-0110R is a four-chamber, gas generator, surface kerolox vernier engine. It is used on the first stage of the Soyuz-2-1V launch vehicle family for two-axis attitude control.
zh: <<M0>>是一款四推力室、燃气发生器循环的地面级液氧煤油游控发动机。用于联盟-2-1V系列运载火箭第一级进行双轴姿态控制。

s: The vernier engine for the RD-0110 power plant. Four of them are used on the Block I upper stage of the Soyuz U and FG launch vehicle variants for attitude control.
zh: 用于<<M0>>动力装置的游控发动机。四台并联用于联盟U和联盟FG运载火箭改型的I子级上面级进行姿态控制。

s: A 1980s medium TWR engine for atmospheric and vacuum use. The RD-0120 is a fuel-rich staged combustion engine developed to power the core stage of the Energia launcher.
zh: 一款20世纪80年代的中TWR大气与真空两用发动机。<<M0>>是一款富燃分级燃烧发动机，专为能源号运载火箭芯级提供动力而研制。

s: The RD-120 is a staged combustion vacuum kerolox engine used as the main power plant on the Zenit launch vehicle family second stage.
zh: <<M0>>是一款分级燃烧真空液氧煤油发动机，用作天顶号系列运载火箭第二级的主动力装置。

s: An upper stage Kerosene/LOX engine designed for new versions of the Soyuz-2 launchers. It will also be used with the Angara family of launchers.
zh: 一款专为新版联盟-2运载火箭设计的上面级液氧/煤油发动机。它也将用于安加拉系列运载火箭。

s: The RD-180 is a two-chamber derivative of the four-chamber RD-170/171 and it powers the first stage of the Atlas V.
zh: <<M0>>是四推力室<<M1>>/171的双推力室衍生型号，为宇宙神V的第一级提供动力。

s: A staged combustion hypergolic vacuum rocket engine used as a power plant on the second stage of the Proton launch vehicle family. Features a one-axis gimbal mechanism for attitude control.
zh: 一种分级燃烧自燃推进剂真空火箭发动机，用作质子号系列运载火箭第二级的动力装置。配备单轴万向节机构用于姿态控制。

s: A gas generator vernier engine cluster found on the second stage of the UR-200 and third stage of the UR-500/Proton series launcher.
zh: 一种燃气发生器循环游控发动机机组，安装在<<M0>>的第二级和<<M1>>/质子号系列运载火箭的第三级。

s: A Soviet pressure-fed vacuum engine. A pair of RD-0225s were used as maneuvering engines on the Almaz space stations.
zh: 苏联的一款挤压循环真空发动机。一对<<M0>>曾用作金刚石空间站的机动发动机。

s: A gas-generator upper stage vernier engine developed for the UR-100N second stage, designed to be used alongside the RD-0235. This represents 1/4th of an RD-0236.
zh: 专为<<M0>>第二级研制的燃气发生器循环上面级游控发动机，设计与<<M1>>配合使用。本部件相当于<<M2>>的四分之一。

s: The RD-0242M2 is a deeply-throttleable derivative of the RD-0242M1 upper stage engine engine. Modified to use monomethyl hydrazine (MMH) instead of unsymmetrical dimethylhydrazine (UDMH).
zh: <<M0>>是<<M1>>上面级发动机的大范围深度节流衍生型号。改用一甲基肼（MMH）替代偏二甲肼（UDMH）。

s: A staged combustion hypergolic booster engine designed to replace the RD-250 engines used on the R-36. It was also used for the MR-UR-100.
zh: 一种分级燃烧自燃推进剂助推器发动机，旨在替代<<M1>>上使用的<<M0>>发动机。它也曾用于MR-<<M2>>。

s: RD-600 Open Cycle Gas Core Atomic Rocket Motor
zh: <<M0>>开式循环气核核动力火箭发动机

s: A pump-fed hypergolic vernier thruster used on the first stage of the R-16, R-36, and Tsyklon rockets.
zh: 一种泵压式自燃推进剂游控推力器，用于<<M0>>、<<M1>>和旋风号火箭的第一级。

s: A pump-fed hypergolic vernier thruster used on the second stage of the R-16 and R-36 ICBM, and the Tsyklon (Cyclone) launch vehicle series for attitude control.
zh: 一种泵压式自燃推进剂游控推力器，用于<<M0>>和<<M1>>洲际弹道导弹的第二级，以及旋风号系列运载火箭进行姿态控制。

s: A gas generator hypergolic engine for the LK lander. It serves as the main engine of the LK lander, used for final descent to the moon, and takeoff to lunar orbit.
zh: 用于LK登月舱的燃气发生器循环自燃推进剂发动机。作为LK登月舱的主发动机，用于月表最终下降和起飞进入月球轨道。

s: A gas generator hypergolic engine for the LK lander. It serves as the backup engine of the LK lander. It has limited throttling capability, and is only to be used for takeoff or abort.
zh: 用于LK登月舱的燃气发生器循环自燃推进剂发动机。作为LK登月舱的备用发动机。节流范围有限，仅用于起飞或中止任务。

s: A French solid rocket engine developed for the MSBS M1 ballistic missile, and later used as the second stage of the Diamant BP.4 launch vehicle, replacing the Topaze.
zh: 法国为MSBS M1弹道导弹研制的固体火箭发动机，后取代黄玉发动机用作钻石BP.4运载火箭的第二级。

s: A reusable fuel-rich staged combustion vacuum engine. Developed in the early 1970s to test technologies for the RS-25 SSME.
zh: 一种可重复使用的富燃分级燃烧真空发动机。于20世纪70年代初研制，用于验证<<M0>>航天飞机主发动机（SSME）的相关技术。

s: Rocketdyne's LH2/LOX full flow staged combustion engine proposal for next generation reusable launch vehicle boosters.
zh: 洛克达因为下一代可重复使用运载火箭助推器提议的液氢/液氧全流量分级燃烧发动机。

s: A small French solid rocket motor used as the second stage of the Rubis sounding rocket and third stage on the Diamant A launch vehicle.
zh: 一种小型法国固体火箭发动机，用作红宝石探空火箭的第二级和钻石A运载火箭的第三级。

s: A small maneuvering engine used on the Soviet 1MV and 2MV spacecraft busses and KAUR-2 comsat bus. Used on early Venera, Mars, Zond, and Molniya satellites.
zh: 一种用于苏联1MV和2MV航天器平台以及<<M0>>通信卫星平台的小型机动发动机。曾用于早期的金星、火星、探测器和闪电号卫星。

s: A small gas-generator vacuum engine, developed as an upper stage for the R-14 to create the Kosmos-3 launch vehicle. Also known as the 11D49 or DU-49.
zh: 一种小型燃气发生器循环真空发动机，作为<<M0>>的上面级研制，从而衍生出了宇宙-3号运载火箭。亦称11D49或<<M1>>。

s: A low-bypass augmented turbofan used by the MiG-31 and Su-47. 152kN wet, 93.2kN dry. OPR 21.2, SFC 0.72/1.86 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 2.9.
zh: 用于<<M0>>和<<M1>>的低涵道比加力涡扇发动机。加力152 kN，无加力93.2 kN。总压比21.2，静态油耗0.72/1.86 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制2.9马赫。

s: A small solid fueled booster taken from the AIM-7 Sparrow missile. It was used as the third stage on the Aerobee 300 and 300A sounding rockets.
zh: 源自<<M0>>“麻雀”导弹的小型固体助推器。曾作为“金龟子”300和300A探空火箭的第三级使用。

s: A small but powerful solid fueled booster used as the first stage for the Aerobee line of sounding rockets.
zh: 一款紧凑但强力的小型固体助推器，用作“金龟子”系列探空火箭的第一级。

s: A small pressure-fed sustainer for the WAC Corporal and Aerobee sounding rockets. Used after a small solid booster.
zh: 用于“下士”WAC和“金龟子”探空火箭的小型挤压循环持续推力发动机。在小型固体助推器工作后启动。

s: The Aerojet AJ10-137 was used as the Service Propulsion System on the Apollo CSM. It was designed to operate for up to 750 seconds and could restart 50 times.
zh: Aerojet <<M0>>-137曾用作阿波罗CSM上的服务推进系统。其设计运行时间最长达750秒，并可重新启动50次。

s: A low thrust pressure-fed hypergolic engine used on the Space Shuttle for orbital insertion, maneuvering, and deorbiting. Currently used by the Orion MPCV.
zh: 用于航天飞机轨道入轨、变轨和脱轨的小推力挤压循环自燃推进剂发动机。目前用于“猎户座”MPCV。

s: The AJ-60A is an SRB produced by Aerojet Rocketdyne. They are currently used as strap-on boosters on United Launch Alliance's Atlas V rocket.
zh: <<M0>>是由Aerojet Rocketdyne生产的固体火箭助推器。目前在联合发射联盟的“宇宙神V”火箭上作为捆绑助推器使用。

s: AJ-260 FL Radial Solid Rocket Booster
AJ-260 SL Radial Solid Rocket Booster
A first stage solid rocket motor used on the early X-1 and X-2 Scout launch vehicles.
zh: 用于早期<<M0>>和<<M1>>“侦察兵”运载火箭的第一级固体火箭发动机。

s: A first stage solid rocket motor developed from Algol I and used on the Scout launch vehicles.
zh: 由“大陵五I”发展而来并用于“侦察兵”运载火箭的第一级固体火箭发动机。

s: The final development version of the first stage solid rocket motor used on the Scout launch vehicles.
zh: 用于“侦察兵”运载火箭的第一级固体火箭发动机的最终研发版本。

s: A small solid kick motor. Developed from the Altair, this successor was used on Scout and Delta to circularize at apogee or perform a final payload kick. Average thrust 28.48 kN, burn time 22 seconds.
zh: 一款小型固体冲量发动机。作为由“牵牛星”发展而来的后继型号，它在“侦察兵”和“德尔塔”上用于远地点圆化轨道或实施最终有效载荷推冲。平均推力28.48 kN，燃烧时间22秒。

s: The Antares solid rocket motor was used as the third stage for the Scout launch vehicle.
zh: “心宿二”固体火箭发动机曾用作“侦察兵”运载火箭的第三级。

s: The Antares II solid rocket motor was used as the third stage for the majority of the Scout launch vehicle launches.
zh: “心宿二II”固体火箭发动机曾用作绝大多数“侦察兵”运载火箭发射任务的第三级。

s: A German pressure-fed vacuum engine burning Aerozine50 and NTO. It was used on the stage of the same name on the Europa I and II launch vehicles.
zh: 一款燃烧<<M0>>和NTO的德国挤压循环真空发动机。它曾用于“欧罗巴”I和II运载火箭上的同名级段。

s: A small hypergolic engine developed for the Apollo program and Voyager Mars. Ultimately never used in space, as the R-4D was chosen for the Apollo program and Voyager Mars was cancelled.
zh: 一款为阿波罗计划和“旅行者火星”开发的小型自燃推进剂发动机。由于阿波罗计划最终选用了<<M0>>，且“旅行者火星”被取消，它从未在太空飞行中使用过。

s: A second stage solid rocket motor used on the Nike-Cajun sounding rocket.
zh: 用于“耐克-卡津”探空火箭的第二级固体火箭发动机。

s: The Castor 1 was first used for a suborbital launch of a Scout X-1 rocket in 1960. Castor 1 stages were also used as strap-on boosters for vehicles with Thor first stages, including the Delta-D.
zh: “卡斯托1”于1960年首次用于“侦察兵”<<M0>>火箭的亚轨道发射。“卡斯托1”级段还曾作为捆绑助推器用于以“雷神”为第一级的运载器，包括“德尔塔-D”。

s: A strap-on booster, improved from the Castor 4A and first tested May 1992. Its 30% performance increase would improve capacity of Atlas IIAS, H-II, and other vehicles. First flight 2001.
zh: 一款由“卡斯托4A”改进而来的捆绑助推器，于1992年5月首飞测试。其性能提升了30%，可增强“宇宙神IIAS”、“H-II”等火箭的运载能力。首飞于2001年。

s: A steel casing solid rocket motor used in pairs by the Ariane 5 launch vehicle for the initial phases of the flight.
zh: 一种钢制壳体固体火箭发动机，在“阿里安5”运载火箭的初始飞行阶段成对使用。

s: The massive Rocketdyne F-1 engine. One of the largest, most powerful rocket engines ever built. Ensure you enable roll capability or disable gimbal as required for your application.
zh: 巨大的Rocketdyne <<M0>>发动机。有史以来制造的体型最大、推力最强的火箭发动机之一。请确保根据任务需求启用滚转能力或禁用万向节。

s: Developed from Altair-III (FW-4S), the FW-5 was a small apogee kick motor used for most Hughes HS-333 satellite busses, including Anik, Westar and Marisat.
zh: 由“牵牛星-III”（<<M0>>）发展而来的<<M1>>是一款小型远地点冲量发动机，用于包括Anik、Westar和Marisat在内的大多数休斯<<M2>>卫星平台。

s: A small solid kick motor, used as the third stage on all but the last Vanguard launch. Burn time 33 seconds.
zh: 一款小型固体冲量发动机，用于除最后一次发射外的所有“先锋”火箭第三级。燃烧时间33秒。

s: HERMeS (Hall Effect Rocket with Magnetic Shielding) is a an experimental Hall effect ion thruster. It was later developed into AEPS, the planned propulsion system for the Lunar Gateway.
zh: <<M0>>（带磁屏蔽的霍尔效应火箭）是一款实验性霍尔效应离子推力器。后来发展为AEPS，即计划用于“月球门户”的推进系统。

s: The Rocketdyne HG-3 engine, which served as a stepping stone between the J-2 and RS-25. Ensure you enable roll capability or disable gimbal as required for your application.
zh: Rocketdyne <<M0>>发动机，曾作为<<M1>>和<<M2>>之间的过渡产物。请确保根据任务需求启用滚转能力或禁用万向节。

s: A hydrolox gas generator upper stage engine, directly descended from the HM4 testbed engine and used on the upper stages of the Ariane launch vehicle family.
zh: 一款氢氧气动循环（燃气发生器循环）上面级发动机，直接脱胎于HM4试验平台发动机，并用于“阿里安”运载火箭家族的上面级。

s: A gridded ion thruster developed for the Transport and Energy Module, Russia's planned nuclear-electric tug.
zh: 一款为“运输和能源模块”（俄罗斯计划中的核电推拖船）开发的栅极离子推力器。

s: The Rocketdyne J-2 rocket engine was the first large hydrolox engine. Five powered the S-II stage on the Saturn V and one was used on the S-IVB stage of the Saturn IB and V.
zh: Rocketdyne <<M0>>火箭发动机是首款大型氢氧发动机。土星五号的S-II级使用五台该发动机提供动力，土星IB和土星五号的S-IVB级也使用了一台。

s: A aerospike engine using proven technology from the J-2 and introducing an aerospike nozzle to the developing J-2S machinery.
zh: 一款气动塞式发动机，采用了源自<<M0>>的成熟技术，并为研制中的<<M1>>机构引入了气动塞式喷管。

s: A pressure-fed kerosene/LOX engine used in the second stage of the Falcon 1 launcher.
zh: 一款用于“猎鹰1号”运载火箭第二级的挤压循环煤油/液氧发动机。

s: A methalox derivative of the original pressure-fed Kestrel engine used on the upper stage of the Falcon 1 launch vehicle. Features multi-ignition capability and a limited throttling range.
zh: 衍生自最初挤压循环“茶隼”发动机的甲烷氧版本，用于“猎鹰1号”运载火箭上面级。具备多次点火能力和有限的节流范围。

s: A Soviet gas generator hypergolic vacuum engine designed for the return stage of the E-8-5 lunar sample return probes. With only one ignition, a very precise trajectory is required.
zh: 一款为<<M0>>月球采样返回探测器返回级设计的苏联燃气发生器循环自燃推进剂真空发动机。仅可单次点火，需要极高精度的轨道。

s: A Soviet pressure-fed hypergolic vacuum engine designed for Salyut-6 and Saylut-7. Also used on Mir and Zvezda.
zh: 一款为礼炮6号和礼炮7号设计的苏联挤压循环自燃推进剂真空发动机。也用于和平号和星辰号。

s: The vernier and landing engine for the LK-700S. Three were to be used as verniers on the TLI and Lunar injection stages, while another three would enable a controlled final descent for the LK-700S.
zh: 用于<<M0>>的游标与着陆发动机。其中三台计划在奔月注入和环月注入级段作为游标发动机使用，另外三台则可为<<M0>>提供受控的最终下降推进。

s: A Soviet gas generator hypergolic vacuum engine. Designed for use in the propulsion systems of the Mars and Venera 3MV, 4MV and 5MV spacecraft buses.
zh: 一款苏联燃气发生器循环自燃推进剂真空发动机。设计用于“火星”以及“金星”3MV、4MV和5MV飞船平台的推进系统。

s: A small pressure-fed hypergolic engine. Developed with the assistance of Rocketdyne to power the upper stage of the N-I rocket.
zh: 一款小型挤压循环自燃推进剂发动机。在Rocketdyne的协助下开发，用于为N-I火箭的上面级提供动力。

s: Light-Bulb Closed Cycle Gas Core Atomic Rocket Motor
zh: “灯泡”闭式循环气冷堆原子火箭发动机

s: A pressure-fed engine used for the ascent module of the Apollo lunar lander.
zh: 一款用于阿波罗登月舱上升级的挤压循环发动机。

s: A LOX/Kerosene gas generator engine designed for booster applications. Three gimbaled engines would have been used in the Navaho booster.
zh: 一款为助推应用设计的液氧/煤油燃气发生器循环发动机。“纳瓦霍”助推器本应采用三台带万向节的该型发动机。

s: The LR91 powered the second stage of Titan launchers. Exhaust from the gas generator provided roll control.
zh: <<M0>>曾为“大力神”运载火箭的第二级提供动力。来自燃气发生器的废气提供了滚转控制。

s: The first stage of the Minuteman ICBM, used in various proposed NASA launch vehicles as a solid booster. Burn time 75 seconds.
zh: “民兵”洲际弹道导弹的第一级，在NASA提出的多型运载火箭方案中被用作固体助推器。燃烧时间75秒。

s: A gas generator cycle hypergolic vacuum engine used on the Fregat upper stage series.
zh: 一种燃气发生器循环自燃推进剂真空发动机，用于“弗雷加特”（Fregat）上面级系列。

s: A staged combustion cycle hypergolic vacuum engine used on the Briz upper stage series.
zh: 一种分级燃烧循环自燃推进剂真空发动机，用于“微风”（Briz）上面级系列。

s: The ullage motor of the Saturn V S-II stage. Attaches to the upper part of the S-II interstage in sets of 4 to 8.
zh: 土星5号 S-II 级的沉底发动机。以4到8台为一组安装在 S-II 级间段的上部。

s: Ullage motor for the S-IV and S-IVB. Can be jettisoned after use to save weight.
zh: 用于 S-IV 和 S-IVB 的沉底发动机。使用后可抛弃以减轻重量。

s: Los Alamos "Small Engine" Atomic Rocket Motor
zh: 洛斯阿拉莫斯“小型发动机”核火箭发动机

s: The Los Alamos "Small Engine" was a compact nuclear thermal rocket derived from the PEWEE core. Designed to be used as a Space Shuttle upper stage, it has a unique folding nozzle to reduce length.
zh: 洛斯阿拉莫斯“小型发动机”是一种源自 PEWEE 反应堆堆芯的紧凑型核热火箭。设计用作航天飞机的上面级，拥有独特的折叠喷管以缩短长度。

s: An early Soviet Hall Effect thruster, used on Soviet and Russian weather satellites.
zh: 一种早期的苏联霍尔效应推力器，用于苏联和俄罗斯的气象卫星。

s: The first ever operational ion thruster, the SPT-60 Hall Effect thruster was first used in 1971 on Soviet Meteor weather satellites.
zh: 有史以来第一款实用的离子推力器，<<M0>> 霍尔效应推力器于1971年首次应用于苏联“流星”气象卫星。

s: A Hall effect ion thruster used on many commercial spacecraft for station keeping.
zh: 一种霍尔效应离子推力器，用于许多专注效益航天器的轨道维持。

s: The SPT-140 is an enlarged SPT-100 created to power large, modern communications satellites.
zh: <<M0>> 是 <<M1>> 的放大版本，旨在为现代大型通信卫星提供动力。

s: The SR19 is an improved Minuteman second stage developed for the LGM-30F Minuteman II.
zh: <<M0>> 是一种改进型“民兵”第二级，为 <<M1>> “民兵 II”研发。

s: A mid-sized apogee kick motor used on ATS-1/2/3.
zh: 一种用于 <<M0>>/2/3 的中型远地点变轨发动机。

s: The SR73 is an improved Minuteman third stage developed for the LGM-30F Minuteman II.
zh: <<M0>> 是一种改进型“民兵”第三级，为 <<M1>> “民兵 II”研发。

s: The Star 12A is a stretched Star 12 with improved propellant, for later, heavier satellites in the Keyhole series.
zh: Star 12A 是 Star 12 的加长型，采用了改进型推进剂，用于“锁眼”系列后期较重的卫星。

s: The Star 13A was developed in the mid-1960s as an apogee motor for Thor-Burner II.
zh: Star 13A 研发于1960年代中期，作为“雷神-燃烧室 II”的远地点发动机。

s: A small apogee kick motor used for geosynchronous satellites. It was used on the first geosynchronous satellite, Syncom 1.
zh: 一种用于地球同步卫星的小型远地点变轨发动机。曾用于第一颗地球同步卫星辛康1号（Syncom 1）。

s: A single STAR 15G motor, used in a variety of applications. This has a straight nozzle.
zh: 单台 STAR 15G 发动机，具有多种用途。配有直喷管。

s: A small apogee kick motor for satellites, introduced in 1968 on Delta 57. Max thrust 12.34kN, burn time 18 seconds.
zh: 一种用于卫星的小型远地点变轨发动机，于1968年随德尔塔57号首次亮相。最大推力 12.34kN，工作时间 18 秒。

s: An apogee kick motor developed by Morton Thiokol. Used by various small commsat busses.
zh: 由莫顿·塞奥科公司研发的远地点变轨发动机。用于多种小型通信卫星平台。

s: The STAR 37 is a vacuum solid rocket motor originally developed as a braking stage for the Surveyor lunar lander program. Later variants were used exclusively as apogee kick stages.
zh: STAR 37 是一种真空固体火箭发动机，最初作为“勘测者”登月探测器计划的制动级开发。后来的衍生型号专门用作远地点变轨级。

s: Developed for SpaceX Starlink satellites, this small but powerful hall effect thruster offers good thrust and moderate specific impulse. Uniquely, it was modified to run on Argon to reduce fuel costs.
zh: 为 <<M0>> “星链”卫星研发，这款小巧而强劲的霍尔效应推力器具有出色的推力和适中的比冲。独特的是，它改用氩气作为推进剂以降低燃料成本。

s: The Space Transportation Booster Engine (STBE) was a late 1980s to early 1990s booster engine design using JP-4 and liquid oxygen as its propellants.
zh: 空间运输助推器发动机（STBE）是1980年代末至1990年代初的一项助推器发动机设计，使用 <<M0>> 和液氧作为推进剂。

s: The Space Transportation Booster Engine (STBE) was a 1990s proposal for a highly reliable low cost booster engine for both expendable and reusable launch vehicles.
zh: 空间运输助推器发动机（STBE）是1990年代提出的一种高可靠性、低成本助推器发动机方案，适用于一次性及可重复使用的运载火箭。

s: A powerful hypergolic engine used in the launch abort system of the Dragon 2 capsule. Other potential applications include hypersonic deceleration and landing for crew and cargo modules.
zh: 一种强大的自燃推进剂发动机，用于龙飞船2号乘员舱的发射中止系统。其他潜在应用包括乘员舱和货运舱的高超音速减速与着陆。

s: A small apogee kick motor used for the Intelsat II series of geostationary satellites.
zh: 一种小型远地点变轨发动机，用于国际通信卫星II号系列地球静止卫星。

s: A small apogee kick motor used for the Intelsat III series of geostationary satellites.
zh: 一种小型远地点变轨发动机，用于国际通信卫星III号系列地球静止卫星。

s: A medium apogee kick motor used for the Intelsat IV and IVA series of geostationary satellites, as well as some early Comstar satellites.
zh: 一种中型远地点变轨发动机，用于国际通信卫星IV号和IVA系列地球静止卫星，以及部分早期的商星（Comstar）卫星。

s: A small apogee kick motor used for early SMS and GOES geostationary weather satellites.
zh: 一种小型远地点变轨发动机，用于早期的 SMS 和 GOES 地球静止气象卫星。

s: A 100 kW Applied-Field MPD thruster in development at the University of Stuttgart Institute of Space Systems. It set a thruster efficiency record of 61.99% in 2019.
zh: 由斯图加特大学空间系统研究所研发的 100 kW 外加磁场磁等离子体动力（AF-MPD）推力器。它在2019年创下了61.99%的推力器效率纪录。

s: The Mercury retro motor, intended to deorbit the capsule. Place 3 on the Mercury Retropack. These were fired in sequence at five second intervals.
zh: 水星号制动发动机，用于使乘员舱脱轨返回。在水星号制动包上安装3台。这些发动机按5秒的间隔依次点火。

s: An early French solid rocket engine used for the first stage of the Topaze sounding rocket and second stage of the Diamant A and B launch vehicles.
zh: 一种早期法国固体火箭发动机，用于“黄玉”（Topaze）探空火箭的第一级，以及“钻石”（Diamant）A 型和 B 型运载火箭的第二级。

s: 4 segment strap-on booster for proposed Saturn IB derivatives. Burn time 115s.
zh: 用于土星IB衍生方案的4分段捆绑助推器。工作时间 115 秒。

s: 5 Segment strap-on booster for Titan IIIC, IIID, IIIE, proposed for Saturn IB derivatives. Burn time 115s.
zh: 用于大力神 IIIC、IIID、IIIE 及土星IB衍生方案的5分段捆绑助推器。工作时间 115 秒。

s: 5.5 segment strap-on booster for Titan 34D and Commercial Titan III. Burn time 115s.
zh: 用于大力神 34D 和专注效益大力神 III 的5.5分段捆绑助推器。工作时间 115 秒。

s: Speculative 8 segment version of the UA107. Burn time 115s.
zh: <<M0>> 的推想型8分段版本。工作时间 115 秒。

s: A Wasserfall derivative engine developed by German and French engineers after WW2 for the sounding rocket of the same name. It was the first French high altitude sounding rocket.
zh: 二战后由德法两国工程师基于“瀑布”（Wasserfall）防空火箭发动机研发，用于同名探空火箭。这是法国第一枚高空探空火箭。

s: Vulcain is a gas-generator sustainer engine that was previously used on Ariane 5 and is now used on Ariane 6.
zh: “火神”（Vulcain）是一款燃气发生器循环主推进级发动机，曾用于阿里安5号，现用于阿里安6号。

s: The first proper VASIMR engine built by Ad Astra, the VX-200SS (Steady State) is built for long-term operation at a wide range of ISP and thrust, with multiple propellant options.
zh: Ad Astra 公司制造的第一款真正的 VASIMR 发动机，<<M0>>（稳态型）专为在宽范围的比冲和推力下长时间运行而设计，具有多种推进剂选项。

s: The Waxwing was a small solid kick motor for circularizing payloads in orbit, used as a third stage on the Black Arrow launch vehicle in 1970-71. 29.4kN average thrust.
zh: “田鸡”（Waxwing）是一种用于载荷入轨圆化的小型固体发动机，在1970至1971年间作为“黑箭”运载火箭的第三级使用。平均推力 29.4kN。

s: A very early kerolox gas generator booster engine used on the Vanguard launch vehicle.
zh: 一种非常早期的液氧煤油燃气发生器循环助推器发动机，用于“先锋”号运载火箭。

s: A small rocket motor intended to be used on the XF8U-3 for increased performance. Cancelled after the prototype exploded during testing and the XF8U-3 was cancelled in favor of the F4H.
zh: 一种旨在用于 <<M0>>-3 以提高性能的小型火箭发动机。原型机在测试期间爆炸，且 <<M0>>-3 项目被取消以支持 F4H，随后该发动机也被取消。

s: Americanized version of the V-2 Model 39 (A-4). It was very similar to its predecessor, but was built using American SAE components rather than metric components, and featured several minor upgrades.
zh: <<M0>> 型号39（<<M1>>）的美制版本。它与前代产品非常相似，但改用美国 SAE 英制部件而非公制部件制造，并进行了多项小幅升级。

s: A LOX/Ammonia gas generator engine which powered the X-15 spaceplane. It was the first large rocket engine capable of throttling and restarting.
zh: 一款驱动 <<M0>> 空天飞机的液氧/氨燃气发生器循环发动机。这是第一款具备节流和二次启动能力的大型火箭发动机。

s: Rocketdyne's pump-fed high performance upper stage engine for perigee/apogee stages, as well as transfer vehicles and lunar and Martian missions. It was tested extensively but has never flown.
zh: 洛克达因公司的泵压式高性能上面级发动机，用于近地点/远地点级，以及转移飞行器、月球与火星任务。它经过了广泛测试，但从未飞行过。

s: A linear aerospike engine developed for NASA's X-33 sub-scale SSTO technology demonstrator. Like the toroidal J-2T engines, the XRS-2200 used machinery derived from the J-2S.
zh: 专为 NASA 的 <<M0>> 缩比 SSTO 技术验证机研发的线性气动塞式喷管发动机。与环形 <<M1>> 发动机一样，<<M2>> 采用了源自 <<M3>> 的机械部件。

s: RB.162, used as the liftjet for the VAK 191B. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 1.66.
zh: RB.162，用作 VAK 191B 的升力喷气发动机。15 km 处的温度马赫数限制：1.66。

s: RD-012U, used on La-350 Burya. Design speed M3.1@18 km.
zh: <<M0>>，用于 <<M1>> 风暴（Burya）。设计速度 M3.1@18 km。

s: RD-36, as used on the production Tu-144D. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 3.19.
zh: <<M0>>，用于量产型 <<M1>>。15 km 处的温度马赫数限制：3.19。

s: RD-41, used as the liftjet for the Yak-141/41M. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 1.68.
zh: <<M0>>，用作 <<M1>>/41M 的升力喷气发动机。15 km 处的温度马赫数限制：1.68。

s: Early afterburning RD-9, as used on the MiG-19/S/PF/PM and early J-7 models. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.0.
zh: 早期加力型 <<M0>>，用于 <<M1>>/S/PF/PM 和早期 <<M2>> 型号。15 km 处的温度马赫数限制：2.0。

s: Afterburning RD-9, as used on the MiG-19R/SF. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.4.
zh: 加力型 <<M0>>，用于 <<M1>>/SF。15 km 处的温度马赫数限制：2.4。

s: Afterburning RD-9, as used on the Yak-27R/V. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.4.
zh: 加力型 <<M0>>，用于 <<M1>>/V。15 km 处的温度马赫数限制：2.4。

s: Afterburning RD-9 derivative, as used on early J-6 models. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.12.
zh: 加力型 <<M0>> 衍生型号，用于早期 <<M1>> 型号。15 km 处的温度马赫数限制：2.12。

s: Afterburning RD-9 derivative, as used on most J-6 models and early Q-5 models. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.23.
zh: 加力型 <<M0>> 衍生型号，用于大多数 <<M1>> 型号和早期 <<M2>> 型号。15 km 处的温度马赫数限制：2.23。

s: Afterburning RD-9 derivative, as used on the Q-5I, A-5 and JQ-5J. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.84.
zh: 加力型 <<M0>> 衍生型号，用于 <<M1>>、<<M2>> 和 <<M3>>。15 km 处的温度马赫数限制：2.84。

s: Afterburning RD-9 derivative, as used on the J-12I. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.36.
zh: 加力型 <<M0>> 衍生型号，用于 <<M1>>。15 km 处的温度马赫数限制：2.36。

s: RJ43-MA-3, as used on CIM-10 Bomarc A. Design speed M2.75@20 km.
RJ43-MA-5, as used on the X-7, XQ-5 and AQM-60A. Design speed M2.00@0 km.
RJ43-MA-11, as used on CIM-10 Bomarc B. Design speed M3.00@21 km.
XRJ47-W-5, used on SM-65 Navaho. Design speed M2.75@16.7 km.

zh: 15 km 处的温度马赫数限制：2.59。

s: XRJ59-MA-3, intended for the Convair Super Hustler, and tested on the X-7. Design speed M4.0@27.5 km.
zh: <<M0>>-<<M1>>，拟用于康维尔超级喧嚣（Super Hustler），并在 <<M2>> 上进行了测试。设计速度 M4.0@27.5 km。

s: Sapphire ASSa.6 Mk.101, as used on the Hunter F.2/F.5. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.2.
zh: 蓝宝石 ASSa.6 Mk.101，用于猎手 F.2/F.5。15 km 处的温度马赫数限制：2.2。

s: Sapphire ASSa.7 Mk.203, as used on the Javelin FAW.7. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.46.
zh: 蓝宝石 ASSa.7 Mk.203，用于标枪 FAW.7。15 km 处的温度马赫数限制：2.46。

s: VK-1, as used on the MiG-15Bis, MiG-17, and Il-28. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 1.81.
Welland RB.23. Reverse-flow centrifugal jet, as used on Meteor F.1. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 1.79.
zh: 威兰 RB.23。反流离心式喷气发动机，用于流星 F.1。15 km 处的温度马赫数限制：1.79。

s: WS-10, as used on the J-10B, J-11B, J-15 and J-16. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.64.
WS-10B, as used on the J-10C and J-20 prototypes. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 3.1.
zh: <<M0>>，用于 <<M1>> 和 <<M2>> 原型机。15 km 处的温度马赫数限制：3.1。

s: WS-10B with thrust vectoring, as used on a J-10B demonstrator and some J-20 variants. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 3.1.
zh: 带推力矢量的 <<M0>>，用于 <<M1>> 验证机和部分 <<M2>> 变体。15 km 处的温度马赫数限制：3.1。

s: Juno IV Block II second stage, converted to use ClF3 to increase performance.
zh: 朱诺 IV Block II 第二级，改装为使用 <<M0>> 以提高性能。

s: Juno IV Block I and Atlas-Vega third stage.
zh: 朱诺 IV Block I 与宇宙神-织女星第三级。

s: Developed for use as an N-1 upper stage. Cancelled with the N-1, but considered for use on Proton and Angara
zh: 设计用作 <<M0>> 上面级。随 <<M0>> 取消，但曾被考虑用于质子号和安加拉号。

s: AKA RD-56M. Upgraded model of the RD-56. Never saw use in the USSR, but was sold to India, and later license built in India. Poor overall reliability
zh: 亦称 <<M0>>。<<M1>> 的升级型号。从未在苏联使用，但出售给了印度，后来在印度获得许可生产。整体可靠性较差。

s: Natively developed Indian upgrade of the KVD-1 following embargos and poor performance. Used for GSLV Mk.II.
zh: 因禁运和性能不佳而在印度本土自主研发的 <<M0>> 升级型号。用于 GSLV Mk.II。

s: Gas generator hydrolox engine used for the H-I upper stage.
zh: 用于 H-I 上面级的燃气发生器循环液氢液氧发动机。

s: Converted to expander bleed cycle to increase performance for use on H-II.
zh: 改装为膨胀排放循环以提高性能，用于 H-II。

s: Simplified LE-5A to reduce cost for H-IIA
zh: 简化的 <<M0>>，用于降低 H-IIA 的成本。

s: Revised LE-5B to improve combustion stability after anomaly on H-IIA flight 5
zh: 改进型 <<M0>>，在 H-IIA 第 5 次飞行发生异常后用于提高燃烧稳定性。

s: Developed as a first stage engine for the Japanese H-II.
zh: 作为日本 H-II 的第一级发动机研制。

s: A redesigned nozzle extension allowed for the LE-7A to achieve its intended performance, at the cost of slightly more weight.
zh: 重新设计的喷管延伸段使 <<M0>> 达到了预期性能，代价是重量略有增加。

s: Used for deep space trajectory correction and planetary orbit insertion.
zh: 用于深空轨道修正和行星轨道捕获。

s: LMAE converted to run on Methalox for use on future manned Lunar and Martian landers. Developed and test fired, but cancelled in 2020 in favor of commercially developed landers.
zh: LMAE 改为使用甲烷液氧，拟用于未来的载人登月和火星着陆器。已研发并完成试车，但在 2020 年被取消，让位于商业研发的着陆器。

s: Lunar Module Descent Engine used up to Apollo 15
zh: 登月舱下降级发动机，使用至阿波罗 15 号。

s: LMDE upgraded for J-class missions. Improved performance and more fuel allowed the LEM to carry rovers and extra scientific equipment to the surface.
zh: 为 J 级任务升级的 LMDE。更高的性能和更多的推进剂使登月舱能够携带月球车和额外的科学设备前往月表。

s: Simplifed LMDE used on Delta-P as an upper stage engine.
zh: 简化的 LMDE，在德尔塔-P 上用作上面级发动机。

s: First production version. Used on Thor and Atlas as vernier engines
zh: 第一批量产版本。在雷神和宇宙神上用作游标发动机。

s: Developed for later, larger Thor variants, with improved performance

zh: （推想的煤油燃烧型）<<M0>>-<<M1>> 的推想上面级构型，膨胀比与 <<M2>>-<<M1>> 相同。

s: First stage engine for Titan IVA and IVB. Equipped with a nozzle extension to improve vacuum performance, since it was not needed at sea level.
zh: 大力神 IVA 和 IVB 的第一级发动机。配备了喷管延伸段以改善真空性能，因为其无需在海平面点火。

s: Speculative LR87-AJ-11A with a shortened nozzle extension for sea-level operation.
zh: 推想的 <<M0>>-<<M1>>，配有缩短型喷管延伸段用于海平面工作。

s: Speculative upper-stage version of the LR87-AJ-11A with the same expansion ratio as the LR91-AJ-11A.
zh: <<M0>>-<<M1>> 的推想上面级构型，膨胀比与 <<M2>>-<<M1>> 相同。

s: Speculative config using equivalent technology to the -AJ-11A but burning Kerosene and LOX for purely civilian applications.
zh: 采用与 -<<M0>> 同等技术、专为纯民用领域燃烧煤油和液氧的推想构型。

s: Speculative config using equivalent technology to the -AJ-11A but burning Kerosene and LOX for purely civilian applications. Uses shortened nozzle extension of the AJ23-138 for sea level use.
zh: 采用与 -<<M0>> 同等技术、专为纯民用领域燃烧煤油和液氧的推想构型。采用 <<M1>>-138 的缩短型喷管延伸段用于海平面工作。

s: Speculative upper-stage version of the (speculative, kerosene-burning) LR87-AJ-11A with the same expansion ratio as the LR91-AJ-11A.
zh: （推想的煤油燃烧型）<<M0>>-<<M1>> 的推想上面级构型，膨胀比与 <<M2>>-<<M1>> 相同。

s: MA-0 and prototype MA-1 Atlas Booster engine, converted to burn kerosene. Used on Convair X12 and Atlas A
zh: <<M0>> 与原型机 <<M1>> 宇宙神助推器发动机，改为燃烧煤油。曾用于康维尔 X12 和宇宙神 A。

s: MA-1 Atlas booster engine. Significantly upgraded and simplified, with both engines sharing turbopumps. Used on Atlas B/C
zh: <<M0>> 宇宙神助推器发动机。经过大幅升级与简化，两台发动机共用涡轮泵。用于宇宙神 B/C。

s: MA-3 Atlas booster engine. Each engine had its own turbopump allow for engines to be quickly swapped. Developed for the USAF for Atlas D
zh: <<M0>> 宇宙神助推器发动机。每台发动机都配备独立的涡轮泵以便快速更换。专为美国空军的宇宙神 D 研制。

s: MA-3 Atlas booster engine. Slightly upgraded for Atlas E/F
zh: <<M0>> 宇宙神助推器发动机。针对宇宙神 E/F 进行了小幅升级。

s: MA-5.1 booster engine. Both engines shared turbopumps due to NASA preferring that configuration. Used for Atlas-Agena launches
zh: <<M0>>.1 助推器发动机。由于 NASA 更倾向于共用构型，两台发动机共用涡轮泵。曾用于宇宙神-阿金纳发射。

s: Atlas MA-5A booster engine. Upgraded with RS-27 components to reduce cost and improve performance. Used on Atlas II
zh: 宇宙神 <<M0>> 助推器发动机。采用 <<M1>> 的部件升级以降低成本并提升性能。用于宇宙神 II。

s: AJ23-129, second stage engine for Titan I ICBMs built before May 1960.
zh: <<M0>>-129，用于 1960 年 5 月之前建造的大力神 I 洲际弹道导弹的第二级发动机。

s: AJ23-131, second stage engine for Titan I ICBMs built after May 1960.
zh: <<M0>>-131，用于 1960 年 5 月之后建造的大力神 I 洲际弹道导弹的第二级发动机。

s: AJ23-133, second stage engine of Titan II. Modified to burn Aerozine50 and Nitrogen Tetroxide to allow storage for long periods of time.
zh: <<M0>>-133，大力神 II 的第二级发动机。改进为燃烧 <<M1>> 和四氧化二氮，以支持长期储存。

s: Speculative config using equivalent technology to the -AJ-5 but burning Kerosene and LOX for purely civilian applications.
zh: 采用与 -<<M0>> 同等技术、专为纯民用领域燃烧煤油和液氧的推想构型。

s: AJ23-135, second stage engine of Titan II GLV. Modified for the Gemini program to reduce chances of failure and make the engine safer.
zh: <<M0>>-135，双子座运载火箭（Titan II GLV）的第二级发动机。针对双子座计划进行了改进，降低了故障率并提高了安全性。

s: Speculative config using equivalent technology to the -AJ-7 but burning Kerosene and LOX for purely civilian applications.
zh: 采用与 -<<M0>> 同等技术、专为纯民用领域燃烧煤油和液氧的推想构型。

s: AJ23-137, second stage engine for Titan IIIA, IIIB and IIIC. Longer burn time and slightly higher performance for the stretched fuel tank of Titan III.
zh: <<M0>>-137，大力神 IIIA、IIIB 和 IIIC 的第二级发动机。燃烧时间更长，性能略有提升，以适应大力神 III 的加长推进剂贮箱。

s: AJ23-140, second stage engine for Titan 24B, 34B, IIIBS, IIID, 34D, 34D7 and IIIE. Slightly improved performance.
zh: <<M0>>-140，用于大力神 24B、34B、IIIBS、IIID、34D、34D7 和 IIIE 的第二级发动机。性能略有提升。

s: Second stage engine for Titan IVA and IVB. Slightly improved thrust.
zh: 大力神 IVA 和 IVB 的第二级发动机。推力略有提升。

s: Block I Phase II baseline LRBE.
zh: Block I Phase II 基线液体助推发动机（LRBE）。

s: In development for use on Vega-E
zh: 正在研发中，拟用于织女星-E（Vega-E）。

s: Initial version of the M-1, generating 1.2 mlbf of thrust
zh: <<M0>> 的初始型号，产生 120 万磅推力。

s: Production version of the M-1, generating 1.5 mlbf of thrust
zh: <<M0>> 的量产型号，产生 150 万磅推力。

s: 1990s proposal to convert the M-1 into a sea level sustainer engine for super-heavy launch vehicles
zh: 20 世纪 90 年代提出的方案，旨在将 <<M0>> 改造成用于超重型运载火箭的海平面主发动机。

s: M-1, uprated to 1.8 mlbf. All M-1 components were designed to handle 1200 psi chamber to allow this upgrade.
zh: <<M0>>，推力提升至 180 万磅。所有 <<M0>> 部件的设计均能承受 1200 psi 的燃烧室压力以支持此次升级。

s: Sea level M-1, but running at 1200 psi chamber pressure.
zh: 海平面构型的 <<M0>>，但燃烧室压力运行在 1200 psi。
用于猎鹰 9 号 v1.2（全推力版）。

s: Used on Falcon 9 v1.2 (Full Thrust and Block 5)
zh: 用于猎鹰 9 号 v1.2（全推力版与 Block 5）。

s: Also known as NAA75-65, XLR43-NA-1 is the USAF service designation. Used for early Navaho applications.
zh: 亦称 <<M0>>-65，<<M1>>-<<M2>> 为其美国空军服役编号。用于早期的纳瓦霍计划。

s: Main production variant for Redstone missile, very similar to USAF XLR43-NA-1 / NAA75-65, except with longer burn time.
zh: 红石导弹的主要量产改型，与美国空军的 <<M0>>-<<M1>> / <<M2>>-65 非常相似，但燃烧时间更长。

s: Later production variant for Redstone missile, also used on Mercury-Redstone with stretched propellant tanks and extra HTP.
zh: 红石导弹的后期量产型号，也用于水星-红石火箭，推进剂贮箱加长并增加了过氧化氢（HTP）储量。

s: A-6 engine converted to run Hydyne as fuel, used on Jupiter-C sounding rocket and Juno I launch vehicle.
zh: 改为使用 Hydyne 为燃料的 <<M0>> 发动机，曾用于丘比特-C 探空火箭和朱诺一号运载火箭。

s: Developed as the first stage engine of the N-1 moon rocket. Gimbal, differential throttle.
zh: 研制用作 <<M0>> 登月火箭的第一级发动机。具备万向节与差动节流阀。

s: Developed as the first stage engine of the N-1 moon rocket. No gimbal, differential throttle.
zh: 研制用作 <<M0>> 登月火箭的第一级发动机。无万向节，具备差动节流阀。

s: A Chinese hypergolic gas generator vacuum engine. Derived from the Isayev S2.1100 Burya booster engine, the YF-3 is a vacuum variant created for the second stage of the DF-4 and Long March 1.
zh: 一款中国自燃推进剂气动发生器真空发动机。衍生自伊萨耶夫S2.1100“风暴”助推器发动机，<<M0>>是为<<M1>>和长征一号第二级研制的真空型号。

s: A Chinese hypergolic gas generator vacuum engine. A YF-22 engine and YF-23 vernier form the YF-24 engine unit used on the second stage of the DF-5, FB-1, and Long March 2/3/4 rockets.
zh: 一款中国自燃推进剂气动发生器真空发动机。一台<<M0>>发动机与一台<<M1>>游机组成了<<M2>>动力单元，用于<<M3>>、<<M4>>以及长征二号/三号/四号火箭的第二级。

s: A Chinese hypergolic gas generator vacuum engine with verniers. A YF-22 engine and YF-23 vernier form the YF-24 engine unit used on the second stage of the DF-5, FB-1, and Long March 2/3/4 rockets.
zh: 一款带游机的中国自燃推进剂气动发生器真空发动机。一台<<M0>>发动机与一台<<M1>>游机组成了<<M2>>动力单元，用于<<M3>>、<<M4>>以及长征二号/三号/四号火箭的第二级。

s: A Chinese hypergolic gas generator vacuum engine, created for the 3rd stage of the Long March 4. Later versions had restart capability.
zh: 一款中国自燃推进剂气动发生器真空发动机，为长征四号第三级研制。后期型号具备多次启动能力。

s: The first operational Chinese hydrolox gas generator vacuum engine. Used on the third stage of the Long March 3. Low performance and unreliable, it was replaced by the YF-75 after 13 flights.
zh: 中国首款投入实用的氢氧气动发生器真空发动机。用于长征三号第三级。因性能较低且可靠性不足，在执行13次飞行任务后被<<M0>>取代。

s: An early 50s turbojet which served as the powerplant for the Su-7, Su-9, Su-11, Tu-128, and Be-10 flying boat.
zh: 一款50年代初期的涡轮喷气发动机，曾作为<<M0>>、<<M1>>、<<M2>>、<<M3>>以及<<M4>>水上飞机的动力装置。

s: The Atar 101 was one of the first jet engines developed in France following WW2. It was used in many early French jet aircraft, including the Vautour I/II, Gerfaut I, and Mystère II.
zh: 阿塔101是二战后法国研制的最早一批喷气发动机之一。它曾用于许多早期法国喷气式飞机，包括秃鹰I/II、苍鹰I和神秘II。

s: The Chimera is a combined cycle ramjet tech demonstrator built by Hermeus. Based around retired J85 cores, it is intended to operate over a flight envelope from Mach 0 to Mach 5.
zh: 奇美拉是Hermeus公司制造的组合循环冲压发动机技术验证机。它基于退役的J85核心机研制，设计飞行包线覆盖马赫0至马赫5。

s: The D-18 was the largest high-bypass turbofan developed in the Soviet Union, created in the 1980s for the An-124 and An-225.
zh: <<M0>>是苏联研制的最大高涵道比涡扇发动机，于20世纪80年代为<<M1>>和<<M2>>研制。

s: A large, 16 kW electric ducted fan. Very powerful for it's size, but fixed pitch propeller blades limit it to low speeds.
zh: 一款大型16 kW电动涵道风扇。就其尺寸而言动力十分强劲，但定距螺旋桨叶片限制了其飞行速度。

s: The EJ200 is a 1990s low-bypass turbofan, designed as a joint venture between many European companies for the Eurofighter Typhoon.
zh: <<M0>>是一款20世纪90年代的低涵道比涡扇发动机，由多家欧洲公司联合为台风战斗机研制。

s: The GEnx is a 2000s large, high-bypass turbofan, developed from the GE90 to power the B787. It is used in most 787 variants, as well as in the 747-8.
zh: GEnx是一款2000年代的大型高涵道比涡扇发动机，由<<M0>>发展而来，旨在为<<M1>>提供动力。它用于大多数787型号以及747-8。

s: An early 1950s turbojet, developed from the earlier J35 by General Electric. It powered the F-86, FJ-2, B-36, B-45, and B-48.
zh: 一款1950年代初期的涡轮喷气发动机，由通用电气在早期J35的基础上研制。它曾为<<M0>>、<<M1>>、<<M2>>、<<M3>>和<<M4>>提供动力。

s: The J57 was a workhorse, designed in the early 1950s and powering the B-52, most of the Century Series fighters, and even the U-2.
zh: J57是一款功勋主力发动机，于1950年代初期设计，为<<M0>>、大多数“百系列”战斗机乃至<<M1>>提供动力。

s: Designed in the late 1950s, the J58 was redesigned and repurposed for one use: Mach 3+ aircraft like the A-12 / SR-71A/B / YF-12A. Also known by it's civilian designation, JT11.
zh: J58于1950年代末期设计，后经过重新设计并转用于单一用途：为<<M0>>/<<M1>>/B/<<M2>>等3马赫以上飞机提供动力。亦称民用型号<<M3>>。

s: Essentially a larger J57, the P&W J75 saw extensive military and civilian use. It was used on the F-105, F-106, F-107, XF8U-3, A-12, U-2, P6M, and the 707 and DC-8 as the JT4A.
zh: 普惠J75本质上是放大的J57，曾广泛应用于军用和民用领域。它用于<<M0>>、<<M1>>、<<M2>>、<<M3>>-3、<<M4>>、<<M5>>、P6M，并以<<M7>>的代号用于707和<<M6>>。

s: The first US "Mach 2" engine, the J79 saw extensive service, powering the B-58, F-4, A-5, and F-104.
zh: 作为美国第一款“2马赫”发动机，J79服役广泛，曾为<<M0>>、<<M1>>、<<M2>>和<<M3>>提供动力。

s: Derived from the J79, the J93 was developed for Mach 3 performance to power the B-70 and F-108.
zh: J93衍生自J79，专为3马赫性能研制，用以驱动<<M0>>和<<M1>>。

s: The NK-12 was a large 1950s turboprop. Created to power the Tu-95, it is the largest turboprop to enter production. It powered the A-90, An-22, Tu-95, Tu-114, Tu-116, Tu-126, and Tu-142.
zh: <<M0>>是一款1950年代的大型涡轮螺旋桨发动机。专为驱动<<M1>>而生，它是投产的最大涡轮螺旋桨发动机。曾为<<M2>>、<<M3>>, <<M1>>、<<M4>>、<<M5>>、<<M6>>和<<M7>>提供动力。

s: The NK-25 was a 1970s low-bypass turbofan, developed from the earlier NK-22. It is the most powerful supersonic jet engine ever flown, and was used to power the Tu-22M3, Tu-160, Tu-160M and Tu-144LL.
zh: <<M0>>是一款1970年代的低涵道比涡扇发动机，由早期的<<M1>>发展而来。它是飞行动力最强劲的超音速喷气发动机，曾用于驱动<<M2>>、<<M3>>、<<M4>>和<<M5>>。
北方1500/阿塔组合循环冲压发动机

s: A late 60s turbojet. Developed to replace the R-11 and R-13, the R-25 added an extremely powerful "extra-power" afterburner, that allowed it to nearly double it's thrust for short periods of time.
zh: 一款60年代晚期的涡轮喷气发动机。为取代<<M0>>和<<M1>>而研制，<<M2>>增加了极其强劲的“超功率”加力燃烧室，使其能够在短时间内将推力提升近一倍。

s: The RD-012 was a supersonic ramjet, designed to power the La-350 Burya cruise missile up to Mach 3.1.
zh: <<M0>>是一款超音速冲压发动机，旨在驱动<<M1>>“风暴”巡航导弹达到3.1马赫。

s: The RJ47 was a supersonic ramjet, designed to power the SM-64 Navaho cruise missile up to Mach 2.75.
zh: <<M0>>是一款超音速冲压发动机，旨在驱动<<M1>>“纳瓦霍”巡航导弹达到2.75马赫。

s: An early 1950s turbojet. Derived from the MetroVick F.2, the first axial-flow jet developed in Britain, the Sapphire powered the Hawker Hunter, Handley Page Victor, and Gloster Javelin.
zh: 一款1950年代初期的涡轮喷气发动机。蓝宝石衍生自英国研制的第一款轴流式喷气发动机<<M0>> F.2，曾为霍克猎手、汉德利·佩季胜利者和格罗斯特标枪提供动力。

s: A Soviet-built derivative of the Nene used in many early Soviet jet aircraft, including the MiG-15, MiG-17, Tu-14, and Il-28.
zh: 苏联生产的尼恩衍生型号，用于许多早期苏联喷气式飞机，包括<<M0>>、<<M1>>、<<M2>>和<<M3>>。

s: The Welland was an early 1940s turbojet, developed from Frank Whittle's original jet engine, the W.1. It was used on the Meteor F.1, but was quickly replaced by later, more powerful jet engines.
zh: 韦兰德是一款1940年代初期的涡轮喷气发动机，由弗兰克·惠特尔设计的首款喷气发动机W.1发展而来。它曾用于流星F.1，但很快被后期性能更强劲的喷气发动机取代。

s: Central Research Institute of Machine Building (ЦНИИмаш)
Khrunichev State Research and Production Space Center (ГКНПЦ)
zh: 赫鲁尼切夫国家科研生产航天中心（GKNPTs）
雷宾斯克发动机设计局（RKBM）

s: Scientific Research Institute of Thermal Processes (НИИТП)

zh: 库尔恰托夫原子能研究所（KIAE）
英国飞机公司与法国宇航
弹道与空气动力学研究实验室（LRBA）
奥托布伦空间推进中心
佩内明德陆军研究中心

s: Company for the Study and Production of Ballistic Devices (SÉREB)
zh: 弹道装置研制与生产公司（SÉREB）
法国国家航空发动机制造公司（SNECMA）

s: Institute of Space and Astronautical Science (ISAS)

zh: 日本宇宙航空研究开发机构（JAXA）

s: National Space Development Agency of Japan (NASDA)
Academy of Aerospace Liquid Propulsion Technology (AALPT)
UR-500/Proton third stage main engine, used with RD-0214 verniers to form the RD-0212 engine module. AKA 8D48
zh: <<M0>>/质子号三级主发动机，与<<M1>>游标发动机组合构成<<M2>>发动机模块。又名8D48

s: UDMH/LOX version of RD-0213. Much higher performance, but requires cryogenic fuels.
zh: <<M0>>的偏二甲肼/液氧版本。性能大幅提升，但需要使用低温燃料。

s: Uprated RD-0213 to allow Proton to launch Salyut 6/7 and Mir.
zh: <<M0>>的增推型号，使质子号能够发射礼炮6号/7号和和平号空间站。

s: UDMH/LOX version of RD-0213 Mk-2. Much higher performance, but requires cryogenic fuels.
zh: <<M0>><<M1>>的偏二甲肼/液氧版本。性能大幅提升，但需要使用低温燃料。

s: UDMH/LOX version of RD-0213 Mk-3. Much higher performance, but requires cryogenic fuels.
zh: <<M0>><<M1>>的偏二甲肼/液氧版本。性能大幅提升，但需要使用低温燃料。

s: UR-200 second stage verniers, used with RD-0206 main engine to form the RD-0205 engine module. AKA 8D67
zh: <<M0>>二级游标发动机，与<<M1>>主发动机组合构成<<M2>>发动机模块。又名8D67

s: UDMH/LOX version of RD-0207. Much higher performance, but requires cryogenic fuels.
zh: <<M0>>的偏二甲肼/液氧版本。性能大幅提升，但需要使用低温燃料。

s: UR-500/Proton third stage verniers, used with RD-0213 main engine to form the RD-0212 engine module. AKA 8D811
zh: <<M0>>/质子号三级游标发动机，与<<M1>>主发动机组合构成<<M2>>发动机模块。又名8<<M3>>

s: UDMH/LOX version of RD-0214. Much higher performance, but requires cryogenic fuels.
zh: <<M0>>的偏二甲肼/液氧版本。性能大幅提升，但需要使用低温燃料。

s: Used on the UR-100 first stage. Three RD-0216 and one RD-0217 make up a 15D2 engine block.
zh: 用于<<M0>>第一级。三台<<M1>>和一台<<M2>>组成一个15D2发动机组。

s: Used on Blok I and II of the LK-700, alongside KTDU-416 verniers.
zh: 用于<<M0>>的Blok I和Blok II级，与<<M1>>游标发动机并用。

s: Used on the UR-100N second stage, with a RD-0236 vernier engine. A.K.A. 15D113
zh: 用于<<M0>>第二级，配有一台<<M1>>游标发动机。又名15<<M2>>

s: Second stage engine module of R-36M and R-36MUTTKh, consisting of a RD-0229 main engine and RD-0230 vernier. AKA 15D84
zh: <<M0>>和<<M1>>的二级发动机模块，由一台<<M2>>主发动机和一台<<M3>>游标发动机组成。又名15D84

s: Second stage engine module of R-36M2 and Dnepr, consisting of a RD-0256 main engine and RD-0257 vernier.
zh: <<M0>>和第聂伯号的二级发动机模块，由一台<<M1>>主发动机和一台<<M2>>游标发动机组成。

s: Second stage main engine of R-36M and R-36MUTTKh. AKA 15D79
Second stage main engine of R-36M2 and Dnepr.
zh: <<M0>>和第聂伯号的二级主发动机。

s: Second stage verniers of R-36M and R-36MUTTKh. AKA 15D83
Second stage verniers of R-36M2 and Dnepr.
zh: <<M0>>和第聂伯号的二级游标发动机。

s: Second stage verniers of UR-100N and UR-100NUTTKh. AKA 15D114
8D51, Soviet derivative of the A-4/Model 39 for the R-1 missile, with simplified construction and increased thrust.
zh: 8D51，苏联为<<M1>>导弹基于<<M0>>/Model 39研制的衍生型号，简化了结构并提高了推力。

s: 8D52, improved RD-100 for the R-2 missile. Also built under license in China as the 5D52 for the DF-1 missile.
zh: 8D52，用于<<M1>>导弹的改进型<<M0>>。中国亦获许可生产，型号为用于<<M2>>导弹的5D52。

s: Improved RD-101, developed for the R-3A missile. Cancelled due to changing priorities in Soviet missile development.
zh: 改进型<<M0>>，为<<M1>>导弹研制。后因苏联导弹研发重点的调整而取消。

s: 8D54, improved RD-101, developed for the R-5 missile.
8D71, mass production version of the RD-103.
Chinese derivative of the RD-101/5D52 for the DF-2A missile, developed after the Sino-Soviet split led to Soviet technical assistance being withdrawn.
zh: 中国为<<M1>>导弹研制的<<M0>>/5D52衍生型号，是在中苏交恶导致苏联撤出技术援助后研发的。

s: Used on Soyuz-U 11A511U and Soyuz-U2 11A511U2 (also known as RD-117)
zh: 用于联盟-U号11<<M0>>和联盟-U2号11<<M1>>（亦称<<M2>>）

s: RD-117 converted to run on Syntin. In reality, only the core used Syntin to save costs
zh: 改为使用辛烷（Syntin）燃料的<<M0>>。实际上为了节约成本，仅芯级使用了Syntin

s: Used on Soyuz-FG and Soyuz-2. Switching to a modern injector based on the RD-111 greatly improves engine performance.
zh: 用于联盟-FG和联盟-2。换装基于<<M0>>的现代喷注器后大幅提升了发动机性能。

s: Used on Soyuz-U 11A511U (also known as RD-118)
Used on Soyuz-U2 11A511U2 (also known as RD-118P)
Used on Soyuz-FG/ST and Soyuz-2. Switching to a modern injector based on the RD-111 greatly improves engine performance.
zh: 用于联盟-FG/ST和联盟-2。换装基于<<M0>>的现代喷注器后大幅提升了发动机性能。

s: Upper stage for Kosmos-2 (11K63). Warning: only rated for 90 minutes before restart.
zh: 用于宇宙-2号（11K63）的上面级。警告：两次启动间的额定间隔时间仅90分钟。

s: Initial production RD-111, running on saturated liquid oxygen because OKB-456 did not have equipment capable of handling subcooled liquid oxygen.
zh: 早期量产型<<M0>>，使用饱和液氧，因为<<M1>>当时缺少处理过冷液氧的设备。

s: RD-111 using subcooled liquid oxygen and redesigned injectors for better performance.
zh: 使用过冷液氧并重新设计了喷注器的<<M0>>，性能更佳。

s: Used on Energia liquid rocket boosters
zh: 用于能源号液体火箭助推器

s: Used on Zenit, a rocket derived from Energia boosters
zh: 用于天顶号，这是一种由能源号助推器衍生而来的火箭

s: Uprated RD-171 for the Vulkan ("Volcano"), baseline for the RD-180, RD-191 and it's derivatives.
zh: 为火神号（"Volcano"）增推的<<M0>>，也是<<M1>>、<<M2>>及其衍生型号的技术基础。

s: Modernized model for use on Zenit
zh: 用于天顶号的现代化型号

s: Modified for the Antares to replace the NK-33.
zh: 为安塔瑞斯号改装以替换<<M0>>。

s: No gimbal, planned to replace the NK-33 on Soyuz 2-1v.
zh: 无万向节，计划在联盟2-1v上替换<<M0>>。

s: First multi-chamber engine designed by Glushko, basis of RD-107/108 and RD-214
zh: 格鲁什科设计的第一款多燃烧室发动机，是<<M0>>/108和<<M1>>的基础
暴风雪号巡航导弹的原型机

s: Engine for the R-12U (8K63S) and Kosmos-2 (11K63)
Used on R-36 and Tsiklon-2 8K65M as RD-251
Used on Tsiklon-2M and Tsiklon-3 11K68 as RD-261
11D43. Original RD-253 as used on the UR-500.
11D41. UDMH/AK27 version of RD-253. Higher thrust, at the cost of efficiency.
zh: 11D41。<<M0>>的偏二甲肼/AK27版本。以牺牲效率为代价换取了更高的推力。

s: 11D31. UDMH/LOX version of RD-253. Much higher performance, but requires cryogenic fuels.
zh: 11D31。<<M0>>的偏二甲肼/液氧版本。性能大幅提升，但需要使用低温燃料。

s: Uprated RD-253 as used on early Proton launches.
zh: 用于早期质子号发射的增推型<<M0>>。

s: Uprated to allow Proton to launch the core module of Mir.
zh: 增推型号，使质子号能够发射和平号的核心舱。

s: Mid-90s upgrade to improve performance of Proton
zh: 旨在提升质子号性能的<<M0>>升级型号

s: RD-254 prototype (extrapolated from early RD-253 performance).
zh: <<M0>>原型机（由早期<<M1>>的性能推算而来）。

s: 11D42. UDMH/AK27 version of RD-254. Higher thrust, at the cost of efficiency.
zh: 11D42。<<M0>>的偏二甲肼/AK27版本。以牺牲效率为代价换取了更高的推力。

s: 11D32. UDMH/LOX version of RD-254. Much higher performance, but requires cryogenic fuels.
zh: 11D32。<<M0>>的偏二甲肼/液氧版本。性能大幅提升，但需要使用低温燃料。

s: RD-254, as designed for use on the upper stages of the UR-700.
UDMH/AK27 version of RD-254. Higher thrust, at the cost of efficiency.
zh: <<M0>>的偏二甲肼/AK27版本。以牺牲效率为代价换取了更高的推力。

s: UDMH/LOX version of RD-254. Much higher performance, but requires cryogenic fuels.
zh: <<M0>>的偏二甲肼/液氧版本。性能大幅提升，但需要使用低温燃料。
设想中70年代中期的<<M0>>升级型号。
设想中80年代中期的<<M0>>升级型号。

s: Speculative mid-90s upgrade for RD-254, based on RD-275.
zh: 设想中90年代中期的<<M0>>升级型号，基于<<M1>>。

s: Speculative 2000s upgrade for RD-254, based on RD-275M.
zh: 设想中2000年代的<<M0>>升级型号，基于<<M1>>。

s: Four RD-263s form the RD-264 15D119 engine module of the R-36M first stage.
zh: 四台<<M0>>构成<<M3>>第一级的<<M1>> 15<<M2>>发动机模块。

s: Used on first stage of the MR-UR-100 alongside a RD-863 vernier engine. No Gimbal.
zh: 用于MR-<<M0>>第一级，配有一台<<M1>>游标发动机。无万向节。

s: A.K.A. RD263F. Four RD-273s form the RD-274 15D285 engine module of the R-36M2 and Dnepr first stage.
zh: 又名<<M0>>。四台<<M1>>构成<<M4>>和第聂伯号第一级的<<M2>> 15<<M3>>发动机模块。

s: RD-270 converted to run on kerosene and liquid oxygen, proposed to replace N-1 first stage engines, or power UR-700M.
zh: 改为使用煤油和液氧的<<M0>>，曾提议用于替换<<M1>>的一级发动机，或为<<M2>>提供动力。

s: Designed for upper stages of N-1M. Tested extensively, but never flew as the N-1 program was cancelled.
zh: 为<<M0>>的上面级设计。经过了广泛测试，但因<<M1>>计划取消而从未飞行。

s: Improved performance with extendable nozzle for use on "Vesuvius" upper stage of Vulkan.
zh: 采用延伸喷管提升性能，用于火神号的“维苏威”（Vesuvius）上面级。

s: Demonstrator model made in collaboration with Aerojet. Extensive weight reduction and a redesigned nozzle for SSTO use.
zh: 与喷气飞机公司（Aerojet）合作研制的技术验证型号。大幅减重并重新设计了喷管，适用于单级入轨（SSTO）。

s: Developed version of S1.5400 engine for the Blok ML and Blok MVL stage of the Molniya-M launch vehicle. Slightly better performance.
zh: 为闪电-M运载火箭的Blok ML和Blok MVL级研制的S1.5400改进型发动机。性能略有提升。

s: The S1.5400A engine, as used on Block 2BLM of the Molniya launch vehicle. Further performance improvements.
zh: 用于闪电号运载火箭Blok 2BLM级的S1.5400A发动机。性能得到进一步改善。

s: Upgrade developed for use on the Blok D stage of the N-1, and later used on Proton. Significant upgrade over the S1.5400
zh: 为<<M0>>的Blok D级研制的升级型号，后来用于质子号。相比S1.5400有显著提升

s: Modification of the RD-58 for use on Proton Blok DM, after the N-1 was cancelled.
zh: 在<<M1>>取消后，为质子号Blok DM级改装的<<M0>>。

s: China Academy of Launch Vehicle Technology (CALT)
zh: 中国运载火箭技术研究院 (CALT)

s: Shanghai Second Bureau of Electromechanical Industry
zh: 上海市第二机电工业局
印度斯坦航空有限公司 (HAL)
国家航空航天技术开发局 (NADA)
朝鲜宇宙空间技术委员会 (KCST)

s: This adjustable ramp intake works best between Mach 1.0 and Mach 3.0.
zh: 该可调节坡度进气道在 1.0 马赫至 3.0 马赫之间工作效果最佳。

s: This pitot intake works best between Mach 0 and Mach 1.5.
zh: 该皮托管进气道在 0 马赫至 1.5 马赫之间工作效果最佳。

s: This shock cone intake works best between Mach 1.5 and Mach 3.0. This one is similar to the intake used on the English Electric Lightning.
zh: 该锥形进气道在 1.5 马赫至 3.0 马赫之间工作效果最佳。与英国电气“闪电”战斗机所用的进气道相似。

s: This shock cone intake works best between Mach 1.5 and Mach 3.0. This one is similar to the intake used on the MiG-21.
zh: 该锥形进气道在 1.5 马赫至 3.0 马赫之间工作效果最佳。与<<M0>>所用的进气道相似。

s: This shock cone intake works best between Mach 1.5 and Mach 3.0. This one is similar to the intake used on the X-7.
zh: 该锥形进气道在 1.5 马赫至 3.0 马赫之间工作效果最佳。与<<M0>>所用的进气道相似。

s: This shock cone intake works best between Mach 1.5 and Mach 3.0.
zh: 该锥形进气道在 1.5 马赫至 3.0 马赫之间工作效果最佳。
1.25m 机身（无附面层隔道进气道）

s: This diverterless supersonic intake works best between Mach 0 and Mach 2.0.
zh: 该无附面层隔道超音速进气道在 0 马赫至 2.0 马赫之间工作效果最佳。

s: Realism Overhaul completely changes parts, so it itself only supports Sandbox play. RP-1 provides Realism Overhaul with a career mode, please install that if you wish to play career or science mode.
zh: Realism Overhaul 彻底重构了部件，因此其自身仅支持沙盒模式。<<M0>> 为 Realism Overhaul 提供了生涯模式支持，若想体验生涯或科学模式，请安装该模组。

s: Used on the UR-100 second stage. One 15D13 and one 15D14 make up a DU-419/8D419 propulsion unit.
zh: 用于<<M0>>二级。一台 15D13 和一台 15D14 构成一个<<M1>>/8<<M2>>推进单元。

s: Modified 15D13, intended for use as the ascent/return engine on the LK-700S. More reliable, with restart capability.
zh: 15D13 的改进型，旨在用作<<M0>>的上升/返回发动机。可靠性更高，具备再点火能力。

s: Sustainer engine of A-350Zh Anti-Ballistic Missile. Capable of rapid restart under high dynamic pressure for rapid upper atmosphere manuevers.
zh: <<M0>>反导拦截弹的巡航级发动机。具备在高动压下快速再点火的能力，用于高层大气的迅速机动。

s: Interim mass-production version of the Model 39 for the A-4 Series B/V-2
zh: Model 39 的过渡性量产版本，用于<<M0>> B 系列/<<M1>>

s: "Interkontinental" version of the Model 39c, for the A-9/A-10 upper stage. Decreased thrust and increased Isp for upper stage use, and special engine modifications to allow air-starting.
zh: Model 39c 的“洲际”版本，用于<<M0>>/<<M1>>上面级。降低了推力并提高了比冲以适应上面级使用，并经过特殊改装以支持空中点火。

s: Prototype engine, used on the Hermes A-3A (RV-A-8) test vehicle.
zh: 原型发动机，用于赫尔墨斯<<M0>>（RV-<<M1>>）测试飞行器。

s: Uprated engine for the Hermes A-3B (SSM-A-16) missile.
zh: 用于赫尔墨斯<<M0>>（SSM-<<M1>>）导弹的升推改进型发动机。

s: A RATO booster modified to be used on the WAC-Corporal for the US Army
zh: 经过改装供美国陆军“下士”火箭（WAC-Corporal）使用的火箭助推起飞（RATO）助推器

s: Developed for the Aerobee X-8, an improved WAC-Corporal for upper atmosphere research to replace the limited stocks of captured V-2s
zh: 为“火箭气象探测仪”（Aerobee）<<M0>>研制，该火箭是改进型 WAC-Corporal，用于高层大气研究以替代数量有限的缴获<<M1>>

s: Improved XASR-1 with helium pressurization to improve performance.
zh: 改进型<<M0>>，采用氦气增压以提高性能。

s: Developed as an upgrade to the XASR-1. Continued to be used until the 1980s for meteorlogical studies.
zh: 作为<<M0>>的升级型号研制。一直使用至 20 世纪 80 年代用于气象研究。

s: Developed privately in collaboration with Rocketdyne. Turbopump system from XLR-32 added, allowing much higher performance. A.K.A RS-72
zh: 与洛克达因（Rocketdyne）合作私下研制。增加了源自<<M0>>的涡轮泵系统，大幅提升了性能。亦称<<M1>>

s: Upgrade for the Agena SPS developed by TRW, using an electric pump system to allow it to draw directly from the Agena fuel tanks.
zh: 由 TRW 研制的阿金娜（Agena）SPS 升级型号，采用电动泵系统使其能直接从阿金娜燃料箱抽取推进剂。

s: Upgrade for the Agena SPS developed by TRW, using an electric pump system to allow it to draw directly from the Agena fuel tanks. HDA version.
zh: 由 TRW 研制的阿金娜（Agena）SPS 升级型号，采用电动泵系统使其能直接从阿金娜燃料箱抽取推进剂。HDA（高密度酸）版本。

s: Derived from the XLR67 used on the RASCAL missile, the Model 117 was intended to power an improved air to surface missile for the B-58 Hustler.
zh: 衍生自“拉斯考”（RASCAL）导弹上使用的<<M0>>，Model 117 旨在为<<M1>>“盗贼”轰炸机配备的改进型空对地导弹提供动力。

s: Model 8001, Agena A Prototypes. Effectively a Model 117 with gimbal added, this engine was poorly optimized for upper stage use and only flew twice on the earliest Agena launches.
zh: Model 8001，阿金娜 A（Agena A）原型。实际上是增加了万向节的 Model 117，该发动机针对上面级工况的优化较差，仅在最早的两次阿金娜发射中飞行过。

s: Model 8048, Agena A. Switched to higher performance hypergolic fuels and featured an larger nozzle for better vacuum performance. Cavitating venturis improved thrust regulation.
zh: Model 8048，阿金娜 A（Agena A）。改用更高性能的自燃推进剂，并具有更大的喷管以获得更好的真空性能。空化文丘里管改善了推力调节。

s: Model 8081, Agena B. Increase burn time and a short nozzle extension increased performance for Agena B. Also featured a restart cartridge to allow restart in space.
zh: Model 8081，阿金娜 B（Agena B）。延长的燃烧时间和短喷管延伸段提高了阿金娜 B 的性能。还配备了再点火启动药筒以支持在轨重启。

s: Model 8096, Agena D. Improved injectors and a larger nozzle extension improved performance for Agena D. This was the most-produced variant of Agena, flying hundreds of times.
zh: Model 8096，阿金娜 D（Agena D）。改进的喷注器和更大的喷管延伸段提升了阿金娜 D 的性能。这是阿金娜产量最高的改型，飞行了数百次。

s: A.K.A. XLR81-BA-13, or Model 8247. Add reusable start tanks, developed for GATV, to allow for up to 14 restarts of the XLR81.
zh: 亦称<<M0>>-<<M1>>，或 Model 8247。增加了为 GATV 研制的可复用启动箱，使<<M0>>最多可进行 14 次再点火。

s: Agena D HDA. Converted to use high density acid oxidizer to increase performance. Cannot restart between 15 minutes and 3 hours after shutdown.
zh: 阿金娜 D（Agena D）HDA。改用高密度酸氧化剂以提高性能。关机后 15 分钟至 3 小时之内无法再点火。

s: Add reusable start tanks, developed for GATV, to allow for up to 14 restarts of the XLR81.
zh: 增加了为 GATV 研制的可复用启动箱，使<<M0>>最多可进行 14 次再点火。

s: Improved Model 8096 for Titan-Agena, including longer life and higher performance injectors developed for Shuttle-Agena. Cannot restart between 15 minutes and 3 hours after shutdown.
zh: 用于大力神-阿金娜（Titan-Agena）的改进型 Model 8096，包括为航天飞机-阿金娜研制的长寿命和更高性能喷注器。关机后 15 分钟至 3 小时之内无法再点火。

s: Add reusable start tanks, developed for GATV, to allow for up to 14 restarts of the XLR81. Cannot restart between 15 minutes and 3 hours after shutdown.
zh: 增加了为 GATV 研制的可复用启动箱，使<<M0>>最多可进行 14 次再点火。关机后 15 分钟至 3 小时之内无法再点火。

s: Higher expansion ratio nozzle prototype. Cannot restart between 15 minutes and 3 hours after shutdown.
zh: 大面积比喷管原型。关机后 15 分钟至 3 小时之内无法再点火。

s: Reusable Agena for STS, featuring much larger nozzle, a large number of restarts, and higher performance. Cannot restart between 15 minutes and 3 hours after shutdown.
zh: 用于航天飞机（STS）的可复用阿金娜，拥有更大的喷管、多次再点火能力和更高性能。关机后 15 分钟至 3 小时之内无法再点火。

s: Improved reusable Agena for STS. Reduced weight, fuel mix modified for better compatibility with shuttle, and turbopump material modified to remove restart limits.
zh: 用于航天飞机（STS）的改进型可复用阿金娜。减轻了重量，修改了燃料配比以更好地适配航天飞机，并改进了涡轮泵材料以消除再点火限制。

s: Ultimate reusable Agena for STS. Reduced weight and thrust to increase Isp, nearly unlimited restarts, and extremely long life.
zh: 用于航天飞机（STS）的终极可复用阿金娜。降低了重量和推力以提高比冲，几乎不受限的再点火次数，以及极长的工作寿命。

s: Agena upgrade for proposed Atlas V upper stage. Tested, but cancelled when studies showed it would be more economical to use single engine centaur instead.
zh: 为拟议中的宇宙神 V（Atlas V）上面级设计的阿金娜升级版。经过测试，但随后研究表明使用单发半人马座（Centaur）更为经济，因而被取消。

s: Liquid Fluorine based design, proposed for use on the GE D-2 Apollo vehicle, and later high performance Agena tugs.
zh: 基于液氟的设计，曾提议用于通用电气（GE）<<M0>>阿波罗飞行器，以及后续的高性能阿金娜拖船。

s: Upper Stage engine used on the Titan Transtage
zh: 用于大力神过渡级（Transtage）的上面级发动机

s: Improved Transtage Injector Program, upgraded AJ10-138 used for later Transtage launches.
zh: 改进型过渡级喷注器计划（ITIP），用于后期过渡级发射的升级版<<M0>>-138。

s: Upper stage engine for the Delta-K
zh: 用于德尔塔-K（Delta-K）的上面级发动机

s: AJ10 variant burning liquid hydrogen and oxygen, proposed for use on the Hylas upper stage. Extremely low chamber pressure and autogeneous pressurization system allows conventional tanks to be used.
zh: 燃烧液氢液氧的<<M0>>改型，提议用于海拉斯（Hylas）上面级。极低的燃烧室压力和自生增压系统允许其使用常规贮箱。

s: AJ10 variant burning liquid hydrogen and oxygen, proposed for use on the GE D-2 Apollo vehicle.
zh: 燃烧液氢液氧的<<M0>>改型，曾提议用于通用电气（GE）<<M1>>阿波罗飞行器。

s: Developed for the upper stage of the Vanguard launch vehicle.
zh: 为先锋号（Vanguard）运载火箭上面级研制。

s: The final version of the J-2 that flew on the Saturn, the 230k variant flew starting with Apollo 8, SA-208 and all subsequent flights.
zh: 土星运载火箭所用 <<M0>> 的最终型号，230k 改型自阿波罗 8 号、<<M1>> 及之后的所有飞行任务开始采用。

s: J93-GE-3, as used on the XB-70. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 3.35.
AL-31F, as used on the Su-27, Su-30M/MKI, and J-11A. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.7.
AL-31FM with thrust vectoring, as used on the Su-27SM, Su-30 and Su-34. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.7.
zh: 带推力矢量的 <<M0>>，用于 <<M1>>、<<M2>> 及 <<M3>>。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.7。

s: AL-41F-1S with thrust vectoring, as used in the Su-35 and Su-30SM2. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.67.
zh: 带推力矢量的 <<M0>>，用于 <<M1>> 和 <<M2>>。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.67。
